title: Learning to Orchestrate Evolutionary Search: Progression-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic DE-CMA-ES Coordination in Optimization and Structural Model Updating
summary: Solving high-dimensional structural model updating problems requires an algorithm capable of navigating complex, non-convex landscapes with correlated parameters. Existing hybrid evolutionary algorithms typically rely on static architectures or fixed switching rules, resulting in disjointed search phases. To address this, this study proposes a Deep Reinforcement Learning-governed dynamic DE-CMAES Orchestration (DRL-DCO) algorithm, in which a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based actor-critic agent continuously governs the evolutionary process as a single, unified system rather than a mechanical concatenation of algorithms. Guided by a progression-aware state representation and a diversity-informed reward, the agent fluidly reallocates computational resources between the differencevector-based exploration of Differential Evolution (DE) and the covariance-guided exploitation of CMA-ES, while jointly regulating population size, elite preservation, and a restart mechanism to escape local optima. This allows DRL-DCO to autonomously transition between exploration-dominant, exploitation-dominant, and mixed-strategy regimes across generations. Beyond the training phase, the trained actor can operate in a supervision-free inference mode, where the internalized policy autonomously orchestrates DE and CMA-ES control from observed search states through forward inference alone, without critic evaluation or weight updates, enabling faster deployment while retaining full effectiveness. Validated on high-dimensional single-objective optimization benchmarks and the IASC-ASCE structural health monitoring benchmark, DRL-DCO achieves superior convergence accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art adaptive and hybrid evolutionary algorithms, as well as single-operator DRL-governed baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DRL-DCO算法，用深度强化学习（DDPG）统一调度DE与CMA-ES，实现高维结构模型修正中的动态探索-开发平衡。
AI.motivation: 高维结构模型修正问题具有复杂非凸、参数相关的搜索空间。现有混合进化算法多依赖静态架构或固定切换规则，导致搜索阶段割裂、难以自适应协调探索与开发。
AI.method: 以DDPG的actor-critic智能体将进化过程作为统一系统进行持续调度，而非机械拼接算法。采用进程感知状态表示与多样性引导奖励；智能体在DE的差分向量探索与CMA-ES的协方差引导开发之间动态分配算力，并联合调控种群规模、精英保留与重启机制。训练完成后，actor可进入无监督推理模式，仅凭前向推断自主调度，无需critic评估与权重更新。
AI.result: 在高维单目标优化基准与IASC-ASCE结构健康监测基准上验证，DRL-DCO在收敛精度与鲁棒性上优于当前先进的适应性与混合进化算法，以及单算子DRL调度基线。
AI.conclusion: DRL-DCO通过强化学习统一编排DE与CMA-ES，可自主在探索主导、开发主导与混合策略间切换，并支持高效无监督部署，是求解高维结构模型修正的有效方案。

title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
summary: Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgenticBBO-Bench，一个统一预算协议下的跨领域代理式黑盒优化基准，覆盖五个领域，系统评估代理方法性能及三个关键设计因素，并提供前沿挑战任务。
AI.motivation: 黑盒优化中目标评估昂贵且受限，LLM 代理结合任务语义、计算与优化工具展现潜力。但已有代理式 BBO 研究使用不同任务域与系统配置，结果难以比较、单个设计选择的影响难以隔离，因此需要一个统一基准。
AI.method: 构建 AgenticBBO-Bench 跨领域基准，涵盖合成函数、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计与分子设计，采用统一的有限预算评估协议；实验对比代理式 BBO 与直接 LLM 方法及最佳数值优化器；并消融分析三个因素：优化工具、任务信息与先验知识、搜索中 LLM 的作用；最后提出五任务前沿挑战并在 Codex 代理框架下评测七个 LLM。
AI.result: 代理式 BBO 在全部五个领域的族平均得分高于直接 LLM 方法，并在四个领域优于最佳数值优化器。消融结果显示：额外数值工具并非一致提升性能；任务语义普遍有用而更具体的先验较不可靠；数值优化器能有效吸收代理所建立搜索轨迹的收益。前沿挑战中，GPT-6 Astra 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 处于性能与成本的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: AgenticBBO-Bench 为代理式黑盒优化提供了统一可比较的评测平台，揭示设计因素的非平凡作用，并指出代理搜索与数值优化结合的有效路径。代码已开源。

title: LIFT: A Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer for Unified Retrieval and Ranking
summary: Cascaded recommender systems use the same user history for retrieval and ranking, while the two stages have access to different information at different points of an interaction. We propose the Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer (LIFT), which decomposes each interaction into ordered Request, Item, Context, and Action states and models them as a causal sequence. Retrieval reads the Request state, while ranking reads the Context state, allowing both tasks to share history modeling while preserving stage-specific information. LIFT instantiates this representation with Role-Conditioned Attention and a lightweight Pre-LN Bias. On ML-20M and Taobao, LIFT achieves the highest Joint Score among the evaluated joint models, improving over the strongest baselines by 4.9% and 3.6%, respectively. Loss-weight sweeps show favorable retrieval--ranking trade-offs, while ablations and scaling analyses further examine lifecycle sequence construction, model components, and capacity settings.

AI.tldr: 提出LIFT（Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer），将交互分解为Request、Item、Context、Action四状态的因果序列，使检索与排序共享历史建模又保留阶段特异信息。
AI.motivation: 级联推荐系统中，检索与排序使用相同用户历史，但两阶段在不同交互时刻可获取的信息不同，存在信息错配问题。
AI.method: 将每次交互分解为有序的Request、Item、Context、Action状态并建模为因果序列；检索读取Request状态，排序读取Context状态；以Role-Conditioned Attention与轻量Pre-LN Bias实例化该表示。
AI.result: 在ML-20M与Taobao上，LIFT在所评估的联合模型中取得最高Joint Score，较最强基线分别提升4.9%和3.6%；损失权重扫描显示良好的检索-排序权衡，消融与扩展性分析进一步考察了生命周期序列构建、模型组件与容量设置。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期感知的状态分解能在保持阶段特异信息的同时实现统一的历史建模，为级联推荐中检索与排序的联合优化提供了有效方案。

title: Learning Multi-Step Query Rewriting via Corpus Feedback for Conversational Search
summary: Conversational Query Rewriting (CQR) turns a context dependent user turn into a standalone query for a retriever, and most methods do this in a single step from the dialogue history before retrieving once. The rewrite is therefore fixed before any corpus evidence is available to correct its reference resolution or its vocabulary. We recast CQR as a sequential retrieval problem: an agent rewrites the current turn, retrieves, and conditions its next rewrite on the returned passages. The agent acts in a typed space of three rewriting operations, resolving conversational intent into a standalone query, generating lexical reformulations, or synthesizing pseudo-documents for document-to-document matching, together with a stop action that ends the episode. We train the policy with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning against a single retrieval-quality reward, using no human rewrite annotations. Across TopiOCQA and QReCC, the agent outperforms several retrieval-aligned baselines, while remaining effective across retrieval backends and generalizing to the CAsT benchmarks without additional training. Further analysis shows that, through retrieval-reward optimization alone, the learned policy develops a behavior of grounding pseudo-documents in passages retrieved by earlier steps, substantially improving retrieval.

AI.tldr: 论文将对话式查询改写（CQR）重构为序贯检索问题，智能体通过改写-检索-再改写的迭代循环，在无人工改写标注下显著提升检索效果。
AI.motivation: 现有CQR方法大多在检索前单步完成改写，改写结果在获得语料证据前即被固定，无法借助检索到的文档来纠正指代消解或词汇选择上的错误。
AI.method: 将CQR建模为序贯检索：智能体在由三类改写操作（生成独立查询、词汇重述、合成伪文档以进行文档-文档匹配）及停止动作组成的类型化空间中行动，先监督微调，再以单一检索质量奖励进行强化学习，不使用人工改写标注。
AI.result: 在TopiOCQA与QReCC数据集上优于多个检索对齐基线，对多种检索后端保持有效，并无需额外训练即可泛化至CAsT基准。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过检索奖励优化，策略即可学会将伪文档锚定于早期步骤检索到的段落，从而大幅提升检索性能。

title: H2CE: Modeling Geo-Semantic Interactions for POI Reranking with Heterogeneous Two-Stage Cross-Encoders
summary: Point-of-Interest (POI) reranking in local search must model query-conditioned tradeoffs among lexical semantics, geospatial proximity, and numerical quality signals such as rating and review count, while remaining practical under real-time serving constraints. A close POI may only partially satisfy the query intent, while a farther one may offer stronger semantic and quality evidence. We present H2CE, a Heterogeneous Two-stage Cross-Encoder for latency-bounded POI reranking. H2CE represents numerical attributes in two complementary ways: bucketized natural-language descriptors are inserted into the cross-encoder input to support semantic--numeric attention, while exact scalar values are processed by dedicated MLPs to preserve magnitude information. The resulting semantic and numerical embeddings are fused through latent-space aggregation, enabling nonlinear interactions beyond scalar weighted sums. H2CE then applies a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 scores all candidates pointwise for scalable filtering, and Stage 2 performs head-to-head pairwise comparison among the top-$K$ candidates with Copeland aggregation, making fine-grained relative tradeoffs explicit while reducing pairwise cost from O(N^2) to O(N+K(K-1)). On a 5,743-query local search test set, H2CE achieves 67.48% NDCG@5, improving over XGBoost LTR by +22.82% absolute and over a zero-shot LLM reranker by +35.89%. The pairwise stage adds +1.98% NDCG@5 over the pointwise model alone. Ablations confirm the value of numerical features, latent aggregation, top-K pairwise reranking, and aligned training.

AI.tldr: 提出H2CE异构两阶段交叉编码器，在实时延迟约束下对POI进行重排序，融合语义与数值信号并用top-K成对比较显式建模查询条件下的权衡关系，在5,743条查询测试集上取得67.48% NDCG@5。
AI.motivation: 本地搜索中的POI重排序需在词法语义、地理邻近性与评分/评论数等数值质量信号之间建立查询条件下的权衡：近处POI可能只部分满足查询意图，较远POI则可能具备更强的语义与质量证据。现有方法难以兼顾非线性交互建模与实时serving的延迟约束，且全量成对比较成本过高。
AI.method: H2CE采用异构两阶段交叉编码器：数值属性以互补双路表示——分桶后的自然语言描述符插入交叉编码器输入以支持语义-数值注意力，精确标量值则由专用MLP处理以保留量级信息；两路得到的语义与数值嵌入经隐空间聚合融合，实现超越标量加权和的非线性交互。架构上，Stage 1对所有候选做pointwise打分以实现可扩展过滤，Stage 2对top-K候选进行成对（pairwise）比较并采用Copeland聚合，将成对开销从O(N²)降至O(N+K(K-1))。
AI.result: 在5,743条查询的本地搜索测试集上，H2CE达到67.48% NDCG@5，较XGBoost LTR绝对提升+22.82%，较零样本LLM重排序器提升+35.89%；成对阶段在纯pointwise模型基础上额外带来+1.98% NDCG@5。消融实验验证了数值特征、隐空间聚合、top-K成对重排序与对齐训练的有效性。
AI.conclusion: H2CE通过数值双路表示、隐空间聚合与两阶段（pointwise+top-K pairwise）架构，在满足延迟约束的同时显式建模语义-地理-质量的细粒度权衡，显著优于LTR与零样本LLM重排序基线。

title: EVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embeddings for Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Accurate and scalable visual document retrieval (VDR) requires both fine-grained page understanding and efficient indexing, yet existing approaches struggle to achieve both. OCR-based text retrieval adds preprocessing latency and can lose visual and structural cues needed to understand complex pages. Single-vector vision-language models bypass OCR, but compressing an entire page into one vector limits the granularity of query--document matching. Multi-vector retrievers with MaxSim provide finer interactions, yet demand large indexes and still leave room for accuracy improvements. We argue that overcoming these limitations requires preserving query-relevant page evidence throughout representation learning and index construction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{\textit{EVIE}} (Evidence-Vector-Informed Embeddings), a family of native visual document retrievers integrating three key innovations: (1) Evidence-judged data governance, which uses a multimodal judge to identify answer-bearing positives and filter unreliable negatives. (2) Bidirectional teacher--student learning with symmetric listwise distillation and prefix-based Matryoshka representation learning (Prefix-MRL), enabling one student checkpoint to serve six nested embedding dimensions without re-encoding. (3) Hierarchical agglomerative index compression (HAC), which clusters page tokens with spatial regularization and stores semantic centroids for single-stage MaxSim retrieval. Extensive experiments across 138 tasks from ViDoRe V1, V2, V3, and JinaVDR validate EVIE. EVIE-8B achieves 66.75 nDCG@10 on V3, exceeding the best external baseline by 1.43 points, with a four-suite average of 79.51. EVIE-4.5B with HAC retains 59.58 nDCG@10 at only 3.81 GiB per million pages, reducing vector payload by $128\times$. Together, these results improve the accuracy--storage trade-off for visual document retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出EVIE系列原生视觉文档检索器，通过证据判定数据治理、双向师生蒸馏与Prefix-MRL、以及层次凝聚索引压缩三项创新，在精度与存储间取得更优权衡，EVIE-8B在V3上达66.75 nDCG@10。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉文档检索方法难以兼顾细粒度页面理解与高效索引：基于OCR的文本检索增加预处理延迟且丢失视觉与结构线索；单向量视觉语言模型虽免OCR，但整页压缩为单向量限制匹配粒度；MaxSim多向量检索器交互更细，却索引庞大且精度仍有提升空间。核心问题在于需要在表示学习与索引构建全过程中保留查询相关的页面证据。
AI.method: EVIE包含三项关键创新：(1) 证据判定数据治理，用多模态评判器识别含答案的正样本并过滤不可靠负样本；(2) 双向师生学习，结合对称listwise蒸馏与基于前缀的Matryoshka表示学习（Prefix-MRL），使单个学生检查点无需重编码即可服务六种嵌套嵌入维度；(3) 层次凝聚索引压缩（HAC），对页面token进行带空间正则的聚类并存储语义质心，用于单阶段MaxSim检索。
AI.result: 在ViDoRe V1、V2、V3和JinaVDR共138项任务上验证：EVIE-8B在V3上达66.75 nDCG@10，超最佳外部基线1.43分，四套件平均79.51；EVIE-4.5B配合HAC仅需3.81 GiB每百万页即保持59.58 nDCG@10，向量负载减少128倍。
AI.conclusion: EVIE通过将查询相关页面证据贯穿表示学习与索引构建，同时提升视觉文档检索的精度与存储效率，改善了准确率与存储之间的权衡。

title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) Task
summary: In this paper, we provide an overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) task. Building on the success of the NTCIR-18 core task AEOLLM, we proposed AEOLLM-2 for NTCIR-19 to further investigate automatic evaluation methods for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly in long-form text generation scenarios. In AEOLLM-2, we introduced a new subtask, Deep Research Evaluation, which focuses on the automatic evaluation of long-form deep research reports generated by LLMs. Participants developed evaluation methods to automatically assess the quality of these reports, and the performance of each method was measured by comparing its scores against human-annotated ground-truth labels. This year, we received 91 runs from 10 teams in total. This paper describes the background of the task, the dataset construction, the evaluation measures, the participants' methods, and the final evaluation results.

AI.tldr: 本文概述NTCIR-19 AEOLLM-2任务，聚焦LLM长文本生成的自动评估，新增"深度研究报告评估"子任务，共收到10支团队91个run。
AI.motivation: 延续NTCIR-18核心任务AEOLLM的成功，进一步探索LLM自动评估方法，特别是长文本生成场景下的评估难题。
AI.method: 提出AEOLLM-2任务，新增Deep Research Evaluation子任务，面向LLM生成的长篇深度研究报告；参赛者构建自动评估方法，以人工标注的ground-truth标签为基准，通过评分对比衡量各方法性能。
AI.result: 共收到来自10支团队的91个run，并给出最终评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统介绍了任务背景、数据集构建、评估指标、参赛方法及最终评测结果，为LLM长文本自动评估提供了基准与参考。

title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
summary: Similar agent skills can share instructions but differ in their conditions of use. Query-based text selection may retain shared instructions and omit these distinctions. We introduce SkillContrast, a training-free selector that compares retrieved skills and retains their differing text with local context for a pretrained reranker. On 1,235 requests from SameCapRisk-Bench, it yields 54-72 more clean hits (requests that retrieve a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling) than TF-IDF query selection at identical per-candidate input lengths, across 2 retrievers and 2 reranker sizes. Length-matched component replacements identify differing text as the main contributor in the primary setting, with smaller, mixed context effects. Relative to full skill bodies, SkillContrast uses 51.1-58.8% fewer model-input tokens, with 10-18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed clean-hit counts at 4B. Candidate-relative differences thus complement query relevance in selecting compact reranking inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练选择器 SkillContrast，通过对比检索到的相似技能、保留差异文本及局部上下文供重排序器使用，在技能选择任务上优于基于查询的 TF-IDF 选择。
AI.motivation: 相似智能体技能往往共享指令，但使用条件不同；基于查询的文本选择可能保留共享指令而遗漏这些区分性条件，导致检索到有帮助技能的同时也命中有风险的"兄弟"技能。
AI.method: SkillContrast 是一种免训练选择器：对检索到的技能进行两两对比，提取其差异文本并附加局部上下文，输入预训练重排序器。在 SameCapRisk-Bench 的 1,235 条请求上评测，采用固定每候选输入长度，并做等长组件替换消融。
AI.result: 相比 TF-IDF 查询选择，在 2 种检索器与 2 种重排序器规模下，clean hits 提升 54-72 次。等长组件替换表明差异文本是主要贡献因素，上下文效应较小且方向不一。相比完整技能正文，模型输入 token 减少 51.1-58.8%；0.6B 模型下 clean hits 少 10-18 次，4B 模型下持平或更高。
AI.conclusion: 候选相对差异可补充查询相关性，用于选择紧凑的重排序输入，在显著降低输入长度的同时保持甚至提升选择质量。

title: Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index. ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR)，一种多模态检索模型，可交替检索条目并更新查询嵌入，使查询表示能根据反馈动态细化，最终用于排序。通过逐步对比监督微调与基于最终倒数排名的强化学习训练，ARR在域内与零样本基准上均取得领先，并证明反馈既提升推理时检索，也改善初始查询嵌入。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态检索通常将查询编码一次后基于嵌入相似度独立排序，虽然高效，但即便检索结果有助于澄清信息需求，查询表示也不会改变，限制了检索的进一步优化。
AI.method: ARR在检索与查询嵌入更新之间交替，使用最终嵌入对集合排序；采用逐步对比监督进行监督微调，以教导编码器利用反馈；并以反馈条目为动作，使用相关项最终倒数排名进行强化学习优化，同时通过查询侧适配器在固定条目索引上实现该优化。
AI.result: ARR在域内和零样本基准上表现强劲，平均超过对比基线；分析显示反馈在推理阶段可提升检索效果，且带反馈训练也能在观察任何条目之前改进初始查询嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 查询表示可通过检索反馈进行自回归细化，结合监督与强化学习优化能在多模态检索中带来显著收益，并同时增强初始查询嵌入质量。

title: Chaos in the Text: Revealing the Modality Preference in Mixed-Modality Retrievers
summary: Dense retrievers have made significant progress on text and image corpora, but whether these capabilities extend reliably to mixed corpora containing text, image, and fused text-image documents remains unclear. In this paper, we systematically examine retrievers across architectures and find that their performance is highly sensitive to modality composition. As image documents are progressively replaced with semantically corresponding text representations, retrieval performance follows a pronounced V-shaped curve, remaining strong on single-modality corpora but degrading substantially when modalities coexist. In particular, irrelevant text causes more severe degradation than an equal number of irrelevant images, a phenomenon we term Chaos in the Text. Further analysis reveals modality preference, whereby text representations receive systematically higher similarity scores, allowing irrelevant text to outrank relevant images. To mitigate this bias, we introduce Trident, which constructs text, image, and fused text-image views of each document as co-equal positives and jointly optimizes relevance discrimination and positive-view balance through Multi-Positive View InfoNCE. Experiments across visual document and natural image benchmarks show that trident improves mixed-modality retrieval on both CLIP-based and VLM-based architectures, reduces sensitivity to modality composition and text distractors, and increases average single-modality retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统考察了稠密检索器在文本、图像及文本-图像融合构成的混合语料上的表现，发现性能对模态组成高度敏感并呈V型曲线，提出利用多正视图InfoNCE的Trident方法缓解模态偏好偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密检索器在纯文本或纯图像语料上表现优异，但其能力能否可靠迁移到包含文本、图像及融合文档的混合语料尚不明确，需要系统检验架构与模态组成对检索性能的影响。
AI.method: 跨多种架构系统评测检索器在不同模态组成下的表现；分析模态偏好的成因；提出Trident方法，为每篇文档构建文本、图像、融合三种共等正视图，并通过Multi-Positive View InfoNCE联合优化相关性判别与正视图平衡。
AI.result: 随着图像文档被语义对应的文本表示逐步替换，检索性能呈显著V型曲线，单模态语料表现强而模态共存时明显下降；无关文本造成的退化比等量无关图像更严重，称为Chaos in the Text；文本表示获得系统性更高的相似度分数，使无关文本可超越相关图像。
AI.conclusion: Trident在视觉文档与自然图像基准上均能提升CLIP类与VLM类架构的混合模态检索性能，降低对模态组成和文本干扰项的敏感性，并提升平均单模态检索表现。

title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
summary: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.

AI.tldr: 提出"Project Greenhouse"，主张仅用有限算力即可构建完全开放且自主的智能体搜索模型；首个里程碑是用"从零预训练+有监督微调"两步法构建了具备竞争力的逐点解码器式重排序模型，且不依赖第三方开放权重底座，全部实验仅用少量GPU，并开源数据、代码、配置与Gaggle系列模型检查点。
AI.motivation: 文献主流做法依赖第三方开放权重底座模型，导致训练过程无法端到端自主掌控；作者希望验证使用适度计算资源即可构建完全开放、自主可控的智能体搜索模型这一论点。
AI.method: 采用两步配方：从零开始预训练（pre-training from scratch），随后进行有监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）；仅使用常见公开数据集，不使用任何第三方开放权重骨干网络，模型为逐点（pointwise）解码器式重排序器；全部实验在少量GPU上完成。
AI.result: 成功构建了具有竞争力的逐点解码器式重排序模型，验证了在有限算力下从零训练可行；并开源了数据、代码、配置以及Gaggle系列模型检查点，支持透明、独立的复现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了以有限计算资源、不依赖第三方底座、端到端自主训练的方式构建开放智能体搜索模型的可行性，为验证其更广泛论点迈出第一步，并强调开放与可复现性价值。

title: NativeScope: Relation-Localized Retrieval over Native Topology with a Correct Anchor
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with reproduction information and an evidence inventory
summary: Dense retrieval usually ranks text chunks by their semantic similarity to a question. This ignores structure that many data systems already store, including section membership, session boundaries, and native order. We propose NativeScope, a scope-then-rank method for queries with a known anchor and relation. It represents a query as q -> (A, r, B). The anchor A and relation r select native units through belonging, before, or after operators, and the target term B ranks only chunks that overlap the selected scope. An internal variant, NS-FullQ, ranks the same candidates with the full question. We evaluate both methods on 200 controlled document and memory records derived from QASPER and LongMemEval under a 1,024-token budget. NativeScope attains native-unit recall of 89.28 percent for documents and 72.50 percent for memories, improving over instance-wide Dense RAG by 42.75 and 22.00 percentage points. NS-FullQ reaches 87.78 percent and 68.50 percent; its differences from NativeScope are inconclusive, locating the primary gain in relational scoping rather than the shorter ranking query. With automatic Top-1 anchors, memory recall falls to 35.50 percent. NativeScope is therefore effective when anchor coordinates and native relations are reliable, but hard scoping inherits errors from the localization interface.

AI.tldr: 提出 NativeScope 的"先定范围、再排序"检索方法：用 q -> (A, r, B) 结构，先以锚点 A 与关系 r 通过 belonging/before/after 算子选出原生单元，再用目标词 B 仅在所选范围内排序，在文档与记忆检索上显著优于实例级 Dense RAG。
AI.motivation: 密集检索通常仅依据文本块与问题的语义相似度排序，忽略了数据系统中已存在的结构信息，如章节归属、会话边界与原生顺序，导致检索范围过大、噪声干扰。
AI.method: 提出 NativeScope：将查询表示为 q -> (A, r, B)，锚点 A 与关系 r 通过 belonging、before、after 算子选出原生单元，目标词 B 仅在所选范围内对重叠块排序；并设内部变体 NS-FullQ，用完整问题对同一候选集排序。在基于 QASPER 与 LongMemEval 构建的 200 条受控文档与记忆记录上、1,024 token 预算下评估。
AI.result: NativeScope 原生单元召回率：文档 89.28%、记忆 72.50%，较实例级 Dense RAG 分别提升 42.75 与 22.00 个百分点；NS-FullQ 为 87.78% 与 68.50%，与 NativeScope 差异不显著。采用自动 Top-1 锚点时，记忆召回率降至 35.50%。
AI.conclusion: 主要增益来自关系式范围限定而非更短的排序查询；NativeScope 在锚点坐标与原生关系可靠时有效，但硬范围限定会继承定位接口的误差。

title: Compact and Efficient Indexes for Learned Sparse Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering 2027 (IEEE ICDE 2027)
summary: This paper investigates how to substantially reduce the memory footprint of learned sparse retrieval indexes without sacrificing the efficiency of state-of-the-art retrieval data structures. Building on SEISMIC, we revisit both levels of its design: the inverted index used to select candidates and the forward index used to score them. For the inverted index, we replace costly per-block summaries with medoids, namely existing documents elected as block representatives, collapsing the per-block metadata from a sparse vector to a single document identifier. For the forward index, we compress both components and values. We reorder the vocabulary to place co-occurring components closer together and encode the resulting $Δ$-gaps with DOTPACKING8, a SIMD-friendly bit-packing scheme that fuses decompression with dot-product evaluation; values are quantized with compact per-component 4-bit codebooks fitted to each component's distribution. We further introduce JUMPDOT, a blocked dot-product kernel tailored for queries that contain only a few non-zero entries. Our forward-index compression is independent of SEISMIC and can be plugged into any system relying on forward-index-based scoring, as we demonstrate by integrating it into KANNOLO. A comprehensive evaluation on MS MARCO with three state-of-the-art learned sparse encoders shows that our solutions markedly improve the speed-space trade-off of learned sparse retrieval: at equal accuracy, our indexes answer queries up to 5.3x faster than the best competitor while using about 3x less memory, and in the most memory-constrained regime, they remain up to 1.9x faster while using up to 3.9x less memory.

AI.tldr: 本文在SEISMIC基础上重新设计倒排索引与前向索引，大幅降低学习型稀疏检索索引的内存占用，同时保持甚至提升检索效率。
AI.motivation: 学习型稀疏检索索引（如SEISMIC）在保持高效检索结构的同时存在较高内存开销，如何在几乎不牺牲效率的前提下大幅压缩内存，是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 倒排索引方面，用medoids（将已有文档选为块代表）替代昂贵的逐块摘要，把每块元数据由稀疏向量压缩为单个文档标识符；前向索引方面，对分量与取值同时压缩：重排词表使共现分量邻近，并用SIMD友好的DOTPACKING8对Δ-gap进行位打包，将解压与点积计算融合，取值用紧凑的逐分量4-bit码本量化；此外提出面向少量非零项查询的块状点积核JUMPDOT。该前向索引压缩方案独立于SEISMIC，可插入任何基于前向索引评分的系统（已集成到KANNOLO）。
AI.result: 在MS MARCO上使用三种先进学习型稀疏编码器的评测显示，所提方案显著改善速度-空间权衡：相同精度下，查询速度最高比最佳对比方案快5.3倍且内存少约3倍；在最受限内存场景下，仍快最多1.9倍且内存少最多3.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过重构倒排与前向索引的表示与编码，本文在保持检索效率的同时实现了学习型稀疏检索索引的大幅内存压缩，且前向索引压缩可通用集成到其他系统中。

title: Language Models for Page-Level Layout Decisions in E-commerce Search
comment: Accepted at the OARS Workshop, ACM RecSys 2026
summary: E-commerce search pages are critical touchpoints for millions of online shoppers. While traditional search engines return a ranked list of results, modern E-commerce search pages increasingly incorporate recommender system modules -- for example, secondary stacks that surface alternative product groupings at specific positions. When introduced appropriately, secondary stacks can improve user engagement; however, suboptimal placement may disrupt browsing flow and degrade the primary results. Unlike traditional search ranking, where evaluation techniques such as interleaving are well established, evaluating page-level layout changes e.g., when and where to insert a secondary stack remains challenging without costly online A/B testing. To address this, we study offline methods for evaluating whether a given layout decision -- specifically, the inclusion of a secondary stack at a particular position -- is beneficial to users. We investigate language models as scalable evaluators by comparing direct prompt-based, prompt-derived feature, and representation-based methods. Our results show that representation-based approaches consistently outperform prompt-based judging in predicting user engagement, suggesting they provide a reliable foundation for offline layout evaluation in E-commerce search.

AI.tldr: 研究电商搜索页"次级堆栈"插入位置这一布局决策的离线评估方法，比较三类语言模型评估器，发现基于表征的方法在预测用户参与度上优于基于提示的方法。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索页正从纯排序列表转向包含推荐模块（如次级堆栈）的页面级布局，合适的插入位置能提升参与度，但位置不当会打断浏览流、损害主结果。传统排序评估方法（如interleaving）无法评估页面级布局改动，而在线A/B测试成本高昂，因此需要可扩展的离线评估方法。
AI.method: 将语言模型作为可扩展的离线评估器，针对"是否在某位置插入次级堆栈"这一布局决策，系统比较三类方法：(1) 直接基于提示的评判（direct prompt-based）；(2) 由提示导出的特征（prompt-derived feature）；(3) 基于表征的方法（representation-based）。以预测用户参与度为评估目标。
AI.result: 基于表征的方法在预测用户参与度方面一致优于基于提示的评判方法，表明其可为电商搜索的离线布局评估提供可靠基础。
AI.conclusion: 基于表征的语言模型评估器是电商搜索页面级布局决策离线评估的可靠方向，可减少对昂贵在线A/B测试的依赖。

title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
summary: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores. Despite progress in retrieval, deduplication, and lifecycle management, the formation stage, the moment a fact is first written to storage has received almost no principled attention. We identify this as the binding constraint on memory quality in production systems. Critical contextual signals, such as the distinction between a permanent user attribute and a transient situation, exist only in the original utterance and are irreversibly lost the moment extraction produces a subject-relation-object triple. No downstream process can recover them. We propose Gated Memory, a lightweight, modular formation framework that interposes two decision checkpoints between conversation and storage: an admission gate that evaluates every candidate fact against the full utterance context before extraction runs, and a conditional enrichment stage that grounds admitted facts through an entity scope taxonomy with privacy constraints. The gate evaluates only the current exchange while using prior turns as read-only reference context, and produces a structured formation record. Admitted content is decomposed into atomic facts, each categorized, tagged with provenance (directly stated versus inferred), scoped to its condition of applicability, and grounded in resolved time and place, subject to a constraint that no entity absent from the context may be asserted. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark with atypical emotional density in utterance data, Gated Memory achieves an overall +2.6% relative improvement in LLM-judge accuracy over a strong baseline with identical retrieval and generation, establishing formation quality as a measurable constraint on memory performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gated Memory 框架，将长期记忆系统的研究焦点从检索/去重转向"记忆形成"阶段，通过准入闸门与条件化丰富两个检查点，在抽取前评估候选事实并保留原始话语的语境信息。在 LoCoMo-10 基准上，该方法在检索与生成模块完全相同的前提下，相比强基线取得 LLM 评判准确率 +2.6% 的相对提升。
AI.motivation: 个性化对话 AI 依赖长期记忆系统，从用户话语中抽取事实并存入持久向量库。现有研究多集中于检索、去重与生命周期管理，而事实首次写入存储的"形成阶段"几乎没有得到原则性关注。作者认为这是生产系统中记忆质量的瓶颈：诸如"永久用户属性"与"瞬时情境"这类关键语境信号仅存在于原始话语中，一旦抽取成主语-关系-宾语三元组便不可逆地丢失，任何下游过程都无法恢复。
AI.method: 提出 Gated Memory——一个轻量、模块化的形成框架，在对话与存储之间插入两个决策检查点：（1）准入闸门，在抽取执行前结合完整话语语境评估每个候选事实；（2）条件化丰富阶段，通过带隐私约束的实体范围分类体系对已准入事实进行接地。闸门仅评估当前轮次，并将历史轮次作为只读参考上下文，输出结构化的形成记录。被准入的内容被分解为原子事实，每条事实经过分类、标注来源（直接陈述 vs. 推断）、限定适用条件范围，并在已解析的时间与地点上接地，且满足"不得断言语境中未出现的实体"的约束。
AI.result: 在话语数据具有非典型情绪密度的 LoCoMo-10 基准上，Gated Memory 在检索与生成模块与强基线完全一致的情况下，LLM 评判准确率整体取得 +2.6% 的相对提升，表明形成质量是可测量的记忆性能约束。
AI.conclusion: 记忆形成阶段是长期记忆质量的关键约束。通过在抽取前设置准入闸门并对准入事实进行条件化丰富与接地，可在不改变下游检索与生成的前提下提升记忆性能，从而将"形成质量"确立为可量化的优化维度。

title: RIT-RAG: Navigating Document Corpora with Retrieval-Induced Trees
comment: 24 pages (main text through Limitations ends on page 9, followed by references and appendix), 9 figures, 16 tables
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in external corpora. Agentic RAG enables iterative search, yet exposes the model to isolated chunks without document structure, making it difficult to distinguish relevant evidence from chunks that merely resemble the query. Structure-aware methods such as PageIndex navigate document structure but cannot scale to the structures of large corpora, which do not fit in the LLM context. Hence, they first commit to a single document using a document retriever and cannot recover from a wrong choice. We propose RIT-RAG (Retrieval-Induced Tree RAG), which combines content retrieval with structural navigation. Offline, RIT-RAG builds a tree for each document from its table of contents or sitemap. At query time, it retrieves a broad set of chunks and uses their positions to induce manageable sub-trees, potentially across multiple documents. An LLM agent navigates these sub-trees, selectively reads promising nodes, and reformulates queries when needed. Thus, retrieval proposes where to look, while the agent decides what to read. Across financial, scientific, and customer-support benchmarks, RIT-RAG achieves the highest answer accuracy among vanilla, graph-based, and agentic baselines. On EntQABench, our new benchmark of 2.84 million technical-documentation webpages, it improves accuracy by 6.8 to 11.4 points over the strongest baseline across three LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RIT-RAG，将内容检索与结构导航结合，通过检索片段位置诱导子树的机制克服了 PageIndex 等方法仅限定单一文档的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agentic RAG 暴露给模型的是孤立片段，缺少文档结构，难以区分真正相关的证据与仅表面相似的片段；而 PageIndex 等结构感知方法无法扩展到大型语料的结构（超出 LLM 上下文），只能先由文档检索器锁定单一文档，一旦选错便无法恢复。
AI.method: 离线阶段为每篇文档基于目录或站点地图构建树结构；查询时先检索一组广泛的片段，利用其位置诱导出规模可控、可跨多文档的子树；再由 LLM 智能体在这些子树上导航、选择性阅读有前景的节点，并在需要时改写查询，形成"检索提出查看位置、智能体决定阅读内容"的分工。
AI.result: 在金融、科学和客户支持基准上，RIT-RAG 在 vanilla、graph-based 和 agentic 基线中取得最高答案准确率；在包含 284 万技术文档网页的新基准 EntQABench 上，跨三种 LLM 较最强基线提升 6.8 至 11.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 内容检索与结构导航的结合可有效缓解孤立片段和单文档锁定问题，兼顾可扩展性与准确率，为大语料结构感知 RAG 提供了可行方案。

title: SAIL: Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop
summary: We introduce SAIL, an open model with 35B total and 3B active parameters for literature research, scientific coding, and multi-step research workflows. SAIL is developed through a science-aware improvement loop: agents built on frontier AI models analyze its task failures and construct training tasks that address the underlying capability gaps. The diagnosis examines search and evidence selection in literature tasks, scientific assumptions and reasoning in coding, and planning and revision in longer investigations. The agents draw on paper collections and scientific code repositories to build problems, interaction trajectories, and executable tasks with the required environments and tools. We repeat this loop over multiple development cycles and train SAIL through supervised fine-tuning, specialist training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning. SAIL achieves competitive performance across scientific research tasks with substantially fewer parameters than leading open-weight models.

AI.tldr: SAIL是一个总参35B、激活3B的开放模型，面向文献研究、科学编程与多步研究流程，通过"科学感知改进闭环"迭代开发，在显著更少参数下取得有竞争力的科研任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有开放权重模型在科研类任务上往往依赖超大参数量，且缺乏针对文献检索、科学推理与长程研究规划等具体能力缺口的系统性改进。作者希望以更少参数构建在文献研究、科学编程和多步研究工作流上具有竞争力的开放模型。
AI.method: 采用科学感知的改进闭环：由基于前沿AI模型的智能体分析SAIL的任务失败，诊断文献任务中的检索与证据选择、编程中的科学假设与推理、长程调研中的规划与修订等能力缺口，并借助论文集合与科学代码仓库构造问题、交互轨迹及含所需环境与工具的可执行任务。该闭环重复多个开发周期，训练流程包括监督微调、专家训练、多教师在线策略蒸馏与智能体强化学习。
AI.result: SAIL在多项科研任务上取得有竞争力的性能，且所需参数量显著少于领先的开放权重模型。
AI.conclusion: "失败诊断—定向造数据—多阶段训练"的迭代闭环可有效将能力提升聚焦于科研场景的真实短板，使激活参数仅3B的开放模型在文献、科学编程与长程研究任务上具备与更大规模开放模型竞争的能力。

title: Beyond Resolution: Object-to-Image Ratio Mismatch in Instance Retrieval
summary: Visual instance retrieval often fails when the same object appears at different apparent sizes in the query and gallery. We show that the dominant cause is usually not resolution loss but object-to-image (O2I) ratio mismatch: the object occupies different fractions of the two images. On a controlled benchmark of 3,021 Objaverse objects rendered at five camera distances, more than 80% of the cross-distance degradation is attributable to O2I mismatch rather than resolution for 9 of 12 pretrained backbones; multi-scale architectures cut the resolution-only effect to single digits yet remain equally susceptible. The failure is also asymmetric: tight queries retrieve more reliably against wide gallery images than the reverse. Guided by this analysis, query-side scale augmentation and an OWLv2 crop reranker reach state of the art on ILIAS 100M (29.2 mAP@1000 before reranking, 42.0 after) without training or modifying the precomputed gallery index, and a LoRA fine-tune matches the query-side gains at a single forward pass, showing that O2I robustness is learnable.

AI.tldr: 视觉实例检索中跨尺度失败的主因是目标占图比例（O2I）失配而非分辨率损失，基于此提出的查询侧尺度增强与重排方法在无训练条件下刷新了ILIAS 100M的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 同一目标在查询图与底库图中表观尺寸不同时，视觉实例检索常失效。作者希望厘清该失败的根本归因：是分辨率损失，还是目标占图比例（O2I）失配，并据此设计无需改动底库索引的鲁棒检索方案。
AI.method: 构建受控基准：3,021个Objaverse物体在5个相机距离下渲染。在12个预训练骨干上做归因分解，对比多尺度架构的敏感性，并分析查询-底库尺度组合的不对称性。基于分析结论，采用查询侧尺度增强、OWLv2裁剪重排（reranker），以及LoRA微调使模型单次前向即具备O2I鲁棒性。
AI.result: 12个骨干中有9个的跨距离性能下降超过80%归因于O2I失配而非分辨率；多尺度架构将纯分辨率效应降至个位数百分比但仍同等易感；失败具有不对称性——紧致查询对宽视角底库图像的检索比反向更可靠。方法在ILIAS 100M上达到SOTA：重排前29.2 mAP@1000，重排后42.0；LoRA微调以单次前向匹配查询侧增强的增益。
AI.conclusion: O2I比例失配是跨尺度实例检索的主要失效机制，而非分辨率损失。该问题可通过查询侧手段（尺度增强、重排）或LoRA微调有效缓解，且无需训练或修改预计算的底库索引，表明O2I鲁棒性是可学习的。

title: Compactness and Consistency: A Conjoint Framework for Deep Graph Clustering
comment: Accepted by Proceedings of the Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026 Oral)
summary: Graph clustering is a fundamental task in data analysis, aiming at grouping nodes with similar characteristics in the graph into clusters. This problem has been widely explored using graph neural networks (GNNs) due to their ability to leverage node attributes and graph topology for effective cluster assignments. However, representations learned through GNNs typically struggle to capture global relationships between nodes via local message-passing mechanisms. Moreover, the redundancy and noise inherently present in graph data may easily result in node representations lacking compactness and robustness. To address these issues, we propose a conjoint framework CoCo, which captures compactness and consistency in the learned node representations for deep graph clustering. Technically, our CoCo leverages graph convolutional filters to learn robust node representations from both local and global views, and then encodes them into low-rank compact embeddings, thus effectively removing the redundancy and noise as well as uncovering the intrinsic underlying structure. To further enrich the node semantics, we develop a consistency learning strategy based on compact embeddings to facilitate knowledge transfer from the two perspectives. Our experimental results indicate that our CoCo outperforms state-of-the-art counterparts on various datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出联合框架CoCo，通过局部与全局图卷积滤波学习鲁棒表示并编码为低秩紧致嵌入，结合一致性学习实现深度图聚类，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: GNN依赖局部消息传递，难以捕捉节点间全局关系；图数据中的冗余与噪声易导致节点表示缺乏紧致性与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 利用图卷积滤波从局部和全局两个视角学习鲁棒节点表示，将其编码为低秩紧致嵌入以去除冗余噪声并揭示内在结构；基于紧致嵌入设计一致性学习策略，促进两视角间的知识迁移以丰富节点语义。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，CoCo的性能优于当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: CoCo通过紧致性与一致性的联合建模有效提升深度图聚类效果。

title: Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Long, Findings). Code: https://github.com/sony/syn-omni
summary: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Syn-Omni统一框架，通过正交模态专家LoRA（OME-LoRA）与渐进协同路由（PSR）实现结构化的全模态适配，在81个跨图像、视频、音频及视听任务上持续优于全模态基线。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态嵌入方法通常在混合模态数据上依赖单一共享参数空间，缺乏通用表示与模态特定表示之间的结构性区分，导致模态特化能力受限。
AI.method: 提出Syn-Omni框架，包含两部分：（1）Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA（OME-LoRA），将适配分解为共享LoRA路径（通用语义）与模态专家LoRA路径（模态专门化）；（2）Progressive Synergy Routing（PSR），先让专家建立模态特定先验，再逐步与其他模态专家交互以实现跨模态协同。
AI.result: 在涵盖图像、视频、音频和视听模态的81个多样化任务上评估，Syn-Omni持续优于全模态基线，验证了结构化专门化与跨模态渐进协同的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化模态特化结合受控的渐进式跨模态协作，是提升全模态嵌入泛化与性能的有效范式。

title: AuraLuxMuse: Adaptive Fusion Modeling for Aesthetic Stage Lighting Design with Music and Expert Guidance
comment: Accepted to appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: We present AuraLuxMuse, a novel system for automated aesthetic stage lighting design that integrates expert knowledge, representation learning, and preference-adaptive modeling. Lighting design in live performance settings requires the seamless translation of musical features into dynamic lighting behaviors. However, traditional workflows remain time-consuming, labor-intensive, and difficult to transfer. AuraLuxMuse encodes music and professional cue sequences into a shared retrieval space, estimates cue-event density, and retargets selected fixture commands to the destination stage. It assists pre-production authoring by returning editable cues rather than replacing the designer with an unconstrained generator. At the heart of AuraLuxMuse are two key modules: Lighting-Aligned Music Pretraining (LAMP), which performs contrastive learning between audio and lighting cues for alignment, and Preference-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (PAMoE), which conditions preference-aware cue retrieval and adaptation on designers' intent through a gated ensemble of style-specific expert networks. To support training and evaluation, we introduce Musilux, the first dataset of paired musical audio and professional lighting cue sequences under diverse performance scenarios. We evaluate AuraLuxMuse across both virtual simulation environments and professional-grade laboratories. Experimental results, including objective and subjective evaluation, demonstrate that AuraLuxMuse retrieves and adapts stage-lighting cues that are visually cohesive, semantically meaningful, and artistically expressive, showing its potential for AI-assisted aesthetic stage design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AuraLuxMuse，一个整合专家知识、表征学习与偏好自适应建模的自动化舞台灯光设计系统，通过LAMP对比学习、PAMoE专家混合和Musilux数据集，实现音乐到灯光线索的检索与适配，并在仿真与专业实验室验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现场演出的舞台灯光设计需要将音乐特征动态转化为灯光行为，但传统工作流程耗时、费力且难以迁移复用。作者希望构建一个辅助（而非替代）设计师的AI系统，返回可编辑的灯光线索以支持前期创作。
AI.method: AuraLuxMuse将音乐与专业灯光线索序列编码到共享检索空间，估计线索事件密度，并将选定的灯具指令重定向到目标舞台。核心包含两个模块：1）Lighting-Aligned Music Pretraining (LAMP)，通过音频与灯光线索的对比学习实现对齐；2）Preference-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (PAMoE)，以门控的风格专属专家网络集合，基于设计师意图进行偏好感知的线索检索与适配。同时构建了首个配对音乐音频与专业灯光线索序列的数据集Musilux。
AI.result: 在虚拟仿真环境和专业级实验室中开展评估，客观与主观评价结果均表明，AuraLuxMuse检索与适配的舞台灯光线索在视觉上协调、语义上有意义且具艺术表现力。
AI.conclusion: AuraLuxMuse展示了AI辅助审美舞台设计的潜力，通过融合专家知识、表征学习与偏好自适应建模，为舞台灯光设计提供了高效、可迁移且可编辑的辅助方案。

title: From Surface to Depth: Towards Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning in Multimodal Emotion Understanding
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly incorporate explainable reasoning for emotion understanding. However, reasoning based mainly on observable affective cues can reduce emotion understanding to superficial cue-label associations, giving rise to the Clever Hans effect. Such shortcuts become unreliable when affective cues are implicit, conflicting across modalities, linguistically misleading, or obscured by redundant details. In contrast, human emotions are shaped by how individuals interpret and evaluate surrounding events beyond observable cues. Inspired by appraisal theories of emotion, we formulate multimodal emotion understanding as a progression from perception to cognitive appraisal, and introduce a dataset, a model, and a benchmark to support this novel paradigm. CogEmo-40K is a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset constructed through a perception-to-appraisal pipeline to elicit evidence-grounded reasoning across six cognitive appraisal dimensions underlying emotion. CogEmo-MoE is a compact sparse MLLM that introduces interleaved MoE blocks for appraisal-specific adaptation, enabling effective appraisal reasoning at a substantially smaller scale than typical emotion MLLMs. CogEmo-Bench introduces an Appraisal Evidence Quality Score (AEQS) to assess cognitive-affective understanding across six complementary appraisal dimensions, addressing the limitation of conventional emotion metrics that evaluate what emotion is predicted but not why it arises. Extensive experiments show that our paradigm not only leads CogEmo-Bench, but also exhibits strong cross-domain generalization. Our findings suggest that perception-to-appraisal reasoning can move beyond surface-level cue-label associations toward more reliable multimodal emotion understanding and closer cognitive alignment between MLLMs and humans.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"从感知到认知评价"的多模态情感理解新范式，并构建了CogEmo-40K数据集、CogEmo-MoE模型与CogEmo-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型的情感理解主要依赖可观察的情感线索，易退化为浅层的"线索-标签"关联，产生Clever Hans效应；当情感线索隐含、跨模态冲突或受冗余信息干扰时，这种捷径推理不可靠。人类情感源于对事件的主观解读与评价，因此需要引入认知评价机制。
AI.method: 受情感评价理论启发，将多模态情感理解形式化为"感知→认知评价"的递进过程。(1) CogEmo-40K：通过感知到评价的流水线构建的大规模指令微调数据集，覆盖六种认知评价维度，激发有证据支撑的推理；(2) CogEmo-MoE：紧凑的稀疏MLLM，引入交错MoE块进行评价特异性适配，以更小规模实现有效评价推理；(3) CogEmo-Bench：提出评价证据质量分数（AEQS），从六个互补评价维度评估认知-情感理解。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该范式不仅在CogEmo-Bench上取得领先，还展现出较强的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: "感知到评价"的推理能够超越表层线索-标签关联，走向更可靠的多模态情感理解，并使MLLM与人类之间实现更接近的认知对齐。

title: A Camera-Native Stereo VR180 Dataset
summary: Immersive VR180 video is increasingly produced with professional stereo fisheye cameras, yet public VR180 research resources are mostly collected from online platforms such as YouTube: already stitched, projected and compressed by unknown pipelines, and without lens calibration. We present a firsthand-captured stereo VR180 dataset recorded with two Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive cameras. It contains 1,211 samples -- 636 stereo video clips (2,220.8 s, mostly 90 fps) and 575 stereo stills -- each released as camera-native Blackmagic RAW, separate-eye native fisheye HEVC (8160x7200 per eye) and half-equirectangular HEVC (7200x7200 per eye), together with the factory lens calibration, portable fisheye/half-equirectangular conversion tools and AI-generated scene and visual-challenge annotations. Re-encoding the released fisheye and half-equirectangular renders with x265 over 24 clips, both eyes, four rate points and nine viewing directions, native-fisheye coding needed more bitrate than half-equirectangular coding at equal viewport quality for all 24 clips (median +38%), in every part of the field of view. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lulinxuan/VR180 ; code: https://github.com/lulinxuan/vr180-dataset-tools

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个第一手采集的专业立体VR180数据集，包含1211个样本（636个立体视频片段与575张立体静态图），同时提供相机原生RAW、原生鱼眼HEVC和半等距柱状HEVC三种格式、镜头标定参数、转换工具及AI标注。基于该数据的重编码实验表明，在相同视口质量下，原生鱼眼编码比半等距柱状编码需要更高码率（24个片段中位数+38%）。
AI.motivation: 现有公开VR180研究资源多来自YouTube等在线平台，已由未知流程完成拼接、投影与压缩，且缺乏镜头标定信息，难以支撑可控、可复现的编码与处理研究。作者希望提供第一手采集、带标定与多格式原始数据的专业立体VR180资源，以弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用两台Blackmagic URSA Cine Immersive相机采集数据，共1211个样本，包括636个立体视频片段（2220.8秒，主要为90fps）和575张立体静态图。每个样本以三种形式发布：相机原生Blackmagic RAW、分眼原生鱼眼HEVC（单眼8160x7200）和半等距柱状HEVC（单眼7200x7200），同时提供出厂镜头标定、可移植的鱼眼/半等距柱状转换工具，以及AI生成场景与视觉挑战标注。评估方面，对24个片段的鱼眼与半等距柱状渲染用x265重编码，覆盖双眼、四个码率点和九个观察方向，在相同视口质量下比较两种投影的码率需求。
AI.result: 在全部24个片段、所有视场区域中，原生鱼眼编码在同等视口质量下所需码率均高于半等距柱状编码，中位数高出38%。数据与代码已公开于Hugging Face和GitHub。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个第一手采集、含原生RAW/鱼眼/半等距柱状多格式及镜头标定的专业立体VR180数据集，并配套转换工具与AI标注；实验表明原生鱼眼编码在等视口质量下码率效率劣于半等距柱状编码，为VR180编码与投影选择提供了实证参考。

title: Controlled Acquisition and Abstention in Three-Channel Score Conflicts
summary: When audio, video, and text disagree, accuracy alone does not show whether to acquire another source or abstain. We study these choices in a controlled three-score benchmark: a policy observes two signed scores, may request the third at a cost, and can abstain. The primary reward is mechanism-specific: abstention is correct only for one designated ambiguity mechanism and is penalized under mixed corruption. Matched controls show that a threshold policy matches always-request decisions with fewer requests; its advantage over always-answer fusion depends on the reward assigned to that ambiguity. On a partially held-out synthetic split, the threshold policy reaches 0.789 +/- 0.006 targeted decision accuracy and 0.481 +/- 0.014 utility across 83 seeds. A three-score majority reference reaches 0.626 +/- 0.008 and 0.252 +/- 0.016, but uses more information. In a matched-budget test, a train-only value selector improves utility over no-query and matched-random policies at 10% and 25% budgets, while pair uncertainty has higher utility at every budget. At 50% and 63.7% budgets, the selector lowers utility despite slightly higher non-ambiguous accuracy. If all abstentions are scored incorrect, majority outranks the threshold policy in utility. At a central temporal setting, full-trace controls match the neural models while position perturbations separate them. On held-out-actor emotion clips, eight-frame fusion has opposite-signed accuracy differences for two encoder pairs, with both actor intervals containing zero; matched-request routing gains are small and uncertain. These results separate full-modality accuracy from pre-request selection value and show that selection value depends on budget and the observed-pair ranking.

AI.tldr: 论文在多模态（音频/视频/文本）不一致场景下，以"是否继续索取第三模态 vs 弃答"为核心决策，构建三分数受控基准，发现阈值策略在较少查询下匹配全查询决策，且请求价值依赖预算与奖励机制。
AI.motivation: 当音频、视频、文本三个模态的判断发生冲突时，单纯追求准确率无法回答两个关键问题：应该继续获取额外信息源，还是应当弃答（abstain）。现有融合研究多关注全模态精度，忽视了"请求前"的选择价值以及弃答在不同歧义机制下的正确性差异。
AI.method: 构建可控的三分数基准：策略观察两个带符号分数，可选择付费请求第三个分数，也可弃答。主奖励为机制特定——仅在指定歧义机制下弃答视为正确，混合损坏（mixed corruption）下弃答被惩罚。设置匹配对照，比较阈值策略、恒请求策略、恒答融合、三分数多数投票参考；并做匹配预算测试，评估仅用训练集的"价值选择器"（value selector）、随机请求与不查询策略，以及基于配对不确定性的策略。在合成切分（83个随机种子）与时序控制、留出演员情绪片段上验证。
AI.result: 在部分留出合成切分上，阈值策略达 0.789±0.006 目标决策准确率、0.481±0.014 效用；三分数多数参考为 0.626±0.008 与 0.252±0.016（但使用更多信息）。阈值策略以更少请求匹配恒请求决策，其对恒答融合的优势取决于赋给该歧义机制的奖励。匹配预算下，仅训练的价值选择器在 10%、25% 预算优于不查询与匹配随机策略；配对不确定性在所有预算下效用更高；在 50%、63.7% 预算下选择器效用反而下降，尽管非歧义准确率略升。若所有弃答计为错误，多数投票在效用上超过阈值策略。时序中心设置中，全轨迹对照与神经模型持平，位置扰动可区分二者。留出演员情绪片段上，八帧融合对两组编码器配对呈现反向符号的准确率差异，两演员区间均含零；匹配请求路由增益小且不确定。
AI.conclusion: 研究将"全模态精度"与"请求前选择价值"明确区分，表明选择价值并非固定属性，而依赖预算规模与已观测配对的排序关系；弃答的正确性高度依赖歧义机制与评分规则。因此多模态决策评估应同时报告请求成本、预算与机制特定奖励，而非仅报告融合精度。

title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActiveMedAgent，将临床"从廉价到昂贵"的序贯检测逻辑引入多模态医学 AI：在冻结的 API 视觉语言模型上，用"每步诊断效用减成本"对检查项打分，并离线训练轻量 MLP 控制器学习何时追加证据、何时下诊断。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断本质上是序贯过程，医生只有在预期能消解诊断不确定性时才从廉价检查升级到昂贵检查。而现有多模态医学 AI 通常一次性使用全部模态，忽略成本与序贯决策，还可能引入信息过载。
AI.method: 以冻结的、仅通过 API 访问的视觉语言模型为基础；维护候选诊断上的概率分布；对每次证据获取按"单步诊断效用 − 成本"打分；在这些带分轨迹上离线训练一个轻量级 MLP 控制器，学习何时请求额外证据、何时做出判定。
AI.result: 在三个常用基准上，基于轨迹的策略学习持续优于无引导采集与全模态基线。并发现信息过载效应：在 175 个样例中，智能体用更少通道即得到正确诊断，而全模态基线失败。
AI.conclusion: 学习"舍弃哪些信息"与学习"获取哪些信息"同样重要；成本感知的序贯采集策略可提升多模态医学诊断的效率与准确率。

title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
summary: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

AI.tldr: LadderEdit：对每次编辑的LoRA适配器进行压缩，用低秩草稿存储，仅在满足重写/泛化/局部性契约失败时沿"阶梯"升秩，实现5.2倍内存节省且支持5万次顺序编辑。
AI.motivation: 大模型终身编辑需要存储成千上万次编辑。主流方法为每次编辑挂载一个LoRA适配器，虽能保持行为但存储量随编辑数线性增长，难以扩展。
AI.method: 每个编辑先以低秩草图形式廉价存储；在探测提示上检查该草图是否仍满足重写、泛化与局部性契约；通过的编辑保留草图，失败的编辑沿"秩阶梯"逐级提升秩直至契约满足。由于每个编辑都保留一定表示，覆盖性得以维持，只有困难编辑才消耗更多秩。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B上，于ZsRE、CounterFact、WikiBigEdit基准测试中，LadderEdit以5.2倍更少内存达到与精确LoRA存储相当的效果，并在5万次顺序编辑下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过按需升秩的草稿-阶梯压缩策略，LadderEdit在保持编辑契约（重写、泛化、局部性）的同时大幅降低终身编辑的存储开销，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
summary: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.

AI.tldr: 提出以"证据充分性"为选择标准的短视频事实核查框架，并构建MiniVer-V基准，实现以16%证据量达到全证据基线性能。
AI.motivation: 短视频事实核查的核心难题在于判定哪些证据足以支撑核查结论。现有方法或把全部证据交给验证器（引入噪声），或按主题相关性选择证据（混淆了"相关"与"充分"）。作者由此提出应以"证据充分性"——即某证据子集是否足以在无冗余情况下支撑一个可信裁决——作为选择准则。
AI.method: 构建MiniVer-V基准：195个短视频，含supported/refuted/insufficient三类裁决标注，5,510个多模态证据单元（视觉关键帧、语音转写、网络检索的外部来源）。提出两层验证框架：第一层用内部证据评估"声明-视频一致性"，第二层判定事实裁决并额外要求外部佐证。在此之上采用充分性驱动的贪心搜索，持续汇集证据直至满足充分性阈值；若候选池耗尽则输出insufficient，而非强行裁决。
AI.result: 在Claude Sonnet 4上，平均仅用4.5个证据单元（占全证据集的16%）即达Macro-F1 0.510，与全证据基线（27.7单元、0.518）在统计上无显著差异；相比无弃权的相同搜索，显著提升了对insufficient样本的识别。效率结论在GPT-5.5上可复现，在开源权重Qwen2.5-72B验证器上仅部分成立。消融实验显示外部证据对事实裁决不可或缺，内部视频证据则将裁决锚定于声明-视频一致性。
AI.conclusion: 证据高效的核查是可行的；当证据确实不足时，需要显式的弃权（abstention）机制。

title: SignRAG: Unified Retrieval-Augmented Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
summary: Contemporary decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. However, existing pretraining paradigms for gloss-free sign language translation (SLT) are largely designed around conventional encoder-decoder pretrained language models, which limits their direct applicability to decoder-only LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose SignRAG, a unified framework combining hierarchical pretraining, target-domain retrieval augmentation, and retrieval-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. Hierarchical pretraining first learns linguistically grounded sign representations and then jointly aligns the sign encoder with an LLM, mitigating cross-modal optimization imbalance. For downstream adaptation, SignRAG complements parameter-based fine-tuning with a target-domain retrieval gallery that provides instance-specific translation cues. To ensure that retrieved contexts are used appropriately, we further introduce Retrieval Utility-Guided Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RUG-RFT), which combines translation-quality and retrieval-utility rewards to encourage beneficial retrieval use while suppressing harmful reliance. Experiments on multiple SLT benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art performance. In particular, to the best of our knowledge, SignRAG is the first gloss-free approach to outperform gloss-supervised methods across all reported metrics on CSL-Daily. Our code has been released at \href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}, together with models of different sizes to support future academic research.

AI.tldr: SignRAG是一个统一框架，通过分层预训练、目标域检索增强和检索感知强化微调，将无注释手语翻译适配到仅解码器大语言模型，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无注释手语翻译的预训练范式主要围绕传统编码器-解码器预训练语言模型设计，难以直接适用于仅解码器大语言模型，存在适用性限制。
AI.method: 提出SignRAG框架，包含三部分：（1）分层预训练：先学习具备语言学依据的手语表征，再将手语编码器与LLM联合对齐，缓解跨模态优化不平衡；（2）目标域检索增强：构建目标域检索库，在参数微调之外提供实例级翻译线索；（3）检索效用引导的强化微调（RUG-RFT）：结合翻译质量与检索效用奖励，鼓励有益检索、抑制有害依赖。
AI.result: 在多个手语翻译基准上取得新的最优性能；据作者所知，是首个在CSL-Daily所有报告指标上超越注释监督方法的无注释方法；代码与不同规模模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: SignRAG有效解决了仅解码器LLM在手语翻译中的适配问题，验证了分层预训练、检索增强与检索感知强化微调结合的有效性，并为后续研究提供了开源资源。

title: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization via Complex-Valued Fusion
comment: Accepted to British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization (OV-AVEL) labels each video segment with an event class, including classes that were never seen during training. The dominant pipeline uses a frozen multimodal foundation model (e.g. ImageBind) to embed the visual frame, the audio mel-spectrogram, and each candidate class name into a shared space, then computes two cosine similarities for each segment against each class: visual-text and audio-text. Existing methods then collapse this pair into a single scalar score with a fixed rule (geometric mean, weighted average) before taking the argmax. Instead, we compute complex-valued similarities and learn their fusion using a complex-valued neural network (CVNN). Each modality's standard representation becomes the real part of our pipeline, and a paired companion stream supplies the imaginary part. We use imaginary part of iHSV for visual modality and CycleGAN-translated phase spectrogram for audio modality as these companion streams. This results in two complex similarities, which are then fused. While the vision and audio encoders remain frozen, only the temporal-attention blocks and the fusion CVNN are trained. The four-stream complex architecture sets a new state of the art on both OV-AVEL benchmarks. On the open (unseen-class) split of OV-AVEBench we reach 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1 (+1.6/+4.1/+6.6 over the previously reported fine-tuned baseline), with consistent gains for seen classes as well. We also modify AVE dataset for this task and observe that our architecture reaches 60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1, achieving state-of-the-art OV-AVEL results on it as well. We also propose a two-stream alternative, which also sees great improvements over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用复数神经网络学习视觉-文本与音频-文本相似度的融合，替代固定规则，在开放词汇音视频事件定位任务上取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇音视频事件定位方法将视觉-文本和音频-文本两个余弦相似度用固定规则（几何平均或加权平均）压缩为单一标量后再取argmax，这种硬性融合方式未针对任务学习，限制了性能。
AI.method: 为每个模态构建复数表示：实部为常规表示流，虚部由配对伴随流提供——视觉用iHSV的虚部，音频用CycleGAN转换的相位谱。由此得到两个复数相似度，再用复数神经网络（CVNN）学习其融合。视觉与音频编码器（如ImageBind）保持冻结，仅训练时间注意力模块和融合CVNN，构成四流复数架构；另提出双流替代方案。
AI.result: 在OV-AVEBench开放（未见类）划分上达到66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，较此前微调基线提升+1.6/+4.1/+6.6，已见类也有一致增益。在修改后的AVE数据集上达到60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，同样刷新SOTA。双流方案也较基线有大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 用可学习的复数融合替代固定相似度融合规则是有效的，四流复数架构在两个OV-AVEL基准上均建立新SOTA，验证了复数表示与时序注意力联合训练的价值。

title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS'26. Project page: https://vincie-next.github.io/
summary: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: VINCIE-NExT 通过"图像编辑即上下文演示"的范式，将图像编辑能力迁移到视频编辑，无需大规模成对视频编辑数据，在 OpenVE-Bench 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑比视频生成更难，核心瓶颈在于（源视频、指令、编辑后视频）三元组标注成本极高、难以规模化合成；而图像编辑领域已积累数百万级配对数据并趋于成熟。因此，如何将成熟的图像编辑能力有效迁移至视频域，成为突破视频编辑数据瓶颈的关键问题。
AI.method: 提出统一框架 VINCIE-NExT：将视频编辑分解为可组合的子任务链（Video → Image → Image → Video），把编辑意图路由至图像域，并在统一扩散目标下实现异构图像/视频语料的联合训练；将模型合成或用户提供的图像编辑对作为上下文视觉演示前置，为每帧输出提供空间外观蓝图；设计新型位置编码，将图像演示与视频帧关联到共享空间坐标系，实现外观编辑的像素级忠实传播；Chain-of-Editing 在推理阶段以渐进式扩散阶段执行子任务链，实现无需重训练即可通过额外算力提升质量的测试时扩展。
AI.result: 在 OpenVE-Bench 上，于多种编辑类别中均达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能；消融实验验证了各组成部分的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以图像编辑对作为上下文视觉演示、经图像域中转实现视频编辑，是一种规避视频配对数据瓶颈的可行且可扩展路径，并天然支持测试时算力换质量的扩展机制。

title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
summary: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

AI.tldr: 提出逐场景的RGB-D图像复用框架：用相对位姿引导的几何warping搬运源视图内容，配合轻量多尺度网络预测RGB残差以校正伪影并补全新暴露区域，同时缓存源特征降低重复计算，从而用图像复用替代邻近视角的重复3DGS渲染，实现低延迟的交互式场景探索。
AI.motivation: 交互式场景探索需要频繁更新视角，但小幅相机运动下可见内容高度重叠；而传统3D Gaussian Splatting对每个目标视角都重新渲染，未利用这种图像重叠，导致重复计算与查询延迟高。仅靠几何warping又无法恢复新暴露内容且对深度误差敏感。因此需要一种将"场景渲染"与"局部视角更新"解耦的高效方案。
AI.method: 逐场景（per-scene）框架：对邻近视角不再重复做场景渲染，而是复用已渲染的RGB-D图像，并由相对位姿引导进行复用。几何warping利用深度与相对位姿搬运源视图内容；一个轻量级多尺度网络预测RGB残差，用于校正warping伪影并推断缺失外观；此外缓存源特征以进一步减少重复计算。
AI.result: 在GS-render上，残差精修相较纯warping将PSNR提升约0.72 dB；在实拍场景与渲染场景上的评测均显示较低的查询延迟。
AI.conclusion: 将场景渲染与局部视角更新分离的范式可支撑响应式的场景探索，在增强现实与虚拟现实等应用中具有潜力。

title: SAVU-BENCH: A Real-World Benchmark for Spatial Audio-Visual Understanding
summary: Spatial audio-visual understanding requires models to recognize not only what is present, but also where events occur and how they relate across modalities. Existing benchmarks often rely on simulated scenes, evaluate isolated spatial skills, and provide limited diagnostic insight into failure modes. We introduce SAVU-Bench, a real-world benchmark that systematically evaluates spatial audio-visual understanding across three capability levels and seven evaluation tasks. We further introduce SAVU-Diag, a scene-linked diagnostic set that decomposes reasoning questions into their prerequisite grounding and alignment sub-tasks. Evaluation of 12 representative models on SAVU-Bench reveals that while visual spatial grounding is relatively mature, spatial perception involving audio remains a primary bottleneck. SAVU-Diag further demonstrates that most reasoning errors co-occur with failures on these prerequisite tasks, though reasoning gaps persist even when prerequisites are correctly resolved. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SAVU-EA, a training-free evidence-augmented baseline that makes spatial cues more explicit. While SAVU-EA substantially improves spatial grounding and joint matching, high-level spatial reasoning remains challenging. Our findings highlight the urgent need for both robust spatial audio perception and deeper integration of cross-modal spatial relations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAVU-Bench真实世界空间音视频理解基准（3个能力层级、7项任务）及SAVU-Diag诊断集，发现音频空间感知是主要瓶颈，并提出免训练证据增强基线SAVU-EA。
AI.motivation: 现有空间音视频理解基准多依赖仿真场景、仅评估孤立空间技能，且对失败模式的诊断能力有限，难以系统刻画模型在空间理解上的能力短板与瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建真实世界基准SAVU-Bench，按三个能力层级、七项评估任务系统评测空间音视频理解；提出场景关联诊断集SAVU-Diag，将推理问题分解为前置的grounding与alignment子任务；并设计免训练证据增强基线SAVU-EA，使空间线索更显式。
AI.result: 对12个代表性模型的评测显示，视觉空间grounding相对成熟，而涉及音频的空间感知是主要瓶颈；SAVU-Diag表明多数推理错误与前置子任务失败共现，但即使前置任务正确，推理差距仍存在；SAVU-EA显著提升空间grounding与联合匹配，但高层空间推理仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型亟需两方面提升：稳健的空间音频感知能力，以及更深层的跨模态空间关系整合；仅靠显式化空间线索不足以解决高层空间推理。

title: BEANS-Next and ROOTS: Broadening Audio-Language Capabilities for Bioacoustics
summary: Bioacoustics and ethology encompass a wide range of audio understanding tasks, many of which stand to benefit from recent advances in large audio-language models. However, progress in the field has so far been assessed on a narrow set of tasks, primarily centered on label-centric biological category recognition, such as species and call-type classification. In this work, we introduce BEANS-Next, a benchmark grounded in a taxonomy of bioacoustics tasks spanning acoustic perception, biological category recognition, scene understanding, and in-context learning. Using BEANS-Next, we show that existing models exhibit limited performance beyond the task families emphasized by existing evaluations, constraining their usefulness for broader bioacoustic applications. To support progress on this broader task space, we also introduce ROOTS, a large-scale training resource built from expanded curated real-world data and previously underused behavioral and acoustic metadata, supplemented by audio-derived information and scalable synthetic generation where labeling is insufficient. We demonstrate that training on this dataset yields substantial progress across all task groups of BEANS-Next, moving audio-language models closer to their potential as general-purpose assistants for bioacoustics and ethology. To accelerate progress in the field, we open-source our benchmark, dataset, and data pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出BEANS-Next生物声学任务基准与ROOTS大规模训练资源，揭示现有音频-语言模型在广泛生物声学任务上性能有限，并通过在ROOTS上训练显著提升各类任务表现，推动模型成为生物声学与行为学的通用助手。
AI.motivation: 生物声学与行为学涵盖广泛的音频理解任务，理论上可从大型音频-语言模型的最新进展中受益；但当前领域进展仅以窄范围任务（主要是物种、叫声类型分类等以标签为中心的生物类别识别）进行评估，无法反映模型在更广泛任务上的真实能力，限制了其实际应用价值。
AI.method: 1) 提出BEANS-Next基准，其基于覆盖声学感知、生物类别识别、场景理解与上下文学习（in-context learning）的生物声学任务分类体系构建；2) 提出ROOTS大规模训练资源，由扩展的精选真实世界数据与以往利用不足的行为及声学元数据构建，并在标注不足时辅以音频衍生信息与可扩展的合成数据生成。
AI.result: 借助BEANS-Next评估发现，现有模型在既有评测重点任务族之外表现有限，制约其更广泛生物声学应用；在ROOTS上训练后，模型在BEANS-Next所有任务组上均取得显著提升，使音频-语言模型更接近成为生物声学与行为学通用助手的目标。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需以更广任务谱系评估与训练生物声学模型；BEANS-Next与ROOTS有效暴露并缓解了现有评测与数据的不足。为加速领域进展，作者开源了基准、数据集与数据处理流程。

title: Listen-to-Reason: Listen with Experts, Retrieve over a Graph, Reason with LLMs
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) fuse an audio encoder into a large language model (LLM) through multi-stage training. This coupling means that a new domain or a stronger LLM requires retraining, and their answers cannot be traced to what the model heard: a chain-of-thought is a post-hoc account. We propose Listen-to-Reason (L2R), an interpretable-by-design pipeline that passes audio to the LLM through an explicit, human-readable tree: small heads on frozen expert encoders map each chunk of a clip to semantically meaningful nodes on the tree (for speech, music and environmental sound), and a frozen text-only LLM answers from these nodes and an ASR transcript without hearing the clip. Every answer can therefore be traced to the nodes and transcript it read, and the nodes are causal: replacing the deciding node with a distractor overturns 78% of correct answers on SAKURA. With a 7B reader, L2R outperforms all LALMs we compare against on SAKURA and trails them by 6-12 points on MMAU and MMAR, despite training about 1,400x fewer parameters on orders of magnitude less audio data. However, because any LLM can serve as the reader, we show that a stronger reader narrows this gap without retraining any audio component. A new domain is added with one small head: with five labelled clips per species, it outperforms QLoRA fine-tuning of an LALM on the same clips by 13-26 points.

AI.tldr: 提出 Listen-to-Reason（L2R），一种"设计即可解释"的音频理解流水线：用冻结专家编码器上的小型预测头将音频片段映射到语义树的节点，再由纯文本 LLM 依据节点与 ASR 转录作答，答案可溯源且节点具因果性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LALMs 将音频编码器通过多阶段训练耦合进 LLM，导致新领域或更强 LLM 都需重新训练，且回答（含思维链）无法追溯到模型实际"听到"的内容，属于事后解释。
AI.method: L2R 将音频经由显式、人类可读的语义树传给 LLM：在冻结的专家编码器上加小型预测头，把语音、音乐、环境声的每个音频块映射到树上语义节点；冻结的纯文本 LLM 仅依据这些节点和 ASR 转录作答，不接触原始音频。读者模型可任意替换，添加新领域只需一个新的小头。
AI.result: 在 SAKURA 上，7B 读者的 L2R 优于所有对比的 LALMs；在 MMAU、MMAR 上落后 6-12 分，但训练参数量少约 1400 倍、音频数据少数个数量级。将决定节点替换为干扰项可推翻 78% 的正确答案，验证节点因果性。更强读者可无需重训音频部分即缩小差距；每物种 5 条标注片段即可超越同数据的 QLoRA 微调 13-26 分。
AI.conclusion: L2R 以显著更低的训练成本实现了可解释、可溯源、可插拔且易于扩展的音频理解，证明将"听"与"推理"解耦的语义树中间表示在性能与可解释性上具有竞争力。

title: AutoSynth: Learning to Generate Editable Synthesizer Programs from Audio and Text
summary: Audio generation models can translate natural-language descriptions into sound, but their outputs are typically waveforms. Their audio quality is constrained by audio compression, and their outputs do not readily support direct edits to notes, timbral parameters, or modulation relationships. We present AutoSynth, which represents MIDI performance events, fixed synthesizer parameters, and variable-length modulation routes as a unified sequence for a synthesizer, and learns their dependencies with an audio-conditioned autoregressive model. A single model supports both tasks. Given reference audio, the model directly predicts a synthesizer program; given text, it uses a pretrained audio generation model and converts the generated audio into a program. Training consists of two stages: supervised learning on large-scale audio-program pairs automatically constructed from a small set of native presets, followed by group-relative policy optimization with a mixed reward combining semantic similarity, pitch-related features, acoustic similarity, and sound usefulness. The pipeline requires neither paired text-target-program annotations nor a differentiable synthesizer. Experiments show that AutoSynth produces complete, editable synthesizer programs and achieves competitive results in both synthesizer inversion and text-driven generation. Audio demos and source code are available at https://auto-synth.github.io/.

AI.tldr: AutoSynth 将 MIDI 演奏事件、固定合成器参数与可变长度调制路由统一表示为合成器程序序列，通过音频条件自回归模型学习其依赖关系，单模型同时支持合成器逆向与文本驱动音频生成，无需成对标注或可微合成器。
AI.motivation: 现有音频生成模型的输出为波形，受音频压缩限制，且难以直接编辑音符、音色参数或调制关系；同时将文本或参考音频映射到可编辑合成器程序缺少成对的文本-目标程序标注，也通常依赖可微合成器，训练困难。
AI.method: 将 MIDI 演奏事件、固定合成器参数与可变长度调制路由编码为统一序列，采用音频条件自回归模型建模依赖。参考音频任务下直接预测合成器程序；文本任务下先借助预训练音频生成模型产生音频再转换为程序。训练分两阶段：先在小规模原生预设自动构造的大规模音频-程序对上做监督学习，再进行组相对策略优化，使用融合语义相似度、音高相关特征、声学相似度与声音可用性的混合奖励。
AI.result: 实验表明 AutoSynth 能生成完整且可编辑的合成器程序，在合成器逆向与文本驱动生成任务上均取得有竞争力的效果；同时整个流程不需要成对的文本-目标程序标注，也不需要可微合成器。
AI.conclusion: AutoSynth 通过统一的程序序列表示与音频条件自回归建模，将音频生成从不可编辑波形推进到可编辑的合成器程序，并以两阶段训练（监督学习加混合奖励的策略优化）在无配对标注、无可微合成器的条件下实现合成器逆向与文本驱动生成，为可控、可编辑的音频生成提供了新范式。

title: Cross-Lingual Speaker Verification with Self-Supervised Pre-Trained Models
summary: Speaker verification (SV) performance degrades under language mismatch due to the entanglement of speaker identity with language-specific acoustic cues. To address this problem, we leverage large-scale self-supervised pre-trained models (PTMs) to learn language-agnostic speaker representations. We utilize PTMs as robust front-end feature extractors, capitalizing on their rich acoustic and linguistic knowledge acquired from vast, diverse audio data. These generalized features are then used to train a downstream speaker embedding network, effectively disentangling speaker identity from language-specific characteristics. We validate our approach on the TidyVoice2026 benchmark, which benchmarks SV under language mismatch. Our proposed system (team T02) achieves equal error rates (EERs) of 2.21% on tv26_eval-A and 2.99% on tv26_eval-U.

AI.tldr: 利用大规模自监督预训练模型作为前端特征提取器，学习语言无关的说话人表征，在TidyVoice2026语言不匹配说话人验证基准上取得EER 2.21%与2.99%。
AI.motivation: 语言不匹配条件下，说话人身份信息与语言相关的声学线索相互纠缠，导致说话人验证性能下降。
AI.method: 将大规模自监督预训练模型（PTMs）用作鲁棒的前端特征提取器，借助其从海量多样音频中学到的声学与语言知识获得泛化特征，再据此训练下游说话人嵌入网络，从而解耦说话人身份与语言特定特征。
AI.result: 在TidyVoice2026基准上，所提系统（队伍T02）在tv26_eval-A上EER为2.21%，在tv26_eval-U上EER为2.99%。
AI.conclusion: 采用自监督预训练模型作为前端特征提取器可有效实现语言无关的说话人表征，缓解语言不匹配带来的性能退化。

title: MiDashengLM-Spatial: Unifying General Audio Understanding and Spatial Awareness
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) have achieved strong performance in general audio understanding, yet most are designed for monaural input and discard the inter-channel cues essential for spatial perception. In contrast, existing spatial audio-language models are purpose-built for spatial tasks and fail to capitalize on the general understanding capabilities of monaural LALMs. We present MiDashengLM-Spatial, the first open-source end-to-end unified audio-language model, to our knowledge, which supports both general audio understanding and spatial awareness within a single architecture. It extends MiDashengLM with a spatial audio encoder, Spatial-Dasheng, integrated through a hierarchical semantic-to-spatial conditioning module that injects intermediate semantic representations into the spatial branch at multiple depths while preserving the original semantic pathway. To provide spatial audio-language supervision at scale, we develop a data synthesis pipeline that renders diverse spatial acoustic scenes with scene-level spatial descriptions and question-answer pairs. Experiments show that Spatial-Dasheng achieves strong performance on sound event localization and detection in real-world scenes, and that MiDashengLM-Spatial substantially outperforms existing LALMs on spatial understanding and reasoning benchmarks. Meanwhile, it remains competitive with state-of-the-art 8B-scale LALMs on diverse monaural benchmarks, demonstrating that spatial awareness can be acquired without compromising general audio understanding. The source code and model checkpoint are available at https://github.com/xiaomi-research/midashenglm-spatial and https://huggingface.co/mispeech/midashenglm-spatial.

AI.tldr: 提出MiDashengLM-Spatial，首个开源端到端统一音频-语言模型，在单一架构内同时支持通用音频理解与空间感知。
AI.motivation: 现有大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）多针对单声道输入设计，丢弃了空间感知所需的通道间线索；而现有空间音频-语言模型为特定空间任务定制，无法利用单声道LALMs的通用理解能力。
AI.method: 在MiDashengLM基础上扩展空间音频编码器Spatial-Dasheng，并通过分层语义到空间条件模块（hierarchical semantic-to-spatial conditioning）在多个深度将中间语义表征注入空间分支，同时保留原语义通路；此外构建数据合成流水线，渲染多样空间声学场景及场景级空间描述与问答对。
AI.result: Spatial-Dasheng在真实场景声事件定位与检测任务上表现强劲；MiDashengLM-Spatial在空间理解与推理基准上显著超越现有LALMs，同时在多样单声道基准上与最先进的8B规模LALMs保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 空间感知能力可在不损害通用音频理解的前提下获得，验证了统一架构的可行性；源码与模型检查点已开源。

title: Selective Listening: Mechanism-Guided Control of Audio Influence in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) exploit multimodal evidence, yet task-irrelevant audio can alter text-reasoning decisions when listening is unnecessary. Aggregate Accuracy can hide this paired drift because audio-induced repairs and damages may cancel. Paired drift analysis and targeted interventions identify architecture-specific, intervention-sensitive late audio pathways as actionable control points. We introduce ICAP-Gate, which applies mechanism-guided, task-conditioned control to each model's pathway. Across four LALMs, two reasoning benchmarks, and environmental-sound and natural-speech interference, ICAP-Gate has lower point estimates for Influence Rate and Answer Flip than ungated inference in all 16 full-split model--condition evaluations. Fixed suppression degrades automatic speech recognition (ASR) across all four models, whereas ICAP-Gate matches ungated ASR performance by preserving the pathway for explicit audio-demand instructions.
