ICAP-Gate has lower paired-drift point estimates than mitigation prompting in all four evaluated settings and provides competitive stabilization relative to eight-sample Self-Consistency while using one generation per query; in controlled ARC measurements, Self-Consistency incurs $7.0$--$9.2\times$ ungated latency. These results establish selective modality influence control as a design principle for robust multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ICAP-Gate:基于机制引导的任务条件化控制,选择性调控 LALMs 中后期音频通路,降低无关音频导致的配对漂移,同时保留显式音频任务性能。
AI.motivation: LALMs 可利用多模态证据,但当任务本身不需要听觉信息时,无关音频仍会干扰文本推理决策。总体准确率(Aggregate Accuracy)会掩盖这种"配对漂移",因为音频引起的"修复"与"损害"可能相互抵消,因此需要配对漂移分析与针对性干预来定位可控制的关键通路。
AI.method: 通过配对漂移分析与针对性干预,识别出架构相关、对干预敏感的后期音频通路作为控制点;提出 ICAP-Gate,对每个模型的该通路施加机制引导的、任务条件化的控制,即仅在任务需要音频时保留通路,否则抑制其影响。实验覆盖 4 个 LALM、2 个推理基准,以及环境声与自然语音干扰。
AI.result: 在全部 16 个全量划分的模型-条件评估中,ICAP-Gate 的 Influence Rate 与 Answer Flip 点估计均低于无门控推理;固定抑制会损害全部 4 个模型的 ASR 性能,而 ICAP-Gate 通过为显式音频需求指令保留通路,可达到与无门控相当的 ASR 表现;在 4 个评估设置中 ICAP-Gate 的配对漂移点估计均低于缓解提示;相对 8 样本 Self-Consistency 具备竞争力,且每查询仅需一次生成,而 Self-Consistency 在受控 ARC 测量中带来 7.0–9.2 倍于无门控的延迟。
AI.conclusion: 选择性模态影响控制可作为一种设计原则,用于提升多模态推理的鲁棒性:不必全局压制音频,而是按任务条件精准调控特定通路,从而兼顾抗干扰与音频任务能力。

title: A computational framework for the acoustic characterization of Suikinkutsu (water harp cave)
summary: Suikinkutsu are partially concealed acoustic devices traditionally installed adjacent to stone water basins (tsukubai) in Japanese temple gardens. While previous research has examined their physical acoustics and cultural significance, computational methods for documenting and comparing their acoustic characteristics remain underexplored. This exploratory study introduces a computational framework for analyzing suikinkutsu using spectral and temporal audio features extracted from field recordings. Rather than estimating the physical geometry of individual suikinkutsu, the framework characterizes their acoustic profiles using a multidimensional set of computational descriptors, enabling systematic comparisons between recordings across different sites and installations. Audio recordings from nine suikinkutsu located at temples, shrines, and gardens in the Kansai region of Japan were analyzed using a feature-extraction pipeline that incorporates Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs), Root Mean Square (RMS) energy, spectral centroid, spectral bandwidth, and spectral contrast. The extracted features indicate that, although the suikinkutsu share broadly similar spectral and timbral characteristics, each exhibits a measurably distinct acoustic profile; a supplementary analysis of within-site and between-site variability suggests these profiles reflect a bounded range of characteristic resonant behaviour rather than a fixed acoustic signature. The proposed framework provides one of the first computational approaches for systematically characterizing and comparing suikinkutsu, contributing a practical foundation for future research and the digital preservation of this distinctive form of Japanese environmental design.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个计算框架，利用频谱与时域音频特征分析日本庭园"水琴窟"的声学特征，对关西地区9处水琴窟录音进行了系统比较，发现它们虽具相似音色特征但各具可区分的声学剖面，为水琴窟的数字化保存提供了基础方法。
AI.motivation: 水琴窟是日本寺庙庭园中置于石水钵旁的隐蔽声学装置，既有研究多聚焦其物理声学与文化意义，而用于记录和比较其声学特征的计算方法仍较为欠缺。本研究旨在填补这一空白，提出可系统刻画与比较水琴窟声学特征的计算途径。
AI.method: 研究采用探索性设计，采集关西地区寺庙、神社与庭园中9处水琴窟的实地录音，构建特征提取流程，提取FFT、梅尔频率倒谱系数（MFCCs）、均方根能量（RMS）、频谱质心、频谱带宽和频谱对比度等多维计算描述符；不估计单个水琴窟的物理几何结构，而是以其声学剖面进行表征，并辅以场地内与场地间变异性分析。
AI.result: 提取的特征表明，各水琴窟虽共享大致相似的频谱与音色特征，但每一处都表现出可测量的独特声学剖面；场地内与场地间变异性分析进一步提示，这些剖面反映的是一定范围内的特征性共振行为，而非固定不变的声学签名。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是首批用于系统刻画与比较水琴窟的计算方法之一，为后续研究及这一独特日本环境设计形式的数字化保存提供了实用基础。

title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://sepgen.github.io/
summary: A 4D audio-visual scene comprises a video, the dynamic geometry it depicts, and the sound sources that populate it, each with its own position and trajectory. Rendering such a scene from a novel viewpoint requires that every source be available as an individual waveform, so that it can be localized in the scene and propagated to the observer before the signals are mixed. Joint audio-video generators can synthesize the video and its soundtrack, but the soundtrack is emitted as a single audio-mix in which the sources are not individually accessible. We present SepGen, which extends a pretrained audio-video generator to emit the video, the mixed soundtrack, and one waveform per captioned source in one joint sampling run. SepGen supports two complementary modes: generation and separation. In generation mode, each source caption specifies what its stem contains. A two-speaker dialogue, for example, comes out as one stem per speaker in the original turn order. In separation mode, the input audio-mix remains clean while the captions specify what to extract, so the model can decompose a recording from a free-text description. We evaluate generation on scenes synthesized from text, and separation on scenes rendered by other generators and on real recordings of speech, music, and sound effects. Given an audio-mix and captions that carry the spoken lines, SepGen outperforms language-conditioned separators, most clearly on speech, and it keeps the lead when the lines are removed from the captions. Code, checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://sepgen.github.io/

AI.tldr: SepGen扩展预训练的音视频生成器，在一次联合采样中输出视频、混合音轨以及每个带字幕声源的独立波形，支持生成与分离两种模式，在语音为主的场景中优于语言条件分离器。
AI.motivation: 4D音视频场景从新视角渲染时，要求每个声源以独立波形形式存在，以便定位并传播后混音；但现有联合音视频生成器只输出单一混合音轨，声源不可单独获取。
AI.method: 在预训练音视频生成器基础上扩展，单次联合采样同时生成视频、混合音轨和每个带标注声源的一条波形；支持生成模式（声源标注规定各stem内容）与分离模式（混合音频保持干净，标注指定需提取内容），实现基于自由文本描述的分解。
AI.result: 在文本合成场景上评估生成，在其他生成器渲染场景及真实语音、音乐、音效录音上评估分离；给定混合音频与含台词的标注时，SepGen优于语言条件分离器，语音上优势最明显，且在去掉台词标注后仍保持领先。
AI.conclusion: SepGen通过将声源级波形生成与音视频联合生成统一，实现可用文本标注控制的多声源生成与分离，为可重混、可新视角渲染的4D音视频场景提供了可行路径。

title: Edit Who Speaks, Control How They Speak: Global Timbre Editing and Local Instruction Control for TTS
summary: Instruction-based text-to-speech (TTS) offers control over voice characteristics and speech expression through interfaces including voice cloning and text-based voice design. Voice cloning reproduces a reference voice, whereas text-based voice design creates a voice from a natural-language description. However, neither interface directly enables users to modify the timbre of a given reference and synthesize speech with the modified voice. Meanwhile, utterance-level expressive instructions leave changes across individual text segments underspecified. We introduce \textbf{EDICT}, a framework that unifies global timbre editing and local expressive control by using an edited acoustic reference to anchor voice identity across segments. To enable synthesis with an instruction-edited voice, EDICT combines reference audio with structured timbre edits to generate an edited reference in codec-token space. This representation serves as a shared voice anchor for a frozen TTS backbone, allowing segment-specific natural-language instructions to guide expression. To accommodate instruction changes while supporting acoustic continuity, EDICT rebuilds the KV cache at each segment boundary, refreshing instruction conditioning while retaining bounded acoustic context from previously generated speech. Evaluations on our proposed TimbreEdit-Bench and IntraTTS-Bench demonstrate improved timbre editing and a favorable balance between local instruction adherence, speaker consistency, and transition quality. Audio demos are available.

AI.tldr: EDICT 是一个统一"全局音色编辑"与"局部表现力控制"的指令式 TTS 框架:它通过结构化音色编辑在 codec token 空间生成编辑后的参考音频作为共享音色锚点,驱动冻结的 TTS 主干,并在每个文本片段边界重建 KV cache,以兼顾指令切换与声学连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有指令式 TTS 的两类接口存在局限:语音克隆只能复现参考音色,无法修改;文本语音设计只能从描述生成新音色,无法基于给定参考进行修改。此外,话语级(utterance-level)表现力指令无法明确各文本片段的局部变化,导致段级表达控制不足。因此需要一个能同时支持"对参考音色进行编辑"和"段级表现力控制"的统一框架。
AI.method: EDICT 将参考音频与结构化音色编辑相结合,在 codec-token 空间中生成"编辑后的参考",作为共享的音色锚点,用于冻结的 TTS 主干以保证跨片段音色一致。各文本片段可携带自然语言指令来引导局部表达。为在适应指令变化的同时维持声学连续性,EDICT 在每个片段边界重建 KV cache:刷新指令条件,同时保留先前生成语音的有界声学上下文。
AI.result: 在作者提出的 TimbreEdit-Bench 与 IntraTTS-Bench 上的评测表明:EDICT 提升了音色编辑效果,并在局部指令遵循度、说话人一致性与过渡质量之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: EDICT 通过"编辑后参考音频作为共享音色锚点 + 片段边界重建 KV cache"的设计,统一了全局音色编辑与局部表现力控制,为指令式 TTS 提供了一种兼顾音色可编辑性、段级指令遵循与声学连贯性的可行方案。

title: Beyond Speech Captions: Speech-Rewarded Style Planning for Conversational Text-to-Speech
summary: Natural-language style descriptions provide an interpretable interface between large language models (LLMs) and controllable text-to-speech (TTS). However, using descriptions as pseudo-labels compresses target acoustics into text, and descriptive fidelity need not imply effective control of a particular synthesizer. We empirically show that speech-text alignment only weakly predicts downstream acoustic similarity among candidate instructions for the same utterance. We therefore propose Speech-Rewarded Style Planning (SRSP), which trains a text-based style planner through a frozen downstream TTS model. Given dialogue history and response text, the planner generates candidate instructions and is optimized with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), using the teacher-forced likelihood of target speech tokens as the reward. On an English subset of the ISCSLP 2026 CoT-TTS corpus, SRSP achieves higher speech-style and emotion similarity to target speech and lower mel-cepstral distortion than the Base LLM and target-audio-informed captioning baselines. LLM-based expressive speech evaluation further shows gains over all baselines in contextual appropriateness and reference consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出 Speech-Rewarded Style Planning（SRSP），用冻结的下游 TTS 模型作为奖励来源，通过 GRPO 训练文本风格规划器，使自然语言指令真正具备对合成器的有效控制力。
AI.motivation: 自然语言风格描述为 LLM 与可控 TTS 之间提供了可解释接口，但将描述用作伪标签会把目标声学信息压缩进文本，且描述保真度高并不等于对特定合成器具有有效控制。作者实证发现语音-文本对齐度对同一话语不同候选指令的下游声学相似度仅有弱预测能力，说明需要直接以合成结果为导向来优化规划器。
AI.method: SRSP 通过冻结的下游 TTS 模型训练基于文本的风格规划器。给定对话历史与回复文本，规划器生成候选指令，并采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化，奖励为教师强制下目标语音 token 的似然。
AI.result: 在 ISCSLP 2026 CoT-TTS 语料的英文子集上，SRSP 相比 Base LLM 和以目标音频为条件的描述生成基线，取得了更高的语音风格与情感相似度，以及更低的梅尔倒谱失真。基于 LLM 的表现力语音评估也显示，其在上下文适当性和参考一致性上优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 以冻结 TTS 模型的下游声学反馈作为奖励、用强化学习训练风格规划器，比依赖伪标签描述保真度更有效，能够提升风格与情感可控性，为可解释的 LLM-TTS 接口提供了新思路。

title: Reference-Free Singing Pitch Correction via Music-Constrained Sequence Editing
summary: Existing singing pitch correction approaches rely on target melodies or accompaniment tracks, which may be unavailable in practice. We formulate reference-free singing pitch correction as a music-constrained sequence editing task that determines whether and how each note should be corrected from the input performance alone. A pretrained symbolic music encoder with lightweight singing-domain adapters produces contextual representations of the singing MIDI. Based on these representations, two lightweight correction heads jointly model correction necessity and signed pitch modification through a factorized pitch-editing distribution. An input-dependent tonal prior derived from the estimated key distribution then reranks the candidate offsets, favoring tonally compatible corrections without target melodies or ground-truth key annotations. Experiments on real paired amateur and professional singing recordings show that the method improves note-level pitch accuracy from 73.25 to 83.43, outperforming a context-based baseline by 3.99 percentage points while balancing error correction and preservation of correctly performed notes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无参考歌声音高修正方法，将其建模为受音乐约束的序列编辑任务，仅凭输入演唱即可判断并完成修正。
AI.motivation: 现有歌声音高修正方法依赖目标旋律或伴奏轨道，实际场景中往往不可获得。因此需要一种无需参考、仅从输入演唱本身进行修正的方案。
AI.method: 使用预训练符号音乐编码器搭配轻量级歌唱域适配器，生成演唱MIDI的上下文表示；在此基础上用两个轻量修正头，通过因子化音高编辑分布联合建模“是否需要修正”与“带符号的音高修改”；再由基于估计调性分布得到的输入相关调性先验对候选偏移重排序，偏向调性相容的修正，无需目标旋律或真实调性标注。
AI.result: 在真实配对业余与专业演唱录音上，音符级音高准确率从73.25提升至83.43，较基于上下文的基线高出3.99个百分点，并在纠错与保留正确音符之间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了无参考的歌声音高修正，在无目标旋律与调性标注条件下有效提升音高准确率，同时兼顾纠错与保留。

title: STEMMA: Song-to-Stem Multi-Audio Reasoning for Large Audio Language Models
summary: Music understanding often requires comparing excerpts and reasoning about relationships among songs, sections, and stems. However, existing large audio-language models (LALMs) and music question-answering datasets typically operate on single recordings or compare independently sampled tracks with no known production relationship. We introduce STEMMA, a multi-audio music question-answering framework built around production provenance: whether excerpts originate from the same track or section, and which stems belong to which mixtures. Because such relations are sparse under conventional audio-first sampling, STEMMA adopts a relation-first construction strategy: it first specifies a target relation and then queries the catalog for excerpts that satisfy it and hard negatives that do not. Labels are determined directly from catalog provenance rather than generated by a language model from metadata. We build STEMMA-Bench for evaluation and a track-disjoint training set, STEMMA-Instruct. Fine-tuning two LALMs on STEMMA-Instruct improves multi-audio reasoning, with the largest gains on structural relations directly determined by the catalog, while preserving single-audio music understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEMMA，一个基于制作溯源（production provenance）的多音频音乐问答框架，通过关系优先策略构建数据，并发布评测基准STEMMA-Bench与训练集STEMMA-Instruct，微调后显著提升LALM的多音频推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）和音乐问答数据集多基于单条录音，或对无已知制作关系的独立曲目进行比较，难以支持片段间的对比与关系推理（如歌曲、段落、分轨间的关系）。
AI.method: 提出关系优先（relation-first）的数据构建策略：先指定目标关系，再从曲库中检索满足该关系的片段及违反该关系的困难负样本。标签直接由曲库溯源信息确定，而非由语言模型依据元数据生成。据此构建多音频问答评测基准STEMMA-Bench，以及按曲目划分的训练集STEMMA-Instruct，并对两个LALMs进行微调。
AI.result: 在STEMMA-Instruct上微调两个LALMs后，多音频推理能力得到提升，其中在由曲库直接确定的结构性关系上增益最大，同时保留了单音频音乐理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 以制作溯源为核心的关系优先数据构建方式，能有效弥补现有数据集在音频间关系监督上的缺失，提升LALMs的多音频音乐推理表现，而不过度损害单音频理解能力。

title: DiffuPlex: Accelerating Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models via Rolling Masked Diffusion
comment: 41 pages, 11 figures, 18 tables. Preprint, under review. Project page: https://diffuplex.github.io/
summary: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.

AI.tldr: DiffuPlex 是一个滚动掩码扩散框架，用单次骨干网络唤醒预测多帧未来内容，从而减少全双工对话模型的序列化计算，同时保持交互行为和通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有精细粒度的全双工语音对话模型虽然支持同时听与说，但其骨干网络仍需在每个交互帧上进行自回归推进，导致序列计算开销大、效率低。作者希望在保持交互质量的前提下减少这种逐帧顺序计算。
AI.method: 提出 DiffuPlex，一种滚动掩码扩散框架：在单次骨干唤醒中预测多个未来用户与助手帧，仅消费每个预测未来中置信的前缀，并以原始帧率继续交互。当用户语音到达时，校验对应的用户预测，若交互发生偏离，则保留已播放的助手内容，仅修正尚未播放的未来。基于同一预测器设计两种推理策略：DiffuPlex-LISTEN（在预测助手静音时消费多帧）与 DiffuPlex-SPEAK（还可消费预测的助手语音）。
AI.result: 在全双工交互和口语语言评测中，DiffuPlex 显著减少顺序骨干计算，同时基本保持交互行为和通用能力。LISTEN 与 SPEAK 分别实现 1.46× 和 1.59× 的部署路径墙钟加速，以及 1.61× 和 1.80× 的核心 LM 加速，所有测得骨干调用均在 80ms 交互间隔内完成。人工评测显示 LISTEN 保持语音自然度和对话质量，SPEAK 保持对话质量但语音自然度有一定下降。
AI.conclusion: DiffuPlex 通过扩散式多帧预测与置信前缀消费，有效降低了全双工对话模型的序列化计算成本，并在速度与交互质量之间取得良好权衡；其中 LISTEN 策略在保持自然度方面更优，SPEAK 策略速度更快但自然度略有损失。

title: How Much Audio Is Left In An Embedding? An Inversion Audit Of Audio Encoders
summary: Pretrained audio encoders are reused for downstream tasks that are often unknown when the encoder is trained, so their usefulness depends partly on which signal properties survive the pretext objective. We study this retained information through paired source reconstruction. Using a shared Stable Audio Open latent diffusion decoder, we reconstruct five-second, 44.1-kHz stereo music from frozen representations produced by supervised classifiers (VGGish, ConvNeXt), an audio-text contrastive model (CLAP), and a waveform-reconstruction model (EnCodec). These objectives impose different pressures to preserve source detail, while their exposed interfaces vary substantially in temporal and spectral resolution. Evaluating on the Million Song Dataset (MSD), we find clear differences in reconstructability across encoder families, while within encoder comparisons show improved recovery when finer temporal or spectral structure is exposed. Even compressed task oriented embeddings support reconstructions that preserve measurable source specificity and high level musical content.

AI.tldr: 本文通过配对源重建（paired source reconstruction）研究预训练音频编码器所保留的信号信息，使用共享的 Stable Audio Open 潜在扩散解码器，从 VGGish、ConvNeXt、CLAP、EnCodec 四类冻结表征重建 5 秒 44.1 kHz 立体声音乐，并在 Million Song Dataset 上评估可重建性差异。
AI.motivation: 预训练音频编码器常被复用于训练时未知的下游任务，其效用部分取决于哪些信号属性在预训练目标（pretext objective）下得以保留。因此需要研究编码器表征中究竟保留了哪些源信号信息。
AI.method: 采用配对源重建方法：固定一个共享的 Stable Audio Open 潜在扩散解码器，从多种冻结（frozen）表征重建 5 秒、44.1 kHz 立体声音乐。所考察的编码器包括监督分类器（VGGish、ConvNeXt）、音频-文本对比模型（CLAP）及波形重建模型（EnCodec）；这些目标对保留源细节施加不同压力，其暴露接口在时间与频谱分辨率上差异显著。评估在 Million Song Dataset（MSD）上进行。
AI.result: 不同编码器家族之间可重建性存在明显差异；在同一编码器内部比较中，当暴露更细的时间或频谱结构时，重建恢复效果更好。即使是被压缩的、面向任务的嵌入（task-oriented embeddings），其重建仍能保留可测量的源特异性（source specificity）与高层次音乐内容。
AI.conclusion: 预训练音频编码器保留的信息量因预训练目标与接口分辨率而异；面向任务的压缩表征虽未以重建为目标，仍保留了相当程度的源特异性和高层音乐信息，说明源重建可作为分析编码器保留信号属性的有效探针。

title: Local Prototype Reconstruction for Text-Compatible Speech-to-LLM Bridge Pretraining
summary: Speech-to-LLM systems often connect a frozen speech encoder to a frozen large language model (LLM) through a small trainable bridge. The bridge is usually treated as plumbing, but it in fact defines the geometry of the speech-to-LLM interface, and the pretraining objective decides whether that interface provides a reusable initialization for downstream tasks. We study a transferable bridge through two complementary properties: global alignment with the text side, and local lexical manifold compatibility, where bridge embeddings remain close to the frozen LLM's input-embedding neighbourhoods. We make this property measurable with a fixed, head-free, timestamp-free diagnostic that applies to any objective, and show that next-word prediction (NWP) and sentence-level contrastive pretraining do not fully capture token-level lexical compatibility. We then introduce Local Prototype Reconstruction (LPR), a lightweight training-only regularizer that requires each aligned bridge token to be reconstructable from a small neighbourhood of frozen LLM token embeddings, with a hard single-prototype anchor as its limiting case. On multilingual ASR and speech translation, LPR improves transfer, with the largest gains on translation and low-resource adaptation. Crucially, our independent diagnostic correlates with downstream gains across objectives, suggesting that lexical manifold compatibility is predictive of reusability for speech-to-LLM bridges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语音到LLM（Speech-to-LLM）系统中可迁移桥接模块的设计，提出用"全局对齐"与"局部词汇流形兼容性"两个性质刻画桥接接口，并引入仅训练期使用的局部原型重构（LPR）正则化器，在多语言ASR与语音翻译上提升迁移效果，且发现独立诊断指标与下游增益相关。
AI.motivation: 现有语音到LLM系统通常用小型可训练桥接连接冻结的语音编码器与冻结的LLM，但桥接常被视为"管道"而被忽视。实际上，桥接定义了语音到LLM接口的几何结构，其预训练目标决定了该接口能否为下游任务提供可复用的初始化。作者希望探究什么样的桥接具有可迁移性。
AI.method: 作者从两个互补性质研究可迁移桥接：与文本侧的全局对齐，以及局部词汇流形兼容性（桥接嵌入需保持在冻结LLM输入嵌入邻域附近）。为此设计了一个固定的、无头（head-free）、无时间戳的诊断指标，适用于任意目标函数，并揭示下一词预测（NWP）和句子级对比预训练无法充分捕捉token级词汇兼容性。进而提出局部原型重构（LPR），一种仅训练期使用的轻量正则化器，要求每个已对齐的桥接token可由冻结LLM token嵌入的小邻域重构，并以硬单原型锚作为其极限情形。
AI.result: 在多语言ASR和语音翻译任务上，LPR提升了迁移效果，其中在翻译和低资源自适应上增益最大。此外，该独立诊断指标在不同目标函数下均与下游增益相关。
AI.conclusion: 词汇流形兼容性是语音到LLM桥接可复用性的预测指标，LPR作为轻量正则化器可有效提升桥接的迁移能力，表明桥接设计应被视为接口几何问题而非单纯"管道"。

title: Breaking the Group Size Barrier: Parameter-Efficient Group Dance Generation with Chain-of-Dancers
summary: Group dance generation aims to synthesize coordinated multi-dancer choreography from music, with broad applications in animation and interactive content creation. This task requires modeling dense inter-person dependencies to ensure spatial coordination, while naturally preserving individual dancer identities. Existing approaches model all dancers jointly with end-to-end transformers, which tie the architecture to a fixed group size and entangle per-dancer identities across frames. We propose ChainDance, a scalable framework that reformulates group dance generation as a Chain-of-Dancers: a sequential decomposition over per-dancer conditional distributions, allowing a single model to scale across variable group sizes without retraining and naturally preserving per-dancer identity. Built on a frozen single-dancer diffusion backbone, ChainDance introduces two lightweight modules: a Role-Aware Text Encoder (RATE) for per-dancer semantic conditioning, and a Group-Aware Motion Encoder (GAME) that aggregates previously generated dancers via a distance-weighted graph convolutional network, and incorporates a training-free noise optimization procedure at inference time to enforce global spatial coherence. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChainDance achieves state-of-the-art motion quality and group coordination while structurally preserving per-dancer identity, with $3$-$4\times$ fewer parameters and requiring $3$-$6\times$ less training time compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出ChainDance：将群舞生成重构为"舞者链"（逐舞者条件分布的序列化分解），基于冻结单舞者扩散骨干，配合角色感知文本编码器(RATE)与群体感知运动编码器(GAME)，实现可变群体规模、身份保持与更低参数/训练成本。
AI.motivation: 群舞生成需同时保证人际空间协调与个体身份保持。现有端到端Transformer联合建模全体舞者，导致架构与固定群体规模绑定，且逐舞者身份在帧间纠缠。
AI.method: 将群舞生成分解为Chain-of-Dancers，即逐舞者条件分布的序列化分解；在冻结的单舞者扩散骨干上加入两个轻量模块：RATE用于逐舞者语义条件，GAME用距离加权图卷积网络聚合已生成舞者；推理阶段引入免训练噪声优化以增强全局空间一致性。
AI.result: 在AIOZ-GDance上达到SOTA的运动质量与群体协调性，并在结构上保持逐舞者身份；参数量减少3–4倍，训练时间减少3–6倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过序列化分解与轻量模块设计，单个模型即可泛化到不同群体规模而无需重训练，为可扩展群舞生成提供了高效方案。

title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
summary: Voice agents are converging on a collaboration pattern: a full-duplex interaction model stays on the live channel as the entry to the conversation, while search, reasoning, and coding are handled through asynchronous delegation. A duplex model supports continuous listening and speaking, but complex reasoning and tool use may exceed its capabilities. A coding agent can plan and execute extended tasks, but its sequential interface is a poor fit for live conversation. Combining them requires a harness that coordinates task acceptance, progress, cancellation, replacement, and result delivery while keeping the conversation responsive. Existing harnesses often rely on coupled heuristics, making them difficult to improve systematically from evidence. We present DuplexAgent, a full-duplex collaboration system whose harness expresses this workflow as six editable modules, and Duplex-Harness-RSI, a closed loop that revises them from interaction traces. A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair. Reasoning LLMs and coding agents in the delegation pool also serve the improvement loop: the Exam Planner selects the next tests from observed weaknesses and the repair archive, and the Harness Editor proposes targeted module changes. The capabilities that serve the user thus also improve the system's coordination. Experiments on intelligence, agentic, and duplex benchmarks show that DuplexAgent combines continuous interaction with difficult reasoning and complex task execution, achieving stronger spoken-knowledge and executable-tool scores than the compared delegated systems while maintaining strong interruption response. A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DuplexAgent 全双工协作系统与 Duplex-Harness-RSI 闭环，用六个可编辑模块编排会话与异步委派，并通过仿真对话轨迹自动诊断与修复协作模块，在智能、智能体和双工基准上优于对比的委派系统。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体正形成一种协作范式：全双工模型在实时通道上作为对话入口，而搜索、推理与编码通过异步委派完成。但全双工模型难以胜任复杂推理与工具使用，编码智能体的顺序接口又不适合实时对话。两者结合需要一套 harness 协调任务接受、进度、取消、替换与结果交付，同时保持对话响应性；现有 harness 多依赖耦合启发式，难以依据证据系统性改进。
AI.method: 提出 DuplexAgent：将协作流程表达为六个可编辑模块的 harness；以及 Duplex-Harness-RSI：从交互轨迹中修改这些模块的闭环。仿真器自动生成带时序的测试对话、运行系统并产出失败轨迹，用于定位需修复的协作模块。委派池中的推理大模型与编码智能体也参与改进循环：Exam Planner 根据观测到的弱点和修复档案选择下一批测试，Harness Editor 提出有针对性的模块修改。
AI.result: 在智能、智能体与双工基准上的实验表明，DuplexAgent 将连续交互与困难推理、复杂任务执行相结合，口语知识分与可执行工具分超过所对比的委派系统，同时保持较强的打断响应能力。harness 消融进一步显示，该模块化、可验证的闭环优于初始 harness 以及缺少其诊断与修复档案的反复编辑。
AI.conclusion: 将协作流程模块化并构建基于轨迹诊断与修复档案的闭环，可系统性地改进全双工语音智能体与异步委派智能体的协同能力，使服务用户的能力同时反哺系统自身的协调机制。

title: Self-Supervised Speech Representations for Cross-Speaker Dysarthria Detection During Awake Craniotomy
summary: Detecting intra-operative speech impairment during awake craniotomy is essential for preserving language function. However, automated detection remains challenging because operating-room recordings contain substantial acoustic interference, clinically relevant speech events are rare, and available cohorts are small and heterogeneous across speakers. This study presents a systematic component-wise evaluation of a pipeline for distinguishing dysarthric from no-trouble speech in the DATABRASE corpus of awake-craniotomy recordings. The pipeline incorporates speaker diarization to isolate patient speech, a multi-view representation combining handcrafted acoustic descriptors with multilayer wav2vec 2.0 embeddings, speaker-conditional normalization and transferability-based feature selection to improve cross-speaker robustness, and a cascaded classifier comprising a gradient-boosted first stage and a neural second stage. Evaluation was conducted under strict speaker-independent conditions using leave-one-speaker-out cross-validation. The results show that cross-speaker performance is influenced more strongly by the speech representation than by classifier choice. The AUCs of three classifiers differed by no more than 4.7%, whereas replacing conventional acoustic descriptors with the multilayer self-supervised representation produced AUC improvements of 18.2%-26.1%. Diarization-conditioned feature extraction and the proposed classifier cascade provided additional consistent gains. These findings indicate that reliable patient-specific speech isolation and strong pretrained representations are more important than increased classifier complexity in low-resource intra-operative settings. They also quantify the potential performance gains that may be achieved through patient-specific preoperative calibration.

AI.tldr: 该研究对清醒开颅术中构音障碍与正常语音的自动检测流程进行了系统性组件评估，发现说话人独立条件下，语音表征比分类器选择对跨说话人性能影响更大。
AI.motivation: 术中语音障碍检测对保护语言功能至关重要，但手术室录音存在严重声学干扰、临床相关语音事件稀少、可用队列小且说话人间异质性强，导致自动化检测困难。
AI.method: 在DATABRASE清醒开颅录音语料上，构建并逐组件评估检测流程：说话人日志（diarization）隔离患者语音；多视角表征融合手工声学描述符与多层wav2vec 2.0嵌入；说话人条件归一化与基于可迁移性的特征选择以提升跨说话人鲁棒性；级联分类器（梯度提升第一阶段+神经网络第二阶段）。采用严格说话人独立的留一说话人交叉验证。
AI.result: 跨说话人性能受语音表征影响大于分类器选择：三种分类器的AUC差异不超过4.7%，而以多层自监督表征替换传统声学描述符使AUC提升18.2%–26.1%；diarization条件化特征提取与所提级联分类器带来额外稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源术中场景下，可靠的患者特异性语音隔离与强预训练表征比增加分类器复杂度更重要；同时量化了通过患者特异性术前校准可能获得的性能提升。

title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://egocentricvoice.github.io/
summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EgoVoice，一个用于训练与评估主动式第一人称语音助手（proactive egocentric spoken assistant）的框架。作者基于 HoloAssist 中真人指导者的第一人称视频，通过声源分离与语音重合成构建干净音频流，将每个视频会话转换为模型需在每一时刻判断"沉默或开口指导"的任务格式。基于全模态 LLM 微调，并用直接偏好优化（DPO）改进主动干预行为。实验表明现有系统难以给出时机恰当、内容有意义的主动干预，而 EgoVoice 在干预时机、内容相关性和人类偏好上均优于零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴 AR 助手正走向连续的真实世界交互：需通过第一人称视频与音频感知用户活动，并在未被明确询问时提供及时的语音指导。已有工作分别推进了主动式视频助手、口语对话系统和第一人称任务理解，但尚未解决从连续第一人称流中联合决定"何时说话"与"说什么"的问题。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：从 HoloAssist 真人指导者的视频记录出发，使用声源分离与语音重合成得到干净音频流；将每个视频会话转为逐时刻决策格式（沉默或给出语音指导）。2) 模型训练：微调一个全模态（omni-modal）LLM。3) 行为优化：使用直接偏好优化（DPO）进一步改进其主动干预行为。
AI.result: 在闭源与开源模型上的对比实验显示：现有系统很少能产生时机恰当且有意义的主动干预；EgoVoice 相对零样本骨干模型在干预时机（intervention timing）、内容相关性（content relevance）和人类偏好（human preference）三方面均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 将"何时介入"与"说什么"统一建模于连续第一人称多模态流，是构建主动式第一人称语音助手的可行路径；源分离与语音重合成可有效构造训练信号，微调加 DPO 能显著改善主动干预质量。该工作同时提供了数据构造与评估框架，为后续研究奠定基准。

title: The optimal information complexity of VC learning
summary: Steinke and Zakynthinou(2020) introduces the Conditional Mutual Information (CMI) framework of analyzing the information complexity of learning algorithms based on algorithm-dependent information-theoretic quantities. We study one of these quantities, the evaluated Conditional Mutual Information (eCMI). It has been an interesting question whether the optimal PAC guarantee for VC classes can be recovered from the algorithm-dependent analyses via CMI. And we show that it is possible to recover this guarantee by constructing a learning algorithm whose eCMI is of order O(d) in the realizable case, where d is the VC-dimension of the concept class. Specially, our algorithm is a randomized Majority-of-5 base learners with optimal in-expectation generalization guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于算法依赖信息量的 CMI 框架中的 eCMI 量，证明可通过构造 eCMI 为 O(d) 的学习算法，从 CMI 分析中恢复 VC 类的最优 PAC 保证。
AI.motivation: Steinke 与 Zakynthinou（2020）提出了基于算法依赖信息论量的 CMI 框架来分析学习算法的信息复杂度。一个悬而未决的问题是：能否通过 CMI 的算法依赖分析恢复 VC 类的最优 PAC 保证。本文正是研究该问题。
AI.method: 构造一个随机化的 "5 选多数"（Majority-of-5）基学习器算法，并分析其在可实现情形下的 eCMI。
AI.result: 所构造算法的 eCMI 在可实现情形下为 O(d)，其中 d 为概念类的 VC 维；该算法具有最优的期望内泛化保证。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造 eCMI 为 O(d) 的算法，证明了可以从 CMI 的算法依赖分析中恢复 VC 类的最优 PAC 保证，从而正面回答了该开放性问题。

title: JevForest: Path Voting for Budgeted Feature Acquisition
summary: Choosing which information to observe is central to prediction under limited observation budgets. We study JevForest, a feature acquisition policy that aggregates path-dependent proposals from bootstrapped trees, weights them by global training information gain, and predicts from the acquired values with a shared masked classifier. An online implementation queries Jev for semantic answers selected by this policy. On small balanced held-out samples, four-question forest acquisition achieves accuracy $0.729$ on AG News ($n=48$), compared with $0.667$ for a static gain ranking and $0.583$ for random ordering. On TREC ($n=24$), the ordering reverses: forest accuracy is $0.667$, compared with $0.750$ and $0.833$. Asking all eight questions in one batch yields higher accuracy at lower measured cost and latency than four sequential forest queries; direct Jev classification matches the batch accuracy while costing less. Offline MiniBooNE experiments yield accuracy $0.845\pm0.010$ at ten features and $0.885\pm0.008$ at forty features over three jointly varying data and forest seeds (mean $\pm$ sample standard deviation). A companion Newton boosting implementation provides preliminary full-feature synthetic results. These exploratory findings establish a working Jev acquisition workflow but do not support a general advantage for path voting: its value depends on the task, predictor, and the distinction between question budgets and actual query costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JevForest特征获取策略（利用自助树路径提议、按全局信息增益加权、共享掩码分类器预测），并在AG News、TREC、MiniBooNE等任务上做探索性评估；结果显示其效果依任务而异，不构成路径投票的普遍优势。
AI.motivation: 在有限观测预算下，选择观测哪些信息是预测的核心问题；作者希望验证基于路径投票的特征获取策略（JevForest）是否能带来普遍收益。
AI.method: JevForest 聚合来自自助（bootstrap）树的路径依赖提议，按全局训练信息增益加权，并用共享掩码分类器根据已获取的特征值进行预测；另有在线实现按该策略选择语义问题查询；并设有牛顿提升（Newton boosting）伴随实现。
AI.result: AG News小样本（n=48）四问森林获取准确率0.729，优于静态增益排序0.667与随机排序0.583；TREC（n=24）顺序反转，森林0.667，对比0.750与0.833；一次性批量八问比四次串行森林查询准确率更高且测得成本与延迟更低；直接Jev分类与批量准确率相当但成本更低；MiniBooNE离线十特征0.845±0.010、四十特征0.885±0.008（三个联合变化的数据与森林种子）。
AI.conclusion: 这些探索性发现建立了一个可用的Jev获取工作流，但不支持路径投票的普遍优势；其价值取决于任务、预测器，以及问题预算与实际查询成本之间的区别。

title: From Log-Odds to Shapley Values: An Explanatory Geometry for the Weighted Naive Bayes Classifier
summary: This paper studies the construction of an explanatory space for a weighted naive Bayes classifier from the supervised representation induced by the model. We start from the classical supervised distance based on conditional log-likelihoods and introduce a discriminative reformulation based on log-odds, which is more directly related to the classification decision. We then show that this representation induces a distance that exactly coincides with the $\ell_1$ distance between vectors of analytical Shapley values, thereby providing a formal explanatory interpretation of the geometry induced by the model. Finally, we empirically compare several supervised distances derived from these representations using a $k$-nearest neighbors classifier. This work highlights a close link between supervised distance, local explanation, and predictive behavior, from a primarily methodological perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文从加权朴素贝叶斯分类器的监督表示出发，构建了一个可解释空间。基于条件对数似然引入对数几率（log-odds）的判别式重构，证明该表示所诱导的距离恰好与解析Shapley值向量间的 $\ell_1$ 距离一致，并用 $k$-近邻分类器对若干监督距离进行了实证比较。
AI.motivation: 加权朴素贝叶斯分类器虽具高效与概率语义，其预测几何与局部解释之间缺乏形式化联系；作者希望为其构建可解释空间，将监督距离与局部解释统一起来，主要从方法论角度揭示监督距离、局部解释与预测行为之间的关系。
AI.method: 以基于条件对数似然的经典监督距离为起点，提出基于对数几率的判别式重构，使其更直接对应分类决策；进而推导该表示所诱导的距离，并与解析Shapley值向量间的 $\ell_1$ 距离进行等价性分析；最后利用 $k$-近邻分类器对所导出的若干监督距离进行实证比较。
AI.result: 理论上证明了对数几率判别式表示所诱导的距离与解析Shapley值向量的 $\ell_1$ 距离完全一致，从而为模型诱导的几何提供了形式化的可解释解释；实验上通过 $k$-近邻分类器比较了由这些表示导出的多种监督距离。
AI.conclusion: 监督距离、局部解释与预测行为之间存在紧密联系，所提出的判别式表示可作为一个兼具几何与解释意义的统一框架，为加权朴素贝叶斯的可解释性研究提供了方法论基础。

title: What can linear attention learn from nonlinear teachers in-context?
summary: Linear attention is a tractable model for understanding the mechanisms governing in-context learning in transformers. For linear regression tasks, recent asymptotic analyses have characterised its learning and generalisation behaviour. We extend this theory to nonlinear single-index targets, $y=f(x^\top w)+\varepsilon $. Our main result establishes a nonlinearity-noise equivalence: linear attention extracts only the linear Hermite component of $f$, while the remaining nonlinear structure contributes to the generalisation error as effective noise. This reduction allows results from the corresponding linear theory to be transferred to nonlinear tasks. We illustrate its implications for finite pretraining data and for the transition from task memorisation to task generalisation as task diversity increases. These results identify a limitation of the reduced linear-attention model and provide a tractable starting point for studying nonlinear in-context learning.

AI.tldr: 本文将线性注意力在上下文学习中的渐近理论从线性回归推广至非线性单指标目标 y=f(x^T w)+ε，证明了「非线性-噪声等价」：线性注意力只提取 f 的线性 Hermite 分量，其余非线性结构以等效噪声形式计入泛化误差，从而可将线性理论迁移至非线性任务。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力是研究 Transformer 上下文学习机制的可处理模型，已有工作针对线性回归任务刻画了其学习与泛化行为的渐近性质。然而真实任务常具有非线性结构，线性理论能否适用于非线性目标、以及线性注意力在处理非线性时的内在局限，尚不清楚。作者希望把该渐近分析拓展到非线性单指标目标，并借此揭示简化线性注意力模型的固有限制。
AI.method: 研究对象为线性注意力模型的上下文学习，任务为非线性单指标目标 y=f(x^T w)+ε。核心分析工具是基于 Hermite 多项式的函数分解：将非线性目标函数 f 分解为线性项与高阶非线性项，并针对线性注意力的预测输出进行渐近分析，考察其如何作用于各阶 Hermite 分量。据此建立「非线性—噪声等价」命题：线性注意力仅能恢复 f 的线性 Hermite 分量，而所有高阶分量在泛化误差中的贡献等价于额外噪声。该等价性使得已有线性理论的结果可直接迁移到非线性情形，作者进而推导其对有限预训练数据以及任务多样性增加时「任务记忆→任务泛化」转变的影响。
AI.result: 主要结果是非线性—噪声等价定理：线性注意力在非线性单指标任务上只能提取 f 的线性 Hermite 分量，其余非线性结构被转化为有效噪声，进入泛化误差。借助该归约，线性理论中的结论被成功迁移：一方面给出了有限预训练数据下泛化行为的刻画；另一方面描述了随任务多样性增加，模型从任务记忆向任务泛化的相变过程。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了简化线性注意力模型的一个本质局限——它无法学习目标函数的非线性成分，只能将其视为噪声。同时，非线性—噪声等价为研究非线性上下文学习提供了一个可处理的起点，将理论分析由线性回归推广至更广泛的非线性任务类别。

title: Calibrating Ambiguity Set via Diagnostic Transport for Distributionally Robust Optimization
summary: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) protects decisions against distributional uncertainty by optimizing over an ambiguity set, but poorly aligned set geometry can require large radii and yield overly conservative decisions. We introduce diagnostic-transport DRO (DT-DRO), which uses held-out calibration data to adapt the ambiguity-set geometry to observed predictive errors. DT-DRO uses the conditional probability integral transform cumulative distribution function to diagnose systematic probability misallocation and translates this information into an outcome-level transport that jointly adjusts the ambiguity-set center and ground cost. The resulting formulation admits a computationally tractable dual reformulation. Theoretically, we derive valid ambiguity radii and decision-risk guarantees that tighten as estimation and approximation errors vanish, and show that DT-DRO can eliminate the nonvanishing robustness floor caused by model misspecification. Synthetic experiments and a power-outage application demonstrate improved decision quality, particularly under structural and tail misspecification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出诊断-传输分布鲁棒优化（DT-DRO），利用验证校准数据诊断预测误差的概率错配，并将其转化为结果层面的传输来联合调整模糊集中心与地面代价，从而自适应修正模糊集几何形状；该模型具有可求解的对偶形式，并给出随估计/近似误差消失而收紧的风险保证，能在模型误设下消除非消失的鲁棒性下限。
AI.motivation: 传统分布鲁棒优化（DRO）依赖预先设定的模糊集几何结构，若该几何与真实预测误差分布不匹配，则需采用较大半径，导致决策过于保守。作者希望利用可得的验证校准数据，让模糊集几何自适应于实际观测到的预测误差，以缓解保守性并消除模型误设带来的额外鲁棒性代价。
AI.method: 提出DT-DRO：使用条件概率积分变换（conditional PIT）累积分布函数诊断概率分配的系统性偏差，并将该诊断信息转化为结果层面的传输映射，用其同时调整模糊集的中心与地面代价（ground cost）；由此构造的新公式可导出计算上可处理的对偶重构，从而保持DRO的可解性。
AI.result: 理论方面，推导出有效的模糊半径与决策风险保证，且保证随估计误差与近似误差趋近于零而收紧；证明DT-DRO能够消除由模型误设造成的非消失鲁棒性下限。实验方面，合成实验与停电（power-outage）应用均显示出决策质量的提升，在结构性误设与尾部误设情形下尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: DT-DRO通过校准数据驱动的诊断-传输机制改进了模糊集几何的自适应性，在保持计算可行性的同时提供了更紧的风险保证，并在实际与模拟场景中验证了优于传统DRO的决策质量，尤其适用于存在结构性或尾部误设的问题。

title: Conformal Prediction under Partial Verification
summary: Conformal prediction provides prediction sets with finite-sample guarantees, but the label verification required for calibration can be expensive. We develop a partial verification method that returns exactly the same prediction sets as complete verification. We characterize calibration certificates, the verified information sufficient to determine the conformal threshold, and design a procedure that coordinates verification across calibration examples. For finite thresholds at high coverage, its verification cost is less than twice the minimum certificate cost when candidates are checked in order. Across retrieval, mathematical solutions, and configuration evaluation, it reduces verification cost by 15-82% compared with verifying calibration examples one at a time, while producing identical prediction sets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种部分验证方法，仅验证校准样本中的必要信息即可获得与完全验证完全一致的预测集合，在高覆盖率有限阈值下验证成本低于最小证书成本的两倍，在检索、数学解题与配置评估任务上较逐个验证降低15-82%成本。
AI.motivation: 共形预测能提供具有有限样本保证的预测集合，但其校准过程需要标签验证，这一环节代价高昂。因此需要一种在不改变预测集合的前提下减少验证开销的方法。
AI.method: 刻画"校准证书"（即足以确定共形阈值的已验证信息），并设计一种在校准样本间协同分配验证过程的程序；当候选按顺序检查时，该方法用于高覆盖率下的有限阈值场景。
AI.result: 在高覆盖率、有限阈值情形下，验证成本低于最小证书成本的两倍；在检索、数学解题和配置评估三类任务中，相比逐个验证校准样本，验证成本降低15-82%，且产生的预测集合完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 部分验证可在保证输出预测集合与完全验证完全相同的前提下显著降低校准验证成本，为共形预测的实用化提供了高效方案。

title: Transformed Samplers with Variance Reduction
summary: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods are the standard tool for computing expectations under complex probability distributions. Control variates reduce the variance of the resulting estimates, but a good control variate requires solving the Poisson equation of the sampler, which rarely admits a closed-form solution. Exact solutions are available when the sampler's kernel has a known spectral decomposition on a simple reference density. In our work, we extend these solutions to general targets through a learned change of variables. A bijection, such as a normalizing flow, is trained so that the target becomes close to the reference in a latent space, and we show that Markov kernels and their Poisson solutions are transformed by any bijection. Running such samplers in the latent space then yields explicit control variates, and the estimator is consistent under mild tail conditions on the map and target. Importance sampling (IS) from the flow is the limiting case of the same construction and the control variates apply to it as well. Experiments on synthetic targets and real posteriors compare the procedure against state-of-the-art samplers and control variates.

AI.tldr: 提出用可学习双射（归一化流）将一般目标变换到具有已知谱分解的参考密度附近，从而构造显式控制变量，降低 MCMC 与重要性采样估计的方差。
AI.motivation: MCMC 是复杂分布下求期望的标准工具，控制变量可降低估计方差，但优质控制变量需求解采样器的 Poisson 方程，通常无闭式解；仅在采样核于简单参考密度上具有已知谱分解时才能得到精确解。因此需要将这类精确解推广到一般目标分布。
AI.method: 训练一个双射（如归一化流），使目标在潜空间中接近参考密度；证明任意双射下马尔可夫核及其 Poisson 解具有相应的变换关系。在潜空间运行采样器即可获得显式控制变量；从该流进行重要性采样是同一构造的极限情形，控制变量同样适用。估计量在映射与目标的温和尾部条件下具有一致性。
AI.result: 在合成目标与真实后验上进行实验，将该方法与当前最优的采样器及控制变量方法进行比较，验证了其在方差缩减方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过可学习变量变换将谱分解已知的精确 Poisson 解推广到一般目标，统一了 MCMC 与重要性采样框架下的显式控制变量构造，在温和条件下保持估计一致性。

title: A General $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt{T γ_T})$ Lower Bound for Kernel Bandits
summary: The kernel bandit problem consists of sequentially optimizing an unknown function with noisy feedback, where the function has bounded norm in a given Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). A central quantity in the regret analysis of kernel bandits is the maximum information gain $γ_T$. In particular, the best existing upper bounds scale as $\sqrt{Tγ_T}$ up to log factors, and nearly-matching lower bounds have been derived for specific kernels such as squared exponential and Matérn. However, lower bounds for general kernels are lacking, thus making it unclear in what generality the upper bounds are near-optimal. In this paper, we establish a general $Ω(\sqrt{Tγ_T/\log T})$ minimax regret lower bound for non-constant continuous kernels on compact domains, establishing near-optimality (within log factors) in a very general sense. We show that the log factor appearing in this bound is unavoidable in general, but that it can be removed under certain conditions. Among other things, our findings imply that the minimax-optimal scaling is exactly $Θ(\sqrt{Tγ_T})$ (i.e., within constant factors) for the Matérn-$ν$ kernel with $ν\in (0,2)$, $γ$-exponential kernel with $γ\in (0,2)$, and certain piecewise-polynomial kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文为一般连续核的核赌博问题建立了通用极小极大遗憾下界 Ω(√(Tγ_T/log T))，证明现有上界在很一般的意义下近似最优，并给出对数因子可去除的条件。
AI.motivation: 核赌博遗憾分析的核心量是最大信息增益 γ_T，已有上界约为 √(Tγ_T)（含对数因子），下界仅对平方指数核、Matérn 核等特定核成立，一般核缺乏下界，导致上界的近最优性适用范围不明。
AI.method: 针对紧域上的非恒定连续核，推导通用的 Ω(√(Tγ_T/log T)) 极小极大遗憾下界。
AI.result: 证明该下界在很一般的意义上达到近最优（相差对数因子）；说明其中的对数因子一般不可避免，但在某些条件下可去除。
AI.conclusion: 对 Matérn-ν 核（ν∈(0,2)）、γ-指数核（γ∈(0,2)）及某些分段多项式核，极小极大最优标度恰为 Θ(√(Tγ_T))（在常数因子意义下）。

title: Accelerating Non-Smooth and Heavy-Tailed Sampling
summary: Anchored Langevin dynamics (ALD) is useful for non-smooth sampling where the density of the target distribution is possibly non-differentiable and heavy-tailed; reflected anchored Langevin dynamics (RALD) can sample possibly non-differentiable target density on a constrained domain. In this paper, we propose and study non-reversible anchored Langevin dynamics (NALD) for sampling possibly non-differentiable and heavy-tailed target density in the Euclidean space and the non-reversible reflected anchored Langevin dynamics (NRALD) for sampling possibly non-differentiable target density in the constrained space. Our construction adds a circulation drift generated by a possibly state-dependent divergence-free skew-symmetric matrix field and a stream potential. It preserves the target distribution without requiring derivatives of target density, admits a random-time-change representation, and applies both on the whole Euclidean space and on bounded domains with normal reflection. By breaking reversibility, we show that NALD and NRALD can converge to their target distributions faster than their reversible counterparts via finite-time non-asymptotic convergence analysis, a large deviations analysis and asymptotic variance reduction. Numerical experiments demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非可逆锚定Langevin动力学（NALD）及非可逆反射锚定Langevin动力学（NRALD），用于在欧氏空间与约束域上采样可能不可微且重尾的目标分布，并通过理论分析与数值实验验证其收敛优势。
AI.motivation: 传统锚定Langevin动力学（ALD）在目标密度不可微、重尾时有效，反射版本（RALD）可处理约束域，但均为可逆动力学，可能存在收敛速度受限的问题。作者希望引入非可逆性以加速收敛，同时避免使用目标密度的梯度。
AI.method: 构造中引入由可能依赖状态的、无散度反对称矩阵场与流势生成的环流漂移项，从而打破可逆性。该方法在保持目标分布不变的前提下不要求目标密度可微，具备随机时间变换表示，并可同时适用于整个欧氏空间和带法向反射的有界域，分别对应NALD和NRALD。
AI.result: 通过有限时间非渐近收敛分析、大偏差分析以及渐近方差缩减，证明NALD与NRALD比其可逆对应版本能更快收敛到目标分布；数值实验验证了所提算法的高效性。
AI.conclusion: 在可逆锚定Langevin动力学基础上引入状态相关的无散度反对称环流漂移，可在不依赖目标密度梯度的前提下实现非可逆采样，并在欧氏空间与约束域上获得更快的收敛速度和更小的渐近方差。

title: Beyond Distributional Fidelity: Causal-Penalized Diffusion for Synthetic Tabular Data
summary: Synthetic tabular generators are commonly optimized for distributional fidelity, but statistical similarity alone does not guarantee preservation of causal effects. In this paper, we study whether causal fidelity can be improved directly within a fully generative tabular model. Causal Fidelity is defined with respect to a target estimand as the discrepancy between inferential distributions obtained from real and synthetic data, and theoretical results show that high statistical fidelity does not generally imply high causal fidelity. We then propose a causal-fidelity-aware training framework which adds a causal discrepancy penalty to the generative objective. The framework is instantiated with a causal-penalized TabDDPM and optimized using an on-policy score-function estimator. We further establish conditions under which causal regularization improves expected causal fidelity. Experiments across diverse treatment-effect simulations and two benchmark datasets evaluate the ability of our method to improve causal fidelity while preserving competitive statistical fidelity.

AI.tldr: 针对合成表格生成器只优化分布保真度、忽视因果效应保持的问题，本文定义"因果保真度"并提出在生成模型训练中加入因果差异惩罚项的框架，实例化为因果惩罚版TabDDPM并用on-policy score-function估计器优化，理论与实验表明该方法可在保持统计保真度的同时提升因果保真度。
AI.motivation: 合成表格生成器通常以分布保真度（distributional fidelity）为优化目标，但统计相似性并不必然保证因果效应（causal effects）的保持。作者由此提出研究问题：能否在完全生成式的表格模型中直接提升因果保真度。
AI.method: 1) 以目标估计量（target estimand）为参照，将因果保真度定义为真实数据与合成数据所得推断分布之间的差异；2) 给出理论结果，说明高统计保真度一般不能推出高因果保真度；3) 提出因果保真度感知的训练框架，在生成目标中加入因果差异惩罚项（causal discrepancy penalty）；4) 以因果惩罚版 TabDDPM 作为具体实例，采用 on-policy score-function 估计器进行优化；5) 建立因果正则化能改善期望因果保真度的条件。
AI.result: 在多种处理效应（treatment-effect）模拟以及两个基准数据集上的实验，评估了方法在提升因果保真度的同时保持有竞争力的统计保真度的能力。
AI.conclusion: 因果保真度可以作为生成式表格模型训练中的直接优化目标；通过在生成目标中引入因果差异惩罚并结合适当的估计器，可在统计保真度不明显受损的前提下改善因果保真度，且其有效性具有理论条件支撑。

title: Feature Space Adaptation for Effortless Gaussian Process Flows
summary: Outside the linear-Gaussian regime, conditional sampling from Gaussian processes (GPs) is challenging. Recent methods such as FlowGP (Moss et al., (2026)) can condition on arbitrary non-linear and non-Gaussian statements, but at considerable cost: an expensive iterative and high-dimensional diffusion that requires hand-specified kernel hyperparameters. In this paper, we alleviate two significant drawbacks of FlowGP by (1) introducing kernel approximations that enable scaling to high-resolution domains and (2) proposing a way to obtain the marginal likelihood by measuring the work needed to steer the diffusion towards conditioning statements. We enable, for the first time, hyperparameter optimisation within FlowGP and demonstrate our approach on probabilistic downscaling from areal summary statistics, PDE solution inference on irregular domains, and recovery of sea level anomaly fields from non-Gaussian satellite observations.

AI.tldr: 该论文改进了FlowGP方法，通过核近似实现高分辨率域的扩展，并利用扩散转向所需的"工作功"来获得边际似然，首次实现了FlowGP内部的超参数优化。
AI.motivation: 在线性-高斯假设之外，从高斯过程（GP）进行条件采样具有挑战性。现有的FlowGP方法虽能对任意非线性、非高斯条件进行采样，但代价高昂：需要昂贵的迭代高维扩散过程，且必须手工指定核超参数。
AI.method: 提出两项改进：(1) 引入核近似，使方法能够扩展到高分辨率域；(2) 通过测量将扩散过程导向条件描述所需的工作量（work）来获得边际似然，从而支撑超参数优化。
AI.result: 首次在FlowGP框架内实现了超参数优化，并在三个任务上进行了验证：基于区域汇总统计的概率降尺度、非规则域上的PDE解推断、以及从非高斯卫星观测中恢复海平面异常场。
AI.conclusion: 通过核近似与基于"工作功"的边际似然估计，缓解了FlowGP的两大缺陷（高分辨率扩展困难与超参数手工指定），使FlowGP具备了可扩展性与自动超参数优化能力。

title: PSI-SINDy: Post-Selection Inference for Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics
summary: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) is a data-driven framework for discovering governing dynamics from time-series data by identifying a sparse subset of candidate dynamical terms from a prespecified library. In this work, we develop a statistical inference framework for quantifying the reliability of dynamical terms selected by SINDy through hypothesis tests and confidence intervals. A key difficulty is that using the same noisy trajectory for both selecting dynamical terms and assessing their statistical significance can introduce selection bias. Post-selection inference provides a principled framework for addressing such bias, and we propose PSI-SINDy, a post-selection inference method tailored to SINDy. Direct application of existing post-selection inference techniques is challenging because SINDy involves measurement error in the candidate terms and shared noise between the response and design. To address these challenges, PSI-SINDy uses data thinning to decompose a single observed trajectory into four mutually independent views with distinct roles in selection and inference. This construction enables inference for selected dynamical terms while accounting not only for selection bias but also for measurement-error and shared noise effects. We establish the theoretical validity of PSI-SINDy under stated conditions and evaluate its performance through numerical experiments on simulated and experimental dynamical-system data.

AI.tldr: 提出PSI-SINDy，将后选择推断引入SINDy，通过数据细化构造四个独立视图，实现动力学项选择与显著性推断的解耦。
AI.motivation: SINDy从含噪时间序列中稀疏辨识动力学项，但同一轨迹既用于选项目又用于评估显著性，会引入选择偏倚，导致所选动力学项可靠性缺乏统计保证。现有后选择推断方法难以直接应用，因为SINDy存在候选项的测量误差以及响应与设计之间的共享噪声。
AI.method: 提出PSI-SINDy，一种面向SINDy的后选择推断方法。核心是数据细化（data thinning）：将单条观测轨迹分解为四个相互独立的视图，分别承担选择与推断的不同角色。该构造在推断所选动力学项时，同时校正选择偏倚、测量误差和共享噪声效应，并在给定条件下建立理论有效性。
AI.result: 理论上证明了PSI-SINDy在所述条件下的有效性；在模拟与实验动力学系统数据上的数值实验评估了其性能。
AI.conclusion: PSI-SINDy为SINDy所选动力学项提供了假设检验与置信区间形式的统计推断框架，提升了结果可靠性评估的严谨性。

title: LAIR-Net: Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Networks for Tabular Regression
summary: Deep randomized models fix hidden-layer parameters through random initialization and learn only closed-form readouts, typically adding depth by stacking random trans formations without target-aware control of hidden-state evolution. We propose LAIR Net, the Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Network, which mixes a shallow learned anchor into each hidden state through a leaky residual transition. We derive a depth uniform bound on input-perturbation sensitivity and use controlled simulations to attribute gains over a randomized baseline to the anchor rather than recursion or added capacity. Benefits emerge when a nonlinear target structure is learnable at the available noise level and diminish for nearly linear targets or dominant noise. Across 23 benchmark datasets, LAIR-Net achieves the best average rank among eight randomized networks and twelve conventional models, with relative performance associated with the same nonlinear-structure and noise quantities identified in simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 LAIR-Net（Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Network），在随机化深度模型的隐状态中通过 leaky 残差混合一个浅层可学习锚点（anchor），以目标感知方式控制隐状态演化，并给出输入扰动敏感度的深度一致上界。
AI.motivation: 深度随机化模型仅训练闭式读出、隐层参数固定，其加深过程只是堆叠随机变换，缺乏对隐状态演化的目标感知控制。作者希望引入可学习的浅层锚点来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 设计 leaky 残差转移，将浅层学习到的锚点混入每一层隐状态；推导输入扰动敏感度关于深度的统一上界；通过受控仿真将相对随机化基线的增益归因于锚点，而非递归结构或容量增加。
AI.result: 在 23 个基准数据集上，LAIR-Net 在 8 种随机化网络与 12 种传统模型中取得最佳平均排名；其相对性能与仿真中识别出的非线性结构与噪声量相关；当目标近似线性或噪声主导时增益减弱。
AI.conclusion: 在隐状态中注入可学习的浅层锚点能有效改进随机化深度模型，其收益依赖于目标的可学习非线性结构与噪声水平。

title: Embedding-Bias in Conditional Independence Testing
summary: To test conditional independence of $X$ and $Y$ given a text or an image $Z$, one conditions on an embedding $ψ(Z)$ in place of $Z$. The embedded test is valid if $Z$ is independent of $X$ or of $Y$ given $ψ(Z)$, which cannot be confirmed from data, and when this fails, the rejection probability under the null hypothesis can tend to one. We study this failure, and show that focusing on a specific form of dependence relaxes what the embedding must retain. For a residual correlation test inspired by the Generalised Covariance Measure, validity only requires that the parts of $\mathbb{E}[X \mid Z]$ and $\mathbb{E}[Y \mid Z]$ missed by $\mathbb{E}[X \mid ψ(Z)]$ and $\mathbb{E}[Y \mid ψ(Z)]$ are uncorrelated. Otherwise, we treat the discarded information as an omitted variable. Under the null hypothesis, the bias equals the absolute correlation of the missed parts times the geometric mean of two partial $R^2$ values. This identity yields a robust test valid under a declared tolerance for the geometric mean, which, like a sensitivity parameter, is not identified from the data. On synthetic data and text embeddings, the robust test holds its level approximately. On text generated by a language model, under an exact null hypothesis, every embedding, even the generator's own states, biases the embedded test.

AI.tldr: 研究条件独立检验中用嵌入 ψ(Z) 替代 Z 导致的失效问题：证明对残差相关检验，有效性仅需被遗漏的条件均值部分不相关，并将被丢弃信息视为遗漏变量，导出偏差恒等式，进而提出对几何均值设定容忍度的稳健检验。
AI.motivation: 条件独立检验（如检验 X⊥Y | Z）中，当 Z 为文本或图像时通常用嵌入 ψ(Z) 代替 Z。嵌入检验的有效性要求 Z 在给定 ψ(Z) 下独立于 X 或 Y，但该假设无法从数据验证；一旦不成立，原假设下的拒绝概率可能趋于 1，即产生严重的第一类错误膨胀。因此需要刻画这种失效并设计更稳健的检验。
AI.method: 聚焦于特定形式的依赖——受广义协方差测度（GCM）启发的残差相关检验。推导原假设下嵌入检验的偏差来源，将被 ψ(Z) 丢弃的信息视为遗漏变量，得到偏差的精确恒等式：偏差等于被遗漏部分的相关绝对值与两个偏 R² 的几何均值之积。基于该恒等式构造稳健检验，只需声明对几何均值的一个容忍度（类似敏感性参数，但不从数据中识别）。
AI.result: 理论结果：(1) 残差相关检验的有效性条件被弱化为：E[X|Z] 与 E[Y|Z] 中被 E[X|ψ(Z)]、E[Y|ψ(Z)] 遗漏的部分不相关；(2) 偏差恒等式给出偏差与被遗漏相关、偏 R² 几何均值的乘积关系；(3) 稳健检验在声明的容忍度下有效。实验：在合成数据与文本嵌入上，稳健检验近似保持其水平；在语言模型生成的文本上，即使原假设精确成立，任何嵌入（包括生成器自身的状态）都会使嵌入检验产生偏差。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入条件独立检验的有效性不可由数据验证，且在实际中极易失效；通过针对残差相关这一特定依赖形式，可将有效性条件放宽为被遗漏条件均值部分不相关，并借助偏差恒等式构造出以容忍度为参数的稳健检验。实验表明稳健检验能近似保持水平，而语言模型文本场景下嵌入检验普遍存在偏差，提示使用嵌入进行条件独立检验时需谨慎并采用稳健方法。

title: Minimax Gaussian Mechanisms for Continual Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning updates a trained model after records are deleted, aiming to match exact retraining without repeating the full training procedure. We develop Gaussian mechanisms for Newton updates under sequential deletion requests. Using Gaussian differential privacy (GDP) and its adaptive composition rule, we show that the full sequence of released models is statistically difficult to distinguish from matched exact retraining. To calibrate these mechanisms for empirical risk minimization, we derive upper bounds on the error of the Newton approximation relative to exact retraining and on how this error changes after each deletion batch. Independent Gaussian noise is calibrated using bounds on the full residual at each release, whereas Gaussian random walk noise uses smaller bounds on residual increments. These bounds yield allocations minimizing the worst-case maximum noise variance across releases under the resulting GDP certification constraints. With count-based bounds, the random walk asymptotically matches the worst-case variance of a single release at deletion cap $M$, while independent noise incurs an additional factor of order $M$. Set-based bounds can reduce the noise variances by using gradients and Hessians of the deleted records. For singleton deletion, we further show that count-based independent noise, count-based random walk noise, and set-based independent noise are minimax among fixed Gaussian covariances under their respective residual or increment bounds. With set-based bounds, allowing variances to adapt to deleted records can improve on every fixed covariance by a factor of order $(\log M)^2$ on some data sequences. The residual and noise bounds also yield parameter and predictive consistency relative to exact retraining, uniformly over deletion policies. Simulations and a credit default data analysis evaluate bounds, noise variances, and estimation errors.

AI.tldr: 本文为序贯删除请求下的牛顿型机器遗忘开发高斯机制，借助GDP及其自适应组合规则，证明所释放模型序列与精确重训练在统计上难以区分；通过对牛顿近似误差及删除批次后误差变化的上界进行刻画，分别校准独立高斯噪声与高斯随机游走噪声，并给出在GDP认证约束下最小化最坏情况最大噪声方差的分配方案。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘希望在不重复完整训练的前提下，使删除记录后的模型更新结果匹配精确重训练。核心难点在于：序贯删除会产生多次模型释放，需要保证整条释放序列与精确重训练序列的统计不可区分性，同时控制噪声方差以保证估计精度。
AI.method: 1) 为牛顿更新构建高斯机制，利用高斯差分隐私（GDP）及自适应组合规则刻画释放序列的可区分性；2) 针对经验风险最小化，推导牛顿近似相对于精确重训练误差的上界，以及该误差在每批删除后的变化上界；3) 独立高斯噪声依据每次释放的完整残差上界校准，高斯随机游走噪声依据残差增量的小上界校准；4) 在GDP认证约束下求解最小化最坏情况最大噪声方差的分配；5) 给出基于计数（count-based）与基于集合（set-based）两类界的方案，并分析单条删除下的极小极大性质。
AI.result: 在计数界下，随机游走噪声在删除上限M处渐近达到单次释放的最坏情况方差，而独立噪声多出一个约M量级的因子；基于集合的界可利用被删除记录的梯度与Hessian降低噪声方差。对单条删除，计数型独立噪声、计数型随机游走噪声与集合型独立噪声在各自残差或增量界下于固定高斯协方差族中均为极小极大最优；在集合界下，令方差随被删除记录自适应，可在某些数据序列上相对任意固定协方差改进约(log M)^2量级。残差与噪声界还给出相对于精确重训练的、在删除策略上一致的参数与预测相合性。模拟与信用违约数据分析评估了界、噪声方差与估计误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为序贯删除下的牛顿型机器遗忘提供了基于GDP的高斯机制与噪声校准框架，明确了独立噪声与随机游走噪声的方差差异、计数界与集合界的优劣，以及若干情形下的极小极大最优性与自适应改进，并通过参数/预测相合性和实验验证了方法的有效性。

title: $σ$Transfer: Uncertainty Transfer from Small to Large Networks under $μ\mathrm{P}$
summary: Reliable predictive uncertainty in Laplace approximations depends critically on the prior precision, yet selecting it requires a posterior sweep that is prohibitively expensive for neural networks with billions of parameters. Under the Maximal Update Parametrization ($μ\mathrm{P}$), we derive a rescaling of the prior covariance that makes the selected precision stable as model width grows. This leads to $σ\mathrm{Transfer}$: we select the precision on a smaller model and zero-shot transfer it to the much larger model, i.e., without searching for the precision on the larger model at all. We show convergence of the prior kernel, posterior covariance, selected precision, and posterior-derived decisions under explicit conditions, and verify $σ\mathrm{Transfer}$ across regression, image classification, and Transformer readouts. For example, measured precision-sweep speedups reach $\sim 5000\times$ when transferring from width 128 to 4096 on MNIST, at a target-NLL degradation of $0.002$; transferring from a public 1B to 7B model gives a median search speedup of $\sim 2.3\times$ (up to $\sim 330\times$), with a mean measured target-NLL increase below $10^{-4}$ across ten tasks. The same posterior stability also enables transfer of acquisition, OOD-detection, and abstention decisions without constructing a target posterior.

AI.tldr: 提出 σTransfer：在 μP 下重新缩放先验协方差，使选定的先验精度随宽度增长保持稳定，从而在小模型上搜索精度并零样本迁移到超大模型，避免在后者上进行昂贵的后验扫描。
AI.motivation: Laplace 近似中可靠的预测不确定性高度依赖先验精度，但其选择需要后验扫描；对数十亿参数的网络而言，这一过程代价过高、不可行。
AI.method: 在 Maximal Update Parametrization（μP）下推导先验协方差的重缩放，使选定的先验精度随模型宽度增大而稳定；据此在小模型上选择精度，并零样本迁移到更大模型，完全不在大模型上搜索。理论上证明先验核、后验协方差、选定精度及后验决策的收敛性，并在回归、图像分类与 Transformer 读出上验证。
AI.result: MNIST 上从宽度 128 迁移到 4096，精度扫描加速约 5000×，目标 NLL 仅下降 0.002；从公开 1B 迁移到 7B 模型，中位搜索加速约 2.3×（最高约 330×），十个任务上平均实测目标 NLL 增幅低于 10^-4。
AI.conclusion: σTransfer 实现了先验精度的零样本跨规模迁移，显著降低 Laplace 近似的调参成本；同一后验稳定性还支持在不构建目标后验的情况下迁移采集、OOD 检测与弃权决策。

title: Softmax Attention on Gaussian Mixtures: Linear When It Can, Selective When It Must
summary: Softmax attention, at the heart of Transformers, has demonstrated remarkable capabilities. Yet its underlying mechanisms remain only partially understood. Recent theoretical work studies Gaussian prompts, where the infinite-prompt limit reduces softmax attention to a linear map, but also removes the query-dependent selection that distinguishes it from linear attention. This work studies the infinite-prompt limit of softmax attention on Gaussian mixtures, which retain the tractability of Gaussian data while introducing latent structure, multimodality, and nonlinear dependencies. We show that softmax attention can represent and learn, via gradient-based methods, optimal solutions to a range of statistical tasks, including supervised classification and denoising. Our results highlight two complementary capabilities of softmax attention: it can recover linear tasks as effectively as its simpler linear counterpart, while also exploiting query-dependent context selection to solve nonlinear tasks beyond the reach of linear attention.

AI.tldr: 本文将softmax注意力的无限提示极限从高斯提示推广到高斯混合，证明其能表示并通过梯度方法学习监督分类与去噪等统计任务的最优解，同时揭示其兼具线性任务的等价能力与非线性任务的查询依赖选择能力。
AI.motivation: softmax注意力是Transformer的核心，但其内在机制尚未被充分理解。已有理论研究采用高斯提示，在无限提示极限下将softmax注意力退化为线性映射，却同时也消除了使softmax区别于线性注意力的“查询依赖选择”这一关键特性。因此需要一个既能保持数学可处理性、又能保留潜在结构与非线性的理论模型来刻画softmax注意力的真实能力。
AI.method: 研究高斯混合上的softmax注意力的无限提示极限。高斯混合保留了高斯数据的可处理性，同时引入潜在结构、多模态分布和非线性依赖。在此设定下刻画softmax注意力对统计任务的表示能力，并分析基于梯度的学习方法能否收敛到最优解。
AI.result: 证明softmax注意力能够表示并（通过梯度方法）学习一系列统计任务的最优解，包括监督分类与去噪。结果表明其具有两种互补能力：一方面能像更简单的线性注意力一样有效地恢复线性任务；另一方面能利用查询依赖的上下文选择来求解线性注意力无法触及的非线性任务。
AI.conclusion: 高斯混合是研究softmax注意力机制的有效理论框架。softmax注意力在保持线性任务性能的同时，凭借查询依赖选择获得超越线性注意力的非线性建模能力，为理解其在Transformer中的核心作用提供了新的理论视角。

title: Conditional Kernel Stein Discrepancy
summary: Kernel Stein discrepancies (KSDs) provide a versatile tool for comparing distributions. One of their main applications is in quantifying the goodness-of-fit (GoF) between a data-generating distribution and a prescribed target distribution. In this work, we study the related problem of conditional GoF quantification: given only a (possibly non-normalized) conditional target model, without information on the distribution of its covariates, and samples from a joint distribution, the goal is to assess how well the conditional distribution of the samples matches the target. To tackle this setting, we present a framework that allows lifting unconditional KSDs to the conditional setting through an operator-valued kernel on the covariate space, going beyond the known Euclidean case. We establish that our suggested statistic vanishes if and only if the conditional model and the true conditional distribution agree for almost all covariates and deploy it to test conditional GoF on smooth manifolds and on discrete spaces. Our experiments on level, power, and runtime demonstrate the viability of testing on these domains using the proposed statistic.

AI.tldr: 本文将核Stein差异（KSD）从无条件情形推广到条件拟合优度检验，通过协变量空间上的算子值核构建统计量，证明其在几乎处处的协变量上等于零当且仅当条件模型与真实条件分布一致，并在光滑流形和离散空间上验证了水平、功效与运行时间。
AI.motivation: 条件拟合优度问题中，仅有（可能未归一化的）条件目标模型，且不知道协变量分布，只有联合分布样本，需要评估样本条件分布与目标的匹配程度。已有KSD方法主要局限于无条件情形或欧氏空间，缺乏在更一般空间上的条件推广。
AI.method: 提出一个框架，利用协变量空间上的算子值核将无条件的KSD提升到条件设定，突破已知的欧氏情形限制；基于该统计量进行条件拟合优度检验，并应用于光滑流形与离散空间。
AI.result: 理论证明所提统计量在几乎处处的协变量上为零当且仅当条件模型与真实条件分布一致；实验在水平、功效与运行时间方面展示了在流形和离散空间上检验的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将KSD扩展至条件拟合优度检验，并在流形与离散空间上提供可行的检验方法，拓展了KSD的适用范围。

title: Learning structured linear dynamical systems from missing observations
summary: We consider the problem of learning structured linear dynamical systems over convex sets $\mathcal{K}$, where only a small subset of the observations are available at each time point. An estimator which minimizes a bias-corrected, potentially non-convex objective function is proposed. Non-asymptotic bounds are obtained for the statistical error, which depend on the local complexity of $\mathcal{K}$, the trajectory length $T$, and the sub-sampling probability $p$. Convergence of the projected gradient descent algorithm is also established. The general theory is applied to settings where (i) $\mathcal{K}$ is a subspace, (ii) $\mathcal{K}$ is the set of bi-isotonic matrices, and (iii) $\mathcal{K}$ is the set of matrices whose rows are formed by sampling Lipschitz functions. We show meaningful recovery of the transition matrix is possible for values of $T$ much smaller than what is required in the unconstrained case, and for $p = o(1)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究凸集约束下结构化线性动力系统的学习问题，在观测稀疏（每次仅部分观测）条件下，提出偏差校正估计量并给出非渐近统计误差界与投影梯度下降收敛性，应用于子空间、双等调和矩阵及Lipschitz函数采样行矩阵三类结构，实现短轨迹、低采样概率下的转移矩阵恢复。
AI.motivation: 线性动力系统学习中，观测往往不完整（每个时间点仅少量观测），且系统的转移矩阵常具有凸结构（如子空间、单调性、光滑性）。传统无约束方法需要较长轨迹与较密观测才能可靠恢复转移矩阵，样本效率低。作者希望利用凸集先验结构，降低对轨迹长度T与采样概率p的要求，实现更高效的结构化系统辨识。
AI.method: 针对部分观测的凸集约束线性动力系统，构造最小化偏差校正目标函数的估计量，该目标函数可能非凸。基于局部复杂度刻画，推导统计误差的非渐近上界，该界依赖凸集K的局部复杂度、轨迹长度T和子采样概率p。同时证明投影梯度下降算法的收敛性。理论推广至三类具体结构：K为子空间、K为双等调和矩阵集合、K为行由采样Lipschitz函数构成的矩阵集合。
AI.result: 获得了依赖局部复杂度、T与p的非渐近统计误差界，并建立投影梯度下降的收敛保证。在三类结构实例中验证：当T远小于无约束情形所需值、且p=o(1)时，仍能实现转移矩阵的有意义恢复，说明凸结构先验显著提升样本与观测效率。
AI.conclusion: 利用凸集结构先验可显著降低结构化线性动力系统辨识对轨迹长度与观测密度的要求，在短轨迹、稀疏采样条件下实现转移矩阵的有效恢复；所提偏差校正估计量、误差界与投影梯度下降收敛性构成了统一理论框架，并可推广至多种具体结构化场景。

title: RobustLDS: Learning linear dynamical systems under adversarial corruptions
summary: We consider the problem of learning linear dynamical systems under adversarial contamination from a single trajectory of length $T$. While identification of linear dynamical systems itself is well-studied, the problem of robust system identification under adversarial contamination is relatively less explored. In this work, we study the setting where a fraction of the $T$ observations are contaminated by adversarial outliers. We propose different estimators based on relaxations of least-trimmed squares along with an alternating minimization algorithm. Furthermore, we also propose two estimators which exploit the group-sparsity (through penalization/hard-constraints) of the outliers. For the estimator with group-sparse penalty, we derive non-asymptotic error bounds which establish its robustness to outliers. We also show empirically that the proposed estimators work well in practice.

AI.tldr: 研究单条长度 T 轨迹下、存在对抗性异常值污染的线性动力系统辨识问题，提出基于最小截断平方松弛、交替最小化以及利用异常值组稀疏性的估计器，并给出非渐近误差界与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 线性动力系统的辨识已被充分研究，但在对抗性污染下的鲁棒系统辨识仍较少被探索；本文关注 T 个观测中有一部分被对抗性异常值污染的场景，旨在填补该空白。
AI.method: 基于最小截断平方（least-trimmed squares）的松弛构造多种估计器，并配合交替最小化算法求解；此外提出两种利用异常值组稀疏性（通过惩罚项或硬约束）的估计器。
AI.result: 针对带组稀疏惩罚的估计器，推导了非渐近误差界，表明其对异常值具有鲁棒性；实验上，所提估计器表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在单轨迹对抗性污染下的线性动力系统辨识中兼顾理论鲁棒性保证与实际有效性。

title: Score-Based Learning of Cluster DAGs from Interventions
summary: Graphical approaches to causal abstraction transform a low-level causal directed acyclic graph (DAG) over many measured variables into a smaller, high-level DAG whose nodes cluster the original variables and whose edges summarize the causal relations between clusters. Such cluster DAGs are easier to interpret, but learning them requires finding the clusters and recovering the edges between them. Madaleno et al. (2026) learn the interventional coarsening (the cluster DAG that merges variables the interventions cannot distinguish) in two constraint-based phases: first the clusters, then the edges. We introduce COARSE, the first score-based method for this task: it keeps the two-phase structure but, under linear Gaussian assumptions, swaps the constraint-based edge phase for a score-based one. We show that the interventions themselves identify a causal order over the clusters, and learning the edges reduces to a single local search per cluster under a cluster-level BIC score. We prove that the procedure runs in polynomial time and, provided the variables affected by each intervention are correctly identified, that it is consistent. On synthetic and real-world interventional data, COARSE matches state-of-the-art edge recovery given enough samples, with an edge phase up to two orders of magnitude faster, including on dense graphs with hundreds of nodes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 COARSE，首个用于学习干预粗化（interventional coarsening）的评分型方法。它保留两阶段结构，在线性高斯假设下用评分型边阶段替代约束型边阶段，利用干预识别簇间因果序，将边学习简化为每个簇上的局部搜索，证明多项式时间复杂度与一致性，并在速度上较现有方法提升最多两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 图因果抽象将底层高维因果 DAG 转化为节点聚类的更小高层 DAG，提升可解释性。但学习此类簇 DAG 需同时找到簇并恢复簇间边，现有方法（Madaleno et al., 2026）采用两阶段约束型方法，效率与扩展性受限，尤其在高维稠密图上。
AI.method: COARSE 保留"先簇后边"的两阶段框架，在线性高斯假设下将约束型边阶段替换为评分型阶段。利用干预本身可识别簇上的因果序，将边学习化归为每个簇在簇级 BIC 评分下的单次局部搜索。理论证明该过程具有多项式时间复杂度，且在每次干预所影响变量被正确识别的前提下具有一致性。
AI.result: 在合成与真实干预数据上，COARSE 在样本充足时达到与当前最优方法相当的边恢复效果，而边阶段速度最高快两个数量级，并可处理含数百节点的稠密图。
AI.conclusion: COARSE 是首个面向干预粗化的评分型方法，通过将边学习转化为基于干预诱导因果序的簇级局部搜索，在保持边恢复精度的同时显著提升效率与可扩展性。

title: Efficient quadratic entropy with distance sketches
comment: Code for reproducing results in LaTeX comments
summary: We detail scalable methods for approximating the quadratic entropy $p^T d p$ for arbitrary distributions $p$ and common distances $d$ of negative type. We focus on the Euclidean and spherical geodesic cases, which both use random feature embeddings and projections to dramatically improve computational complexity within a simple framework. Amortization of a single large matrix multiplication and control variates further enable computation at large scale with low memory and runtime in situations where $d$ is held constant while $p$ varies. We demonstrate this with a comparison against direct pair sampling and bibliometric/scientometric examples on Open Graph Benchmark datasets, revealing papers, fields, and institutions with both particularly narrow and broad interdisciplinary reach from their citations and text features alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展方法近似任意分布下负定型距离的二次熵 $p^Tdp$，聚焦欧氏与球面测地情形，通过随机特征嵌入与投影降低复杂度，并借助单次大矩阵乘法的摊销与控制变量实现大规模低内存低耗时计算，应用于文献计量分析。
AI.motivation: 二次熵 $p^Tdp$ 在任意分布与常见负定型距离下的直接计算代价高昂，尤其当 $d$ 固定而 $p$ 变化、需要大规模重复计算时，现有方法（如直接成对采样）在内存与运行时间上难以扩展。
AI.method: 针对欧氏与球面测地两种负定型距离，采用随机特征嵌入与投影，构建简洁统一的近似框架；通过摊销一次大型矩阵乘法并结合控制变量（control variates），在 $d$ 固定、$p$ 变化的情形下实现大规模、低内存、低耗时的计算。
AI.result: 与直接成对采样进行对比，并在 Open Graph Benchmark 数据集上完成文献计量/科学计量实验，仅凭引用与文本特征即识别出跨学科影响力特别窄和特别宽的论文、领域与机构。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为负定型距离下的二次熵提供了可扩展、低资源消耗的近似方案，并在大规模文献计量场景中验证了有效性与实用价值。

title: Efficient and Generalizable Archetypal Analysis for Discrete Data
summary: Archetypal Analysis (AA) represents observations as convex combinations of extremal data-driven profiles, yielding interpretable low-dimensional descriptions of complex datasets. Classical AA relies on a least-squares objective, which is poorly suited to discrete observations such as binary, count, and categorical data. We introduce an efficient likelihood-based framework for AA supporting Bernoulli, Poisson, and multinomial observation models. Our optimization scheme employs local quadratic approximations of the negative log-likelihood, enabling constrained updates through sequential minimal optimization (SMO) and an active-set method. Scalability is improved by bounding the active set while preserving simplex feasibility. We further introduce a cross-validated predictive likelihood criterion for selecting the number of archetypes, providing a principled alternative to reconstruction-error heuristics and stability-based diagnostics. Synthetic experiments demonstrate computational efficiency and accurate recovery of model complexity. Applications to single-cell RNA sequencing, microbiome composition, and somatic mutation data show that the learned archetypes capture interpretable domain-specific structures while achieving competitive likelihood fits and stable solutions. Overall, the proposed framework enables efficient likelihood-based archetypal analysis of discrete data, complemented by predictive likelihood-based model selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的基于似然的原型分析（AA）框架，支持伯努利、泊松和多项观测模型，用于离散数据的低维可解释建模。
AI.motivation: 经典原型分析依赖最小二乘目标，不适合二值、计数和分类等离散观测数据，因此需要一种基于似然的框架来更好地处理此类数据。
AI.method: 采用负对数似然的局部二次近似，通过序列最小优化（SMO）和主动集方法实现约束更新；通过限制主动集规模并保持单纯形可行性提升可扩展性；引入交叉验证的预测似然准则选择原型数量。
AI.result: 合成实验表明该方法计算高效且能准确恢复模型复杂度；在单细胞RNA测序、微生物组组成和体细胞突变数据上，学习到的原型捕捉到可解释的领域特定结构，同时获得有竞争力的似然拟合和稳定解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了离散数据的高效基于似然的原型分析，并辅以基于预测似然的模型选择方法。

title: Diffusion Removes Langevin's Conditioning Dependence: A Sharp Gaussian Analysis
summary: Despite their empirical success, why diffusion models overcome the bottlenecks of classical score-based samplers remains unclear. In this work, we leverage Gaussian distributions to isolate this phenomenon. We establish 2-Wasserstein convergence bounds for optimized hyperparameters, showing that diffusion processes achieve a sampling error of $O(\sqrt{dλ_{\max}}\log N/N)$, where $d$ is the dimension, $N$ the number of sampling steps, and $λ_{\max}$ the largest eigenvalue of the target covariance matrix. Unadjusted and underdamped Langevin dynamics suffer from an additional $\sqrtκ$ factor, where $κ$ is the condition number. These rates follow from spectral bounds which are sharp: we confirm them via matching first-order asymptotics as $N\rightarrow\infty$. Our analysis provides a rigorous characterization, in the Gaussian setting, of how time-dependent score trajectories remove condition-number dependence during sampling. By contrast, in the learning phase, we show that estimating the unnoised score by gradient descent leads to essentially the same estimator as estimating a noisy score, which suggests that the benefits of noising do not come from the learning phase.

AI.tldr: 在高斯设定下，为扩散模型与Langevin采样器建立2-Wasserstein收敛界，证明扩散过程采样误差为$O(\sqrt{d\lambda_{\max}}\log N/N)$，而Langevin动力学存在额外$\sqrt\kappa$因子，从而严格刻画了时变分数轨迹消除条件数依赖的机制。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在实践中成功，但为何能克服经典基于分数的采样器（如Langevin动力学）的瓶颈尚不清楚。作者希望用一个可解析的框架隔离并解释这一现象。
AI.method: 利用高斯分布作为可解析的测试场景，针对优化超参数建立2-Wasserstein收敛界；通过谱界分析给出尖锐速率，并用$N\rightarrow\infty$时的一阶渐近匹配加以验证；同时对比学习阶段中"无噪分数"与"有噪分数"的梯度下降估计量。
AI.result: 扩散过程采样误差为$O(\sqrt{d\lambda_{\max}}\log N/N)$，其中$d$为维度、$N$为采样步数、$\lambda_{\max}$为目标协方差矩阵最大特征值；未调整与欠阻尼Langevin动力学则多出$\sqrt\kappa$因子（$\kappa$为条件数）。所给速率由尖锐谱界导出并经验证。学习阶段中，用梯度下降估计无噪分数与估计有噪分数得到基本相同的估计量。
AI.conclusion: 在高斯设定下严格刻画了时变分数轨迹如何消除采样中的条件数依赖；并指出加噪的收益并非来自学习阶段。

title: Differentiable Systematic Resampling for Variational Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: Particle filters are a standard tool for nonlinear state estimation, but their resampling step is discrete, preventing gradient-based learning in variational sequential Monte Carlo. We introduce Differentiable Systematic Resampling (DSR), a temperature-controlled relaxation of systematic resampling, that preserves the CDF-ordered, banded structure of systematic resampling while enabling full gradient flow. DSR converges to exact systematic resampling as the temperature vanishes, and we prove a pointwise exponential convergence rate for the induced bias. Compared to optimal-transport-based differentiable resampling, DSR avoids iterative solvers and has substantially lower computational overhead. Experiments on stochastic dynamical systems and real-world handwriting data show that DSR achieves comparable or superior filtering and dynamics learning performance.

AI.tldr: 提出可微系统重采样（DSR），用温度控制的松弛方法实现系统重采样的可微化，保持CDF有序带结构，温度趋零时收敛到精确系统重采样，并给出偏差的逐点指数收敛率。
AI.motivation: 粒子滤波是标准非线性状态估计工具，但重采样步骤是离散的，阻碍了变分序列蒙特卡洛中的基于梯度的学习。已有基于最优传输的可微重采样方法需要迭代求解器，计算开销大。
AI.method: 提出DSR：对系统重采样做温度控制的连续松弛，保留其CDF有序、带状结构，同时允许完整梯度回传。温度趋零时收敛到精确系统重采样。与最优传输方法相比，DSR无需迭代求解器。
AI.result: 理论上证明了DSR诱导偏差的逐点指数收敛率；计算开销显著低于最优传输方法。在随机动力系统和真实手写数据上，DSR的滤波与动力学学习性能达到相当或更优水平。
AI.conclusion: DSR为变分序列蒙特卡洛提供了高效、可微的重采样方案，兼顾精确性与梯度可训练性，实验验证其性能与计算优势。

title: Quickest Change Detection with Diffusion-Integrated Scores
summary: Classical CUSUM relies on the log-likelihood ratio of the underlying distributions, which cannot generally be computed from finite pre- and post-change samples alone. We propose diffusion-integrated score CUSUM (DI-SCUSUM), a training-free detector. We add Gaussian noise to the samples to form two smooth density estimates and calculate their Hyvärinen scores exactly, without training a score network. For each incoming observation, we sample a diffusion time, perturb the observation, and use the importance-weighted score difference as an increment in the DI-SCUSUM recursion. Under the assumption that observations follow the fixed empirical distributions, the post-change mean increment is proportional to the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from the smoothed post-change to the smoothed pre-change empirical distribution. We establish exponential false-alarm scaling and a first-order delay bound that, for a fixed threshold and increment scaling, is inversely proportional to the KL divergence. In the calibrated anisotropic Gaussian simulation, DI-SCUSUM nearly matches likelihood-ratio CUSUM and reduces the measured detection delay by about 91% relative to score-based CUSUM. On MNIST and Oxford-IIIT Pet, DI-SCUSUM also has lower empirical conditional detection delay than SCUSUM at comparable false-alarm levels.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的扩散积分分数CUSUM（DI-SCUSUM）检测器，利用加噪构造平滑密度估计并精确计算Hyvärinen分数，以重要性加权分数差作为递归增量，实现近似然比CUSUM的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 经典CUSUM依赖对数似然比，而该比值一般无法仅由有限的变前与变后样本计算得到，因此需要一种无需训练、仅依赖经验样本即可进行序贯变点检测的方法。
AI.method: 对样本加高斯噪声形成两个平滑密度估计，并精确计算其Hyvärinen分数（无需训练分数网络）；对每个新观测采样一个扩散时间、扰动该观测，将重要性加权分数差作为DI-SCUSUM递归的增量。
AI.result: 在固定经验分布假设下，变后平均增量与平滑后经验分布间的KL散度成正比；建立了指数级虚警缩放和与KL散度成反比的一阶延迟界；在各向异性高斯仿真中接近似然比CUSUM并将检测延迟较SCUSUM降低约91%；在MNIST和Oxford-IIIT Pet上于相当虚警水平下具有更低的条件检测延迟。
AI.conclusion: DI-SCUSUM为免训练序贯变点检测提供了理论保证与实证优势，可有效替代传统似然比CUSUM及其分数型变体。

title: ISBO: Scalable Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Optimization with Log Gaussian Cox Process Models via the INLA-SPDE Approach
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a popular method for efficiently optimizing expensive black-box objectives. However, BO utilizing standard Gaussian Processes is ill-suited for doubly stochastic Cox Processes that are often used in spatio-temporal problem spaces. We introduce INLA-SPDE Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Optimization (ISBO): the first scalable BO framework for spatio-temporal data, that models the log-intensity with a Log-Gaussian Cox Process(LGCP) and performs inference via Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation and Stochastic Partial Differential Equations (INLA-SPDE) approach. Using a Matern field on meshes yields a sparse Gaussian Markov Random Field, where INLA provides fast and accurate posterior inference throughout sequential optimization. ISBO stably locates high-intensity regions and the peak of the latent intensity with minimal evaluations. A time-varying Upper Confidence Bound acquisition with masking avoids revisits, while penalized-complexity priors regularize early rounds. Experiments on synthetic and real-world spatio-temporal datasets show accurate peak discovery, intensity recovery, and substantial speedups over an RKHS-based baseline, positioning ISBO as a practical choice for BO with point-process data.

AI.tldr: 提出ISBO，首个面向时空点过程数据的可扩展贝叶斯优化框架，用LGCP建模对数强度并通过INLA-SPDE快速推断，实现高精度峰值发现与显著加速。
AI.motivation: 标准高斯过程的贝叶斯优化不适合双重随机Cox过程，而这类过程常用于时空问题空间，亟需可扩展的时空贝叶斯优化方法。
AI.method: 以Log-Gaussian Cox Process建模对数强度；采用INLA-SPDE推断，在网格上使用Matern场得到稀疏高斯马尔可夫随机场；设计带掩码的时变置信上界采集函数避免重复访问，并用惩罚复杂度先验正则化早期轮次。
AI.result: 在合成与真实时空数据集上实现准确的峰值发现与强度恢复，相较基于RKHS的基线有显著加速，且评估次数极少。
AI.conclusion: ISBO是处理点过程数据贝叶斯优化的实用选择。

title: Testing Algebraic Complete Intersections
summary: Given independent and identically distributed samples samples from a probability distribution in a potentially high-dimensional real space, we study the problem of testing whether the distribution is concentrated near a real algebraic complete intersection of prescribed dimension, bounded degree, and bounded condition number.
