We design an explicit and effective learning procedure which either certifies the nonexistence of such a manifold, up to a controlled relaxation of the approximation threshold, or returns a candidate regression manifold with controlled geometric complexity. Equivalently, the procedure tests the manifold hypothesis within this hypothesis class. The proposed procedure relies on quantitative geometric estimates for regular polynomial systems, which lead to a tractable auxiliary optimization problem. We then develop a data-driven algorithm to solve this auxiliary optimization problem, establishing explicit bounds on its sample and arithmetic complexity.

AI.tldr: 研究检验高维概率分布是否集中在一个代数完全交（给定维数、有界次数与有界条件数）附近的假设检验/学习问题，提出显式有效算法，在近似阈值受控放松下要么证明该流形不存在，要么返回几何复杂度可控的候选回归流形，即在该假设类内检验流形假设。
AI.motivation: 流形假设是机器学习与高维统计中的核心假设，但缺乏针对特定结构化流形类（如代数完全交）的可计算、可证明的检验方法。本文旨在为该假设类提供显式、有效的检验程序，并给出样本与算术复杂度保证。
AI.method: 基于正则多项式系统的定量几何估计，将问题转化为一个可处理的辅助优化问题；随后设计数据驱动算法求解该辅助优化问题，并建立显式的样本复杂度与算术复杂度上界。
AI.result: 算法要么在受控放松近似阈值下认证此类流形不存在，要么返回具有受控几何复杂度的候选回归流形；辅助优化问题具有可处理性，且样本与算术复杂度均有显式界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为代数完全交流形类上的流形假设检验提供了理论上可证明有效的方法，兼具显式几何控制与复杂度保证，属于学习与假设检验的交汇方向。

title: Prediction-Powered Data Fusion for Treatment Effect Estimation
summary: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) identify treatment effects without confounding but are often small, whereas observational studies (OBS) are large but may be confounded. Many estimators combining a small RCT with a large OBS have been developed for the average treatment effect (ATE) and the conditional ATE (CATE). However, existing ATE estimators either make assumptions on the OBS or do not borrow enough power from them. The CATE has been studied less than the ATE. Existing CATE methods either assume the OBS are unconfounded, rely on a model of the confounding function, or accept bias in exchange for lower variance. We therefore propose a framework that, without special assumptions on the OBS, fuses the OBS and the RCT by preserving the unbiasedness of RCT-based estimation while borrowing power from the large OBS to boost precision. Applying this principle, we build an ATE estimator, AIPW-Fusion, with closed-form weights and confidence intervals, and two CATE learners, DR-Fusion and R-Fusion. Experiments corroborate our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个融合观察性研究与随机试验的估计框架，在不对观察性研究作特殊假设的前提下，既保持随机试验估计的无偏性，又借用大数据提升精度，并据此构建了一个ATE估计量（AIPW-Fusion）和两个CATE学习器（DR-Fusion、R-Fusion）。
AI.motivation: 随机对照试验（RCT）能识别无混杂的处理效应但样本量小；观察性研究（OBS）样本大但可能存在混杂。已有融合两者的估计量要么对OBS施加假设，要么未能充分利用其统计功效。CATE研究少于ATE，现有CATE方法或假设OBS无混杂，或依赖混杂函数模型，或以偏差换低方差。因此需要一个不依赖特殊假设、兼顾无偏性与精度的融合框架。
AI.method: 提出一个融合OBS与RCT的框架：在不对OBS作特殊假设的情况下，保留基于RCT估计的无偏性，同时借用大型OBS的统计功效提升精度。具体构建了ATE估计量AIPW-Fusion（具有闭式权重与置信区间），以及两个CATE学习器DR-Fusion和R-Fusion。
AI.result: AIPW-Fusion给出了闭式权重和置信区间；实验验证了所提方法的理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在不依赖OBS特殊假设的前提下融合RCT与OBS，同时保持无偏性并提升精度，适用于ATE与CATE的估计。

title: Density Ratio Estimation with Stein Displacement Fields
summary: Density ratios quantify distribution shift from a probability-mass point of view, whereas displacement fields describe, from a dynamical point of view, how one distribution is transported onto another. Although both offer complementary insights, they are usually estimated separately, and converting one into the other requires post-processing. In this paper, we estimate the density ratio between a target and a base distribution by parametrizing it through a displacement field acting on the base: the log-ratio is modeled as minus the Stein operator of the base applied to the field, up to a normalizing constant. This gives both statistical and dynamical descriptions of the distribution shift through a single convex optimization problem. Iterating this estimate-and-move step gives two inference algorithms: push-forward moves the model and corrects a pretrained sampler without retraining it, whereas pull-back moves the data closer to the base and fits a transformation model one layer at a time. Applications to distribution shift in simulation-based inference and to nonlinear independent component analysis illustrate the benefits and limitations of the approach.

AI.tldr: 提出通过位移场参数化密度比（对数比建模为基分布 Stein 算子作用于场的负值加归一化常数），将密度比估计与位移场估计统一为单一凸优化问题，并衍生出 push-forward 与 pull-back 两种推理算法。
AI.motivation: 密度比从概率质量角度刻画分布偏移，位移场从动力学角度描述分布输运，二者互补但通常分别估计，互相转换需要后处理。本文希望用单一框架同时获得统计与动力学两种描述。
AI.method: 将目标与基分布间的密度比通过作用于基分布的位移场参数化：对数比 = -（基分布 Stein 算子作用于该场）+ 归一化常数。由此把两种描述纳入单个凸优化问题。迭代"估计—移动"步骤得到两种算法：push-forward 推动模型、在不重训预训练采样器的情况下进行校正；pull-back 将数据拉近基分布并逐层拟合变换模型。
AI.result: 在基于模拟的推断中的分布偏移问题以及非线性独立成分分析任务上进行了验证，展示了该方法的优势与局限。
AI.conclusion: 通过 Stein 算子将密度比与位移场统一在一个凸优化框架内，可同时给出分布偏移的统计与动力学描述，并支持无需重训采样器的校正与逐层变换模型拟合，但在所考察任务中也存在一定局限。

title: Discovering Global False Negatives On the Fly for Self-supervised Contrastive Learning
summary: In self-supervised contrastive learning, negative pairs are typically constructed using an anchor image and a sample drawn from the entire dataset, excluding the anchor. However, this approach can result in the creation of negative pairs with similar semantics, referred to as "false negatives", leading to their embeddings being falsely pushed apart. To address this issue, we introduce GloFND, an optimization-based approach that automatically learns on the fly the threshold for each anchor data to identify its false negatives during training. In contrast to previous methods for false negative discovery, our approach globally detects false negatives across the entire dataset rather than locally within the mini-batch. Moreover, its per-iteration computation cost remains independent of the dataset size. Experimental results on image and image-text data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/vibalcam/GloFND.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GloFND，一种基于优化的方法，可在训练过程中为每个锚点自动学习识别假负例的阈值，实现全局假负例检测且单次迭代计算成本与数据集规模无关。
AI.motivation: 自监督对比学习中，负对通常由锚点图像与从整个数据集中随机采样的样本构成，这会导致语义相似的样本被误当作负对（假负例），使其嵌入被错误地推开，损害表征学习效果。现有假负例发现方法多局限于小批量内部，检测范围有限。
AI.method: 提出GloFND：一种基于优化的方法，在训练过程中动态地为每个锚点数据学习识别其假负例的阈值；与以往方法不同，该方法在整个数据集范围内全局检测假负例，而非仅在小批量局部范围内进行；同时其单次迭代的计算开销与数据集大小无关。
AI.result: 在图像数据与图像-文本数据上的实验结果验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GloFND通过自适应阈值实现全局假负例检测，兼顾检测范围与计算效率，可有效缓解对比学习中的假负例问题，并适用于图像及图文多模态场景。

title: Exact SO(3)-Equivariant Isotropic Kernels for Rotation-Robust Neural Dynamics
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop NeurReps (Proceedings Track)
summary: Neural surrogates for vector-valued partial differential equations can fit training data yet change their predictions when the same physical state is expressed in a rotated coordinate frame. We study this failure on three-dimensional Navier--Stokes dynamics observed at irregularly placed points. We introduce the Invariant-Conditioned Isotropic Kernel Neural Operator (IKNO), a compact graph model that builds local interactions from scalar quantities unchanged by rotation and vector directions that rotate with the data. Consequently, rotating the positions and velocities rotates the predicted velocity change in exactly the same way. On a held-out test set fixed after model design, training unconstrained graph models on randomly rotated examples reduces but does not eliminate their coordinate dependence. In contrast, IKNO is consistent to numerical precision, matches the forecasting accuracy of a general rotation-aware Tensor Field Network with $5.6$ times fewer parameters, and outperforms a parameter-matched graph simulator. These results show that a compact, PDE-specialized model can remove coordinate dependence without sacrificing forecasting accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出IKNO图神经算子，用旋转不变的标量与随数据旋转的向量方向构建局部交互，从而在三维Navier–Stokes预测中实现严格坐标一致性，同时保持预测精度并大幅减少参数量。
AI.motivation: 向量值偏微分方程的神经代理模型虽能拟合训练数据，但当同一物理状态以旋转后的坐标系表示时，预测结果会发生变化，即模型缺乏旋转（坐标）等变性。作者希望在三维、非规则采样点上的Navier–Stokes动力学中解决这一失效问题。
AI.method: 提出Invariant-Conditioned Isotropic Kernel Neural Operator（IKNO）：一种紧凑的图模型，其局部交互由两部分构成——不受旋转影响的标量不变量，以及随数据一同旋转的向量方向；据此保证输入位置与速度旋转时，预测的速度变化量以完全相同方式旋转。实验将IKNO与无约束图模型、旋转感知的Tensor Field Network及参数量匹配的图模拟器对比。
AI.result: 在设计完成后固定的留出测试集上，无约束图模型用随机旋转样本训练只能减弱、不能消除坐标依赖；IKNO则达到数值精度级的一致性，其预测精度与通用旋转感知的Tensor Field Network相当，但参数量少5.6倍，并优于参数量匹配的图模拟器。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，一个紧凑的、面向PDE特化的模型可以在不牺牲预测精度的前提下消除坐标依赖，即实现严格的旋转等变性。

title: D-SLR: The Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank Decomposition
summary: Compressing a matrix for reconstruction still defaults to the truncated SVD, approximating the data with a single low-rank structure. It is common to reduce the residual further by adding an overlapping row-sparse component, but methods that solve this joint problem often require iterative solvers and tuning of regularization parameters. We propose the Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank (D-SLR) decomposition, a closed-form drop-in for the truncated SVD that improves or exactly matches it. D-SLR restricts rows to either being stored verbatim or approximated by the low-rank fit, never both. Under squared error this restriction costs nothing: the joint optimum is attainable disjointly with fewer parameters at every non-trivial rank and stored row count (shape). With zero stored rows D-SLR reduces to the truncated SVD, so it never does worse at equal cost. The algorithm scores the entire error-versus-parameters tradeoff, and the solution is chosen afterwards by a supplied error target or parameter count, or by a selection rule. The grid and solution together cost three SVDs, with no tuning or regularization. We derive an assumption-free, a-posteriori lower bound on the error at every shape, giving each solution a computable certificate on the potential gain of any other choice of rank and stored rows. Experiments on synthetic and real data (LLM embedding tables, network traffic, hyperspectral images) confirm the gains and quantify the certificate.

AI.tldr: 提出D-SLR分解：将矩阵行限制为"逐行原样存储"或"低秩拟合"二者其一，作为截断SVD的闭式替代，在相同或更少参数下不劣于SVD，且无需调参与正则化。
AI.motivation: 矩阵压缩重构长期默认使用截断SVD，仅以单一低秩结构逼近数据；为降低残差常额外叠加重叠的行稀疏分量，但此类联合求解需迭代求解器并需调正则参数，缺乏闭式、免调参的方案。
AI.method: D-SLR（Disjoint Row-Sparse plus Low-Rank）分解：约束每行要么被原样存储，要么由低秩拟合近似，二者互斥不重叠。在平方误差下证明该"不相交"限制无代价，联合最优可不相交地达到，且在每个非平凡秩与存储行数（shape）下使用更少参数。零存储行时退化为截断SVD。算法一次性评估整条"误差-参数"权衡曲线，事后由给定误差目标、参数量上限或选择规则确定解，网格构造与求解共需三次SVD。
AI.result: 推导出每个shape下无假设、后验的误差下界，为每个解提供可计算证书，用以界定任意其他秩与存储行数选择可能带来的增益。在合成数据及真实数据（LLM嵌入表、网络流量、高光谱图像）上验证了增益并量化了该证书。
AI.conclusion: D-SLR是截断SVD的闭式、即插即用替代，在等成本下从不更差，能在更少参数下达到或改进SVD，且无需调参或正则化；同时提供后验误差下界证书，指导秩与存储行数的选择。

title: Explaining the Saliency Map Sparsity of Adversarially-Trained Neural Networks
summary: Understanding why deep neural networks make a given prediction is of great importance for their safe deployment. In computer vision, saliency maps, which highlight the image region most influential for a prediction, remain a widely-used form of explanation. An empirical observation is the apparent sparsity of gradient saliency maps of adversarially-trained neural networks. In this paper, we propose a theoretical explanation of this phenomenon for two-layer ReLU networks. We build on the established equivalence of adversarial training to the minimization of the empirical risk with weight-decay penalization and an added adversarial total variation term -- valid for certain loss functions. As the number of data points and neurons grows and the regularization parameters are sent to zero at appropriate rates, we prove that minimizers converge to a Bayes classifier with minimal gradient and Barron norm. Sparsity appears since for adversarial training with $\ell_\infty$-attacks the gradient norm is anisotropic and favors axis-aligned / sparse gradients. We illustrate our theoretical findings experimentally by evaluating the gradient $\ell_1$-norm and thresholded sparsity of naturally versus adversarially trained models.

AI.tldr: 本文为两层ReLU网络中对抗训练模型梯度显著性图的稀疏性现象提供了理论解释。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络预测的可解释性对其安全部署至关重要，而对抗训练网络梯度显著性图表现出的稀疏性尚缺乏理论说明。
AI.method: 利用对抗训练等价于带权重衰减惩罚与额外对抗全变差项的经验风险最小化这一结论，在数据点与神经元数量增加、正则化参数以适当速率趋于零的极限下，证明最小化器收敛到具有最小梯度范数与Barron范数的贝叶斯分类器；并分析ℓ∞攻击下梯度范数的各向异性。
AI.result: 理论表明对抗训练中梯度范数具有各向异性，偏好轴对齐/稀疏梯度，从而产生稀疏性；实验通过梯度ℓ1范数与阈值化稀疏度对比自然训练与对抗训练模型加以验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从理论上解释了对抗训练网络梯度显著性图稀疏的成因，并获得实验支持。

title: SPD-MetaFormer is what you need for small-data brain decoding
summary: Brain signal decoding is challenging because neural recordings are noisy and vary across individuals, while labeled data are often limited. Recent attention-based models on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) manifold have nevertheless achieved strong performance using covariance and connectivity representations, yet the contribution of learned token weighting remains unclear. We examine two representative architectures, MAtt (based on log-Euclidean geometry) and GBWAtt (based on generalized Bures--Wasserstein geometry), and find that their learned attention weights remain close to uniform after training. We relate this behavior to bounded similarity parameterizations that, under the original softmax scaling, limit attention-weight contrast. Moreover, replacing learned weights with uniform weights, throughout training and evaluation, has little effect on mean predictive performance while preserving each model's original aggregation geometry. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SPD-MetaFormer, an attention-free architecture built on uniformly weighted Fréchet aggregation under log-Euclidean geometry. Its backbone uses a geodesic residual to update a summary token and a shared spectral feedforward map to transform all tokens, followed by a learned weighted readout. Token states remain SPD-valued until tangent-space classification. Across three EEG benchmarks, SPD-MetaFormer achieves competitive results relative to published Euclidean and manifold baselines. Separate matched reproductions test learned versus uniform weighting within MAtt and GBWAtt. These results suggest that, in the short-sequence and limited-data regimes studied, carefully designed SPD architectures can provide a simpler and effective alternative to adaptive manifold attention.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在MAtt和GBWAtt中学习到的注意力权重接近均匀，替换为均匀权重对性能几乎无影响，据此提出无需注意力机制的SPD-MetaFormer架构，在三个EEG基准上取得有竞争力结果。
AI.motivation: 脑信号解码面临神经记录噪声大、个体差异显著、标注数据有限等挑战。尽管基于对称正定（SPD）流形的注意力模型（如MAtt、GBWAtt）表现优异，但学习到的token加权所起作用不明确，作者希望厘清曼流形注意力的实际贡献。
AI.method: 考察两种代表性架构MAtt（基于对数欧氏几何）与GBWAtt（基于广义Bures–Wasserstein几何），将学习到的注意力权重与均匀权重进行对比；分析有界相似度参数化在原始softmax缩放下的权重对比度限制；据此提出SPD-MetaFormer：基于对数欧氏几何下的均匀加权Fréchet聚合，主干含测地残差更新摘要token与共享谱前馈映射，token状态保持SPD值直到切空间分类。
AI.result: MAtt与GBWAtt训练后的注意力权重仍接近均匀；以均匀权重替换学习权重（训练与评估全程）对平均预测性能影响很小，且保持原模型的聚合几何。SPD-MetaFormer在三个EEG基准上相对已发表的欧氏与流形基线取得有竞争力结果；对MAtt与GBWAtt的匹配复现实验进一步验证了学习权重与均匀权重的对比。
AI.conclusion: 在短序列、有限数据场景下，精心设计的SPD架构可作为自适应流形注意力的更简单有效的替代方案，说明学习式token加权带来的增益有限。

title: When Lower Reconstruction Loss Hurts: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) relies heavily on reconstruction loss minimization to preserve model quality at low precision. We show that the weights favored by minimizing this loss need not yield better model performance on new tasks. In fact, we find that lower reconstruction loss can even degrade model performance on the same calibration data. Our analysis further shows that weights with lower reconstruction loss on calibration data can have higher loss than other weights when the distribution of input activations changes. Motivated by these observations and our analysis, we propose Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ), a post-hoc refinement process that minimizes worst-case reconstruction loss over a constrained set of input activation distributions. DRQ refines the integer codes representing quantized weights within the existing quantization grid, keeping quantization parameters and inference operators unchanged. Extensive experiments show that DRQ improves models quantized by six representative PTQ methods, including AWQ, GPTQ, and ParoQuant, and delivers gains across both dense and mixture-of-experts large language models. These results establish DRQ as a general post-hoc refinement framework for weight-only PTQ, achieving better downstream performance without adding inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文指出权重后训练量化(PTQ)中最小化重构损失未必带来更优下游性能，甚至可能因激活分布偏移而变差，据此提出分布鲁棒量化(DRQ)：在受限的输入激活分布集合上最小化最坏情况重构损失，仅在既有量化网格内精修整数量化码，不改变量化参数与推理算子。
AI.motivation: 权重-only PTQ 普遍以重构损失最小化为核心目标，但作者发现该目标与真实模型性能并不一致：更低的重构损失甚至会在同一校准数据上降低性能；原因是校准时重构损失更低的权重，在输入激活分布发生变化时反而可能损失更高。因此需要一个对激活分布变化更鲁棒的精修目标。
AI.method: 提出 DRQ（Distributionally Robust Quantization），一种事后精修方法：将重构损失的最小化改为在受限的输入激活分布集合（分布不确定性集）上最小化最坏情况重构损失，从而获得分布鲁棒的权重解。DRQ 只精修表示量化权重的整数码，保持在原有量化网格内，不改变量化参数与推理算子，因此不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在六种代表性 PTQ 方法（含 AWQ、GPTQ、ParoQuant）上均取得改进，并在稠密与混合专家（MoE）大语言模型上均带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: DRQ 是一个通用的权重-only PTQ 事后精修框架，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升下游性能，可作为现有 PTQ 方法的即插即用增强。

title: From Geometry to Generalization: Why Row Normalization Can Beat Adam and Muon
summary: Different optimizers can fit the same training data while selecting classifiers with substantially different geometries, but whether this difference provably affects population performance remains unclear. We show that row-wise normalization can achieve strictly higher population accuracy than full-batch Adam, a proxy for random-reshuffling Adam, and exact-SVD Muon in high-dimensional multiclass classification. Under an isotropic Gaussian-cloud data model, this advantage arises because row normalization's class-wise Euclidean geometry asymptotically preserves the population decision-boundary directions, whereas Adam's coordinate-wise geometry and Muon's spectral geometry introduce nonvanishing distortions. Beyond isotropy, the advantage persists for full-batch training on class means with independently oriented class-mean and test-noise covariances. It holds for power-law spectra with class-mean exponent below one, even under heavily anisotropic test noise. When both covariances are diagonal and sufficiently close, the advantage over Adam can reverse, while applying the same random rotation to both restores it by changing only their alignment with Adam's coordinate axes. Synthetic and last-layer language-model experiments support the predicted advantage.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：在高维多分类中，行归一化（row-wise normalization）相较全批量 Adam、随机重排 Adam 代理及精确 SVD Muon，可实现严格更高的总体精度，其根源在于几何诱导的决策边界方向保持程度不同。
AI.motivation: 不同优化器虽能在同一训练集上拟合出表现相近的分类器，但其几何形态差异显著；这些几何差异是否可证明地影响总体性能（population performance）此前尚不清楚，作者旨在给出可证明的理论刻画。
AI.method: 在等向高斯云数据模型下分析各优化器诱导的几何：行归一化为类式欧氏几何、Adam 为坐标式几何、Muon 为谱几何；进而推广到类均值与测试噪声协方差独立取向的全批量训练、幂律谱（类均值指数小于 1，含强各向异性测试噪声），并考察两类协方差均为对角且接近时优势反转、以及同时对两者施加随机旋转的影响，辅以合成数据与语言模型末层实验。
AI.result: 行归一化的类式欧氏几何渐近保持总体决策边界方向，而 Adam 的坐标式几何与 Muon 的谱几何引入不消失的畸变，故其总体精度严格更高；在非等向设定、类均值指数小于 1 的幂律谱及强各向异性噪声下优势依旧成立；当两类协方差均为对角且足够接近时，相对 Adam 的优势可反转，而对两者施加同一随机旋转即可恢复该优势。
AI.conclusion: 优化器选择通过几何畸变可证明地影响总体精度，决策边界方向的保持程度是关键机制；理论与合成及语言模型末层实验一致，为优化器设计与理解泛化差异提供了几何视角。

title: Rare Gate Disagreements Can Limit Plasticity: When Gradient Flow Mispredicts Finite-Batch SGD
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. Tong Che leads the project
summary: Population gradient flow is a common tool for reasoning about how neural networks adapt, including after pretraining. We show that it can mispredict finite-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) qualitatively, and we trace the discrepancy to a specific mechanism. In a two-unit ReLU regression, a source task drives the two neurons toward positive proportionality and a target task rewards separating them. After source training for time $T$, gradient flow recovers on the target in time linear in $T$. Online SGD with batch size $b$ and step size $η$ in both phases instead fails with high probability throughout a horizon of order $e^{c/η}$ once $T \gtrsim \log(b/η)$, uniformly on an explicit set of initializations with Gaussian probability above one percent. For each fixed $T$, small-step SGD still recovers, so the failure requires the joint limit of small steps and long pretraining. At the target clone, the population instability is carried entirely by inputs on which the two ReLU gates disagree. For units at angle $δ$ these inputs form a wedge of probability $δ/π$, and weight decay shrinks the angle exponentially during pretraining. On every other input both units receive the same random linear update, which contracts their separation in conditional expectation. Bounding the cumulative probability of sampling the wedge along the exact online recursion, without a diffusion approximation, shows that recovery with fixed probability from an identical source-gradient-flow checkpoint, within $e^{c/η}$ updates, requires $Nb \gtrsim e^{λT}$ target samples and batch size $b \gtrsim ηe^{λT}$, where $N$ counts updates and $λ$ is the weight decay. In simulations, recovery is approximately a function of the disagreement budget $bδ/η$ and saturates in the horizon.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示群体梯度流在预训练后会对有限批SGD的适应行为产生定性误判，并给出其机制：源任务使两个ReLU神经元趋于正比例，目标任务却要求其分离；预训练时间T超过log(b/η)后，小批量SGD在e^{c/η}步内以高概率失败，而群体梯度流仍以线性于T的时间恢复。
AI.motivation: 群体梯度流常被用于分析神经网络（含预训练后）的适应过程，但作者发现其在有限批SGD场景下会给出定性错误的预测，因此希望找出偏差来源及具体机制。
AI.method: 在双单元ReLU回归设定中，构造源任务驱动两神经元趋向正比例、目标任务奖励其分离。对比群体梯度流与批量b、步长η的在线SGD在源训练时间T后的恢复行为；分析目标克隆处的不稳定性来源（两ReLU门不一致的输入楔形区域，概率为δ/π，权重衰减使角度指数收缩），并在精确在线递归上界定采样楔形的累积概率（不使用扩散近似）来推导恢复所需的样本量与批大小条件。
AI.result: 梯度流在目标任务上以线性于T的时间恢复；在线SGD在T≳log(b/η)后于阶e^{c/η}的时间范围内以高概率失败，且该失败在显式初始集（高斯概率>1%）上一致成立。对固定T，小步长SGD仍能恢复，故失败需小步长与长预训练的联合极限。恢复条件为Nb≳e^{λT}、b≳ηe^{λT}（N为更新次数，λ为权重衰减）。仿真中恢复近似是分歧预算bδ/η的函数并在时间范围上饱和。
AI.conclusion: 群体梯度流与有限批SGD在预训练后适应上存在定性差异，其根源是两ReLU单元分歧输入（楔形区域）的罕见采样与累积效应。只有在小步长和长预训练联合极限下才会出现失败，且恢复对分歧预算bδ/η敏感，这为预训练后优化的理论分析提供了警示。

title: Exploiting Gradients in Bayesian Inference of Expensive Simulators
summary:
Simulators based on differential equations are ubiquitous in science and engineering. They are often used in simulation-based inference to evaluate the posterior distribution of the input parameters based on real-world observations of the simulator outputs. However, inference becomes challenging when individual simulator evaluations are computationally expensive. In such cases, a Bayesian optimization-based active learning approach with Gaussian process surrogate models has been used to maximize the information obtained from a limited simulation budget. Recently, gradients of simulator outputs with respect to input parameters have become increasingly available, yet they are rarely exploited for inference. Even though we only need to learn the simulator input-output relationship, gradient information can provide an additional valuable signal to guide the active learning procedure. This is of particular interest in the case of expensive simulators, when sample efficiency is crucial.
  In this paper, we demonstrate how incorporating gradient information into the Gaussian process surrogate accelerates Bayesian optimization-based inference under a limited simulation budget. Our results show significant improvement in convergence speed from using gradient information. For reverse-mode differentiation, the inference efficiency gains are maintained when accounting for the additional computational cost. In contrast, for forward-mode differentiation, the inference speed-up does not outweigh the computational costs. These results indicate that gradient-enhanced surrogates are beneficial primarily in problems where the number of parameters exceeds the output dimensionality, where reverse-mode differentiation is efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文将仿真器梯度信息融入高斯过程代理模型，加速基于贝叶斯的主动学习推断，发现在反向模式微分下能保持效率增益，而前向模式则因计算代价不划算。
AI.motivation: 基于微分方程的仿真器广泛用于仿真推断，但当单次仿真评估昂贵时，贝叶斯优化结合高斯过程代理模型的主动学习方法受限于仿真预算。近年来仿真器输出对输入参数的梯度日益可得，却很少被用于推断。虽然只需学习仿真器输入-输出关系，梯度信息可提供额外信号来指导主动学习，对昂贵仿真器下的样本效率尤为关键。
AI.method: 将梯度信息融入高斯过程代理模型，用于基于贝叶斯优化的主动学习推断流程，以在有限仿真预算下提升信息获取效率；并分别考虑反向模式微分与前向模式微分带来的额外计算成本。
AI.result: 使用梯度信息显著提升了收敛速度。反向模式微分下，计入额外计算成本后推断效率增益仍得以保持；前向模式微分下，推断加速无法抵偿计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 梯度增强代理模型主要适用于参数数量超过输出维度的问题，此时反向模式微分效率高，因而更具优势。

title: Credal Machine Learning for Risk-Averse Decision Making
summary: In many machine learning applications, it is necessary to guard against worst-case scenarios and predictions that could result in substantial losses. In principle, this can be achieved by training risk-averse predictive models that minimize loss functions such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), rather than relying on models that perform well on average. In practice, however, the effectiveness of this approach to risk aversion is undermined by the learner's uncertainty regarding the true loss distribution and, consequently, the true CVaR. To achieve reliable risk-aversion, we propose a method in which this (epistemic) uncertainty is represented in terms of credal sets, i.e., sets of probability distributions. More specifically, we develop an efficient yet reliable learner that produces predictions in the form of credal sets and combine it with a novel decision rule that maps each credal set to a single predictive distribution for CVaR minimization. Across classification, under distribution shift, and in reinforcement learning, our approach reliably avoids catastrophic decisions, while sacrificing little in expected performance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于credal sets表示认知不确定性，并配合新型决策规则进行CVaR风险最小化的学习方法。
AI.motivation: 在需要防范最坏情况的机器学习应用中，通常通过最小化CVaR等风险规避损失函数来训练预测模型。但实践中，学习器对真实损失分布（进而对真实CVaR）的不确定性削弱了风险规避的有效性，因此需要可靠地处理这种认知不确定性。
AI.method: 用credal sets（概率分布的集合）来表示认知不确定性；开发一个高效且可靠的learner，其以credal sets形式产生预测；结合一种新颖的decision rule，将每个credal set映射为单一预测分布以进行CVaR最小化。
AI.result: 在分类、分布偏移（distribution shift）以及强化学习任务中，该方法能可靠地避免灾难性决策，同时在期望性能上损失很小。
AI.conclusion: 通过以credal sets刻画认知不确定性并配合专门决策规则进行CVaR最小化，可实现可靠的风险规避，兼顾安全性与期望性能。

title: Verification with Transfer: Exact Information Frontiers and Their Price in Calls
comment: 46 pages, of which 8 pages main text. The Lean 4 formalization is in the ancillary files
summary: A verifier that accepts or rejects whole answers reveals little: under a flat prior over $k$-bit answers, zero error needs $2^k-1$ verifications. The usual remedy is to solve related source tasks, either all first, as a curriculum does, or interleaved with verification. We price this remedy in information and in calls. With an exact verifier, the least causal information that any interleaving of source calls and $n$ verifications needs to succeed with probability $s$ is a list rate-distortion function, attained by one observation before any verification. It lower-bounds the expected number of binary source calls, which designed sources meet within $1+\log_25$ calls for unique answers and within a logarithmic term in general, where no additive constant suffices. With an exact verifier and fixed sources, moving every call before the first verification preserves all hard caps on calls, although interleaving can save unboundedly many expected calls; under a noisy verifier, source-first protocols can lose unbounded factors in information and in error. For linear banks over $\mathbb{F}_2$, optimal accuracy has a closed form, and after a polynomial-time reduction the budget profile is computable in time $2^{O(h^2)}\operatorname{poly}(J,k+h)$ for $J$ sources and nuisance dimension $h$. In these banks, for zero error under a hard cap, the calls beyond the rounded-up information price are exactly those spent on nuisance. Every numbered result apart from two clauses about the planner is machine-checked in Lean 4, assuming two published results. Used as a ruler, the frontier shows a small transformer using all delivered bits at latent dimension $5$ and none at $11$ within fixed training budgets; in a test with predictions recorded before training, low XOR degree of the target bits did not suffice for their use.

AI.tldr: 本文用信息论刻画"验证器+源任务调用"的代价：精确验证下最优为"先观测一次再做验证"，其调用数由列表率失真函数下界；并给出线性F2库的闭式最优精度与多项式时间预算剖面算法。
AI.motivation: 整体答案的验证器信息量极低（平坦先验下零错误需2^k−1次验证），实践中常用"先解相关源任务"或"与验证交替"来补救，但这种补救在信息与调用次数上的代价缺乏精确量化。
AI.method: 将源调用与n次验证的交错协议形式化为信息论问题：定义列表率失真函数给出成功概率s所需的最小因果信息；用该下界约束二元源调用的期望次数；比较"源优先"与"交错"协议；对F2上的线性库推导最优精度闭式解，并通过多项式时间归约在时间2^{O(h²)}poly(J,k+h)内计算预算剖面；结果用Lean 4机器验证。
AI.result: 精确验证下，任何交错协议成功概率s所需最小因果信息等于列表率失真函数，由"验证前一次观测"达到；该界下界期望二元源调用数，设计源在唯一答案下达到1+log_2 5次以内、一般情形差一个对数项，且无加性常数可达。固定源下把所有调用移到首次验证前保持所有硬性调用上限，但交错可节省无界期望调用；噪声验证下源优先协议可能损失无界的信息与误差因子。F2线性库最优精度有闭式解，预算剖面可在2^{O(h²)}poly(J,k+h)内计算；零错误硬上限下超出取整信息价的调用恰好花在nuisance上。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以率失真为"标尺"给出源调用与验证交互的精确代价边界，揭示交错仅对期望调用有利而对硬上限与噪声鲁棒性无益；线性库情形可高效计算，理论预测与小型Transformer的位使用行为（latent维度5用满、11不用）相符。

title: Composite Online-to-Nonconvex Conversion with Optimal Oracle Complexity
summary: We consider stochastic nonsmooth nonconvex composite optimization, which includes several important problems such as constrained optimization and the regularized training of neural networks. The objective is the sum of a possibly nonsmooth nonconvex Lipschitz function and a convex regularizer, and the function is accessed through stochastic gradients or function values. The goal is to find a point that satisfies a Goldstein-type stationarity condition designed for composite objectives. To our knowledge, no oracle complexity bound for this setting is known under first-order access, and existing complexities under zeroth-order access are suboptimal. To handle this issue, we employ the framework of online-to-nonconvex conversion, which chooses update directions by an online learner and is known to achieve optimal rates for noncomposite problems. We extend the framework to our composite scenario by introducing new losses for the learner, which contain the regularizer itself rather than its linearization and for which a variant of online mirror descent achieves low regret. We show that the resulting algorithm finds such a point with $O(δ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ stochastic gradient queries or $O(dδ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ function-value queries, where $δ$ is the Goldstein radius, $\varepsilon$ is the stationarity tolerance, and $d$ is the dimension. These rates match the optimal ones for noncomposite nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, demonstrating that the additional convex regularizer does not worsen the oracle complexity. We also give rates for the smooth case and present numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机非光滑非凸复合优化，目标为Lipschitz非光滑非凸函数与凸正则项之和。作者扩展online-to-nonconvex转换框架，为学习器设计含正则项本身的新损失，使online mirror descent变体达到低regret，从而首次给出该设置下Goldstein型稳定点的oracle复杂度：随机梯度查询$O(\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$，函数值查询$O(d\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$，与非复合情形最优率一致。
AI.motivation: 随机非光滑非凸复合优化涵盖约束优化、神经网络正则化训练等重要问题，目标是找到复合目标的Goldstein型稳定点。然而在一阶oracle访问下尚无已知复杂度界，零阶访问下现有复杂度也次优，因此需要建立最优的oracle复杂度。
AI.method: 采用online-to-nonconvex转换框架，通过在线学习器选择更新方向；将其扩展到复合场景，为学习器引入包含正则项本身（而非其线性化）的新损失函数，并设计达到低regret的online mirror descent变体，由此构造算法。
AI.result: 算法找到Goldstein型稳定点所需随机梯度查询为$O(\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$，函数值查询为$O(d\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$，其中$\delta$为Goldstein半径，$\varepsilon$为稳定性容差，$d$为维度。该速率与非复合非光滑非凸优化的最优速率相匹配。此外还给出光滑情形的速率并进行数值实验。
AI.conclusion: 额外凸正则项不会恶化oracle复杂度，所得复杂度达到非复合问题的最优水平，为非光滑非凸复合优化提供了首个一阶最优复杂度界。

title: Closing the Horizon Gap in Policy Optimization for Adversarial MDPs
summary: We consider policy optimization for online episodic tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs) with adversarial losses and bandit feedback. Policy optimization updates the policy locally at each state and avoids optimization over the occupancy-measure polytope, but its existing regret bounds are larger by a factor of the horizon $H$ than those of occupancy-measure-based algorithms. We close this gap by using regularized $Q$-functions, which allow us to control the stability of the local updates jointly over all state-action pairs rather than separately at each state. The resulting algorithm attains high-probability regret bounds of $\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$ for known transitions and $\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$ for unknown transitions, where $S$ is the number of states, $A$ the number of actions, and $T$ the number of episodes. Both bounds improve the horizon dependence of existing policy optimization bounds, and the latter matches the best-known bound. We further extend the algorithm to adversarial linear-mixture MDPs and obtain the same improvement in the horizon dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文通过正则化Q函数联合控制所有状态-动作对的局部更新稳定性，消除了策略优化算法在在线情景式表格MDP中相对于占用测度算法多出的H因子，达到已知转移$\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$、未知转移$\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$的高概率遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 策略优化在每个状态局部更新策略，避免在占用测度多面体上优化，但其现有遗憾界比占用测度类算法大一个horizon因子H，亟需弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 针对带对抗损失和bandit反馈的在线情景式表格MDP，采用正则化Q函数，对所有状态-动作对的局部更新稳定性进行联合控制，而非在每个状态分别控制；并进一步推广到对抗线性混合MDP。
AI.result: 已知转移下取得$\widetilde O(\sqrt{HS(H+A)T})$的高概率遗憾界，未知转移下取得$\widetilde O(HS\sqrt{AT})$；两者均改善了现有策略优化界的horizon依赖，后者匹配已知最优界；在线性混合MDP中也获得相同的horizon依赖改进。
AI.conclusion: 正则化Q函数可有效弥补策略优化与占用测度算法之间的horizon因子差距，并在表格MDP与线性混合MDP中均取得更优或最优的遗憾保证。

title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
summary: Koopman operator theory provides a linear framework for analyzing nonlinear dynamical systems and has become a major tool for data-driven modeling. A central challenge, however, is that finite-dimensional approximations computed by methods such as extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) require the dictionary to be specified a priori. Recent machine-learning approaches address this limitation by learning the dictionary from data, predominantly using artificial neural network (ANN) autoencoder architectures. Although kernel methods offer an alternative with greater interpretability and tractability for theoretical analysis, they have received little attention in this setting. We introduce extended dynamic mode decomposition with kernel-based dictionary learning (EDMD-kDL), a kernel-based method for learning finite-dimensional Koopman embeddings directly from data. The method combines ideas from collocation methods and bilevel optimization to simultaneously learn a kernel dictionary and the corresponding Koopman approximation. We evaluate EDMD-kDL against state-of-the-art ANN-based approaches on a range of numerical experiments, including global sea-surface-temperature forecasting and learning directly from video data. Across all tested settings, EDMD-kDL achieves performance comparable to or better than the ANN-based methods. Moreover, in contrast to standard kernel methods, the proposed approach is scalable to large datasets by design since the size of the required kernel matrices depends on the number of collocation points rather than the size of the training dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于核的Koopman字典学习方法EDMD-kDL，通过配置点与双层优化同时学习核字典与Koopman近似，在多个任务上媲美或优于基于神经网络的先进方法，并可扩展至大规模数据集。
AI.motivation: Koopman算子理论为非线性动力系统提供线性分析框架，但EDMD等有限维近似方法需预先指定字典。现有机器学习方法主要依赖人工神经网络自编码器从数据中学习字典，而核方法虽具备更强的可解释性与理论可分析性，却在此场景中鲜受关注。
AI.method: 提出EDMD-kDL，融合配置法（collocation methods）与双层优化（bilevel optimization）思想，以核方法直接从数据中学习有限维Koopman嵌入，同时学习核字典及相应的Koopman近似。
AI.result: 在包括全球海表温度预测及直接从视频数据学习等多项数值实验中，与最先进的基于人工神经网络的方法相比，EDMD-kDL在所有测试场景下性能相当或更优。此外，由于所需核矩阵的规模仅取决于配置点数量而非训练数据集大小，该方法在设计上可扩展至大规模数据集，区别于标准核方法。
AI.conclusion: EDMD-kDL为Koopman字典学习提供了一种兼具可解释性、理论可分析性与可扩展性的核方法替代方案，在性能上可与神经网络方法竞争。

title: SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration.
  SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time.
  Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{https://bogao-code.github.io/SLVR/}{here}.

AI.tldr: 提出 SLVR 训练框架，将多模态推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择与整合的分类型潜在阶段，在无需推理时生成文本思维链的前提下提升细粒度视觉推理性能。
AI.motivation: MLLM 常依赖语言先验而非任务相关视觉证据作答；文本思维链虽能缓解该问题，但自回归生成中间步骤会带来额外推理开销，且现有潜在推理方法对中间状态编码内容缺乏控制，难以分别监督规划、定位与证据选择。
AI.method: SLVR 首先通过掩蔽泄露答案的文本，并将正确答案与视觉上合理的干扰项进行对比，训练模型依赖图像；随后将推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择与整合等类型化潜在阶段，分别用计划、边界框、视觉证据和最终理由等对应信号监督每个阶段，从而赋予潜在推理显式功能结构并在推理时避免生成文本链。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 构建，SLVR 在多模态推理基准上取得一致提升，MMVP 绝对增益 +9.4，BLINK Relation 增益 +14.2，同时在 V*、MathVista 与 ChartQA 上亦有改善。
AI.conclusion: 结构化潜在监督可在不承担文本 CoT 解码开销的情况下改善细粒度视觉推理。

title: Seeing Through the Glare: A Multi-Source Benchmark and Ocular-Adaptive Pixel MeanFlow for Eyeglass Reflection Removal
summary: Eyeglass reflection removal is important across smartphone imaging, video conferencing, and other face-centric visual applications. The task is challenging because reflections range from mild photometric contamination to severe ocular occlusion, requiring selective correction and plausible reconstruction without altering identity or natural appearance. Existing datasets cover limited reflection conditions, constraining generalization to complex real-world scenes and systematic evaluation. We introduce \textbf{OcuBench}, a multi-source benchmark comprising 10,280 controllable synthetic pairs, 732 real-input pseudo-pairs, and 458 independent real-world test images, supporting both paired evaluation and assessment beyond generated supervision. We further propose \textbf{OcuFlow}, an ocular-adaptive pixel MeanFlow (pMF) framework for efficient, detail-preserving restoration. It combines geometry-adaptive representation with one-step pMF to focus reconstruction on reflection-obscured ocular regions, together with native-resolution frequency-preserving synthesis to retain reliable observed details. Experiments across diverse reflection conditions demonstrate that OcuFlow achieves consistent advantages in reflection removal quality, ocular fidelity, and efficiency. In a blind user study, it receives $67.32\%$ of selections, $6.2\times$ the next-best share. Both the code and dataset will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对眼镜反光去除任务，提出多源基准测试集OcuBench与眼区自适应的一步式pMF框架OcuFlow，在反光去除质量、眼区保真度与效率上取得一致优势，盲测中选择占比达67.32%，为次优方法的6.2倍。
AI.motivation: 眼镜反光去除在智能手机成像、视频会议及以人脸为中心的视觉应用中十分重要，但任务具有挑战性：反光程度从轻微的光度污染到严重的眼部遮挡不等，需要在选择性校正与合理重建之间取得平衡，同时不改变身份特征与自然外观。现有数据集覆盖的反光条件有限，导致方法难以泛化到复杂真实场景，也限制了系统性评估。
AI.method: 工作包含两部分：一是构建多源基准OcuBench，由10,280对可控合成样本、732对真实输入伪配对样本以及458张独立真实世界测试图像组成，同时支持配对评估与超越生成式监督的评估；二是提出OcuFlow，一种眼区自适应像素MeanFlow（pMF）框架，用于高效、保留细节的复原，其结合几何自适应表示与一步式pMF，将重建聚焦于反光遮挡的眼部区域，并采用原生分辨率频率保持合成以保留可靠的观测细节。
AI.result: 在多种反光条件下的实验表明，OcuFlow在反光去除质量、眼部保真度和效率方面均取得一致优势；在盲测用户研究中获得67.32%的选择比例，为次优方法的6.2倍。代码与数据集将公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过OcuBench弥补了现有数据集在反光条件覆盖与评估系统性上的不足，并通过OcuFlow在质量、保真度与效率上验证了有效性，为眼镜反光去除提供了基准与高效方法，后续将开源代码与数据。

title: LinSlot: Exploiting Linear Representation hypothesis for unsupervised attribute discovery from slot based object representation
summary: This paper studies the problem of learning disentangled representations of objects and their attributes from raw, unstructured image data. Slot-based methods have shown considerable success in unsupervised learning of object representations from images. Block-slot attention-based methods extend this framework to attribute representations by assuming a uniform factorization of object representations into attributes, which may be suboptimal and consequently limit the quality of the learned representations. We therefore investigate a framework for jointly discovering object and attribute representations. Our key contribution is leveraging the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which postulates that composable concepts can be represented as linearly additive subspaces in slot representations. Based on this insight, we propose a probabilistic model connecting images, slots (objects), and blocks (attributes). We present an architecture that leverages block attention to connect attribute representations to slots and incorporates LRH in both object and attribute representation spaces. This architecture effectively optimizes the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) of the proposed graphical model. Our experiments demonstrate (i) effective discovery of disentangled object and attribute representations, (ii) empirical evidence for LRH in slot space, and (iii) the ability to perform image editing owing to the disentangled and interpretable nature of the learned representations. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improvements in DCI scores over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于线性表示假设(LRH)的概率框架，联合学习图像中物体(slot)与属性(block)的解耦表示，通过block attention连接属性与物体并在两个表示空间引入LRH约束，有效优化ELBO，在多个数据集上DCI分数超越SOTA并支持图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有基于block-slot attention的方法假设物体表示可均匀分解为属性，这一假设可能次优，从而限制了所学表示的质量。因此作者希望构建一个能联合发现物体与属性表示的框架，以提升解耦表示的学习效果。
AI.method: 本文利用线性表示假设(LRH)，即组合性概念可表示为slot表示中的线性可加子空间。据此提出一个连接图像、slot(物体)与block(属性)的概率模型，并设计架构：用block attention将属性表示连接到slot，同时在物体与属性表示空间中都引入LRH约束。该架构可有效优化所提出图模型的证据下界(ELBO)。
AI.result: 实验表明：(i)能够有效发现解耦的物体与属性表示；(ii)在slot空间中获得LRH的经验性证据；(iii)由于表示的解耦性与可解释性，可进行图像编辑。在多个数据集上，DCI分数相比现有SOTA方法有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将LRH引入block-slot框架并联合建模物体与属性，本文在解耦表示学习上取得优于SOTA的性能，验证了LRH在slot空间的有效性，并展示了可解释表示在图像编辑上的应用潜力。

title: MESSENGER: Memory-Enhanced Sequential Scene Flow Estimation via Autoregressive Next-Frame Forecasting
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code will be released at: https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger
summary: Scene flow can capture low-level 3D motion displacements in dynamic scenarios. Early pairwise estimators relying on instantaneous two-frame motion lack long-term temporal correlation and also struggle with poor extrapolation ability in future prediction. Although some recent methods attempt to explore multi-frame scene flow estimation in a sequence-to-sequence manner, they typically suffer from heavy computational overhead with increasing input frames and long-horizon prediction degradation due to ineffective motion propagation. To address these problems, we propose a novel memory-enhanced sequential scene flow pipeline, called MESSENGER. To sufficiently mine long-term temporal dependencies naturally within consecutive sequences, a memory buffer is designed by explicitly storing multiple history flow estimates and latent states. For each input frame, the temporally stored flows and states are correlated and retrieved to predict the current initialized flow in a next-frame forecasting manner. Furthermore, we develop an uncertainty-aware reweighting module to filter unreliable retrievals and mitigate accumulated errors. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of our MESSENGER, reducing EPE3D by 71.6% on nuScenes and 67.7% on Argoverse 2 in long-horizon future extrapolation. This superiority can be attributed to our designed autoregressive forecasting paradigm, which naturally forces the network to progressively learn the next-frame distribution based on history observations. Code will be released at https://github.com/liujiuming123/Messenger.

AI.tldr: 提出记忆增强的序列场景流估计框架MESSENGER，通过显式存储历史流与隐状态并采用不确定性感知重加权，在长时程外推上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 早期成对场景流估计依赖瞬时两帧运动，缺乏长时时间关联且未来外推能力差；近期多帧序列方法虽尝试序列到序列估计，但随输入帧数增加计算开销大，且因运动传播无效导致长时程预测性能退化。
AI.method: 设计记忆缓冲区显式存储多个历史流估计与隐状态，对每个输入帧进行时序存储流的关联与检索，以"下一帧预测"方式生成当前帧初始流；同时提出不确定性感知重加权模块，过滤不可靠检索并缓解误差累积；整体为自回归预测范式。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上取得state-of-the-art性能，长时程未来外推中EPE3D分别降低71.6%和67.7%。
AI.conclusion: MESSENGER通过自回归预测范式迫使网络基于历史观测逐步学习下一帧分布，有效挖掘连续序列中的长期时序依赖，在长时程外推任务上展现优越性；代码将开源。

title: DOGS: Design-Space Sampling for Prompt-Driven Logo Generation
summary: Prompt optimization for text-to-image (T2I) generation has been pursued almost entirely as text rewriting, in which a short user brief is expanded into a longer, model-preferred token sequence. We argue that such a language-space formulation is ill-suited to structured visual design tasks such as logo creation, where a one-line brief leaves most design decisions unspecified. These decisions depend on relational priors that a linear sequence cannot encode, and they leave an uncontrolled channel through which protected marks may be reproduced. We therefore recast logo prompting as sampling within a structured design space, and instantiate this idea as DOGS (Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler). From a large corpus of real-world logos, we mine a typed, graph-structured design grammar whose edges record empirical co-occurrence. A GFlowNet sampler then generates design graphs with probability proportional to a terminal reward that combines recognizability, aesthetics, and corpus-relative originality. Every slot draws only from a closed design-level vocabulary, and any infringement-inducing or harmful token is removed during parsing. The originality reward further penalizes proximity to existing logos, thereby incorporating infringement avoidance into the method by construction. On two open-source renderers and against nine baselines, DOGS produces logos that are more recognizable and aesthetic, substantially more diverse, and far less prone to trademark infringement.

AI.tldr: 该论文将logo提示词优化从"文本改写"重构为"结构化设计空间采样"，提出DOGS方法，在可识别性、美观性、多样性与商标侵权规避上均优于九个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I提示词优化几乎都采用"文本改写"范式，将简短的用户描述扩展为更长的、模型偏好的token序列。作者认为这种语言空间的形式化不适合logo设计等结构化视觉设计任务：一句简短需求无法确定大量设计决策，这些决策依赖线性序列无法编码的关系先验，并且文本通道不受控，可能复现受保护的商标标识。
AI.method: 作者将logo提示词重构为结构化设计空间内的采样问题，并实例化为DOGS（Design-space prompting with an Originality-aware GFlowNet Sampler）。具体而言：从大规模真实logo语料中挖掘一个带类型的图结构设计语法，其边记录经验共现关系；用GFlowNet采样器生成设计图，生成概率正比于一个终端奖励，该奖励融合可识别性、美观性与相对语料的原创性。每个槽位只从封闭的设计级词表中取值，任何诱发侵权或有害的token在解析阶段即被剔除；原创性奖励进一步惩罚与已有logo的接近程度，从而在构造上内嵌侵权规避。
AI.result: 在两个开源渲染器上、与九个基线方法对比，DOGS生成的logo更具可识别性与美观性，多样性显著更高，且商标侵权倾向大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 面向logo等结构化视觉设计任务，将提示词优化从语言空间的文本改写转向结构化设计空间采样，可同时改善生成质量、多样性并内建侵权规避能力，是一条优于纯文本改写范式的技术路径。

title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
summary:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs),
  but it typically assumes a static training environment. As the actor improves, fixed tasks drift out of its learning frontier: many
  become trivial, others remain unsolvable; and the learning signal collapses. We argue that VLM post-training should evolve the
  visual environment alongside the actor, not just the actor itself. We propose VICO, a co-evolutionary framework in which an actor
  and an Environment-as-Rewriter (EnvRewriter) are trained jointly: the EnvRewriter edits verifiable image-side structures, such as
  scene graphs, chart tables, or protected region masks, and re-renders them to produce label-valid training samples whose difficulty
  is calibrated to the actor's current ability through a pass-rate-based reward. This loop continuously realigns task difficulty with
  actor capability without any additional human annotation. Across nine multimodal benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning and
  visually grounded understanding, VICO-8B improves over its base model by up to +5.0% on out-of-domain tasks, surpasses the strongest
  self-evolution and text-editing co-evolution baselines by +4.3% and +8.4% respectively, and stays comparable to chart-specialized
  RLVR methods using 16-160 times fewer labeled samples. By shifting from human-labeled supervision to image-editing co-evolution,
  VICO offers a scalable path beyond static-corpus RLVR for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: VICO是一个面向视觉语言模型后训练的共同进化框架，通过联合训练Actor与被重渲染的视觉环境重写器，按通过率校准题目难度，实现无需额外人工标注的可扩展RLVR。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习通常假设训练环境是静态的。随着Actor能力提升，固定的任务会逐渐偏离其学习前沿：部分题目变得过于简单，部分始终不可解，导致学习信号崩溃。因此需要让视觉环境随Actor共同演化，而不仅优化Actor本身。
AI.method: 提出VICO共同进化框架，联合训练Actor与Environment-as-Rewriter。EnvRewriter编辑图像侧的可验证结构（场景图、图表表格、受保护区域掩码等）并重新渲染，生成标签有效的训练样本；通过基于通过率的奖励，使样本难度校准到Actor当前能力，形成持续对齐难度的闭环，无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: 在覆盖数学推理和视觉定位理解的九个多模态基准上，VICO-8B在域外任务上较基座模型最高提升+5.0%，分别超过最强自进化基线和文本编辑共同进化基线+4.3%和+8.4%，并在使用16至160倍更少标注样本的情况下与图表专用RLVR方法保持相当水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过从人工标注监督转向图像编辑共同进化，VICO为视觉推理提供了一条超越静态语料RLVR的可扩展路径。

title: Velocity Scaling in Flow Matching
summary: Scaling a learned flow-matching velocity field $v_θ$ by a gain $γ(t)$ was recently shown to greatly improve generation quality. Prior work argued that velocity fields trained with mean-squared error (MSE) systematically underestimate velocity magnitude and that scaling corrects this error. We show that MSE training does not create a velocity-magnitude deficit. We find instead that velocity scaling reduces population time lag: sampled states at model time $t$ resemble training states from an earlier time. Velocity scaling and moving model time back are two ways to address this population time lag. Across architectures and model sizes, measuring population time lag and using it to select a gain greatly improves generation quality, reducing FID from 28.0 to 12.2 (estimated by linear interpolation between FID measurements at neighboring gains) on ImageNet-256 at NFE 25 without guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文否定了"MSE训练导致速度幅值系统性低估"这一此前解释，指出速度缩放（velocity scaling）实质上是缓解"群体时间滞后"（population time lag），并据此选择增益γ(t)可显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 此前工作发现，将学习到的流匹配（flow-matching）速度场按增益γ(t)缩放可大幅提升生成质量，并将其归因于MSE训练使速度幅值被系统性低估，缩放用于纠正该误差。作者质疑这一解释，希望探明速度缩放真正起作用的机制。
AI.method: 作者先通过分析表明MSE训练并不产生速度幅值的缺失；随后提出"群体时间滞后"假说：在模型时间t上采样的状态，实际上更接近训练数据中更早时间的状态。基于此，将"缩放速度"与"将模型时间往回移动"视为应对该滞后的两种等价手段。作者在多种架构和模型规模上测量群体时间滞后，并用其来选取增益γ(t)。
AI.result: 跨架构与模型规模，测量群体时间滞后并据此选择增益，能大幅提升生成质量：在ImageNet-256、NFE 25、无引导条件下，FID从28.0降至12.2（该数值由相邻增益下FID测量值线性插值估计得到）。
AI.conclusion: 速度缩放的真正机制并非纠正MSE带来的幅值低估，而是缓解群体时间滞后；群体时间滞后是一个可测量、可指导增益选择的实用指标，能够有效改善生成质量。

title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distilled into few-step variants and being deployed to enable fast inference. However, their ability to generate harmful or undesired content poses significant safety risks. Data-driven unlearning methods suppress targeted generations by fine-tuning model weights using specialized unlearning objectives. Crucially, these objectives implicitly rely on multi-step denoising dynamics, an assumption that breaks down for few-step distilled (FSD) models, resulting in ineffective forgetting. Furthermore, performing unlearning on the non-distilled base model and subsequently re-distilling it to obtain an unlearned FSD model incurs substantial computational and time overhead, making it impractical in many settings. Hence, we address this limitation with a preference-driven unlearning framework that revisits Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for diffusion models. We show that standard DPO and its unlearning derivatives, formulated around noise-prediction error, transfer poorly to FSD models due to their altered generation dynamics. To overcome this, we introduce a modified preference optimization formulation explicitly aligned with the few-step generation properties, enabling direct concept removal in FSD models while preserving few-step efficiency and maintaining strong retention of desirable (non-targeted) capabilities. We evaluate our framework primarily on identity and NSFW (nudity) removal tasks and also extend our method to object-level unlearning. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and effective forgetting, and strong retention performance, establishing our method as a practical and principled solution for unlearning in FSD models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向少步蒸馏扩散模型（FSD）的偏好驱动遗忘框架，修正DPO目标以对齐少步生成动力学，实现直接概念移除且保持效率与保留性。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏扩散模型（FSD）被广泛部署以加速推理，但其可生成有害内容，存在安全风险。现有数据驱动的遗忘方法依赖多步去噪动力学假设，在FSD上失效；若先对基础模型遗忘再重新蒸馏，则计算与时间开销过大。
AI.method: 将Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）重新引入扩散模型遗忘，分析表明标准DPO及其遗忘变体基于噪声预测误差，难以迁移到FSD；提出与少步生成特性显式对齐的修正偏好优化目标，直接在FSD模型中进行概念移除。
AI.result: 在身份移除与NSFW（裸体）移除任务上进行了主要评估，并扩展到物体级遗忘。大量实验显示出一致有效的遗忘效果与强保留性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为FSD模型遗忘提供了实用且有原则的解决方案，兼顾少步效率与对非目标能力的保留。

title: SPLIT-RL: Staged Perception-Language Reasoning Training with Claim-Level Advantages
summary: Vision-Language (VL) reasoning requires a model to both extract relevant and accurate information from an image (visual reasoning, VR), and to infer the answer from it (language reasoning, LR). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically trains both through a single chain-of-thought with a final-answer reward. This gives every CoT token the same sequence-level advantage, failing to distinguish capability specific errors. We propose SPLIT-RL, a staged post-training approach that trains VR and LR in disjoint phases. Because a group's rollouts differ along one capability at a time, the group-relative advantage isolates it, and each phase is optimized using phase-specific reward. We further introduce Claim-Level Advantage (CLA-GRPO), which decomposes VR-phase rollouts into atomic visual claims and provides a fine-grained advantage at claim level based on visual-type group formation. Although trained in two phases, trained policy is evaluated like GRPO model, with a single CoT call at inference time. Under this protocol, SPLIT-RL improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.4-6.1 points across Qwen3-VL models from 2B to 30B-A3B and InternVL3.5-8B. Evaluating each capability using an oracle based diagnostic shows that answer-only GRPO leaves perception unchanged, whereas SPLIT-RL improves both VR and LR.

AI.tldr: 提出SPLIT-RL分阶段后训练方法，将视觉推理（VR）与语言推理（LR）分解到不相交阶段训练，并引入Claim-Level Advantage（CLA-GRPO）在视觉阶段提供claim级细粒度优势，在不增加推理成本的前提下平均准确率较GRPO提升1.4-6.1点。
AI.motivation: VL推理需要同时具备从图像提取准确信息的视觉推理（VR）和据此推断答案的语言推理（LR）两种能力。现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（如GRPO）用单一思维链加最终答案奖励同时训练两者，导致所有CoT token共享同一序列级优势，无法区分不同能力导致的错误，因而无法针对性地优化各自能力。
AI.method: 提出SPLIT-RL分阶段后训练框架：将VR与LR放在互不相交的阶段分别训练。由于同一group内的rollout一次只在一个能力维度上产生差异，组相对优势可隔离该能力，每个阶段使用阶段专属奖励进行优化。同时提出Claim-Level Advantage（CLA-GRPO），在VR阶段将rollout分解为原子视觉claim，并基于视觉类型分组构建claim级细粒度优势。训练虽分两阶段，但推理时仍与GRPO模型一致，单次CoT调用完成。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL（2B至30B-A3B）及InternVL3.5-8B上，SPLIT-RL相较GRPO平均准确率提升1.4-6.1点。基于oracle的诊断评估显示：仅用答案奖励的GRPO对感知能力无改善，而SPLIT-RL同时提升VR与LR两种能力。
AI.conclusion: 将VL推理的视觉与语言能力解耦、分阶段用能力专属奖励训练，可有效隔离并分别优化两种能力，且不增加推理开销；该范式优于单一CoT的序列级奖励训练，为多能力VL推理的后训练提供了新思路。

title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
summary: Video-language models commonly assume that more temporal observations lead to more reliable reasoning. We question this assumption and argue that the key challenge is not merely processing more video frames efficiently, but learning to reason reliably under limited temporal evidence. We propose SAVER, a dense-to-sparse post-training framework that uses dense video views as training-time references for sparse-frame inference. During reinforcement post-training, paired dense and sparse views are optimized with grounding rewards and a reliability-gated reference reward, encouraging sparse view predictions to preserve task-relevant temporal evidence. Notably, SAVER is trained only on 1,250 randomly sampled temporal grounding examples, without using any video question answering annotations. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks and six video question-answering benchmarks, SAVER consistently improves performance across frame budgets. In particular, SAVER can match or surpass dense-frame Qwen3.5 baselines while using substantially fewer frames. These results show that temporal grounding can serve as an effective evidence-localization proxy for learning sparse video reasoning that transfers to broader video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SAVER，一种“密集到稀疏”的后训练框架，用密集视频视图作为训练参考，让稀疏帧推理在有限时序证据下仍能保持可靠，并在时序定位与视频问答任务上以更少帧数取得更优或相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 视频-语言模型通常默认“时序观测越多，推理越可靠”。本文质疑该假设，认为核心挑战不是高效处理更多帧，而是在有限时序证据下进行可靠推理。
AI.method: SAVER采用密集到稀疏的后训练框架：训练时使用成对的密集与稀疏视频视图，通过强化后训练优化，结合grounding奖励与可靠性门控的reference奖励，促使稀疏视图预测保留任务相关的时序证据。仅使用1,250个随机采样的时序定位样本训练，不使用任何视频问答标注。
AI.result: 在三个时序定位基准和六个视频问答基准上，SAVER在不同帧预算下均稳定提升性能；尤其在显著减少帧数时，可匹配或超越密集帧的Qwen3.5基线。
AI.conclusion: 时序定位可作为有效的证据定位代理，用于学习可迁移到更广泛视频理解任务的稀疏视频推理能力。

title: GHARP: Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages (14 main + references + 15 pages supplementary), 14 figures, 17 tables
summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. We decouple the problem into an identity stage that builds a representation of the subject's geometry and appearance offline, and an animation stage that predicts expression-dependent residuals on top of it at runtime. This separation offers a favorable trade-off with respect to fidelity, quality and runtime: the identity stage can be expensive while the animation stage runs a lightweight network, optimized for mobile devices. Our method performs animation in a semantically structured latent space of a pretrained reconstruction model, where expression changes remain spatially contained, making residual prediction efficient. This reconstruction prior provides a consistent spatial layout, allowing fusion of multiple input views into a compact, fixed-size canonical Gaussian representation. While this two-stage design improves the runtime-quality trade-off, it still inherits a problem common to all expression-driven avatar methods: expression codes describe only the face and thus omit body pose and clothing position, making these regions underspecified in the input. The animation network faces an ill-posed mapping and resorts to averaging over conflicting body appearances, producing blur and temporal flicker. We address this with a body alignment network that learns to align the person's body in the target image with the input reference images, removing the ambiguity from the training signal. Our method achieves state-of-the-art quality on the Ava-256 benchmark while running up to 13x faster on an A100 GPU with 8x fewer Gaussians.

AI.tldr: GHARP 提出一种实时 3D 人头动画方法：离线构建身份表示，运行时以轻量网络预测表情相关残差，并通过身体对齐网络消除身体与衣物位置歧义，在 Ava-256 上达到 SOTA 质量且速度提升最高 13 倍、高斯数量减少 8 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有表情驱动头像方法存在运行时与质量难以兼顾的问题，且表情编码仅描述面部，忽略身体姿态与衣物位置，导致动画网络面临不适定映射，产生模糊与时间闪烁。
AI.method: 将任务解耦为离线身份阶段与运行时动画阶段：身份阶段基于预训练重建模型的语义结构化潜空间，融合多视角输入，构建紧凑定长规范高斯表示；动画阶段用轻量网络在该潜空间内预测表情相关残差，并引入身体对齐网络，将目标图像中的人体与输入参考图像对齐以消除训练信号的歧义。
AI.result: 在 Ava-256 基准上取得最先进质量，在 A100 GPU 上运行速度最高提升 13 倍，高斯数量减少 8 倍。
AI.conclusion: GHARP 通过两阶段解耦、结构化潜空间残差预测与身体对齐，有效改善实时质量与效率的权衡，并解决表情驱动头像中身体区域欠约束导致的模糊和闪烁问题。

title: GPU-Accelerated Computation of Persistent Homology for Topological Analysis of Image Data
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Includes supplementary material (8 pages) after the main paper. Code: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data
summary: In recent years, persistent homology has seen rapid adoption in deep learning, yet its computation remains a major bottleneck in network training. This paper introduces TopoGPU, a GPU streaming pipeline that computes persistence diagrams of cubical complexes induced by 2D and 3D images. TopoGPU streams the input image chunk by chunk, processing each chunk with massively parallel GPU kernels on a grid of GPU blocks; the resulting boundary relations are accumulated in host memory, where the CPU performs the boundary matrix reduction. TopoGPU introduces a stratification-aware discrete Morse matching that provably preserves persistent homology under streaming, together with a parallel topological sorting algorithm and a parallel V-path parity algorithm for deriving Morse boundaries on the GPU. TopoGPU outperforms Cubical Ripser, a state-of-the-art method for persistent homology computation, on every benchmark evaluated, achieving an average end-to-end speedup of 53.24x and a maximum of 198.01x. We further integrate TopoGPU into a topology-preserving deep network, demonstrating that it substantially reduces the cost of persistent homology computation during network training. TopoGPU is open source, with pre-built binaries, Google Colab notebooks, and Docker images available at the project's GitHub page: https://github.com/seravee08/GPU-Computation-of-Persistent-Homology-for-Image-Data.

AI.tldr: TopoGPU：一种针对2D/3D图像的GPU流式持续同调计算管线，通过分层感知离散Morse匹配与并行排序/奇偶性算法，在保持持续同调不变的前提下实现平均53.24倍、最高198.01倍的端到端加速，并可用于拓扑保持深度网络训练。
AI.motivation: 持续同调在深度学习中的应用日益广泛，但其计算开销已成为网络训练的主要瓶颈，亟需高效的计算方案。
AI.method: 提出TopoGPU：以分块流式方式处理图像，GPU内核在块网格上大规模并行处理各块，边界关系累积于主机内存，由CPU执行边界矩阵约简；同时引入分层感知的离散Morse匹配（可证明在流式下保持持续同调）、并行拓扑排序算法，以及用于在GPU上推导Morse边界的并行V-路径奇偶性算法。
AI.result: 在所有评测基准上均优于当前最先进方法Cubical Ripser，端到端平均加速53.24倍，最高达198.01倍；集成到拓扑保持深度网络后，显著降低了训练中持续同调的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: TopoGPU有效缓解了持续同调计算的瓶颈，具备开源实现（含预编译二进制、Colab笔记本与Docker镜像），可支撑拓扑感知深度学习的高效训练。

title: LVSPM: Long Sequence View Synthesis and Pose Estimation Model
summary: We present LVSPM, a generalizable model that jointly estimates camera poses and synthesizes novel views from uncalibrated image collections. Trained with only RGB images and pose supervision, LVSPM avoids dense 3D ground truth and employs test-time training (TTT) layers to scale seamlessly to hundreds of input views. On RealEstate10k, Co3Dv2, and DL3DV, LVSPM surpasses VGGT in pose estimation across 16-256 views, with especially large margins at strict thresholds. For novel view synthesis under a practical protocol where more views cover larger scenes, LVSPM achieves state-of-the-art pose-free quality---surpassing even pose-dependent models in PSNR---and still maintains high quality as scene scale grows, while baselines collapse. The code is available at https://burningdust21.github.io/Projects/LVSPM .

AI.tldr: LVSPM是一个可泛化模型，能从未标定图像集合中联合估计相机位姿并合成新视角；仅用RGB图像与位姿监督训练，借助test-time training层扩展至数百输入视角，在多个数据集上超越VGGT并实现无位姿SOTA新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在相机位姿估计与新视角合成中多依赖稠密3D真值或标定输入，难以扩展到大量视角和大规模场景；本文希望构建一个无需稠密3D监督、可泛化且能随输入视角数量与场景规模增长的统一模型。
AI.method: 提出LVSPM模型，联合估计相机位姿并合成新视角；仅使用RGB图像与位姿监督训练，避免稠密3D真值；引入test-time training (TTT) 层，实现从16到256个输入视角乃至数百视角的无缝扩展。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10k、Co3Dv2和DL3DV上，LVSPM在16-256视角设置下的位姿估计超过VGGT，在严格阈值下优势尤为明显；在“更多视角覆盖更大场景”的实际协议下，无位姿新视角合成达到SOTA，PSNR甚至超过依赖位姿的模型，并在场景规模增大时保持高质量，而基线方法崩溃。
AI.conclusion: LVSPM验证了仅用RGB与位姿监督即可实现可泛化的联合位姿估计与新视角合成，并通过TTT层获得良好的视角与场景规模扩展性，为无位姿、大规模场景重建与渲染提供了有效方案。

title: Fluid-Gen-Zero: Grounding Pretrained Video Generators in Physics without Training
summary: We present Fluid-Gen-Zero, a training-free framework for physics-aware fluid-object interaction video generation that decouples physical reasoning from appearance synthesis. Our key insight is to delegate motion dynamics to a physics simulator while preserving the appearance modeling capacity of pretrained video generators. We bridge these two domains through a two-level agentic workflow: generation-time planning, where a vision-language model (VLM) agent interprets intent and the simulation rollout to organize generation clips, and latent-space guidance, which injects simulation signals into denoising through region-aware latent wrapping. This plug-and-play design is compatible with current video foundation models. We further introduce a benchmark for fluid-object interaction video generation. Across Tora (CogVideoX-based), VACE and WanMove (Wan-based), Fluid-Gen-Zero consistently improves simulation alignment, reducing object trajectory error by 26.7%-81.5% and fluid fEPE (fluid flow endpoint error) by 67.9%-84.0%, while largely preserving perceptual quality. In a human preference study, raters favor Fluid-Gen-Zero in 55.1%-74.4% of same-backbone comparisons across three backbones, and in 90.4%-94.2% of comparisons against simulation-based methods. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Fluid-Gen-Zero 是一个免训练框架，通过将物理推理与外观合成解耦，实现物理感知的流体-物体交互视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型在物理感知（尤其是流体-物体交互的动力学建模）方面能力不足，难以在保持外观质量的同时准确模拟物理运动。
AI.method: 将运动动力学委派给物理模拟器，同时保留预训练视频生成器的外观建模能力；通过两级智能体工作流桥接两域——生成时规划（VLM 智能体解读意图与模拟推演以组织生成片段）与潜空间引导（通过区域感知潜空间包裹将模拟信号注入去噪过程）。该即插即用设计兼容现有视频基础模型。
AI.result: 在 Tora（基于 CogVideoX）、VACE 与 WanMove（基于 Wan）上，一致提升模拟对齐度：物体轨迹误差降低 26.7%-81.5%，流体 fEPE 降低 67.9%-84.0%，同时基本保持感知质量。人类偏好研究中，同骨干对比下 55.1%-74.4% 更偏好本方法，对比基于模拟的方法时为 90.4%-94.2%。
AI.conclusion: Fluid-Gen-Zero 通过解耦物理推理与外观合成，在多种视频基础模型上显著提升流体-物体交互视频的物理对齐度，具有即插即用特性；同时提出了该任务的基准，代码与数据将在接收后发布。

title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出 Omni-Diffusion-Distill 两阶段蒸馏框架，将统一多模态扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的图像生成与多模态理解同时压缩为少步学生模型，实现 18.2x/21.2x 推理加速并保持甚至提升性能。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态 dLLM 用单一架构同时支持图像生成与多模态理解，但其迭代解码需要数十到数百次前向传播，推理成本高。现有少步蒸馏方法多只针对图像生成或文本生成中的单一任务，无法说明如何在保留生成与理解双重能力的前提下，将完全离散的多模态 dLLM 压缩为单一高效学生模型。
AI.method: 提出两阶段统一蒸馏框架 Omni-Diffusion-Distill，在离散 token 空间中对图像与文本的生成和理解进行对齐蒸馏。第一阶段：学生通过重放缓存的教师轨迹学习跳过解码步；第二阶段：学生在自身 rollout 的中间状态上精炼。并加入两项补救机制：成对碰撞惩罚（pairwise collision penalty）减少并行文本解码中的重复；熵匹配引导（entropy-matched guidance）防止图像生成中因拟合尖锐化教师分布导致的熵崩溃。
AI.result: 在解码效率与生成/理解性能的权衡上达到 SOTA：图像生成从 128 步降至 8 步，多模态理解从 512 步降至 64 步，分别获得 18.2x 与 21.2x 的 wall-clock 加速。该预算下，文生图任务在 GenEval 得 0.828、DPG-Bench 得 83.0；多模态理解在 MM-Vet 上 GPT 评分 20.0，在 COCO captioning 得 57.2（同步骤下为教师 28.4 的两倍）。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Diffusion-Distill 首次实现统一多模态 dLLM 在离散 token 空间中的生成与理解联合少步蒸馏，在显著降低推理成本的同时维持强劲性能，为高效统一多模态模型提供了可行方案。

title: Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
summary: Image retrieval methods often rely on a single global semantic descriptor extracted from an image, e.g., the [CLS] token in vision transformers. However, trying to squeeze all the semantic information of an image into a single descriptor can hurt downstream retrieval performance, especially for fine-grained retrieval tasks. In this work, we augment the semantic tokens in the newer visual transformers, the global [CLS] token and the four register tokens, with a carefully selected collection of spatial tokens, aiming to capture the spatial region representation that characterizes the contents captured in each of the semantic tokens. We leverage the DINOv2-reg model, which includes register tokens that emergently learn object and part-based representations. For each "cue" token ([CLS] and each register token), we find a "buddy" image patch token and extract an N x N patch region to produce a set of localized ROI tokens. Our approach automatically captures important regions of interest without any external bounding boxes or saliency modules, purely by matching semantic tokens with their spatial representation regions. Furthermore, we incorporate these tokens into a multi-vector retrieval framework inspired by ColBERT, enabling fine-grained matching via a per-token alignment mechanism while avoiding the large storage cost of keeping all patch embeddings. Through extensive experiments, we find that (1) register tokens encode useful fine-grained details that can complement the [CLS] token; (2) automatically pooled ROI tokens further improve fine-grained discrimination; and (3) multi-vector retrieval with a small set of tokens improves over a DINOv2-reg single-vector baseline while remaining tractable for large-scale search. The code is available at https://github.com/IdhcbIan/Augmenting_CLS_with_ROI_tokens.

AI.tldr: 该工作将DINOv2-reg中的语义token（[CLS]与四个register token）与自动匹配的空间patch区域（ROI token）结合，并借助ColBERT式多向量检索框架实现细粒度图像检索。
AI.motivation: 传统图像检索依赖单一全局语义描述子（如ViT的[CLS] token），将图像全部语义压缩进单一向量会损害下游检索性能，尤其在细粒度检索任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 基于含register token的DINOv2-reg模型，对每个"cue"token（[CLS]及每个register token）寻找一个"buddy"图像patch token，并提取N×N的patch区域，生成一组局部化ROI token；无需外部bounding box或显著性模块即可自动捕获兴趣区域。随后将语义token与ROI token纳入受ColBERT启发的多向量检索框架，通过逐token对齐机制实现细粒度匹配，同时避免保留全部patch embedding带来的巨大存储开销。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) register token编码了可补充[CLS] token的有用细粒度细节；(2) 自动池化的ROI token进一步提升细粒度判别力；(3) 使用少量token的多向量检索在优于DINOv2-reg单向量基线的同时，仍可支持大规模搜索。
AI.conclusion: 通过将语义token与自动选择的ROI空间区域token结合，并采用多向量检索框架，可在不依赖外部标注区域的情况下显著提升细粒度图像检索性能，且存储与检索成本可控。

title: PCAsplat: Gaussian Splatting with Local PCA Regularization
summary: Gaussian splatting has emerged as a flexible representation for 3D reconstruction from posed images. However, existing methods are optimized primarily using rasterization-based losses, which supervise a splat only when it contributes to sampled camera rays. Gaussians that are occluded or contribute little to the sampled view therefore receive weak or no geometric gradients and may drift away from the underlying surface, producing undesired floaters. We introduce PCAsplat, a geometry-aware regularization framework for Gaussian splatting based on differentiable local principal component analysis (PCA). Our PCA regularizer acts directly on neighborhoods of Gaussian centers and can therefore update Gaussians that do not contribute to the current training view. We regularize the PCA eigenvalues to encourage Gaussians to move to the underlying surface with isotropic tangent-plane coverage. We also align each Gaussian normal with the PCA-estimated neighborhood normal to enforce consistent orientation. Experiments on DTU, Tanks and Temples, and NeRF Synthetic show that the splats produced by PCAsplat better approximate samples of the reference surface while substantially reducing undesired floaters. These surface-aligned splats enable downstream geometry-processing tasks, including point cloud segmentation, and direct Poisson reconstruction. Additionally, PCAsplat remains competitive under conventional novel view synthesis and mesh extraction tasks. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: PCAsplat 提出基于可微局部主成分分析（PCA）的几何感知正则化框架，直接作用于高斯中心邻域，使未参与当前视角监督的高斯也能获得几何梯度，从而抑制漂浮物并提升表面对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅（Gaussian splatting）方法主要依赖光栅化损失进行优化，仅在泼溅对采样相机光线有贡献时才被监督。因此，被遮挡或对采样视角贡献很小的高斯获得很弱甚至没有几何梯度，容易偏离真实表面，产生漂浮物（floaters）。
AI.method: 1) 提出 PCAsplat，一种基于可微局部 PCA 的几何感知正则化框架；2) PCA 正则项直接作用于高斯中心邻域，可更新不参与当前训练视角的高斯；3) 正则化 PCA 特征值，促使高斯移动到真实表面并具有各向同性的切平面覆盖；4) 对齐每个高斯的法线与 PCA 估计的邻域法线，保证朝向一致。
AI.result: 在 DTU、Tanks and Tunnels 与 NeRF Synthetic 上，PCAsplat 生成的泼溅更接近参考表面采样，且显著减少漂浮物。表面贴合的泼溅支持下游几何处理任务，包括点云分割与直接泊松重建；同时在常规新视角合成与网格提取任务上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 利用可微局部 PCA 对高斯邻域施加几何正则化，可弥补光栅化监督的几何梯度缺失，改善表面对齐与漂浮物问题，并兼顾新视角合成与网格提取性能。代码将开源。

title: Mid-Training Language Models on Raw Video
summary: Multimodal large language models learn mostly from paired image-text data or annotated video, and raw web video is rarely used to further train an existing language model. We study whether raw video, with no captions and no text loss, can serve as mid-training data for a pretrained language model. Frames are encoded into continuous visual tokens, and the language model learns to predict the next visual token. We mid-train Qwen3-1.7B on raw clips from YT-Temporal-1B and then apply the same image-text instruction tuning to it and to the model without mid-training, so that the two differ only in mid-training. The mid-trained model scores 2.9 points higher on average across four video benchmarks and 5.1 points higher across ten image benchmarks, spanning perception, document, and chart tasks. Text performance is preserved even though mid-training includes no text, with an average of 48.9 across 14 text benchmarks compared with 48.0 for the model without mid-training. Analyses across training show that the image and video gains emerge within 30% of training and plateau thereafter, varying by less than 0.5 points. Predicting captions fails to outperform next-visual-token prediction, demonstrating that video mid-training can remain purely self-supervised without the computational overhead or labeling noise of automated captioning.

title: Expression-Diverse References for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
summary: Identity-preserving video generation aims to maintain a subject's identity while synthesizing realistic videos. Yet a single reference portrait captures the subject's appearance under only one facial configuration. As expressions change, facial appearance can vary in highly identity-specific ways, leaving the subject's appearance under unseen expressions underdetermined by the reference alone. This expression-dependent variation also complicates evaluation: similarity to a neutral reference may decrease under strong expressions even for real images of the same person. We investigate this limitation from both generation and evaluation perspectives. First, we quantify how face-recognition similarity varies with expression intensity using controlled photographs and MEAD videos. We then construct a compact yet expressive reference gallery that captures diverse expression-dependent facial configurations. Matching against this gallery provides a more robust measure of identity similarity under expressive motion. To further expose performance degradation with expression intensity, we report identity similarity separately for mild, intense, and extreme expressions. For generation, we extend Stand-In to condition on our expression-diverse reference sets and develop a data-curation pipeline that extracts consistent yet diverse face crops from training videos. In practical settings where only a single portrait is available, we construct the reference set by synthesizing additional expressions with a pretrained facial reenactment model. On our controlled benchmark, both real and synthesized reference sets outperform the evaluated baselines in identity similarity across all three expression-intensity regimes, with the largest improvements for extreme expressions.

AI.tldr: 该论文从生成与评估两个角度研究身份保持视频生成中单张参考人像的局限：表情变化导致面部外观按身份特异方式改变，单参考图无法确定未见表征下的外观，也使相似度评估失真。作者构建表情多样化的参考图库作为更稳健的身份相似度度量，并报告轻、强、极强三档表情下的性能；生成端扩展 Stand-In 以表情多样参考集为条件，并提出从训练视频提取一致且多样人脸裁剪的数据策展流程，单张人像场景下用预训练表情重演模型合成额外表情。受控基准上，真实与合成参考集在三档表情强度下均优于基线，极强表情提升最大。
AI.motivation: 单张参考人像仅捕获一种面部构型下的外观，表情变化会以高度身份特异的方式改变面部外观，使未见表情下的外观欠定；同时这种表情依赖的变化也使评估复杂化——即使对同一人的真实图像，强烈表情下与中性参考的相似度也可能下降。
AI.method: 1) 用受控照片与 MEAD 视频量化人脸识别相似度随表情强度的变化；2) 构建紧凑且具表现力的参考图库，捕获多样的表情依赖面部构型，以匹配该图库获得更稳健的身份相似度度量；3) 按轻、强、极强三档分别报告身份相似度；4) 生成端扩展 Stand-In 以表情多样参考集为条件，并设计从训练视频提取一致且多样人脸裁剪的数据策展流程；5) 仅有单张人像时，用预训练面部重演模型合成额外表情构建参考集。
AI.result: 在受控基准上，真实与合成参考集在三档表情强度下（轻、强、极强）的身份相似度均优于所评估的基线，且在极强表情下提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 身份保持视频生成应超越单参考图范式，采用表情多样化的参考集来更稳健地度量与保持身份；该思路在生成与评估两方面均有效，尤其显著改善极强表情场景下的身份相似度。

title: Transforming Image Editors into Video Editors
summary: Recent image editing systems have achieved impressive semantic understanding, visual fidelity, and instruction-following ability, while video editing remains substantially more difficult and costly. In this paper, we present a simple alternative to end-to-end video editing: instead of training a monolithic video editor, we transform a strong image editor into a video editor through anchor-based generation. Our key insight is that video editing can be decomposed into two subproblems: editing a sparse set of keyframes and propagating those edits across time. Based on this observation, we propose Anchor-based Video Editing (AVE), a two-stage framework in which a powerful image editor first performs composed editing on selected keyframes, and a motion-guided image-to-video diffusion model then generates the final video by treating the edited keyframes as fixed anchors. This design directly inherits the strengths of modern image editors while avoiding expensive end-to-end video editing training. Experiments on IVEBench and VIE-Bench show that AVE achieves strong performance in instruction following, temporal consistency, and content fidelity. Further ablations reveal that final video editing quality is strongly correlated with the quality of the image editor, suggesting that future progress in video editing may come from stronger image editing foundations and lightweight transfer to video. Code is available at https://github.com/wangf3014/AVE.

AI.tldr: 提出Anchor-based Video Editing (AVE)，用强图像编辑器编辑关键帧，再由运动引导的图像到视频扩散模型以编辑帧为锚点生成视频，避免昂贵的端到端视频编辑训练。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑在语义理解、视觉保真和指令遵循方面远比图像编辑困难且成本高昂，端到端训练单体视频编辑器代价过大。作者希望寻找一种简单替代方案，充分利用现有强图像编辑器的能力。
AI.method: 核心洞见是把视频编辑分解为两个子问题：编辑稀疏关键帧、将编辑沿时间传播。基于此提出两阶段框架AVE：第一阶段由强图像编辑器在选定关键帧上执行组合编辑；第二阶段由运动引导的图像到视频扩散模型将已编辑关键帧视为固定锚点，生成最终视频。
AI.result: 在IVEBench和VIE-Bench上，AVE在指令遵循、时序一致性和内容保真度方面均取得强劲表现。消融实验显示，最终视频编辑质量与图像编辑器质量高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 视频编辑的进展可能来自更强的图像编辑基础以及向视频的轻量迁移，而非依赖端到端的视频编辑训练。

title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
summary: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views.
