Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it. We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.

AI.tldr: Slot3R 提出免训练的集合关联式改造，将 3D 空间的"地址"与"是否融合"解耦，允许同一位置共存多个状态，在 Point3R 主干冻结下显著提升流式 3D 重建精度并大幅降低显存占用。
AI.motivation: 流式 3D 重建需在在线处理不断扩张的场景时保留每帧证据。空间记忆按重建位置组织历史，天然适配该需求。但现有方法 Point3R 用空间邻近性既做新观测与记忆条目的关联、又决定是否融合，把"共址"与"状态同一性"混为一谈。由于指针是图像块的摘要，邻近指针可能编码不同表面、视角或可见性状态，直接平均会在后续帧澄清歧义之前破坏互补证据。
AI.method: 提出 Slot3R：一种免训练（training-free）的集合关联式（set-associative）改造，保持 Point3R 预训练主干冻结。核心是让同一地址可共存多个状态（位置只决定寻址，不强制合并）。此外引入有界稀疏读出（bounded sparse readout），将持久化存储与逐帧解码器访问解耦。
AI.result: 在 300–500 采样帧下，Slot3R 将 Point3R 的点云精度误差（Acc）在 7Scenes 上降低 57.1%–63.1%，在 NeuralRGBD 上降低 64.0%–72.0%；在全部三个位姿基准上降低 Sim(3) 对齐的绝对轨迹误差（ATE）；在视频深度估计上保持竞争力。在相同协议下，600–1000 采样帧的全部评测设置均以约 19 FPS 完成，而 Point3R 与 InfiniteVGGT 在 800 帧及以上出现显存耗尽（OOM）。
AI.conclusion: 位置应决定寻址而非决定观测必须合并；通过集合关联式多状态共存与有界稀疏读出，Slot3R 在不重训主干的前提下同时提升流式 3D 重建精度、位姿与深度表现，并显著改善长序列下的显存可扩展性。

title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
summary: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出ME-World，将多智能体第一视角世界建模定义为多智能体同步自视角流生成，实现跨视角动作一致、共享环境一致与交互状态更新一致。
AI.motivation: 现有第一视角世界模型多聚焦单智能体；多智能体场景常依赖粗粒度动作（移动、相机控制、离散指令），细粒度具身交互建模不足，且缺乏共享世界中多流同步一致性。
AI.method: 将多智能体第一视角世界建模形式化为多智能体同步自视角流生成；ME-World在共享token序列中联合去噪多条自视角流，以所有智能体的目标视角位姿为条件，并借助共享环境记忆约束生成。
AI.result: 在真实与合成多智能体数据上训练评估，并引入共享世界一致性指标（环境一致性、更新一致性、身份一致性）；相比现有方法，在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持与视频质量上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: ME-World为细粒度多智能体交互的第一视角世界建模提供了统一框架与一致性评测指标，验证了联合去噪、跨视角位姿条件与共享环境记忆的有效性。

title: From What to Which: Decoding Modifier Grounding in Frozen MLLMs
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can describe increasingly complex visual scenes, token-level grounding becomes crucial. Yet, when an MLLM generates "the yellow banana on the left", established grounding approaches focus on what is in the image ("banana"), overlooking tokens that help describe which instance is meant ("yellow", "left"). In this work, we ask whether frozen MLLM representations contain decodable grounding information about the referred instance across generated tokens, extending to modifiers such as attributes, spatial expressions, and relational/action terms. To address this question, we introduce OTTER, a lightweight supervised probe over frozen MLLM representations that uses Optimal Transport (OT) to align generated tokens with visual regions and produce compact grounding maps. Our results show that (i) instance-discriminative visual information can be decoded from modifier tokens, with the clearest evidence for spatial terms, but (ii) is not confined to them, as contextualized object nouns also carry referential information; (iii) the recovered grounding remains informative under context perturbations, while selected regions remain relevant to generation; and (iv) the learned OT-based grounding extends beyond the controlled setting to free generation and cross-dataset transfer.

AI.tldr: 研究冻结MLLM表示中逐token的指代性grounding信息，提出OTTER探针，用最优传输对齐生成token与视觉区域，发现修饰词（尤其空间词）也携带可解码的实例判别信息。
AI.motivation: MLLM能描述日益复杂的视觉场景，逐token grounding变得关键；但现有grounding方法只关注"什么在图中"（如banana），忽略了帮助区分"哪个实例"的token（如yellow、left）。作者因此探究冻结MLLM表示中是否含有关于被指代实例的可解码grounding信息，并扩展到属性、空间、关系/动作等修饰词。
AI.method: 提出OTTER：一个轻量级监督探针，作用于冻结的MLLM表示之上，利用最优传输（OT）将生成token与视觉区域对齐，产生紧凑的grounding图。
AI.result: (i) 可从修饰词token解码出具有实例判别力的视觉信息，空间词证据最清晰；(ii) 该信息不局限于修饰词，语境化的名词也携带指代信息；(iii) 在上下文扰动下恢复的grounding仍具信息量，所选区域与生成保持相关；(iv) 学到的OT grounding可推广到自由生成与跨数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: 冻结MLLM表示中蕴含跨生成token的实例级grounding信息，且可通过OT对齐被有效解码，突破传统"what"式grounding，为参考实例级grounding提供新视角。

title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
comment: More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix
summary: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at $512^2$ and PixelDiT at $1024^2$ using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional generation using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix

AI.tldr: 提出的BudgetPix是一种自适应tokenization框架，根据视觉复杂度和空间布局动态分配计算量，实现推理时的灵活计算预算。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型普遍采用均匀tokenization，对同等大小的图像patch分配相同计算预算。该静态范式无法适应推理时不同的资源约束，且对简单背景与复杂细节投入相同精力，导致质量-成本权衡次优。
AI.method: BudgetPix包含三个关键组件：（1）自适应编码器，结合熵引导的四叉树与多尺度patch嵌入器，将固定尺寸图像映射为可变长token序列；（2）尺度感知解码器，从多尺度token集合重建固定分辨率图像；（3）灵活的训练与采样调度，使像素空间去噪器能在可变token数量下运行。该方法可无缝集成现有像素空间扩散架构，单checkpoint支持多种计算预算。
AI.result: 在文生图任务上，BudgetPix在512²下以25%原始计算预算匹配MiniT2I-L，在1024²下匹配PixelDiT；在MeanFlow骨干的类别条件生成中，仅需60%计算预算即可实现近乎零质量损失，FID仅增加0.8点。人类与VLM评估确认其在质量-效率权衡上显著优于先前预算自适应基线。
AI.conclusion: BudgetPix通过自适应tokenization实现推理时灵活计算预算，在保持生成保真度的同时大幅降低计算成本，建立了显著改进的质量-效率权衡。

title: Is In-Domain Training Enough for Fine-Grained Industrial Anomaly Understanding?
summary: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出SiGMA空间接地多智能体框架，通过异构MLLM智能体与专用视觉缺陷专家分工，在MMAD基准上达85.2%平均准确率，超过最强训练专家4.0%，接近人类专家1.5%以内。
AI.motivation: 单一多模态大模型难以同时胜任多模态工业异常理解中的检测、定位、描述与推理。研究显示域内训练无法弥合该差距：在MMAD基准上，训练专家最高仅75.5%的缺陷定位准确率（人类为92.3%），甚至检测异常不如未训练基座模型。不同MLLM虽互补，却在细粒度感知上共有短板，简单组合无法弥补。
AI.method: SiGMA框架将任务分工给异构MLLM智能体与专用视觉缺陷专家：多模态搜索器提供工业知识与正常参考；缺陷专家将查询-参考对比转化为校准的异常证据；无标签可靠性控制器依据任务级能力与查询级证据质量对各来源加权。
AI.result: 在MMAD上达85.2%平均准确率，比最强训练专家和Gemini-2.5-Pro高4.0%，与人类专家差距在1.5%以内；仅用三个≤9B参数智能体即达84.4%；新MLLM可免重训接入。
AI.conclusion: 将细粒度感知交给专用视觉缺陷专家、以无标签可靠性控制器整合异构MLLM的分工式多智能体框架，可有效提升MM-IAU性能并具备模型可扩展性。

title: Controllable Exaggeration for Generative Motion Models via Training-Time Adaptation and Inference-Time Guidance
summary: Recent motion generative models have demonstrated strong capabilities in synthesizing physically plausible character motion, but often overlook established animation principles used by professional animators to ground and design their animation work. Understanding and incorporating these principles into motion generative pipelines is essential for producing motions that serve not only physically grounded applications but also the needs of the character animation community. This enables the creation of characters that not only move in physically plausible ways but also feel alive, expressive, and engaging. To close this gap, we focus on the Exaggeration principle of animation and investigate how it can be incorporated into modern motion generative pipelines to produce more expressive character motions. To this end, we introduce a framework that operates at two stages of existing motion generative pipelines. The first stage introduces exaggeration during training, where we perform supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained text-to-motion models on our curated exaggeration dataset. The second stage operates at inference time, where we: (i) introduce a mathematical formulation of exaggeration based on dynamic movement primitives (DMPs); and (ii) leverage this formulation as an exaggeration guidance signal to guide existing diffusion and flow-matching text-to-motion generation models toward exaggerated motion without additional training. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations against three strong motion generation models, we show that our methods generate more exaggerated and expressive motions while preserving neutral reference motion intent and physical plausibility.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有动作生成模型忽视动画夸张原则的问题，提出一个两阶段框架：训练阶段在自建夸张数据集上微调预训练文本到动作模型，推理阶段基于动态运动基元（DMP）建立夸张的数学表达并作为引导信号，无需额外训练即可引导扩散与流匹配模型生成更夸张、更富表现力且保持物理合理性的动作。
AI.motivation: 近期动作生成模型虽能合成物理合理的角色动作，但普遍忽视专业动画师所依赖的动画原则，导致生成动作难以满足角色动画社区对"生动、有表现力、有感染力"的需求。
AI.method: 提出作用于现有动作生成流程两个阶段的框架。第一阶段在训练时引入夸张：在自建的夸张数据集上对预训练文本到动作模型进行有监督微调。第二阶段在推理时操作：(i) 基于动态运动基元（DMP）提出夸张的数学形式化；(ii) 将该形式化作为夸张引导信号，在不额外训练的情况下，引导已有的扩散和流匹配文本到动作生成模型趋向夸张动作。
AI.result: 通过与三个强动作生成模型的定性和定量对比评估，所提方法能生成更夸张、更具表现力的动作，同时保持中性参考动作的意图与物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 将动画原则中的夸张原则引入现代动作生成流程是可行且有效的，训练期微调与推理期引导相结合的两阶段方案在提升表现力的同时不牺牲动作意图与物理真实性。

title: RiCo: Neural Simulation of Rigid-Body Interactions via Local Contact Reasoning
summary: Accurate simulation of rigid-body interactions is essential for predictive physical world models. Despite recent progress in modeling object dynamics, capturing how local contacts between surfaces shape object motion remains challenging. While end-to-end world models predict interactions across entire scenes or objects, in practice, rigid-body contact is inherently local, and only nearby surfaces can directly exchange contact forces. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo), which represents interactions between objects through sparse neighborhoods of contact surface points. RiCo combines each point's state with the relative geometry, motion, and physical properties of nearby surfaces, then reasons across the object's points to determine how these local contacts jointly affect its motion. By confining cross-object reasoning to nearby surfaces while propagating contact information within each rigid body, RiCo retains fine-grained interaction details without the cost of modeling every pair of scene points. Such properties enable RiCo a higher accuracy and contact fidelity. Experiments on MOVi-benchmark demonstrate that RiCo reduces 100-frame position and orientation errors by 31-35% and approximately 38%, respectively, compared with baselines. Moreover, RiCo achieves high contact fidelity, with ground-truth-relative penetration-time and mean-depth differences of 11.0% and 2.22 mm, respectively. RiCo further generalizes zero-shot from small-scale training scenarios to scenes containing 270 objects. Our real-world multi-ball collision experiments further provide preliminary evidence of sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: RiCo通过稀疏接触表面点邻域表示物体交互，将跨物体推理限制在近邻表面、在刚体内部传播接触信息，从而在MOVi基准上显著降低100帧位置/朝向误差并提升接触保真度，且可零样本泛化至270个物体的场景并初步实现sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 刚体交互的精确模拟对预测性物理世界模型至关重要。现有端到端世界模型在整个场景或物体层面预测交互，但刚体接触本质上是局部的，只有邻近表面能直接交换接触力，因此全局建模方式既低效又难以捕捉局部接触如何塑造物体运动，细粒度交互细节丢失。
AI.method: 提出Rigid-body Contact Reasoning (RiCo)，用接触表面点的稀疏邻域表示物体间交互：将每个点的状态与附近表面的相对几何、运动及物理属性结合，再在物体各点之间进行推理，以判定这些局部接触如何共同影响其运动。通过把跨物体推理约束在邻近表面、同时在每个刚体内部传播接触信息，保留细粒度交互细节而无需建模场景中所有点对。
AI.result: 在MOVi基准上，相比基线将100帧位置误差降低31–35%、朝向误差降低约38%；接触保真度高，相对真值的穿透时间差为11.0%、平均深度差为2.22 mm。可从小规模训练场景零样本泛化到含270个物体的场景；真实世界多球碰撞实验初步证明sim-to-real迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 局部接触邻域建模是刚体交互预测的有效归纳偏置：RiCo以稀疏接触点推理兼顾精度与效率，在精度、接触保真度、规模化泛化及sim-to-real方面均表现优异，为预测性物理世界模型中的刚体交互模拟提供了可行方向。

title: ContiLNN: Mitigating Slice Sampling Discontinuity with Liquid Neural Networks for Medical Image Restoration
summary: Anatomical continuity provides complementary information for medical image restoration, but its use requires accounting for local anatomy and variations in slice sampling. We introduce ContiLNN, which augments two-dimensional restoration backbones with bidirectional closed-form continuous-time (Bi-CfC) modules for cross-slice modeling while retaining in-plane feature extraction. Slice-index intervals modulate gates determined by local features and hidden states, enabling propagation to respond to sampling variations without numerical ODE integration. Reference-guided consistency aligns first- and second-order cross-slice intensity differences to preserve anatomical variation, while distillation from a frozen backbone helps retain in-plane fidelity. Across five training seeds, ContiLNN improves mean PSNR over Restore-RWKV by 0.1907, 1.0176, and 1.2482 dB for CT denoising, MRI super-resolution, and reduced-count PET restoration, respectively, with lower RMSE in all three tasks. CT results are descriptive for one held-out patient. PET ablations support ordered propagation beyond additional pointwise capacity. Under contiguous training, Bi-CfC achieves higher fidelity than a Bi-GRU with similar parameter counts and arithmetic costs across all tested sampling conditions. Matched seven-slice profiling shows 52.8% lower latency and 57.0% lower peak GPU memory use than Bi-GRU. Mixed-gap training improves sparse and irregular-context performance for both operators, without a uniform ranking across metrics and contexts. Experiments with fewer training patients and a second backbone further support data efficiency and backbone compatibility.

AI.tldr: ContiLNN通过在二维复原骨干网络上增加双向闭式连续时间(Bi-CfC)模块进行跨切片建模，利用切片索引间隔调节门控，并结合参考引导一致性与蒸馏，在CT去噪、MRI超分辨及低计数PET复原任务上提升了PSNR并降低RMSE。
AI.motivation: 医学图像复原中，解剖连续性可提供互补信息，但其利用需考虑局部解剖结构与切片采样变化，现有二维骨干网络难以有效建模跨切片信息。
AI.method: 提出ContiLNN，在二维复原骨干上加入双向闭式连续时间(Bi-CfC)模块实现跨切片建模，同时保留面内特征提取；由局部特征与隐状态决定的门控受切片索引间隔调节，无需数值ODE积分即可对采样变化做出响应；采用参考引导一致性对齐一阶与二阶跨切片强度差异以保留解剖变化；并通过冻结骨干蒸馏保持面内保真度。
AI.result: 在五个训练种子下，相较Restore-RWKV，CT去噪、MRI超分辨与低计数PET复原的平均PSNR分别提升0.1907、1.0176、1.2482 dB，三项任务RMSE均更低。CT结果为单例留出患者的描述性结果；PET消融支持有序传播优于单纯增加逐点容量；连续训练下Bi-CfC在相似参数量与计算量下各采样条件均优于Bi-GRU；七切片匹配分析显示延迟降低52.8%、峰值GPU显存降低57.0%；混合间隔训练改进了稀疏与不规则上下文的性能，但指标与情境间无统一排序；更少训练患者与第二骨干的实验支持数据效率与骨干兼容性。
AI.conclusion: ContiLNN通过跨切片连续时间建模与一致性约束，在多种医学图像复原任务中提升精度与效率，并展现出数据效率与骨干兼容性。

title: Reasoning-Informed Visual Editing
summary: Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation, but still face challenges in visual editing, particularly in following complex instructions, preserving appearance consistency, and supporting flexible input formats. To study this gap, we introduce RISEBench, the first benchmark for evaluating Reasoning-Informed viSual Editing (RISE), and extend it to RISEBench++, a more comprehensive and fine-grained benchmark for this emerging task. RISEBench++ extends the taxonomy into a hierarchical scheme spanning six reasoning dimensions: Temporal, Causal, Spatial, Logical, and Counterfactual Reasoning, together with Hybrid Reasoning integrating multiple reasoning types across multi-turn edits. These dimensions are further decomposed into 12 subcategories and 65 fine-grained task types. We expand input formats to include multi-image conditioning and scale the benchmark to 1000 human-annotated test cases, released in English and Chinese. We also improve our evaluation framework, assessing Instruction Reasoning, Appearance Consistency, and Visual Plausibility with human judges and an LMM-as-a-judge approach for more reliable and calibrated judgements. Beyond benchmarking, we introduce RISE-Agent, a training-free agentic framework integrating reasoning-driven planning, tool-augmented execution, and verifier-guided refinement, outperforming most strong existing approaches across diverse RISE tasks. We evaluate 58 visual editing approaches, including 34 open-source models, 19 closed-source models, and 5 agentic methods. The results reveal substantial challenges in reasoning-based visual editing, with even the strongest evaluated approach, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, achieving only 56.6% accuracy. RISEBench++ highlights the limitations of contemporary editing models, provides insights, and indicates future directions for reasoning-aware visual editing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RISEBench++，一个面向推理驱动视觉编辑（RISE）的分层细粒度基准，并配套提出免训练智能体框架RISE-Agent，系统评测了58种视觉编辑方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在视觉编辑上仍面临三大挑战：难以遵循复杂指令、难以保持外观一致性、难以支持灵活输入格式。而此前缺乏专门针对"推理驱动视觉编辑"的系统性评测基准。
AI.method: 构建RISEBench++：将任务分类扩展为六维分层体系（时序、因果、空间、逻辑、反事实、混合推理），细分为12个子类与65种任务类型；扩充多图条件输入，规模达1000个人工标注中英双语测试样例。评测框架从指令推理、外观一致性、视觉合理性三方面，采用人工评审与LMM-as-a-judge。此外提出免训练RISE-Agent，融合推理驱动规划、工具增强执行与验证器引导的迭代优化。
AI.result: 评测58种方法（34个开源、19个闭源、5个智能体）。即便最强的GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst也仅达56.6%准确率，表明推理型视觉编辑仍是重大挑战。
AI.conclusion: RISEBench++揭示了当代编辑模型在推理感知视觉编辑上的局限，提供了洞察与评测工具，并指明未来研究方向。

title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GPD（Geometry-Privileged Distillation），将深度、语义与鸟瞰图（BEV）几何线索渲染为紧凑文本作为特权信息，在在线自蒸馏（OPSD）中仅对错误轨迹施加特权 KL 约束，并以 GRPO 为基础训练，使部署模型保持纯 RGB 输入。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在空间推理上持续存在短板，根源在于 RGB 输入无法直接提供几何证据。现有方案要么在推理阶段注入 3D 信息（增加架构与延迟成本），要么仅用结果奖励监督最终答案，无法纠正源自感知层面的深度或方向误判。而空间训练语料的 3D 扫描来源本身已包含场景真实几何。
AI.method: GPD 将几何证据作为在线自蒸馏中的特权信息。对每个问题，将深度、语义和鸟瞰图（BEV）线索渲染为紧凑文本，与参考答案一并路由给教师模型；仅对错误的轨迹施加特权 KL 散度，作为 GRPO 的增强项；部署模型仅使用 RGB 输入。方法包含问题条件化路由与错误轨迹限定两项关键设计。
AI.result: 在 4B 骨干模型上，GPD 在 VSI-Bench 上达到 57.1，在 MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench 和 ViewSpatial 上平均 37.6，在多个空间推理基准上优于 GRPO 与答案特权 OPSD。消融实验证实：3D 特权与答案特权具有互补性；问题条件化路由优于全上下文注入；将蒸馏限制在错误轨迹上具有增益。
AI.conclusion: 以几何证据作为特权信息的蒸馏策略能在不增加推理成本的前提下有效提升 VLM 空间推理能力，且 3D 特权、答案特权、问题条件化路由与错误轨迹限定共同构成有效组合。

title: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
summary: Interactive virtual worlds allow agents to learn through exploration and interaction. What agents can learn is bounded by the environments they practice in, which must be faithful, with consistent state, rules, and dynamics, and realistic, with observations that follow the real-world visual distributions. Achieving both across diverse worlds remains a bottleneck. We introduce AgentGarten, a framework that couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer to build real-time interactive environments. Its simulation backends maintain persistent world state and execute program-defined interaction rules, while the renderer generates visual observations from structured conditions exported through a common interface. To build the neural renderer, we adapt a pretrained video model to geometry conditions, distill it with our proposed Adversarial Forcing, and optimize inference for real-time interaction. Adversarial Forcing makes history prefilling differentiable through exact replay, so that losses on later predictions update how the renderer encodes prior observations, and adds real-data adversarial supervision to improve its visual quality. In AgentGarten, agents perceive the world through visual observations, interact with it in real time, and improve by distilling each round of experience into playbooks that subsequent agents inherit and refine. Our empirical study demonstrates a substantial gain in learning efficiency, with agents learning from just 4 rounds compared with millions for a conventional reinforcement learning counterpart. As new worlds can be written as code and rendered through the same interface, environments can scale in both number and difficulty alongside their agents, a step toward agents that keep evolving through interactive experience.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentGarten 框架，将模拟器/游戏引擎与共享神经渲染器耦合，以构建兼具状态一致性与视觉真实感的实时交互环境，使智能体仅需 4 轮经验即可高效学习，并支持环境随智能体共同扩展。
AI.motivation: 智能体通过交互与探索学习，其能力上限受训练环境约束：环境需既"忠实"（状态、规则与动力学一致）又"真实"（观测符合真实世界视觉分布）。然而在多样化世界中同时满足这两点仍是瓶颈，现有环境难以兼顾可交互性与视觉保真度。
AI.method: 1) 框架设计：AgentGarten 把模拟器与游戏引擎作为仿真后端，维持持久化世界状态并执行程序定义的交互规则；共享神经渲染器通过统一接口读取结构化条件，生成视觉观测。2) 渲染器构建：将预训练视频模型适配到几何条件，采用提出的 Adversarial Forcing 进行蒸馏，并针对实时交互优化推理。3) Adversarial Forcing：通过精确回放使历史预填充（history prefilling）可微，让后续预测的损失能反向更新渲染器对历史观测的编码方式，并引入真实数据对抗监督以提升视觉质量。4) 智能体学习：智能体以视觉观测感知世界、实时交互，并将每轮经验蒸馏为 playbook 供后续智能体继承与改进。
AI.result: 学习效率显著提升：智能体仅需 4 轮经验即可学习，而传统强化学习对照方法需数百万轮。同时，新世界可写成代码并通过同一接口渲染，使环境在数量与难度上可与智能体同步扩展。
AI.conclusion: AgentGarten 通过仿真后端与神经渲染器的解耦耦合，同时实现环境的忠实性与视觉真实感，并借助可扩展的代码化世界构建与 playbook 传承机制，为智能体在交互经验中持续演化提供了可行路径。

title: WorldAlign: Decoupled 4D Reward for World-Consistent Video Generation
comment: Includes an appendix with implementation details, human evaluation, and additional ablation analysis. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/
summary: Faithful visual world simulation requires generated videos to maintain 4D world consistency, encompassing both static and dynamic consistency. Static consistency requires coherent 3D structure in static environments across viewpoints, while dynamic consistency requires plausible subject motion and consistent appearance over time. Geometry-aware post-training offers a promising way to improve world consistency. However, existing methods often rely on a static-scene assumption. Even those that accommodate dynamic scenes struggle to provide reliable static-consistency feedback, while dynamic consistency is often overlooked or inadequately assessed. To address these limitations, we introduce WorldAlign, a decoupled 4D reward framework that semantically separates static regions and dynamic subjects and provides feedback by aligning each with a world prior suited to its assumptions. For static regions, WorldAlign aligns static geometry with a geometric world prior through semantically guided masked reprojection, enabling more reliable static-consistency evaluation; an auxiliary camera-motion reward discourages nearly static solutions. For dynamic subjects, WorldAlign uses a strong vision-language model (VLM) as a dynamic world prior and constructs a VLM-as-a-judge reward based on sample-specific checklists that assess dynamicity, physical plausibility, shape, and texture consistency. This decoupled design enables more effective online post-training without requiring human preference annotations. Across two pretrained image-to-video generators, Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, WorldAlign jointly improves static and dynamic consistency over existing methods without suppressing overall or subject motion. These results support decoupled world-prior alignment for more faithful visual world simulation. Project page: https://worldalign.github.io/.

AI.tldr: WorldAlign 提出解耦的 4D 奖励框架，将静态区域与动态主体分离并分别对齐适配的世界先验，从而在无需人类偏好标注的情况下提升图像到视频生成的静态与动态一致性。
AI.motivation: 忠实视觉世界模拟要求生成视频保持 4D 世界一致性，包括跨视角的静态 3D 结构一致性与随时间变化的动态运动及外观一致性。现有几何感知后训练方法多依赖静态场景假设，即便处理动态场景也难以提供可靠的静态一致性反馈，且动态一致性常被忽视或评估不足。
AI.method: WorldAlign 采用解耦的 4D 奖励框架：语义上分离静态区域与动态主体，并分别对齐各自假设下适配的世界先验。对静态区域，通过语义引导的掩码重投影将静态几何对齐到几何世界先验，提供更可靠的静态一致性评估，并辅以相机运动奖励抑制近乎静态的解；对动态主体，使用强视觉语言模型（VLM）作为动态世界先验，基于样本特定的检查清单构建 VLM-as-a-judge 奖励，评估动态性、物理合理性、形状与纹理一致性。
AI.result: 在两个预训练图像到视频生成器 Wan2.1 与 Wan2.2 上，WorldAlign 在未抑制整体运动或主体运动的前提下，相比现有方法同时提升了静态与动态一致性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，解耦的世界先验对齐能够支持更忠实的视觉世界模拟。

title: GenIA: Generative Reconstruction with Test-Time Input Alignment
summary: Reconstructing complete 3D object assets from monocular or sparse multi-view observations remains challenging. Generative 3D foundation models can complete object geometry beyond the observed views, but their predictions may not faithfully reproduce the observed geometry, appearance, or pose. We introduce GenIA, a framework for test-time input-aligned generation that grounds SAM3D's generative prior in geometric and photometric observations without retraining the foundation model. We improve object pose by deriving translation and scale from geometry while retaining the learned rotation prior, and align appearance through visibility-biased attention, cross-observation fusion, and differentiable rendering guidance during denoising. An optional post-denoising refinement further adapts the appearance latent, lightweight decoder adapters, and object placement to the observations. Our framework also supports externally supplied geometry; when given temporal shapes of dynamic objects, it recovers a shared, input-aligned canonical appearance and stable world-space placement. Across synthetic and real benchmarks, GenIA improves pose prediction and object reconstruction from monocular, multi-view, and dynamic inputs, outperforming recent optimization-based, per-frame image-to-3D, and video-to-4D methods. Our project page is available at https://facebookresearch.github.io/GenIA.

AI.tldr: GenIA：一种无需重训练基础模型的测试时输入对齐生成框架，将SAM3D生成先验锚定在几何与光度观测上，提升位姿与外观重建，支持单目、多视图及动态输入。
AI.motivation: 从单目或稀疏多视图观测重建完整3D物体资产仍具挑战。生成式3D基础模型虽能补全观测视角之外的几何，但其预测可能无法忠实还原已观测的几何、外观与位姿。作者希望在不重训练基础模型的前提下，使生成结果与输入观测对齐。
AI.method: 提出GenIA测试时输入对齐生成框架：1）从几何推导平移与尺度，同时保留学习到的旋转先验以改进物体位姿；2）通过可见性偏置注意力、跨观测融合以及去噪过程中的可微渲染引导来对齐外观；3）可选的后去噪精修，进一步调整外观隐变量、轻量解码器适配器与物体摆放；4）框架支持外部提供的几何，当给定动态物体的时序形状时，可恢复共享的、输入对齐的规范外观与稳定的世界空间摆放。
AI.result: 在合成与真实基准上，GenIA在单目、多视图和动态输入下均提升了位姿预测与物体重建效果，优于近期基于优化的方法、逐帧图像到3D方法以及视频到4D方法。
AI.conclusion: GenIA通过测试时对齐策略将生成式3D基础模型的先验与观测证据结合，无需重训练即可提高位姿与外观的输入忠实度，并统一支持静态与动态、单目与多视图以及外部几何输入场景。

title: SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation
summary: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. Regional geometry metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow preserves the specified geometry in high-control regions and enables plausible shape variation in low-control areas. A user study further indicates that the resulting balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom remains competitive in overall quality. When evaluating appearance on fixed geometry, text-conditioned routing achieves state-of-the-art prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy. Qualitative results additionally show localized routing of image cues. The project page is available at SpaceFlow3D.github.io.

AI.tldr: SpaceFlow提出一种免训练的局部可控3D生成流程，通过几何基元代理与局部控制级别，在流生成过程施加空间约束，并分段匹配实现局部外观路由，兼顾几何保真与生成自由度。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成方法缺乏显式局部控制：几何遵循度通常由全局控制强度决定，外观也无法局部指定，难以对物体不同部件分别施加约束或条件。
AI.method: 输入文本描述与一组几何基元，每个基元作为物体部件的代理并赋予局部控制级别，指定该区域严格遵循输入形状还是允许生成式补全；在结构生成阶段于生成流过程中施加这些空间约束；外观合成阶段将生成结构分割并匹配到基元，每个生成部件仅以其对应文本或图像提示为条件，从而限制跨部件信息泄漏。
AI.result: 区域几何指标显示方法在高控制区域保持指定几何、在低控制区域产生合理形状变化；用户研究表明几何保真与生成自由的平衡在整体质量上具竞争力；在固定几何上的外观评测中，文本条件路由取得最优的提示忠实度与颜色/材质准确率；定性结果展示图像线索的局部路由。
AI.conclusion: SpaceFlow实现了免训练、局部可控的文本到3D生成，统一支持几何约束与局部外观条件，在保真度与自由度之间取得良好平衡，并可扩展到图像线索的局部化控制。

title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpaceCast-Bench，首个直接诊断"预测性空间推理"能力的基准，涵盖 182 个真实场景、3,862 道题、16 类任务、三个层级；21 个模型评测显示最强模型仅 58.0%，人类为 87.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准主要测试"空间感知"（读取输入中已可见的关系），而真实世界的空间智能要求"预测性空间推理"：从观测中构建场景、预判干预如何改变场景，并推理未见结果。该能力缺乏直接、可诊断的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 SpaceCast-Bench，以"观测—变换—推断"（observe-transform-infer）框架组织；题目来自 182 个真实场景共 3,862 题，覆盖 16 种任务类型，分三个层级：静态感知、局部预测、全局预测，逐级要求场景理解、空间状态更新与对未观测结果的关系推理。通过程序化方式生成训练数据用于微调。
AI.result: 评测 21 个模型：最强模型仅 58.0%，人类 87.2%，空间专用模型接近随机水平。受控分析表明：bridge views（桥接视角）对整合分布式观测至关重要；显式 3D 证据比生成的结果图像或视频更稳定地带来增益。在程序化生成数据上微调使 Qwen3-VL-4B 从 34.0% 提升至 65.7%，并在六个域外基准上取得宏观平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 预测性空间推理是当前模型（含空间专用模型）的显著短板，与人类差距巨大；bridge views 与显式 3D 证据是关键支撑要素；基于程序化生成数据的微调可有效提升该能力并具备跨域泛化性。

title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
summary: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.

AI.tldr: ViSkill：一种视觉原生的技能学习框架，将成功交互编码为可直接被VLM智能体访问的复合视觉技能卡，实现技能积累与策略优化的闭环互促。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强智能体多依赖文本中心表示，将空间布局与动作-状态对应关系线性化为语言，丢失关键几何结构；虽有工作引入视觉证据，但技能构建与策略优化相互分离，二者互促潜力未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: ViSkill将成功交互编码为复合视觉技能卡，检索到的技能同时指导推理与奖励塑形，成功轨迹再被蒸馏回技能库，形成技能积累与策略改进相互强化的闭环；并提供可选的冷启动机制加速早期学习。
AI.result: 在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上，ViSkill达到0.89的总体成功率，结合冷启动初始化提升至0.91，优于所有评测的专有与开源基线，且收敛速度快于标准PPO。
AI.conclusion: 视觉原生技能表示能有效保留几何结构，技能库与策略优化的闭环反馈可显著提升样本效率与成功率，为VLM智能体的技能学习提供了新范式。

title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models
summary: Multiplayer world models must generate independently controlled views with consistent representations of both players and their shared environment. Most existing approaches coordinate multiple players through joint multi-view generation, whose cost grows with each additional player. We present WorldCast, a distributed multiplayer world model in which each player runs a local client comprising a video generator and a state model. Using recorded player positions and map geometry during training, the state model estimates the player's position from generated video and control inputs. Clients exchange player states and project them into camera-aligned player state fields that guide where and how other players are rendered. Shared scene state enables clients to reuse one another's generated observations to maintain consistent scene appearance across views. Experiments on Counter-Strike 2 demonstrate WorldCast's consistency, real-time performance, and distributed scalability. The camera-aligned player state field improves player rendering rates by over an order of magnitude over joint-generation methods, while shared scene state improves visual consistency over whole rounds. Each client runs in real time and exchanges only player and scene states, enabling scalable multiplayer generation without a centralized computational bottleneck. Image quality remains stable over hour-long rollouts.

AI.tldr: WorldCast 是一种分布式多玩家世界模型，每个玩家运行由视频生成器和状态模型组成的本地客户端，客户端间仅交换玩家状态与场景状态，实现实时、可扩展且长期一致的多视角生成。
AI.motivation: 多玩家世界模型需要为各玩家生成独立控制且相互一致的视角，同时保持玩家与共享环境表征的一致性。现有方法多采用联合多视角生成来协调多个玩家，其计算成本随玩家数量增加而增长，难以扩展并易形成集中式计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 WorldCast 分布式框架：每个玩家运行本地客户端，包含视频生成器与状态模型。训练时利用记录的真实玩家位置和地图几何，使状态模型根据生成视频与控制输入估计玩家位置。客户端之间交换玩家状态，并将其投影为相机对齐的玩家状态场（camera-aligned player state field），用于指导其他玩家的渲染位置与方式；同时共享场景状态，使客户端可复用彼此的生成观测以维持跨视角的场景外观一致。
AI.result: 在 Counter-Strike 2 上的实验表明 WorldCast 具备一致性、实时性与分布式可扩展性。相机对齐玩家状态场使玩家渲染速率相比联合生成方法提升一个数量级以上；共享场景状态在整局回合中改善视觉一致性。每个客户端实时运行且仅交换玩家与场景状态，实现无集中式计算瓶颈的可扩展生成；在长达一小时的 rollout 中图像质量保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: WorldCast 通过分布式客户端与轻量状态交换，替代昂贵的联合多视角生成，在保证多玩家视角一致性的同时实现实时、可扩展和长时间稳定的多玩家世界建模。

title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
summary: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

AI.tldr: MAMHOI 提出一种以可供性（affordance）为中介的因子化框架，通过显式的“运动-可供性”接口将场景理解与人体-物体运动合成解耦，在无需成对的人-物-场景数据条件下实现复杂3D场景中真实且物理可行的人-物交互生成。
AI.motivation: 在复杂3D场景中生成真实的人-物交互（HOI）需要两种互补能力：对环境中交互可行性的推理，以及真实的人-物运动合成。然而，这两类能力的大规模联合监督数据极为稀缺：人-场景数据集提供环境感知运动信息，人-物数据集捕捉交互动力学细节，但成对的人-物-场景数据仍十分匮乏，导致难以直接端到端训练。
AI.method: MAMHOI 采用可供性中介的因子化（affordance-mediated factorization）设计，在场景理解与运动合成之间引入显式的运动-可供性接口：先由场景条件模型预测交互在何处、以何种方式可被可行地执行（即可供性），再由可供性条件的HOI模型据此生成相应的人-物运动。该因子化使场景理解与交互动力学可分别从互补的监督来源中学习，而不依赖成对的人-物-场景数据。
AI.result: 在复杂室内环境中的实验表明，MAMHOI 在降低物体-场景穿透（object-scene penetration）的同时，更好地保持了人-物交互质量，生成出更真实且物理可行的场景感知交互结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的运动-可供性接口对场景感知HOI生成进行因子化，MAMHOI 有效绕开了成对人-物-场景数据缺失的瓶颈，兼顾物理可行性与交互真实性，为复杂场景下的人-物交互生成提供了可行路径。项目主页：https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/

title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WOVEN —— 一个按场景、动作与推理类型组织的视觉状态转移推理训练源与基准，包含 36,076 个来自视频预训练生成模型的真实 rollout 样本。作者先评测 38 个前沿 MLLM，发现它们在视觉转移推理上存在系统性缺陷；随后在多尺度模型上训练，证明该能力可跨任务迁移，并总结出一套视觉世界建模的训练配方。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在空间、具身、物理与时间推理上普遍失败。作者假设这些失败源于共同的"视觉转移推理"能力缺失，并希望验证该能力能否作为一种可共享的训练原语——即不同模型可从不同监督来源学习并复用到不同任务。已有基准仅分别记录这些缺陷，缺乏对场景、动作与推理操作的受控比较。
AI.method: 1）构建 WOVEN：按场景（20 类）、动作（5 类）、推理类型（8 类）组织转移监督，共 36,076 个样本，数据来自视频预训练生成模型的多样化真实 rollout。2）基准评测 38 个前沿 MLLM（如 GPT-5.4、Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B）。3）在 WOVEN 上训练多个规模的 MLLM，进行迁移测试与数据替换实验，并通过留出基准前瞻性验证训练配方。
AI.result: 评测显示存在显著且系统性的缺陷：最强模型也远低于人类水平，且失败跨模型家族、跨规模持续存在。训练实验表明模型学到可广泛迁移的共享能力：每个仅约 2,000 条的子集共同使 26 个外部基准中的 22 个提升，最高提升 27.3 个百分点；WOVEN 数据可替换某项任务自身 30–50% 的训练数据而保持相当精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立视觉转移推理可作为 MLLM 视觉世界模型训练的可复用基础，并给出经前瞻验证的训练配方：按所教授的推理操作（而非所展示的动作、场景或领域）选择监督，并优先选择视觉状态变化更大的样本以提升鲁棒性。

title: OneSearch-VL: Unified Multimodal Deep Research Agent for Image and Video
summary: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. A key challenge is to preserve the dependencies linking localized visual anchors, entity relations, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations. We introduce OneSearch-VL, a unified agent centered on the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG), which encodes these dependencies as a shared task-level reference for data construction, process supervision, and operation-level evaluation. Our VGEG-based data engine constructs and verifies multi-image and video questions and filters expert trajectories. Using these data, we assemble OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL, respectively. We further derive the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) from VGEG annotations to supervise evidence traceability and visual grounding during RL. For fine-grained evaluation, we construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, organizing questions by the research operations encoded in their VGEGs. Experiments show that OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B with tool access by 20.2 and 17.6 percentage points on the two new benchmarks, respectively, while also achieving substantial gains across 7 image benchmarks and VideoDR. Project repository: https://github.com/appletea233/OneSearch-VL

AI.tldr: 提出OneSearch-VL，以视觉锚定证据图(VGEG)为核心统一单图、多图与视频深度研究，构建数据引擎、SFT/RL语料与EVGR奖励，并新建多图与视频基准，8B模型显著超越Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.motivation: 单图、多图、视频深度研究虽操作不同，但共享"视觉定位—外部检索—事实组织"工作流。核心挑战在于保持视觉锚点、实体关系、来源支持事实与答案生成操作之间的依赖关系，现有方法难以统一建模并提供过程级监督与细粒度评估。
AI.method: 以视觉锚定证据图(VGEG)为核心编码上述依赖，作为数据构建、过程监督与操作级评估的共享任务级参照。基于VGEG的数据引擎构建并校验多图与视频问题、筛选专家轨迹，形成OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K与OneSearch-VL-RL-10K。从VGEG标注派生证据感知视觉锚定评分奖励(EVGR)，用于强化学习中的证据可追溯性与视觉定位监督。新建OneSearch-MI-Bench与OneSearch-Video-Bench，按VGEG编码的研究操作组织问题。
AI.result: OneSearch-VL-8B在含工具访问条件下，于两个新基准上分别较Qwen3-VL-8B提升20.2与17.6个百分点，并在7个图像基准与VideoDR上也取得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 以VGEG为统一核心可有效串联数据构建、过程监督与操作级评估，验证了统一智能体在多图与视频深度研究中的有效性，并已开源项目仓库。

title: Beyond Spatio-Temporal Priors: A Generalizable Approach for Dense Correspondence Matching
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 7 figures, including appendices
summary: Dense correspondence matching has historically been bounded by simplifying spatio-temporal priors, such as smooth motion and rigid geometry. While effective for classical tasks, these assumptions break down in image editing and reference-guided generation (IEG), where transformations can preserve visual identity while breaking physical continuity. To establish identity-preserving correspondence across such transformations, we introduce FreeMatching, a generalizable framework combining generative and semantic foundation representations with heterogeneous supervision from classical datasets, tracked videos, and synthetic scenes. Teacher-guided iterative refinement further improves correspondence in IEG without dense correspondence annotations. Experimentally, a single FreeMatching model substantially improves correspondence quality on challenging IEG image pairs while retaining competitive performance on classical benchmarks. Furthermore, we demonstrate its utility as a quantitative metric for evaluating identity preservation, with scores that correlate with human judgment. The code is available at https://github.com/luping-liu/FreeMatching.

AI.tldr: 提出FreeMatching框架，突破传统时空先验限制，实现图像编辑与参考引导生成（IEG）中的身份保持稠密对应匹配。
AI.motivation: 传统稠密对应匹配依赖平滑运动、刚性几何等时空先验，这些假设在图像编辑和参考引导生成（IEG）中失效——此类变换可保持视觉身份却打破物理连续性，因此需要新的身份保持对应机制。
AI.method: 结合生成式与语义基础表示，并利用经典数据集、跟踪视频、合成场景的异构监督；采用教师引导的迭代精化，在无稠密对应标注的IEG场景下提升匹配质量。
AI.result: 单一FreeMatching模型在具挑战性的IEG图像对上显著提升对应质量，同时在经典基准上保持竞争力；作为身份保持评估的定量指标，其得分与人类判断相关。
AI.conclusion: FreeMatching以通用框架实现跨变换的身份保持对应匹配，兼具IEG匹配改进与评估指标双重价值，代码已开源。

title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
summary: We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models' point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset (pumpire-6k) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/

AI.tldr: Pumpire：面向图像/视频级3D基础模型点对点距离估计能力的统一基准，含6k帧数据集与29种基线配置的评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有评测通常将深度与相机内参分开评估，或用几何相似度指标评价点云，无法直接反映模型的点对点距离估计能力；同时重建3D空间中的物理尺度感知这一更基础能力被以往协议忽视。
AI.method: 构建大规模多样化数据集pumpire-6k（100个真实场景，每场景64帧，共6400帧，含实测点对点距离标注）；基于该数据集提出统一评测协议，覆盖图像级与视频级3D基础模型（含/不含深度先验），直接从重建几何评估点对点距离误差，并支持跨设定比较。
AI.result: 对29种代表性3D基础模型基线配置进行大量实验，给出点对点距离误差的直接评测与跨设定对比，并提供全面结果分析。
AI.conclusion: Pumpire提供了统一的基准与评测协议，直接衡量重建3D空间中的物理尺度感知与点对点距离估计能力，填补了既有评测的空白。

title: FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?
summary: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FastBench，用于评估高动态真实视频流下的流式视频大语言模型理解能力，并给出免训练基线 ProactiveFrame。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频 VLM 基准多聚焦低动态场景，且在有限上下文预算下难以兼顾时间历史、空间分辨率与时间粒度；1--2 FPS 稀疏采样会漏掉快速事件。
AI.method: 构建基于轨迹的流水线：由高帧率片段生成 QA、过滤掉 2 FPS 即可回答的问题、用 SAM3 与 CoTracker3 轨迹验证答案，并经三轮人工检查；数据集含 306 个 QA 对，覆盖 8 个领域、6 类能力与前向/即时/后向时间范围，并标注证据区间。同时提出免训练基线 ProactiveFrame，通过文本 token 调整输入帧率，采用双层滑动窗口保留近期高帧率观测、将较旧观测降采样为稀疏历史。
AI.result: 最强模型 Gemini-3.5-Flash 仅得 50.7%；Qwen3-VL-8B 从 2 FPS 的 32.9% 提升至 24 FPS 的 44.6%，但随历史压缩增益饱和；ProactiveFrame 较稀疏均匀采样分别提升 5.4 与 1.5 个百分点，但仍明显低于 oracle 引导聚焦。
AI.conclusion: 现有 VLM 难以仅凭视频流判断何时需要更细的时间感知，FastBench 为高动态流式视频理解提供了测试平台。

title: LEGO: A Lifting-Free Approach for Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Generating an egocentric video from a single exocentric recording is a challenging case of novel view synthesis, as the two cameras share little overlap and much of the target view is unobserved. Current state-of-the-art methods reconstruct the scene explicitly by estimating depth, lifting the video into a point cloud, and re-rendering it from the egocentric camera to condition a video diffusion model. This deterministic mapping assigns each pixel to a single reprojected location, which preserves texture but translates depth errors into misplaced content. We ask what a video diffusion model should receive as its condition and propose a lifting-free answer: a learned view synthesizer, an LVSM-style transformer fine-tuned to render the egocentric view directly without depth, point clouds, or reprojection, resolving cross-view correspondence internally. In contrast, its probabilistic mapping averages each region over candidate source locations according to a learned correspondence distribution, preserving structure while fine texture is averaged away. We argue that this trade-off suits a diffusion generator, whose denoising training excels at restoring detail, so an effective condition should prioritize structural alignment over sharpness. This distribution's concentration also yields a per-region confidence, used both to mask low-confidence regions and to guide the generator toward high-confidence areas during early layout-forming denoising steps. Our approach consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art explicit pipeline and generalizes to other datasets without retraining. The synthesizer thus supplies view structure, and the diffusion model its detail.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无显式提升（lifting-free）的视角合成方案：用 LVSM 风格 Transformer 直接渲染第一人称视角作为条件，替代传统"深度估计—点云—重投影"流程，并结合置信度掩码与引导，在扩散生成中恢复细节，性能优于 SOTA 且可跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 从单个第三人称（exocentric）视频生成第一人称（egocentric）视频时，两相机重叠区域小、目标视角大量区域未被观测。现有 SOTA 采用显式重建：估计深度、将视频提升为点云、重投影渲染后再条件化视频扩散模型。这种确定性映射把每个像素指派到唯一重投影位置，虽保留纹理，却把深度误差转化为内容错位，因此需要重新思考扩散模型应接收何种条件。
AI.method: 提出无提升方案：采用学习式视角合成器（LVSM 风格 Transformer），经微调后直接渲染第一人称视角，不使用深度、点云或重投影，在内部解决跨视角对应关系。其映射为概率式：依据学习到的对应分布，将每个区域在候选源位置上做加权平均——保留结构，但精细纹理会因平均而模糊。作者认为该权衡契合扩散生成器，因为去噪训练擅长恢复细节，故条件应优先保证结构对齐而非清晰度。分布的集中度还给出逐区域置信度，用于掩蔽低置信区域，并在早期形成布局的去噪步骤中引导生成器聚焦高置信区域。
AI.result: 该方法在性能上稳定优于 SOTA 的显式流水线，并且无需重新训练即可泛化到其他数据集。
AI.conclusion: 合成器负责提供视角结构，扩散模型负责补充细节，二者互补；该条件设计思路验证了"结构优先于清晰度"对扩散生成条件的合理性。

title: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts
summary: In this work, we show that a single Transformer block, applied recurrently, can match the accuracy of a full-depth vision encoder at comparable inference FLOPs without intermediate feature distillation. reViT restores depth-specific transformations by representing the FFN at each recurrent depth as a convex combination of a small shared expert bank. A continuous normalized-depth coordinate programs this mixture, defining a resampleable trajectory through FFN parameter space. We evaluate this design in two regimes: supervised ImageNet-1k training and distillation from a DINOv2 teacher. Across both regimes, controlled adaptations identify weight-space merging as the strongest tested MoE family at a matching one-FFN budget, ahead of the token-dispatch and output-mixture alternatives. Trained from scratch, reViT-B/16 attains DeiT III accuracy with about 70\% fewer stored parameters. An 8-experts model distilled using only the teacher's output features retains nearly all of its DINOv2 teacher's linear-probe accuracy and transfers across classification, segmentation, and depth prediction. Elastic-depth training allows one checkpoint (trained model) to operate at multiple tested depths by resampling the same normalized coordinate interval. For fixed-depth deployment, the recurrent block can be materialized as a conventional dense graph, removing online routing and merging without changing the one-FFN-per-depth compute but expanding deployment storage.

AI.tldr: 提出 reViT：将单个 Transformer block 循环复用，并把每层 FFN 表示为小型共享专家库的凸组合，由归一化深度坐标调制，从而在同等推理 FLOPs 下匹配全深度视觉编码器精度，并支持弹性深度与稠密化部署。
AI.motivation: 深层视觉编码器参数量与存储开销大，但简单参数共享（循环同一 block）会丢失各深度特有的变换能力；已有方案多依赖中间特征蒸馏来弥补，成本高。作者希望在不使用中间特征蒸馏、且不增加每深度 FFN 计算量的前提下，恢复深度特异性。
AI.method: 1) 循环应用单个 Transformer block；2) 将每个循环深度的 FFN 表示为一个小型共享专家库的凸组合，即权重空间合并（weight-space merging），而非 token 分发或输出混合；3) 用连续归一化深度坐标对该混合进行调制，形成可在 FFN 参数空间中重采样的轨迹；4) 在监督 ImageNet-1k 训练与 DINOv2 蒸馏两种设定下评估，并做受控消融比较不同 MoE 家族；5) 支持弹性深度训练与固定深度下的稠密图物化部署。
AI.result: 受控对比显示，在单 FFN 预算下权重空间合并优于 token 分发与输出混合两类 MoE 方案。从头训练的 reViT-B/16 以约少 70% 的存储参数达到 DeiT III 精度；8 专家模型仅用教师输出特征蒸馏，即保留 DINOv2 教师几乎全部线性探测精度，并可迁移到分类、分割与深度预测。弹性深度训练使单一 checkpoint 通过在相同归一化坐标区间重采样，支持多个测试深度。
AI.conclusion: reViT 证明循环单 block 结合深度坐标调制的专家凸组合，可在不损失精度的情况下大幅压缩存储，并兼具弹性深度推理能力；固定深度部署时可物化为稠密图以消除在线路由与合并，代价是部署存储扩张。

title: VersaCamVLA: Camera-Configurable VLA Policies for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful foundations for robotic manipulation, but their reliance on fixed camera configurations during training makes them brittle to changes in camera count or pose during deployment. To overcome these limitations, we propose VersaCamVLA, a camera-configurable framework that decouples camera-set representation from action learning. VersaCamVLA learns a unified scene-token interface that maps an arbitrary, variable set of posed RGB views into fixed-size latent scene tokens. This is achieved via multi-signal target-view prediction and Wrist-Augmented Pose Sampling (WAPS), which leverages natural wrist-camera motion for free pose diversity. At deployment, a lightweight spatial encoder injects these compact scene tokens into a pretrained base VLA as a supplementary visual condition, requiring no explicit 3D sensing or novel-view rendering. Experiments on RoboTwin, LIBERO, and a real-robot platform demonstrate that VersaCamVLA consistently outperforms prior VLA methods and direct multi-view baselines, maintaining robust performance across varying camera counts and unseen camera poses.

AI.tldr: 提出VersaCamVLA，一种相机配置可变的VLA框架，将任意数量与位姿的RGB视图映射为固定尺寸场景token，注入预训练VLA，在相机数量与位姿变化下保持鲁棒操作性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在训练时依赖固定的相机配置，部署中相机数量或位姿一旦变化性能即显著下降，缺乏对相机配置的泛化能力，而显式3D感知或新视角渲染代价高。
AI.method: 通过多信号目标视图预测与腕部增强位姿采样（WAPS，利用腕部相机运动提供免费位姿多样性），学习统一的场景token接口，将任意可变集合的带位姿RGB视图编码为固定尺寸的隐场景token；部署时用轻量空间编码器将这些压缩token作为补充视觉条件注入预训练基础VLA，无需显式3D感知或新视角渲染。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin、LIBERO及真实机器人平台上，VersaCamVLA持续优于已有VLA方法与直接多视图基线，在相机数量变化与未见相机位姿下均保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: 将相机集合表示与动作学习解耦是提升VLA相机配置泛化性的有效途径，统一场景token接口可在不引入3D传感的前提下实现可变相机配置的鲁棒操纵。

title: OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026. Code and benchmark can be found at https://01yzzyu.github.io/OmniCapBench/
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. We introduce OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that reframes audio--visual caption evaluation as a deep-structured diagnostic framework. OmniCapBench shifts the prediction target from free-form text to sets of atomic, verifiable evaluation units across three tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, enabling reliable scoring with deterministic constraint checks and localized LLM-based semantic comparisons. With 786 densely annotated videos, OmniCapBench effectively distinguishes MLLM perception errors, including temporal grounding failures, identity drift, cross-modal misalignment, and hallucinated descriptions. Evaluating frontier MLLMs reveals strong local perception but weak long-horizon audio--visual reasoning, particularly in identity drift and cross-modal misalignment, providing a fine-grained roadmap for omnimodal development.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniCapBench，将音视频描述评测从自由文本评分重构为原子化、可验证单元的结构化诊断框架，涵盖实体引用、视觉镜头、音频事件三条轨道，包含 786 个密集标注视频，可定位 MLLM 的时序定位失败、身份漂移、跨模态错位与幻觉等问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型正向连续音视频推理演进，亟需能揭示其能力边界的评测。音视频描述是理想的诊断任务，但现有基准存在耦合权衡：整段描述评分有覆盖度却无定位，局部探针有定位却无覆盖，且无约束的 LLM 评判器不稳定。
AI.method: 将预测目标由自由形式文本转为原子化、可验证的评测单元集合，分三条轨道：实体引用、视觉镜头、音频事件。采用确定性约束检查实现可靠评分，并在局部范围内使用 LLM 进行语义比较。
AI.result: 构建 786 个密集标注视频的基准，有效区分 MLLM 的感知错误类型，包括时序定位失败、身份漂移、跨模态错位与幻觉描述。对前沿 MLLM 的评测显示其局部感知较强，但长时序音视频推理薄弱，尤其表现在身份漂移与跨模态错位。
AI.conclusion: OmniCapBench 以结构化诊断替代自由文本评分，兼顾覆盖度与定位能力，提升评测稳定性，并为全模态模型发展提供细粒度改进方向。

title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
summary: Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as \emph{closed-loop task execution in visual world space} and introduce \textbf{WorldGuide}. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce \textbf{WorldGuide Bench}: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on \textbf{WorldGuide-Bench}, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on \textbf{VideoCraft-Bench} compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WorldGuide，将过程性视频生成形式化为视觉世界空间中的闭环任务执行，通过联合训练的规划器与执行器以及层级视觉记忆，实现从初始图像和目标出发的逐步动作预测、片段生成与终止判定，并构建了 WorldGuide Bench 数据集，在两个基准上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 视频生成器与视频世界模型能合成看似合理的视觉轨迹，但在长时程过程性任务中，生成必须根据实际已产生的状态自适应调整：模型需从生成状态判断下一步动作、执行该动作并识别任务何时完成。开环生成无法适应执行结果，而现有闭环系统多依赖预训练执行器或间接验证，导致"决定动作"与"成功实现动作"之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 将过程性视频生成建模为视觉世界空间中的闭环任务执行，提出 WorldGuide：仅给定初始图像与任务目标，模型预测原子动作、生成对应视频片段，并利用生成结果选择下一动作或终止。规划器（Planner）与执行器（Executor）在同一逐步过程性演示上训练——规划器学习从视觉进展预测下一原子动作或任务完成，执行器直接学习实现所预测动作。采用层级视觉记忆在有界历史 token 代价下维持长时程状态。针对缺乏逐步动作-视频监督的问题，构建 WorldGuide Bench：约 59K 逐步标注视频，覆盖 245 个任务与 27 个过程性类别。
AI.result: 在 WorldGuide-Bench 上达到 33.33% 任务成功率，优于近期强视频模型 MiniMax-H3 的 29.90%（且 MiniMax-H3 还额外获得参考动作计划）；在 VideoCraft-Bench 上以仅目标条件达到 47.69%，而 MiniMax-H3 为 32.73%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明确目标导向的过程性视频生成，将规划与学习到的执行相耦合至关重要。

title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
summary: Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video, which we lift and complete into multi-view videos. To learn from this imperfect supervision, we propose Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS: a Fourier-series deformation field guarantees looping by construction, while a Grounded Drift Field anchored at the reference view absorbs cross-view inconsistency. Unlike prior Eulerian methods limited to fluid-like motion, we capture general deformation, object motion, and illumination change. We introduce a ground-truth-free evaluation covering vividness, naturalness, loop seam coherence, and scene quality. On 39 reconstructed and generated scenes, OuroWorld outperforms all baselines and wins 70.8%-99.0% of user-study comparisons. Project page: https://ouroworld.userwei.com

AI.tldr: OuroWorld是一个免掩码框架，可将任意静态3DGS场景转化为可无缝循环、任意视角可探索的3D动态影像（3D cinemagraph）。
AI.motivation: 现有3D世界模型虽能生成逼真的可探索场景，但场景"冻结在时间中"，缺乏动态；且已有动态化方法（如欧拉式方法）多局限于流体类运动，难以刻画一般形变、物体运动与光照变化。
AI.method: 用视觉-语言模型推断合理动态并引导视频模型合成参考视频，再提升并补全为多视角视频；提出Inconsistency-Robust Periodic 4DGS：傅里叶级数形变场从构造上保证循环性，以参考视角为锚的Grounded Drift Field吸收跨视角不一致，从而从不完美监督中学习。
AI.result: 提出无真值的评估指标，覆盖生动性、自然度、循环接缝一致性与场景质量；在39个重建与生成场景上优于所有基线，并在用户研究中赢得70.8%–99.0%的对比。
AI.conclusion: OuroWorld实现了免掩码、可无缝循环、多视角一致的静态3DGS动态化，扩展了可捕捉的运动类型，并建立了相应的评估体系。

title: What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach
summary: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.

AI.tldr: 世界模型可通过扩展第一视角人类视频显著提升智能体建模保真度并接近饱和，但物体交互保真度提升缓慢且差距明显，缩小差距的关键在于训练方式而非数据量。
AI.motivation: 世界模型有望替代物理仿真器，但距离实际部署仍很遥远。作者希望探究扩展第一视角（ego-centric）人类视频数据能把世界模型推进到什么程度，并寻找更直接的评估方式。
AI.method: 构建包含30,000小时、覆盖1,000余种场景类型与14,000名贡献者的第一视角视频数据集；不依赖不透明下游指标，而是直接在具有挑战性的分布外（OOD）基准上评估智能体与物体交互保真度；系统分析数据规模的影响，设计视觉条件（conditioning）方案，并引入将容量从场景外观转向物体动态的监督方案。
AI.result: 训练数据扩大100倍可同时提升智能体与物体保真度，但两者不均衡：智能体建模良好，物体保真度显著更低且提升缓慢。智能体提升并非全部来自数据，精心的视觉条件设计可在少量数据下使保真度饱和，从而可单独测量物体保真度并找到其饱和点。所提监督方案可提升物体保真度，但仍有较大差距。结论可迁移至下游人形建模。
AI.conclusion: 扩展第一视角数据使智能体建模接近其极限，而对世界的影响（物体交互）建模仍远落后；弥合这一差距取决于模型的训练方式，而不仅仅取决于数据规模。

title: Rubric-CEPR: Self-Evolving Image Editing via Reward-Verified Self-Distillation
summary: Instruction-guided image editors have become highly capable, yet improving them further still depends on human-edited training pairs or external reward models. Such supervision is costly to obtain and can reward plausible failures: a realistic output may leave the requested change undone or alter content that should be preserved. In this work, we strive to improve a pretrained image editor using only its own generations, without human-edited targets or an external training-time reward model. To this end, we propose a self-evolving framework, named Rubric-CEPR, that verifies the editor's own samples with its internal representations through a rubric-augmented Contrastive Edit-Preservation Reward (CEPR). A Planner proposes structured edit instructions from unlabeled images, the Editor samples multiple candidate edits, and a frozen Critic scores each candidate with decomposed rubric checks for edit realization, removal of the old state, and content preservation, using features already exposed by the editor. Non-compensatory gates reject infeasible candidates, and the best verified candidate is distilled into the editor through lightweight adapter training. On Qwen-Image-Edit, Rubric-CEPR improves ImgEdit from 4.36 to 4.60 (+5.5%), with a +24.9% gain on object isolation, and transfers to GEdit-Bench and Complex-Edit. The same procedure also improves Step1X-Edit by +7.8% on ImgEdit. We hope our approach will serve as a solid baseline for image editors that improve themselves from their own verified samples. Our code is publicly available at $\href{https://riteshthawkar.github.io/Rubric-CEPR/}{\text{this URL}}$

AI.tldr: 提出 Rubric-CEPR 自进化框架，仅依赖编辑器自身的生成样本与内部表征，通过评分量表增强的对比编辑-保持奖励（CEPR）验证并蒸馏最优候选，实现无需人工目标或外部奖励模型的图像编辑自提升。
AI.motivation: 现有指令引导图像编辑器虽能力强，但进一步提升依赖人工编辑的训练对或外部奖励模型，这类监督获取成本高，且可能奖励看似合理却失败的结果：如未完成所请求的编辑，或改动了本应保持的内容。
AI.method: 框架包含三个组件：Planner 从无标注图像生成结构化编辑指令；Editor 采样多个候选编辑；冻结的 Critic 利用编辑器已暴露的特征，按分解式评分量表对每个候选打分，涵盖编辑实现、旧状态移除与内容保持三个维度，并用非补偿性门控拒绝不可行候选。随后将最佳已验证候选通过轻量适配器训练蒸馏回编辑器。
AI.result: 在 Qwen-Image-Edit 上，Rubric-CEPR 将 ImgEdit 从 4.36 提升至 4.60（+5.5%），对象隔离任务增益达 +24.9%，并可迁移至 GEdit-Bench 与 Complex-Edit；同一流程在 Step1X-Edit 上使 ImgEdit 提升 +7.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了仅凭编辑器自身的生成样本即可实现有效自提升，为图像编辑器的自进化提供了坚实基线，代码已公开。

title: Does Dynamic-Point Filtering Help When Texture Is Scarce? A Controlled Study of ORB-SLAM2 Front-Ends in Synthetic Indoor Scenes
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, submitted to IROS 2026. Open-source code and dataset available
summary: Dynamic-point filters are routinely added to feature-based visual SLAM, and several recent systems argue that removing dynamic features can leave too few static features in low-texture regions. So far, these systems have been evaluated only on texture-rich benchmark sequences. We present a controlled study that isolates this interaction. We render synthetic indoor sequences in which surface texture (four levels, quantified by FAST-corner density and image-gradient entropy) and scene dynamics (three levels) are varied factorially along identical camera trajectories, with stereo, RGB-D, ground-truth poses and dynamic masks. On this grid we compare ORB-SLAM2 without filtering, with an optical-flow and epipolar-residual filter (FLOW), and with a multi-view depth-consistency filter (GEOM), and report trajectory error, tracking completeness and surviving static features over five runs. Because the masks give per-keypoint ground truth, we also measure each filter's dynamic-point precision and recall and its static-feature false-removal rate, so that mechanistic explanations can be tested directly. We do not propose a new filter. On 720 runs over 24 sequences, filtering helped mainly in the most dynamic cells; the benefit did not decline monotonically with texture, but at the lowest level filtering reduced tracking completeness, and ORB-SLAM2 never initialised in static L3 scenes. Contrary to our hypothesis, GEOM discarded more static keypoints than FLOW (median FRR 6.8% vs. 1.5% for RGB-D, 19.6% vs. 1.5% for stereo); its RGB-D advantage tracked dynamic-point recall and vanished in stereo mode. Data and code are available at https://github.com/felixxxue/texture-dynamics-slam.

AI.tldr: 本文不提出新滤波器，而是通过可控合成实验研究视觉SLAM中动态点滤波与纹理丰富度的交互作用。在24个序列、720次运行上比较ORB-SLAM2无滤波、光流-对极残差滤波(FLOW)与多视图深度一致性滤波(GEOM)，发现滤波收益主要出现在高动态场景，低纹理下反而降低跟踪完整性，且GEOM比FLOW误删更多静态关键点。
AI.motivation: 动态点滤波器常被加入基于特征的视觉SLAM，近期系统认为移除动态特征会使低纹理区域静态特征过少。然而这些系统此前仅在纹理丰富的基准序列上评测，缺乏对"纹理-动态"交互作用与滤波器内部机制的受控分析。
AI.method: 渲染合成室内序列，在相同相机轨迹上因子化地改变表面纹理（4个等级，用FAST角点密度与图像梯度熵量化）与场景动态（3个等级），提供双目、RGB-D、真值位姿与动态掩码。在此网格上比较ORB-SLAM2无滤波、FLOW（光流+对极残差）和GEOM（多视图深度一致性），报告轨迹误差、跟踪完整性与存活静态特征（5次运行）。借助掩码提供的逐关键点真值，测量各滤波器的动态点精确率与召回率及静态特征误删率(FRR)。
AI.result: 在24个序列共720次运行中：滤波主要在最动态单元有帮助；收益未随纹理单调下降，但在最低纹理等级滤波降低了跟踪完整性，且ORB-SLAM2在静态L3场景从未初始化。与假设相反，GEOM比FLOW丢弃更多静态关键点（中位FRR：RGB-D为6.8% vs 1.5%，双目为19.6% vs 1.5%）；GEOM的RGB-D优势与动态点召回率一致，但在双目模式下消失。
AI.conclusion: 动态滤波的收益依赖于动态程度而非纹理丰富度，且在低纹理下会损害跟踪完整性；滤波器机制差异显著，GEOM的静态误删率远高于FLOW，其优势仅在RGB-D下有效。作者未提出新滤波器，而是提供可控评测网格与数据代码供后续研究。

title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
summary: Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 74.51 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 78.19 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.

AI.tldr: 提出NavGPT-3：将长时程智能体强化学习语言模型与动作策略通过OS式运行时harness连接，实现推理/执行/监控多线程调度与中断切换；配套NavGPT VLA动作策略（19.28M样本，codec视觉token分配，8B单独达R2R-CE 74.51 SR）。完整系统在R2R-CE达SOTA（81.51 SR），在RxR-CE首次达到人类水平（成功率90.43 vs 90.4 SR，nDTW 78.47 vs 77.7），单回合1分22秒（人类约3分钟）。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体强化学习训练的语言模型具备推理、精确动作表达与多步目标追求能力，提升了具身智能体的理解与决策上限；但物理交互仍依赖动作策略提供的密集、低延迟控制。核心动机是弥合"语言模型推理"与"底层物理控制"之间的鸿沟，即设计连接前沿语言模型智能与低层控制的具身接口。
AI.method: 1) NavGPT-3 harness：类操作系统运行时，将推理、执行、监控作为线程运行，各自拥有上下文、工具与权限，由运行时调度并决定哪个线程控制机器人运动，支持中断与线程切换以应对突发真实事件。2) NavGPT VLA动作策略：在19.28M样本上训练，采用codec allocation按场景变化比例分配视觉token。3) 全面消融harness设计及两模型间的交互。
AI.result: NavGPT VLA 8B单模型在R2R-CE达74.51 SR，RxR-CE达78.19 SR领先；完整harness在R2R-CE达81.51 SR（SOTA）。RxR-CE上成功率90.43 vs 人类90.4 SR，路径保真度78.47 vs 77.7 nDTW，单回合1分22秒（人类约3分钟）。由VLA执行路径时，推理循环缩短，系统最低反应时间从每个语言模型决策3-19秒降至每个动作策略步0.5-1秒（1-2 Hz）。
AI.conclusion: 将语言模型推理与低层物理控制连接的关键在于具身接口的设计；该接口使语言模型智能与动作策略协同，实现实时反应与人类水平导航。将开源全部模型、代码与评测记录。

title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
summary: Shortcut learning is a prevalent issue in robot learning. The limited diversity of robot demonstration datasets can mislead policies into exploiting spurious correlations between tasks and irrelevant features, such as viewpoint or background. Collecting sufficiently diverse robot demonstrations is costly and inefficient, motivating algorithmic alternatives. We focus on vision-language-action (VLA) models and discover that different vision-language model backbones exhibit substantially different levels of susceptibility to visual shortcut learning. We find that model behavior correlates with our proposed representation-level metric, action margin, which requires no policy rollouts. Visual shortcuts consistently enter action representations in early layers, with models differing in the extent to which later layers correct them by incorporating language information. To boost models' attention to language, we introduce task scrubbing, a new domain-adversarial training method that decreases models' likelihood of using visual shortcuts and improves VLAs' generalization. Experiments in both simulation and the real world across multiple VLAs and visual cues show that task scrubbing improves out-of-distribution robustness and often eliminates visual shortcut learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究VLA模型中的视觉捷径学习问题，提出无需rollout的表征级指标"action margin"来预测模型易感性，发现捷径在早期层进入动作表征、后期层通过语言信息部分纠正；并提出"task scrubbing"域对抗训练方法，在仿真与真实环境中提升分布外鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 机器人示教数据集多样性不足，导致策略利用任务与无关视觉特征（如视角、背景）间的伪相关，即捷径学习；采集多样化示教成本高、效率低，因此需要算法层面的替代方案。现有工作未系统揭示不同视觉语言模型骨干在视觉捷径易感性上的差异及其机制。
AI.method: 1）聚焦VLA模型，比较不同VLM骨干的视觉捷径易感性；2）提出表征级指标action margin，无需策略rollout即可预测模型行为；3）通过层次分析定位捷径进入动作表征的位置及后期层的语言纠正作用；4）提出task scrubbing——一种域对抗训练方法，通过降低模型使用视觉捷径的可能性来增强其对语言信息的关注。
AI.result: 模型行为与action margin指标相关；视觉捷径一致地在早期层进入动作表征，不同模型在后期层借助语言信息纠正的程度不同；在仿真和真实世界、多种VLA与视觉线索的实验中，task scrubbing提升了分布外鲁棒性，并常常消除视觉捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: 视觉捷径学习在VLA中普遍存在且可用无需rollout的表征指标提前预测；通过域对抗式的task scrubbing可有效抑制捷径、强化语言条件，从而显著提升分布外泛化能力，为低成本缓解机器人学习中的捷径问题提供了可行路径。

title: Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation: On the Equivalence of Distribution Matching Distillation and Drifting Models
summary: Researchers are exploring effective one-step generative model continuously, and, Drifting Models (Deng et al., 2026), demonstrate great potential in one-step generation recently. There are works that reveal the connection between Diffusion & Flow Style Generative Models (DFSGMs) (Ho et al., 2020; Song et al., 2020a;b; Lipman et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022) and Drifting Models (Li & Zhu, 2026; Lai et al., 2026; Turan et al., 2026). But no one has yet established a precise correspondence between the Drifting Model and the widely used distillation method- Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD/DMD2) (Yin et al., 2024b;a) to the best of our knowledge, even though their optimization objective formulas are virtually identical. In this paper, we prove that by converting the velocity-field / noise-field from the pre-trained DFSGMs into the attraction force field in Drifting Models and estimating the repulsion force field from the generative distribution, training the Drifting Model is naturally equivalent to the Distribution Matching Distillation. With this equivalent concept, we propose an improved method based on DMD from the Drifting Model's perspective- Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD).

AI.tldr: 本文将漂移模型（Drifting Models）与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD/DMD2）建立了精确对应关系，并据此提出改进方法 MBDMD。
AI.motivation: 尽管漂移模型与 DMD/DMD2 的优化目标公式几乎相同，且已有工作揭示 DFSGMs 与漂移模型的联系，但尚无研究建立漂移模型与广泛使用的分布匹配蒸馏之间的精确对应，作者希望填补这一空白并从漂移模型视角改进 DMD。
AI.method: 论文证明：将预训练 DFSGMs 的速度场/噪声场转换为漂移模型中的吸引力场，并从生成分布估计排斥力场时，训练漂移模型天然等价于分布匹配蒸馏。基于该等价性，作者从漂移模型视角提出改进方法——多带宽分布匹配蒸馏（MBDMD）。
AI.result: 建立了漂移模型与分布匹配蒸馏之间的精确等价关系，并据此衍生出 MBDMD 这一改进方法。
AI.conclusion: 漂移模型训练可被视为分布匹配蒸馏的等价形式，这一等价概念为从漂移模型角度改进蒸馏方法提供了理论依据，进而催生了 MBDMD。

title: OmniDex: Scaling Dexterous Hand Grasping to Diverse Cluttered Scenes
summary: Dexterous grasping is the foundational primitive in embodied AI, demanding massive data to train robust models. As real-world data collection is expensive, simulation has become the mainstream paradigm. Yet, while cluttered scenes best reflect real-world applications, learning to grasp within them is bottlenecked by a critical scarcity of large-scale data. To resolve this, we curate high-quality 3D objects and supporting bases, proposing a scalable seed-and-filter strategy that bypasses sluggish scene-level optimization. This yields an unprecedented benchmark comprising over 2.6 million scenes and 0.4B scene-specific grasp ground truths, featuring diverse realistic layouts paired with rich semantic and geometric observations. Furthermore, we introduce the OmniDex model to overcome the grasp multimodality and last-millimeter precision errors plaguing current generative models. By coupling Soft Winner-Takes-All learning with human-inspired physical constraints during training, and utilizing physics-driven ranking, our approach achieves robust dexterous grasping without the latency of post-optimization. Experimental results show that OmniDex model achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization across diverse scenes, views, and unseen objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展的seed-and-filter策略，构建含260万+场景、4亿抓取真值的杂乱场景灵巧抓取基准，并提出OmniDex模型，通过Soft Winner-Takes-All学习与类人物理约束及物理驱动排序，实现无需后优化的鲁棒灵巧抓取，取得SOTA与强泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 灵巧抓取是具身智能的基础能力，需海量数据训练。真实数据采集昂贵，仿真成为主流；但杂乱场景虽最贴近现实应用，却因大规模数据稀缺而成为学习瓶颈。
