AI.method: 1) 整理高质量3D物体与支撑底座，提出可扩展的seed-and-filter策略，绕开缓慢的场景级优化，构建大规模杂乱场景基准；2) 提出OmniDex模型，训练中耦合Soft Winner-Takes-All学习与类人物理约束，并采用物理驱动排序，以应对抓取多模态与毫米级精度误差，且无需后优化延迟。
AI.result: 产出超260万场景、4亿场景专属抓取真值的基准，具备多样真实布局及丰富语义与几何观测；OmniDex在多种场景、视角与未见物体上达到SOTA性能并展现强泛化能力，同时避免了后优化延迟。
AI.conclusion: 通过大规模杂乱场景数据构建与兼具多模态建模和精确约束的生成模型，可有效突破灵巧抓取的数据瓶颈，实现鲁棒、高效且泛化性强的灵巧抓取。

title: How Firm Should a Grasp Be?
summary: An ideal robot grasp is firm enough to securely handle an object, yet gentle enough to avoid damaging it. Achieving this balance requires knowledge of the object's material properties, such as its mass, elasticity, and surface friction. These properties, however, are seldom precisely known a priori. In this work, we propose a visuotactile approach to estimating material properties in real time, during the process of grasping. Our method uses these estimated properties to determine the minimum grasp force required to handle the object. We contribute a new dataset of real-world objects (fruits and vegetables) with measured physical properties (shape, mass, elasticity, and friction), which we use to construct our force estimation model via simulations. We experimentally validate our approach to grasp force control using a robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. We demonstrate our system's ability to gently grasp a wide variety of objects, in each case adapting to their unique physical properties.

AI.tldr: 提出一种视觉-触觉融合方法，在抓取过程中实时估计物体的材质属性（质量、弹性、表面摩擦），据此计算最小抓取力，实现既牢固又轻柔的抓取，并通过平行夹爪机器人实验验证。
AI.motivation: 理想抓取需兼顾牢固与轻柔，避免损坏物体；但这依赖于物体的质量、弹性、表面摩擦等材质属性，而这些属性通常无法先验精确获知，因此需要在线实时估计。
AI.method: 采用视觉-触觉（visuotactile）方法，在抓取过程中实时估计材质属性；构建了包含真实物体（水果和蔬菜）的物理属性（形状、质量、弹性、摩擦）测量数据集，并基于仿真构建抓取力估计模型，用于确定最小所需抓取力。
AI.result: 在配备平行夹爪的机器人上进行了抓取力控制实验验证，系统能够轻柔抓取多种物体，并针对每个物体的独特物理属性进行自适应调整。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-触觉实时材质属性估计结合仿真构建的力模型，可实现自适应的最小力抓取控制，兼顾安全性与稳固性，适用于多样化真实物体。

title: Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?
summary: Small vision-language models may be able to read external evidence yet struggle to obtain it. We introduce Harness Compilation (HC), an offline procedure that adapts the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness. A large teacher uses student execution traces to revise reusable content and control, while a separate validation set selects the deployed harness. Deployment requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls. Across seven visual question-answering settings with students of at most 9B parameters, HC improves scores over bare students by 9.9-23.9 points, averaged over three independent builds per setting. Interventions on five runtime decision types (invocation, selection, argument generation, evidence integration and abstention) show why this allocation matters: requesting evidence and generating open queries can be costly, whereas bounded choices and reading supplied text can remain useful student work. Fact cards benefit all ten evaluated students, but decision policies transfer unevenly. Recompilation for a new student model helps when the transferred interface no longer fits the student. With 100 practice items, HC exceeds answer-only LoRA on three tasks. Larger training budgets can match or surpass a fixed harness, while combining the two improves SlideVQA beyond either alone. These findings support allocating work from measured student behavior rather than uniformly removing decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出 Harness Compilation (HC)：离线地用大模型教师依据小 VLM 的执行轨迹修订可复用的外部上下文与决策控制，并由独立验证集选择部署用 harness；无需权重更新与教师调用，在七个 VQA 设定上较裸学生模型提升 9.9–23.9 分。
AI.motivation: 小型视觉语言模型（≤9B）具备阅读外部证据的能力，却难以自主获取证据。既有做法常统一削减或固定学生的决策，未按学生实际行为分配工作。
AI.method: HC 为离线编译流程：冻结小 VLM 不变，大教师模型利用学生执行轨迹修订可复用的内容（如 fact cards）与控制策略（harness），另设验证集选择最终部署的 harness；部署阶段无需权重更新或教师调用。并以五类运行时决策（调用、选择、参数生成、证据整合、弃答）做干预分析。
AI.result: 七个 VQA 设定、学生≤9B、每个设定三次独立构建平均，较裸学生提升 9.9–23.9 分；干预显示请求证据与生成开放式查询代价高，而有界选择与阅读已提供文本仍适合学生；fact cards 对全部十个学生均有增益，但决策策略迁移不均；换新学生时重编译在有帮助；100 条练习样本下 HC 在三项任务上超过 answer-only LoRA；更大训练预算可追平或超过固定 harness，二者结合使 SlideVQA 超过任一单独方案。
AI.conclusion: 应按测得的学​​生行为来分配工作，而非一刀切地移除决策；小模型与外部 harness 的分工可通过离线编译有效优化，且内容增益比决策策略迁移更稳健。

title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Being-M0.7 潜在世界-动作模型，利用混合模态人类数据预训练，经机器人中期训练与动作后期训练，迁移视觉-运动先验至人形机器人控制，在 SIMPLE 基准取得最高总体成功率，并在真实 Unitree G1 任务上匹配最强基线。
AI.motivation: 人形移动操作需协调全身运动并预判场景演化，但机器人演示数据稀缺；人类视频与运动数据可规模化成监督来源，然而多为单一模态（仅有视频或仅有运动），缺乏成对视频-运动数据，且人类运动无法直接对应可执行的机器人动作。
AI.method: 构建超过 10,000 小时以人为中心的原始数据语料，融合纯视频、纯运动与成对视频-运动流，联合预测未来潜在视觉状态与运动，使视觉表征编码未来运动学。采用三阶段训练：预训练学习运动学结构与视觉动态先验；机器人中期训练将粗粒度先验适配至机器人视角与身体动力学；动作后期训练中通过门控交叉注意力，将冻结且已适配先验的视觉预测表征与当前图像、本体感知融合，输出可执行全身指令。
AI.result: 在 SIMPLE 基准上取得所比较基线中最高的总体成功率；在真实世界 Unitree G1 移动操作任务上与最强基线持平。
AI.conclusion: 混合模态人类数据的视觉-运动先验可通过潜在世界-动作建模有效迁移至人形全身控制，为数据稀缺下的人形移动操作学习提供可扩展路径。

title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
summary: In diffusion transformers, low-rank branches can mitigate 4-bit weight--activation (W4A4) post-training quantization (PTQ) loss by decomposing each weight into a low-bit residual and a high-precision low-rank component. Existing low-rank PTQ approaches, however, either optimize low-rank compensation and residual quantization separately, often requiring higher ranks, or rely on second-order weight updates without explicitly modeling activation quantization error, which becomes particularly pronounced under 4-bit quantization. To address these limitations, we present \method{}, a unified framework modeling low-rank-assisted W4A4 PTQ as a coupled calibration problem and deriving optimization-based solvers from the joint objective. Eliminating the output-side low-rank factor yields a \emph{deflated Hessian} that discounts residual errors already captured by the low-rank component, while an activation-noise surrogate is incorporated to suppress activation quantization error. Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 \method{} consistently outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant in PSNR and LPIPS. It further surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on SANA-1.6B, FLUX.1-schnell, and FLUX.1-dev with an $8\times$ smaller rank and up to $6.25\times$ faster quantization. Furthermore, on the Qwen3-8B LLM, rank-4 \method{} improves MMLU accuracy from 61.50\% to 68.17\% over rank-32 SVDQuant. Overall, \method{} achieves better W4A4 performance with substantially lower rank and quantization cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向扩散Transformer的W4A4后训练量化统一框架，将低秩辅助量化建模为耦合标定问题，通过"deflated Hessian"和激活噪声代理项联合优化，以极小秩实现优于高秩基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩PTQ方法将低秩补偿与残差量化分开优化，往往需要更高秩；或依赖二阶权重更新却未显式建模激活量化误差，而该误差在4-bit量化下尤为显著。
AI.method: 将低秩辅助的W4A4 PTQ建模为耦合标定问题，从联合目标推导基于优化的求解器：消去输出侧低秩因子得到"deflated Hessian"，对已被低秩分量捕获的残差误差进行折减；并引入激活噪声代理项以抑制激活量化误差。
AI.result: 在五个扩散骨干网络上，rank-4方法在PSNR和LPIPS上持续优于rank-4 SVDQuant；在SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell和FLUX.1-dev上以8倍更小的秩超过rank-32 SVDQuant，量化速度最高提升6.25倍；在Qwen3-8B LLM上MMLU准确率从61.50%提升至68.17%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以显著更低的秩和量化成本实现了更优的W4A4量化性能。

title: Bernoulli Flow Models: Self-Consistent Generative Modeling for Binary Data
summary: Binary diffusion models typically require a large number of function evaluations (NFEs) to generate high-quality samples, making practical inference computationally expensive. Reducing NFEs while preserving sample quality without distillation or additional training remains a significant challenge. Existing binary diffusion models define a discrete one-step forward path and then derive the reverse posterior. In low-NFE settings requiring cross-step sampling, they approximate the true multi-step likelihood with a single-step likelihood transition, which severely degrades sample quality. To address this fundamental limitation and decouple the generative dynamics from fixed discrete time steps, we propose Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM). Rather than relying on sequential one-step Markov diffusion chains, BFM defines a unified continuous global Bernoulli probability flow path between data distributions and pure noise, from which we derive analytical closed-form posterior transitions over arbitrary time intervals. Consequently, reducing the inference NFE is no longer an approximation based on skipping discrete steps; it only requires re-evaluating the analytical posterior over a new time grid. This eliminates the structural training-inference mismatch inherent to discrete chains and yields self-consistent low-NFE sampling. Experiments show that BFM is highly robust to aggressive NFE reduction. On LSUN Churches 256x256, a BFM trained with 256 steps achieves an FID of 9.22 using only 16 sampling steps, whereas the state-of-the-art discrete baseline degrades to 204.10. BFM also remains competitive with continuous and discrete generative baselines under standard full-step inference. These results establish BFM as a theoretically rigorous, self-consistent, and practically effective framework for fast binary data generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Bernoulli Flow Models（BFM），通过在数据分布与纯噪声之间定义统一的连续全局伯努利概率流路径，并推导任意时间区间的解析闭式后验转移，从而将低NFE采样从"跳步近似"转变为"在新时间网格上重估解析后验"，实现了自洽的低NFE生成。
AI.motivation: 二元扩散模型生成高质量样本通常需要大量函数评估（NFE），推理成本高昂；在不依赖蒸馏或额外训练的前提下降低NFE同时保持样本质量仍是难点。现有二元扩散模型定义离散单步前向路径再推导反向后验，在低NFE需跨步采样时，用单步似然转移近似真实多步似然，导致样本质量严重下降。作者希望解决这一根本局限，使生成动力学与固定离散时间步解耦。
AI.method: 提出Bernoulli Flow Models（BFM）。不再依赖序列化的单步马尔可夫扩散链，而是在数据分布与纯噪声之间定义统一的连续全局伯努利概率流路径，并由此推导任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验转移。因此，降低推理NFE不再是"跳过离散步"的近似，而只需在新的时间网格上重新评估解析后验，从而消除离散链固有的训练-推理结构不匹配，实现自洽的低NFE采样。
AI.result: BFM对激进的NFE削减具有高度鲁棒性。在LSUN Churches 256x256上，用256步训练的BFM仅用16步采样即达到FID 9.22，而最先进的离散基线退化至204.10。在标准全步推理下，BFM也与连续和离散生成基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: BFM是一个理论严谨、自洽且实用的快速二元数据生成框架。

title: CoPoE: Multimodal Fusion via Decomposable Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts for Missing-Modality Alzheimer's Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis benefits from integrating heterogeneous clinical, imaging, genomic, and biomarker evidence, but clinical cohorts frequently suffer from irregular modality missingness. Existing fusion methods often synthesize absent inputs, risking the introduction of artificial surrogates, or pool available signals into uninterpretable latent spaces. We present CoPoE (Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts), a disease-coordinate framework that maps multimodal evidence into a structured latent space partitioned into four distinct biological and clinical axes: genetic Risk, molecular Pathology, Neurodegeneration, and clinical Stage (R/P/N/S). Each observed modality parameterizes a diagonal Gaussian expert over the full RPNS vector, and a masked Product-of-Experts architecture fuses only the available modalities. Consequently, absent modalities add no factor to the fusion path, allowing the network to preserve a robust, decomposable posterior for any non-empty modality subset without synthetic imputation in the RPNS path. Through extensive missing-modality experiments on the ADNI dataset, CoPoE achieves the best all-modality performance and the highest mean AUROC across all 15 observed-subset evaluations among standardized missing-modality fusion baselines under a shared non-PET ADNI embedding benchmark, while substantially improving raw-probability ECE, Brier score, and NLL. Furthermore, PET-supervised probing shows evidence enrichment within the pathology (P) block under full modalities, with tau-related signal retained even when direct fluid biospecimen inputs are withheld. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/CoPoE.

AI.tldr: 提出CoPoE框架，将多模态AD诊断证据映射到由遗传风险(R)、分子病理(P)、神经退行(N)、临床分期(S)四轴组成的结构化潜空间，用掩码Product-of-Experts仅在可用模态上融合，无需合成填补即可处理任意模态缺失子集。
AI.motivation: 多模态阿尔茨海默病诊断需整合临床、影像、基因组和生物标志物等异质证据，但临床队列普遍存在不规则模态缺失。现有融合方法要么合成缺失输入（引入人工替代物风险），要么将可用信号池化到不可解释的隐空间。
AI.method: CoPoE（Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts）将多模态证据映射到划分为四个生物学/临床轴（遗传风险、分子病理、神经退行、临床分期，即RPNS）的结构化潜空间。每个观测模态对一个完整RPNS向量参数化一个对角高斯专家，掩码Product-of-Experts架构仅融合可用模态；缺失模态在融合路径中不添加因子，从而在无合成填补的RPNS路径下为任意非空模态子集保留稳健、可分解的后验。
AI.result: 在ADNI数据集的大量缺失模态实验中，于共享的非PET ADNI嵌入基准下，CoPoE在全模态性能最佳，且在所有15个观测子集评估中取得最高平均AUROC（优于标准化缺失模态融合基线），同时显著改善原始概率ECE、Brier分数和NLL。此外，PET监督探针显示全模态下病理(P)区块存在证据富集，即使不提供直接体液样本输入仍保留tau相关信号。
AI.conclusion: CoPoE通过疾病坐标化的Product-of-Experts融合，在无需合成填补的前提下实现了对任意模态缺失子集的稳健、可分解且可解释的多模态AD诊断，并在缺失模态鲁棒性、校准指标及病理通路证据保留方面均优于基线。

title: WAM-Cache: Staleness-Bounded KV Reuse for Efficient World Action Models
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://dingkai0302.github.io/wam-cache/
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable generalist robot manipulation by conditioning an action expert on representations from a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). In closed-loop control, the video DiT runs at every chunk to encode the current observation into layerwise key-value (KV) pairs that the action expert queries. This prefill dominates the per-chunk computational cost, yet existing training-free accelerations leave it fully dense. We present WAM-Cache, a training-free framework that retains layerwise key-value representations across chunks and recomputes only a sparse refresh set of tokens. Crucially, we find that the intuitive heuristic of refreshing visually drifted tokens plateaus far below the dense baseline, even with an oracle predicting ground-truth KV drift. Downstream action accuracy is instead governed by where the action expert attends, not by what moved. WAM-Cache therefore selects the refresh set by uniting the action expert's cross-attention with visual latent surprise, complemented by a strict age bound that suppresses compounding error. On Fast-WAM, WAM-Cache cuts video DiT prefill FLOPs by 32-42% across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world experiments, while staying within 0.7-1.8 percentage points of the dense policy in simulation and 2.5 points on a real robot.

AI.tldr: WAM-Cache 是一个免训练框架，通过跨 chunk 复用视频 DiT 的分层 KV 表示，仅稀疏刷新关键 token，将预填充 FLOPs 降低 32-42%。
AI.motivation: 在闭环机器人操控中，视频 DiT 每个 chunk 都需运行以编码当前观测为分层 KV 对，该预填充占据每 chunk 的主要计算开销，但现有免训练加速方法仍保持全稠密计算，效率提升有限。
AI.method: 保留跨 chunk 的分层 KV 表示，仅重算稀疏刷新集；发现"刷新视觉漂移 token"的直觉启发式效果远低于稠密基线，即便用 oracle 预测真实 KV 漂移也不行；转而依据动作专家的注意力位置选择刷新集，结合动作专家的交叉注意力与视觉潜变量 surprise，并加入严格年龄上界以抑制误差累积。
AI.result: 在 Fast-WAM 上，WAM-Cache 于 RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO 及真实世界实验中降低视频 DiT 预填充 FLOPs 32-42%，仿真中与稠密策略差距在 0.7-1.8 个百分点以内，真实机器人上为 2.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 下游动作精度由动作专家的注意力位置决定，而非视觉变化本身；据此设计的免训练缓存策略可在大幅降低计算的同时保持接近稠密基线的性能。

title: WARP-VLA: Wrist-Camera Adaptation for View-Robust Policy Execution in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Despite recent advances in Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) for robotic manipulation, their performance remains sensitive to changes in camera configuration. The problem becomes more evident in cross-setup deployment, as reproducing the exact camera pose used for training is nearly impossible. Unlike fixed external views, wrist views are more challenging because the camera moves with the robot, causing even small mounting variations to alter fine-grained geometric cues. To address this, we propose WARP-VLA, a camera-view robust VLA for diverse wrist camera configurations. WARP-VLA adopts a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture where individual experts learn view-specific feature transformations, and a router combines them based on implicit view information. This allows the policy to be deployed without requiring camera extrinsic parameters as additional input. Through experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, WARP-VLA improves the average success rate of pi-0.5 from 39.2% to 78.3% under wrist-view perturbations. The real-robot experiments further show that the feature-level adaptation learned in simulation successfully transfers to diverse deployment settings. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release our wrist viewpoint robustness benchmark and a plug-and-play implementation.

AI.tldr: 提出WARP-VLA，用MoE架构实现腕部视角鲁棒的视觉-语言-动作模型，无需相机外参即可部署。
AI.motivation: VLA模型对相机配置变化敏感，跨设置部署时难以复现训练相机位姿；腕部相机随机器人移动，微小安装差异即可改变细粒度几何线索，问题尤为严重。
AI.method: 采用混合专家（MoE）架构：各专家学习视角特定的特征变换，路由器基于隐式视角信息进行组合，从而无需将相机外参作为额外输入即可部署策略。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，腕部视角扰动下将pi-0.5的平均成功率从39.2%提升至78.3%；真实机器人实验表明仿真中习得的特征级自适应可成功迁移到多样部署环境。
AI.conclusion: WARP-VLA有效提升腕部视角配置下的鲁棒性，并发布腕部视角鲁棒性基准及即插即用实现以支持复现与后续研究。

title: CoCam4D: Geometry-Aware Cooperative 4D Perception for Camera-Only Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles often suffer from limited perception due to occlusions, blind spots, limited sensor range, and the complex nature of surrounding environments. Multi-agent collaborative perception (CP) addresses these challenges by allowing vehicles to share sensory information and reconstruct the scene cooperatively. However, camera-only perception remains fundamentally limited by the uncertainty of distance-dependent monocular depth estimation. We propose CoCam4D, a Bayesian framework for collaborative perception that explicitly models geometric uncertainty. It uses a VGGT-based feedforward network to generate 3D Gaussian scene representations with associated uncertainty estimates, enabling multiple vehicles or agents to efficiently combine their observations. By sharing compact Gaussian primitives, reliable observations from one agent can reduce the depth uncertainty of another without requiring LiDAR sensors. To support real-world deployment, we introduce Dynamic Object Primitives (DOPs), a compact 35-byte representation designed for efficient C-V2X communication. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method consistently outperforms recent vision-only methods, achieving improvements of 11.48% on OPV2V+ and 10.62% on DAIR-V2X-C, demonstrating the potential of geometrically grounded collaborative perception for LiDAR-free autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: CoCam4D是一个基于贝叶斯的纯视觉协同感知框架，通过VGGT生成带不确定性的3D高斯场景表示，并用35字节动态对象图元实现高效通信，在OPV2V+和DAIR-V2X-C上分别提升11.48%和10.62%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶的单车感知受限于遮挡、盲区、传感器范围及环境复杂性，多智能体协同感知可缓解这些问题；但纯相机方案受单目深度估计中随距离增长的不确定性制约，且在不依赖LiDAR的前提下难以保证几何可靠性，同时还需满足车联网通信的带宽约束。
AI.method: 提出CoCam4D，一个显式建模几何不确定性的贝叶斯协同感知框架：采用基于VGGT的前馈网络生成带不确定性估计的3D高斯场景表示，多车共享紧凑的高斯图元以融合观测，使某车可靠观测降低他车的深度不确定性；并设计面向C-V2X通信的35字节动态对象图元（DOPs）。
AI.result: 在OPV2V+和DAIR-V2X-C数据集上持续优于近期纯视觉方法，分别取得11.48%和10.62%的性能提升，验证了几何约束下的协同感知在无LiDAR自动驾驶中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: CoCam4D表明，通过不确定性感知的3D高斯表示与超紧凑通信图元，纯视觉协同感知可在不依赖LiDAR的条件下显著提升感知性能，为无LiDAR自动驾驶提供了可行路径。

title: Neural Networks for Temporal Pattern Recognition and Dynamic Arm Gesture Speed Estimation for Robot Control
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published in Proceedings of the Intelligent Robotics FAIR 2026 (IntRob '26), June 18-19, 2026, Budapest, Hungary, ACM
summary: Deploying intelligent robotic systems that interact with humans through gestures requires neural networks capable of recognizing diverse temporal patterns. We present a systematic benchmark of ten abstract sequential tasks--five permutation-invariant (set) and five order-dependent (sequence) problems--evaluated across eighteen neural network architectures spanning recurrent, convolutional, attention-based, and set-function families. Beyond the core architecture-task grid, we explore numerous preprocessing and target-variable transformations, yielding more than 250 distinct experimental configurations. All variants are trained and tested under strictly identical conditions (fixed random seeds, shared hyperparameters, shared data splits) to ensure fair and reproducible comparison. Ranking across all ten tasks reveals four consistently top-performing architectures--BiGRU, TCN, Conv1D, and GRUReLU--all compact enough for real-time deployment (under 2,000 parameters in the benchmark setting). Based on this ranking, we apply three architecturally diverse top models (BiGRU, TCN, and GRUReLU) to a practical robotics problem: estimating the execution speed of dynamic arm gestures from skeletal keypoint sequences. Three speed interpretations (peak count, period time, and mean spike spacing) are evaluated on a custom dataset of eight traffic-related gesture classes comprising 256,710 frames recorded via OpenPose. The best configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 0.198 on the peak-count interpretation, corresponding to roughly 5% relative error, while the period-time interpretation reaches approximately 4% relative error, and the mean spike spacing interpretation approximately 8% relative error. These results demonstrate that neural networks can reliably estimate gesture speed from skeletal data, opening a path toward speed-aware gesture-controlled robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文对18种神经网络架构在10个抽象序列任务上进行统一基准测试，筛选出BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D、GRUReLU四个最佳紧凑模型，并将其应用于基于骨骼关键点的动态手势速度估计，取得约4%–8%的相对误差。
AI.motivation: 手势交互机器人需要能识别多样时序模式的神经网络，但现有架构（循环、卷积、注意力、集合函数）缺乏在统一条件下、跨任务类型的公平对比，且手势速度估计这一实用能力尚未被系统验证。
AI.method: 构建含10个抽象顺序任务（5个置换不变的集合任务、5个顺序依赖的序列任务）的基准，覆盖循环、卷积、注意力及集合函数四类共18种架构；进一步引入多种预处理与目标变量变换，形成250余种实验配置。所有变体在固定随机种子、共享超参数与数据划分的严格相同条件下训练与测试。依据总体排名选取BiGRU、TCN、GRUReLU三个架构各异的最佳模型，用于从OpenPose提取的骨骼关键点序列估计动态手臂手势速度，评估峰值计数、周期时间、平均尖峰间隔三种速度解释。
AI.result: 排名显示BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D、GRUReLU四个架构表现一致最优，且参数均少于2000，适合实时部署。在自建数据集（8类交通相关手势、256,710帧、OpenPose采集）上，峰值计数解释取得平均绝对误差0.198（约5%相对误差），周期时间解释约4%相对误差，平均尖峰间隔解释约8%相对误差。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络可可靠地从骨骼数据估计手势速度，为速度感知的手势控制机器人系统提供了可行路径；同时，紧凑型架构在序列任务中兼具高性能与实时部署能力。

title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
summary: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MultiWorldBench，一个用于诊断多人世界模型的Minecraft基准，含495个案例配置、7个任务套件与10项能力。评测Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld并对比Engine GT，发现生成系统的多人一致性严重不足。
AI.motivation: 多人世界模型要求各自独立控制的视角必须与一个共享且持续存在的世界保持一致。然而，现有研究缺乏针对这一"多视角一致性"的系统性诊断手段，因此需要构建专门的基准来揭示生成系统在多人场景下的能力缺口。
AI.method: 构建MultiWorldBench诊断性Minecraft基准，包含495个案例配置，覆盖7个任务套件和10项能力，涵盖独立控制、跨视角运动、共享状态同步、持久性、结构推理、并发交互与延迟重访。评测Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld三个生成系统，并以Engine GT作为参考基准；同时引入人类偏好评测，与自动评测进行相关性分析。
AI.result: 十项能力平均分：Gamma-World最高（21.39），Solaris次之（20.88），MineWorld仅1.89，而Engine GT达91.69。Gamma-World在控制、共享状态与重访能力上表现较好；Solaris在跨视角运动与竞态条件一致性上领先。但所有生成系统在状态持久性上不超过8.00，在结构一致性上不超过1.33，且在空间推理与建筑身份保持上均无成功案例。人类偏好给出相同总体排名，与自动评测高度一致，维度级Spearman相关系数均值为0.96。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单个视角看起来合理并不等于构成了连贯的多人世界；现有生成式世界模型在多人共享状态、持久性与结构一致性方面仍存在根本性缺陷。

title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $Φ$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
summary: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $Φ$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $Φ$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. After integration and functional validation in the mission environment, early experiments on real $Φ$sat-2 acquisitions revealed a significant mismatch between simulated and in-orbit data. The pipeline was therefore retrained on real Level-1 imagery using an improved annotation strategy to better handle ambiguous marine regions, substantially enhancing performance. Beyond demonstrating the onboard feasibility of the application, the $Φ$sat-2 experience highlights the importance of robust annotation strategies and sensor-aware design, and shows that simulation-based development is valuable for pre-flight risk reduction, while reliable scientific validation requires representative in-orbit data and should be clearly distinguished from functional validation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在ESA Φsat-2任务上部署轻量级海洋异常检测流程的经验：涵盖开发、星上集成与在轨适应；因仿真数据与在轨数据存在显著差异，最终基于真实Level-1影像与改进标注策略重训模型，性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: 提升对地观测系统的响应速度与带宽效率，通过在卫星端直接处理数据实现星上人工智能；同时验证海洋异常检测应用在资源受限星载硬件上的可行性，并厘清仿真开发与在轨科学验证之间的区别。
AI.method: 构建轻量级海洋异常检测流程，包含海陆分割、海洋区域自监督特征编码、基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测，以及可选的异常类型表征。发射前使用Φsat-2仿真影像训练和验证，评估算法性能与硬件兼容性；集成和功能验证后，在真实在轨采集数据上进行早期实验，并用改进标注策略在真实Level-1影像上重训模型。
AI.result: 在轨早期实验发现仿真数据与真实在轨数据之间存在显著不匹配；采用改进标注策略并基于真实Level-1影像重训后，性能得到大幅提升；验证了该应用在星上部署的可行性。
AI.conclusion: Φsat-2经验表明：稳健的标注策略和传感器感知设计至关重要；基于仿真的开发有助于降低飞行前风险；可靠的科学验证需要具有代表性的在轨数据，并应与功能验证明确区分。

title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

AI.tldr: Memento 3 让冻结的 LLM 智能体通过外部记忆持续学习显式世界模型，用可修订的自然语言规则手册及其编译代码进行预测与规划，在 ARC-AGI-3 与 Atari Pong 上取得显著成效。
AI.motivation: 智能体在陌生环境中需要推断世界运行机制并随新证据修正理解，但有限观测往往对应多个可解释历史却对未来预测分歧的世界模型，因此需要一种能持续学习、保持可修订性的显式世界模型构建方式。
AI.method: 采用外部记忆机制：智能体维护自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录关于环境动态的可修订假设并保留未知部分的不确定性；将规则手册编译为可执行代码用于预测与规划；通过观察、反思、规则修订、编译与验证的持续循环，利用预测误差同时优化规则手册与代码。代码更新仅在 LLM 判断其忠实于规则手册且单元精确回放能复现观测转移时被接受。扩展版本维护多个并行世界模型，共享交互证据并以预测引导探索。
AI.result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的每一关，平均相对人类动作效率（RHAE）达 100.0，仅使用人类动作数的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例中，学得的反馈控制器在三次不同开局评估中各以 21:0 获胜，且无需进一步调用 LLM。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将上述过程作为基于模型的递归自我改进（RSI）路径加以研究：在底层 LLM 保持固定的前提下，智能体自主探索环境、修订世界模型，并用经验证的更新指导后续交互与学习，验证了冻结 LLM 下持续世界模型学习的有效性。

title: A Minimal Optical-Flow Representation for Vision-Based Tactile Rotation Classification in Robotic Manipulation Across Gravity Domains
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors provide rich contact information, but processing high-resolution images can be costly for resource-constrained platforms such as space robots. This work investigates whether a compact representation of tactile motion can classify object rotation across different gravity conditions. Dense optical flow from a simulated GelSight Mini is aggregated over a 7x9 grid into 126 features and used to classify the direction of load-induced rotation under Earth, Mars, Moon, and orbital gravity. Gravity causes a small but significant shift in these features, accounting for 1.6% of their variance (R2 = 0.016). Despite its small magnitude, this shift affects models trained only on Earth data: XGBoost accuracy decreases from 94.4% on Earth to 75.9% in orbit. In contrast, a single model trained across all four gravity domains achieves 96.3% overall accuracy and 95.1%-97.0% across individual domains, without using gravity as an input. The representation can also be reduced to 40 features while retaining 95.7% accuracy, with XGBoost requiring only 0.14 ms per inference. These findings show that Earth-gravity performance alone is insufficient to establish the transferability of tactile perception for space robotic manipulation, highlighting the need to account for gravity-induced domain shifts during training and validation.

AI.tldr: 本文将模拟GelSight Mini的稠密光流聚合成7x9网格的126维紧凑表示，用于跨重力条件分类负载引起的物体旋转方向；地球数据训练模型在轨道重力下精度从94.4%降至75.9%，而四重力域联合训练模型达96.3%总体精度，且可压缩至40维并保持95.7%精度。
AI.motivation: 视触觉传感器能提供丰富接触信息，但高分辨率图像处理对空间机器人等资源受限平台代价高昂。作者希望验证：触觉运动的紧凑表示能否在不同重力条件（地球、火星、月球、轨道）下稳健地完成物体旋转方向分类，并探讨仅依赖地球重力数据评估触觉感知可迁移性是否充分。
AI.method: 从模拟的GelSight Mini获取稠密光流，在7x9网格上聚合成126维特征，用于分类负载诱导旋转的方向，涵盖地球、火星、月球与轨道四种重力。对比仅用地球数据训练的XGBoost与四重力域联合训练的单一模型；并通过特征降维与推理耗时评估紧凑性，训练中不使用重力作为输入。
AI.result: 重力对特征造成小幅但显著的偏移，仅解释1.6%的方差（R2=0.016）。该偏移虽小，却使仅用地球数据训练的模型性能下降：XGBoost在地球上准确率94.4%，在轨道重力下降至75.9%。相反，跨四重力域训练的单一模型总体准确率达96.3%，各域为95.1%-97.0%。特征可压缩至40维仍保持95.7%准确率，XGBoost单次推理仅需0.14 ms。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭地球重力下的性能不足以证明触觉感知在空间机器人操作中的可迁移性；重力引起的域偏移需要在训练与验证阶段加以考虑，而跨重力域联合训练的紧凑触觉运动表示可实现高精度且低延迟的旋转分类。

title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.

AI.tldr: 提出"数据空间迭代"少步生成框架，摒弃流离散化，在数据空间直接精炼预测，性能优于标准离散化基线。
AI.motivation: 流匹配采样需大量网络评估，蒸馏可降至一步或少步，但一步生成质量损失大，少步生成成为实际选择。现有少步方法沿概率流迭代，依赖人工选取且代价高昂的时间步离散化，启发式设定且难以调优，当样本或空间位置的精炼难度不同时还具局限性。
AI.method: 提出数据空间迭代框架：从噪声出发，共享生成器在数据空间直接精炼其预测，每次迭代都被训练以产生其容量所允许的最佳样本，从而完全去除流离散化。该形式与分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）以极小改动集成，在匹配训练设置下可实现迭代方法的可控对比。
AI.result: 在类别条件ImageNet 256x256上，数据空间迭代优于标准离散化基线，并匹配或超越通过调度搜索选出的变体，且无需调度专属训练。
AI.conclusion: 数据空间迭代为快速生成提供了一种简单有效的替代方案，可取代离散化流空间迭代。

title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
summary: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

AI.tldr: SuperNav 让预训练 MLLM 专注于请求理解、场景理解与决策，将运动执行交给导航工具，无需导航微调即可在陌生环境中完成多样化导航任务。
AI.motivation: 通用服务机器人需要同时具备任务通用性与场景通用性的导航系统，而现有微调 MLLM 预测导航动作的方法依赖训练数据覆盖，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 为预训练 MLLM 配备专用 agent harness，包含导航技能、面向智能体的物理交互工具、任务进度与上下文管理；并通过统一视觉点接口让模型直接在图像中指定目标并依据执行反馈修正决策。
AI.result: 在实例级、多物体和需求驱动任务上优于四个基线；在 HM3D 上的类别级评估及真实四足机器人部署验证了跨环境适用性。
AI.conclusion: 将决策与运动执行解耦、保留 MLLM 通用能力，是实现可泛化机器人导航的有效途径。

title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
summary: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

AI.tldr: JWS 是一种单阶段端到端扩散模型，直接在雷达空间进行概率降水临近预报，结合掩码异步扩散与评分规则目标，实现少步生成，在 SEVIR 和 MeteoNet 上达到 SOTA 且训练与推理成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有概率降水临近预报的扩散方法通常依赖独立训练的有损压缩模块或确定性预报组件，且迭代去噪导致推理成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出 JWS：单阶段端到端扩散模型，直接在雷达空间建模以简化训练推理并消除压缩不确定性；采用 Masked Asynchronous Diffusion 时间步采样方案，在适配高维时空数据的同时保留干净上下文；配合简单评分规则目标，使训练与概率预报对齐并支持少步生成。
AI.result: 在 SEVIR 与 MeteoNet 基准上取得最先进的概率预报性能，同时降低训练与推理成本；最小模型在参数量大幅减少的情况下仍具竞争力，推理速度提升超过 17 倍。
AI.conclusion: 直接在雷达空间进行端到端扩散建模并引入评分规则目标，可同时提升概率预报精度与效率，为低成本、少步生成的概率临近预报提供有效范式。

title: HANS: A Handwritten Answer Sheet Dataset for Noisy Hybrid Document Parsing
summary: Intelligent grading and automated scoring technologies constitute critical infrastructure for smart education. However, existing document parsing and handwriting recognition benchmarks are predominantly designed for well-structured printed documents or isolated mathematical expressions, lacking datasets that capture the complex characteristics inherent to student answer sheets, including multi-line derivation processes, heterogeneous mixtures of text and mathematical formulae, and noise artifacts such as strikethroughs. To address this gap, we introduce HANS, the first dataset explicitly constructed for real-world educational scenarios, encompassing mathematical expressions, natural language text, hand-drawn tables, and diverse noise patterns including corrections and deletions, accompanied by fine-grained annotations that establish a reliable foundation for robust recognition research. Building upon HANS, we propose NA-GOT, an end-to-end framework that achieves two-stage noise suppression through a lightweight noise suppression module operating at the feature level, complemented by a noiseaware attention mechanism incorporated into the decoding stage. Experimental results demonstrate that HANS poses substantial challenges to existing methods, while NA-GOT achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and stability for answer process recognition. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向真实教育场景的手写答题过程数据集HANS，并基于此提出两阶段噪声抑制框架NA-GOT，显著提升含噪答案过程识别的准确性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 智能阅卷与自动评分是智慧教育的关键基础设施，但现有文档解析与手写识别基准多面向结构良好的印刷文档或孤立数学表达式，缺乏能刻画学生答题纸复杂特性的数据集，如多行推导过程、文本与公式异质混排、删除线等噪声。因此需要构建真实教育场景数据集并提升噪声鲁棒识别能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建HANS数据集：首个面向真实教育场景的数据集，涵盖数学表达式、自然语言文本、手绘表格及涂改、删除等多样噪声模式，并配有细粒度标注；2) 提出NA-GOT端到端框架：通过特征级轻量噪声抑制模块实现第一阶段噪声抑制，并在解码阶段引入噪声感知注意力机制实现第二阶段噪声抑制，形成两阶段噪声抑制方案。
AI.result: 实验结果表明HANS对现有方法构成显著挑战，而NA-GOT在答案过程识别的准确率与稳定性上均取得显著提升。数据集将在论文发表后公开。
AI.conclusion: HANS填补了真实教育场景手写答题过程识别数据的空白，NA-GOT验证了特征级与解码级两阶段噪声抑制的有效性，为鲁棒手写识别研究提供了数据基础与方法参考。

title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.

AI.tldr: 提出 Code-Only-as-Policy（COAP）新范式：将具身世界视为图灵机，用纯代码测量与跟踪状态并完成决策，无需在控制回路中保留 VLM/VLA。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人策略普遍在控制回路中保留模型（VLA 或 Agent Harness 运行时查询 VLM），带来延迟、成本与不可控性。作者认为若状态可被准确表征，决策可完全用代码表达。
AI.method: COAP 由代码从相机图像与本体感受测量并跟踪机器人、环境与任务状态，据此做出全部决策；同一代码跨 episode 复用，不同任务共享同一代码库，回路中不含 VLM 或 VLA。
AI.result: 在 RoboDojo 的 42 个双臂任务上，所得代码库在测试时无模型参与的情况下达到 70.24% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: COAP 具备显式状态、可控执行与可扩展性三大优势，适合作为递归自我改进（RSI）的媒介；其上限取决于状态表征精度与代码逻辑鲁棒性，并可兼作 VLA 与 Agent Harness 的高效数据引擎。

title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.

AI.tldr: 提出LeWAM：一种基于无解码器JEPA潜空间的双向Transformer世界动作模型，端到端训练前向、反向、逆动力学与策略四种预测模式，在表征对齐、闭环控制与规划性能上均优于重建式WAM。
AI.motivation: 传统世界动作模型（WAM）基于重建式表征预测动作与未来观测，但该类表征包含噪声与冗余信息，会干扰下游预测任务；同时需要探索既能充当世界模型又能直接用于策略执行的统一架构。
AI.method: LeWAM采用无解码器的JEPA潜空间，通过全部四种模式（前向、反向、逆动力学、策略预测）端到端训练一个双向Transformer。在规划阶段，对比直接在原始动作空间采样（易被MPC利用动力学模型误差）与在策略头的噪声空间中进行规划两种方式。
AI.result: 1）对齐：线性探针从LeWAM潜空间中读取机器人与物体状态的效果优于常规Le World Model（仅前向的JEPA世界模型），且对视觉干扰物的忽略程度与LeWM相当，远优于重建式WAM。2）执行：闭环评估中LeWAM与相同编码器、相同规模训练的流匹配策略性能相当，同时额外提供世界模型能力。3）规划：在策略头噪声空间中规划可提升WAM闭环性能，而直接采样原始动作会因动力学模型不准确而被MPC利用，导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: LeWAM证明了在无解码器JEPA潜空间上联合训练多种预测模式，可同时获得高质量表征、竞争性闭环策略与可利用的规划能力；规划时应在策略头噪声空间而非原始动作空间进行采样。

title: BrickBench: Evaluating Agentic Brick Design
summary: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BrickBench 基准与 BrickAgent 环境，用于评估智能体根据文本提示设计可物理搭建的乐高模型的能力，并揭示当前顶尖智能体在物理与语义合规性上表现良好但设计质量不及人类设计者。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体研究缺乏对"文本驱动的可物理实现积木设计"这一任务的系统评估；该任务要求智能体在离散零件库中选件，并同时满足局部与全局约束，兼具语义、设计和物理可搭建性。
AI.method: 提出 BrickBench 基准：给定文本提示，智能体需从离散零件库中选择零件并生成装配方案，联合推理局部与全局约束；在三种不同规模与零件可用性设置下评估有效性、对齐度与设计质量。同时提供 BrickAgent 环境，供编码智能体构建、检查和验证其设计。
AI.result: 领先智能体在很大程度上能够满足可验证的物理与语义要求，但在设计质量上仍不及人类设计方案。
AI.conclusion: BrickBench 与 BrickAgent 为智能体式文本条件积木设计提供了标准化评估平台，表明当前智能体在物理与语义合规性方面已较成熟，但在创造性设计层面仍有明显提升空间。基准与环境已公开于 http://www.brickben.ch。

title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
summary: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. Training such a model on existing robot datasets faces two obstacles: imprecise calibration can impair action following, while limited coverage of unsuccessful interactions can bias predictions toward successful outcomes. To improve action following across embodiments, we render action trajectories into image-space conditions and introduce offline geometric calibration to align these conditions with the target videos. To broaden interaction coverage, we introduce counterfactual post-training, modifying recorded action trajectories and generating future videos under a wider range of actions and contact configurations. To provide feedback on these predictions without paired ground-truth futures, we construct a human-annotated video dataset covering robot, object, and interaction defects and use it to train an embodied video reward model. Its scores guide reinforcement-learning post-training toward more physically plausible interaction outcomes. On AgiBot, DreamTrue attains state-of-the-art action following, while reducing the human-assessed interaction defect rate from from 48.12% to 6.25%. Notably, our model ranks first in the world model track of the AgiBot World Challenge 2026. The project page can be found at https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue.

AI.tldr: DreamTrue 是一个多视角、跨本体的机器人世界模型，可实现动作忠实且物理合理的视频预测，在 AgiBot 上达到SOTA动作跟随并将人工评估的交互缺陷率从48.12%降至6.25%。
AI.motivation: 在现有机器人数据集上训练世界模型面临两大障碍：一是标定不精确会削弱动作跟随能力；二是数据中对失败交互的覆盖不足，会使预测偏向成功结果。
AI.method: 1) 将动作轨迹渲染为图像空间条件，并引入离线几何标定使条件与目标视频对齐，以提升跨本体的动作跟随；2) 提出反事实后训练，通过修改已记录动作轨迹，在更广泛的动作与接触配置下生成未来视频，扩大交互覆盖；3) 构建覆盖机器人、物体与交互缺陷的人工标注视频数据集，训练具身视频奖励模型，在缺乏成对真值未来视频的情况下为预测提供反馈，并用其分数引导强化学习后训练，以获得更物理合理的交互结果。
AI.result: 在 AgiBot 上，DreamTrue 达到SOTA的动作跟随性能，并将人工评估的交互缺陷率从48.12%降低到6.25%；在 AgiBot World Challenge 2026 世界模型赛道中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 通过图像空间动作条件与几何标定、反事实后训练及具身视频奖励模型引导的强化学习后训练，DreamTrue 在多视角、跨本体机器人世界模型上显著提升了动作忠实性与物理合理性，并取得领先性能。

title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
summary: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.

AI.tldr: Dex-One2Many是一个real-to-sim-to-real框架，通过将单个人类视频抽象为序列化场景图来引导强化学习，从而学习可泛化的灵巧操作策略，并在仿真中训练后零样本迁移到真实多指手。
AI.motivation: 从单个人类视频学习灵巧操作可替代昂贵的机器人示教，但现有方法多局限于模仿演示动作，难以泛化到视频中未出现的初始物体位姿、目标位姿和抓取方式；而纯强化学习虽泛化性强，却在无先验引导时面临高维探索困难，尤其在复杂多阶段任务中。因此需同时解决泛化与探索这对耦合难题。
AI.method: 提出Dex-One2Many框架：核心思想是将视频抽象为序列化场景图，用以引导RL。场景图作为生成式约束用于采样多样化的重置状态，并为每个阶段提供密集奖励。由于图约束的是关系而非精确位姿，采样的重置状态可覆盖视频之外的物体位姿与抓取；同时从这些状态初始化各阶段并用密集奖励引导，使探索过程短且有方向。策略完全在仿真中训练。
AI.result: 在五个工具使用与操作任务上，Dex-One2Many在已见配置中超越基线6.5%；在未见场景中，其鲁棒的泛化能力使领先优势扩大至71%。
AI.conclusion: 将单个人类视频结构化为序列场景图，可在保持广泛泛化性的同时实现高效引导探索，训练于仿真的策略能零样本迁移至真实多指手，在泛化场景下显著优于基线。

title: Teaching a Robot Dog New Tricks: Diverse Quadruped Skills via Combined Reinforcement and Imitation Learning with Adversarial Task Selection
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled legged robots to perform a range of skills in single-task settings. However, applications such as farm robotics or space exploration require diverse skills such as locomotion, digging, or close-range surveying. Training an end-to-end policy to address this problem remains difficult due to challenges such as sample inefficiency and gradient conflict between tasks in multi-task learning. We propose a three-stage method that trains a single policy to perform distinct tasks such as walking, digging, and hopping, and compose them into novel behaviors such as crawling. First, multiple teacher policies are trained using RL on narrowly defined tasks. Then, two additional stages train a student policy with a multi-teacher distillation setup that uses a combined RL and Imitation Learning (IL) objective under an adversarial task selection process that focuses training on the worst-performing task. With this method, we train a student policy that performs 22 tasks using 8 teachers. Evaluations show our method preserves motion quality and tracks commands more accurately than PPO and distill-then-finetune baselines, and in some cases generalizes to new tasks without explicit training. Finally, we demonstrate real-world robustness by deploying the resulting policy on a Unitree B1 quadruped. Video: https://youtu.be/V9yX04EBcFA

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段多教师蒸馏方法，用8个教师策略训练单一学生策略完成22项腿式机器人任务，性能优于PPO和distill-then-finetune基线，并在Unitree B1上实现真机部署。
AI.motivation: 农业机器人和太空探索等场景需要行走、挖掘、近距离勘察等多样技能，但端到端多任务策略训练面临样本效率低和任务间梯度冲突的难题。
AI.method: 三阶段流程：先用RL训练多个窄任务教师策略；再通过多教师蒸馏训练学生策略，采用RL与IL联合目标，并在对抗式任务选择机制下将训练集中于表现最差的任务；最终将技能组合成爬行等新行为。
AI.result: 用8个教师策略训练出完成22项任务的学生策略，运动质量和指令跟踪精度优于PPO与distill-then-finetune基线，部分新任务无需显式训练即可泛化，并在Unitree B1四足机器人上验证了实机鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 多教师蒸馏结合对抗任务选择可有效缓解多任务学习中的梯度冲突，实现单一策略的多技能学习与新行为组合，并具备真实机器人部署能力。

title: TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception
summary: Hair stroking is common in daily grooming and personal care, and is also widely used in hair-product evaluation, motivating robots with similar physical interaction capabilities. Existing robotic hair-care and surface-following methods mainly rely on trajectory planning, compliance, force regulation, or tactile-conditioned policies, but deformable hair can remain in contact while gradually drifting across the end-effector, making local interaction difficult to regulate. We propose TacHair, a tactile contact-distribution guided online correction framework that represents high-resolution tactile observations as a spatial hair-contact distribution. A visuotactile imitation policy generates the nominal stroking motion, while a separately trained residual module corrects local contact deviations, separating task progression from contact recovery. We evaluate TacHair in 525 real-robot trials across five head geometries and three hair conditions. A successful stroke requires both sufficient task progression and contact maintenance; our method improves success from 42.9% to 62.3% and contact maintenance from 59.4% to 88.0% over the same visuotactile policy without correction. These results demonstrate spatial tactile contact distributions as an effective feedback representation for contact-preserving interaction with deformable and visually occluded surfaces. Demos, code, and datasets are available at https://tachair.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 TacHair，以高分辨率触觉的“毛发接触空间分布”为反馈表示，通过视觉触觉模仿策略生成标称梳理动作，并用独立训练的残差模块在线修正局部接触偏差，实现可变形毛发上的接触保持操作。
AI.motivation: 毛发梳理在个人护理与毛发产品评测中很常见，需要机器人具备类似物理交互能力。现有机器人护发/曲面跟随方法依赖轨迹规划、柔顺控制、力调节或触觉条件策略，但可变形毛发易在保持接触的同时逐渐相对末端执行器漂移，导致局部交互难以调控。
AI.method: TacHair 框架：将高分辨率触觉观测表示为空间毛发接触分布；由视觉触觉模仿策略生成标称梳理运动；另设独立训练的残差模块修正局部接触偏差，从而将任务推进与接触恢复解耦。
AI.result: 在 525 次真机试验中，覆盖五种头部几何与三种毛发条件；成功标准需同时满足充分任务推进与接触保持。相比无修正的同一视觉触觉策略，成功率由 42.9% 提升至 62.3%，接触保持率由 59.4% 提升至 88.0%。
AI.conclusion: 空间触觉接触分布是一种有效的反馈表示，可用于对可变形且视觉遮挡表面的接触保持交互；相关演示、代码与数据集已公开。

title: Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search
summary: Generative motion planners typically use learned trajectory priors for initial generation, while leaving test-time repair to local continuous refinement. We introduce Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends the learned prior from efficient parallel generation to structural repair. A masked generative transformer generates discrete trajectory candidates in parallel, and Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) uses scene geometry to target where to edit and which prior-supported alternatives to evaluate. This turns refinement into an efficient search over discrete motion alternatives, enabling route-level restructuring beyond local trajectory deformation. MGMP achieves 96% success on Ring Maze and 82% repair success on Controlled Route Invalidation on Kuka, exceeding the strongest external baselines by 23 and 25 percentage points, respectively. It further generalizes to unseen layouts, additional obstacles, unseen geometries, single- and dual-arm planning, and real-world Baxter tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出MGMP，用掩码生成式Transformer并行生成离散轨迹，并用几何引导的token搜索进行结构级修复，实现远超基线的运动规划效果。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式运动规划器通常仅用学习到的轨迹先验做初始生成，测试时修复依赖局部连续细化，难以进行路线级结构调整，修复能力受限。
AI.method: MGMP：掩码生成式Transformer并行生成离散轨迹候选；Geometry-Guided Token Search（GGTS）利用场景几何决定编辑位置及评估哪些先验支持的替代方案，将修复转化为离散运动备选的高效搜索。
AI.result: Ring Maze成功率达96%；Kuka Controlled Route Invalidation修复成功率达82%，分别超最强外部基线23和25个百分点；并可泛化到未见布局、额外障碍、未见几何、单/双臂规划及真实Baxter任务。
AI.conclusion: 将学习先验从并行生成扩展到结构修复，把连续细化转为离散运动备选搜索，可实现超出局部形变的路线级重构，显著提升规划与修复性能并具备良好泛化性。

title: TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perception
summary: Navigation in vision-denied environments is challenging for humanoid robots because proprioceptive odometry drifts and localization uncertainty accumulates rapidly. We present TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework that enables humanoid navigation toward a goal by actively probing surrounding structures without relying on vision. TAPNAV maintains a pose belief from odometry, IMU, and tactile contact observations, and couples uncertainty-aware global route planning with information-gain-driven local probing. The global planner searches for routes that keep predicted localization uncertainty bounded by exploiting opportunities for tactile correction, while the local planner selects probe actions that maximize expected information gain. A whole-body controller coordinates the humanoid's locomotion and end-effector contact to execute the planned navigation and probe motions. We evaluate TAPNAV in simulation and on a Unitree G1 across different floor plans and obstacle geometries. TAPNAV achieves lower state estimation error and a higher task completion rate than baselines. These results demonstrate that actively planning physical interactions with the environment can provide localization cues for reliable humanoid navigation without vision.

AI.tldr: 提出TAPNAV，一种触觉主动感知框架，使类人机器人在无视觉环境中通过主动触摸周围结构实现导航。
AI.motivation: 无视觉环境下类人机器人导航困难，因为本体感受里程计漂移、定位不确定性快速累积。
AI.method: 基于里程计、IMU与触觉接触观测维护位姿信念；耦合不确定性感知的全局路径规划与信息增益驱动的局部探测；全局规划器寻找使预测定位不确定性有界的路径，利用触觉校正机会，局部规划器选择最大化期望信息增益的探测动作；全身控制器协调运动与末端接触以执行导航和探测动作。
AI.result: 在仿真及Unitree G1机器人上针对不同户型与障碍几何进行评测，相比基线实现更低的状态估计误差和更高的任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: 主动规划与环境的物理交互可为无视觉下可靠的类人机器人导航提供定位线索。

title: Same Action, Different Outcome: Variability in Dynamic Cloth Manipulation
summary: Although cloth is known to exhibit different outcomes under repeated fast dynamic motions, even when the same trajectory is applied, this variability has not yet been systematically characterized. Quantifying it is essential to assess the reliability of learned manipulation policies and the extent to which simulation can reproduce real-world behavior. To study this, we execute the same trajectory ten times across four dynamic tasks, two of which are novel, each tested with three cloths of very different properties and at up to three execution speeds, with a total of 269 recorded rollouts. For all of them, we record small marker positions on the cloth and synchronized stereo camera. We then formalize different metrics to quantify variability, and our results show how it is significant in every test condition, in most cases one to three orders of magnitude above the repeatability inherent to the robot and sensing noise. Our results also show variability is driven mainly by the cloth physical properties but also grows with speed. By replaying all the rollouts in four calibrated modern cloth simulators, we show that none of them can reproduce the variability magnitude we observed in real cloth, nor its ordering. Together with our analysis, we publish the dataset with synchronized OptiTrack, vision and robot logs and their corresponding simulator twins.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统量化了布料在重复快速动态操作中的变异性，发现其显著高于机器人及传感噪声，主要由布料物理属性驱动并随速度增长，且现有四种主流布料仿真器均无法复现真实布料的变异性幅度与排序。作者公开了含同步动捕、视觉与机器人日志及仿真对照的数据集。
AI.motivation: 尽管布料在重复快速动态运动下即使轨迹相同也会呈现不同结果，但这种变异性尚未被系统刻画。量化该变异性对于评估学习到的操作策略的可靠性，以及判断仿真能在多大程度上复现真实世界行为至关重要。
AI.method: 在四项动态任务（其中两项为新任务）中，对每块布料执行相同轨迹10次，使用三种性质差异显著的布料和最多三种执行速度，共记录269次 rollout；在每个 rollout 中记录布料上的小标记点位置与同步立体相机数据。随后形式化定义多种变异性度量指标。进一步将全部 rollout 在四个经过标定的现代布料仿真器中回放，对比真实与仿真表现。
AI.result: 在所有测试条件下变异性均显著存在，多数情况下比机器人自身重复性和传感噪声高1至3个数量级；变异性主要由布料物理属性驱动，并随执行速度增大。四个仿真器均无法复现真实布料观察到的变异性幅度，也无法复现其排序。
AI.conclusion: 真实布料在动态操作中具有不可忽略且系统性的变异性，现有布料仿真器尚不足以复现该特性，这削弱了仿真到真实迁移与策略可靠性评估的可信度。作者发布了包含同步 OptiTrack、视觉与机器人日志及其对应仿真孪生的数据集，为后续研究提供基准。

title: Diagnosing and Recovering from Observation-Space Shift at Long-Horizon Skill Seams
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation is often built by chaining independently trained skills. Although each skill can be reliable in isolation, performance degrades sharply when skills are chained: each downstream skill must start from the state its predecessor leaves behind rather than from its training distribution. We study this failure mode, Observation-Space Shift (OSS), and ask what causes these skill-seam failures. Using privileged simulator resets, we find that the dominant shift comes from displaced scene state (e.g., an open drawer or secondary objects left behind by earlier skills), not from the robot's joint configuration or the object the downstream skill manipulates. To test this diagnosis, we build a fully learned detect-restore-resume system: a task-progress monitor detects the stall, a learned policy restores the displaced scene components, and seam-robust fine-tuning lets the skill resume. It recovers the seam where every tested alternative fails, which we treat as evidence for the diagnosis rather than as a general-purpose method. On the BOSS-44 benchmark, the system improves full-chain success from 7.6% to 26.5%, a 3.5x improvement over the base policy and 51% of a privileged restoration oracle, whereas best-of-K resampling, a Diffusion Policy, and world-model baselines fail to recover from the evaluated seam states. On a real Franka arm running a fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy, the same monitor is limited by exterior-camera observability, yet closing the loop still recovers some otherwise-terminal failures, motivating wrist and gripper sensing. These results suggest that some long-horizon composition failures are better addressed by restoring the scene before resuming the policy than by retrying from an off-support state.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长程机器人操作中"技能拼接"失败的主导原因，提出观测空间漂移（OSS）诊断，并构建检测-恢复-续行系统，在BOSS-44上把全链成功率从7.6%提升到26.5%。
AI.motivation: 长程操作通常由独立训练的技能串联而成，单技能可靠，但串联后性能急剧下降。原因是下游技能必须从前序技能留下的状态出发，而非其训练分布。作者希望弄清这种"技能接缝"失败究竟由何种状态漂移主导。
AI.method: 借助仿真器特权重置进行控制变量分析，定位漂移来源；据此构建全学习式"检测-恢复-续行"系统：任务进度监视器检测停滞，学习策略恢复被移位的场景部件，接缝鲁棒微调使技能得以续行。并在BOSS-44基准和真实Franka机械臂（微调π0.5策略）上验证。
AI.result: 主导漂移来自被移位的场景状态（如拉开的抽屉、前序技能遗留的次级物体），而非机器人关节构型或下游技能所操作的目标物体。系统在BOSS-44上将全链成功率由7.6%提升至26.5%（相对基策略3.5倍，达到特权恢复oracle的51%）；而best-of-K重采样、Diffusion Policy与世界模型基线均无法从所评估的接缝状态恢复。真机上监视器受外部相机可观测性限制，但闭环仍挽回部分原本终止的失败，提示需引入腕部与夹爪传感。
AI.conclusion: 部分长程组合失败更适合在续行策略之前先恢复场景，而非从分布外状态盲目重试。

title: Skill-SLM: Agent Skill-driven Small Language Models for Reliable Robot Operation
summary: Small language models (SLMs) have been increasingly adopted for onboard robot operation because they enable intelligent decision-making. However, existing approaches are mainly distillation-oriented and rely on enumerating representative task-solution pairs. This makes dataset construction difficult and limits generalization to diverse robot tasks whose possible forms grow rapidly. This paper proposes Skill-SLM, a framework that reformulates SLM-driven robot operation as a task-decomposition and skill-composition problem. Given a natural language task instruction, Skill-SLM decomposes the task into subtasks, selects appropriate skills from the skill library, and orchestrates the selected skills into executable robot operations. First, to support the skill-driven workflow, we propose a novel robot operational skill aware context-free grammar (CFG) to extract the skills required to accomplish tasks and build the skill library accordingly. Then, we configure LLM teachers to induce and synthesize training datasets for the SLMs, enabling SLMs to decompose tasks and orchestrate skills reliably. Additionally, we employ a progressive skill orchestration strategy to improve the reliability of skill implementation and overall robot operation. Experiments on UAV operation tasks indicate that Skill-SLM substantially outperforms distillation-oriented baselines, especially on unseen tasks that require generalization of capabilities. Additional experiments on ground vehicle tasks further demonstrate that Skill-SLM can be applied to different robot platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Skill-SLM框架，将SLM驱动的机器人操作重构为任务分解与技能组合问题，通过技能感知CFG构建技能库、LLM教师合成训练数据、渐进式技能编排策略，在无人机任务上显著优于蒸馏基线，并可迁移至地面车辆。
AI.motivation: 现有SLM机器人操作方案以蒸馏为主，依赖枚举代表性任务-解决方案对，导致数据集构建困难，且难以泛化到形态快速增长的多样化机器人任务。
AI.method: 提出Skill-SLM：给定自然语言指令，将任务分解为子任务，从技能库中选择技能并编排为可执行机器人操作。首先设计机器人操作技能感知的上下文无关文法（CFG）以抽取任务所需技能并构建技能库；然后配置LLM教师归纳并合成SLM训练数据集，使SLM可靠地完成任务分解与技能编排；并采用渐进式技能编排策略提升技能执行与整体操作的可靠性。
AI.result: 无人机操作任务实验中，Skill-SLM显著优于蒸馏导向基线，尤其在需要能力泛化的未见任务上；地面车辆任务实验进一步证明可应用于不同机器人平台。
AI.conclusion: Skill-SLM通过任务分解与技能组合范式，缓解了蒸馏方法的数据集构建与泛化瓶颈，具备跨平台适用性。

title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
summary: The diversity of robot embodiments and action spaces makes it challenging to build robot world models that generalize across different embodiments. We introduce the Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model (LAC-WM), which operates within a learned unified latent action space shared across diverse embodiments. This unified action space improves the world model's performance when adapted to previously unseen robot embodiments. We compare LAC-WM with an Explicit Action-Conditioned World Model (EAC-WM), which conditions on explicit motion labels. Our results show that explicit action conditioning leads to disjoint action representations across embodiments, limiting downstream performance when adapting to new robots. We evaluate both models on dexterous manipulation tasks and a modified LIBERO benchmark. LAC-WM improves downstream performance over EAC-WM by up to 46.7% on dexterous manipulation and 11.7% on LIBERO. Crucially, the unified latent action space allows LAC-WM's downstream performance to scale positively with the number of embodiments used during pretraining. In contrast, the disjoint action space in EAC-WM leads to decreased performance as the number of pretraining embodiments increases. These results highlight the importance of a unified action space for efficient cross-embodiment learning, addressing a key challenge in robotics. Project website: https://lacwm.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出LAC-WM，通过学习跨具身的统一潜在动作空间构建机器人世界模型，在灵巧操作任务上比显式动作条件的EAC-WM性能提升最高46.7%，在LIBERO上提升11.7%，并随预训练具身数量增加而正向扩展。
AI.motivation: 机器人具身形态与动作空间高度多样，导致世界模型难以跨具身泛化。核心挑战在于不同具身的动作表示彼此不兼容，阻碍知识迁移。
AI.method: 提出Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model（LAC-WM），在跨多种具身共享的学习型统一潜在动作空间中运行；与基于显式运动标签的Explicit Action-Conditioned World Model（EAC-WM）对比。在灵巧操作任务与改进的LIBERO基准上评估。
AI.result: LAC-WM较EAC-WM在灵巧操作上下游性能最高提升46.7%，在LIBERO上提升11.7%。统一潜在动作空间使LAC-WM下游性能随预训练具身数量增加而正向扩展；而EAC-WM的离散动作空间随预训练具身数量增加性能反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 统一动作空间对高效的跨具身学习至关重要，可有效应对机器人领域的关键挑战。显式动作条件导致的跨具身动作表示割裂会限制迁移性能。

title: OmniHOI: Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction from Monocular Human Video
comment: The project page is available at https://hydrofoooil.github.io/OmniHOI/
summary: Monocular videos of human manipulation provide abundant dexterous demonstrations, yet reconstructing hand-object interaction from a single view and transferring it to robot hands remain difficult, limiting their direct use for robot execution. Prior methods either require task-specific RL training, limiting scalability, or assume clean motion-capture trajectories and thus cannot operate directly on video. We present OmniHOI, a pipeline that turns an RGB video of hand-object interaction into an interaction-faithful trajectory on dexterous hands. The key idea is to enforce physical consistency using the evidence available at each stage: image evidence during reconstruction, contact geometry during retargeting, and dynamics during physics-in-the-loop refinement. Each stage optimizes the corresponding representation directly, correcting errors before they propagate downstream or must be absorbed by a learned policy. Across 150 motion-capture trajectories transferred to each of five dexterous hands with 6 to 22 DoF, we achieve 39-89% success, compared with at most 31% for prior transfer methods. On 60 monocular video clips, we achieve 53% success, compared with 28% for the best prior video-to-robot pipeline. Its trajectories also execute on a real bimanual robot across diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: OmniHOI 将单目RGB人手操作视频转化为灵巧手上的保交互轨迹，通过分阶段物理一致性约束实现视频到机器人的直接迁移。
AI.motivation: 人类操作的单目视频蕴含丰富灵巧演示，但从单视角重建手-物交互并迁移到机器人手仍很困难，限制了其直接用于机器人执行。现有方法要么需要任务特定的强化学习训练、可扩展性差，要么假设干净的动捕轨迹而无法直接处理视频。
AI.method: 提出 OmniHOI 流水线，将手-物交互RGB视频转换为灵巧手上保交互的轨迹。核心思想是在各阶段利用可获得证据强制物理一致性：重建阶段用图像证据，重定向阶段用接触几何，物理闭环精修阶段用动力学。每个阶段直接优化对应表示，在下游误差传播前或被学习策略吸收前予以纠正。
AI.result: 在150条动捕轨迹迁移到5种灵巧手（6至22自由度）上，成功率为39-89%，而先前迁移方法最高仅31%。在60个单目视频片段上成功率为53%，最佳先前进视频到机器人流水线为28%。其轨迹还在真实双臂机器人上跨多种任务执行成功。
AI.conclusion: 通过分阶段、基于证据的物理一致性优化，OmniHOI 显著优于现有迁移与视频到机器人方法，并可直接在真实双臂机器人上执行多样任务。

title: Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification
summary: Sampling-based system identification estimates physically meaningful parameters by tuning a simulator to reproduce the target system dynamics, providing an interpretable approach to improving sim-to-real transfer. Yet when the collected trajectories do not distinguish the effects of different parameters, multiple parameter combinations can reproduce those trajectories, leading to unreliable parameter estimates. To address this challenge, we introduce an Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design framework (IDTD), which formulates the objective for the exploration policy built on the Schur complement score derived from the Fisher information matrix. To faithfully reflect parameter separability in the exploration objective, IDTD normalizes the score against the per-parameter information, selects the most favorable trajectory segment for each parameter, and aggregates the resulting scores logarithmically. The optimized trajectory is therefore composed of complementary intervals, each exposing a distinct subset of parameters whose contribution to the motion over that interval can be attributed unambiguously. Across diverse simulation environments, ranging from a linear-dynamics system to the Go2 quadruped, G1 humanoid, and Crazyflie quadrotor, IDTD reduces the parameter identification error by 39.6% on average relative to the strongest prior active-exploration baseline and attains improved downstream policy transfer. Furthermore, we validate the proposed trajectory design on a real K1 humanoid, demonstrating that the resulting identified parameters accurately capture the real-system dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息解耦轨迹设计框架（IDTD），基于Fisher信息矩阵的Schur补得分构建探索策略目标，通过归一化、最优分段选择与对数聚合，生成由互补区间组成的轨迹，从而提升可辨识性，平均降低参数辨识误差39.6%。
AI.motivation: 基于采样的系统辨识通过调节仿真器复现目标系统动力学来估计具有物理意义的参数，具有可解释性并有助于提升sim-to-real迁移效果。但当采集的轨迹无法区分不同参数的影响时，多组参数组合都能复现这些轨迹，导致参数估计不可靠。核心问题在于轨迹对参数的可辨识性/可分性不足。
AI.method: 提出信息解耦轨迹设计框架（IDTD）：以Fisher信息矩阵导出的Schur补得分为基础，构建探索策略的目标函数；为使探索目标真实反映参数可分性，对得分按各参数的信息量进行归一化，为每个参数选择最有利的轨迹片段，并对所得得分进行对数聚合。优化后的轨迹由互补区间组成，每个区间仅暴露一个明确的参数子集，使其对该区间运动的贡献可被无歧义地归因。
AI.result: 在多样仿真环境中（从线性动力学系统到Go2四足、G1人形和Crazyflie四旋翼），IDTD相对最强的先前主动探索基线平均降低参数辨识误差39.6%，并获得更好的下游策略迁移效果。此外，在真实K1人形机器人上验证了该轨迹设计，辨识出的参数能准确刻画真实系统动力学。
AI.conclusion: IDTD通过信息解耦的轨迹设计有效缓解参数不可辨识问题，显著降低辨识误差并改善策略迁移，且在真实平台上验证了其有效性与可迁移性。

title: Higher-Order Morphology Priors for Quadruped Reinforcement Learning Under Actuator Degradation
summary: Actuator degradation turns quadruped locomotion into a coordination problem requiring joints to compensate for lost actuation. Prior work suggests that morphology-aware graph policies improve learning and generalization under body perturbations. We ask whether these benefits can be strengthened by explicitly modeling higher-order mechanical structure. We represent the Unitree Go1 as a cell complex with limb- and body-level rank-2 cells and apply Hodge-based message passing. Under degradation training, the node-edge-face Hodge actor achieves the highest return on unseen actuator degradations, with higher survival and lower velocity-tracking error. These results support higher-order morphology as a useful inductive bias for whole-body compensation under actuator degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文将Unitree Go1建模为胞腔复形（含肢体级与躯干级rank-2胞腔），采用Hodge消息传递构建"节点-边-面"策略，在退化训练下对未见执行器退化取得最高回报、更高存活率与更低速度跟踪误差。
AI.motivation: 执行器退化使四足运动变为协调问题，关节需补偿失去的驱动力。已有工作表明形态感知图策略能提升身体扰动下的学习与泛化，作者进一步追问：显式建模高阶力学结构能否强化这一收益。
AI.method: 将Unitree Go1表示为胞腔复形，包含肢体级与躯干级的rank-2胞腔，并施加基于Hodge理论的Hodge消息传递，从而构建节点-边-面（node-edge-face）的Hodge actor策略；在退化训练设置下进行学习与评估。
AI.result: 在退化训练下，节点-边-面Hodge actor在未见过的执行器退化上取得最高回报，同时具有更高的存活率和更低的速度跟踪误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将高阶形态作为归纳偏置，在执行器退化情形下有助于实现全身协调补偿。

title: iAm.md: Robot Skill Self-Assessment through Agentic Introspection for Unknown Open-Vocabulary Domains
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the 13th Italian Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Robotics (AIRO 2026). Project page: https://yurimachine.github.io/iAm.md/
summary: Agentic AI based on Large Language Model generalization capabilities offers a wide range of potential applications, including planning for embodied tasks. For example, embodied agents based on Foundation models can generate plausible plans in autonomous robotics scenarios. Due to limited context windows or hallucinatory phenomena in the next-token prediction formulation, behaviors may be generated without establishing whether the deployed robot and the observed environment actually support the requested operation, in what we call a "grounding failure". Thanks to the recent improvements in reasoning capabilities of foundation models, autonomous robot behavior generation problem can be formulated as a code generation problem. We present iAm.md, a Markdown standard and generation framework, that allows anchoring this process in complementary forms of deployment evidence. Through open-vocabulary semantic mapping, we combine local vision-language detections and object segmentation and refer them to persistent object records in this intermediate standardized representation, allowing agentic introspection. We then study this new technique on a simulated TIAGo, on navigation-and-manipulation tasks, showing how this standardized representation jointly supports skill self-assessment and executable task generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 iAm.md——一种 Markdown 标准与生成框架，通过开放词汇语义建图将视觉-语言检测与目标分割结果锚定到持久化对象记录的中间标准化表示中，使具身智能体在代码生成式行为生成中实现可执行性与自省，并在仿真 TIAGo 的导航与操作任务上验证了技能自评估与任务泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型泛化能力的智能体（agentic AI）可用于具身任务规划，但受限于有限上下文窗口与下一 token 预测范式中的幻觉现象，生成的行为可能未验证机器人本体与所观测环境是否真正支持该操作，导致所谓"grounding failure"（落地失败/接地失败）。随着基础模型推理能力提升，自主机器人行为生成可被建模为代码生成问题，因此需要一种能将生成过程锚定在部署证据上的表示框架。
AI.method: 提出 iAm.md，一种 Markdown 标准与生成框架，用互补形式的部署证据锚定该过程。方法上通过开放词汇语义建图，将局部视觉-语言检测结果与目标分割结果结合，并将其关联（refer）到该中间标准化表示中的持久化对象记录，从而支持智能体的自省（agentic introspection）。
AI.result: 在仿真 TIAGo 平台上就导航与操作任务开展研究，表明该标准化表示能够联合支持技能自评估（skill self-assessment）与可执行任务泛化（executable task generalization）。
AI.conclusion: iAm.md 作为标准化中间表示与生成框架，可缓解具身智能体行为生成中的落地失败问题，并同时服务于技能自评估与可执行任务泛化。

title: ActiveReg: Information-Driven Active Regional Probing for Partial-to-Full Bone Registration
summary: Accurate bone registration is essential for orthopedic surgical navigation and robotic assistance. In a common workflow, the surgeon needs to identify and probe a number of prescribed locations on the exposed bone surface to obtain data points for registration, which can be difficult and time-consuming under limited surgical exposure. Reducing the number of required points while providing clear probing guidance would ease the surgeon's acquisition task intra-operatively. We present ActiveReg, a closed-loop framework that recommends probing regions rather than individual points, allowing flexibility in the exact contact location. A D-optimal planner that takes into account the already acquired points and the uncertainty of current registration information helps achieve accurate registration with fewer points. An online assessment combines pre-update innovation consistency with uncertainty at predefined surgical task locations improves the reliability of completion decision, without requiring ground truth. Simulations across four anatomical scenarios demonstrated that ActiveReg can achieve competitive accuracy compared with baseline registration methods while using substantially fewer acquired points. Real phantom experiments with optical and electromagnetic tracking demonstrated comparable mean target registration error to the Gradient-SDF framework, using only 24-28 acquired points instead of 771-1263.

AI.tldr: ActiveReg 是一种闭环骨配准框架，通过推荐"探测区域"而非单点，结合 D-最优规划与在线评估，在显著减少采集点数的情况下实现竞争性配准精度。
AI.motivation: 骨科手术导航与机器人辅助中，骨配准精度至关重要。传统流程要求术者在有限显露的骨面上逐点探测多个预设位置以获取配准数据点，操作困难且耗时。因此，需要在提供清晰探测引导的前提下减少所需点数，以降低术中采集负担。
AI.method: 提出 ActiveReg 闭环框架：1）推荐探测区域而非单个点，允许接触位置灵活；2）采用 D-最优规划器，同时考虑已获取点与当前配准信息的不确定性；3）在线评估将更新前的新息一致性与预设手术任务位置处的不确定性相结合，在无需真值的情况下提高完成决策的可靠性。
AI.result: 在四个解剖场景的仿真中，ActiveReg 在采集点数显著更少的情况下达到与基线配准方法相当甚至具竞争力的精度。在光学与电磁跟踪的真实体模实验中，其平均目标配准误差（TRE）与 Gradient-SDF 框架相当，但仅需 24-28 个采集点，而非 771-1263 个。
AI.conclusion: ActiveReg 通过区域式推荐、D-最优规划与无真值在线评估，实现了高精度、低点数、高可靠完成判定的骨配准，验证了其在减少术中采集负担方面的有效性与实用性。

title: A Reconfigurable Fabric Based Pneumatic Actuator with Button Fastened Constraint Modules for Multi Mode Actuation
summary: Soft pneumatic actuators are widely used in soft robotics. However, their actuation modes are typically fixed by internal chamber designs or reinforcements, making post fabrication reconfiguration difficult. This paper presents a reconfigurable fabric-based pneumatic actuator that enables rapid, tool free, and reusable switching among multiple actuation modes by attaching constraint fabric modules to a buttoned textile sleeve. By rearranging low-stretch constraint parts on a single actuator body, the proposed system realizes four actuation modes isotropic expansion, contraction, bending, and twisting without redesigning or disassembling the actuator.We further introduce an attachable capacitive fabric-based tactile sensor module that can be mounted at arbitrary locations on the actuator surface for task dependent contact sensing. Experiments demonstrated an elongation ratio of 1.2, a maximum bending angle of approximately 60 degrees, and a twisting angle of approximately 90 degrees at 24 kPa, while achieving blocking forces exceeding 10 N across all modes. The tactile sensor exhibited a monotonic, force-dependent increase in capacitance with low hysteresis (approximately 12%) and stable cyclic responses under preload. Finally, we constructed soft robotic arms composed of multiple actuators and demonstrated in situ motion reconfiguration for grasping by changing the attached constraint patterns. These results indicate that the proposed modular constraint and sensing framework improves the functional adaptability of fabric-based soft robots while preserving a simple, robust actuator structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可重构织物基气动驱动器，通过按钮式织物套筒上附加约束织物模块，实现无工具、可重复的多种驱动模式快速切换，并集成了可贴附的电容式织物触觉传感器。
AI.motivation: 传统软体气动驱动器的驱动模式通常由内部腔体设计或加强结构固定，制成后难以重构，缺乏任务适应性。
AI.method: 采用按钮式织物套筒与低拉伸约束织物模块的模块化组合，通过重新排布约束部件实现各向同性膨胀、收缩、弯曲和扭转四种驱动模式；并引入可安装于驱动器表面任意位置的贴附式电容织物触觉传感器。
AI.result: 在24 kPa下，伸长率为1.2，最大弯曲角约60度，扭转角约90度，各模式下阻塞力均超过10 N；触觉传感器电容随力单调增加，迟滞低（约12%），在预载下具有稳定的循环响应；由多个驱动器构成的软体机械臂可实现抓取动作的原地运动重构。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的模块化约束与传感框架在保持驱动器结构简单、鲁棒的同时，提升了织物基软体机器人的功能适应性。

title: Towards Path-Creative Navigation: Robot Navigation through Embodied Interaction
summary: Autonomous navigation in cluttered and constrained environments typically assumes a fixed environment and searches only for paths within existing free space. However, a route can be blocked by an articulated structure, a movable object, or a pedestrian, and reaching the goal may therefore require appropriate embodied interaction with the environment. This paper formulates Path-Creative Navigation (PCN), a navigation paradigm in which the robot recovers free space by coordinating locomotion and embodied interaction, and addresses one class of PCN tasks with a mapless framework. The vision-LiDAR-odometry framework integrates local observations, obstacle geometry, and robot-state estimates through a unified navigation system, providing stable semantic and geometric information for navigation and interaction. The traversability-aware decision method utilizes visual and LiDAR distance information to determine whether a blockage is actionable and whether it can be safely bypassed, enabling the robot to interact only when necessary while supporting articulated structure pushing, movable object pushing, obstacle avoidance, and pedestrian requests. We design simulation scenarios and evaluate different methods in both simulation and two real-world tasks that cannot be completed by conventional navigation alone without embodied interaction. These results demonstrate that our framework achieves higher task completion than the baseline methods by coordinating navigation and interaction in cluttered and constrained environments. Code is available at:{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/path-creative-navigation/}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"路径创造式导航"(PCN)新范式，机器人通过协调移动与具身交互恢复自由空间，并给出一种无地图框架实现该类任务。
AI.motivation: 传统杂乱受限环境下的自主导航假设环境固定、仅在已有自由空间中寻路；但路径可能被铰接结构、可移动物体或行人阻塞，到达目标需要与环境进行具身交互，现有方法无法应对。
