AI.method: 提出视觉-激光雷达-里程计融合框架，通过统一导航系统整合局部观测、障碍物几何与机器人状态估计，提供稳定的语义与几何信息；并提出可通行性感知决策方法，利用视觉与LiDAR距离信息判断阻塞是否可操作、能否安全绕行，仅在必要时交互。
AI.result: 设计了仿真场景，在仿真与两个真实世界任务中评估不同方法；这些任务仅靠传统导航无法完成。结果表明该框架在杂乱受限环境中通过协调导航与交互，任务完成率高于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 协调导航与具身交互可有效提升杂乱受限环境下的任务完成能力，PCN范式及其无地图框架为该问题提供了可行解决方案，代码已开源。

title: FOCUS: From Privileged States to RGB-D with Controlled Modality Switching and Representation Alignment
summary: Vision-based reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation is sample-inefficient because RGB-D observations are high-dimensional and noisy. Privileged state information available in simulation can accelerate training, but its absence at test time creates a train-test modality gap. We propose FOCUS, a single-stage PPO framework that trains the critic on privileged state while automatically regulating whether the actor collects rollouts from RGB-D or privileged-state latents. Regulation is driven by the KL divergence between the action distributions induced by the two modalities, while representation alignment encourages consistent action selection across them. Together, these mechanisms limit RGB-D rollouts when the actor's action distributions from RGB-D and privileged-state latents disagree. As they align, RGB-D exposure increases, shifting on-policy training toward the RGB-D inputs used at test time. Across five manipulation tasks, FOCUS raises average test success from 0.71 to 0.93 relative to the strongest RGB-D-at-test baseline on each task. When accounting for each method's complete training pipeline, budget-normalized training-success AUC increases from 0.47 to 0.65. On Pick-and-Place, test success rises from 0.47 to 0.86, while AUC increases from 0.12 to 0.61, a 5.0x improvement in learning efficiency over the fixed interaction budget.

AI.tldr: FOCUS是一个单阶段PPO框架，使用特权状态训练critic，并通过KL散度自动调节actor的rollout来源（RGB-D或特权状态潜变量），以缓解视觉强化学习的训练-测试模态差距。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的机器人操作强化学习因RGB-D观测高维且含噪而样本效率低；仿真中的特权状态虽可加速训练，但测试时不可得，导致训练-测试模态差距。
AI.method: 提出单阶段PPO框架FOCUS：critic用特权状态训练；以两种模态诱导的动作分布间的KL散度驱动调节机制，决定actor从RGB-D还是特权状态潜变量收集rollout；同时用表征对齐促进跨模态动作选择一致性。当两种潜变量的动作分布不一致时限制RGB-D rollout，随对齐程度提高而增加RGB-D暴露，使on-policy训练逐步转向测试时使用的RGB-D输入。
AI.result: 在五个操作任务上，相比各任务最强"测试时用RGB-D"基线，平均测试成功率从0.71提升至0.93；计入完整训练流程后，预算归一化训练-成功AUC从0.47提升至0.65。在Pick-and-Place上，测试成功率从0.47升至0.86，AUC从0.12升至0.61，在固定交互预算下学习效率提升5.0倍。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS通过KL散度驱动的rollout来源调节与跨模态表征对齐，有效弥合特权状态训练与RGB-D测试之间的模态差距，显著提升测试成功率与样本效率。

title: Distributed Relative Localization Based on Ultra-WideBand and LiDAR for Multi-robot with Limited Communication
comment: This paper has been published in IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
summary: Relative localization is crucial for a multi-robot system to collaboratively perform tasks, such as exploration and formation. However, this is highly challenging for homogeneous robots with similar appearance in GPS-denied and communication-limited environments. In this paper, we propose a fully distributed relative position estimation approach for a team of robots based on onboard UWB and LiDAR sensors, in which LiDAR is utilized to obtain the position of anonymous objects in Line-of-Sight (LOS), and UWB is used for ranging between robots. We construct two graphs, namely UWB connection graph and LiDAR connection graph, to represent the spatial relationship among objects (robots and obstacles) based on UWB and LiDAR measurements. Identification and relative position estimation are formulated as a common subgraph matching problem. A falsely-matched robot identification approach is designed to recognize the falsely-matched results caused by obstacle blockage in LiDAR field of view. These robots are then localized by leveraging the well-matched robots and the UWB ranging measurements in the UWB connection graph. We conducted experiments to evaluate the performance of our approach. The results show that the proposed approach is capable of achieving satisfactory positioning accuracy for a team of robots in a distributed manner with only exchanging limited information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于机载UWB与LiDAR的全分布式相对定位方法，将机器人识别与相对位置估计建模为公共子图匹配问题，并设计误匹配识别策略处理LiDAR视场遮挡，实现仅交换有限信息下的高精度分布式定位。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统协同执行探索、编队等任务依赖相对定位，但在GPS拒止且通信受限环境中，外观相似的同构机器人难以区分，相对定位极具挑战性。
AI.method: 利用LiDAR获取视距内匿名目标位置，UWB用于机器人间测距；构建UWB连接图与LiDAR连接图表征目标（机器人与障碍物）间空间关系；将识别与相对位置估计建模为公共子图匹配问题；设计误匹配机器人识别方法，检测LiDAR视场中因障碍遮挡导致的误匹配；利用匹配成功的机器人与UWB连接图中的测距测量对被误匹配机器人进行定位。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法在分布式方式下仅交换有限信息即可为机器人团队实现令人满意的定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 基于UWB与LiDAR的图匹配框架能够有效解决同构机器人在GPS拒止、通信受限环境下的相对定位问题，且具备分布式与低通信开销特性。

title: PMTRM: Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module for Embodied Policy Learning
summary: Robotic manipulation often contains repeated motions whose local observations look similar at different phases. When these phases require different actions, a policy that relies mainly on the current observation may repeat completed motions or switch phases at the wrong time. To address this phase ambiguity, we present the Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module (PMTRM), a lightweight plug-in module with only 7.61M parameters that encodes a bounded history of executed states and actions into a latent sequence for existing policies. To help distinguish phases, a temporal heterogeneity objective penalizes positive similarity between distant positions in this sequence, while anchor and reconstruction losses preserve information needed for action prediction. The reconstruction decoder is used only during training, leaving the temporal re-encoder to supply history to the policy at inference. We train the module progressively on synthetic sequences and robot data, then jointly with the policy, using temporal masking to accommodate partial histories. This integration retains the original action head and action space and adds auxiliary losses to the original policy loss. Experiments with multiple policy backbones in simulation and on a real robot show improved task success on tasks with phase ambiguity, with little additional computation.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量即插即用模块PMTRM（7.61M参数），将有限历史的状态-动作序列重编码为潜在序列来缓解机器人操作中的阶段歧义，配合时间异质性、锚点与重构损失训练，在仿真与真机上提升多策略骨架的任务成功率且计算开销小。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作存在重复动作，不同阶段的局部观测相似；当各阶段所需动作不同时，仅依赖当前观测的策略会重复已完成动作或错误切换阶段，即"阶段歧义"问题。
AI.method: 设计PMTRM即插即用模块，将有限长度的已执行状态与动作历史编码为潜在序列注入现有策略；采用时间异质性目标惩罚序列中远距离位置间的正相似度以区分阶段，并用锚点损失和重构损失保留动作预测所需信息；重构解码器仅用于训练，推理时仅由时间重编码器向策略提供历史。训练分阶段进行：先在合成序列与机器人数据上渐进训练，再与策略联合训练，并用时间掩码处理不完整历史；集成时保留原动作头与动作空间，仅在原策略损失上增加辅助损失。
AI.result: 在多种策略骨架下于仿真和真实机器人上实验，在具有阶段歧义的任务上任务成功率提升，附加计算量很小。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模历史时序信息并对阶段表示施加异质性约束，可有效缓解阶段歧义，且以轻量插件形式兼容现有策略，兼顾性能与效率。

title: Higher-Order Action Supervision Makes A Strong Policy Class
summary: Modern data-driven decision-making methods, such as imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL), have achieved great success in solving many complex tasks. However, these methods often suffer from serious control instability and robustness issues when applied in real-world applications such as robotics and autonomous driving, posing notable challenges for their practical deployment. We argue that this instability issue stems largely from their limitations in solely supervising and optimizing zeroth-order actions (i.e., the action labels), failing to account for higher-order action dynamics and temporal consistency. In this paper, we show that simultaneously supervising both zeroth- and first-order actions can dramatically enhance policies' performance and control robustness. To achieve this, we introduce a novel and elegant loss scheme supported by formal theoretical guarantees that can equip any off-the-shelf policy model (e.g., deterministic, stochastic, or flow policies) with the capability for higher-order action supervision, without requiring any structural modifications. Moreover, our proposed method can serve as a lightweight plug-and-play module that seamlessly integrates with a broad spectrum of existing offline RL frameworks. Extensive evaluations on OGBench and D4RL demonstrate that our approach yields substantial performance and robustness improvements across a wide range of continuous control environments. Notably, our method can also enhance policies' out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability in the challenging low-data regime, making it an ideal tool in tackling many real-world control problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅需改进损失函数的高阶动作监督方案，可即插即用地增强离线模仿学习与强化学习策略的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动决策方法（IL、RL）在机器人、自动驾驶等真实场景中存在严重的控制不稳定与鲁棒性问题，作者认为根源在于仅对零阶动作（动作标签）进行监督与优化，忽略了高阶动作动力学与时间一致性。
AI.method: 提出一种新的损失方案，同时监督零阶与一阶动作；该方案具有理论保证，无需结构修改即可为任意现成策略模型（确定性、随机、flow 策略）赋予高阶动作监督能力，并可作为轻量级即插即用模块集成到多种离线 RL 框架。
AI.result: 在 OGBench 和 D4RL 的广泛连续控制环境中取得显著的性能与鲁棒性提升；在低数据场景下还能增强策略的分布外（OOD）泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 同时监督零阶与一阶动作可显著提升策略性能与控制鲁棒性，所提方法通用、即插即用，适合应对真实世界控制问题。

title: Demonstrating Arena 5.0: A Photorealistic ROS2 Simulation Framework for Developing and Benchmarking Social Navigation
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures. Published at Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2025
summary: Building upon the foundations laid by our previous work, this paper introduces Arena 5.0, the fifth iteration of our framework for robotics social navigation development and benchmarking. Arena 5.0 provides three main contributions: 1) The complete integration of NVIDIA Isaac Gym, enabling photorealistic simulations and more efficient training. It seamlessly incorporates Isaac Gym into the Arena platform, allowing the use of existing modules such as randomized environment generation, evaluation tools, ROS2 support, and the integration of planners, robot models, and APIs within Isaac Gym. 2) A comprehensive benchmark of state-of-the-art social navigation strategies, evaluated on a diverse set of generated and customized worlds and scenarios of varying difficulty levels. These benchmarks provide a detailed assessment of navigation planners using a wide range of social navigation metrics. 3) Extensive scenario generation and task planning modules for improved and customizable generation of social navigation scenarios, such as emergency and rescue situations. The platform's performance was evaluated by generating the aforementioned benchmark and through a comprehensive user study, demonstrating significant improvements in usability and efficiency compared to previous versions. Arena 5.0 is open source and available at https://github.com/Arena-Rosnav.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍机器人社会导航开发与基准测试框架 Arena 5.0，核心贡献为集成 NVIDIA Isaac Gym、构建社会导航策略基准、以及增强场景生成与任务规划模块，并通过基准测试与用户研究验证了可用性与效率提升，项目已开源。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在在前作基础上推进机器人社会导航的开发与评测框架，解决仿真真实感与训练效率、社会导航策略缺乏统一基准、以及社会导航场景（如应急与救援）生成与任务规划可定制性不足的问题。
AI.method: 方法上，Arena 5.0 完成 NVIDIA Isaac Gym 的完整集成，支持照片级真实感仿真与更高效训练，并无缝复用既有模块（随机环境生成、评估工具、ROS2 支持，以及规划器、机器人模型与 API 的集成）；同时构建涵盖不同难度生成与定制世界及场景的社会导航策略综合基准，采用多维度社会导航指标评估；并提供大规模场景生成与任务规划模块。
AI.result: 结果方面，通过生成上述基准测试以及一项综合用户研究对平台性能进行评估，结果显示相较于先前版本在可用性与效率上有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 结论是 Arena 5.0 作为一个开源框架，为机器人社会导航的开发与基准测试提供了更强的仿真、评测与场景生成能力，并已公开于 https://github.com/Arena-Rosnav。

title: SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning
summary: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) enable multi-step reasoning for robotic task planning, but continued reasoning can overwrite valid intermediate plans or leave constraint violations unresolved, reducing planning reliability and wasting inference-time computation. We develop an inference-time monitor that exposes and verifies intermediate plans without disrupting the original decoding trajectory. Building on this monitor, we propose SafeInferCom, a formal verifier-guided framework that preserves valid intermediate plans and directs error correction during generation. Experiments across multiple LRLMs and planning domains reveal reasoning-response inconsistency and limited self-correction under one-shot inference. SafeInferCom improves planning success and accelerates error correction relative to one-shot inference. When combined with iterative refinement, it further improves success while reducing token usage compared with refinement alone. We additionally evaluate SafeInferCom in VirtualHome and provide a real-world robotic-arm demonstration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出推理时监控器与形式化验证器引导框架 SafeInferCom，用于提升大型推理语言模型在机器人任务规划中的可靠性并减少推理计算浪费。
AI.motivation: 大型推理语言模型虽支持多步推理以完成机器人任务规划，但持续推理可能覆盖已有效的中间规划，或使约束违反问题未被解决，从而降低规划可靠性并浪费推理时计算资源。
AI.method: 首先开发一种推理时监控器，在不干扰原始解码轨迹的前提下暴露并验证中间规划；在此基础上提出 SafeInferCom 形式化验证器引导框架，保留有效中间规划并在生成过程中引导错误纠正。
AI.result: 在多个大型推理语言模型和规划领域上的实验揭示了推理—响应不一致以及单次推理下自我纠错能力有限的问题。SafeInferCom 相对单次推理提升了规划成功率并加速错误纠正；与迭代精炼结合时，相较单独精炼进一步提升成功率并减少 token 使用。此外在 VirtualHome 中进行了评估，并提供了真实机械臂演示。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理时监控与形式化验证器引导，SafeInferCom 能有效提升大型推理语言模型机器人任务规划的可靠性与效率，并在仿真环境与真实机械臂场景中得到验证。

title: SimVLA: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Learning for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Large-scale, diverse datasets have driven the success of LLMs and VLMs. But VLAs for robotics remain limited by the cost and complexity of real-world data collection. While simulation offers a scalable alternative, its potential for sim-to-real VLA learning in mobile manipulation remains largely underexplored. We introduce SimVLA, an end-to-end framework that trains VLAs entirely on synthetic simulation data without teleoperation for mobile manipulation. SimVLA is first pre-trained on two complementary simulation-derived datasets: SimAction, a large-scale robot action dataset spanning 35 diverse mobile manipulation tasks, generated by composing atomic skills, and SimVQA, which leverages privileged simulator state to provide spatial, geometric, and subtask-level visual-language supervision. We further post-train SimVLA on a mixture of SimAction and SimDeploy, a dataset collected from policy rollouts across diverse simulated environments. We evaluate SimVLA on tasks including restocking, pouring, and cleaning, and show zero-shot transfer to real-world mobile manipulation, including real home environments. SimVLA outperforms policies trained on 50 in-domain real-world demonstrations, suggesting that simulation can enable scalable sim-to-real mobile manipulation. We further demonstrate the value of multiple complementary forms of supervision for effectively leveraging simulation in VLA training.

AI.tldr: SimVLA是一个完全基于仿真数据、无需遥操作的端到端VLA训练框架，用于移动操作任务，并实现零样本迁移至真实家庭环境。
AI.motivation: 机器人的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）受限于真实世界数据采集的高成本与复杂性，而仿真虽具备可扩展性，其在移动操作的sim-to-real VLA学习中的潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: SimVLA首先在两个互补的仿真数据集上预训练：SimAction（覆盖35种移动操作任务、由原子技能组合生成的大规模机器人动作数据集）与SimVQA（利用仿真器特权状态提供空间、几何与子任务级视觉-语言监督）；随后在SimAction与SimDeploy（多环境策略rollout采集的数据集）的混合数据上后训练。
AI.result: 在补货、倒液、清洁等任务上评估，SimVLA实现向真实世界移动操作（含真实家庭环境）的零样本迁移，性能超过使用50条域内真实演示训练的策略。
AI.conclusion: 仿真能够支撑可扩展的sim-to-real移动操作；多种互补的监督形式对在VLA训练中有效利用仿真数据具有重要价值。

title: Distributed Relative Localization for Homogeneous Multi-Robot Systems through UWB Ranging and Limited Communications
comment: This paper has been published in IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics
summary: Accurate and reliable relative localization is crucial for multi-robot applications like exploration, search, and rescue missions. LiDAR-based solutions offer high accuracy in localizing surrounding objects; however, distinguishing homogeneous robots with similar appearances remains challenging due to the lack of distinctive identification features. In this paper, we propose a fully distributed relative pose estimation approach by integrating LiDAR, UWB, and odometry measurements, allowing each robot to accurately and continuously localize its teammates without external infrastructure. Specifically, potential anonymous teammate robot clusters from LiDAR scans are tracked by a dynamic tracker. We then identify teammate robots from these tracked anonymous clusters using a joint matching strategy, ensuring reliable data association between robots and clusters. Finally, by combining the corresponding LiDAR observations, UWB ranging, and odometry measurements, each robot precisely localizes others while minimizing data exchange. The system requires only odometry data exchange through onboard UWB, eliminating the need for additional communication infrastructure like WiFi routers or mesh networks. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed relative localization approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合LiDAR、UWB与里程计的全分布式相对位姿估计方法，实现无外部基础设施下多机器人间的匿名集群跟踪、联合匹配与精确相对定位。
AI.motivation: 多机器人探索、搜索与救援等任务需要准确可靠的相对定位。LiDAR方案对周围物体定位精度高，但同构机器人外观相似、缺乏可区分标识，导致机器人间识别与数据关联困难；同时希望避免依赖WiFi路由器或mesh网络等外部通信基础设施。
AI.method: 全分布式相对位姿估计：1) 用动态跟踪器对LiDAR扫描中的匿名队友机器人集群进行跟踪；2) 采用联合匹配策略从跟踪到的匿名集群中识别队友机器人，保证机器人与集群间可靠的数据关联；3) 融合对应LiDAR观测、UWB测距与里程计测量精确估计他人位姿，并最小化数据交换；仅通过机载UWB交换里程计数据。
AI.result: 大量仿真和真实世界实验验证了所提相对定位方法的有效性与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该分布式方案在无外部基础设施条件下实现连续、准确的队友相对定位，且通信开销低，适用于多机器人协同任务。

title: USDCraft: Geometrically Grounded Programmatic Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation
summary: Geometrically faithful and functional articulated 3D assets are essential for real-to-sim robot manipulation, where policies trained in simulation must transfer to physical objects. Recent mesh-based methods learn to infer articulation from annotated 3D assets, but deployment remains challenging when real-world objects fall outside the training distribution or their meshes are incomplete or corrupted. To address these limitations, we formulate articulated asset reconstruction as programmatic modeling grounded in partial geometric evidence and introduce USDCraft, a framework in which a pretrained LLM writes and revises executable programs for simulation-ready articulated assets without task-specific training. We propose source geometry analysis, which converts the source mesh into a metric textual description that distinguishes observed surface from unknown space, and iterative geometric rechecking, which re-encodes each candidate in the same representation so that discrepancies point to program edits while unobserved regions remain open to completion. Visual feedback and physical authoring guidance complete the modeling process, which produces articulated USD assets with explicit physical properties that load into Isaac Sim without manual adjustment. Experiments demonstrate leading articulation recovery on two benchmarks and validate USDCraft's effectiveness for real-to-sim-to-real robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出USDCraft框架，将铰接式3D资产重建表述为基于部分几何证据的程序化建模，由预训练LLM编写并修订可执行程序，无需任务特定训练即可生成可仿真的铰接USD资产。
AI.motivation: 面向real-to-sim机器人操作，仿真中训练的策略需迁移到物理对象，因此需要几何忠实且功能性的铰接3D资产。现有基于网格的方法依赖标注数据学习铰接推断，当真实物体超出训练分布、或网格不完整/损坏时，部署效果受限。
AI.method: 将铰接资产重建表述为以部分几何证据为基础的程序化建模。核心包括：源几何分析，将源网格转换为度量化的文本描述，区分已观测表面与未知空间；迭代式几何复查，将每个候选以同一表示重新编码，使差异指向程序编辑，未观测区域保持开放以待补全；并结合视觉反馈与物理创作先验指导。
AI.result: 在两个基准上取得领先的铰接恢复性能，并验证了USDCraft在real-to-sim-to-real机器人操作中的有效性。生成的铰接USD资产具有显式物理属性，可无需手工调整直接载入Isaac Sim。
AI.conclusion: USDCraft表明，以LLM驱动的程序化建模替代任务特定训练，可在部分或损坏几何输入下生成仿真就绪的铰接资产，打通real-to-sim-to-real的机器人操作流程。

title: PlanWAM: Planning-Shaped Future Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: World models in end-to-end autonomous driving predict future scene evolution to provide foresight for trajectory planning. Existing methods mainly study how to predict the future and how to use it, but less often ask which future representation is actually most useful for planning. To this end, we propose PlanWAM, a Planning-Shaped World Action Model. The key idea is to let the planning task shape the future-state representation, so that it retains the information most useful for planning. A latent world model then predicts this planning-shaped future latent representation from historical observations and uses it for planning, enabling foresighted planning. Specifically, we first use a Temporal Register Pyramid to compress multi-frame historical information in a recency-aware manner, learning a compact history representation oriented toward future reasoning and planning. We then introduce a privileged future posterior branch that observes ground-truth future frames, and shape its future latent representation with trajectory-planning objectives to obtain a planning-shaped future latent representation. Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation trains a prior branch that depends only on history to predict this future latent representation. The predicted future latent representation serves as planning context and guides trajectory generation and selection. PlanWAM achieves 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest and reaches 38.7 HD-Score on closed-loop HUGSIM in a zero-shot setting, demonstrating leading planning performance across both open-loop and closed-loop evaluations. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that planning-shaped future representations provide an effective and deployable form of foresight for world-action models.

AI.tldr: PlanWAM通过让规划任务塑造未来状态表征，用隐世界模型预测该"规划塑造"的未来隐表征用于轨迹规划，在NAVSIM与HUGSIM上取得领先的规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶世界模型多关注"如何预测未来"和"如何使用未来"，但较少探讨哪种未来表征对规划真正最有用。作者希望让规划任务反过来塑造未来表征，使其保留对规划最有价值的信息。
AI.method: 提出PlanWAM（Planning-Shaped World Action Model）。首先用Temporal Register Pyramid以近因感知方式压缩多帧历史，学习面向未来推理与规划的紧凑历史表征；再引入特权未来后验分支，观测真实未来帧，并用轨迹规划目标塑造其未来隐表征，得到"规划塑造"的未来隐表征；通过Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation训练仅依赖历史的先验分支来预测该未来隐表征；预测出的未来隐表征作为规划上下文指导轨迹生成与选择。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest上分别达到93.8 PDMS与90.9 EPDMS；在闭环HUGSIM零样本设置下达到38.7 HD-Score，在开环与闭环评测中均展现领先的规划性能。大量实验表明规划塑造的未来表征是有效且可部署的未来预见形式。
AI.conclusion: 让规划任务塑造未来状态表征，并以此作为世界-动作模型的规划上下文，是一种有效且可部署的预见机制，可显著提升端到端自动驾驶的规划表现。

title: Rewiring Semantics, Dynamics, and Control: A Simple yet Effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent framework for complex robotic manipulation, building on the strong semantic understanding of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, such VLM backbones offer insufficient physical dynamics priors, which limits the generalization capabilities of robot policies. Recent efforts therefore integrate video-generation World Models (WMs) into robot policies through various strategies, using predictive dynamics to facilitate action generation. Despite these advances, harnessing semantic understanding and dynamics prediction as complementary guidance for action generation remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce $\mathrm{ACT}^3$, a simple yet effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer that fuses semantic and dynamics information into control actions while preserving the distinct roles of context streams. Specifically, $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ enables the dedicated action expert to access VLM and WM representations through layerwise attention, with each backbone attending only within its own stream. This straightforward interaction design maintains independent forward propagation in the context streams while allowing both backbones to be updated through control supervision. Experiments on both simulated and real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks show that the proposed $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ yields results superior to its counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出ACT³（以动作为中心的三流Transformer），融合VLM语义与WM动力学信息，通过分层注意力让动作专家访问两条上下文流，在仿真与真实机器人操作基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖预训练VLM，语义理解强但缺乏物理动力学先验，导致机器人策略泛化受限；已有工作尝试用视频生成世界模型（WM）补充动力学预测，但难以把语义理解与动力学预测作为互补指导有效融合到动作生成中。
AI.method: 提出ACT³——简单有效的以动作为中心三流Transformer。设计三股流：VLM语义流、WM动力学流与动作专家流，各自角色保持独立。动作专家通过分层注意力（layerwise attention）访问VLM与WM表示，而每个骨干网络仅在本流内部进行注意力，从而保持上下文流的独立前向传播，同时让两个骨干均可通过控制监督信号进行更新。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界机器人操作基准上的实验表明，ACT³ 的性能优于同类对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM语义与WM动力学作为互补引导、以简单交互设计融入动作生成是可行且有效的；分层注意力既维持上下文流独立性又保留控制监督下的可训练性，可作为VLA策略增强的通用范式。

title: Experience-Guided Initiation Search for Learned Skills in Skill Composition
summary: Deploying frozen learned skills, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, in new environments requires identifying initiation configurations that support reliable execution. In skill composition, an initiation configuration affects not only the current skill but also the physical state passed to subsequent skills, so successful execution of an individual skill does not necessarily imply successful completion of the composed task. Estimating target-specific capability through extensive rollouts is costly in real-world deployment, while directly reusing historical experience can be unreliable under environment changes. We propose EVIS, an Experience-Guided and Behavior-Validated Initiation Search framework for discovering reliable initiation configurations under limited target interaction. EVIS uses historical execution experience to prioritize promising candidates and target-environment behavior to validate whether they remain effective. We evaluate EVIS on single-skill and two-stage manipulation tasks with frozen VLA policies. EVIS reduces mean target-environment queries and improves reliable candidate discovery under small interaction budgets. These results show that combining historical guidance with target-side behavioral validation can reduce the interaction cost of deploying frozen learned skills in new environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 EVIS 框架，利用历史经验引导与目标环境行为验证，在有限交互预算下为冻结的 VLA 策略搜索可靠的启动配置，降低新环境部署的交互成本。
AI.motivation: 在新的环境中部署冻结的学习技能（如 VLA 策略）需要找到能支持可靠执行的启动配置。在技能组合中，启动配置不仅影响当前技能，还决定传递给后续技能的物理状态，因此单个技能执行成功并不代表组合任务成功。通过大量 rollout 估计面向目标的能力在真实部署中成本高昂，而直接复用历史经验在环境变化下又不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 EVIS（Experience-Guided and Behavior-Validated Initiation Search）框架：用历史执行经验对候选启动配置进行优先级排序，再借助目标环境的实际行为验证候选是否仍然有效，从而在有限的目标交互下发现可靠的启动配置。
AI.result: 在冻结 VLA 策略上的单技能与两阶段操作任务中评估：EVIS 降低了平均目标环境查询次数，并在较小交互预算下提升了可靠候选的发现率。
AI.conclusion: 将历史经验引导与目标侧行为验证相结合，可有效降低在新环境中部署冻结学习技能的交互成本。

title: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
summary: Embodied coding agents can combine modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies, yet effective composition requires anticipating which policy family will succeed in the current physical state. We present RoboAware, which builds on coding agents' skill orchestration by learning only a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes. Inspired by the success of REPL, we propose the $P^5$ schema and formulate a hierarchical MDP based on it. $P^5$ organizes skills uniformly into five semantic stages, defining where responsibility can be compared. To address the lack of counterfactual branch outcomes in existing work, we introduce State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), which restores the same training state to generate and execute a code block from each admissible family, exposing outcomes that selected-branch experience leaves unobserved. Building on this, we propose Execution-Aware Learning (EAL), which combines Monte Carlo tree search with Q-learning to distill these outcomes into family-conditioned values. At deployment, the coordinator selects the policy family according to observable context, and the frozen coding agent generates the next local code block. Comprehensive single-episode evaluations on 100 tasks show that RoboAware reaches a 77.0% overall success rate, with SOTA averages of 90.0% on RoboSuite, 73.8% on diverse LIBERO-Pro task clusters, and 90.0% on challenging RoboTwin bimanual tasks, outperforming existing code-as-policy and VLA-harness baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboAware：仅学习状态条件下的“职责协调器”，用于模块化机器人技能与冻结端到端策略的组合选择；采用P^5五阶段语义模式、状态锁定反事实分支（SCB）与执行感知学习（EAL）。
AI.motivation: 具身编码智能体虽能组合模块化技能与冻结的端到端策略，但有效组合需预判在当前物理状态下哪类策略族（policy family）会成功，而现有工作缺乏反事实分支结果，难以进行可靠的责任分配与选择。
AI.method: 1) 借鉴REPL提出P^5模式，将技能统一组织为五个语义阶段，定义可比较职责的位置，并据此构建分层MDP；2) 提出状态锁定反事实分支（SCB），将同一训练状态恢复后，对每个可采纳策略族生成并执行代码块，暴露被“选中分支经验”所遗漏的结果；3) 提出执行感知学习（EAL），用蒙特卡洛树搜索+Q学习将反事实结果蒸馏为策略族条件价值；4) 部署时协调器依据可观测上下文选择策略族，再由冻结编码智能体生成下一局部代码块。
AI.result: 在100个任务上进行综合单回合评测：总体成功率77.0%；RoboSuite平均90.0%、LIBERO-Pro多任务簇平均73.8%、RoboTwin双臂任务90.0%，均达到SOTA，优于现有code-as-policy与VLA-harness基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过仅学习状态条件的职责协调器，并以P^5统一技能语义、SCB获取反事实监督、EAL蒸馏族条件价值，可在不微调冻结策略的前提下显著提升具身编码智能体的组合成功率与跨基准泛化能力。

title: DAMP: Humanoid Locomotion via Denoised Belief Learning and Adversarial Motion Priors
summary: Humanoid robots possess the structural capability to traverse complex terrains. However, achieving stable t raversal without relying on perceived information remains challenging, particularly in complex environments. This paper introduces DAMP, a reinforcement learning framework aimed at achieving robust and naturalistic humanoid locomotion over challenging terrains, with the assumption that no perceived information is available. The framework leverages recurrent neural networks to capture temporal dependencies and implicitly infer privileged and other task-relevant latent information. By aligning the learned representations with the task objective, the method enables robust and goal-consistent policy learning. This end-to-end framework achieves transfer learning from simulation to real-world environments, demonstrating the proposed method's robustness and generalization capabilities. The video of the real-world demonstration can be found at the following link: https://youtu.be/AkI7TZB2DDM.

AI.tldr: 提出DAMP强化学习框架，在不依赖感知信息的假设下，实现人形机器人复杂地形上的稳健自然行走，并完成仿真到真实的迁移。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人具备穿越复杂地形的结构能力，但在无感知信息条件下实现稳定穿越仍具挑战性，尤其是复杂环境中的鲁棒性与自然性难以兼顾。
AI.method: 采用端到端强化学习框架，利用循环神经网络捕获时间依赖，隐式推断特权信息及其他任务相关潜在信息；通过将学习到的表征与任务目标对齐，实现稳健且目标一致的政策学习。
AI.result: 实现了从仿真到真实环境的迁移学习，验证了方法在真实场景中的鲁棒性与泛化能力，并提供了真实世界演示视频。
AI.conclusion: 在无感知信息假设下，DAMP能够实现人形机器人复杂地形上的稳健自然行走，并具备良好的仿真到真实迁移与泛化性能。

title: RAGNAROK: Radar-Aided Gravity-Normalized Alignment for Robust Open Keyframe-based Radar-Visual-Kinematic-Inertial SLAM
summary: Legged robots offer superior mobility in unstructured environments, but reliable operation in such conditions requires robust state estimation. To address the vulnerability of proprioceptive estimators in rough terrain, recent methods have incorporated radar to provide velocity measurements. However, their limited yaw observability still leads to drift, and failure-aware fusion for adverse environments remains underexplored. In this letter, we present RAGNAROK, the first radar-visual-kinematic-inertial SLAM designed for robust operation in challenging environments. It integrates slip- and rolling-contact-aware leg velocity estimation, a kinematics-aware radar factor, and degradation-aware image enhancement. We further incorporate a B-spline-based radar-aided proprioceptive backbone, adaptive weighting, and online extrinsic calibration. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets demonstrate that RAGNAROK achieves robust performance under challenging conditions and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The source code and dataset are available at https://github.com/hanjun815/RAGNAROK.

AI.tldr: 提出RAGNAROK，首个雷达-视觉-运动学-惯性SLAM系统，用于挑战性环境下足式机器人的鲁棒状态估计。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人在非结构化环境中机动性强，但可靠运行依赖鲁棒状态估计。本体感知估计器在崎岖地形易失效；已有引入雷达提供速度测量的方法偏航可观测性有限导致漂移，且面向恶劣环境的失效感知融合研究不足。
AI.method: 集成滑动与滚动接触感知的腿部速度估计、运动学感知的雷达因子、退化感知图像增强；引入基于B样条的雷达辅助本体感知主干、自适应加权与在线外参标定。
AI.result: 在公开和自采数据集上的大量实验表明，RAGNAROK在挑战性条件下表现鲁棒，并优于当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: RAGNAROK实现了复杂环境下足式机器人鲁棒的多传感器融合SLAM，代码与数据集已开源。

title: SDPAD: A Fully Spike-Driven Pipeline for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving demands trajectory planners that are both highly accurate and cheap enough for edge deployment. State-of-the-art artificial neural network (ANN) planners meet the accuracy requirement at the cost of heavy dense computation, while spiking neural networks (SNNs)---though promising orders-of-magnitude energy savings through sparse, event-driven arithmetic---still lag far behind in planning accuracy. We present \textbf{SDPAD}, a fully spike-driven end-to-end planning pipeline that closes this gap. SDPAD converts a pre-trained ANN perception stack into integer-spike form via quantized ANN2SNN conversion, lifts multi-view images into the bird's-eye-view (BEV) space with a spike-driven-max (SDM) depth distribution (Spike-3D-Lift), and plans through the Spike-QFormer, a spiking query transformer in which ego, agent, and map queries distilled from the BEV scene are fused by learnable waypoint queries via cross-attention, followed by deformable spike-cross-attention refinement. Every operation is gated by integer spikes and inference is a single feed-forward pass without temporal simulation loops. On the nuScenes open-loop benchmark, SDPAD achieves an average $L_2$ error of 0.40\,m and a collision rate of 0.12\%, on par with strong ANN planners while consuming 69.9\,mJ---less than 2\% of recent ANN baselines. In closed-loop evaluation on the NAVSIM navtest split, SDPAD reaches 86.3 PDMS, surpassing the previous SNN planner SAD by 4.3 points and matching mainstream ANN planners at a fraction of their energy. To our knowledge, SDPAD is the first fully spike-driven planner evaluated in end-to-end autonomous driving, demonstrating that SNNs can rival dense ANNs in complex driving tasks.

AI.tldr: SDPAD 提出首个全脉冲驱动的端到端自动驾驶规划流程，通过量化 ANN2SNN 转换、Spike-3D-Lift 与 Spike-QFormer，在精度对齐主流 ANN 规划器的同时将能耗降至其 2% 以下。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶要求轨迹规划器兼具高精度与边缘部署的低成本。现有 ANN 规划器精度高但稠密计算开销大；SNN 虽具稀疏事件驱动算术的能耗优势，规划精度却远落后。论文旨在以全脉冲驱动方案弥合这一精度—能耗鸿沟。
AI.method: SDPAD 将预训练 ANN 感知栈经量化 ANN2SNN 转换变为整数脉冲形式；通过 Spike-3D-Lift（含 spike-driven-max 深度分布 SDM）把多视角图像提升至 BEV 空间；再由 Spike-QFormer 完成规划：从 BEV 场景蒸馏出的 ego、agent、map 查询与可学习 waypoint 查询经交叉注意力融合，并辅以可变形脉冲交叉注意力精修。所有操作均由整数脉冲门控，推理为单次前馈，无时间步仿真循环。
AI.result: nuScenes 开环基准上平均 L2 误差 0.40 m、碰撞率 0.12%，与强 ANN 规划器相当，能耗仅 69.9 mJ，低于近期 ANN 基线的 2%；NAVSIM navtest 闭环评测达 86.3 PDMS，较此前 SNN 规划器 SAD 提升 4.3 点，并以极低能耗匹配主流 ANN 规划器。
AI.conclusion: SDPAD 是首个在端到端自动驾驶中评估的全脉冲驱动规划器，证明 SNN 能在复杂驾驶任务中与稠密 ANN 相媲美，实现了精度与能耗的兼顾。

title: Acting from Belief, Looking When Needed: A Bayesian Spatial World Model for Navigation under Intermittent Perception
summary: Robot navigation commonly uses wide-coverage, high-frequency sensing to reduce partial observability; this reliance becomes restrictive when another task temporarily redirects a shared sensor from navigation, interrupting navigation-relevant observations. We study navigation under intermittent perception: acting from an internal spatial belief and looking again only when execution needs a new observation, potentially freeing the shared sensor for other tasks between navigation observations. ALONE, a Bayesian spatial world model, propagates a structured spatial belief using executed actions and corrects it with selectively acquired observations; learned priors over common geometric structures infer unobserved structure from available observation history. It decodes the belief into a spatial estimate for the motion-planning module and predicts a reliability map expressing confidence in the estimate's accuracy. ALONE requests an observation only if insufficient reliability hinders navigation and new evidence should make relevant-region spatial information more reliable; otherwise, it continues acting from the propagated belief. We instantiate ALONE for drone navigation with intermittent single-camera depth images. Across two simulated scene families, it achieves 98% and 97% closed-loop success at a 10 Hz decision rate. Among successful trials, median fractions of decision steps requiring a new depth observation are only 0.9% and 1.3%, respectively, demonstrating high navigation success with substantially reduced observation demand. Real-world indoor flight experiments further validate navigation under intermittent depth observations, with all 10 trials successful.

AI.tldr: ALONE是一种贝叶斯空间世界模型，用于间歇性感知下的导航：依靠内部空间信念执行动作，仅在可靠性不足时请求新观测，实验证明其在高成功率下大幅降低观测需求。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航通常依赖宽覆盖、高频率传感以降低部分可观测性，但当共享传感器被其他任务临时征用时，导航相关观测会被中断，这种依赖成为限制。作者研究间歇性感知下的导航问题，目标是在不持续用传感器的情况下仍可靠导航，从而释放共享传感器供其他任务使用。
AI.method: 提出ALONE，一种贝叶斯空间世界模型。它利用已执行动作传播结构化空间信念，并用选择性获取的观测进行校正；通过学习的常见几何结构先验，从已有观测历史推断未观测结构。将信念解码为空间估计供运动规划模块使用，并预测表达估计精度置信度的可靠性地图。仅当可靠性不足阻碍导航且新证据应能提升相关区域空间信息可靠性时，才请求一次观测，否则继续基于传播信念执行动作。以间歇性单相机深度图像的无人机导航为实例。
AI.result: 在两个仿真场景族中，10 Hz决策率下闭环成功率分别为98%和97%；成功试验中，需要新深度观测的决策步比例中位数仅为0.9%和1.3%。真实室内飞行实验中10次试验全部成功，验证了间歇性深度观测下的导航能力。
AI.conclusion: ALONE表明，通过维护结构化空间信念并仅在必要时主动请求观测，可在显著降低观测需求的同时实现高导航成功率，为共享传感器被多任务占用的场景提供了有效方案。

title: Learning Language-Conditioned Traversability Representations for Adaptive Visual Navigation
summary: Traversability is essential for visual navigation but varies with robot capabilities and user preferences. Conventional pipelines often rely on explicit costmaps or segmentation masks with predefined criteria, requiring hand-crafted rules and careful tuning. Moreover, viewpoint-dependent segmentation masks complicate asynchronous planning under perception latency. We present LaTraNav, a framework that learns language-conditioned traversability representations for adaptive visual navigation. Its asynchronous architecture combines a slow vision-language model that produces latent representations of traversability and navigation goals, with a fast flow-matching planner conditioned on these representations. To train the system, we develop a simulation-based data generation pipeline with controllable trajectories, producing observations paired with language instructions, traversability maps, goal locations, and diverse trajectories. Photorealistic image translation further enhances visual realism. Evaluations on datasets from multiple sources demonstrate effective language-guided traversability segmentation and goal localization by the slow VLM, alongside adaptive pixel-space path planning by the fast planner. Latent conditioning improves planning performance over explicit segmentation masks, while asynchronous scheduling increases the path-update rate by $6.05\times$ at the same semantic-update rate.

AI.tldr: LaTraNav 提出一种语言条件的可通行性表示学习框架，通过慢速 VLM 生成潜表示、快速流匹配规划器异步规划，实现自适应视觉导航。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉导航依赖显式代价地图或预定义标准的分割掩码，需手工设计规则并精细调参；且依赖视角的分割掩码在感知时延下难以支持异步规划。此外，可通行性随机器人能力与用户偏好变化，需要自适应表示。
AI.method: 框架采用异步架构：慢速视觉语言模型（VLM）产生可通行性与导航目标的潜表示，快速流匹配规划器以这些表示为条件进行规划。训练上构建基于仿真的数据生成流水线，可控轨迹生成观测与语言指令、可通行性地图、目标位置及多样轨迹配对，并通过照片级图像翻译增强视觉真实性。
AI.result: 在多来源数据集上，慢速 VLM 实现有效的语言引导可通行性分割与目标定位，快速规划器实现自适应像素空间路径规划；潜条件相比显式分割掩码提升规划性能；在相同语义更新率下，异步调度将路径更新率提升 6.05 倍。
AI.conclusion: 以语言条件的潜可通行性表示结合异步慢-快架构，可替代显式分割掩码与手工规则，实现更自适应、更高更新率的视觉导航，并验证了潜条件与异步调度的有效性。

title: Scalable LEO Conjunction Screening using Adaptive Synthetic-Covariance Thresholds
summary: As orbital populations grow, conjunction screening must search more object pairs for potential collision risks. Existing pipelines use early-stage filters, such as an apsis filter, to eliminate pairs whose orbital altitude ranges cannot produce a close approach. However, these filters apply the same fixed threshold to every object, making the screening unnecessarily conservative for well-constrained objects while potentially insufficient for objects with greater orbit-prediction uncertainty. In this work, we present an uncertainty-aware conjunction screening method that replaces a single fixed apsis threshold with object-specific thresholds derived from propagated radial uncertainty. The resulting thresholds vary across both objects and prediction time, becoming narrower when propagated uncertainty is small and wider when uncertainty grows. We pair this adaptive screening rule with a binary-search altitude sweep that makes resulting heterogeneous intervals efficient to evaluate at catalog scale with log-linear search complexity. We evaluate the method on 33,791 objects from the Space-Track General Perturbations (GP) catalog using the preceding eight public ephemeris snapshots and a seven-day prediction horizon. The adaptive sieve retains 162.8 million candidate pairs, reducing the candidate set by 28.78% relative to a fixed 50 km apsis threshold and by 71.48% relative to brute-force all-pairs screening. It retains all close approaches identified in two independently propagated reference sets. At the largest tested catalog size, the binary-search sweep is 27 times faster than exhaustive interval evaluation while returning the same candidate set. These results demonstrate that uncertainty-aware screening can substantially reduce the candidate burden passed to downstream conjunction analysis, providing a scalable path toward managing increasingly large and heterogeneous orbital populations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的交会筛选方法，用基于传播径向不确定度的目标专属阈值替代固定近地点高度阈值，并配合二分搜索高度扫描实现星表规模的候选对高效评估。
AI.motivation: 轨道目标数量增长使交会筛选需搜索更多目标对。现有流程采用固定阈值（如近地点高度筛选）剔除轨道高度范围无法产生接近的目标对，但对所有目标使用同一阈值：对轨道预报良好的目标过于保守，对预报不确定度大的目标又可能不足。
AI.method: 将单一固定近地点高度阈值替换为基于传播径向不确定度推导的目标专属阈值；该阈值随目标和预报时刻变化——传播不确定度小时更窄，不确定度增大时更宽。同时配合二分搜索式高度扫描，以对数线性搜索复杂度高效评估由此产生的异质区间。
AI.result: 在Space-Track GP星表33,791个目标上，使用前8个公开星历快照与7天预报时域评估。自适应筛选保留1.628亿个候选对，相比固定50 km近地点阈值减少28.78%，相比暴力全对筛选减少71.48%，并保留了两个独立传播参考集中识别出的所有接近事件。在最大测试星表规模下，二分搜索扫描比穷举区间评估快27倍，且返回相同候选集。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知筛选可显著降低下游交会分析承担的候选对负担，为管理日益庞大且异质的轨道目标群提供可扩展路径。

title: YOCO: You Only Calibrate Once! Fast Mocap Calibration for Dexterous Teleoperation
summary: Dexterous teleoperation requires reliable human-hand state estimations. However, common low-cost motion-capture gloves and markerless trackers often exhibit biases that vary across users, glove fit, and recording sessions, degrading retargeting and demonstration quality. We present YOCO, a fast few-shot, fine-tuning-free calibration framework that corrects biased hand-pose streams from a small set of paired raw and target poses. Instead of optimizing a separate model for every operator or session, YOCO conditions a calibration HyperNet on the paired examples and predicts LoRA-style updates for a frozen MANO hand-estimation module, turning per-user calibration into a lightweight feed-forward adaptation step while preserving the geometric prior of MANO and the efficiency of a compact estimator. We train YOCO with synthetic drift augmentations on InterHand2.6M and evaluate on augmented InterHand sequences, offline real glove data, and dexterous teleoperation tasks. Across these settings, YOCO improves calibration efficiency, hand-state estimation quality and teleoperation performance compared with uncalibrated input and standard calibration baselines.

AI.tldr: YOCO是一个快速、少样本、免微调的手部姿态校准框架，通过对冻结的MANO估计模块预测LoRA式更新，纠正低成本动捕手套和无标记跟踪器的偏差。
AI.motivation: 低成本动捕手套和无标记跟踪器存在跨用户、手套佩戴和录制会话变化的偏差，损害重定向与示教质量。传统方法需为每个操作者或会话单独优化模型，代价高。
AI.method: YOCO以少量成对的原始姿态与目标姿态为条件，用校准HyperNet预测LoRA式更新，作用于冻结的MANO手部估计模块，将逐用户校准转为轻量前馈适应，同时保留MANO几何先验与紧凑估计器效率。在InterHand2.6M上用合成漂移增强训练。
AI.result: 在增强的InterHand序列、离线真实手套数据和灵巧遥操作任务上，YOCO相比未校准输入和标准校准基线，在校准效率、手部状态估计质量和遥操作性能上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: YOCO实现了免微调的少样本手部姿态校准，可有效纠正用户与会话相关偏差，提升遥操作与示教质量。

title: From Solo to Ensemble: A Hierarchical Framework for Composable Multi-Agent Human-Object Interaction
summary: Physics-based human-object interaction has achieved robust single-agent manipulation skills, yet extending them to multi-agent cooperative tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches typically adapt interaction policies through task-specific fine-tuning, which entangles low-level contact-rich execution with high-level coordination and limits reuse across object geometries, interaction types, and team sizes. We propose a hierarchical framework that converts a single-agent HOI policy into a reusable Object-oriented Motion Skill. Specifically, we reinterpret teacher rollouts as object-oriented action supervision by extracting short-horizon object-proxy motions from executed trajectories, and distill task-specific teachers into a low-level skill operating in an Object-oriented Action Space. For downstream tasks, the distilled skill is frozen as a reusable executor, while a high-level policy coordinates multiple agents by generating region-wise object-oriented actions conditioned on the shared object, task goal, agent states, and local manipulation regions. This formulation shifts multi-agent HOI learning from direct contact-rich full-body control to compact object-level proxy-motion coordination. Experiments on diverse HOI tasks show that the distilled Object-oriented Motion Skill supports robust proxy-motion execution and enables composable policy learning across different interaction types, object geometries, and team sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层框架，将单智能体人-物交互（HOI）策略转化为可复用的“物体导向运动技能”（Object-oriented Motion Skill），以冻结的低层执行器配合高层区域化协调策略，实现跨物体几何、交互类型与团队规模的多智能体协作。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真下的人-物交互（HOI）已在单智能体操作上表现稳健，但扩展到多智能体协作仍困难。现有方法多依赖任务特定的微调来适配交互策略，导致低层富接触执行与高层协调相互纠缠，难以在物体几何、交互类型和团队规模之间复用。
AI.method: 1）将教师轨迹重解释为物体导向的动作监督：从已执行轨迹中提取短时域的“物体代理（object-proxy）”运动；2）把任务特定的教师策略蒸馏为在“物体导向动作空间”（Object-oriented Action Space）中运行的低层技能；3）下游任务中冻结该技能作为可复用执行器，由高层策略依据共享物体、任务目标、智能体状态与局部操作区域，生成区域化的物体导向动作，从而协调多个智能体。该形式将多智能体 HOI 学习从直接的富接触全身控制转为紧凑的物体级代理运动协调。
AI.result: 在多种 HOI 任务上的实验表明，蒸馏得到的物体导向运动技能能够支持稳健的代理运动执行，并实现跨不同交互类型、物体几何与团队规模的可组合策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过将单智能体 HOI 策略蒸馏为与物体对齐的可复用低层技能，并在物体导向动作空间上进行高层区域化协调，该框架解耦了低层富接触执行与高层协作，提升了多智能体 HOI 的复用性与可组合性。

title: 2DGS-Planner: Rasterization-based Path Planning in 2D Gaussian Splatting Map
summary: Gaussian splatting provides an explicit and efficiently rasterizable scene representation for robot navigation. However, individual Gaussian primitives may not reliably represent obstacles as they are jointly optimized through alpha-composited rendering from a finite set of reconstruction views. We propose 2DGS-Planner, a path planner for ground robots that reads planning-relevant geometry from a 2D Gaussian splatting (2DGS) map through rasterization, rather than treating individual Gaussian primitives as obstacles. During offline roadmap construction, multi-view attribution converts rendered normal dispersion into structural scores for non-ground disks supported by the reconstruction views. These scores guide adaptive node sampling on the ground. Path-aligned orthographic queries validate candidate edges, while cylindrical queries estimate local clearance fields that are cached on the edges. During online planning, graph search initializes a route, and path refinement reuses the cached fields while accounting for the robot's dimensions and ground constraints. Experiments demonstrate improved roadmap connectivity, more accurate clearance estimation, and higher planning success compared with the tested baselines. These results support rasterization as an effective geometric query interface for planning directly on Gaussian maps. Code and data are available at https://2dgs-planner.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出2DGS-Planner，将2D高斯泼溅地图的光栅化作为几何查询接口，而非把单个高斯基元当作障碍，用于地面机器人路径规划。
AI.motivation: 高斯基元经有限重建视角的alpha合成渲染联合优化，单个基元不能可靠表示障碍，因此需要从渲染层面提取规划相关几何。
AI.method: 离线阶段：多视角归因将渲染法线离散度转为非地面圆盘的结构分数，指导地面自适应节点采样；路径对齐正交查询验证候选边，圆柱查询估计局部间隙场并缓存于边。在线阶段：图搜索初始化路径，路径细化复用缓存间隙场并结合机器人尺寸与地面约束。
AI.result: 相比基线，路线图连通性提升、间隙估计更准确、规划成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 光栅化可作为直接在高斯地图上规划的有效几何查询接口，代码与数据已开源。

title: UltraLight Luma: A Novel Edge-Deployable Perception Network for Crop-Row Segmentation in Agricultural Robotics
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IECON 2026. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
summary: Reliable crop-row perception is essential for autonomous agricultural robots, but low-cost deployment is constrained by computation, memory, power, and inference time. This paper addresses crop-row detection and navigation-line extraction using UltraLight Luma, a compact encoder-decoder segmentation network with a progressive learning strategy and only 13.1k trainable parameters. The predicted crop-row masks are processed using a post-processing algorithm to estimate row alignment for downstream visual servoing. UltraLight Luma improves parameter efficiency over U-Net, YOLOv8, and YOLOv26 while maintaining reliable crop-row detection performance. The model required only 25.23 mJ per inference, demonstrating its suitability for resource-constrained agricultural robots.

AI.tldr: 提出UltraLight Luma轻量编码器-解码器分割网络（仅13.1k可训练参数），结合渐进式学习策略实现作物行检测与导航线提取，单次推理仅需25.23 mJ，适用于资源受限的农业机器人。
AI.motivation: 可靠的作物行感知是自主农业机器人的关键，但低成本部署受限于算力、内存、功耗与推理时间，现有方法难以在资源受限平台上兼顾性能与效率。
AI.method: 设计UltraLight Luma紧凑型编码器-解码器分割网络，采用渐进式学习策略；对预测的作物行掩膜使用后处理算法估计行对齐信息，服务于下游视觉伺服控制。
AI.result: 在保持可靠作物行检测性能的同时，参数效率优于U-Net、YOLOv8与YOLOv26；单次推理能耗仅25.23 mJ。
AI.conclusion: UltraLight Luma以极低参数量与能耗实现了作物行检测与导航线提取，适合部署于资源受限的农业机器人平台。

title: PathTime-VLA: Path-Time Decoupling for Factorized Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies typically predict actions at fixed time intervals, coupling the route a robot follows with its execution pace. This coupling complicates adaptation from teleoperation: useful geometric guidance comes with timing shaped by interface delays and operator behavior. Our key insight is to bring the path-time parameterization of classical motion planning into the learned action representation of a VLA. We introduce PathTime-VLA, which represents motion as a progress-indexed interaction path $X(s)$ and a positive interval-time profile. The latter defines a monotone time law $t(s)$, yielding controller commands $X(s(t))$. For a given path, alternative executions are expressed through the time profile, allowing chunk-wise speed choices without changing the geometric prediction target. This representation supports a staged post-training procedure: demonstrations and DAgger interventions establish a target-domain prior, Speed-DQN learns execution multipliers from robot interaction, and Path-AWR uses rollout outcomes to refine the diffusion path generator. A path-conditioned action expert realizes the resulting motions while maintaining distinct learning interfaces for path generation and execution timing. Across three tasks, the complete method achieves $58/60$ successes versus $57/60$ for PathTime-VLA under BC + DAgger at fixed $1\times$, with approximately $39$-$52\%$ shorter mean completion times over successful trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathTime-VLA，将经典运动规划中的路径-时间参数化引入VLA策略，解耦几何路径与执行节奏，通过分阶段后训练实现更快更稳的操作执行。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通常在固定时间间隔预测动作，导致机器人路径与执行速度耦合。这种耦合使从遥操作数据中迁移变得困难：有用的几何引导往往伴随由界面延迟和操作者行为造成的不理想时间分布。
AI.method: 将运动表示为进度索引的交互路径X(s)与正的区间时间剖面，后者定义单调时间律t(s)，生成控制指令X(s(t))。同一路径的多种执行通过时间剖面表达，实现分块速度选择而无需改变几何预测目标。采用分阶段后训练：演示与DAgger干预建立目标域先验；Speed-DQN从机器人交互中学习执行倍率；Path-AWR利用rollout结果精炼扩散路径生成器。路径条件动作专家实现运动，并保持路径生成与执行定时的独立学习接口。
AI.result: 在三个任务上，完整方法取得58/60成功率，对比PathTime-VLA在BC+DAgger固定1×下的57/60；成功试验的平均完成时间缩短约39%–52%。
AI.conclusion: 路径-时间解耦表示能有效提升VLA策略的执行效率，同时保持甚至提升成功率，验证了将经典运动规划参数化引入学习式动作表示的可行性与价值。

title: WAND: Learning Robust Navigation under Complex Wind Disturbances and Dense Obstacles for Quadrotors
summary: Robust navigation in cluttered environments remains a fundamental challenge for quadrotors, particularly when strong wind disturbances arise, which perturb vehicle dynamics, limit control authority, and substantially increase collision risk. Existing learning-based navigation policies typically rely on obstacle perception and proprioceptive observations, requiring the policy to infer time-varying disturbance effects implicitly and thereby limiting robustness under partial observability. This paper proposes WAND (Wind-Aware Navigation with Disturbance Estimation), a reinforcement learning framework for navigation under time-varying wind disturbances in dense obstacle fields. Specifically, WAND estimates wind-induced disturbance acceleration from historical proprioceptive states using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). This estimation is integrated into the policy via a zero-initialized residual module, \emph{WindAdapter}, while simultaneously providing feedforward compensation for low-level control. The dual use of the estimate couples disturbance-conditioned navigation with feedforward disturbance rejection. Across 12 wind-disturbed simulation settings, WAND improved the observed success rate by 8.3 percentage points on average relative to feedforward compensation alone. Controlled opposite-crosswind experiments further showed wind-direction-dependent trajectory adaptation. In indoor fan-induced flight tests, WAND succeeded in 18 of 20 trials, demonstrating the feasibility of real-time onboard navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WAND框架：用TCN从历史本体感知状态估计风扰加速度，并通过零初始化残差模块WindAdapter注入策略，同时提供前馈补偿，实现稠密障碍下抗时变风扰导航。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在稠密环境中受强风扰时动力学被扰动、控制权限受限、碰撞风险增大；现有学习型导航策略仅依赖障碍感知与本体感知，需隐式推断时变扰动，在部分可观测下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: WAND将风扰估计与导航策略解耦：用时间卷积网络（TCN）从历史本体感知状态估计风致扰动加速度；估计量一方面通过零初始化残差模块WindAdapter融入策略网络，另一方面直接用于底层控制的前馈补偿，使扰动条件化导航与前馈扰动抑制相耦合。
AI.result: 在12种风扰仿真设置中，WAND相对仅前馈补偿平均提升观测成功率8.3个百分点；受控逆风交叉实验显示轨迹随风向自适应；室内风扇扰动飞行测试中20次试验成功18次，验证了实时机载导航可行性。
AI.conclusion: 显式估计风扰并同时用于策略条件化与前馈补偿，可有效提升四旋翼在稠密障碍与时变风扰下的导航鲁棒性与实机可行性。

title: STAG: A Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph Representation from Grid-Based Costmaps for Robotic Navigation
summary: Autonomous rovers navigating large unstructured environments need efficient global planning that accounts for terrain traversability. However, searching dense grid-based costmaps becomes computationally expensive as the mapped area grows. We introduce STAG, a Sparse Traversability-Aware Graph that converts costmaps into compact graphs. STAG combines a medial-axis topological backbone, representative nodes for homogeneous traversability regions, and transition nodes near strong traversability gradients. Edges encode geometry and traversability to account for path length and terrain difficulty. We compare A* on STAG and dense grids using synthetic cave maps, mine maps and the DARPA CERBERUS dataset. Across five benchmark categories comprising 203 map instances and 101,200 queries, STAG reduces median planning time by 3.4x to 9.9x and peak query memory by 2.1x to 15.4x, with median relative path-length differences of -2.9% and +7.6%. STAG offers a compact representation for global planning, trading dense-grid traversability optimality for faster, less memory-intensive search.

AI.tldr: 提出STAG（稀疏可通行性感知图），将稠密代价地图转换为紧凑图结构，在大规模非结构化环境中实现高效全局路径规划。
AI.motivation: 自主漫游车在大规模非结构化环境中导航需要高效的全局规划，且必须考虑地形可通行性。然而基于稠密栅格代价地图的搜索随着已建图区域增大，计算开销显著上升。因此需要一种更紧凑、更高效的全局规划表示方法。
AI.method: STAG将代价地图转换为稀疏图，由三部分构成：（1）中轴（medial-axis）拓扑骨架；（2）代表同质可通行性区域的代表性节点；（3）位于强可通行性梯度附近的过渡节点。图中边同时编码几何信息与可通行性，以兼顾路径长度和地形难度。在合成洞穴地图、矿井地图及DARPA CERBERUS数据集上，将STAG上的A*与稠密栅格上的A*进行对比。
AI.result: 在5个基准类别、共203个地图实例和101,200次查询中，STAG将中位规划时间缩短3.4倍至9.9倍，峰值查询内存降低2.1倍至15.4倍；中位相对路径长度差异为-2.9%至+7.6%。
AI.conclusion: STAG为全局规划提供了一种紧凑表示，以牺牲稠密栅格上的可通行性最优性为代价，换取更快、内存占用更低的搜索性能。

title: TACROSS: An Efficient and Low-Cost Scalable Human Touch System Across Heterogeneous Tactile Sensors for Dexterous Robot Learning
summary: Collecting tactile demonstrations on robots is costly and slow, motivating the use of lower-cost human tactile gloves for scalable data collection. However, human capacitive/piezoresistive gloves and robotic tactile sensors differ fundamentally in transduction principle, sensor layout, spatial resolution, and dynamic response, making alignment of raw sensor channels ill-posed. To address this problem, we present TACROSS, a scalable system for learning from human touch and transferring it to robots that bridges this heterogeneity by aligning tactile streams at the level of contact events rather than raw sensor values. The hardware component of TACROSS integrates a piezoresistive glove with five layers and a cost of USD 10.86 with 285 sensing points. To align contact semantics, we design canonicalizers and residual adapters that map heterogeneous signals into a shared tactile latent with 256 dimensions via a temporal Transformer with attention across fingers. We further introduce a robot-grounded policy learning scheme in which robot demonstrations provide the sole source of ground-truth action supervision, while human demonstrations support tactile representation learning and provide confidence-weighted auxiliary supervision through valid retargeted hand targets. We evaluate our system on four contact-rich manipulation tasks. Compared to conventional teleoperation, our proposed system achieves a 3.5-fold efficiency improvement while reducing demonstration acquisition equipment cost by 95.7%. We will open-source the TACROSS hardware and software system and publicly release a tactile dataset comprising over 150 hours of recordings. Project page: https://tacross-touch-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: TACROSS：低成本触觉手套采集人类触觉演示，在接触事件层面跨模态对齐，实现从人到机器人的触觉策略迁移，在四个富接触操作任务上效率提升3.5倍、采集设备成本降低95.7%。
AI.motivation: 机器人上采集触觉演示成本高、速度慢，促使人们使用低成本人类触觉手套进行可扩展的数据采集。但人类电容/压阻手套与机器人触觉传感器在换能原理、传感器布局、空间分辨率和动态响应上存在本质差异，直接对齐原始传感器通道是病态（ill-posed）问题。因此需要一个能跨越这种异构性、从人类触觉中学习并迁移到机器人的可扩展系统。
AI.method: 提出TACROSS系统，核心思想是在接触事件层面而非原始传感器数值层面进行触觉流对齐。硬件为五层压阻式手套，成本10.86美元，含285个传感点。算法上设计规范化器（canonicalizers）与残差适配器（residual adapters），通过带跨手指注意力（attention across fingers）的时序Transformer将异构信号映射到256维共享触觉潜空间。此外引入机器人锚定的策略学习方案：机器人演示作为唯一的真值动作监督来源，人类演示用于触觉表征学习，并通过有效重定向手部目标提供置信度加权的辅助监督。
AI.result: 在四个富接触操作任务上评估。相比传统遥操作，该系统实现3.5倍效率提升，同时演示采集设备成本降低95.7%。作者将开源TACROSS的硬件与软件系统，并公开发布包含超过150小时记录数据的触觉数据集。
AI.conclusion: 在接触事件层面进行跨模态触觉对齐，可有效弥合人类手套与机器人触觉传感器间的异构性，验证了低成本人类触觉数据用于机器人触觉策略学习的可行性与可扩展性，为触觉数据规模化采集提供了硬件与算法一体化的解决方案。

title: Tell Robot What Not to Do: A Negation Understanding Perspective
summary: Instruction following enables robots to perform diverse tasks specified in natural language, making it a fundamental capability for human-robot interaction. Beyond communicating desired outcomes, users also need to specify constraints on what not to do. We investigate how to enable vision-language-action models (VLAs) to follow negated instructions, where robots must accomplish task goals while respecting explicit exclusions. To this end, we propose NegaAlign, a parameter-efficient, plug-and-play framework that extends pretrained VLAs to follow negated instructions through image-language supervision alone. Specifically, we introduce Negation Transformation Layers into selected layers of the vision-language backbone to reshape intermediate instruction representations. Meanwhile, a teacher-guided alignment mechanism is designed to align instruction-relevant visual tokens, transferring action-relevant grounding from instructions that satisfy the negated constraint. The training phase uses supervision constructed from existing demonstrations and updates only the inserted layers, keeping all pretrained parameters frozen, including the action generator. We further introduce NegaBench, a simulation benchmark spanning 10 scenarios across five domains for systematically evaluating manipulation under negated constraints. Experiments across GR00T, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements in negated instruction following. With 11.6M trainable parameters, NegaAlign increases the negated-instruction success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 2.60% to 88.45% on NegaBench and from 12.4% to 88.8% on real-world tasks, while retaining performance on affirmative instructions.

AI.tldr: 提出 NegaAlign，一种参数高效、即插即用的框架，通过图像-语言监督扩展预训练 VLA 模型以遵循否定指令，并构建 NegaBench 基准进行评测。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）已能执行自然语言指定的任务，但用户除表达目标外还需指定"不应做"的约束。如何让 VLA 在完成任务目标的同时遵守显式排除条件（否定指令），是当前人机交互中的空白与需求。
AI.method: 1) 在视觉-语言骨干的选定层中插入 Negation Transformation Layers，重塑中间指令表征；2) 设计教师引导的对齐机制，对齐与指令相关的视觉 token，从满足否定约束的指令中迁移动作相关 grounding；3) 训练仅用现有演示构造的监督，只更新插入层，冻结全部预训练参数（含动作生成器），实现参数高效与即插即用。
AI.result: 在 GR00T、π₀、π₀.₅ 上均取得一致的否定指令遵循提升。仅 11.6M 可训练参数下，π₀.₅ 在 NegaBench 上否定指令成功率由 2.60% 升至 88.45%，在真实任务上由 12.4% 升至 88.8%，同时保持对肯定指令的性能。并构建了覆盖五大领域 10 个场景的仿真基准 NegaBench。
AI.conclusion: NegaAlign 以极小参数量显著提升了 VLA 对否定指令的遵循能力，且不损害原有肯定指令性能，验证了方法的有效性与通用性。

title: Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning for Temporally Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: A generated video of a task the robot is about to perform is useful guidance only if it depicts the phase the robot is actually in. We show that temporal misalignment can turn a task-consistent generated future into actively harmful guidance. On CALVIN, a five-frame early shift nearly erases the benefit of generated futures, reducing success from 81.3% to 54.8% against 54.0% without futures; imposed timing shifts reduce it even further to 34.2%, 19.8 points below the future-free policy. We introduce Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning (RAFC), which treats this as a control problem rather than a generation problem. At every step, RAFC estimates how far to trust the received clip and which nearby temporal hypothesis to prefer, falling back toward a static branch when neither fits, and it learns both from task reward alone without shift labels or alignment supervision. RAFC sits on top of Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), which builds the clip once from task grounding, a robot-free digital-twin rollout, and mask-free video diffusion. Under deliberately off-grid phase shifts and rate mismatch, RAFC substantially improves success under temporal mismatch. Candidate ensembling accounts for most of the recovery near alignment, while learned reliability adds a further 7.0 percentage points over uniform averaging of the identical candidate bank under off-grid shifts. The gain holds on the evaluated task sets and survives on a Franka under natural timing mismatch nobody imposed, where aggregate success rises from 26.7% to 56.7%. All resources will be made publicly available. https://future-condition.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 生成未来视频若与机器人当前所处阶段存在时间错位，会从有益指导变为有害干扰；作者提出可靠性感知未来条件化（RAFC），把时间错位当作控制问题，用任务奖励自学习地选择信任度与时间假设，在CALVIN与Franka上显著恢复并提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 生成式未来视频被广泛用作机器人任务引导，但视频只有在刻画出机器人当前真实所处阶段时才有用。作者指出：时间错位会让一个任务内容一致的生成未来变成主动有害的引导，而现有工作多关注生成质量，忽视了"何时该信、信哪一段"这一时序对齐问题。
AI.method: 将时序对齐重新定义为控制问题而非生成问题。底层为Future-Experience Conditioning（FEC）：基于任务 grounding、无机器人数字孪生 rollout 与无掩码视频扩散一次性构建视频片段。在其上提出 Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning（RAFC）：每步估计对该片段的信任程度，并在邻近的多个时间假设中选择更合适的一个；若两者都不匹配则回退到静态分支。训练仅使用任务奖励，不需要偏移标签或对齐监督，并采用候选集成。
AI.result: CALVIN上提前五帧的偏移几乎抹平生成未来的收益，成功率从81.3%降至54.8%（无未来为54.0%）；强加时序偏移进一步降至34.2%，比无未来策略低19.8个百分点。在刻意非网格相位偏移与速率失配下，RAFC大幅提升成功；接近对齐时候选集成贡献了大部分恢复，而在非网格偏移下学习到的可靠性比同一候选库的均匀平均再提升7.0个百分点。在自然时序失配（非人为施加）的Franka上，总体成功率从26.7%提升至56.7%。
AI.conclusion: 时序错位是生成式未来引导的关键失效模式，将其建模为可学习的可靠性控制问题（RAFC）能有效缓解时序失配，并在不同任务集和真实机器人自然错配场景下稳定提升成功率；相关资源将公开。

title: CAPABLE: Capability-Aware Policy Adaptation via Behavioral Latent Encoding
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies assume the embodiment on which they were trained and can fail when a joint fault changes how commanded actions are physically executed. Existing fault-recovery methods often require task-specific retraining, fault labels, explicit diagnosis, or privileged embodiment information. We introduce CAPABLE, a unified capability-aware adaptation framework for frozen VLAs that integrates self-supervised capability inference with residual reinforcement learning. CAPABLE infers capability, how much of the commanded motion each joint actually realizes and how that motion contributes to end-effector behavior, online from command-response history and kinematics using a temporal encoder shared across joints, Jacobian grounding, cross-joint attention, and self-supervised physical prediction. The resulting representation conditions a residual policy that adds bounded corrections to the VLA arm action without fault labels or faulty-joint identifiers. Across 28 LIBERO tasks, CAPABLE raises success on an actuator excluded from fault training from 24.8% to 59.3%, outperforming a parameter-matched global-history baseline by 17.4 points while preserving healthy performance. Leave-one-actuator-out experiments across six joints show that this transfer is not specific to one actuator, and additional evaluations characterize transfer to unseen fault families and demonstrate recovery on a physical Franka Panda. https://capable-vla.github.io/

AI.tldr: CAPABLE 提出一种面向冻结 VLA 策略的统一"能力感知"自适应框架，将自监督能力推断与残差强化学习结合，在无故障标签、无故障关节标识的情况下实现关节故障下的在线恢复。
AI.motivation: VLA 策略默认训练时的本体结构不变，当关节故障改变指令动作的物理执行方式时会失效。现有故障恢复方法通常需要任务特定重训、故障标签、显式诊断或特权本体信息，泛化性与部署成本受限。本文希望在不改动冻结 VLA、不依赖上述额外信息的前提下实现在线自适应恢复。
AI.method: CAPABLE 由两部分组成：(1) 自监督能力推断，利用跨关节共享的时序编码器、雅可比（Jacobian）接地、跨关节注意力与自监督物理预测，从指令-响应历史与运动学中在线推断每个关节的"能力"——即实际执行了多少指令运动以及该运动对末端执行器行为贡献几何；(2) 以该能力表征为条件训练残差策略，在 VLA 的机械臂动作上叠加有界修正，整个过程不依赖故障标签与故障关节标识。
AI.result: 在 28 个 LIBERO 任务上，对一个被排除在故障训练之外的执行器，成功率从 24.8% 提升至 59.3%，比参数量匹配的全局历史基线高 17.4 个百分点，同时保持健康状态下的性能。六关节的留一执行器（leave-one-actuator-out）实验表明该迁移并非只针对某一执行器；额外评估还刻画了向未见故障族的迁移，并在实体 Franka Panda 上展示了恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过自监督能力推断驱动残差 RL，可在不重训、不诊断、不访问特权本体的条件下赋予冻结 VLA 通用的故障适应能力，且跨执行器、跨故障族及真实机器人均具备一定泛化性。

title: Predicting Cable Dynamics with Physical Attention Bias
summary: Learned simulators for deformable linear objects (DLOs) such as cables have to predict the motion of cables they were not trained on and stay stable over long rollouts. Most of their error occurs where the cable touches itself or the floor. Attention over all pairs of cable segments can represent contact between parts of the cable that are far apart along its length, but attention has no notion of geometry. A cable has two pairwise distances, which agree only while it is straight: the arc-length distance along the cable, which governs elastic forces, and the Euclidean distance in space, which governs contact. We add a physical attention bias, an additive term on the attention logits with a learned rate, and ask which distance it should use. We compare no bias, each distance alone, and both distances on disjoint sets of heads, keeping the rest of the model and the training protocol fixed. A physical bias improves prediction on unseen cables. The gain is largest when attention is the only mechanism that connects distant segments: there, the arc-length bias reduces prediction error by 15% and more than halves the drift in segment length. The Euclidean bias alone stays close to unbiased attention, while assigning both distances across heads is best or near-best on every metric we report. Code and per-run records: https://github.com/avihaig/dlogps.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究可变形线状物体(DLO,如线缆)学习型仿真器的泛化与长期稳定性问题,提出在注意力logits上加入"物理注意力偏置",并系统比较弧长距离、欧氏距离及二者分头组合的效果。
AI.motivation: 学习型线缆仿真器需预测未训练过的线缆并保持长程稳健,而大部分误差发生在自接触或与地面接触处;全局注意力能建模远距离段间的接触,却缺乏几何概念。线缆存在两种成对距离(弧长距离约束弹性力、欧氏距离约束接触),仅在伸直时一致,因此需要探究注意力应使用哪种距离。
AI.method: 在注意力logits上添加带可学习速率的加性物理偏置项,在保持模型其余部分与训练协议不变的前提下,对比:无偏置、仅弧长距离偏置、仅欧氏距离偏置,以及将两种距离分配到不同注意力头上的组合方案。
AI.result: 物理偏置提升了在未见线缆上的预测性能;当注意力是连接远距离段唯一机制时增益最大,弧长偏置使预测误差降低15%并将段长漂移减半以上;仅欧氏偏置与无偏置接近;两种距离分头分配在各项指标上均最优或接近最优。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的物理注意力偏置能有效改善DLO学习型仿真器对未见线缆的预测精度与长期稳定性,且弧长距离在弹性主导场景中尤为关键,联合使用两种距离最为稳健。代码与逐次运行记录已公开。

title: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026 as Spotlight. Project page: https://react-vla.github.io
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REACT——一种滚动去噪（rolling-denoising）框架，使基于流的VLA模型在保持长时域上下文的同时更具反应性：通过维护带错位流时间步的持久动作缓冲区，每步用最新观测对全时域去噪、执行最纯净的动作块、前移已部分精炼的未来块并在尾部追加新噪声，并配合双解耦实现实时控制。
AI.motivation: 基于流的VLA模型生成动作块（action chunk）以支持时序连贯的机器人运动，但分块控制存在闭环权衡：长块执行平滑，频繁重规划（replanning）提升反应性却带来动作不连续。作者希望在保留长时域上下文的同时提升反应性，兼顾平滑与低延迟。
AI.method: REACT不从头重新生成整段动作块，而是维护一个持久的动作缓冲区，其中各块处于错位的流时间步（staggered flow timesteps）。每个控制步：用最新观测对整个时域做去噪；执行最纯净（cleanest）的动作块；将部分精炼的未来块向前平移；并在尾部追加新噪声。由此每个被执行的动作块在部署前经历多次近期观测的精炼。为支持实时控制，还提出双解耦（dual decoupling），将感知、VLM编码、DiT去噪与动作执行分离，从而在现实算力约束下实现高频观测更新与动作流式输出。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准以及跨多个机器人平台的双臂操作与动态控制真实任务上，REACT相较频繁重规划与异步基线在任务成功率上更高、反应延迟更低，并且轨迹更平滑。
AI.conclusion: REACT通过滚动去噪与双解耦机制，缓解了动作块控制中平滑性与反应性之间的闭环权衡，在仿真与真实机器人任务中同时提升了成功率、降低了反应延迟并改善了轨迹平滑度。

title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.

AI.tldr: 提出 HWAM（人形世界动作模型），通过联合生成参考动作与执行后本体状态来显式建模"动作–执行差距"，在三项真机任务上取得最高成功率（如 Candy Picking 70.6% vs Fast-WAM 43.3%）。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人通用操作中，VLA 与 WAM 策略输出的是参考动作，需经全身控制、机器人动力学、平衡与接触等环节才被真正执行。这一层级结构导致"动作–执行差距"：策略给出的参考动作与机器人实际实现的运动不一致。若不对实际执行的身体状态显式建模，未来视觉预测就必须同时解释场景演化与参考–执行偏差，难以将动作与其物理结果对应。
AI.method: HWAM 将机器人执行后的本体感知状态作为显式预测目标，联合生成参考动作与其实现的身体状态，把执行运动监督直接引入动作学习。训练包含三条互补的条件路径：Policy 路径仅在当前观测条件下联合去噪状态–动作轨迹，匹配部署条件；Forward Dynamics Modeling（FDM）以动作与执行后状态为条件预测未来视觉观测；Inverse Dynamics Modeling（IDM）从视觉转移重建联合轨迹。三者共同连接策略参考、实际身体运动与视觉结果。
AI.result: 在 LimX OLI 人形机器人的三项真机任务上，HWAM 在所有评估基线中取得最高成功率。在 Candy Picking 任务上成功率为 70.6%，而 Fast-WAM 为 43.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模执行后本体状态、联合生成状态–动作轨迹，可有效缓解分层人形系统中的动作–执行差距，提升真实机器人操作策略的性能。

title: Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems
summary: Robotic systems operating over extended tasks must maintain a world state assembled from observations arriving at different times, with varying confidence and potential revisions. Conventional representations emphasize latest estimates, hindering fact provenance, decision reproduction, or execution auditing. We present Traceable World State (TWS), a middleware-neutral semantic representation and reference runtime for provenance-aware robot world state. A TWS snapshot captures entities, relations, observations, confidence, and revision metadata. Validated update operations transform snapshots immutably, ordered updates support deterministic replay, and a canonical SHA-256 hash chain ensures tamper-evident logs. We evaluate TWS through schema conformance, complete state lifecycles, deterministic replay, and fault injection. Passing 38 tests across Python 3.10-3.14, the framework detects record corruptions, broken hash links, sequence discontinuities, and world mismatches. Across ten public BEHAVIOR-1K task definitions, TWS imported 153 entities and 146 relations with successful validation. On 103 NVIDIA Unitree G1 simulated trajectories containing 78,369 frames, TWS achieved exact terminal-state replay in all episodes and detected 412/412 injected corruptions with a 1.72% storage overhead over Plain JSONL.

AI.tldr: TWS：可溯源机器人世界状态表示与运行框架，支持不可变更新、确定性重放与哈希链防篡改。
AI.motivation: 长时机器人任务中世界状态由异时观测拼接，观测置信度不一且可能修正；传统最新估计式表示难以追溯事实来源、复现决策或审计执行过程。
AI.method: 提出中间件中立的语义表示与参考运行时TWS。快照记录实体、关系、观测、置信度与修订元数据；经校验的更新操作以不可变方式变换快照；有序更新支持确定性重放；规范SHA-256哈希链实现防篡改日志。评估涵盖模式一致性、状态生命周期、确定性重放与故障注入。
AI.result: Python 3.10-3.14 下38项测试通过，可检测记录损坏、哈希断链、序列不连续与世界状态不匹配。十个BEHAVIOR-1K公开任务定义中导入153个实体、146个关系并验证成功。103条NVIDIA Unitree G1仿真轨迹（78,369帧）中全部轨迹实现终端状态精确重放，检测出412/412注入损坏，相对Plain JSONL存储开销1.72%。
AI.conclusion: TWS在不显著增加存储开销的前提下，为机器人世界状态提供可溯源、可重放、可审计的表示与运行时，适用于长时任务的执行审计与故障诊断场景。

title: SkillWeave: Weaving Heterogeneous Demonstrations into Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills
comment: IROS 2026 Workshop on Haptics and Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires both large-scale task progression and precise contact-rich interaction, making it challenging to collect demonstrations that effectively support both regimes. We present SkillWeave, a heterogeneous demonstration framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that combines teleoperation for coarse reaching and transport with kinesthetic teaching for precise, contact-rich skills. To address the visual mismatch introduced by the demonstrator's presence during kinesthetic data collection, we propose an object-mask-conditioned diffusion policy that uses offline object segmentation for training supervision and a lightweight learned mask predictor at deployment, avoiding online segmentation and image inpainting. To mitigate distribution shift between independently trained sub-task policies, we introduce successor-aware terminal steering, which selects among actions sampled from the predecessor policy to guide the system toward states supported by the successor's demonstrated initial-state distribution. Across three real-world long-horizon tasks, SkillWeave achieves 27% average end-to-end success. Mask-conditioned kinesthetic policies improve dexterous sub-task success to an average of 65%, while successor-aware handoffs achieve an average composition efficiency of 87%. These results show that matching demonstration modality to interaction regime, explicitly addressing kinesthetic visual mismatch, and steering policy handoffs toward successor-supported states substantially improves long-horizon dexterous manipulation. Videos and code are available at skillweave-authors.github.io .

AI.tldr: SkillWeave 提出一种异构示范框架，用遥操作采集粗粒度移动、用动觉示教采集精细接触技能，并结合物体掩码条件扩散策略与后继感知终端引导，在三个真实长时程灵巧操作任务上实现27%端到端成功率。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作既需要大范围的任务推进，又需要精细的接触丰富交互，单一示范采集方式难以同时有效支撑这两种模式；同时动觉示教中演示者存在会引入视觉不匹配，独立训练的子任务策略之间存在分布偏移。
AI.method: 1) 异构示范框架：遥操作负责粗粒度接近与搬运，动觉示教负责精细接触丰富技能；2) 物体掩码条件扩散策略：训练时用离线物体分割作监督，部署时用轻量学到的掩码预测器，避免在线分割与图像修复；3) 后继感知终端引导：在前驱策略采样动作中选择能引导系统进入后继策略示范初始状态分布支持区域的行动。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界长时程任务上平均端到端成功率27%；掩码条件动觉策略将灵巧子任务成功率提升至平均65%；后继感知交接实现平均87%的组合效率。
AI.conclusion: 将示范模态与交互模式匹配、显式处理动觉视觉不匹配、并引导策略交接朝向后继支持状态，可显著提升长时程灵巧操作性能。

title: ManiUnit: A Manipulation Skill Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate multi-room environments and execute a sequence of manipulation skills under a single natural language instruction. Learning and evaluating these skills present three challenges: similar observations under a fixed task instruction may make skill selection ambiguous; even when a preceding skill succeeds, the robot state inherited by the next skill may deviate from its demonstrated starting states and affect execution; and task-level metrics hinder skill-specific diagnosis, while early failures leave later skills untested. We therefore introduce ManiUnit, a manipulation skill dataset and benchmark built from 50 BEHAVIOR-1K activities. Its dataset contains 137,899 segments across 21 skill types and 417 subtasks, and its benchmark contains 1,260 test instances. Correspondingly, ManiUnit pairs each segment with an explicit subtask instruction; measures sensitivity to perturbations of the robot's starting base position or joint configuration; and restores intermediate simulator states and defines local success conditions so that each skill can be evaluated without executing preceding stages. Evaluations of representative vision-language-action (VLA) policies show that similar aggregate scores can hide substantial per-skill differences. The tested starting-state perturbations also degrade execution: on the full benchmark, joint perturbations reduce success rates by approximately 56% relative to those from demonstrated starting states. On two long-horizon activities, a skill policy trained on ManiUnit segments achieves 78.7% local manipulation success, compared with 49.3% for a task policy trained on complete demonstrations. The trained skills further support complete-task execution on these activities, as coordinating the task and skill policies through a planner raises full-task success from 4.0% to 18.0%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ManiUnit——一个面向长时程移动操作的操作技能数据集与基准，含137,899个片段、21类技能、417个子任务及1,260个测试实例，通过子任务指令、起始状态扰动敏感度评测和中间状态恢复实现技能级诊断。
AI.motivation: 长时程移动操作需在多房间环境中按单条自然语言指令依次完成多项操作技能，但现有学习与评测面临三大挑战：固定任务指令下相似观测导致技能选择歧义；前序技能成功后机器人状态偏离演示起始状态而影响后续执行；任务级指标难以定位具体技能问题且早期失败使后续技能无法被测试。
AI.method: 基于50项BEHAVIOR-1K活动构建ManiUnit数据集与基准。数据集包含137,899个片段，覆盖21种技能类型与417个子任务；基准含1,260个测试实例。为每个片段配以显式子任务指令；评测机器人基座位置或关节构型的起始状态扰动敏感度；恢复中间仿真状态并定义局部成功条件，使各技能无需执行前序阶段即可独立评测。
AI.result: 对代表性VLA策略的评测显示，相似的总体得分掩盖了显著的技能间差异。起始状态扰动造成性能退化：在完整基准上，关节扰动使成功率相对演示起始状态降低约56%。在两项长时程活动上，基于ManiUnit片段训练的技能策略取得78.7%的局部操作成功率，而基于完整演示训练的任务策略仅49.3%。训练所得技能进一步支持完整任务执行：通过规划器协调任务策略与技能策略，将全任务成功率由4.0%提升至18.0%。
AI.conclusion: ManiUnit通过技能级指令标注、起始状态扰动评测与中间状态恢复，实现了长时程移动操作的可诊断、可分解评测，揭示聚合指标的掩盖效应与起始状态偏差的影响，并证明技能级训练与任务—技能规划协调能有效提升局部操作与全任务成功率。

title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 27 pages, 11 figures and 13 tables. Under review
summary: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce UNITAS, to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, UNITAS achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UNITAS，首个3D原生世界动作模型（WAM），在统一度量3D坐标系中融合观测、动作与场景动态，用动作流和场景流表示机器人与人手操作，实现动作执行与场景预测。
AI.motivation: 现有WAM多基于预训练视频生成器，以图像或视觉潜变量表示世界演化；但机器人交互发生在度量三维空间，图像是视角相关的投影，其像素距离无法直接编码物理距离，导致表示与物理现实不匹配。
