AI.method: UNITAS在每个交互内将观测、动作和场景动态统一到共享的度量3D坐标系，并跨机器人本体与人手使用同一表示。动作流将人手与机器人夹爪表示为3D点轨迹，场景流描述以这些轨迹为条件的场景点位移。采用世界对齐的3D位置嵌入，在有/无深度输入时均能锚定视觉token；物理时间轨迹分词器将每条点轨迹编码为一个锚定于其当前3D位置的token。该接口同时支持直接动作执行与动作条件场景预测。模型规模1.7B参数。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin的动作条件场景预测任务上优于对比方法，位移误差比PointWorld最高降低49%；操作成功率取得SOTA，LIBERO达99.8%，真实任务平均85%。
AI.conclusion: UNITAS以3D原生统一表示实现了跨本体的动作与场景动态建模，验证了度量3D空间表示在世界动作模型中的有效性，兼顾动作执行与场景预测。代码已开源。

title: PIER: An Evidence-Gated Execution Interface for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Ancillary files include reproducibility code and retained experimental records
summary: Generating a plausible robot action does not establish that current observations justify its execution. Motivated by exploratory observations of high-confidence visual outputs under severe occlusion, we present PIER, an execution-authorization interface that separates evidence checks, decision provenance, and stage-scoped re-observation from hardware control. The deterministic gate evaluates declared visual and tactile inputs, while its caller maintains a budget of at most one re-observation per stage. We evaluate the implementation using 1,600 threshold-grid cases and 1,200 paired synthetic traces spanning score noise, missing tactile inputs, stale observations, and falsely reassuring scores. The finite grid yields zero declared invariant violations, and a matched Boolean baseline reproduces all non-recovery decisions. Under synthetic score noise, re-observation reduces valid-state denials from 57/120 to 18/120 while increasing invalid-state proceeds from 5/120 to 7/120. Stale and falsely reassuring inputs expose limitations that threshold checks alone cannot resolve. Exploratory visual, tactile, and robot setup records provide context but do not establish physical task performance. These results characterize an inspectable authorization interface and its input-contract limitations, without claiming superiority over equivalent rule logic, calibrated tactile accuracy, or certified physical safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIER——一种执行授权接口，将证据校验、决策溯源与阶段级重观测从硬件控制中解耦，通过确定性门控与每阶段至多一次重观测预算，刻画可审查的授权边界及其输入契约局限。
AI.motivation: 生成看似合理的机器人动作，并不等于当前观测就能证明执行该动作是正当的。作者受"严重遮挡下仍输出高置信度视觉结果"这一探索性观察启发，认为需要把"证据是否充分"的判断与动作执行分离，并检验其失效边界。
AI.method: PIER是一种执行授权接口，将证据检查、决策溯源、阶段级重观测与硬件控制解耦。确定性门控对声明的视觉与触觉输入进行评估，调用方维护每阶段至多一次重观测的预算。评估使用1,600个阈值网格用例与1,200条配对合成轨迹，覆盖分数噪声、触觉输入缺失、陈旧观测与虚假安心分数；并设置匹配的布尔基线进行对照。
AI.result: 有限网格上声明的不变量违例为零，匹配布尔基线可复现全部非恢复类决策。在合成分数噪声下，重观测将有效状态被拒由57/120降至18/120，同时使无效状态下继续执行由5/120升至7/120。陈旧输入与虚假安心分数暴露了仅靠阈值检查无法解决的局限。探索性视觉、触觉与机器人搭建记录仅提供背景，不构成物理任务性能证据。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了一个可审查的授权接口及其输入契约局限，并未主张其优于等价规则逻辑、已标定的触觉精度或经认证的物理安全。核心贡献在于把"授权"作为可检查、可溯源、带重观测预算的独立层次加以形式化与压力测试。

title: Leveraging Human-In-The-Loop Demonstrations in Reinforcement Learning for Digital Twin-Driven Robot Flexibility
summary: Growing automation makes collaborative robots work in more variable environments, increasing the need for adaptation. We propose a human-in-the-loop online training framework combining a digital twin (DT), reinforcement learning (RL), and human demonstrations. Unlike DTs used mainly to generate synthetic data before task execution, our DT is synchronized with the physical system in real time through camera feeds, allowing the virtual robot to update its observations and policy from real-world feedback. A dual actor framework integrates imitation learning (IL) without adding a direct imitation loss to the RL actor, so demonstrations can guide adaptation instead of manual reprogramming. The proposed framework is demonstrated on the Ufactory Xarm5 collaborative robot, where the robot's end-effector aims to reach the target position while avoiding obstacles. The experiments show that the framework can resume training after a change in the physical workspace and that, with a fixed set of non-optimal demonstrations, the dual actor framework achieves a much higher final success rate than two methods that add an imitation loss to the actor. The same pattern holds with real human demonstrations collected in virtual reality (VR): with demonstrations that never reach the goal, the dual actor framework reached 83-100% mean deterministic evaluation success, against 0-17% for the two imitation-loss methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种人在回路（human-in-the-loop）在线训练框架，将数字孪生、强化学习与人类示范相结合，实现对协作机器人环境变化的快速适应，且不依赖人工重编程。
AI.motivation: 自动化程度提高使协作机器人面临更易变的工作环境，任务执行前生成的静态数字孪生难以应对运行中的环境变化，而人工重编程成本高，因此需要一种能在运行中持续适应的训练方案。
AI.method: 构建与物理系统通过摄像头实时同步的数字孪生，使虚拟机器人能基于真实反馈更新观测与策略；并提出双演员（dual actor）框架，将模仿学习与强化学习解耦，不在RL演员上添加直接模仿损失，从而让人类示范用于引导适应而非被强制复制。
AI.result: 在Ufactory Xarm5协作机械臂末端避障到达任务上验证：物理工作空间变化后框架能恢复训练；在固定非最优示范下，双演员框架最终成功率显著高于两种在演员中加入模仿损失的方法。使用VR采集的真实人类示范（示范从未到达目标）时，双演员框架平均确定性评估成功率为83–100%，而两种模仿损失方法仅为0–17%。
AI.conclusion: 实时同步的数字孪生结合双演员模仿-强化学习框架，可在示范质量不足的情况下有效支持协作机器人在线适应，优于传统模仿损失方案。

title: Instance-anchored interaction evidence: Grounding robot plans in human pointing and handling
summary: A robot that assists people must often act on what a person has shown rather than said: which of several identical cartons was pointed at, or which box was handled. The plan is executed from the final scene, whereas the evidence occurs earlier, possibly on objects that have since moved. We propose instance-anchored interaction evidence (IAE), which registers every object of the final scene to its public identifier, keeps each identity through the video by backward mask propagation, and describes every frame by the geometry between hands, forearms and these instances. An evidence network trained only from task outcomes scores the instances. For pointing tasks, a grammar-constrained dynamic program trained with a structured loss decodes object-destination programs; symbolic programs handle reference disambiguation and, without learning, episodic tasks. On 1,255 WatchAct benchmark requests, scored by symbolic execution, IAE reaches 64.2% plan success on implicit-intent tasks against 27.5% for a 32B vision-language model (strict success 49.7% against 15.4%), and 46.4% against 27.0% on restoration, reversal and imitation without task-specific training. Controls with the same perception overlays, the same 32 frames, forward tracking, or a relation model trained on the same labels do not explain the gain. Given IAE's evidence as text with its meaning explained, the same language model reaches 57.4%: most of the gain comes from the instance-anchored evidence, and the explicit programs add 6.8 points at a fraction of the cost. Pointing remains the hardest case, with 16.9% strict success. The code is available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/iae-watchact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“实例锚定的交互证据”（IAE），将最终场景中每个物体与其公开标识符绑定，通过反向掩码传播在整段视频中保持身份，并用“手—前臂—实例”之间的几何关系描述每一帧，再由仅利用任务结果训练的“证据网络”对实例打分。指向类任务用受语法约束的动态规划与结构化损失解码“物体—目的地”程序，符号程序负责指代消歧并可在不学习的情况下完成情景任务。在WatchAct的1255条请求上，IAE在隐式意图任务上达到64.2%计划成功率（严格成功49.7%），远超32B视觉语言模型的27.5%（严格15.4%），在复位、反转与模仿任务上为46.4%对27.0%且无需任务特定训练；将证据以文本形式提供给同一语言模型仅得57.4%，说明主要增益来自实例锚定证据，显式程序再额外贡献6.8个百分点。指向仍是最难情形，严格成功仅16.9%。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要依据“人展示了什么”而非“人说了什么”来行动，例如在多个相同纸箱中识别被指向或搬运过的那一个。关键困难在于：决策要在最终场景执行，而证据发生在更早时刻，且涉及的对象可能已经移动。因此需要一种能把最终场景的实例与历史交互证据对应起来的表示方法。
AI.method: 提出实例锚定的交互证据（IAE）：(1) 将最终场景中每个物体注册到其公开标识符，并通过反向掩码传播在视频中保持身份；(2) 用“手、前臂与这些实例之间的几何关系”描述每帧；(3) 用仅从任务结果训练的证据网络对实例打分；(4) 指向任务用受语法约束的动态规划结合结构化损失解码“物体—目的地”程序；(5) 用符号程序处理指代消歧，并无需学习地完成情景任务。
AI.result: 在WatchAct基准的1255条请求上，以符号执行为评分标准：隐式意图任务中，IAE计划成功率达64.2%，而32B视觉语言模型为27.5%（严格成功分别为49.7%与15.4%）；在复位、反转与模仿任务上，IAE为46.4%，对照为27.0%，且未使用任务特定训练。相同感知叠加、相同32帧、前向跟踪或在同一标签上训练的关系模型等对照均无法解释该增益。将IAE证据以文本形式（并解释其含义）交给同一语言模型，仅达57.4%，说明主要增益来自实例锚定证据，显式程序在小成本下额外贡献6.8个百分点。指向仍是最困难情形，严格成功仅16.9%。
AI.conclusion: IAE通过在最终场景实例与历史交互证据之间建立身份对应，显著提升了对隐式意图与情景任务的计划成功率，且增益主要来自实例锚定证据本身而非模型规模或感知细节；显式符号程序以较低成本进一步提升性能，但指向类任务仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
summary: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间语言建模（Spatial Language Modeling），将场景轮廓、目标、动作目标与未来状态用离散坐标和语义token的统一词表表示，并由任务特定语法组织成空间序列，用单个自回归Transformer以统一的下一token预测目标同时学习动作生成与动作条件状态预测。方法先在随机游玩数据上做转移预训练，再在专家示范上联合训练动作与状态，在Push-T仿真和真机上均取得有竞争力的表现，真机上任务成功率与目标覆盖率优于对比策略基线。
AI.motivation: 目标导向操作中，动作如何改变场景几何这一信息可为目标导向的操控提供补充监督，但现有方法通常只学习动作策略而忽略对动作引起状态变化的建模。作者希望用统一的序列建模框架，让动作生成与动作条件状态预测相互促进。
AI.method: 用离散坐标与语义token构成的共享词表表示场景轮廓、目标、动作目标和未来状态；通过任务特定语法将这些元素组织为空间序列，用单个自回归Transformer以共同的下一token目标学习动作生成与动作条件状态预测。训练分两阶段：先在随机游玩转移数据上预训练，再在专家示范上联合训练动作与状态。预训练中记录的动作坐标作为后续状态预测的条件但不计入预测损失；控制时模型只解码可执行的动作目标，并用新观测状态更新历史。
AI.result: 在Push-T仿真和真机上评估：仿真性能具有竞争力；真机上任务成功率和目标覆盖率高于所评估的真机策略基线。消融实验显示联合动作与状态序列训练可提升控制效果，随机游玩预训练带来进一步增益。在给定动作轨迹时，同一模型还能预测连续场景状态，捕捉推动的几何效应。
AI.conclusion: 将动作与动作条件状态预测统一为空间序列建模问题，可让动作生成与几何变化预测共享同一自回归模型并互相提供监督；联合训练和随机游玩预训练对控制性能均有增益，且模型具备预测动作所致场景状态变化的能力。

title: RESETTLE: Robotic Recovery through Disagreement-Triggered Retrieval and Efficient Corrective Control
summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires timely intervention to correct emerging deviations and restore progress after execution errors. However, recovery methods based on repeated vision-language reasoning or iterative online optimization can incur substantial latency, delaying intervention. To address these challenges, we introduce RESETTLE(Robotic rEcovery through diSagrEement-Triggered reTrievaL and Efficient Corrective Control), a model-agnostic framework that provides computationally efficient recovery at the action-execution interface of frozen robot policies. RESETTLE triggers recovery when two action proposals independently sampled under identical conditioning persistently disagree. It retrieves a same-task demonstration reference using an adapted V-JEPA encoder and combines a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual to execute one corrective action without online trajectory optimization or additional vision-language reasoning, then returns control to the base policy. Across six base policies in simulation, RESETTLE achieves up to 8.70%, 6.28%, and 6.83% absolute success-rate gains on LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World, and RoboCasa Tabletop, respectively, with further improvements on four real-world tasks using two policies. In QwenPI-based comparisons, its monitoring-and-recovery computation latency is 74.04%--93.57% lower than VoLoAgent's monitoring-and-planning latency for grasp and place tool calls. It also raises Harness VLA's LIBERO-Pro Swap success from 42% to 50%, demonstrating compatibility with high-level agentic planning. Code available at: https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE

AI.tldr: RESETTLE：一种模型无关、计算高效的机器人操作恢复框架，通过“双动作提案持续不一致”触发恢复，检索同任务演示并执行单步校正动作，在不做在线轨迹优化或额外VLM推理的前提下提升多种基座策略成功率并大幅降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中，执行偏差与错误需要及时干预以恢复进度；但现有基于反复视觉-语言推理或迭代在线优化的恢复方法延迟高，导致干预滞后。因此需要一种快速、低计算开销的恢复机制。
AI.method: 提出RESETTLE（Robotic rEcovery through diSagrEement-Triggered reTrieval and Efficient Corrective Control），作用于冻结策略的“动作-执行”接口。触发条件：在同一条件下独立采样的两个动作提案持续不一致时启动恢复。恢复过程使用适配的V-JEPA编码器检索同任务演示参考，结合状态伺服先验与受保护的视觉残差执行一次校正动作，无需在线轨迹优化或额外视觉-语言推理，随后把控制权交回基座策略。
AI.result: 在仿真中跨6个基座策略：LIBERO-Plus绝对成功率最高提升8.70%，Meta-World提升6.28%，RoboCasa Tabletop提升6.83%；在2个策略、4个真实任务上亦有进一步提升。基于QwenPI的对比中，其监控与恢复计算延迟比VoLoAgent的监控与规划延迟低74.04%–93.57%。并将Harness VLA在LIBERO-Pro Swap上的成功率从42%提升到50%。
AI.conclusion: RESETTLE以模型无关方式为冻结策略提供轻量、及时的恢复能力，在多个仿真与真实任务上稳定提升成功率，同时显著降低恢复延迟，并可与高层智能体规划兼容。代码已开源。

title: MiniWAM: Learning Compact Future Targets for Efficient World-Action Modeling
summary: World modeling has emerged as an effective co-training objective for robot policies, giving rise to World Action Models (WAMs) that jointly predict actions and future states. However, most WAMs predict future states in the native representation space of pretrained visual backbones, resulting in high-dimensional targets with substantial training cost. We introduce MiniWAM, which instead predicts compact future representations learned from privileged current-future transitions. To construct these targets, we propose Predictive Representations via Inverse Spatiotemporal Modeling (PRISM), which combines inverse-dynamics supervision with feature reconstruction to emphasize control-relevant transition information while preserving useful future-state information. With the learned PRISM encoder frozen, MiniWAM is trained to jointly predict the resulting targets and robot actions from current observations. With 65$\times$ fewer native future feature tokens, MiniWAM consistently outperforms native future-feature prediction with both DINOv3 and WAN2.1 VAE features, while achieving up to an 8$\times$ speedup in world-action training. At 0.25B parameters, MiniWAM is already competitive with substantially larger WAMs on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmarks. Representation analyses further show that PRISM contributes behavioral structure beyond feature reconstruction alone. These results demonstrate that effective world-action modeling does not require predicting native visual futures, and that compact predictive representations provide a strong and substantially more efficient target for policy learning. The project page is available at: https://j1dan.github.io/MiniWAM.

AI.tldr: MiniWAM 提出用紧凑的可预测表征替代原始视觉前向特征作为世界行动模型的预测目标，通过 PRISM 学习控制相关的未来表征，在 65 倍更少 token 的情况下性能更优且训练提速最高 8 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有世界行动模型（WAMs）大多在预训练视觉骨干的原始表征空间中预测未来状态，导致目标维度极高、训练成本巨大。因此需要一种更高效、仍保留控制相关信息的世界建模目标。
AI.method: 1) 提出 PRISM（Predictive Representations via Inverse Spatiotemporal Modeling），结合逆动力学监督与特征重建，从特权的当前-未来转移中学习紧凑的未来表征，以突出控制相关转移信息并保留有用的未来状态信息。2) 冻结 PRISM 编码器，训练 MiniWAM 从当前观测联合预测该紧凑目标与机器人动作。
AI.result: 在 DINOv3 与 WAN2.1 VAE 特征下，MiniWAM 仅用 65 倍更少的原始未来特征 token，却持续优于原始未来特征预测，世界-动作训练最高提速 8 倍；0.25B 参数下在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 仿真基准上与远大规模 WAMs 相当。表征分析表明 PRISM 在纯特征重建之外贡献了行为结构。
AI.conclusion: 有效的世界-行动建模不需要预测原始视觉未来；紧凑的可预测表征为策略学习提供了更强且显著更高效的目标。

title: MAP2: Model- and Acceleration-Based Pursuit with MPC and Gaussian Process Residual Learning for Autonomous Racing
summary: Autonomous racing requires accurate trajectory tracking near the handling limits of a vehicle while maintaining low computational latency. Geometric controllers are computationally efficient, but the Ackermann steering geometry becomes invalid under limit-handling conditions. Model- and Acceleration-based Pursuit (MAP) preserves the simplicity of geometric approaches while leveraging tire dynamics. Yet MAP remains fundamentally a geometric controller that relies on Ackermann steering geometry, and its tire model may not fully capture the vehicle's actual dynamic response. This paper presents MAP2, a model-based pursuit controller that combines a curvature-based kinematic MPC and a Sparse Gaussian Process (SGP) residual correction. The proposed algorithm uses MPC to optimize kinematic control inputs over a prediction horizon and maps them to steering commands through a tire dynamics model augmented with SGP residual correction. Real-world vehicle experiments demonstrate substantial reductions in lateral tracking error and lap time. Compared with MAP and Pure Pursuit (PP), MAP2 reduces the average lateral tracking error by 37.99% and 44.65%, respectively, while reducing average lap time by at least 1.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出MAP2控制器，结合曲率型运动学MPC与稀疏高斯过程残差校正，提升自动驾驶赛车极限工况下的轨迹跟踪精度与圈速。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶赛车需在车辆操控极限附近实现高精度轨迹跟踪且保持低计算延迟。几何控制器计算高效，但阿克曼转向几何在极限工况下失效；MAP虽保留几何方法的简洁性并利用轮胎动力学，但其本质上仍依赖阿克曼转向几何，且轮胎模型难以完全刻画车辆真实动力学响应。
AI.method: MAP2将基于曲率的运动学MPC与稀疏高斯过程（SGP）残差校正相结合：MPC在预测时域内优化运动学控制输入，并通过经SGP残差校正增强的轮胎动力学模型将其映射为转向指令。
AI.result: 实车实验表明横向跟踪误差与圈速显著降低。相比MAP与纯追踪（PP），MAP2平均横向跟踪误差分别降低37.99%与44.65%，平均圈速至少缩短1.5%。
AI.conclusion: MAP2在保持低计算延迟的同时，通过MPC与SGP残差校正融合运动学模型与轮胎动力学，有效提升极限工况下的轨迹跟踪性能与赛车速度。

title: Sim-to-Real RL for ASVs using SysID
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to ICRA 2027. Code available at: https://github.com/UMich-CURLY/ASTRA_RL/tree/df98e7fd01420163082255403f3b032e0d8d0d03
summary: Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) operating in dynamic marine environments require robust control policies for tasks such as path following and station keeping, making reinforcement learning (RL) a promising alternative to classical controllers. However, existing ASV simulators rarely support parallel environments for RL training. Such existing simulators require accurate hydrodynamic modeling from computational fluid dynamics solvers or towing tank tests for setting hydrodynamic parameters to address the sim-to-real gap. To address these challenges, we present an ASV simulator and accompanying pipeline that enables training policies starting from unknown vehicle dynamics. Our framework uses only a CAD model and brief set of open-water field trajectories for approximating and refining both hydrodynamic and thruster parameters. Real-world deployments on a BlueBoat ASV demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer in path following and station-keeping tasks without prior hydrodynamic and propeller information.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种ASV仿真器及配套流程，可在未知车辆动力学条件下训练强化学习控制策略，仅用CAD模型和少量开阔水域轨迹即可逼近并精化水动力与推进器参数，并在BlueBoat上实现零样本sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 动态海洋环境下的ASV（自主水面艇）在路径跟踪与定点保持任务中需要鲁棒控制策略，强化学习是经典控制器的有前景替代方案。然而，现有ASV仿真器很少支持RL训练所需的并行环境；同时，为缩小sim-to-real差距，它们通常依赖CFD求解器或拖曳水池试验获得精确的水动力参数，成本高且门槛大。
AI.method: 提出一个支持RL训练的ASV仿真器及配套训练流程，允许从未知车辆动力学出发学习策略。方法仅使用CAD模型和少量开阔水域实测轨迹，对水动力参数与推进器参数进行逼近和迭代精化，从而无需先验水动力与螺旋桨信息。
AI.result: 在BlueBoat ASV上的真实部署表明，在无先验水动力与螺旋桨信息的条件下，路径跟踪与定点保持任务实现了成功的零样本sim-to-real迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过可并行训练的仿真器与基于少量实测数据的参数辨识流程，降低了ASV强化学习控制策略的训练与部署门槛，验证了未知动力学条件下零样本sim-to-real迁移的可行性。

title: Residual Modeling Closes the Regression and Generative Policy Gap in Robot Learning
summary: Learning from demonstration has enabled impressive robot behaviors. A common choice for policy learning is to use diffusion or flow matching (Flow-Policies), which often outperforms direct action regression trained with mean squared error (MSE-Policies). This gap is commonly attributed to multimodal demonstrations. We revisit this gap from the perspective of statistical modeling: how action-prediction residuals shape policy optimization. Our analysis of real-world robot demonstration data reveals substantial state-dependent variation in residual scales and heavier-than-Gaussian tails. While both MSE-Policies and Flow-Policies exhibit heavy-tailed action residuals, their training gradients behave differently: MSE allocates more gradient magnitude to observations with large action residuals, which hurts optimization. Motivated by these findings, we introduce heteroscedastic Student-t action regression (HT-Policies), which learns input-dependent residual scales and reduces the influence of heavy tails. HT-Policies predict action chunks with a single feed-forward pass and can reuse pretrained flow-matching-based policy networks as the backbone. Across four simulation benchmarks and real-robot evaluations, HT-Policies achieves success rates competitive with generative policy baselines, both when trained from scratch and from pretrained vision-language-action and world-action models, despite being faster in training and inference. Together, these findings shed light on the practical advantages of generative objectives in robot learning from demonstrations and offer an efficient direct-regression alternative for a range of architectures and tasks. Project page: https://the-labone.github.io/regression-policy-project/

AI.tldr: 本文从统计建模角度重新审视生成式策略(Flow-Policies)优于MSE回归策略(MSE-Policies)的原因，发现动作残差存在显著的状态依赖尺度变化与重尾分布，进而提出异方差Student-t动作回归策略(HT-Policies)，在多个仿真与真机任务上取得与生成式策略相当的成功率，同时训练与推理更快。
AI.motivation: 机器人示教学习(demonstration)中，扩散或flow matching策略(Flow-Policies)通常优于以MSE训练的直接动作回归(MSE-Policies)，这一差距常被归因于演示数据的多模态性。作者希望从统计建模视角重新审视该差距，即动作预测残差如何影响策略优化。
AI.method: 作者先分析真实机器人演示数据，发现残差尺度存在显著的状态依赖变化且呈重尾(非高斯)分布；进一步分析梯度行为发现，MSE会把更大的梯度幅值分配给动作残差较大的观测，从而损害优化。基于此提出异方差Student-t动作回归(HT-Policies)：学习输入依赖的残差尺度，抑制重尾影响；以单次前馈预测动作块(action chunks)，并可复用预训练的flow-matching策略网络作为骨干。
AI.result: 在四个仿真基准与真机评测中，HT-Policies的成功率与生成式策略基线相当；无论从零训练，还是基于预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型与世界-动作模型训练，均表现出竞争力，同时在训练和推理上更快。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了生成式目标在机器人示教学习中具有实际优势的原因，并提供了一种高效的直接回归替代方案，可适用于多种架构与任务。

title: From Language to Motion: Task-Conditioned Focal-Stack Trajectory Integration for Microscopic Robots
summary: Microscopic robots require accurate task geometry despite changes in language, parts, and focus. We present a semantic-to-physical framework that maps instructions to constrained geometric operators, reuses frozen open-vocabulary perception, and integrates locally reliable focal-plane trajectories by confidence weighting and dynamic programming. Calibrated multi-view geometry connects 2-D paths to physical execution. Prompt, unseen-part, and geometry reconfiguration tests yield 6.30-6.59-pixel RMSE. Relative to part-specific U-Net training with 20-100 labels, the proposed zero-new-label configuration takes 15 rather than 72-165 min. Across nine part-illumination conditions, trajectory-space integration reduces RMSE from 14.41 to 6.28 pixels (56.4%) and P95 error from 20.07 to 8.13 pixels (59.5%) compared with image-first multi-focus fusion. An ablation isolates the roles of confidence and path-wise selection. In representative robot experiments, target-region coverage improves from 83.5% to 92.9%. Dispensing provides a measurable physical trace, not a task-specific limitation of the method.

AI.tldr: 提出语义到物理框架，将指令映射为受约束的几何算子，复用冻结的开放词汇感知，并通过置信度加权与动态规划融合局部可靠焦平面轨迹，实现显微机器人精确任务几何。
AI.motivation: 显微机器人需在语言、部件与焦点变化下仍保持准确的任务几何，而现有部件专用方法依赖大量标注且耗时长。
AI.method: 语义到物理框架：指令→受约束几何算子；复用冻结的开放词汇感知；以置信度加权和动态规划整合局部可靠的焦平面轨迹；用标定的多视角几何将2-D路径连接到物理执行。
AI.result: 提示、未见过部件、几何重构测试RMSE为6.30–6.59像素；相比20–100标签的部件专用U-Net训练，零新标签配置耗时15而非72–165分钟；九种部件-照明条件下，轨迹空间融合将RMSE从14.41降至6.28像素（56.4%），P95误差从20.07降至8.13像素（59.5%）；消融验证了置信度与逐路径选择的作用；代表性机器人实验中目标区域覆盖率由83.5%提升至92.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以零新标签实现跨语言、部件与焦点的鲁棒几何精度，并显著优于图像优先多焦融合，分液仅作为可测物理痕迹而非任务局限。

title: Fixed-Reference Pose Residuals for Measuring Cross-Dataset Cue Transfer in Human-Robot Interaction Anticipation
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Supplementary material available as an ancillary file
summary: Social and service robots in public spaces need to anticipate which nearby person is about to approach and touch them, so that a response can be prepared before contact. It is largely unknown which cues support this anticipation when a model trained with one robot is used on another robot at a different site. We study this question with a fixed-reference pose residual (FRPR) model: a geometry predictor built from the person's bounding box and mask is trained and frozen, and a temporal network then learns from body pose an additive correction to its logit, so that every prediction splits exactly into a geometry term and a pose term. Between two public egocentric datasets recorded by different robots, HUI360 and SSUP-A, with every choice made on source data, the pose correction raised average precision (AP) from 0.277 to 0.321 from SSUP-A to HUI360 and gave no measurable gain in the opposite direction; the same asymmetry held over a stronger, source-selected geometry reference. Freezing gave no AP advantage over joint training, and simple geometric baselines and tree ensembles remained competitive or better, so the construction serves measurement rather than prediction accuracy. A head-orientation residual added small gains in both directions. Post hoc, whether a person faces the camera kept its discriminative direction across datasets, whereas head pitch reversed. With thresholds chosen on source data, the neural models that use geometry detected at most 17% of target interactions. Code and processed data are available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/FRPR-interaction-anticipation.

AI.tldr: 提出固定参考姿态残差（FRPR）模型，将交互预测分解为几何项与姿态项，用于跨机器人跨场地测量姿态线索的迁移性，发现姿态修正的增益方向不对称，该构造服务于测量而非提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 公共空间中的社交与服务机器人需要在接触前预判哪位附近行人即将靠近并触碰自己。当把一个机器人上训练的模型用于另一场地、另一机器人时，哪些线索支持这种预判尚不清楚，因此需要一个可分离线索贡献的测量框架。
AI.method: 构建FRPR模型：基于行人边界框与掩码训练的几何预测器被冻结，随后时序网络从身体姿态学习对其logit的加性修正，使每次预测严格分解为几何项与姿态项。在HUI360与SSUP-A两个不同机器人采集的公开第一人称数据集间互测，所有选择均在源域数据上做出；并加入头部朝向残差实验，与联合训练、简单几何基线及树集成进行对比。
AI.result: SSUP-A→HUI360时姿态修正将AP从0.277提升至0.321，反向无显著增益；该不对称性在更强的源域几何参考下依然存在。冻结未比联合训练带来AP优势，简单几何基线与树集成仍具竞争力甚至更优，说明该构造用于测量而非精度。头部朝向残差在两个方向均有小幅增益。事后分析显示"人是否面向相机"的判别方向跨数据集保持一致，而头部俯仰方向反转。以源域阈值选择时，使用几何的神经模型最多检测到17%的目标域交互。
AI.conclusion: FRPR将几何与姿态线索可加分离，为跨机器人、跨场地的接近-触碰预判线索迁移提供了测量工具；结果表明姿态修正的方向性增益不稳定，几何基线依然强劲，跨域阈值迁移下检测率低，代码与处理数据已开源。

title: Real-Time Motion Planning with Dynamic Hazards: Classical vs. Learning-Based Methods
comment: This paper is scheduled to be presented at the 2027 International Symposium on Artificial Life and Robotics (AROB 2027)
summary: We study real-time motion planning in dynamic hazard fields through a controlled comparison between classical planning and learning-based methods. Rather than introducing a new planner, we construct a unified benchmark in which representative classical and learning-based methods face the same environments, motion constraints, information assumptions, and evaluation metrics. The test environment consists of planar domains populated with rotating sprinkler-like hazards that generate time-varying forbidden regions via sweeping angular sectors. Our results show a clear regime shift. In deterministic environments, classical planners achieve near-perfect success and higher-quality paths, though sometimes at the cost of substantial planning or replanning time. Under stochastic obstacle dynamics, however, online search becomes strongly budget-sensitive: low budgets lead to frequent failure, while high budgets improve success at the cost of latency and longer trajectories. PPO-based policies, trained under the same scenario distribution, consistently outperform in latency, success rate, and path quality in these stochastic regimes. Overall, the results indicate that uncertainty in obstacle evolution, more than partial observability, is the dominant factor determining which planning paradigm is practically effective for the problem at hand.

AI.tldr: 通过统一基准对比经典规划与学习型方法在动态危险场中的实时运动规划，发现不确定性（而非部分可观测性）是决定规划范式有效性的主导因素。
AI.motivation: 动态危险场中的实时运动规划存在经典规划与学习型方法的路线之争，但缺乏在相同环境、约束、信息假设与评价指标下的受控对比，难以判断各范式的实际适用范围。
AI.method: 不提出新规划器，而是构建统一基准：在平面域中布置类旋转喷淋头危险源，通过扫掠角扇区生成时变禁行区域；让代表性经典方法与基于学习的方法（PPO策略）在相同环境、运动约束、信息假设和指标下接受测试，并设置确定性/随机障碍动力学及不同在线搜索预算。
AI.result: 出现明显范式转变：确定性环境下经典规划器成功率近满且路径质量更高，但规划/重规划耗时可能很高；随机障碍动力学下在线搜索对预算高度敏感，低预算频繁失败，高预算提升成功率但增加延迟与路径长度；PPO策略在随机情形下于延迟、成功率与路径质量上均稳定占优。
AI.conclusion: 障碍演化的不确定性比部分可观测性更能决定哪种规划范式在实际问题上有效，为方法选择提供了依据。

title: Walking on Roofs: Exploring the Potential of Walking Robots for Construction Work on Roofs
comment: Preprint of paper which appeared in the Proceedings of CLAWAR 2026, 29th International Conference on Climbing and Walking Robots and the Support Technologies for Mobile Machines, Cranfield University, Cranfield, Beford, United Kingdome, 2026
summary: This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying quadruped walking robots for the automation of work in roof environments. While quadrupeds have demonstrated versatility across various domains, their large-scale deployment remains limited, partly due to lack of application-specific designs. Roof environments represent a novel and unexplored use case, combining high safety risks for human workers with repetitive, strenuous tasks that could benefit from robotic assistance. A dedicated test rig of a roof's surface was designed to evaluate the baseline performance of a commercial quadruped, the \emph{Unitree Go2}, in this new environment. Experiments revealed that standard ball feet are inherently inadequate for locomotion on sloped roofs: slippage increased quadratically with incline angle, get-up and lie-down sequences were only possible on small inclines, and critical failures already occurred regularly on moderate inclines of 25°. This work provides the first systematic assessment of quadruped locomotion in roof environments, highlighting both the potential and the current limitations of this application and establishes a baseline for future research. Effective solutions will require a combination of task-oriented foot designs, advanced contact mechanics and environment-specific control strategies, such as reinforcement learning for roof-adapted gaits.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估四足机器人（Unitree Go2）在屋顶环境作业的可行性：在坡度屋顶测试平台上，标准球形足部因打滑等问题导致在25°中等坡度即频繁失效，表明当前商用四足尚不足以直接胜任屋顶作业，需针对性改进。
AI.motivation: 屋顶作业对人类工人存在高安全风险且任务重复、繁重，适合机器人替代；而四足机器人虽具通用性，却因缺乏面向具体应用的设计而难以大规模部署，屋顶这一场景此前尚未被探索。
AI.method: 搭建专用的屋顶表面测试平台，以商用四足机器人Unitree Go2为对象，在斜坡屋顶上开展基线性能测试，考察打滑、起卧动作及坡度临界失效等运动性能指标。
AI.result: 标准球形足在斜坡屋顶上运动能力不足：打滑随坡度呈二次增长；起身与趴下动作仅能在小坡度完成；在25°中等坡度上已频繁出现关键失效。
AI.conclusion: 这是对四足机器人在屋顶环境运动的首次系统评估，既揭示了应用潜力也明确了当前局限，为后续研究建立了基线；有效方案需结合任务导向的足部设计、先进接触力学及面向特定环境的控制策略（如基于强化学习的屋顶适配步态）。

title: Toward Lunar Legged Robots: Field Deployment Lessons at LUNA
comment: Proceeding to the IEEE iSparo Conference 2026
summary: Legged robots are promising candidates for future lunar surface missions because they can traverse steep, loose, and obstacle-rich terrain that challenges conventional wheeled rovers. However, readiness for lunar deployment is limited by uncertainties in foot-regolith interaction, dust generation, illumination-driven perception degradation, and operational constraints. This paper reports lessons from the 2025 LUNA analogue campaign, where ANYmal-D and Magnecko traversed loose regolith simulant and crater-like terrain and collected long-horizon navigation and visual-inertial data under challenging lighting. We show that quadrupedal robots can traverse regolith simulant, but performance is affected by sinkage and slip, dust-generating contacts, and perception failures caused by overexposure, shadows, and low-texture regions. These results motivate tighter integration of regolith-aware locomotion policies, illumination-robust perception, repeatable analogue testing, and mission-level operational validation for future lunar legged robots.

AI.tldr: 本文报告2025年LUNA模拟月面实验活动中ANYmal-D与Magnecko四足机器人在松散模拟月壤和类陨石坑地形上的长时导航与视觉惯性数据采集经验，揭示了足-壤相互作用、扬尘及光照导致感知退化等关键问题。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人因能穿越陡坡、松散及障碍密集地形，被视为未来月面任务的理想候选者，但其月球部署成熟度受限于足-月壤相互作用不确定性、扬尘、光照驱动的感知退化及任务运行约束等未解决问题。
AI.method: 依托2025年LUNA模拟实验活动，使用ANYmal-D与Magnecko两款足式机器人在松散模拟月壤和类陨石坑地形上行走，并在挑战性光照条件下采集长时导航与视觉惯性数据。
AI.result: 四足机器人能够穿越模拟月壤地形，但其性能受下沉与滑移、产生扬尘的足-地接触，以及过曝、阴影和低纹理区域导致的感知失效所影响。
AI.conclusion: 未来月球足式机器人需要更紧密地集成月壤感知的运动策略、光照鲁棒的感知能力、可复现的模拟测试流程以及任务级的运行验证。

title: PLaW-VLA: Predictive Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Learning to predict how the world evolves can provide vision-language-action (VLA) policies with predictive context for long-horizon control, but its effectiveness depends on what future representation is modeled and how it conditions action generation. We introduce PLaW-VLA, which models task-relevant future states in a pretrained prediction-oriented representation space, reducing the need to predict control-irrelevant visual details. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, PLaW-VLA conditions action generation on observation history, current task semantics, and predicted future states through structured causal attention. Experiments show a +11.8 percentage-point (pp) gain over reactive policies on RoboTwin Hard Horizon III and a +1.77 pp gain over reconstruction-oriented latent prediction on zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, supporting improved long-horizon control and generalization under distribution shift, respectively. By avoiding low-level visual reconstruction, PLaW-VLA lowers the burden of future prediction, enabling a lightweight latent world model with parallel future prediction and about 1/19 the inference latency of generative world-action modeling at comparable policy performance.

AI.tldr: PLaW-VLA 在预训练的预测导向表征空间中建模任务相关的未来状态，并通过结构化因果注意力让动作生成以观测历史、当前任务语义与预测未来状态为条件，从而提升长时程控制与泛化能力，同时降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 让 VLA 策略具备预测能力可为长时程控制提供预测性上下文，但其效果取决于"建模何种未来表征"以及"如何以此条件化动作生成"。现有做法的未来预测可能受控制无关视觉细节的干扰，或依赖低层视觉重建，增加预测负担。
AI.method: 提出 PLaW-VLA：在预训练的预测导向（prediction-oriented）隐空间中对任务相关的未来状态建模，避免预测控制无关的视觉细节；基于 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构，通过结构化因果注意力将动作生成条件化于观测历史、当前任务语义以及预测的未来状态；采用轻量隐式世界模型，支持并行未来预测。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin Hard Horizon III 上相比反应式（reactive）策略提升 11.8 个百分点；在零样本 LIBERO-Plus 上相比面向重建的隐式预测提升 1.77 个百分点。推理延迟约为生成式 world-action modeling 的 1/19，且在策略性能相当的情况下实现。
AI.conclusion: 避免低层视觉重建可降低未来预测负担，使轻量隐式世界模型成为可能，兼顾长时程控制能力、分布偏移下的泛化性与推理效率。

title: LiteNWM: Efficient Latent World Models for Onboard Visual Navigation in the Wild
summary: Direct visual navigation policies generate trajectories efficiently but do not explicitly evaluate their future consequences. Generative navigation world models provide this foresight through visual rollouts, which are costly when evaluating multiple candidates. We present LiteNWM, a latent navigation world model that shares visual encoding across candidates and jointly predicts their action-conditioned future representations at multiple horizons, while a learned scorer uses these predictions to select trajectories. In offline evaluations on RECON, SCAND, and SACSoN, LiteNWM reduces macro-averaged trajectory error by 17.56% relative to NoMaD+NWM-XL and achieves a 128.00-fold end-to-end speedup on an RTX 5090. The same evaluator transfers from NoMaD to MBRA without proposer-specific retraining, reducing MBRA's macro-averaged trajectory error by 16.2%. In real-robot experiments in unseen indoor and outdoor environments, LiteNWM improves navigation success from 43.3% to 83.3% relative to NoMaD. These results demonstrate that LiteNWM can be deployed for future-aware planning and closed-loop navigation on a physical robot.

AI.tldr: LiteNWM 是一种潜在导航世界模型，通过跨候选共享视觉编码并联合预测多时域动作条件下的未来表征，以低成本实现未来感知的轨迹选择与真实机器人闭环导航。
AI.motivation: 直接视觉导航策略虽能高效生成轨迹，却不显式评估未来后果；生成式导航世界模型虽能通过视觉 rollout 提供前瞻性，但在评估多个候选轨迹时计算代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出 LiteNWM：在潜在空间中构建导航世界模型，对多个候选轨迹共享视觉编码，联合预测其动作条件下的多时域未来表征；并训练一个评分器（scorer）利用这些预测结果选择轨迹。该评分器可在不同轨迹提议器之间迁移，无需针对特定提议器重新训练。
AI.result: 在 RECON、SCAND、SACSoN 离线评测中，相较 NoMaD+NWM-XL 将宏平均轨迹误差降低 17.56%，在 RTX 5090 上实现 128.00 倍端到端加速；评分器从 NoMaD 迁移至 MBRA 时无需重训，将 MBRA 宏平均轨迹误差降低 16.2%；在未见过的室内外真实环境中，导航成功率从 NoMaD 的 43.3% 提升至 83.3%。
AI.conclusion: LiteNWM 能够以低计算成本提供未来感知的规划能力，可部署于真实机器人实现闭环导航，并具备良好的跨提议器迁移性与泛化能力。

title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
summary: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出ARC方法，通过"推理配方"（推理轨迹+自动标注管线+模型适配）在无需新增机器人数据的情况下大幅提升现有RFM的零样本任务性能。
AI.motivation: 当前提升机器人基础模型（RFM）的主流路线依赖更大模型、更多示教数据和昂贵的规模化训练，成本高且效率低。作者希望找到一种高效且互补的替代方案，通过恰当的推理机制显著提升现有SOTA RFM的零样本性能。
AI.method: 提出ARC，包含三个关键要素：(1) 推理轨迹——应基于机器人的下一动作，并解释其因果结构（为何该动作合适、应产生何种效果）；(2) 可扩展的自动标注管线——从已有示教中自动生成推理轨迹，无需采集新数据，据此构建ARC-Trace-DROID；(3) 模型适配策略——针对不同架构和能力定制微调与推理，使VLA（如π_0.5）和WAM（如Cosmos3-Nano-Policy）等SOTA模型学会利用这些轨迹进行控制。
AI.result: 在无需额外机器人示教数据或基础规模训练的情况下取得前所未有的零样本性能提升：在RoboLab-120和MolmoSpaces上刷新SOTA，RoboLab-Reasoning-50上提升最多50个百分点；真实机器人上使π_0.5任务成功率提升82.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 恰当的推理配方可作为提升机器人基础模型能力的有效且高效的补充路径，与扩大模型和数据规模的路线形成互补，能在不增加数据采集与大规模训练成本的前提下显著改善零样本任务表现。

title: A Physics-Informed Collision Learning Framework for Collaborative Robot Motion Generation
summary: Close-proximity multi-arm manipulation requires collision models that are both geometrically accurate and differentiable enough for real-time optimization. Classical geometry checkers provide reliable distances but are difficult to use inside gradient-based model predictive control, while conservative proxy models can restrict tightly coupled motion. We present PI-UDF, a physics-informed unified differentiable framework for body-to-body collision distance prediction between articulated robots. PI-UDF combines analytical forward kinematics with learnable link-geometry embeddings and a shared residual network to predict pairwise inter-arm distances directly from robot configurations. To improve safety-critical fidelity, we combine quota-driven boundary mining with an asymmetric boundary-crossing penalty that emphasizes false-safe sign errors near the collision boundary. The learned distance field is integrated into nonlinear MPC as a differentiable inter-arm clearance term. We validate the framework on a real dual-Franka platform through high-speed close-proximity 14-DoF dual-arm swapping, sustained single-arm dynamic evasion, and dynamic-evasion planning configurations with frozen, predicted, and target-switching treatments of the moving arm. Hardware experiments and offline Drake/FCL replay show that PI-UDF provides a differentiable inter-arm clearance estimate suitable for closed-loop collision-aware collaborative robot motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出PI-UDF：一种物理信息统一可微分框架，用于关节机器人间体-体碰撞距离预测，并集成到非线性MPC中实现双臂紧邻协作运动。
AI.motivation: 紧邻多臂操作需要几何精确且可微的碰撞模型以支持实时优化。经典几何检测器距离可靠但难以嵌入基于梯度的MPC；保守代理模型又会限制紧密耦合运动。因此需兼顾精度、可微性与安全性的距离预测方法。
AI.method: PI-UDF 将解析正运动学与可学习连杆几何嵌入结合，并用共享残差网络直接从机器人构型预测双臂间成对距离。为提升安全关键保真度，采用配额驱动边界挖掘与不对称越界惩罚，重点惩罚碰撞边界附近的"假安全"符号错误。所学习距离场作为可微的臂间间隙项集成进非线性MPC。
AI.result: 在真实双Franka平台上验证：14自由度双臂高速紧邻交换、持续单臂动态规避，以及移动臂采用冻结、预测、目标切换处理的动态规避规划配置。硬件实验与离线Drake/FCL回放表明，PI-UDF 提供可微的臂间间隙估计，适用于闭环碰撞感知协作机器人运动生成。
AI.conclusion: PI-UDF 通过物理信息与可微学习统一建模关节机器人间碰撞距离，兼顾安全关键精度与实时优化可微性，可有效支撑紧邻双臂协作的闭环运动生成。

title: GLIO2: A GPU-Parallelized Tightly-Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-GNSS System for Robust and Real-Time Global Localization and Mapping
summary: Globally consistent, real-time state estimation in large-scale, perceptually degraded environments is essential for autonomous vehicles and aerial robots, and requires fusing LiDAR, inertial, and GNSS measurements. Existing fusion methods, however, share a scan-to-map front-end with two failure modes. First, each scan is aligned to an incrementally built map that drifts under degeneracy, and once the estimate diverges the error is irrecoverable. Second, even without divergence, a registration biased by dynamic objects or wrong correspondences is propagated as a single pose constraint with an over-confident covariance, leaving its correspondences unavailable for GNSS to re-weight or relinearize. We propose GLIO2, a tightly-coupled LiDAR-Inertial-GNSS system whose GPU-parallel front-end jointly optimizes scan-to-multiscan LiDAR, IMU pre-integration, and raw GNSS measurements in a single sliding-window factor graph, sustaining real-time operation on edge hardware. A complementary offline back-end reuses the same cached factors to refine the entire trajectory in batch, completing the 30-min, 4.51-km UrbanNav Whampoa sequence in about 24 s. Across three public benchmarks (UrbanNav, MARS-LVIG, M3DGR) and self-collected UAV and vehicle data, GLIO2 attains the best overall accuracy among evaluated systems. On a 5.66-km bridge traversed at up to 96 km/h, where every competing baseline diverges under LiDAR degeneracy, it maintains 1.6 m horizontal accuracy. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, the full pipeline runs at about 25 Hz (39.60 ms per scan). The source code and datasets will be released.

AI.tldr: GLIO2：GPU并行前端在滑动窗口因子图中紧耦合优化scan-to-multiscan LiDAR、IMU预积分与原始GNSS观测，配合离线批处理后端，在退化环境下实现全局一致实时状态估计。
AI.motivation: 大规模、感知退化环境下的全局一致实时状态估计对自动驾驶与空中机器人至关重要，需融合LiDAR、惯性与GNSS。现有融合方法共享同一scan-to-map前端，存在两大失效模式：一是将每帧扫描对齐到增量构建的地图，该地图在退化下漂移，一旦估计发散则误差不可恢复；二是即使未发散，被动态物体或错误对应偏置的配准也会作为单一位姿约束传播，并伴随过度自信的协方差，导致其对应关系无法被GNSS重新加权或重新线性化。
AI.method: 提出GLIO2，一种紧耦合LiDAR-惯性-GNSS系统。其GPU并行前端在单一滑动窗口因子图中联合优化scan-to-multiscan LiDAR、IMU预积分与原始GNSS测量，可在边缘硬件上保持实时运行；另设互补的离线后端，复用相同缓存因子对整条轨迹进行批量精化。
AI.result: 离线后端约24秒完成30分钟、4.51 km的UrbanNav Whampoa序列。在UrbanNav、MARS-LVIG、M3DGR三个公开基准及自采集无人机与车辆数据上，GLIO2在评估系统中取得最佳整体精度。在一条5.66 km、最高时速96 km/h的桥梁上，所有对比基线均在LiDAR退化下发散，而GLIO2保持1.6 m水平精度。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上，完整流水线约25 Hz运行（每帧39.60 ms）。
AI.conclusion: GLIO2通过前端紧耦合多源因子与后端批处理复用因子的架构，有效克服了传统scan-to-map前端在退化环境下的发散与不可恢复问题，在精度、鲁棒性与边缘实时性上均表现优异，代码与数据集将开源。

title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
summary: A generalist robot should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input--output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis, and the validated release of new skills, while people steer the process through objectives and corrections; stable skill sequences are further consolidated into reusable compound skills. On a mobile manipulator, RoboRSI develops multi-object household cleanup over 104 rounds. In simulation, it achieves the highest success rate on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboRSI，一个基于自顶向下技能精炼（TSR）的机器人自我改进系统，通过层级化技能结构与多智能体协作，将执行反馈转化为可验证、可复用的能力，并在真实与仿真任务中取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人不仅要完成多样任务，还应通过经验持续提升，将执行过程中学到的知识转化为后续任务可复用的能力。尽管基于代码执行的机器人智能体已能依据执行反馈修复程序，但如何围绕赋予经验意义的任务结构来组织这些经验仍是核心挑战：需要将每次修复归因到负责的能力、以执行证据支撑，并在复用前完成验证。
AI.method: 提出 RoboRSI 自我改进系统，核心为自顶向下技能精炼（TSR）。TSR 将任务分解为复合技能、原子技能与基础技能，为各技能划定职责范围并显式定义输入—输出契约；将每次执行结果归因到对应责任分支，并把修改限制在该分支内。在此基础上，由 Manager、Planner、Engineer、Reviewer 协调规划、执行、诊断与新技能的经验证发布，人类通过目标与纠正进行引导；稳定的技能序列进一步固化为可复用的复合技能。
AI.result: 在移动操作机器人上，RoboRSI 经过 104 轮迭代完成了多物体家庭清理任务；在仿真中，于 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus 与 RoboTwin 上取得最高成功率，较最强基线高出 2.7 至 11.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以任务结构为组织核心的技能精炼机制，能够支撑经验的有效归因、验证与复用，使机器人实现持续自我改进；RoboRSI 在真实机器人与多种仿真基准上均验证了该范式的有效性与性能优势。

title: Control-Ready Uncertainty for Trajectory Diffusion
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026 as a Spotlight presentation. 39 pages, 12 figures
summary: Diffusion models can represent complex, multimodal trajectory distributions, but extracting uncertainty from them typically requires costly Monte Carlo sampling. This limits their use in real-time control, where robots must rapidly assess risk and maintain safety margins. We introduce Score-Curvature for Online Precision Estimation (SCOPE), a lightweight module that augments diffusion trajectory models with control-ready uncertainty. SCOPE learns a structured precision matrix around each nominal trajectory by distilling score-curvature information and producing calibrated Gaussian tubes with low overhead and without repeated Monte Carlo sampling. These tubes provide per-timestep covariance estimates that can be used both as predicted occupancy for moving agents and as adaptive exploration guides for robot control. We evaluate SCOPE with mode-conditioned multimodal diffusion backbones in pedestrian forecasting, crowd navigation, Maze2D control, and real-world Franka Panda manipulation. Across these settings, SCOPE provides fast uncertainty estimation, which leads to better closed-loop performance. Project page: https://zackaxue.github.io/SCOPE-project-page/

AI.tldr: 提出SCOPE，一种轻量模块，通过蒸馏score-curvature信息为扩散轨迹模型学习结构化精度矩阵，生成校准的高斯管，实现无需蒙特卡洛采样的快速不确定性估计，提升实时控制性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能表征复杂多模态轨迹分布，但从中提取不确定性通常需要昂贵的蒙特卡洛采样，限制了其在实时控制中的应用——机器人需快速评估风险并维持安全裕度。因此需要一种低开销、无需重复采样的不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: SCOPE围绕每条标称轨迹学习结构化精度矩阵，通过蒸馏score-curvature信息，生成校准的高斯管，提供逐时间步的协方差估计。这些估计既可作为移动智能体的预测占据，也可作为机器人控制的自适应探索引导。方法结合了mode-conditioned多模态扩散骨干网络。
AI.result: 在行人预测、人群导航、Maze2D控制和真实世界Franka Panda操作等任务中评估SCOPE，均实现了快速不确定性估计，并带来更好的闭环控制性能。项目页面：https://zackaxue.github.io/SCOPE-project-page/
AI.conclusion: SCOPE以低开销、无需蒙特卡洛采样方式为扩散轨迹模型提供控制就绪的不确定性，显著提升多种实时控制场景的闭环性能。

title: FAITH: Feasibility-Aware Safety-Filtered RL for High-Dimensional Systems
summary: Safe reinforcement learning commonly places safety and task performance in the same policy objective, where they can introduce competing updates. Safety filters separate them at action execution, but classical designs require an analytic safety function and dynamics model, and standard minimal-intervention filters are myopic to long-horizon task return because they minimize only instantaneous action deviation. Hard projections are also undefined when no safe action exists. We present FAITH, a feasibility-aware, model-free framework that approximates the optimal state-action safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering with a feedforward network. The task policy optimizes the task return through the filtered dynamics, which recovers the feasible constrained problem without a competing safety term in the task-policy update. When no action satisfies the learned safety condition, the same filter approaches the action with minimum predicted peak harm. On a double integrator example and a Safety Gym environment, FAITH achieves the highest return among methods with no feasible-start violations and matches the lowest harm from infeasible starts. On a 29-DoF humanoid, it reaches a 99.95% safety rate while retaining 97% of the unfiltered return in Walking-Avoid, and obtains the highest measured safety rate in Push-Avoid by learning to sacrifice balancing and fall away from the protected region. The same policies are also demonstrated on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid.

AI.tldr: FAITH 提出一种可行性感知、无模型的强化学习框架，通过前馈网络近似最优状态-动作安全值并摊销最小干预过滤，在不引入竞争性安全项的情况下实现安全约束任务策略优化。
AI.motivation: 传统安全强化学习将安全与任务性能放入同一策略目标，导致更新相互竞争；安全过滤器虽在执行层分离二者，但经典设计依赖解析安全函数与动力学模型，且最小干预过滤器仅最小化瞬时动作偏差、对长时程回报短视，硬投影在无安全动作时无定义。
AI.method: FAITH 学习近似最优状态-动作安全值，并用前馈网络摊销最小干预过滤；任务策略通过过滤后的动力学优化任务回报，从而恢复可行约束问题且任务策略更新中无竞争性安全项；当无动作满足学习到的安全条件时，过滤器退化为选择预测峰值伤害最小的动作。
AI.result: 在双积分器与 Safety Gym 环境中，FAITH 在无可 行起点违规的方法中取得最高回报，并在不可行起点下匹配最低伤害；在 29 自由度人形机器人上，Walking-Avoid 中达到 99.95% 安全率并保留 97% 未过滤回报，Push-Avoid 中通过学习牺牲平衡并远离受保护区域获得最高实测安全率；同一策略还在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: FAITH 通过将安全过滤与任务策略优化解耦，并引入可行性感知的峰值伤害最小化机制，在仿真与真实人形机器人上同时实现高安全率与高任务回报。

title: VioLA: Learning Generalist Humanoid Control Policies from Human Data
summary: Teaching a humanoid to follow instructions with its whole body runs into two obstacles. Its action space is large and tightly coupled: legs, arms, and fingers must move together while the robot keeps its balance, which makes joint-level actions hard to learn. And humanoid demonstrations are scarce, so current humanoid generalist policies do not follow new instructions out of the box and are fine-tuned on teleoperated demonstrations of each task before deployment. Human demonstrations exist in far larger numbers, but a person's motion is not a robot command. We remove both obstacles by changing what the generalist policy predicts. We introduce VioLA, a generalist humanoid policy that predicts body and hand motion latents instead of joint commands. A pretrained body- and hand-controller execute these latents on the robot. Their corresponding motion encoders map human and robot motion into the same latent spaces. A human recording is therefore labeled in the policy's action space, and the training demonstration pool contains 140.6 million frames, 93.2% of them human. As a result, VioLA follows locomotion instructions on the real robot zero-shot, without task-specific fine-tuning, reaching 100% success where GR00T N1.7 and $Ψ_0$ reach 16.7% and 0%, respectively. It also reaches 88.6% manipulation success without task-specific fine-tuning. The same approach works across two VLA and one world-action model backbones. A generalist policy trained on human demonstrations alone performs locomotion tasks on the real robot zero-shot. Code and checkpoints will be released.

AI.tldr: VioLA将通用人形策略的输出从关节指令改为身体与手部运动隐变量，借助预训练控制器执行隐变量、运动编码器统一人机动作空间，从而利用140.6M帧（93.2%为人类）演示数据实现零样本全身指令跟随。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身指令跟随面临两大障碍：一是动作空间大且强耦合（腿、臂、手指需协同并保持平衡），关节级动作难以学习；二是人形演示数据稀缺，现有通用策略无法直接遵循新指令，需针对每个任务用遥操作演示微调。人类演示数据量远大于机器人数据，但人体运动并非机器人可直接使用的命令。
AI.method: 提出VioLA通用人形策略，其预测对象不是关节指令，而是身体与手部的运动隐变量（motion latents）。预训练的身体与手部控制器在机器人上执行这些隐变量；对应的运动编码器将人体和机器人运动映射到同一隐空间。由此人类录像可直接被标注到策略的动作空间中，训练演示池达1.406亿帧，其中93.2%为人类数据。该方法在两种VLA和一种world-action model骨干上均适用。
AI.result: 在真实机器人上，VioLA零样本跟随移动指令，无需任务特定微调，成功率达100%；对比GR00T N1.7为16.7%、Ψ₀为0%。无需任务特定微调的操纵成功率达88.6%。仅用人类演示训练的通用策略也能在真实机器人上零样本完成移动任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将策略预测空间从关节指令改为共享隐空间的运动隐变量，VioLA同时解决了人形动作空间耦合难学与演示数据稀缺的问题，实现了跨骨干、零样本的全身指令跟随，并证明人类演示可单独支撑真实机器人的通用策略，代码与检查点将开源。

title: Generative Neural Retargeting for Human-to-Robot Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning dexterous manipulation, but the embodiment gap prevents human motion from being executed directly on robots. Inverse kinematics (IK) retargets human motion to robots efficiently but ignores dynamics, often producing infeasible motions. Reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) are commonly employed to yield dynamically feasible motions, but both are sample-inefficient and sensitive to hyperparameters. RL suffers from costly and unstable training and tedious reward engineering; MPC avoids policy optimization, yet retargets each trajectory in isolation, and solving one does not make the next easier. Sampling cost grows rapidly with dataset size and task difficulty. We hypothesize that dynamically feasible trajectories concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold shared across demonstrations, so that retargeting can be reduced to sampling from that manifold, conditioned on human motion, rather than solving a fresh optimization problem for every demonstration. We propose \textbf{Generative Neural Retargeting} (GNR), which uses a flow matching model to sample feasible trajectories. GNR outperforms MPC with only $8.5\%$ of the samples required by MPC, achieving a success rate of $56.20\%$ compared to $27.20\%$ for MPC. GNR can be used for scalable and efficient retargeting of large-scale, long-horizon, and millimeter precision human demonstrations: by applying GNR within a real-to-sim data engine, we produce a dexterous manipulation dataset with dense contact-force labels, spanning $223$k demonstrations and $3.3$k object geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出生成式神经重定向GNR，用流匹配模型从跨演示共享的低维流形采样可行轨迹，以8.5%的MPC采样量达到56.20%成功率（MPC为27.20%），并支撑223k条演示的大规模灵巧操作数据集构建。
AI.motivation: 人类演示是灵巧操作的可扩展数据源，但人-机具身差异使其无法直接在机器人上执行。IK重定向高效却忽略动力学，常产生不可行动作；RL与采样型MPC虽能得到动力学可行动作，但样本效率低、对超参敏感：RL训练昂贵不稳定、奖励设计繁琐；MPC虽免去策略优化，但逐条轨迹独立求解，成本随数据集规模与任务难度快速增长，且无法复用先前求解经验。
AI.method: 作者假设动力学可行轨迹集中于一个跨演示共享的低维流形附近，因此将重定向从"逐条求解新优化问题"转化为"以人类动作为条件、从该流形采样"。据此提出生成式神经重定向（Generative Neural Retargeting, GNR），采用流匹配（flow matching）模型学习并可采样可行轨迹，替代MPC的在线优化。
AI.result: GNR仅需MPC 8.5%的采样量，成功率达56.20%，显著优于MPC的27.20%。在真实到仿真（real-to-sim）数据引擎中应用GNR，可对大规模、长时域、毫米级精度的人类演示进行可扩展且高效的重定向，产出含稠密接触力标签的灵巧操作数据集，覆盖22.3万条演示与3.3千种物体几何。
AI.conclusion: 将动力学可行轨迹建模为条件生成问题、从共享低维流形采样的GNR，在样本效率与成功率上均优于传统MPC，并能支撑大规模高质量灵巧操作数据集与稠密接触力标注的构建，为可扩展的人到机器人运动重定向提供新范式。

title: SpatialHarness: Test-Time Spatial Scaffolding for Fine Robotic Manipulation
summary: Frontier multimodal foundation models (e.g., GPT-6 Astra) have recently shown strong potential for direct robotic control, yet their performance on fine manipulation remains limited. We argue that an important source of failure is not necessarily insufficient policy capability, but insufficient spatial observability, where task-critical spatial relationships may be poorly revealed by the existing physical camera setup. We introduce SpatialHarness, a test-time embodied harness that provides test-time spatial scaffolding for fine robotic manipulation without policy fine-tuning or changes to the physical sensing setup. SpatialHarness maintains an online simulated scene synchronized with real-world execution, identifies task-critical spatial relationships, and renders complementary virtual views that expose them to a frozen multimodal policy. To keep the simulated scene aligned during interaction, we develop interaction-aware scene synchronization that distinguishes static, held, and transition modes. We evaluate SpatialHarness on four real-robot manipulation tasks spanning precise geometric alignment, object-relative placement, and articulated-object interaction. Using the same frozen GPT-6 Astra policy, SpatialHarness substantially improves task success, including from 26.7% to 66.7% on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on Tower of Hanoi. These results indicate that improving spatial observability at test time can unlock fine-manipulation capabilities already present in strong multimodal foundation models. Project website: https://emilia113.github.io/SpatialHarness/.

AI.tldr: 提出测试时具身"空间脚手架"框架 SpatialHarness，通过在线仿真渲染互补虚拟视图增强冻结多模态策略的空间可观测性，在四个真机精细操作任务上大幅提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 前沿多模态基础模型（如 GPT-6 Astra）虽具备直接机器人控制潜力，但在精细操作上表现受限。作者认为失败主因并非策略能力不足，而是"空间可观测性不足"——任务关键的空间关系因固定物理相机布置而未被充分呈现。
AI.method: SpatialHarness 为测试时具身框架，无需策略微调或改动物理传感布置：1）维护与真实执行同步的在线仿真场景；2）识别任务关键的空间关系；3）渲染能暴露这些关系的互补虚拟视图输入冻结的多模态策略；4）提出交互感知场景同步机制，区分静态、持握与过渡三种模式以保持仿真与真实对齐。
AI.result: 在四类真机操作任务（精确几何对齐、物体相对放置、铰接物体交互）上，使用同一冻结 GPT-6 Astra 策略，成功率显著提升：插头插入从 26.7% 到 66.7%，汉诺塔从 0% 到 100%。
AI.conclusion: 在测试时提升空间可观测性即可释放强多模态基础模型中已具备的精细操作能力，为无需微调的机器人操作提供新路径。

title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
summary: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出Success Guided Sampling (SGS)，一种自适应采样器，将RL训练集中于策略能力前沿附近的任务配置，从而在大规模并行仿真下高效学习，解决此前方法难以处理的多地形四足运动与接触丰富的装配任务，并实现真机零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人需完成从敏捷运动到灵巧操作等多种任务。现有sim-to-real RL依赖大量工程化的任务先验（如塑形奖励、示教）。近期工作表明，多样化仿真重置加大规模并行仿真可减轻工程负担，但将这一范式简单扩展到更精密或动态的问题仍不平凡：仿真重置虽有助于探索，却均匀采样浪费了不断增长的学习经验——大量批次被用于策略已掌握或尚无法尝试的配置，导致扩大并行环境规模难以带来预期收益。
AI.method: 提出Success Guided Sampling (SGS)，一个简单的自适应采样器，将RL训练集中在策略能力前沿附近的任务配置上，使大规模仿真RL能充分利用批次中的经验，从而更有效地扩展到大规模并行仿真。实验使用最多2^20（超过100万）个并行环境。
AI.result: SGS使RL能够解决此前方法失败的挑战性多地形四足运动与接触丰富装配任务；并将学到的操作策略蒸馏为基于RGB的策略，在真实硬件上对若干挑战性装配任务实现零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: SGS通过面向策略能力前沿的自适应采样，显著提升大规模并行仿真RL的样本效率与可扩展性，在运动与操作任务上超越先前方法，并成功实现真机零样本部署。

title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
summary: Text-conditioned motion generators produce trackable whole-body motion, but they have no notion of scene-dependent safety: the same action may target an object or a person. Existing safeguards either inspect the prompt, require labeled motion data, or enforce geometric constraints; therefore, they do not directly account for how scene context changes a motion's meaning. We introduce contextual safety filtering (CSF), a training-free filter that grounds natural-language safety rules in safe and unsafe reference trajectories produced by the generator. For each active rule, safe and unsafe reference trajectories define an affine safety value that a safe reference tracking CBF-QP enforces. Across four pretrained generators with different architectures, CSF activates the intended rules in all explicit and scene-triggered unsafe cases and reduces the danger-event rate by up to 90%, while preserving 88-100% of benign motions. We demonstrate the complete system on a real-world Unitree G1, where it successfully prevents unsafe motions in a variety of scenarios, including interactions with humans and objects.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练上下文安全过滤(CSF)，将自然语言安全规则落地为生成器产生的安全/不安全参考轨迹，通过安全参考跟踪CBF-QP在线过滤动作，在四种预训练生成器上激活全部显式与场景触发的不安全情形，危险事件率最多降低90%，保留88-100%良性动作，并在Unitree G1真机上验证。
AI.motivation: 文本条件动作生成器虽能生成可跟踪的全身动作，但缺乏场景相关安全概念：同一动作指向物体或人时含义不同。现有防护手段或检查提示词、或依赖标注动作数据、或施加几何约束，均未直接刻画场景上下文如何改变动作语义。
AI.method: CSF为免训练过滤器。对每条激活的自然语言安全规则，由生成器分别采样安全与不安全参考轨迹，据此定义一个仿射安全值函数；再用"安全参考跟踪"CBF-QP在生成过程中施加约束，从而在线修正动作，使其远离不安全参考、靠近安全参考。
AI.result: 在四种不同架构的预训练生成器上，CSF在所有显式与场景触发的不安全案例中均成功激活目标规则；危险事件率最高下降90%，同时保留88%-100%的良性动作。真机Unitree G1验证可防止多类场景中的不安全动作，包括与人、物体的交互。
AI.conclusion: CSF以无需训练、无需标注数据的方式把语言安全规则与场景上下文结合，实现对文本条件动作生成的可证明式在线过滤，兼顾安全性与良性动作保持率，并具备真实机器人部署可行性。

title: SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching
summary: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpectralCache，一种免训练的谱域缓存框架，通过复用稳定奇异子空间并线性外推低维奇异值，加速扩散式世界模型推理。
AI.motivation: 扩散式世界模型推理开销大，源于去噪过程中反复的 Transformer 计算；现有缓存方法多利用特征/令牌级时序冗余，未探索扩散特征背后的数学结构。
AI.method: 发现世界模型特征在相邻去噪步间具有高度稳定的奇异子空间及可预测的奇异值演化；据此复用稳定奇异子空间，仅对低维奇异值做线性外推；并利用相邻全量计算特征的谱一致性，通过奇异值缩放跳过部分昂贵骨干评估。
AI.result: 在代表性世界模型上一致提升推理效率且保持生成质量；HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B 上实现 5.22 倍加速，静态场景 WorldScore 达 65.90。
AI.conclusion: 揭示扩散世界模型特征的谱结构规律，提出免训练谱缓存方法，在推理效率上显著优于现有免训练缓存方法并保持生成质量。

title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Keyframe Mnemonics，一种自监督方法，通过从随机采样的历史观测中学习目标函数并将其用作关键帧选择的奖励，从而发现信息关键观测（mnemonics），再训练以此条件化的行为克隆（BC）策略。方法在无限视野下提供上下文保持保证，并在合成记忆任务与机器人操作基准上取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 非马尔可夫环境中的行为克隆要求策略对长视野上下文信息进行推理。现有策略架构依赖循环或注意力机制捕捉长期依赖，但循环模型在时间反向传播下存在隐状态坍缩与梯度不稳定问题，注意力模型则受上下文长度根本限制。因此需要一种能高效保留长程决策相关信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出Keyframe Mnemonics自监督方法：从随机采样的过去观测中学习一个目标函数，将其作为关键帧选择的奖励，从而"发现"一组信息关键观测（mnemonics）；随后训练一个以发现的关键帧为条件的行为克隆策略来建模动作分布。在特定任务结构假设下，该形式化方法提供无限视野的上下文保持保证，同时在策略工作记忆中维持一小组决策相关关键帧。
AI.result: 在合成记忆域上，mnemonic条件化BC策略达到100%成功率（SR），并能泛化到训练视野高数个数量级的场景且无性能下降；在记忆密集型机器人操作基准的23个任务上，相较最强基线平均绝对SR提升13.9%，在真实机器人上于20倍更长视野下仍保持80% SR。代码与视频见 https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io。
AI.conclusion: Keyframe Mnemonics通过自监督发现关键帧并以此条件化策略，有效缓解了循环模型的隐状态坍缩与梯度不稳定以及注意力模型的上下文长度限制，实现长视野上下文保持，并在合成与真实机器人任务上验证了优越的泛化性与成功率。

title: Diffu-LoRA: A Novel Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Diffusion Models
summary: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models from a few reference images requires preserving subject identity while following prompts that describe new contexts. Full-model fine-tuning is parameter-intensive, whereas low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters but leaves open how adaptation capacity should be distributed across layers. We introduce Diffu-LoRA, a parameter-efficient method that learns this allocation through gated low-rank adaptation. Diffu-LoRA inserts trainable low-rank components into the linear layers of Transformer blocks and assigns a learnable gate to each component. Bilevel optimization updates the adaptation weights and gate parameters on separate data splits, while progressive pruning removes components with the lowest gate values to meet a prescribed rank budget. This procedure allocates adaptation capacity nonuniformly across layers while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Experiments with Stable Diffusion on subjects from DreamBooth and additional collected datasets show improved overall subject fidelity and prompt alignment relative to the evaluated fine-tuning baselines. Ablation studies examine the contributions of bilevel optimization, progressive pruning, and adapter placement. These results support learned rank allocation as a practical approach to parameter-efficient diffusion model personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Diffu-LoRA，一种通过门控低秩自适应学习层间秩分配的参数高效扩散模型个性化方法，在保持主体身份的同时提升提示对齐。
AI.motivation: 从少量参考图像个性化文生图扩散模型需要在遵循描述新场景提示的同时保留主体身份。全模型微调参数量大，而 LoRA 虽减少可训练参数，但适配容量如何在各层间分配仍未解决。
AI.method: Diffu-LoRA 在 Transformer 块的线性层插入可训练低秩组件，并为每个组件分配可学习门控。采用双层优化在不同数据划分上更新自适应权重与门控参数，并通过渐进剪枝移除门值最低的组件以满足预设秩预算。该过程在冻结预训练主干的同时实现层间非均匀的适配容量分配。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion 上针对 DreamBooth 及额外收集数据集的主体进行实验，相比所评估的微调基线在整体主体保真度和提示对齐方面均有提升。消融实验考察了双层优化、渐进剪枝和适配器放置的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持学习式秩分配作为参数高效扩散模型个性化的一种实用方法。

title: Wieszcz-XIX: A 3.1-Billion-Word Corpus of Pre-1918 Polish and Temporally Bounded Language Models Trained From Scratch
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Corpus: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SKocur/polish-pre1918-corpus ; code: https://github.com/SKocur/wieszcz-xix ; weights: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22099358
summary: Historical Polish is well documented as a language but annotated in machine-readable form only to about a million words for the period this paper covers; the rest sits behind optical character recognition of variable quality. We present Wieszcz-XIX, a corpus of 6.75 billion tokens (about 3.1 billion words) in 294,369 documents, most of them periodical issues, of Polish published from 1800 to 1918, assembled from Wolne Lektury and the Internet Archive by a pipeline that filters, deduplicates, audits for post-1918 leakage and splits at the document level. It is over three orders of magnitude larger than the annotated corpus of the same period, and we quantify its defects: recognition corruption against a false-positive floor, near-identical duplication, which is removed, and post-1918 leakage, which is excluded from the training corpus itself down to a known residue of 0.04 to 0.38% of its bytes, found in the transcribed source, so the published corpus is the trained one document for document. On a hand-corrected sample the character error rate is 0.68% where the text is legible, and 45% of the sampled passages cannot be corrected. On it we train a ladder of decoder-only models from 47M to 349M parameters from scratch, and measure their temporal boundedness. Against two modern Polish base models, one far larger, the 349M shows a crossover, as does the 107M against the comparator of its size: post-1918 vocabulary costs them about 3.1 bits per byte more than period vocabulary, a gap the comparators do not show, and period vocabulary costs them fewer bits than it costs the comparators. Shown period text, the models keep its spelling and the comparators only partly. Adding parameters gains about twice as much as a second pass over the data. We release the corpus, code and weights. Content warning: the models reproduce period prejudice, including antisemitic statements.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 Wieszcz-XIX，一个覆盖 1800–1918 年波兰语出版物的 67.5 亿 token（约 31 亿词）语料库，并基于此从头训练 47M–349M 参数的仅解码器模型，量化其时间边界性与缺陷。
AI.motivation: 历史波兰语虽文献丰富，但机器可读的标注语料仅约百万词量级，其余仅能以质量不稳定的 OCR 形式获取，缺乏大规模、可训练的同期语料。
AI.method: 从 Wolne Lektury 与 Internet Archive 采集，经过滤、去重、1918 年后泄漏审计，并在文档级切分，构建 294,369 篇文档的语料；对转录源中 0.04–0.38% 字节的泄漏残留进行排除，使发布语料与训练语料逐文档一致；在人工校正样本上评估字符错误率；训练 47M–349M 参数模型并与两个现代波兰语基座模型比较。
AI.result: 可辨识文本的字符错误率为 0.68%，但 45% 的抽样段落无法校正。349M 模型相对更大的现代模型出现交叉优势，107M 相对同规模比较模型亦然：1918 年后词汇比同期词汇多耗约 3.1 bits/byte，而比较模型无此差距，且同期词汇在本文模型上耗比特更少；模型能保留历史拼写，比较模型仅部分保留。增加参数量带来的收益约为对数据再训练一遍的两倍。
AI.conclusion: Wieszcz-XIX 以三个数量级以上的规模超越同期标注语料，验证了历史语料训练专用模型在时间边界性与拼写保留上的优势，并公开语料、代码与权重；同时提示模型会复现时代偏见。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Preparation of Transportation Management Plans: A Case Study with WisDOT WisTMP System
summary: Work zones are critical yet hazardous components of transportation infrastructure, requiring carefully designed Transportation Management Plans (TMPs) to ensure safety and mobility. However, TMP preparation remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on practitioner expertise. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to automate TMP content generation, leveraging the WisDOT WisTMP system as the application context. The framework fine-tunes multiple open-source LLMs across different model scales and deploys them locally to ensure data security. To support model training, we construct a domain-specific dataset from historical WisTMP documents by converting PDF files into structured question-answer pairs in JSON format. Experimental results show that fine-tuning significantly improves performance across standard text generation metrics. Further section-wise and strategy-level analyses reveal that, while LLMs achieve strong overall performance, they tend to over-generate strategies and struggle to produce project-specific justifications and accurate cost estimates. In addition, scaling from 7B/8B to 14B yields limited gains. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs to improve TMP preparation efficiency while highlighting remaining challenges in LLM-assisted TMP development. The source code and demo videos will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM辅助框架，通过本地微调开源大模型，自动化生成交通管理计划（TMP）内容，以WisDOT WisTMP系统为应用场景。
AI.motivation: TMP是交通基础设施中的关键但高风险环节，其编制过程劳动密集且高度依赖从业者经验，亟需自动化手段提升效率并保障数据安全。
AI.method: 构建领域专用数据集：将历史WisTMP文档从PDF转为结构化JSON问答对；对多个不同规模的开源LLM进行微调并本地部署，以保障数据安全。
AI.result: 微调在标准文本生成指标上显著提升性能；分章节与策略层面分析显示模型总体表现较强，但倾向过度生成策略，难以给出项目针对性论证与准确成本估算；从7B/8B扩展到14B收益有限。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备提升TMP编制效率的潜力，但在项目针对性论证与成本估算方面仍存挑战；源代码与演示视频将公开。

title: Cognitive Thermometers: Machine Learning and Logical Complexity
summary: How does the human mind represent semantic categories? Why do natural languages favor certain meanings over others? Prior explanations have relied on logical definability and complexity, but these are highly sensitive to the choice of logical language, rendering some design choices unmotivated. In this article, we propose that machine learning provides a somewhat more agnostic approach to measuring semantic complexity. We review emerging evidence that logic and machine learning often yield converging results on relative complexity and its resulting effects in semantic typology. Where they diverge, learning appears to be a better explanation than logical complexity. We argue that treating machine learning models as ``cognitive thermometers'' enables a unified approach to complexity that bridges symbolic logic and connectionist AI.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以机器学习作为衡量语义复杂度的更中立方法，用以解释人类心智的语义范畴表征及自然语言的语义偏好。
AI.motivation: 以往解释语义范畴与语言意义偏好依赖逻辑可定义性和复杂度，但这类指标高度依赖所选逻辑语言，导致部分设计选择缺乏合理依据。
AI.method: 作者综述新兴证据，比较逻辑方法与机器学习方法在相对复杂度及其语义类型学效应上的一致性，并将机器学习模型视为“认知温度计”。
AI.result: 逻辑与机器学习在相对复杂度及语义类型学效应上常得到趋同结果；当两者出现分歧时，学习比逻辑复杂度更具解释力。
AI.conclusion: 将机器学习模型作为“认知温度计”可提供统一的复杂度研究框架，从而连接符号逻辑与连接主义人工智能。

title: Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders
summary: Our work explores learning a compressed latent representation of text, at the intersection of data compression and representation learning. We propose an autoencoder architecture that performs residual downscaling and upscaling of hidden representations along the time axis, with a residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck. We analyze our approach for different quantization methods, training objectives, and datasets. For different levels of compression, we evaluate the similarity between the original and reconstructed text both at the surface-level (BLEU) and at the semantic-level (LLM-based judge). Additionally, we evaluate our models on downstream question-answering and semantic text similarity benchmarks. Our approach results in compressed representations which are on par with lossless text compression algorithms at 2.24 bits per byte on web text data, while having good reconstruction and downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自编码器，通过在时间轴上对隐表示进行残差下采样与上采样，并引入残差低维离散瓶颈，学习文本的压缩潜在表示；在2.24 bits/byte的压缩率下达到无损压缩水平，并保持良好重建与下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 探索数据压缩与表示学习的交叉点，即学习文本的压缩潜在表示，兼顾高压缩率与可用性。
AI.method: 提出一种自编码器架构：沿时间轴对隐表示进行残差下采样（downscaling）与上采样（upscaling），并配备残差低维离散瓶颈；系统分析不同量化方法、训练目标和数据集的影响。
AI.result: 在不同压缩级别下，从表层（BLEU）与语义层（基于LLM的评判）评估原始与重建文本相似度；并在下游问答和语义文本相似度基准上评测。在网页文本数据上达到2.24 bits/byte，与无损压缩算法相当，同时重建与下游任务表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该压缩潜在表示在压缩率上可与无损文本压缩算法媲美，且保持较好的重建质量和下游任务性能，验证了压缩与表示学习结合的有效性。

title: Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale
summary: Enterprise conversation analytics asks many questions of millions of interactions. Each question can require reconstructing what people mean and identifying which information matters, repeating costly interpretive work across the same transcripts. We propose a simple principle: clarify the text, then focus the reader. Statement normalization transforms dialogue into short, speaker-attributed statements with source references and semantic tags. The statements make meaning more explicit; the tags support selecting evidence for a particular question. Downstream models can use the full representation or a relevant subset, depending on what helps them make the decision. In an offer-suppression task on customer-service calls, normalization improves a supervised classifier without selection, while weaker prompted readers benefit from both normalization and selection. A small model can learn the normalization contract, while lightweight encoders handle tagging and downstream decisions. Sharing this preparation across questions supports an inference pipeline built entirely from small models, making analytics over millions of conversations substantially less expensive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"先澄清文本、再聚焦读者"的原则，通过"语句规范化"将对话转写为带说话人归因、来源引用和语义标签的短陈述，从而在企业对话分析中复用解释性工作，让整套推理流程可由小模型完成，显著降低大规模分析成本。
AI.motivation: 企业对话分析需对数百万交互提出大量问题，每个问题都要重新理解语义、识别关键信息，导致对同一转写重复进行昂贵的解释性工作。因此需要一种能在多个问题间共享文本准备成果的机制。
AI.method: 提出语句规范化（statement normalization）：将对话转为简短、带说话人归因的陈述，并附加来源引用与语义标签。陈述使意义更显式，标签支持针对特定问题选择证据。下游模型可使用完整表示或相关子集。在小模型上学习规范化契约，由轻量编码器负责标注与下游决策。
AI.result: 在客服通话的报价抑制任务上，规范化在无选择的情况下即提升了监督分类器；较弱的提示式读取器则同时受益于规范化与选择。小模型可学会规范化契约，轻量编码器可承担标注与下游判定。
AI.conclusion: 将文本准备在问题间共享，可构建完全由小模型组成的推理流水线，使对数百万对话的分析成本大幅降低。

title: Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models
summary: Corrective feedback is among the best-evidenced drivers of second-language acquisition, yet corrections delivered during lessons rarely accumulate into an actionable view of grammar mastery. Prompted frontier models can provide such a view from learner--tutor lesson transcripts, but they are costly at scale. We close this gap by fine-tuning Qwen3.5 small language models (SLMs) on filtered and rebalanced teacher-generated supervision, then deploying an efficient 0.8B model in an end-to-end grammar mastery tracker for all English learners on our platform. Internalizing the annotation contract into adapter weights enables pairing the 0.8B model with a compact matched prompt rather than verbose instructions. On two human-curated benchmarks, both the deployed 0.8B model and a 4B reference comparator outperform prompted GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol in precision and recall under nested matching criteria of increasing strictness: concept, evidence span, and correctness. The deployed 0.8B SLM reduces serving cost by approximately 16$\times$. A feature-level online experiment shows significant gains in learner engagement ($+15.8\%$) and key business metrics, including scheduled hours ($+2.1\%$) and GMV from new lessons ($+13.2\%$).

AI.tldr: 通过微调 Qwen3.5 小模型（部署 0.8B），将课程中的纠错反馈转化为语法掌握度追踪视图，在两项人工标注基准上优于提示版 GPT-5.4/5.6 Sol，服务成本降低约 16 倍，并带来学习参与度与业务指标提升。
AI.motivation: 纠错反馈是二语习得中被证据支持最强的驱动因素之一，但课堂中产生的纠正信息很少能被累积为可操作的语法掌握度视图。前沿模型虽可从师生课堂转录中生成此类视图，却在大规模应用时成本过高。
AI.method: 在经筛选与重平衡的教师生成监督数据上微调 Qwen3.5 系列小语言模型，将标注规范内化到适配器权重中，使 0.8B 模型可搭配精简的匹配提示而非冗长指令；随后将 0.8B 模型部署到面向平台全体英语学习者的端到端语法掌握度追踪器中。
AI.result: 在两个人工标注基准上，按概念、证据片段、正确性三级递增严格度的嵌套匹配标准评估，部署的 0.8B 模型与 4B 参考模型在精确率和召回率上均超过提示版 GPT-5.4 与 GPT-5.6 Sol；部署的 0.8B 模型将服务成本降低约 16 倍。特征级在线实验显示学习参与度提升 15.8%，预约课时提升 2.1%，新课程 GMV 提升 13.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将标注契约内化到小模型适配器中，可在显著降低推理成本的同时超越大型提示模型，并在真实业务场景中产生可测量的学习行为与商业收益，为大规模语法掌握度追踪提供了可行路径。

title: Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute
summary: A large language model can only use the text that fits in its context window, and it recomputes its internal key-value (KV) state for a prompt every time the prompt is sent. We test a memory layer, the public package galahad-kv, that saves the KV state of each block of about 16,000 tokens to encrypted local NVMe disk and loads it back later, byte-exact, without recomputing it. We ran it on 50,000,000 tokens of real public text, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA H100, with Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 31B. Every block we probed was loaded back from the encrypted store with no recompute (100 of 100, at depths from 0 to 50M tokens) on both models. Loading a block was 2.8x to 4.3x faster than recomputing it and used 8.8x to 12.3x less GPU energy, and GPU memory stayed flat over the whole 50M-token stream. Asked about facts planted millions of tokens earlier, the 12B model gave the right answer 82 times out of 100 and the 31B model 98 times out of 100. Neither model made up an answer. The limits are as follows. This is reuse of stored state, not a wider attention window: one block is loaded at a time, and how well a question is answered depends on the model. Writing the memory is a one-time cost, and the store takes terabytes of local NVMe disk. We describe the test protocol, which is built to resist common ways of gaming long-context benchmarks, and give a single-GPU reproduction that uses public software and a free licence for the package.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试了公开包 galahad-kv 的记忆层，将每约16,000 token块的KV状态加密保存到本地NVMe磁盘并逐字节精确加载，无需重算。在单张H100上以vLLM服务5,000万token文本，100/100探测块均免重算加载，加载比重算快2.8–4.3倍、GPU能耗低8.8–12.3倍，显存保持平稳；12B与31B模型对百万级token前植入事实的答对率分别为82%和98%，且均未编造答案。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型受限于上下文窗口，且每次发送提示都要重新计算内部KV状态，造成重复计算开销。作者希望验证通过磁盘存储并复用KV状态，能否在不重算的情况下扩展可用上下文并降低计算与能耗成本。
