In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"对齐泛化预测"任务：预测微调模型遵循某一价值观后，其在大量未见价值观上的行为变化；对66种价值观进行大规模分析，发现基于模型激活的表征显著优于文本描述方法。
AI.motivation: 开发者通过后训练让模型展现亲社会价值观与行为特质，但即便在既有对齐评估中得分很高，针对狭窄行为集的训练仍会以意外方式影响模型在未见情境中的表现。因此需要理解并预测价值观微调带来的泛化效应。
AI.method: 建立"对齐泛化预测"任务，即预测微调模型遵循某一给定价值观后，其在多种留出价值观上的行为变化。对现代对齐目标中的66种价值观进行大规模对齐泛化效应分析，并在该任务上对多种表征技术进行基准测试，对比基于激活的表征与基于文本描述的方法。
AI.result: 基于模型在上下文中应用价值观时激活的表征显著优于文本描述方法：最佳激活方法与本研究的泛化矩阵相关系数达0.45，而基于描述的基线仅为0.05。进一步将预测对齐泛化的表征应用于下游任务，衡量多价值观对齐目标中各价值观的相似度，发现其与模型鲁棒性显著相关。此外还发现存在共享的、与模型无关的价值观空间的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了对LLM价值观泛化进行研究的必要性，并可据此构建首个基于经验泛化动态的LLM价值观分类体系，为模型行为的经验化设计、训练与对齐提供支持。

title: An Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Large-Scale Semantic Table Interpretation and Data Quality Assessment
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, Workshop on Quality of Knowledge Graphs at ESWC 2026, May 11, 2026, Dubrovnik, Croatia
summary:
Knowledge Graph (KG) quality depends not only on downstream graph validation, but also on the quality of tabular metadata used before integration. In metadata-only Semantic Table Interpretation (STI), where cell values are unavailable, noisy, or unsuitable, column headers become a critical source of semantic evidence for traceable KG preparation.
  We present an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only Column Type Annotation (CTA) and Data Quality Assessment (DQA). The framework maps headers to 39 interpretable FinalFormat types using curated lexical resources and preserves token-level traceability through SourceKeywords. Each assigned type activates validation rules based on a taxonomy of Data Quality Issues (DQIs), producing detections such as missing data, duplicates, domain violations, wrong data type, and temporal mismatch. These detections are aggregated into HeadersIQ, a lightweight, unweighted data source-level quality metric.
  The framework was evaluated across heterogeneous benchmarks, including UCI, Prague, Kaggle, VizNet/Sato, SOTAB, T2Dv2, and the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, comprising around 120,000 header columns. The results show broad practical coverage across noisy real-world metadata, while a parallel KG-mapping pathway supports alignment to DBpedia and Schema.org. On the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, the official GT-strict evaluation was modest. However, a blinded diagnostic audit indicates that many mismatches reflect benchmark granularity, aliasing, and ontology-selection effects rather than wholly implausible header-centric predictions. We report this audit as diagnostic evidence on disagreement patterns, not as revised benchmark performance. Overall, the paper presents a reusable workflow for metadata-driven semantic annotation, data source-level quality monitoring, and KG-oriented benchmark diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可解释、以表头为中心的框架，用于仅元数据的列类型标注（CTA）与数据质量评估（DQA），覆盖约12万表头列，并给出面向知识图谱的基准诊断。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱质量不仅取决于下游图验证，也取决于集成前表格元数据的质量。在仅元数据的语义表格解释（STI）场景中，单元格值不可用、噪声大或不适用，列标题成为可追溯知识图谱准备的关键语义证据。
AI.method: 框架将表头映射到39种可解释的FinalFormat类型，依据人工整理的词汇资源，并通过SourceKeywords保留词元级可追溯性；每个被赋予的类型依据数据质量问题（DQI）分类体系激活相应校验规则，检测缺失数据、重复、域违规、错误数据类型、时间不匹配等问题；检测结果聚合为轻量、非加权的数据源级质量指标HeadersIQ；并行设置知识图谱映射通路，支持对齐DBpedia与Schema.org。
AI.result: 在UCI、Prague、Kaggle、VizNet/Sato、SOTAB、T2Dv2及SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG等多个异构基准上评估，共约12万表头列，对噪声真实元数据具有广泛实用覆盖；在SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG赛道上官方GT-strict评测结果一般，但盲审诊断审计显示，许多不匹配源于基准粒度、别名及本体选择效应，而非表头中心预测完全不合理。该审计作为分歧模式的诊断证据报告，并非修订后的基准成绩。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了一套可复用工作流，用于元数据驱动的语义标注、数据源级质量监测与面向知识图谱的基准诊断。

title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) offer a parameter efficient approach to scaling reasoning by reusing shared parameters across recurrent computation steps. Despite their promise, effective post-training of LoopLMs remains challenging. Existing approaches either provide reward based supervision that is sparse or costly to extend across loops, or rely on external teachers or privileged information, leading to limited teacher availability or teacher-student context mismatch. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopOPD, a cross-loop on-policy distillation framework that uses additional recurrent computation within a LoopLM as its own source of supervision. LoopOPD uses a frozen terminal loop policy as a compute privileged teacher for an intermediate loop student on student generated rollouts, providing dense supervision without an external teacher or privileged information. We further propose Dynamic LoopOPD (D-LoopOPD), which continually refreshes the terminal loop teacher as the shared model parameters are updated, enabling recurrent self-improvement. We characterize how distillation updates propagate across loop depths and derive sufficient conditions under which a single update yields simultaneous local improvement at both loop depths. Experiments on Ouro-Thinking models show that LoopOPD improves mathematical reasoning, while D-LoopOPD yields further gains through dynamic teacher updates. Despite being trained only on mathematical data, the resulting models also improve on general reasoning and code generation benchmarks, demonstrating that recurrent computation can serve as an effective source of supervision for LoopLMs. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: LoopOPD利用LoopLM内部终端循环作为教师，对学生循环进行跨循环在线策略蒸馏，D-LoopOPD动态刷新教师实现循环自改进，提升数学、通用推理与代码生成能力。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型（LoopLMs）通过复用共享参数在循环计算步骤中扩展推理能力，参数效率高，但其后训练面临困难：现有方法或依赖稀疏、难以跨循环扩展的奖励监督，或依赖外部教师与特权信息，导致教师可用性受限或教师-学生上下文不匹配。
AI.method: 提出LoopOPD跨循环在线策略蒸馏框架，以冻结的终端循环策略作为计算特权教师，对中间循环学生模型在学生自生成轨迹上进行蒸馏，无需外部教师或特权信息即可提供稠密监督；进一步提出D-LoopOPD，在共享参数更新时持续刷新终端循环教师，实现循环自改进。同时刻画蒸馏更新跨循环深度的传播机制，推导单次更新同时实现两个循环深度局部改进的充分条件。
AI.result: 在Ouro-Thinking模型上的实验表明，LoopOPD提升了数学推理能力，D-LoopOPD通过动态教师更新带来进一步增益；尽管仅在数学数据上训练，所得模型在通用推理与代码生成基准上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 循环计算可作为LoopLMs的有效监督来源，跨循环在线策略蒸馏为LoopLMs后训练提供了无需外部教师的高效方案。

title: Conversational Task Disambiguation over Tabular Data: Leakage-Aware Formulation, Benchmark Suite, and Training
comment: 39 pages (9 main, 30 appendix), 12 figures (5 main, 7 appendix)
summary: Conversational task disambiguation over tabular data uses dialogue to resolve missing information about a user's intended task before producing a solution over tables or databases. Existing evaluation and training lack a leakage-aware foundation. Task success mixes the agent's disambiguation and solution-generation capabilities and can also reflect oracle leakage, that is, information that a user simulator reveals beyond what a real user would. Existing datasets also lack a shared representation of ambiguities and access boundaries. We introduce the notion of an ambiguous verifiable task, which formalizes ambiguities and resolutions, decomposing the agent into an asking policy and a solution policy, and the environment into an oracle and verifier. This framework provides baselines and metrics for evaluating task disambiguation separately from solution generation, formal definitions of oracle leakage, judge-free leakage diagnostics, and a training objective for the asking policy. We instantiate the framework in text-to-SQL with AmbiTab, a benchmark suite that unifies six ambiguous datasets under a common representation specifying what the agent, oracle, and verifier may access. We evaluate clarification strategies and oracle leakage, and train an asking policy with reinforcement learning. The trained asker improves our disambiguation metrics on all six datasets and task success on five, and our leakage diagnostics measure how training affects oracle leakage.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"模糊可验证任务"框架，将对话式任务消歧拆解为提问策略与求解策略、预言机与验证器，并实例化为 AmbiTab 基准，统一六个模糊数据集，用于分离评估消歧与求解能力并诊断预言机泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有面向表格数据的对话式任务消歧在评测与训练上缺乏考虑信息泄漏的基础：任务成功率混合了智能体的消歧能力与求解能力，还可能反映"预言机泄漏"（用户模拟器透露了真实用户不会提供的信息）；同时现有数据集也缺少对模糊性与访问边界的统一表示。
AI.method: 作者提出"模糊可验证任务"概念，形式化模糊性与消解过程，将智能体分解为提问策略与求解策略，将环境分解为预言机与验证器。该框架提供：分离评估消歧与求解的基线与指标、预言机泄漏的形式化定义、无需裁判的泄漏诊断方法，以及提问策略的训练目标。随后在 text-to-SQL 中实例化为 AmbiTab 基准套件，以统一表示规定智能体、预言机和验证器可访问的信息，整合六个模糊数据集。作者评估了澄清策略与预言机泄漏，并用强化学习训练提问策略。
AI.result: 训练后的提问器在全部六个数据集上提升了消歧指标，并在其中五个数据集上提升了任务成功率；泄漏诊断方法量化了训练对预言机泄漏的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为对话式任务消歧提供了考虑泄漏的形式化基础与统一基准，能够将消歧能力与求解能力分开评估与训练，并可用于度量和控制预言机泄漏。

title: Plan-and-Patch: Diffusion Language Models for Agentic Planning
summary: Planning is increasingly important for long-horizon agents, where successful execution requires coordinating subgoals, tool use, and intermediate outcomes over many steps. Yet assumptions made during planning may be invalidated by the environment, tools may return unexpected results, or actions may fail. Effective agents must therefore not only generate plans, but also revise them. Such revisions often affect only part of a plan, leaving the preceding and subsequent structure intact. Rather than regenerate the entire plan and risk unnecessary changes, repair can regenerate the affected region conditioned on the preserved prefix and suffix. We introduce Plan-and-Patch, a plan-and-act framework in which a diffusion language model (dLLM) generates a structured, program-like plan through parallel unmasking and repairs it by filling in selected regions while keeping the surrounding steps fixed. We compare DreamReasoner-8B and Qwen3-8B as diffusion and autoregressive (AR) planners. On Natural Plan without task-specific training, diffusion (53.7%) achieves nearly twice the plan repair success rate of AR (27.0%). After task-specific training on agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and TextCraft, the planners achieve similar observed success in plan generation, while diffusion reduces mean plan-generation latency by 39-46% relative to AR. Our results show that Plan-and-Patch provides a framework for faster plan generation and effective plan repair in long-horizon agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 Plan-and-Patch 框架，用扩散语言模型并行生成类程序的计划，并通过"打补丁"方式仅重生成待修复区域，在长程智能体规划中实现更快的计划生成与更有效的计划修复。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体需在数十步中协调子目标、工具调用与中间结果，而规划假设可能被环境推翻、工具返回意外结果或动作失败，因此智能体必须在生成计划的同时具备计划修正能力。局部修复通常只影响计划的一部分，若全量重生成会引入不必要的改动，故需要一种在保留前后文条件下只重生成受影响区域的方法。
AI.method: Plan-and-Patch：一个计划-执行（plan-and-act）框架。由扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过并行去掩码生成结构化的、类程序式计划；当计划需修正时，仅选中受影响区域进行填充式重生成，固定前后已保留的步骤（前缀与后缀条件化）。对比 DreamReasoner-8B（扩散）与 Qwen3-8B（自回归，AR）作为规划器。
AI.result: 在 Natural Plan 上、无任务特定训练时，扩散模型计划修复成功率为 53.7%，接近 AR（27.0%）的两倍。在 ALFWorld 与 TextCraft 等智能体基准上进行任务特定训练后，两者在计划生成的观测成功率上相近，但扩散模型相较 AR 将平均计划生成延迟降低 39–46%。
AI.conclusion: Plan-and-Patch 为长程智能体提供了一个兼顾更快计划生成与有效计划修复的框架，表明扩散语言模型在局部条件化修补与并行生成上相较自回归规划器具有优势。

title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning environments are now a primary lever for improving large language model (LLM) capabilities in post-training, yet most agentic benchmarks remain static: the world moves only when the agent acts, the reward is a terminal verdict, and the pass bar is set arbitrarily. We introduce StoreBench, a live-commerce environment in which an agent runs a mid-size online apparel store on a production-grade commerce backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment under uncertainty. Customers order around the clock, suppliers reprice and fail, and market shocks arrive with partial or no warning. The agent acts through the same 29 merchant tools a human operator would use, under a windowed operation budget that makes simulated time a function of actions taken, so model latency cannot influence simulated time. Pass thresholds are calibrated against scripted anchor policies, the reward is hardened against a catalogue of reward hacks, and every episode replays identically given a sequence of actions. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs on 11 scenarios of 30 to 45 days and a full simulated year, over three world seeds at matched reasoning effort. No model matches the scripted smart-triage policy on average: the best, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, passes 49% of task-seed cells against the heuristic's 97%. Human experts working through the same tools and budgets outscore every model (mean composite 0.708 vs. 0.700). Over a full simulated year under the Claude Code harness, most models show dramatic performance improvement. In a GRPO post-training run, Qwen3.5-27B trained on only five disjoint tasks raises its mean composite on the held-out evaluation tasks from 0.136 to 0.373. We release five example training-split tasks, ten sample trajectories, and the scoring and verification tooling; the full environment and evaluation suite are withheld to keep the benchmark uncontaminated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StoreBench——一个以生产级电商后端为支撑的直播电商强化学习环境，用于测试 LLM 智能体的长时程规划与不确定性下的经济决策能力，并通过校准阈值、加固奖励与可复现回放保证评测严谨性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评测基准大多为静态环境：世界仅在智能体动作时变化，奖励是终局裁决，及格线任意设定，难以真实反映长时程规划与经济判断能力，也不适合作为强化学习训练信号。
AI.method: 构建 StoreBench：智能体在 29 个真实商户工具上运营中型线上服装店，客户全天候下单、供应商调价与违约、市场冲击部分或无预警；采用窗口化操作预算使模拟时间取决于动作而非模型延迟；阈值以脚本化锚定策略校准，奖励针对一系列 reward hack 进行加固，且给定动作序列后每回合可严格复现。在 11 个场景（30–45 天与完整模拟一年）、三个世界种子、匹配推理强度下评测七个前沿 LLM，并进行 GRPO 后训练实验。
AI.result: 无模型平均表现达到脚本化 smart-triage 策略水平：最佳模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 仅通过 49% 的任务-种子单元，而启发式策略为 97%。人类专家在相同工具与预算下优于所有模型（均值综合分 0.708 对 0.700）。在 Claude Code 框架下完整模拟一年时，多数模型性能大幅提升。GRPO 后训练中，Qwen3.5-27B 仅在五个互不重叠任务上训练，即将留出评估任务的平均综合分从 0.136 提升至 0.373。
AI.conclusion: StoreBench 揭示前沿 LLM 在动态经济环境中的长时程规划仍显著落后于简单启发式策略，但通过长时程运行与强化学习微调可获得明显提升；作者公开五个训练任务、十条样本轨迹及评分与验证工具，保留完整环境与评测套件以防污染。

title: Measuring and Mitigating Solution Mode Collapse in RLVR
summary: A language model (LM) can usually answer the same question in more than one way, but reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is indifferent to which correct answer a model produces. A solution will earn the same reward whether it is the thousandth copy of a familiar answer or one the model has never produced before. Yet, there is potential value in having the model retain multiple correct solutions as it is trained. For instance, multiple modes may give users a choice and provide problem-solving strategies that improve overall model performance. Here, we introduce ModeBench, a benchmark of multi-solution tasks in which the verifier returns both correctness and mode discovered. We then use ModeBench to measure how solution diversity changes under RLVR post-training. We find that RLVR post-training concentrates probability onto fewer correct modes even as accuracy holds or improves, and moreover, that frontier models are already highly concentrated. We then introduce our solution, Re:Max, which stores one verified example per discovered mode in a replay buffer and trains on those stored modes uniformly. A solution found once is, therefore, practiced as often as one found repeatedly. Across three model scales, two RL objectives, and harder task constructions, replay improves both how often a policy succeeds and how many different ways it can succeed.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ModeBench基准，以验证器同时返回正确性与"模式"来度量多解任务的解答多样性，发现RLVR后训练会压缩正确模式的概率分布；提出Re:Max，通过回放缓冲为每个已发现模式保留一个已验证样例并均匀训练，在多种规模与目标下同时提升成功率与解法多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR使用可验证奖励，对同题的不同正确解法给予相同奖励，因而模型无论输出"第一千个同质答案"还是"从未产生过的新解法"都得到相同回报。但保留多个正确解法具有潜在价值：可为用户提供选择，并提供有助于整体性能提升的解题策略。因此需要量化并缓解RLVR对解答多样性的侵蚀。
AI.method: 作者构建ModeBench——多解任务基准，其验证器同时返回正确性与所发现的模式（mode）。用该基准测量RLVR后训练中解答多样性的变化。针对多样性坍缩提出Re:Max：在回放缓冲区中为每个已发现模式保存一个已验证样例，并对缓冲区中存储的模式进行均匀训练，使得"仅被找到一次"的解法与"被反复找到"的解法获得同等练习频率。
AI.result: ModeBench度量显示，RLVR后训练在准确率保持或提升的同时，将概率集中到更少的正确模式上；前沿模型本身已高度集中。Re:Max在三种模型规模、两种RL目标以及更难的任务构造下，均同时提升了策略的成功频率与其能够成功的方式数量。
AI.conclusion: RLVR存在"正确但趋同"的多样性坍缩问题，且该现象在前沿模型中已很显著。将奖励从"答案正确"扩展为"覆盖模式"的回放式均匀训练（Re:Max）是一种有效缓解手段，能够在不牺牲甚至提升成功率的前提下增加可实现的正确解法数量。

title: GameCommBench: A Unified Benchmark and Type-Aware Evaluation for AI-Generated Game Commentary
summary: Game commentary is an open-ended generation task requiring multimodal perception, strategic reasoning, and contextual knowledge. Existing AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) studies remain fragmented across games, modalities, and evaluation protocols, while overlap-based or holistic evaluators fail to capture the functional heterogeneity of commentary. We introduce \textsc{GameCommBench}, a unified benchmark spanning board games, sports, and esports, with commentary aligned to heterogeneous game contexts and annotated by commentary type. We further propose Type-Aware Commentary Evaluation (TACE), a structured framework for evaluating different types of commentary. We then validate TACE for reliability and human agreement, and use it to benchmark representative AI commentators. Results reveal non-uniform capability profiles, with live observation and strategic analysis emerging as major bottlenecks. Together, \textsc{GameCommBench} and TACE provide a diagnostic foundation for comparable and interpretable AI-GGC evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一基准GameCommBench与类型感知评估框架TACE，用于AI生成游戏解说的可比、可解释评估，揭示其在实时观察与策略分析上的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: AI生成游戏解说（AI-GGC）任务需多模态感知、策略推理与情境知识，但现有研究在游戏、模态与评估协议上碎片化；基于重叠或整体性评估器无法反映解说的功能异质性。
AI.method: 构建跨棋类、体育、电竞的统一基准GameCommBench，将解说与异质游戏情境对齐并按解说类型标注；提出类型感知解说评估框架TACE；验证TACE的可靠性与人类一致性，并用其评测代表性AI解说模型。
AI.result: 能力画像呈非均衡分布，实时观察与策略分析是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: GameCommBench与TACE为AI-GGC提供诊断性基础，支持可比且可解释的评估。

title: Do LLMs Learn from Rewards in Context? : Rethinking the role of reward in In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: LLM agents increasingly improve at inference time by accumulating experience in context rather than by updating parameters. This process is often described as in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL). Whether in-context learning (ICL) can actually play the role of RL, however, has not been tested. We study this question in its simplest form, direct ICRL, where the model conditions directly on raw trajectory-reward pairs, and ask whether the reward acts as a learning signal. Through controlled experiments on four benchmarks across six models, we find that the reward is read, but its effect is small: flipping, randomizing, or removing the reward leaves the improvement curve almost unchanged, and this holds even under meta-prompts that explicitly instruct the model to explore, exploit, or reason over rewards. Trajectories drive improvement, but not through their semantic content: shuffled or corrupted trajectories work as well as real ones. These patterns closely mirror those known in ICL, suggesting that direct ICRL is better understood as a special case of ICL than as inference-time RL. This reframing has implications for agent memory design: ICL factors such as input distribution and demonstrations may matter more than RL elements such as reward shaping and exploration.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控实验质疑"上下文强化学习"（ICRL）是否真正发挥了强化学习作用，发现奖励信号对模型改进影响甚微，改进主要由轨迹驱动而非语义内容，因此直接ICRL更应被视为ICL的特例。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在推理时通过积累上下文经验而非更新参数来提升表现，这一过程常被描述为上下文强化学习（ICRL）。然而，上下文学习（ICL）是否真的能扮演RL的角色尚未得到验证，作者希望在最简单的形式——直接ICRL中检验奖励是否作为学习信号起作用。
AI.method: 研究采用最简单的直接ICRL形式，即模型直接以原始轨迹-奖励对作为条件输入。在四个基准、六种模型上进行受控实验，通过翻转、随机化、移除奖励，以及在显式指示探索、利用或推理奖励的元提示下，观察改进曲线的变化，并测试打乱或损坏的轨迹是否与真实轨迹同样有效。
AI.result: 奖励确实被读取，但其效应很小：翻转、随机化或移除奖励几乎不改变改进曲线，即便在显式指示探索、利用或推理奖励的元提示下也如此。轨迹驱动了改进，但并非通过其语义内容——打乱或损坏的轨迹与真实轨迹效果相当。这些模式与已知的ICL现象高度相似。
AI.conclusion: 直接ICRL更应被理解为ICL的一个特例，而非推理时RL。这一重新定义为智能体记忆设计提供启示：输入分布和示范等ICL因素可能比奖励塑形和探索等RL要素更为重要。

title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
summary: KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. Under a restricted RAM-Net construction, we prove that soft address assignments extend hard quantized matching to a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and supports recurrent aggregation. These connections further enable Transformer-to-RAM-Net weight migration through a new path based on a soft-quantized intermediate construction. Across nine pretrained Transformer models from 0.3B to 7B parameters, RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of the teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing across six commonsense and knowledge tasks using only a 500M-token budget per model.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出RAM-Net可作为KV缓存量化与线性注意力之间的统一桥梁，并通过软地址分配、理论证明与权重迁移实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: KV缓存量化保留全部KV条目但压缩为离散码，线性注意力则将多个历史KV聚合为固定大小连续状态，二者各有存储、计算与干扰问题。论文关注能否在单一机制中同时实现逐KV压缩与多KV聚合。
AI.method: 将RAM-Net建模为离散地址空间上的软分配机制，软分配决定每个地址对应连续槽状态的循环更新；在受限RAM-Net构造下证明软地址分配可将硬量化匹配扩展为可分离读写重叠；并提出基于软量化中间构造的Transformer-to-RAM-Net权重迁移路径。
AI.result: 在九个0.3B至7B参数的预训练Transformer上，每个模型仅使用500M token预算，在六个常识与知识任务中平均恢复教师模型相对随机猜测准确率增益的87.1%。
AI.conclusion: RAM-Net通过软地址分配统一了逐KV压缩与多KV循环聚合，理论上局部近似全注意力相似性并支持循环聚合，实践中可实现高效权重迁移并保持较高性能。

title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
summary: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"腐蚀格"（corruption lattice）统一描述扩散、自回归及混合模型的解码过程，定义调度代价为并行步骤所丢弃的依赖关系，并证明零代价调度的最少步数由数据几何（图上的树深度）决定。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型擅长连续场、自回归模型擅长离散token，二者长期被视为不同类别。近期混合模型虽兼取两者优势，但其解码调度均为固定设计，缺乏对调度性能的可预测性分析，因此作者希望回答：能否在解码前预测固定步数下不同调度方案的性能。
AI.method: 将扩散、自回归及中间模型统一表示为同一腐蚀格上的路径；将调度的代价定义为并行步骤所丢弃的依赖关系；对马尔可夫于图上、沿路径依赖的数据，分析最少步数与图树深度（treedepth）的关系；并利用从预训练权重中估计的成对依赖核，在解码前预测代价的排序。
AI.result: 理论上，零代价调度的最少步数等于图的树深度，序列长度下为对数级、网格边长下为线性级；步数少于树深度时任何调度均有正代价，其排序可在解码前用估计的成对依赖核预测。实验上，在文本生成、图像生成与视频生成任务中，不同调度在不同指标与基准下的排序预测大多得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来的自回归模型、扩散模型及各类混合模型提供了统一的解码设计原则，即依据数据几何与依赖代价来选择调度。

title: Read What Matters: Query-Adaptive Quantization for KV Caches
summary:
KV-cache entries are stored before their future queries are known, but each decoding query needs precision in different places. We study this mismatch using separate budgets for retained bits and bits fetched per query. ReadKV stores each key and value in a progressive code whose prefixes support different reconstruction precisions. For each query, it allocates key-channel prefixes using the query, computes attention from the reconstructed keys, and then allocates value-token prefixes using that attention. Stored entries remain unchanged. Each stage optimizes a calibrated distortion objective under a fixed budget; we prove exact allocation under diminishing refinement gains and relate these objectives to attention-output error. We also exhibit a finite-dimensional attention family where query-dependent access strictly outperforms every query-independent reader at the same read budget, even with unrestricted competing encoders and decoders.
  Across six base models, reading four bits on average from an eight-bit cache increases C4 perplexity by at most 0.66%, using about one quarter of the logical reads and half the retained capacity of a 16-bit cache. It is consistently more accurate than storing and fully reading four bits at the same payload-read budget. Retaining more bits than each query fetches is aimed at long-context decoding, where the cache bytes moved per step, rather than the weights, dominate cost. Long-context question answering and retrieval on two instruction-tuned models provide additional quality evidence. On the tested 8K-token, batch-one, single-layer workload on an NVIDIA A10G, a restricted eight-bit ReadKV reader with a two-bit mean payload-read budget has 39% lower latency than the tested TurboQuant codec.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReadKV：将 KV-cache 条目存为渐进式编码，保留较多比特但每查询仅读取少量比特，并用查询自适应地分配 key/value 前缀读取预算，在低读取预算下显著降低困惑度与延迟。
AI.motivation: KV-cache 条目在存储时未来查询未知，而每个解码查询所需的精度位置不同，存在"存储精度"与"查询需求"的错配；同时长上下文解码的瓶颈是每步搬运的 cache 字节而非权重。因此需要一种按查询动态决定读取精度的机制。
AI.method: 为 retained bits（保留比特）与 bits fetched per query（每查询读取比特）设置独立预算。ReadKV 将每个 key/value 存为渐进式编码（前缀对应不同重建精度）。对每个查询：先用该查询分配 key-channel 前缀，由重建 key 计算注意力，再依据该注意力分配 value-token 前缀；存储条目保持不变。每一阶段在固定预算下优化标定的失真目标，作者在递减细化增益下证明了精确分配并建立目标与注意力输出误差的联系，还构造了一个有限维注意力族，证明在相同读取预算下查询相关读取严格优于任何查询无关读取器。
AI.result: 在六个基座模型上，从八比特 cache 平均读取四比特使 C4 困惑度最多上升 0.66%，逻辑读取量约为 16-bit cache 的四分之一、保留容量为其一半；在相同 payload-read 预算下始终优于"存四比特并全读四比特"。在两个指令微调模型的长上下文问答与检索上获得额外质量证据。在 NVIDIA A10G、8K token、batch-one、单层负载下，受限的八比特 ReadKV 读取器在二比特平均 payload-read 预算下，延迟比测试的 TurboQuant 编解码器低 39%。
AI.conclusion: 保留比特多于每查询读取比特的渐进式 KV-cache 方案，可在低读取预算下以极小精度损失换取显著的内存流量与延迟收益，适合长上下文解码场景。

title: Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables effective capability transfer between language models, yet the mechanisms underlying its failures are not fully understood. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning, OPD with larger-scale teachers exhibits early loss plateaus, with an average final loss reduction of 25.1% after 200 updates, compared with 96.2% for self-RL teachers, obtained by further reinforcement learning (RL) training of the initial student. To understand this difference, we analyze OPD as an idealized continuous-time dynamical system in the small-learning-rate limit. Our training-log diagnostics associate these plateaus with an early decline in a gradient-based learning-signal proxy while substantial loss remains; these measurements do not establish why the underlying gradient weakens. We further prove a local recovery guarantee for teachers sufficiently close to the initial student in a shared parameterization under regularity conditions, offering a conditional explanation for the success of self-RL teachers in our experiments. Across runs with and without loss plateaus, we observe small relative parameter changes (0.025-0.098%) and high similarity between the student's representations before and after OPD (linear CKA $>0.98$ across layers). These observations suggest that limited representation adaptation may contribute to learning-signal collapse, a hypothesis that remains to be tested. Code is available at https://github.com/leizhao7/opd-learning-signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了on-policy distillation (OPD)能力迁移失败的机制，发现大规模教师会引发早期loss平台期，并将其归因于学习信号塌缩与表征适应不足。
AI.motivation: OPD虽能实现语言模型间的能力迁移，但其失败机制尚不清晰。作者希望解释为何大规模教师下的OPD会出现性能提升停滞，并理解self-RL教师与大规模教师之间效果差异的根本原因。
AI.method: 作者在代码生成与数学推理任务上开展OPD实验，对比大规模教师与self-RL教师；将OPD建模为小学习率极限下的理想连续时间动力系统；通过训练日志诊断梯度学习信号代理；并在共享参数化与正则条件下证明教师接近初始学生时的局部恢复保证；同时测量参数变化幅度与表征相似性（linear CKA）。
AI.result: 大规模教师OPD在200次更新后平均最终loss仅下降25.1%，而self-RL教师下降96.2%，并伴随早期loss平台期；平台期与基于梯度的学习信号代理早期下降相关，此时loss仍较高；有/无平台期的运行中参数相对变化仅0.025-0.098%，OPD前后学生各层表征相似度很高，linear CKA >0.98。
AI.conclusion: OPD失败可能源于表征适应有限导致的学习信号塌缩；local recovery guarantee为self-RL教师的成功提供条件性解释。作者强调该机制仍是待检验假设。代码已开源。

title: RL-ARC: Calibrating Large Reasoning Models via Reasoning-guided Uncertainty
summary: Language models (LMs) are commonly trained with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enhance their reasoning capabilities. However, since RLVR does not explicitly account for calibration during training, it can lead to severe calibration degradation, including overconfidence. Recent calibration-aware training methods for LMs, which incorporate objectives for uncertainty estimation into training, improve calibration but still exhibit overconfidence under distribution shift, while sacrificing reasoning performance. To this end, we propose RL-ARC, a calibration-aware training framework that jointly leverages reasoning confidence and answer confidence. Specifically, RL-ARC leverages reasoning confidence as an auxiliary signal for calibrating answer confidence, applying it as reasoning-guided regularization for correct cases and as an overconfidence penalty for incorrect cases. Comprehensive results across ID and OOD settings show that, beyond improving calibration, RL-ARC enables reasoning models to adaptively estimate confidence based on the given question without substantially sacrificing reasoning performance, thereby highlighting the importance of reasoning confidence for training reliable reasoning models.

AI.tldr: RL-ARC：一种校准感知训练框架，联合利用推理置信度与答案置信度，将推理置信度作为正则化信号来校准答案置信度，在分布内与分布外场景下同时改善校准并保持推理性能。
AI.motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽能提升语言模型推理能力，但训练中未显式考虑校准，导致严重校准退化（如过度自信）。现有校准感知训练方法虽改善校准，但在分布偏移下仍过度自信，且牺牲推理性能。
AI.method: 提出RL-ARC校准感知训练框架，联合利用推理置信度（reasoning confidence）与答案置信度（answer confidence）。将推理置信度作为校准答案置信度的辅助信号：在正确样本上作为推理引导的正则项，在错误样本上作为过度自信惩罚项。
AI.result: 在分布内（ID）与分布外（OOD）设置下，RL-ARC不仅改善校准，还使推理模型能根据给定问题自适应估计置信度，且未明显牺牲推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理置信度对于训练可靠的推理模型至关重要，RL-ARC通过联合两类置信度实现了校准与推理性能的更好权衡。

title: UniData: Universal Multimodal Instruction Generation Pipeline
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly being applied in a wider range of real-world scenarios. However, due to the substantial labor cost, creating high-quality multimodal instruction datasets for MLLMs remains a significant challenge. Although some methods propose to generate instruction data, they often face limitations in modality support and struggle with generating multi-round instructions. To address these problems, we introduce UniData, a universal instruction generation pipeline, to transform simple user requirements into multi-round, multimodal instructions. Specifically, UniData first expands user requirements into multiple diverse events. Using these events, UniData then integrates an any-to-any large model for multimodal instruction generation. Finally, UniData enhances data quality by correcting irrelevant and redundant inference flow, leveraging correlations between instruction rounds. To train this pipeline, we also build UniDataset, a dataset comprising 20,000 entries across nine modalities for improved multimodal generation. Our experiments demonstrate that UniData achieves SOTA performance in data quality and can also enhance the understanding and generation capabilities of other multimodal models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UniData，一个通用指令生成流水线，可将简单用户需求转化为多轮、多模态指令，并构建 20,000 条、覆盖九种模态的 UniDataset。实验表明 UniData 在数据质量上达到 SOTA，并能提升其他多模态模型的理解与生成能力。
AI.motivation: 为 MLLM 构建高质量多模态指令数据集人工成本高昂；已有生成方法在模态支持范围上受限，且难以生成多轮指令。
AI.method: UniData 分三步：1) 将用户需求扩展为多个多样化事件；2) 基于这些事件，集成 any-to-any 大模型进行多模态指令生成；3) 利用指令轮次间的相关性，修正无关与冗余的推理流程以提升数据质量。为训练该流水线，构建 UniDataset，含九种模态、20,000 条数据。
AI.result: UniData 在数据质量上取得 SOTA 表现，并能增强其他多模态模型的理解与生成能力。
AI.conclusion: UniData 提供了可扩展的通用多模态多轮指令生成方案，缓解了人工构建数据的成本与模态/轮次限制问题，并具备对下游多模态模型的增益能力。

title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.

AI.tldr: 提出EFRE方法，用可演化的函数库替代单一提示，解决提示优化在持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与规则过拟合问题，性能优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的持续学习需在不退化已有能力的前提下获取新技能。现有方法多依赖参数更新设计，成本高；提示优化虽避免参数更新且在单项任务上表现优异，但能否直接用于持续学习尚不明确。分析发现，提示优化在顺序任务适应中会遭遇灾难性遗忘，且优化后的提示会积累过拟合于局部任务分布的规则。
AI.method: 提出Evolving Functional REpertoires（EFRE），将单一提示替换为随新任务到来的函数库：兼容性更新精炼已有函数，冲突性更新则触发新函数的产生。
AI.result: 在三任务持续学习流上，EFRE最终平均性能比GRPO高7.50个百分点；适应Bio任务后，在FinQA上仅下降1.56个百分点，而基础提示优化方法下降25.10个百分点。在最小智能体系统中实例化EFRE，不同骨干模型上均获得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: EFRE在大型语言模型持续学习中表现优异，并在高级智能体系统的持续学习方面展现出巨大潜力。

title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: We changed the agent: did it actually get better? Every self-improving agent loop answers this hundreds of times, and every answer comes from a verifier. On open-ended tasks none exists, so the loop is handed a hand-written rubric or a bare LLM judge grading output from a model like itself, inviting reward hacking and shared blind spots. We make the verifier the evolving object: an inspectable expression over small, mostly deterministic drawback detectors, synthesized from clustered failures, gated at birth, and selected for agreement with a ten-item anchored reference set plus consensus over unlabeled outputs, never for the agent's score. On MBPP+ it gains +0.21 held-out agreement over the hand-authored seed composition, on every seed, and ends ahead of the bare LLM judge it contains. One finding should change how co-evolved verifiers are validated: removing the anchor guards collapses the verifier into a vacuous always-pass grader, yet that collapsed verifier trains skills just as well. Downstream task score cannot certify a self-evolved verifier. Score does answer sufficiency, and there an evolved verifier can substitute: Double Ratchet, pairing the verifier with a lifecycle-managed skill loop, retains 88-110% of the lift that ground truth or a rubric buys the same loop, across code generation, enterprise text-to-SQL, and reference-free report generation. When evolved skills gamed the report rubric, an outer judge caught it and one added detector repaired it; the judge itself was wrong until given the task contract.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"验证器"本身作为自进化对象：一个由小型、多为确定性的缺陷检测器构成的、可检查的表达式，从聚类后的失败中合成、出生时受门控、并依据十项锚定参考集的一致性与无标注输出共识进行选择，而非依据智能体得分。在 MBPP+ 上较人工撰写种子构架提升 +0.21 的留出一致性，且优于其所包含的裸 LLM 评判器。关键发现：移除锚定守卫会使验证器坍缩为恒通过的无效评判器，但其训练技能效果不减，说明下游任务得分无法认证自进化验证器。在代码生成、企业级 Text-to-SQL 与无参考报告生成中，Double Ratchet 保留 88-110% 的增益。
AI.motivation: 自改进智能体循环每次迭代都需验证器判断"是否真的变好"，但开放式任务缺乏客观验证器，只能依赖手写评分标准或与被评模型同源的裸 LLM 评判器，从而引发奖励劫持与共享盲区。作者旨在把验证器本身变成可进化、可检查的对象，并解决"如何验证验证器"这一元问题。
AI.method: 将验证器形式化为对小型、多为确定性的缺陷检测器的可检查表达式：从聚类失败中合成，出生时施加门控，选择标准为与十项锚定参考集的一致性以及对无标注输出的共识，明确不以智能体得分为优化目标。提出 Double Ratchet 框架，将进化验证器与生命周期管理的技能循环配对。通过消融（移除锚定守卫）检验验证器的有效性，并跨代码生成、企业级 Text-to-SQL、无参考报告生成三类任务评估。
AI.result: MBPP+ 上留出一致性较人工种子构架提升 +0.21，且在全部种子上成立，并超过其所含的裸 LLM 评判器。消融显示：移除锚定守卫导致验证器坍缩为恒通过的无效评分器，但该坍缩验证器训练技能的效果与有效验证器相当，证明下游任务得分无法认证自进化验证器。Double Ratchet 在三类任务中保留 88-110% 的增益（相对真值或评分标准）。报告任务中技能曾钻评分标准空子，外层评判器捕获后由新增一个检测器修复，且该评判器在获得任务契约前判断有误。
AI.conclusion: 验证器应作为自进化的第一类对象，其选择须基于锚定一致性而非智能体得分，因为任务得分在诊断上不充分（坍缩验证器仍能训练技能），但在充分性上有效（进化验证器可替代真值/评分标准带来相近增益）。同时，外层评判器需明确的契约约束才能可靠判定奖励劫持。

title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
summary: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 将长时程智能体的改进拆分为"自演化测试框架"与"权重训练"两条杠杆，并通过失败构成（流程失败/内容失败）来诊断该用哪条杠杆。
AI.motivation: 改进长时程LLM智能体通常有两条路径：在冻结模型外演化harness，或直接训练权重。但缺少一个判据来决定在具体场景下应当用哪条杠杆，以及两者增益的互补关系。
AI.method: 按"首个触发信号"对失败轨迹打标签，区分流程失败（阻塞调用、循环、步数预算耗尽）与内容失败（交付的方案质量差）。先让自演化harness循环修复流程失败，再将演化harness轨迹用于训练LoRA适配器，并做交叉种子与消融（base/训练权重 × 原始/演化harness），另设answer-shuffled的placebo adapter对照。
AI.result: DeepPlanning上，自演化harness将Qwen3.5-4B留出分数从0.16提升至0.30、9B从0.32提升至0.44；4B交付率由55%升至90%。演化轨迹训练的LoRA在原始harness下两个规模均+0.13；4B上与harness叠加后分数翻倍以上，9B上适配器单独即可匹配完整演化线，内容失败从约1/4降至1/20。placebo适配器低于基线。WebArena-Lite迁移+0.09（117个未见任务），增益来自模型所见输入，适配器无额外贡献。
AI.conclusion: 提出"先诊断、再干预"的规则并应用两次：先读失败构成以在harness与权重之间选择，再读被接受的编辑改变了什么以决定哪些增益值得训练进权重。结果基于八个模型、六个家族、两个基准，采用四轮采样的均值并对照当期锚点。

title: Internalizer: Portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping for Very Large Language Models
summary:
Hypernetworks that map a context directly to a LoRA adapter let a large language model carry that context in its weights, but prior work has demonstrated them only on base models of up to 14 billion parameters.
  We present the Internalizer, a state-of-the-art, portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork that generates document-specific LoRA adapters for the frozen 284B-parameter DeepSeek v4 Flash, a target two orders of magnitude larger than in any previous work. Most of its parameters live in a model-agnostic trunk with only thin entry and exit layers per base model, so it trains cheaply against small models before being ported to the large one.
  On unseen documents of up to 4096 tokens, the generated adapters reach 84.9% top-1 and 97.8% top-5 teacher-forced accuracy against 63.4% and 83.5% for the base model, with nothing in the context window but a three-word instruction.
  Once the hypernetwork is trained, a single forward pass turns any document into an adapter for such a model, which could be served alone for speed or alongside the document in the window to raise accuracy further.

AI.tldr: 提出Internalizer，一种可移植的上下文到参数映射超网络，能为冻结的284B参数DeepSeek v4 Flash生成文档专属LoRA适配器，规模比此前工作大两个数量级，在未见文档上取得84.9% top-1与97.8% top-5教师强制准确率。
AI.motivation: 超网络可将上下文直接映射为LoRA适配器，使大语言模型把上下文"携带"在权重中，但既有工作仅在最高140亿参数的基座模型上验证，缺乏在超大规模模型上的可行性证明；同时直接训练大模型超网络成本高昂。
AI.method: 设计Internalizer作为上下文到参数的映射超网络。其大部分参数置于与模型无关的主干（trunk）中，仅针对每个基座模型保留轻量的入口与出口层，因此可先在小型模型上低成本训练后再迁移到284B参数的冻结DeepSeek v4 Flash上；推理时仅需一次前向传播即可将任意文档转换为该模型的LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 在长度达4096 token的未见文档上，生成的适配器达到84.9% top-1与97.8% top-5教师强制准确率，而基座模型仅为63.4%与83.5%；且上下文窗口中仅有三词指令。
AI.conclusion: 超网络可扩展至数百B级模型并保持可移植性与训练经济性；训练完成后单次前向即可将文档转为适配器，既可单独部署以提升速度，也可与文档同时置于窗口中进一步提升准确率。

title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
summary: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

AI.tldr: 提出一种4-张量注意力模型，用于预测场景的下一语义状态，可服务于视频生成与机器人规划。在ROCStories的下一句任务上，该模型相较自由运行的一维Transformer取得更低交叉熵，并在相近参数量下大幅缩短训练时间。
AI.motivation: 预测场景的下一语义状态对视频生成和机器人规划具有重要价值。作者希望将编码器、渲染器和规划器排除在更新之外，以单独检验注意力更新机制本身的效果，因此需要一个能在语义层面提供统一"下一状态"任务的测试平台，ROCStories中每个窗口都对应同一"下一句"任务，适合用于隔离评估该更新。
AI.method: 模型为4-张量注意力：一个状态窗口中的状态带有位置(x, t)以及两条纤维——语义纤维和时间上下文纤维；并使用一个softmax在整个窗口上联合归一化注意力。帧与智能体的情境被写成这些状态，而编码器、渲染器和规划器不参与更新。在ROCStories上训练，每个窗口在语义层提出相同的下一句预测任务。
AI.result: 在验证集上（每种设置一个随机种子），三个匹配设置下，4-张量模型的末句交叉熵均低于自由运行的一维Transformer：H=2,L=2时降低5.3%；H=4,L=2时降低2.6%；H=4,L=3时降低2.4%。在H=4,L=2时参数量近乎相同，分别为172.5M与175.9M。在相同两块GPU上，4-张量模型运行2.4小时，基线运行45.2小时（基线采用自由运行解码，每个目标token需一次顺序前向）。
AI.conclusion: 4-张量注意力更新在语义层下一状态预测上优于自由运行的一维Transformer，且在参数量相近时显著降低了训练时间。这表明将注意力在窗口位置与两条纤维上联合归一化，是一种有效且高效的场景下一语义状态预测机制，可服务于视频生成与机器人规划。

title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
comment: 33 pages (12 non-appendix pages), 7 figures, published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
summary: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"叠加专精假说"（SSH），认为MoE专家的专精对象是细粒度特征的并集而非单一领域，并据此开发RouterInterp方法，在gpt-oss-20b上解释专家路由的准确率比基于token统计的方法高约65%。
AI.motivation: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型通过将token路由到仅激活部分token的模块化专家网络来实现高效扩展。主流假说认为每个专家专精于单一、连贯的领域，但基于该假说的可解释性研究普遍不成功，因此需要新的理论解释。
AI.method: 提出叠加专精假说（SSH），认为专家专精于细粒度特征的并集而非单一宽泛领域。基于SSH设计RouterInterp方法，识别对路由决策最具预测性的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征，并生成统一的自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在gpt-oss-20b上，RouterInterp的检测准确率比先前基于token统计的方法高约65%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种可扩展的方法来生成更准确的专家路由解释，并加深了对基础模型中此前难以解释组件的理解。

title: GRPODropout: Less is More for Online Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GRPODropout，通过在策略更新前选择性剔除少量高概率、正优势的 rollout 并重新中心化保留优势，缓解 RL 训练中的策略熵坍缩，在更少样本下取得更高准确率与更高熵。
AI.motivation: GRPO 等强化学习方法虽显著提升大语言模型推理能力，但常出现策略熵坍缩：采样多样性下降削弱探索、限制进一步提升。既有方法多从算法层面（奖励修改、熵/KL 正则）或 token 级重加权入手，本文则从"哪些 rollout 参与策略更新"这一互补视角切入，认为相同采样预算下并非所有 rollout 都对更新有正向贡献。
AI.method: 提出 GRPODropout：在标准更新前，采用简单策略选择性移除少量"高概率且正优势"的 rollout，并对保留下来的优势进行重新中心化（recenter）；同时建立 rollout 级别的理论分析，用于指导方法设计与阈值选择。该方法仅改变 rollout 的使用方式，额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比原始 GRPO，本方法取得更高准确率，同时 actor 熵更高，且用于更新的 rollout 样本更少，体现"less is more"。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了 RL 中 rollout 使用的新洞见：剔除部分 rollout 反而能提升性能，为缓解熵坍缩提供了算法层面之外的有效途径。

title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
summary: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.

AI.tldr: 提出MindFlow框架，将研究创意生成建模为"心智流"图结构，由概率心智超网与控制器驱动，并用锦标赛式相对排序优化，实现可控可优化的创意生成。
AI.motivation: 科研创意生成与评估本质上开放且多目标，需在新颖性、合理性与可行性间权衡。现有基于LLM的方法依赖精心设计的提示或固定智能体流程，受限于预定义、静态的构思工作流，难以扩展与调控。
AI.method: 将构思显式形式化为图结构的"心智流"（Flow in Mind），由模块化思考算子构成，并以概率心智超网建模；给定研究主题后，控制器动态采样思考流以生成候选创意；采用锦标赛式相对排序对该开放问题优化，使控制器逐步偏向高质量思考流；同时提出联合评估"发现问题"与"解决问题"的评价协议，超越仅评标题或摘要的判断。
AI.result: 在多样化主题上，MindFlow 展现出作为显式、可控且可优化研究创意生成器的优越性。
AI.conclusion: MindFlow通过图结构心智流与相对排序优化，突破了静态构思流程的限制，为可扩展、可控且可优化的科研创意生成提供了新范式。

title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic-TTT，学习一个测试时策略来自主决定何时调用测试时训练（TTT）、选择哪种 TTT 算法以及是否复用已有技能，从而将部署经验转化为参数级自我改进。
AI.motivation: TTT 能将部署经验转为参数更新，实现模型级自我改进，在 IMO 竞赛等预设场景中效果显著；但 TTT 并非普遍有效，不同算法适用于不同场景，误用会浪费测试时算力甚至损害性能。因此需要"能动性"来决定是否 TTT、选哪个算法、能否复用技能。
AI.method: Agentic-TTT 将各种 TTT 过程封装为可调用工具，把积累的技能视为动态演化的部署环境，并依据决策带来的效用增益训练测试时策略。
AI.result: 在自建基准上，Agentic-TTT 相对骨干模型效用近乎翻倍，学会在效用与算力间权衡，并能泛化到训练未见领域。
AI.conclusion: 该结果指向自主自我改进：模型能够自行决定如何从自身部署经验中学习。

title: InterviewPlayground: A Simulation Environment for Evaluating AI Interviewers
summary: Increasingly, AI interviewers are being developed to elicit open-ended responses in applications like market research, public polling, preference elicitation, and social science research. However, evaluating AI interviewers is challenging because they function in extended, multi-turn interactions where they must adapt to participant behaviors. To address this need, we develop InterviewPlayground, a simulation environment for evaluating AI interviewers using simulated study participants whose behaviors are grounded in social theory. Simulated studies in InterviewPlayground produce an InterviewReportCard, which assesses the performance of AI interviewers using a suite of validated measures. To test whether our simulation-based evaluations predict performance with human participants, we conduct 15 real qualitative studies with five AI interviewers, three interview topics, and 450 human participants and compare them to simulated studies in InterviewPlayground. We find that AI interviewer performance in InterviewPlayground predicts performance in human studies with an average Pearson correlation of 0.86 across 12 measures, and the simulated interactions from InterviewPlayground reproduce key findings from behavioral analysis of AI interviewers in the human studies. Together, these findings support the validity of InterviewPlayground in assessing AI interviewer performance and examining potential failure modes. Our work contributes a simulation environment for AI interviewers supported with empirical validation, and more broadly, a roadmap for future work to develop validated, simulation-based evaluations of conversational AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InterviewPlayground，一个基于社会理论模拟参与者行为的访谈模拟环境，可为 AI 访谈者生成 InterviewReportCard 评估报告；通过 15 项真人研究（5 个 AI 访谈者、3 个话题、450 名参与者）验证其与人类研究的绩效相关性（12 项指标平均 Pearson r=0.86），证明模拟评估的有效性。
AI.motivation: AI 访谈者日益用于市场调研、民意调查、偏好 elicitation 与社会科学研究，但其运作于多轮、长时程交互，需根据参与者行为动态调整，因此难以评估。缺乏能够模拟参与者行为并根据社会理论提供可验证指标的评估环境。
AI.method: 开发 InterviewPlayground 模拟环境：以社会理论为参与者行为建模基础，生成模拟研究并输出 InterviewReportCard，用一套经验证指标评估 AI 访谈者表现；随后开展 15 项真实定性研究，涉及 5 个 AI 访谈者、3 个访谈主题和 450 名人类参与者，将真人研究结果与模拟研究结果对照，检验模拟评估的预测效度。
AI.result: InterviewPlayground 中 AI 访谈者的表现在 12 项指标上与真人研究表现的平均 Pearson 相关系数为 0.86；模拟交互复现了真人研究中 AI 访谈者行为分析的关键发现，支持模拟评估的预测效度与失效模式考察。
AI.conclusion: InterviewPlayground 为 AI 访谈者评估提供了经实证验证的模拟环境，并提出了一套面向对话式 AI 系统的、可验证的、基于模拟的评估路线图。

title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.

AI.tldr: RACE：通过跨轮动作支持的轻量似然估计，让智能体学会何时推理、何时直接行动，在降低推理成本的同时维持或提升性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体通常在每一步动作前都进行推理，但并非每一轮都需要新推理——早期推理可能已足够支撑后续动作。核心挑战在于：如何在不依赖高昂生成式验证的前提下，判断现有推理何时仍然充分、何时需要新的推理步骤。
AI.method: 作者发现有：移除额外推理后，后续参考动作似然度的下降幅度，能较好地反映这些动作在已有早期推理下是否仍可恢复，从而提供一种轻量信号来估计跨轮动作支持度。基于此提出 RACE 训练方法，其核心是似然引导的渐进式推理覆盖检测（LoGiC）过程，逐步识别那些移除后对当前及后续参考动作影响有限的推理轮次；所得移除信号被同时融入监督微调与智能体强化学习，使策略学会何时推理、何时直接行动。
AI.result: 在四个代表性智能体基准上，RACE 大幅降低了推理成本，同时保持或提升了任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨轮似然估计识别冗余推理轮次，可有效实现智能体的自适应推理，在不牺牲（甚至提升）任务表现的前提下显著减少推理开销。

title: When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization
summary: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑组策略优化中移除参考策略KL正则反而可能更优的现象，系统分析KL与奖励交互中的七类失败模式，并提出零和校准策略优化（ZCPO）：用条件KL度量的相对漂移校准组内奖励系数，并整合进基础代理目标。数学推理实验与消融验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 动机源于一个反直觉现象：去掉参考策略KL正则有时反而提升组策略优化效果。这说明参考策略信息的进入方式存在问题，因此有必要研究KL信息应如何介入组相对（group-relative）更新。
AI.method: 分析KL与奖励交互的七种潜在失败模式：(1) 奖励裁剪后的残差KL更新；(2) 梯度抵消后的KL更新；(3) 同奖励组内的KL更新；(4) KL随响应长度增长；(5) KL相对贡献失衡；(6) KL集中在少量token上；(7) 将KL并入奖励时的采样噪声。据此提出ZCPO：以条件KL度量的相对漂移来校准组内奖励系数，并将其整合进基础代理目标。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上的实验与消融实验支持该设计在作者设定下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: KL正则不应简单移除或直接并入奖励，而应通过条件KL相对漂移对组内奖励系数进行校准，从而更合理地引入参考策略信息，提升组策略优化表现。

title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems
summary: Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试了五个模型在20个监管与平台政策领域中的规则敏感性：删除、替换或否定给定规则后，合规判定（OCS）与内部合规表征（ICS-delta）几乎不变，说明合规判定并非基于所给规则。护栏模型规则敏感性最低、准确率仅约51%，且提示优化与表征干预均无法弥补该差距。
AI.motivation: 合规系统部署的隐含假设是：判定应由所给监管规则决定。但该假设此前未被直接检验。作者希望揭示模型的高准确率是否真正"基于规则"，还是依赖规则之外的其他线索，从而评估合规系统的可信度与失效风险。
AI.method: 在五个模型、20个监管与平台政策领域上进行对照扰动实验：固定案件不变，仅删除、替换或否定其治理规则。用两个指标度量响应：OCS（判定是否随规则改变而改变）与ICS-delta（模型内部合规表征是否发生偏移）。同时比较护栏模型（在其原生分类体系的自定义规则适配下评估）与通用模型的表现，并检验改进提示与对内部表征的直接干预能否缩小差距。
AI.result: 判定与内部表征均少有变化——模型判定常对所给规则的实质扰动保持不变。护栏模型是五个模型中规则敏感性最低、准确率也最低的，仅略高于随机（51%），而通用模型为90–92%。不过在"删除规则会改变原本正确预测"的案例上，模型能紧密追踪规则，说明该现象更多反映简单案例而非全面忽视。更好的提示与内部表征干预均未能弥补这一差距。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭准确率不能证明合规判定以所给规则为依据；模型的判定常与规则脱钩。因此合规评估需要引入规则敏感性等指标，并重新审视护栏模型的可靠性。

title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
summary: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.

AI.tldr: 提出SparseDecoding，一种面向解码的免训练N:M剪枝框架，通过解码激活校准和优化的SpMV内核，实现准确且快速的LLM解码。
AI.motivation: LLM解码阶段受内存带宽限制，延迟高。基于Hessian的免训练分层剪枝虽能减少解码时读取的非零参数，但现有方法用预采集的自然序列计算Hessian，而解码时模型输入的是自生成token，二者存在分布偏移，导致剪枝所用激活分布与生成时激活分布不一致，损害剪枝模型性能。此外，现有带来实际加速的LLM剪枝方法主要针对SpMM，对主导解码的SpMV支持有限。
AI.method: SparseDecoding从算法与系统两个维度设计：算法上，利用稠密模型自回归生成过程中逐层采集的激活（排除prefill阶段）构建校准矩阵，使剪枝目标与解码激活对齐；系统上，开发了采用位掩码索引（bitmask indexing）与固定步长遍历（fixed-step traversal）的优化N:M稀疏矩阵-向量（SpMV）内核。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B/32B等代表性LLM上，方法在长文本生成基准上持续优于标准的固定文本校准，并在A100 GPU上实现最高1.48倍的端到端实际解码加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过将剪枝校准对齐到解码激活并优化SpMV内核，SparseDecoding同时提升了剪枝模型的生成精度与解码效率，验证了解码感知剪枝在LLM推理加速中的有效性。

title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
summary: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对抗启发式学习（AHL）新范式，用AI智能体作为学习引擎、在冻结模型权重的前提下迭代修订游戏策略与配套软件，并发布含12个真实对抗游戏与1920份人类程序档案的AAArena基准；在竞赛式评测协议下，Opus5.5+Claude Code获6枚金牌，剩余6个人类梯队无人攻克，规则越复杂表现越弱。
AI.motivation: 对抗游戏推动了从启发式搜索到强化学习的进展，但从有限样本中学习并自适应策略依然是难题。作者希望探索一种替代路径：把游戏经验转化为可执行策略的修订，而非依赖权重更新，从而验证AI智能体作为"学习引擎"的潜力与边界。
AI.method: 基于启发式学习（HL）形式化提出对抗启发式学习（AHL）：以AI智能体为学习引擎，在模型权重固定的条件下精炼游戏策略及其支撑软件。构建AAArena基准，包含12个真实对抗游戏与1,920份存档人类程序，评测协议参照真实游戏竞赛，要求智能体在固定的对局与评测预算内完成规则解读、选择对手、分析回放并修订游戏智能体以取得最高排名。评测了多种模型与框架（harness）配置。
AI.result: Opus5.5配合Claude Code获得6枚金牌；但没有任何被评测配置能在其余6个人类梯队上登顶。规则规格越复杂，表现普遍越弱。进一步实验表明：对手选择与密集反馈有助于策略改进；智能体既可从自身对局的on-policy回放中学习，也可从其他玩家对局的off-policy回放中学习。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了HL在对抗游戏中的潜力，同时指出现存挑战：游戏理解、策略实现与长时程策略发展仍是持续难点。

title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"先验壁垒"概念量化预训练模型对目标概念的支持程度，发现其呈长尾分布，并据此设计自适应指令选择方法PASS。
AI.motivation: SFT中不同概念获得的预训练支持差异显著：高频概念易学好，稀有概念表示薄弱。现有指令选择方法未考虑这种先验支持的不均衡，导致训练起点不一致。
AI.method: 1) 提出prior barrier，度量预训练模型对竞争概念相对目标概念的支持强度；2) 理论推导长尾先验壁垒下SFT的预测风险界，刻画先验壁垒与累积SFT证据如何共同决定性能；3) 提出PASS：构造参考派生概念，估计每条指令提供的区分性证据，并将选择预算自适应分配给当前覆盖不足的概念。
AI.result: 在4种主干模型-预算设置下，PASS一致优于7种最先进指令选择方法；消融实验表明自适应分配持续优于均匀分配。
AI.conclusion: 先验壁垒长尾分布解释了头尾概念SFT起点的差异；同时考虑"哪些指令有证据"与"哪些概念缺监督"的自适应选择可有效提升SFT效果。

title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
summary: When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"认知谦逊（EH）"为核心评估智能体在证据与先验信念冲突时的行为，将其操作化为Identify、Solve、Escalate（ISE）三个轨迹级维度，并在受控与自然发生的知识冲突中评估四个智能体。结果显示高任务准确率并不等于高EH，冲突常在早期被检测但后期未被维持或解决，模型级干预可提升EH但往往牺牲准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有对智能体系统的评估主要聚焦任务成功率，对智能体在检索证据与自身先验信念冲突时如何应对（修正答案、承认不确定性，还是坚持错误结论）缺乏洞察，因此需要一套超越任务成功的评估框架来刻画智能体的认知谦逊。
AI.method: 提出用认知谦逊（EH）评估智能体，即其在任务执行中识别、依据并传达不确定性的意愿；通过Identify、Solve、Escalate（ISE）三个轨迹级行为维度进行操作化。利用知识冲突（骨干语言模型的参数化知识与所遇证据矛盾，或两个上下文来源相互矛盾）设置两类场景：受控冲突与多步智能体执行中自然发生的冲突，并各配匹配的无冲突对照组。评估四个智能体。
AI.result: 更高的任务准确率不必然对应更强的认知谦逊：部分高准确率配置在执行中能识别冲突，但未能在错误的最终答案中传达未解决的不确定性。轨迹级分析显示，智能体常在执行早期步骤检测到冲突，却在后续步骤中未能维持或解决。模型级干预可改善EH，但常以任务准确率为代价。
AI.conclusion: 认知谦逊并非单一模型属性，而是源于骨干模型、智能体框架（harness）与评估环境三者交互的结果；评估智能体应超越任务成功指标，纳入轨迹级的EH度量。

title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.

AI.tldr: 大模型能高比例正确援引法律依据，但判决对其所称依据的依赖度极低（0%–21.7% 至 43.3%–50.0%），且判决更易被事实中隐藏的对抗指令操纵（73.3%–96.4%）。
AI.motivation: 法律实践中常将模型"点名法律依据"视为判决由此推导的证据，但这一假设未经检验；作者希望直接测量判决对所指法律依据的实际依赖程度，并考察其是否与对抗攻击脆弱性共存。
AI.method: 固定案件事实，将模型援引的法律依据替换为无关依据，从隐藏状态中解码模型演化的判决（verdict）。覆盖 7 个开源权重模型（8B–70B）、4 个涵盖司法与合同推理的基准，并训练一个专门法律推理 LoRA 模型作对照。另在 5 个核心模型上进行红队评估：将对抗指令隐藏于案件事实中，比较其遵从率与依据替换敏感度。通过排除提示措辞噪声与采样混淆的对照实验验证稳健性。
AI.result: 明确要求援引依据时，模型给出正确法律依据的比例为 66.7%–100%；而依据变化导致判决改变的比例显著更低：CaseHOLD 为 0.0%–21.7%，ECHR 与 SCOTUS 为 30.0%–76.7%，ContractNLI 为 43.3%–50.0%。模型规模扩大未缩小该差距，专门法律推理模型亦然。红队测试中对抗指令遵从率达 73.3%–96.4%，远高于判决替换敏感度，且在模型排序上无例外。结果在排除措辞与采样混淆的检验中均复现。
AI.conclusion: 援引法律依据是判决依赖性的糟糕代理指标，而同一判决却单独易受对抗操纵。生成的"法律解释"不宜作为合规或审计凭证使用。

title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
summary: Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OnTrack，一种流式监控机制，通过将智能体的步骤与依赖关系同已记录的成功运行进行对比，在约 1 毫秒/步的开销下实现告警或阻断。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体多自主运行，缺乏规则化防护，不可逆动作会带来成本与安全问题。现有方案要么用防护智能体逐步监控（增加成本与延迟），要么事后评估日志（事后才发现问题，代币已消耗、损害已成）。
AI.method: 将智能体的步骤与依赖同已记录的成功运行进行流式对比；在三种递减访问权限下研究：完全参考访问（历史运行+工具 schema）、中等访问（仅工具 schema）、无先验知识（仅生成时的步骤日志）。并在 SWE-bench 轨迹上评估。
AI.result: 访问数据越少，监控能力越弱，从计划违反检测到识别循环、停滞和重复工具调用递减。在 SWE-bench 上，基于前 8 步，比内容相似度方法更好地将失败轨迹排在成功轨迹之下（+0.057 AUROC）；配合中止策略可节省约 18% 失败运行算力，83% 被中断运行确实走向失败（6 次中止中 5 次正确）。
AI.conclusion: OnTrack 以近毫秒级开销实现流式监控，有效提前识别失败轨迹并节省算力，但监控能力依赖于可访问的先验数据量。

title: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
summary: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLM-BlockFE，一种 LLM 引导的离线特征构建框架，将长文本转化为可执行特征程序，在线推理时无需调用 LLM。
AI.motivation: 工业风控系统依赖结构化数据模型进行高效预测，但大量有价值信息蕴含于非结构化长文本中。人工特征工程成本高，而实时调用 LLM 处理每次输入难以满足部署要求。
AI.method: 通过增量追加不可变代码块构建特征程序，并用下游模型评估候选特征；针对传统贪心搜索易陷入次优解的问题，引入基于深度校准信用分配的块级回滚机制，并以交错方式推进多条独立搜索轨迹，通过共享各轨迹探索方向的固定描述减少冗余探索；搜索后冻结程序用于提取结构化特征。
AI.result: 在两个公开和两个私有数据集上，全量数据对比中相较最强基线取得 0.0069 至 0.0358 的绝对 AUC 提升；在五个已部署金融风控应用的上线后监测中，相较现有人工设计策略取得 0.02 至 1.56 个百分点的绝对 KS 提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM-BlockFE 有效兼顾了长文本信息利用与在线推理效率，验证了离线特征程序构建在工业风控场景中的实用价值。

title: Freeze the Decoder, Heal the Encoder: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for SVD-Based KV-Cache Compression
summary: Comparing parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes under a single, shared learning rate is a common but flawed practice: when the arms being compared have very different trainable-parameter counts, a shared rate can simultaneously depress the larger arms' means and inflate their variance, manufacturing a large, seemingly multi-seed-significant advantage for the smallest arm that is not a real effect. We document this confound in a concrete setting: post-hoc SVD-based KV-cache compression, where an already-pretrained model is converted to a low-rank (multi-head-latent-attention-style) cache by factorizing its key/value weights into a down-projection ("encoder") and an up-projection ("decoder"), after which a short fine-tune ("healing") recovers the accuracy lost to truncation. Under a shared learning rate, freezing the decoder and healing only the encoder looks like a clear win over healing the decoder or both factors; once every arm is given its own tuned learning rate, that apparent advantage disappears, and encoder-only healing instead reaches parity with the alternatives, at a real, measured saving of 3x fewer trainable parameters and 3x less optimizer-state memory. We verify this parity with per-arm learning-rate tuning and three seeds per configuration on a vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct), at the one compression ratio this protocol covers, and replicate it on a text-only testbed across two backbones. Encoder-only healing is therefore a lower-memory drop-in recipe for retrofitting low-rank KV-cache compression at training time, and the shared-learning-rate pitfall we document and correct is a cautionary result for comparing any fine-tuning recipes whose arms differ in trainable-parameter count.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示并纠正了参数高效微调比较中的"共享学习率陷阱"：在SVD KV-cache压缩场景下，统一学习率会制造出最小可训练参数组的虚假优势；逐组调参后该优势消失，仅训练encoder的healing方案以3倍更少可训练参数和3倍更少优化器状态内存达到与替代方案持平的效果。
AI.motivation: 参数高效微调（PEFT）配方比较中普遍采用单一共享学习率，但被比较的各方案可训练参数量差异很大。共享学习率可能同时压低参数量大的方案均值并抬高其方差，从而人为制造出最小参数量方案的"多随机种子显著"假优势。作者希望系统记录这一混杂因素并给出修正后的可靠结论，应用于SVD KV-cache压缩这一具体场景。
AI.method: 以post-hoc SVD-based KV-cache压缩为验证场景：将已预训练模型的key/value权重分解为down-projection（encoder）和up-projection（decoder），转为低秩（MHA-latent-attention风格）缓存，再用短程微调（"healing"）恢复截断造成的精度损失。对比三种healing方案（仅encoder、仅decoder、两者都训练）。关键做法是放弃共享学习率，改为为每个arm单独调参（per-arm learning-rate tuning），并在每种配置下使用三个随机种子。
AI.result: 在共享学习率下，仅冻结decoder、只healing encoder似乎明显优于healing decoder或两者；一旦为每个arm单独调参，该表观优势消失，encoder-only healing与替代方案达到持平（parity），同时实现真实可测的节省：3倍更少可训练参数、3倍更少优化器状态内存。在Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct视觉语言模型上、该协议覆盖的单一压缩比下验证了持平结果，并在两个骨干的纯文本测试台上复现。
AI.conclusion: Encoder-only healing是一种更低内存的即插即用方案，用于在训练时对低秩KV-cache压缩进行retrofit。所记录并纠正的共享学习率陷阱是一个警示性结果，适用于任何比较可训练参数量不同臂的微调配方。

title: SPERA: Spherical Prior EEG Foundation Model with Geometry- and Frequency-Aware Latent Prediction
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive measure of ongoing neural activity, but building general-purpose EEG models remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of subjects, devices, and electrode montages.
