AI.result: 在日处理5万笔交易、准确率98.46%、ROC-AUC 0.9990的生产欺诈检测系统上，审计日EDS=0.23可在6个月前由DART轨迹预测（beta=0.008/周，R²=0.94，95%CI [0.006,0.010]）；78%的可解释性债务集中于最高监管风险类别（>1万美元交易），该风险不对称在系统级指标中完全不可见。
AI.conclusion: TRACE为生产级AI部署的EU AI Act第13条合规提供首个可量化运营架构，开辟了独立于"解释生成"的"解释治理"新子学科。

title: Spectrally Targeted Muon
summary: The Muon optimizer orthogonalizes each update matrix, setting all of its singular values to one, and has proven highly effective for training large language models. It remains unclear, however, whether this success comes from amplifying small singular directions that gradient descent neglects or from suppressing large, degenerate directions that disrupt training. We introduce Spectrally Targeted Muon, which orthogonalizes only the singular values above or below a threshold $τ$, so that varying $τ$ interpolates between normalized SGD and Muon. It isolates the relevant singular subspaces with projections computed by Newton-Schulz iteration on a shifted Gram matrix, so no SVD is needed. We evaluate these variants on the CIFAR-10 and NanoGPT speedruns, tracking the effective rank of gradient, update, and weight matrices and a new metric, the alignment of updates with the tangent space of the weight matrix's isospectral manifold. We find three things. First, the small singular values of the momentum are not noise. Orthogonalizing everything except the few largest singular values of each matrix nearly matches Muon while touching only a small fraction of the momentum, whereas orthogonalizing only the top falls well short even though it holds almost all of it. On language models every momentum singular value is far below one, so targeted orthogonalization can only amplify, and Muon wins by making directions that are too small to train on at their raw scale trainable. Second, shrinking the largest singular values is what keeps the parameter spectrum flat; this is cheap, and it is not what drives the loss. Third, AdamW differs from Muon mainly in how slowly it builds structure, which explains its slower start and why warmup helps AdamW but only hurts Muon.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spectrally Targeted Muon (STM)，仅对高于或低于阈值 τ 的奇异值做正交化，从而在 normalized SGD 与 Muon 之间插值；无需 SVD。实验表明 Muon 的效果主要来自放大极小奇异方向使其可训练，压缩最大奇异值只影响谱平坦性而非损失。
AI.motivation: Muon 对更新矩阵做完全正交化（把所有奇异值置 1）在大语言模型训练中很有效，但其成功机制不明：究竟是放大了梯度下降忽略的小奇异方向，还是抑制了破坏训练的大退化方向。作者希望解耦这两种效应。
AI.method: 提出 Spectrally Targeted Muon：只正交化阈值 τ 以上（或以下）的奇异值，τ 变化即可在 normalized SGD 与 Muon 间插值。用位移 Gram 矩阵上的 Newton-Schulz 迭代计算投影以分离相关奇异子空间，避免 SVD。在 CIFAR-10 与 NanoGPT speedrun 上评测，追踪梯度、更新与权重矩阵的有效秩，并提出新指标——更新与权重矩阵等谱流形切空间的对齐度。
AI.result: 1) 动量的小奇异值不是噪声：正交化除少数最大奇异值外的全部（仅触及小部分动量）几乎可媲美 Muon，而只正交化顶部（占几乎全部动量）效果明显不足；语言模型上每个动量奇异值都远小于 1，针对性正交化只能放大，Muon 通过让原始尺度下过小、无法训练的方向变得可训练而取胜。2) 压缩最大奇异值才是保持参数谱平坦的原因；这很廉价，且并非驱动损失的因素。3) AdamW 与 Muon 的差异主要在构建结构的速度，这解释了 AdamW 起步更慢，以及 warmup 帮助 AdamW 却只损害 Muon。
AI.conclusion: Muon 的核心收益来自放大过小的奇异方向使其可训练，而非抑制大奇异方向；谱平坦性由压缩最大奇异值保证但与损失无关；AdamW 与 Muon 之别源于结构建立速度。

title: ASPIRE: Saddle-Point Discovery through Set Prediction and Physical Refinement
summary: Predicting thermally activated diffusion and defect evolution with event-driven models requires identifying atomic rearrangement mechanisms and their activation barriers. Discovering the associated saddle points is a major computational bottleneck: multiple rearrangements may originate from one metastable state, while costly local searches can fail or repeatedly converge to the same saddle. To address this challenge, we introduce ASPIRE (Atomistic Saddle-Point Inference with Refinement for Events), a framework that predicts a set of saddle candidates from a single initial atomic environment and refines them through Dimer searches on the original interatomic potential. The framework's equivariant set predictor, Ev-Quiformer, integrates (i) geometry-conditioned scalar-vector event slots for generating multiple saddle-point proposals and (ii) a decoder that maps each slot to a full atomic displacement field by combining atom, slot, and anchor-relative vectors with invariant coefficients. We also contribute two datasets: (i) BCCFE4VACAV-4000, comprising 4,000 four-vacancy body-centered cubic iron configurations and 65,450 reference events grouped by initial state for set supervision and post-refinement evaluation; and (ii) BCCFE-1TO4VAC, comprising 5,372 configurations with one to four vacancies each. Theoretically, we establish conditions for proposal equivariance. Experimentally, ASPIRE achieves 77.20% reference-event coverage on this benchmark, compared with 75.73% for a conventional Dimer baseline, while requiring approximately half as many Dimer force evaluations. In a timing evaluation on 50 configurations, ASPIRE reduces wall time per configuration from 478.8 s to 176.3 s under the stated hardware settings.

AI.tldr: 提出ASPIRE框架，用等变集合预测器Ev-Quiformer从单一初始原子环境预测多个鞍点候选，再经Dimer搜索精修，显著提升效率并降低力评估次数。
AI.motivation: 事件驱动模型模拟热激活扩散与缺陷演化需识别原子重排机制及其激活势垒，但鞍点搜索是主要计算瓶颈：一个亚稳态可能存在多种重排，局部搜索昂贵且易失败或重复收敛到同一鞍点。
AI.method: ASPIRE（Atomistic Saddle-Point Inference with Refinement for Events）：从单一初始原子环境预测一组鞍点候选，并在原始原子间势上通过Dimer搜索精修。其等变集合预测器Ev-Quiformer集成：(i) 几何条件化的标量-向量事件槽以生成多个鞍点提议；(ii) 解码器，将每个槽映射为完整原子位移场，结合原子、槽与锚点相对向量及不变系数。理论上建立提议等变性的条件。并贡献两个数据集：BCCFE4VACAV-4000（4,000个四空位BCC铁构型及65,450个按初始态分组的参考事件）和BCCFE-1TO4VAC（5,372个含1至4个空位的构型）。
AI.result: 在该基准上ASPIRE达到77.20%的参考事件覆盖率，优于传统Dimer基线的75.73%，同时所需Dimer力评估次数约为其一半。在50个构型的时间评估中，在所述硬件设置下，单构型墙钟时间由478.8秒降至176.3秒。
AI.conclusion: ASPIRE通过等变集合预测加精修的策略，在保证更高事件覆盖率的同时大幅减少力评估与墙钟时间，为热激活扩散与缺陷演化的鞍点搜索提供了高效方案。

title: Transferability of Learned States in Neural PDE Solvers
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Assessing useful reuse in neural PDE solvers is challenging: final accuracy can reflect source learning and target-time computation. Our reuse contract separates solution accuracy, learning contribution, and numerical utility through paired state comparisons, matched target information and budgets, and cost accounting. A literature audit extracts 18 version-specific protocol records from 12 papers, documenting retained states, target-time resources, and reported controls. For a fixed linear system and residual tolerance, we construct two initial guesses with identical solution-error, energy-error, and residual norms, reaching the same solution with different conjugate-gradient (CG) iteration counts. Across 240 source-training trajectories, two linear PDE families, Fourier neural operators and convolutional networks, a fixed predictor's benefit reverses across correction algorithms. Among pairs with both relative prediction errors less than or equal to 5 percent on 64 in-distribution tasks (63 by 63 interior grids), reductions in all three norms accompany more CG iterations, at mean taskwise rates of 23.5 percent and 23.9 percent in two libraries. Work-based selection saves 2.50-3.33 CG iterations on held-out in-distribution tasks; matched adaptation demonstrates finite-budget pretraining value. Independent batches confirm a 0.73 percent complete online saving for one physics-trained Fourier neural operator against zero-initialized Poisson-preconditioned CG. Reuse requires matched state comparisons and downstream computational evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"复用契约"框架，通过配对状态比较、匹配目标信息与预算、以及成本核算，将神经PDE求解器中的最终精度分解为解的精度、学习贡献与数值效用，并据此审计文献、开展受控实验。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE求解器中的"有用复用"难以评估：最终精度同时反映源域学习与目标时刻的计算量，二者混淆，导致无法判断复用是否真正带来收益。
AI.method: 提出复用契约：分离解的精度、学习贡献与数值效用；采用配对状态比较、匹配目标信息与预算、成本核算。对12篇论文进行文献审计，提取18条版本特定的协议记录。构造具有相同解误差、能量误差和残差范数的两个初始猜测，观察CG迭代次数差异。在240条源训练轨迹、两个线性PDE族、Fourier神经算子与卷积网络上检验固定预测器的收益是否随校正算法反转。在64个分布内任务上比较三种范数与CG迭代次数。
AI.result: 相同误差/残差范数的两个初始猜测以不同CG迭代次数达到同一解；240条轨迹中固定预测器的收益在不同校正算法间发生反转；64个分布内任务上三种范数降低均伴随更多CG迭代（两库平均任务级速率23.5%与23.9%）；基于功的选择在留出任务上节省2.50–3.33次CG迭代；匹配自适应显示有限预算预训练价值；独立批次确认某物理训练FNO相对零初始化Poisson预处理CG有0.73%的完整在线节省。
AI.conclusion: 神经PDE求解器的有用复用必须依赖匹配状态比较与下游计算证据，仅看最终精度不足以判断学习贡献。

title: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Lygist/Budgeted-Multi-Source-Counterfactual-Annotation-for-Off-Policy-Evaluation
summary: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the value of a target policy from logged data, but limited behavior-policy coverage can force high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation. Counterfactual annotations can add evidence about unobserved actions, yet practical sources, including domain experts and large language models (LLMs), may be costly, biased, or noisy. We study budgeted acquisition of such annotations for contextual-bandit OPE. Given source-specific costs and error profiles, we formulate an integer allocation problem over context-action pairs and annotation sources to minimize the component of estimator variance that depends on the annotation plan. We characterize when annotations are valuable through a first-annotation threshold and local annotation-value regimes. For the coupled multi-source problem, we develop a majorization-minimization algorithm with dynamic-programming subroutines that monotonically improves the objective. Experiments in synthetic clinical and LLM-annotated education bandits show that our allocation method reduces fixed-profile mean squared error (MSE) by 20.58% and 10.77%, respectively, relative to no annotation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在预算约束下的反事实标注采集问题，用于上下文赌博机中的离策略评估（OPE）。针对不同标注源的代价与误差特征，将问题建模为整数分配问题，提出主化-最小化算法与动态规划子程序，实验证明可显著降低固定误差剖面下的MSE。
AI.motivation: 传统OPE在行为策略覆盖不足时，需要高方差重加权或奖励模型外推。反事实标注能补充未观测动作的信息，但专家与LLM等实际标注源存在昂贵、有偏、噪声大的问题，因此需要在有限预算下合理分配标注资源。
AI.method: 将预算约束下的标注采集形式化为上下文-动作对与标注源上的整数分配问题，目标是最小化依赖于标注方案的估计量方差分量；通过"首次标注阈值"和局部标注价值区域刻画标注的价值；对多源耦合问题，提出主化-最小化（MM）算法，并配以动态规划子程序，单调改进目标函数。
AI.result: 在合成的临床赌博机与LLM标注的教育赌博机实验中，相比无标注基线，所提分配方法将固定误差剖面下的均方误差（MSE）分别降低20.58%和10.77%。
AI.conclusion: 面向上下文赌博机OPE的预算化反事实标注分配是可行且有效的；考虑源特异性代价与误差特征的整数优化能显著降低估计方差与MSE，所提MM算法具有良好的理论与优化性质。

title: Optimizing Large Language Models with Chained LMOs
summary: Muon has motivated a growing family of optimizers that compose multiple matrix normalizations, but these methods remain fragmented and lack a unified perspective. We introduce chained linear minimization oracles (chained LMOs), which cast these methods as compositions of LMOs. Despite their empirical success, many chains fall outside the standard LMO framework and can diverge on smooth convex objectives. To explain why composition can nevertheless help, we turn to linear associative memory and show that chaining can improve over Muon under anisotropic embeddings. Empirically, we propose TensorChain, a novel optimizer within the framework that stacks compatible weight matrices across different layers and normalizes the 3d tensor across its axes. In Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B pretraining, TensorChain outperforms all chained baselines in average token efficiency, with average token savings of 9.6% over Muon at matched validation loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“链式线性最小化预言机”（chained LMOs）框架，将Muon等由多个矩阵归一化组合而成的优化器统一为LMO的复合，并据此设计新优化器TensorChain。
AI.motivation: Muon衍生出一系列组合多种矩阵归一化的优化器，但方法碎片化、缺乏统一视角；且许多“链式”方法超出标准LMO框架，在光滑凸目标上可能发散，因此需要一个统一框架并解释复合为何有效。
AI.method: 提出chained LMOs，把此类方法建模为LMO的复合；借助线性联想记忆（linear associative memory）理论分析各向异性嵌入下链式复合相对Muon的改进；并据此提出TensorChain——跨不同层堆叠兼容权重矩阵，沿各轴对三维张量进行归一化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3 0.6B与1.7B预训练中，TensorChain在平均token效率上优于所有链式基线，在匹配验证损失下相比Muon平均节省9.6%的token。
AI.conclusion: 链式LMO为Muon类优化器提供了统一视角，理论上说明复合在各向异性嵌入下可带来收益，实践上TensorChain验证了该框架的有效性并显著提升token效率。

title: Invariant-Measure Reasoners: Stable Representations for Latent Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning models repeatedly update a latent state using the same recurrent block. As the recurrent depth increases, the sequence of latent states may converge to a compact subset of the state space without necessarily converging to a fixed point. Existing models typically predict by applying a prediction head to a single latent state. However, the latent state can continue to change even after many updates, potentially making predictions unstable across recurrent depths. To address this instability, we introduce invariant-measure reasoners (ImR), a framework that uses an invariant measure as a stable representation. This measure describes the long-run distribution of latent states on the compact subset and is invariant under updates by the recurrent block. ImR predicts from the expectation of the prediction head's output under this measure. We use ImR in two ways: fine-tuning only the prediction head of existing models and training models from scratch. Both approaches reduce prediction instability and improve accuracy in many settings on maze and Sudoku tasks. In some settings, models trained with ImR exhibit non-fixed-point behavior more frequently than existing models yet achieve high accuracy even with such behavior, unlike existing models. These results suggest that ImR can leverage otherwise destabilizing dynamics for latent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出不变测度推理器（ImR），用循环块更新下不变的长程分布作为稳定表示，通过对预测头输出求期望来做预测，缓解潜在推理模型随深度增加产生的预测不稳定，在迷宫和数独任务上提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 潜在推理模型用同一循环块反复更新潜在状态。随着循环深度增加，潜在状态序列可能收敛到状态空间的一个紧致子集，但未必收敛到不动点。现有模型通常只对单个潜在状态施加预测头进行预测，而潜在状态在多次更新后仍可能变化，导致跨循环深度的预测不稳定。
AI.method: 提出不变测度推理器（ImR）框架，使用不变测度作为稳定表示。该测度刻画潜在状态在紧致子集上的长程分布，且在循环块更新下保持不变。ImR 在该测度下对预测头输出的期望进行预测。ImR 有两种使用方式：仅微调现有模型的预测头，以及从头训练模型。
AI.result: 两种方式均降低了预测不稳定性，并在迷宫和数独任务的多种设置下提升准确率。在某些设置中，用 ImR 训练的模型比现有模型更频繁地表现出非不动点行为，但即便存在这种行为仍能达到高准确率，而现有模型则不能。
AI.conclusion: ImR 能够利用原本会造成不稳定的动力学来服务潜在推理，表明非不动点的循环动力学可被转化为有利的表示资源。

title: F$^3$NO: Frequency-Decomposed Finite-Time Flow-map Neural Operators with Cross-Scale Conditioning
summary: Neural operators enable fast PDE forecasting, but repeated predictions accumulate errors and fine-scale structures remain difficult to resolve. We introduce a frequency-decomposed finite-time flow-map neural operator (F$^3$NO) that leverages updated low-frequency features to guide nonlinear refinement of high-frequency information. Within each layer, this cross-scale conditioning connects global spectral processing with local detail refinement. The model directly predicts states at specified future times and adjusts the contributions of the two branches according to the prediction interval. For longer trajectories, it combines parallel predictions within short temporal segments with recursive propagation between segments. Experiments on five PDE benchmarks demonstrate improved forecasting accuracy over autoregressive and direct-prediction baselines. Ablations show that frequency-decomposed refinement can improve accuracy with fewer parameters, while the benefits of segmentation depend on spatial resolution and dynamical regime.

AI.tldr: 提出频率分解的有限时间流映射神经算子F³NO，用低频特征引导高频细节的非线性精化，结合分段并行预测与递归传播，在五个PDE基准上超越自回归与直接预测基线。
AI.motivation: 神经算子虽能快速进行PDE预测，但重复迭代预测会累积误差，且难以分辨细尺度结构。因此需要一种能兼顾长时程稳定性与高频细节精度的预测框架。
AI.method: F³NO采用频率分解的有限时间流映射设计：每层内通过跨尺度条件化，将全局谱处理与局部细节精化相连，用更新后的低频特征指导高频信息的非线性精化；模型直接预测指定未来时刻状态，并按预测区间调节两条分支的贡献；对较长轨迹，采用短时段内并行预测与段间递归传播相结合的策略。
AI.result: 在五个PDE基准实验上，F³NO相比自回归预测基线和直接预测基线均提升了预测精度。消融实验表明，频率分解精化能以更少参数提升精度，而分段策略的收益取决于空间分辨率和动力学特性。
AI.conclusion: 频率分解精化与有限时间流映射相结合可有效提升PDE预测的精度与参数效率；分段递归传播的增益具有条件性，需结合空间分辨率与动力学机制加以选择。

title: Low-rank tensor structure of precipitation and its application to satellite-reference merging
summary: The intermittent and variable nature of precipitation makes its accurate estimation over extended domains difficult, yet its spatiotemporal structure suggests that a low-rank representation may be possible. This work represents daily precipitation over the contiguous United States (CONUS) as spatiotemporal tensors and applies CANDECOMP/PARAFAC factorization, showing that preserving the native spatial and temporal modes yields more accurate reconstruction than factorizing independent daily fields or unfolded space--time matrices. Building on this finding, this work presents TMerge, a tensor-based framework that integrates satellite precipitation with sparse reference observations through shared low-rank spatial and temporal factors. TMerge was applied to correct the IMERG Final Run product with climate prediction center reference observations over CONUS. During 2019-2022, TMerge increased correlation from 0.53 to 0.85 and reduced root-mean-square error and mean absolute error by 48.2% and 29.3%, respectively. TMerge consistently outperformed linear bias correction, quantile mapping, and neural networks across seasons, precipitation-intensity regimes, and regions. Improvements were spatially coherent and largest in coastal regions where IMERG errors were greatest. These results demonstrate that low-rank tensor structure parsimoniously approximates the dominant spatiotemporal variability of precipitation and provides a practical mechanism for improving satellite estimates under limited reference observations over extended domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文将美国本土日降水表示为时空张量并进行CP分解，证明保留原生时空模态的重建优于矩阵分解，进而提出TMerge张量融合框架，用稀疏站点观测校正卫星降水，显著提升精度并优于多种现有方法。
AI.motivation: 降水具有间歇性与变率大的特点，在大范围区域内精确估计困难；但其时空结构暗示可能存在低秩表示，为卫星降水产品的校正提供了新思路。
AI.method: 将CONUS日降水建模为时空张量，采用CANDECOMP/PARAFAC（CP）分解，对比独立日场与时空矩阵展开的分解效果；基于共享的低秩空间与时间因子提出TMerge框架，将卫星降水与稀疏参考观测融合，用于校正IMERG Final Run。
AI.result: 2019—2022年间，TMerge将相关系数从0.53提升至0.85，RMSE和MAE分别降低48.2%和29.3%；在各季节、降水强度区间和区域上均优于线性偏差校正、分位数映射和神经网络；改进具有空间连贯性，且在IMERG误差最大的沿海地区提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 低秩张量结构能够以简约方式近似降水的主要时空变率，为在有限参考观测条件下改进大范围卫星降水估计提供了实用机制。

title: Emergent Inverse-Depth Scaling From Nonlinearity In Attention
summary: Scaling laws describe power-law improvements in model performance with dataset size and parameter count, yet their underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. To explain the parameter count scaling, existing theory posits power-law scaling with model depth. In linear-attention models, this scaling is tied to a power-law data spectrum: unable to selectively attend to relevant tokens, these models learn according to global spectral strength, with stronger directions learned before weaker ones. Large language models, however, can be strongly nonlinear. Here, we show that nonlinear attention yields inverse-depth decay of loss across all tested data spectra. Nonlinearity enables attention to focus selectively on relevant tokens, allowing strong and weak spectral directions to be learned in parallel. Similar focusing across layers motivates a connection to the central limit theorem: shared error across layers sets the loss plateau, while aggregation turns layer-specific differences into continued gains with depth. Our findings suggest that depth scaling may arise from nonlinearity in attention, which allows large language models to focus locally and may make the global covariance structure less relevant.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型参数量（深度）缩放律的机制：现有线性注意力理论将深度缩放归于数据谱的幂律结构，而本文发现非线性注意力在各类数据谱下均表现为损失随深度反比衰减，并据此提出基于中心极限定理的解释。
AI.motivation: 缩放律已能刻画性能随数据规模与参数量的幂律提升，但其内在机制尚不清晰。现有理论以深度幂律缩放解释参数量效应，并在线性注意力模型中将其归因于数据谱的幂律分布：由于无法选择性关注相关词元，模型按全局谱强度学习，强方向先于弱方向被学到。但大语言模型具有强非线性，这一线性理论可能不再适用。
AI.method: 对比分析线性与非线性注意力：测试非线性注意力在多种数据谱（而非仅幂律谱）下的损失—深度关系；分析非线性带来的选择性关注能力，即模型可聚焦于相关词元，使强、弱谱方向并行学习；并结合跨层误差结构，用中心极限定理建立深度缩放的理论联系。
AI.result: 在所有测试的数据谱上，非线性注意力均导致损失随深度呈反比（inverse-depth）衰减，而非线性注意力理论所预测的幂律缩放；非线性使强、弱谱方向可并行学习，因而结果对全局协方差结构（数据谱）不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 深度缩放可能源于注意力的非线性：非线性使大语言模型能够进行局部聚焦，从而使全局协方差结构的重要性下降。据此，跨层共享误差决定损失平台，而层间差异的逐层聚合带来随深度持续的性能增益。

title: CityDeploy-Bench: Benchmarking Physics-Grounded Spatial Set Planning for Multi-Transmitter Network Deployment
summary: Automating city-scale wireless deployment remains challenging under complex urban propagation and network-wide interference. We introduce \textbf{CityDeploy-Bench}, a benchmark that reframes multi-transmitter deployment as \emph{physics-grounded spatial set planning} under a unified ray-tracing verifier. The benchmark separates utility representation from planning dynamics, enabling controlled comparison between direct scalar rewards, relational models, and higher-order interaction structures across diverse planners. Our experiments reveal a clear transition in planning behavior as physical coupling grows. Deployment quality becomes increasingly dependent on whether the learned utility captures collective transmitter interactions, whereas stronger search alone cannot compensate for missing relational structure. This establishes multi-transmitter deployment as a coordination problem over physically interacting sets rather than a collection of independent spatial decisions. We release CityDeploy-Data and the benchmark framework as a reproducible testbed for research linking decision learning with physically grounded wireless network design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CityDeploy-Bench，将多发射机城市部署重构为物理约束下的空间集合规划问题，并在统一射线追踪验证器下比较不同效用表示与规划器，发现随物理耦合增强，部署质量取决于效用能否刻画发射机间的集体交互。
AI.motivation: 城市级无线部署自动化受复杂城市传播与全网干扰制约。现有方法多将部署视为独立空间决策的集合，缺乏对发射机间物理耦合与关系结构的刻画，因此需要可控、可复现的基准来分离效用表示与规划动态，系统研究交互结构对部署质量的影响。
AI.method: 提出 CityDeploy-Bench 基准，将多发射机部署形式化为物理约束下的空间集合规划，并配备统一的射线追踪验证器。该框架将效用表示与规划动态解耦，从而在多种规划器上受控比较三类效用表示：直接标量奖励、关系模型以及高阶交互结构。同时发布 CityDeploy-Data 与基准框架作为可复现测试平台。
AI.result: 实验显示，随着物理耦合增强，规划行为出现明显转变：部署质量越来越取决于学习到的效用是否捕捉到发射机间的集体交互；单纯增强搜索能力无法弥补关系结构的缺失。
AI.conclusion: 多发射机部署应被理解为物理交互集合上的协调问题，而非一组相互独立的空间决策；该基准为连接决策学习与物理约束的无线网络设计研究提供了可复现测试床。

title: Optimally Pacing Budget Spending and Learning
summary:
We establish near-optimal regret bounds for budget-constrained online learning against arbitrary classes of budget-pacing experts in the adversarial setting. In particular, given any class of $F$ experts and a candidate budget pacing schedule, we provide a full-information algorithm which obtains regret $O(D \sqrt{\log F}+ \sqrt{T\log F})$ against all experts whose cumulative spending stays within distance $D$ of this schedule, matching lower bounds established by Braverman et al. (2025).
  We additionally show that our technique extends to various problems in online resource allocation, where the learner gets to see the rewards and costs of the current options available to them, and establish $O(D\sqrt{\log F})$ regret bounds when fractional allocation is allowed. This is the first algorithm we are aware of which can achieve $o(\sqrt{T})$ guarantees for such tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文在对抗性设定下，针对预算节奏专家类建立了近最优后悔界：全信息算法达到 O(D√log F + √(T log F))，匹配已有下界；并推广到在线资源分配问题，在允许分数分配时达到 O(D√log F)，首次实现 o(√T) 保证。
AI.motivation: 预算约束在线学习中，现有方法难以在对抗性环境下对任意预算节奏专家类达到最优后悔界，且在线资源分配任务中缺乏 o(√T) 的保证。
AI.method: 提出全信息算法，针对给定专家类与候选预算节奏计划，控制累计支出与计划距离在 D 内的专家子类；并将该技术推广至在线资源分配，利用当前选项的奖励与成本信息，支持分数分配。
AI.result: 主要结果为 O(D√log F + √(T log F)) 的后悔界，匹配 Braverman et al. (2025) 的下界；在线资源分配分数分配设定下达到 O(D√log F)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为预算约束在线学习提供近最优后悔保证，并将方法扩展至在线资源分配，首次实现 o(√T) 级保证。

title: Stability-Plasticity Balance via Singular-Vector Selection in LLM Continual Learning
summary: Domain-specific continual adaptation of LLMs risks catastrophic forgetting, creating a fundamental tension between acquiring new capabilities and preserving those learned during pretraining. PEFT mitigates this problem by restricting the number of trainable parameters, but existing methods lack a principled unit for deciding where plasticity should be allocated and stability should be preserved. We identify the singular-vector channel as a natural unit for managing this trade-off. Each channel represents an input-output transformation, which can be updated to acquire new knowledge or fixed to preserve pretrained capabilities. Based on this perspective, we introduce SVC, a parameter-efficient continual-learning method that selectively updates Singular-Vector Channels. Before fine-tuning, SVC uses domain-specific data to estimate each channel's adaptation benefit and a fixed public general-domain corpus only as a history activation proxy for estimating forgetting cost. It then adaptively selects trainable channels based on these scores via knee-based cost screening, Pareto-front filtering, and Otsu thresholding. Experimental results across four LLM families and eight downstream tasks show that SVC better preserves pretrained capabilities while achieving strong downstream performance relative to existing PEFT baselines. Further analysis of channel scoring and selection demonstrates that selective plasticity at the singular-vector-channel level enables effective continual LLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SVC 方法，将奇异向量通道作为 PEFT 中可训练/冻结的决策单元，通过估计每个通道的适应收益与遗忘代价，自适应选择可训练通道，实现持续学习中的可塑性与稳定性权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM 的领域持续适应易引发灾难性遗忘，存在获取新能力与保留预训练能力的根本矛盾。现有 PEFT 虽通过限制可训练参数量缓解该问题，但缺乏一个原则性的单元来决定"可塑性应分配在何处、稳定性应保留在何处"。
AI.method: 识别出"奇异向量通道"（singular-vector channel）作为管理该权衡的自然单元：每个通道代表一个输入-输出变换，可更新以获取新知，也可固定以保留预训练能力。基于此提出 SVC：微调前，用领域特定数据估计各通道的适应收益（adaptation benefit），用固定的公共通用领域语料作为历史激活代理来估计遗忘代价（forgetting cost）；再通过基于拐点的代价筛选（knee-based cost screening）、Pareto 前沿过滤与 Otsu 阈值法自适应选择可训练通道。
AI.result: 在四个 LLM 系列、八个下游任务上，SVC 相比现有 PEFT 基线在保持预训练能力的同时取得更强的下游性能。对通道打分与选择的分析表明，奇异向量通道级别的选择性可塑性可实现有效的持续 LLM 适应。
AI.conclusion: 奇异向量通道是 PEFT 持续学习中管理可塑性-稳定性权衡的有效原则性单元；通道级的选择性更新能够兼顾下游性能与预训练能力保留。

title: DaCe-DT: Data-Centric Offline Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Prompts and Trajectory Correction for Heterogeneous Tasks
summary: Offline multi-task reinforcement learning (Offline MTRL) heavily depends on the quality and distribution of pre-collected data. However, existing methods mainly focus on algorithmic optimization, with less emphasis on data-level improvements to enhance learning ability and generalization performance. This paper, from a data perspective, reveals three key bottlenecks that limit Offline MTRL performance:(i) ineffective utilization of prompts length under diverse task complexities, and (ii) semantic irrelevance of randomly sampled prompt segments, (iii) misleading supervision induced by fragmented and discontinuous trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose DaCe-DT, a robust offline MTRL framework designed to be insensitive to heterogeneous task complexities and data quality, featuring length-gated prompt masking (LGPM), retrieval-augmented prompt construction (RAPC), and value-adaptive return calibration (VARC). Together, these mechanisms enable DaCe-DT to deliver data-centric prompt adaptation and trajectory refinement, resulting in robust multi-task generalization and stable policy learning amid heterogeneous offline data and tasks. Experimental results on Meta-World show that DaCe-DT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average improvement of 11.73% on optimal datasets and an improvement of 13.34% on suboptimal datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in learning stably from imperfect data and improving overall multi-task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文从数据视角分析离线多任务强化学习的性能瓶颈，提出DaCe-DT框架，通过三种机制实现数据中心的提示自适应与轨迹优化，在Meta-World上超越SOTA约11.73%（最优数据集）和13.34%（次优数据集）。
AI.motivation: 现有离线多任务强化学习（Offline MTRL）方法主要聚焦算法层面优化，较少关注数据层面的改进，因而难以提升学习能力与泛化性能。本文指出三个数据层面的关键瓶颈：(i) 不同任务复杂度下提示长度利用不充分；(ii) 随机采样的提示片段语义无关；(iii) 碎片化、不连续轨迹带来误导性监督。
AI.method: 提出DaCe-DT框架，包含三个机制：长度门控提示掩码（LGPM）、检索增强提示构建（RAPC）与价值自适应回报校准（VARC）；三者协同实现数据中心的提示自适应与轨迹精炼。
AI.result: 在Meta-World基准上，DaCe-DT持续优于现有最优方法，最优数据集平均提升11.73%，次优数据集平均提升13.34%。
AI.conclusion: DaCe-DT对异构任务复杂度与数据质量不敏感，能在不完美数据上稳定学习，实现鲁棒的多任务泛化与稳定的策略学习，验证了数据视角改进的有效性。

title: Cova-PINN: Cross-Domain Conservation Physics-Informed Neural Network for Fluid-Solid Conjugate Heat Transfer in Complex Geometries
summary: Multi-domain physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) flexibly model medium-specific representations to solve fluid--solid conjugate heat transfer (CHT). However, standard multi-domain PINNs enforce governing equations and interface conditions on separately sampled domain supports, which can yield plausible temperature fields but inaccurate end-to-end energy transfer and outlet temperatures. We propose Cova-PINN, a multi-domain PINN framework that aligns conservation support with thermal interaction paths in complex geometries. Cova-PINN jointly optimizes cross-domain composite control-volume balances at the local scale and paired-wall closure at the global exchanger scale. We evaluate Cova-PINN on four triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) heat exchangers and a geometrically distinct DualMS design against CHT-specific, optimization-oriented, and complex-geometry PINN baselines under a common protocol. Relative to the closest baseline, MUSA-PINN-CHT, Cova-PINN reduces average outlet-temperature and device-level closure errors across the four TPMS topologies by $37.7\%$ and $60.2\%$, respectively, while also improving full-field and heat-duty accuracy, with consistent gains on DualMS.

AI.tldr: 提出Cova-PINN多域PINN框架，通过将守恒支撑与热交互路径对齐，联合优化局部跨域复合控制体积平衡和全局成对壁面闭合，显著提升流体-固体共轭传热的出口温度和能量传递精度。
AI.motivation: 标准多域PINN在独立采样的域支撑上施加控制方程和界面条件，虽能给出看似合理的温度场，但端到端能量传递和出口温度不准确，需解决守恒性与热交互路径不匹配的问题。
AI.method: Cova-PINN在复杂几何中对齐守恒支撑与热交互路径，局部尺度上联合优化跨域复合控制体积平衡，全局换热器尺度上优化成对壁面闭合；在四个TPMS换热器及一个几何不同的DualMS设计上，与CHT专用、优化导向及复杂几何PINN基线在统一协议下对比。
AI.result: 相较最接近的基线MUSA-PINN-CHT，Cova-PINN在四个TPMS拓扑上平均出口温度误差降低37.7%、器件级闭合误差降低60.2%，同时提升全场与热负荷精度，并在DualMS上获得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 将守恒支撑与热交互路径对齐可有效改善多域PINN的端到端能量传递与出口温度预测精度，验证了Cova-PINN在复杂几何共轭传热问题上的有效性与泛化性。

title: Dynamics as Code: On Model Compression via Dynamic System
summary: The escalating size of pretrained neural networks has rendered model compression a prerequisite for deployment under stringent memory and compute constraints. With the irrational winding as an example, earlier work introduced a dynamic system (DS) paradigm that reconceptualizes compression as compact weight representation: high-dimensional parameters are encoded by the index of a trajectory produced by a dynamic system, from which the vector is recovered during decompression. This mechanism is fundamentally distinct from pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and low-rank decomposition. Along this direction, we prove that under a Diophantine condition, a finite trajectory of \(M = O(ε^{-(d+ν)})\) states in the irrational winding constitutes an \(ε\)-net over the \(d\)-dimensional weight space, thereby linking state resolution, decompression error, and compression ratio in a predictable manner. Furthermore, we propose a generalized DS-based model compression framework by unifying four DS families---space-filling curves (Hilbert, Peano, Morton/Z-order, Snake), chaotic systems (Lorenz), congruential and pseudo-random generators (LCG, PCG), and low-discrepancy sequences (Halton). Also, we introduce the KD-tree and coordinate-template acceleration to scale to large models as well as outlier identification to control the error. Experiments on ResNet-18 and Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B validate that DS-based compression achieves competitive compression ratios without post-hoc retraining, with controllable decompression error and flexible state-space design, establishing it as a principled and practical compression approach.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于动态系统（DS）的模型压缩范式：用动态系统轨迹的索引编码高维权重，并从Diophantine条件下证明有限轨迹构成ε-net，建立分辨率—解压误差—压缩率的可预测联系；进而统一四类DS族并引入KD-tree、坐标模板加速与离群点识别，在ResNet-18与Qwen模型上验证了无需事后重训练、误差可控的竞争力压缩比。
AI.motivation: 预训练神经网络规模不断增大，在严格的内存与算力约束下模型压缩成为部署前提。现有剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏、低秩分解等方法的压缩机制与本文不同，作者希望将压缩重新表述为紧凑的权重表示问题，寻找一种原理清晰且可实践的压缩途径。
AI.method: 以无理缠绕为代表的动态系统范式，将高维参数用动态系统生成轨迹的索引编码，解压时由轨迹恢复向量。理论上证明在Diophantine条件下，无理缠绕中M = O(ε^{-(d+ν)})个状态的有限轨迹构成d维权重空间上的ε-net。提出统一四类DS族的压缩框架：空间填充曲线（Hilbert、Peano、Morton/Z-order、Snake）、混沌系统（Lorenz）、同余与伪随机生成器（LCG、PCG）、低差异序列（Halton）。并引入KD-tree与坐标模板加速以扩展到大型模型，同时用离群点识别控制误差。
AI.result: 在ResNet-18及Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B上的实验表明，基于DS的压缩在无需事后重训练的情况下取得有竞争力的压缩比，解压误差可控，状态空间设计灵活。
AI.conclusion: 基于动态系统的模型压缩是一种有原理支撑且实用的压缩方法，通过统一多类动态系统、可预测的误差—压缩率关系以及加速与误差控制机制，为大规模模型部署提供了新路径。

title: Machine Learning Optimization for Enhanced OS Fingerprinting
summary: Operating System (OS) Fingerprinting is a technique that can be used to identify a network's operating systems by evaluating network traffic in the form of TCP/IP packets. This research will explore the effectiveness of passively identifying operating systems on the CIC-IDS2017 dataset, a collection of over 47 gigabytes of pcap files with their corresponding operating systems. This research also proposes a new command line interface, OsirisML, which uses nPrint to preprocess the data into tabular data and XGBoost to apply ML to the data to generate, retrain, and test ML models. When packets are split randomly between training and testing, OsirisML models reach an accuracy of 97.66% on a down-sampled subset of the Friday capture and 84.69% on the entire capture. On the entire Monday capture, which contains no attacks, OsirisML reaches an accuracy of 73.83% and an F-1 score of 79.38%.

AI.tldr: 本文探索在CIC-IDS2017数据集上被动识别操作系统的有效性，并提出命令行工具OsirisML，结合nPrint特征预处理与XGBoost机器学习进行OS指纹识别，在随机划分训练测试集下取得最高97.66%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 操作系统指纹识别可通过分析TCP/IP数据包流量来识别网络中的操作系统。既有研究缺乏在公开大规模数据集（CIC-IDS2017，超过47GB pcap文件）上对被动OS识别有效性的系统评估，因此本文旨在填补这一空白并提供一个可用的自动化工具。
AI.method: 提出命令行工具OsirisML，使用nPrint将原始pcap数据预处理为表格化特征，再采用XGBoost算法进行机器学习建模，支持模型生成、再训练与测试，并在CIC-IDS2017数据集（含对应操作系统标签）上进行被动OS识别实验。
AI.result: 当数据包在训练集与测试集之间随机划分时，OsirisML在Friday捕获的降采样子集上达到97.66%准确率，在完整Friday捕获上达到84.69%；在完整Monday捕获（不含攻击）上准确率为73.83%，F-1分数为79.38%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于nPrint特征与XGBoost的被动OS指纹识别在大规模真实流量数据上具有可行性，OsirisML工具可有效支持OS识别模型的生成与评估，但完整流量与无攻击流量场景下的准确率仍有提升空间。

title: QUILT: Rethinking Sparse-Attention Prefill through Shared Query Execution
summary: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context attention, but existing kernels typically process queries independently, repeatedly loading and dequantizing KV entries shared across queries. We observe substantial overlap in the KV entries selected by neighboring queries, creating opportunities for cross-query reuse. We present QUILT, a workload-aware sparse-attention execution mechanism that jointly processes neighboring queries and reuses shared KV entries to reduce redundant memory traffic and computation. QUILT introduces Shift-and-Compare Set Decomposition (SCSD), which transforms irregular set operations into regular data-parallel primitives suitable for modern accelerators, and pipelines SCSD with attention computation to hide its overhead. Cascaded sharing captures reuse hierarchically at multiple granularities. A tile-aware execution strategy balances sharing granularity with hardware tile utilization and selectively removes low-importance query-specific tails to eliminate underutilized tiles. We evaluate QUILT on LongBench using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-3.2 under both tensor and sequence parallelism. Compared with the state-of-the-art sparse-attention kernel, QUILT reduces average kernel latency by up to 55.1% and processed KV data by up to 55.9%, while reducing time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency by up to 36.8% with negligible accuracy degradation.

AI.tldr: QUILT是一种工作负载感知的稀疏注意力执行机制，通过联合处理相邻查询并复用共享KV条目，减少冗余访存与计算，在LongBench上显著降低延迟与KV数据量。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力内核独立处理每个查询，导致邻居查询间共享的KV条目被重复加载与反量化，产生大量冗余内存流量和计算开销。作者观察到相邻查询选择的KV条目存在显著重叠，因此存在跨查询复用的机会。
AI.method: QUILT联合处理相邻查询、复用共享KV条目；提出Shift-and-Compare Set Decomposition（SCSD），将不规则集合操作转化为适合现代加速器的规则数据并行原语，并与注意力计算流水线化以隐藏开销；采用级联共享（Cascaded sharing）在多个粒度上分层捕获复用；引入tile感知执行策略，在共享粒度与硬件tile利用率间取得平衡，并通过选择性移除低重要性的查询特定尾部以消除未充分利用的tile。
AI.result: 在LongBench上使用GLM-5.3与DeepSeek-3.2并在张量并行与序列并行下评估：相比最先进的稀疏注意力内核，平均内核延迟降低最多55.1%，处理KV数据量减少最多55.9%，首token时延（TTFT）降低最多36.8%，且精度退化可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨查询KV复用与工作负载感知的执行设计，QUILT在保持精度的前提下有效提升长上下文稀疏注意力的执行效率。

title: Ranking Prior Alignment for Credit Risk Modeling: When Do External Priors Matter?
summary:
Cold-start credit scoring -- deploying models with scarce labeled data, weak features, or minimal capacity -- is a recurring problem in financial machine learning. When a new lending product launches, labeled default data is scarce, feature pipelines are immature, and models must be deployed with minimal capacity to avoid overfitting. Standard defenses operate on the same limited data; what is needed is a source of external regularization grounded in domain knowledge.
  We propose Ranking Prior Alignment, a model-agnostic framework that distills external ranking priors (from domain experts, teacher models, or LLMs) into any scoring model via a temperature-scaled KL divergence loss. The framework unifies neural (MIL attention) and tree-based (XGBoost custom objective) architectures through a single formulation: L = L_task + gamma(t) * KL(P_agent || P_model), where gamma(t) follows an exponential decay schedule. The method requires no external model at inference, and its tree-based instantiation tolerates annotation noise up to eta = 0.5.
  On an industrial dataset of over 1.5M merchants, MIL alignment achieves 7/7 positive evaluation cells at 3K bags (1 ID + 3 OOT + 3 degradation metrics; peak Delta AUC = +0.020 on OOT-1), and XGBoost ablation achieves 9/9 positive metrics at 300 bags. Cross-dataset validation on public Amex shows 5/5 positive folds (avg Delta AUC = +0.041). Four model families (MIL, XGBoost, LightGBM, Logistic Regression) and four teacher architectures show that the framework is both model-agnostic and prior-source-independent.
  We further observe that alignment gains exhibit an inverse-scaling pattern: benefits grow as data abundance N, model capacity C, and feature quality Q decrease, helping practitioners decide when to invest in prior annotation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ranking Prior Alignment，一种模型无关的框架，通过温度缩放的 KL 散度损失将外部排序先验蒸馏进任意评分模型，用于缓解冷启动信贷评分中的标注稀缺、特征薄弱与容量受限问题。
AI.motivation: 冷启动信贷评分是金融机器学习中反复出现的问题：新产品上线时违约标注数据稀缺、特征管道不成熟、模型必须以极小容量部署以避免过拟合。标准防御手段只能在同一有限数据上操作，因此需要一种基于领域知识的外部正则化来源。
AI.method: 从领域专家、教师模型或 LLM 中提取外部排序先验，通过温度缩放的 KL 散度损失将其蒸馏进评分模型。统一公式为 L = L_task + gamma(t) * KL(P_agent || P_model)，其中 gamma(t) 采用指数衰减调度。框架统一了神经（MIL 注意力）与树模型（XGBoost 自定义目标）两类架构，推理阶段不需要外部模型。
AI.result: 在包含超过 150 万商户的工业数据集上，MIL 对齐在 3K 袋数据时取得 7/7 正向评估单元（1 个 ID + 3 个 OOT + 3 个退化指标；OOT-1 上峰值 Delta AUC = +0.020），XGBoost 消融在 300 袋时取得 9/9 正向指标。在公开 Amex 数据集上跨数据集验证为 5/5 正向折（平均 Delta AUC = +0.041）。四种模型族（MIL、XGBoost、LightGBM、逻辑回归）与四种教师架构表明该框架既模型无关又与先验来源无关。树模型实例可容忍高达 eta = 0.5 的标注噪声。
AI.conclusion: 对齐收益呈现逆缩放模式：当数据丰度 N、模型容量 C 与特征质量 Q 下降时收益增大，可帮助从业者判断何时值得投入先验标注。

title: RideBench: A Large-Scale Exogenous-Aware Benchmark for Ride-Hailing Time Series Forecasting
summary: We release Ride-Hailing, a large-scale ride-hailing time series dataset synthesized from DiDi's marketplace data across 200 spatial areas. Ride-Hailing spans four consecutive years at half-hourly granularity and covers three representative exogenous scenarios: Weather Disturbance, Holiday Effect, and Large-scale Event Impact. Built upon Ride-Hailing, we introduce RideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for exogenous-aware ride-hailing forecasting, covering both regular week-ahead forecasting and long-horizon 8-week-ahead forecasting with up to 2,688 prediction steps. RideBench evaluates over 30 representative forecasting methods, including endogenous-only models, exogenous-aware models, and time series foundation models. Our results show that future-known exogenous variables provide clear benefits in regular week-ahead forecasting, especially under weather, holiday, and large-scale event (e.g., major sporting events and concerts) scenarios. However, current exogenous-aware models still struggle to fully capture disturbance-induced pattern changes under complex external contexts. For long-horizon forecasting, existing models cannot simultaneously achieve low pointwise errors, accurate broad trends, and reliable near-term forecasts. These findings reveal a clear mismatch between existing forecasting models and real-world ride-hailing requirements, highlighting the need for models that can better exploit future-known exogenous information, scale across heterogeneous areas, and support long-horizon planning. By introducing Ride-Hailing and RideBench, we aim to encourage the community to study these practical challenges in real-world ride-hailing forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文发布大规模网约车时序数据集Ride-Hailing及配套基准RideBench，系统评估30余种预测方法在外生情景下的表现，揭示现有模型与真实网约车需求之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 真实网约车预测需应对天气扰动、节假日、大型活动等外生情景，并支持长期规划，但缺乏覆盖多区域、长时段、含外生情景的大规模基准数据，现有模型能力与实际需求存在明显不匹配。
AI.method: 构建Ride-Hailing数据集：来自某网约车平台市场数据、覆盖200个空间区域、连续四年、半小时粒度；涵盖天气扰动、节假日效应、大型活动冲击三类外生情景。基于该数据提出RideBench基准，包含常规提前一周预测与最长提前8周（最多2688步）的长期预测任务，并评测30余种方法：仅内生模型、外生感知模型与时间序列基础模型。
AI.result: 常规提前一周预测中，未来已知外生变量带来明显收益，尤其在天气、节假日和大型活动情景下；但外生感知模型在复杂外部情境下仍难以充分捕捉扰动引起的模式变化。长期预测中，现有模型无法同时实现低点误差、准确的总体趋势和可靠的近期预测。
AI.conclusion: 现有预测模型与真实网约车需求存在明显错位，亟需能更好利用未来已知外生信息、跨异质区域扩展并支持长期规划的模型。Ride-Hailing与RideBench旨在推动社区研究这些实际挑战。

title: CARE: A Lightweight Plug-in Gated Correction and Uncertainty-aware Module for Long-term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate long-horizon forecasting is critical to electricity load scheduling and traffic flow management, and to financial risk control. Existing deterministic backbones output a single trajectory, masking heterogeneous prediction difficulty across horizons and channels and providing no localized reliability signal. We present CARE (Corrective branch with Aligned context and Relative-error Estimation), a lightweight plug-in that enhances any deterministic forecaster without architectural redesign. Operating in parallel with the base model, CARE resamples historical context to match the forecast horizon, learns residual correction patterns from this aligned history, and applies scale-aware bounded updates modulated by per-coordinate sigmoid risk gates. A multi-objective loss jointly optimizes forecast accuracy, residual tracking, risk alignment, and base-model anchoring. Across eight benchmarks with three representative backbones, CARE improves accuracy with marginal parameter and latency overhead. Its risk gates reliably identify high-error regions: on Weather, the highest-gate tertile exhibits nearly four times the error of the lowest-gate tertile, offering planners an interpretable per-step trust signal. Code is available at https://github.com/CG-BNYC/CARE.

AI.tldr: CARE 是一种轻量级即插即用模块，可增强任意确定性多变量长时程预测器，通过残差校正与逐坐标风险门控，在提升精度的同时提供可解释的逐点可靠性信号。
AI.motivation: 现有多变量长时程预测的确定性主干模型只输出单条预测轨迹，掩盖了不同预测时程与通道间预测难度的异质性，也无法给出局部化的可靠性信号，不利于电力负荷调度、交通流管理与金融风险控制等决策场景。
AI.method: 提出 CARE（Corrective branch with Aligned context and Relative-error Estimation），与基础模型并行运行：重采样历史上下文以对齐预测时程，从对齐后的历史中学习残差校正模式，并通过逐坐标 sigmoid 风险门控施加尺度感知的有界更新；采用多目标损失联合优化预测精度、残差跟踪、风险对齐与基础模型锚定。
AI.result: 在八个基准数据集、三种代表性主干模型上，CARE 以极小的参数与延迟开销提升预测精度；风险门控能可靠识别高误差区域，例如 Weather 数据集上最高门控三分位组的误差约为最低组的三倍多，提供可解释的逐步信任信号。
AI.conclusion: CARE 无需重构架构即可作为通用插件增强确定性预测器，兼顾精度提升与可解释的逐坐标可靠性评估，具有较低的部署成本。

title: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
summary: Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition before reward-driven refinement. We propose PIVOT (Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization), a dynamic transition framework that routes samples between OPD and GRPO according to teacher-evaluated sequence perplexity. PIVOT moves low-perplexity samples to GRPO for reward-driven refinement while keeping high-perplexity samples under OPD for continued domain knowledge acquisition. Experiments on Banking77 and HWU64 show that PIVOT consistently outperforms continued OPD and globally synchronized OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO baselines under the same number of post-warm-up student optimization steps, achieving stronger downstream performance and more stable training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出PIVOT框架，依据教师评估的序列困惑度在OPD与GRPO之间动态路由样本，在垂直领域小模型少样本分类中优于固定调度的基线。
AI.motivation: 垂直领域少样本分类下小语言模型监督信号有限，难以获得领域决策知识。现有知识蒸馏到强化学习的流水线多采用全局固定的阶段切换调度，忽视了不同样本所需的教师引导获取量存在差异。
AI.method: PIVOT（Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization）动态转换框架：以教师评估的序列困惑度为路由信号。低困惑度样本转入GRPO进行奖励驱动的精炼；高困惑度样本保留在On-Policy Distillation（OPD）中继续获取领域知识。
AI.result: 在Banking77与HWU64数据集上，在相同的预热后学生优化步数下，PIVOT持续优于继续OPD和全局同步OPD→GRPO基线，取得更强的下游性能与更稳定的训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 样本级自适应转换优于全局固定调度，困惑度可作为有效的教师引导获取程度指标，用于协调蒸馏与强化学习两个阶段。

title: SACQ: Structured Decoding with Memory-Conditioned Refinement for Long-Horizon Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) models predominantly employ patch-based encoders terminated by a flatten readout head that maps the entire encoded historical memory to all future steps through a single shared projection. This implicit coupling of future positions obscures position-specific historical-to-future alignment and amplifies sensitivity to corrupted inputs and extreme supervision noise. We present SACQ, a plug-in structured prediction head that replaces flatten readout while keeping the encoder unchanged. SACQ adopts a two-stage decoding pipeline: it first establishes a coarse patch-grid forecast scaffold, then refines each future position through cross-attention over historical memory and merges the attention-derived correction with the coarse scaffold via a learned per-patch gate. To stabilize optimization under long horizons and noisy labels, we further propose a batch-adaptive scaled log-cosh loss that automatically calibrates robustness to the current residual scale, suppressing outlier gradients while preserving MSE-like sensitivity for typical errors. SACQ attains top-tier test MSE/MAE across PatchTST, DLinear, and patch-Mamba backbones with only modest incremental overhead in parameters and latency. Under inference-time input corruption and training-set label-noise stress tests, SACQ substantially outperforms flatten readouts, with ablation studies validating each architectural component.

AI.tldr: 提出SACQ——一种即插即用的结构化预测头，替代扁平读出层，通过两阶段解码与自适应损失提升长期时间序列预测的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LTSF模型多采用基于patch的编码器配合扁平读出层，用单一共享投影将整段历史记忆映射到所有未来步。这种对未来的隐式耦合模糊了特定位置的历史—未来对齐关系，并放大了对损坏输入与极端监督噪声的敏感度。
AI.method: SACQ保持编码器不变，仅替换读出层，采用两阶段解码：先建立粗粒度patch-grid预测脚手架，再通过历史记忆上的交叉注意力对每个未来位置进行细化，并用学习到的逐patch门控将注意力修正与粗脚手架融合。同时提出批自适应缩放log-cosh损失，根据当前残差尺度自动校准鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在PatchTST、DLinear与patch-Mamba三种骨干上，SACQ均取得顶尖的测试MSE/MAE，参数与延迟开销增加有限。在推理期输入损坏与训练集标签噪声压力测试下，SACQ显著优于扁平读出；消融实验验证了各架构组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SACQ作为一种通用即插即用预测头，可有效改善长期时间序列预测的精度与鲁棒性，且代价较小，具备良好的实用与推广价值。

title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
summary: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

AI.tldr: 提出无标签的Rashomon集框架FateMultiplicity，度量轨迹推断模型多重性，并检验其逐细胞命运输出的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 轨迹推断中多个拟合同样好的模型配置会给出相互冲突的细胞命运判定，但这一多重性问题缺乏无监督的度量与可靠性评估手段。
AI.method: 无标签构建统计可容许模型集（Rashomon集）：在交叉拟合的留出基因上评估模型偏差，并经随机种子变异校准的非劣性检验；比较不同算法配置的多重性规模，检验逐细胞认证边际FM相对拟合模型自身决策边际（及种子离散基线）的判别能力，并分析集合广度、基数与q-分位/上确界等阈值放松策略对判别力的影响。
AI.result: 多重性规模大且更依赖模型空间多样性而非集合大小（第二算法12个配置暴露20.0%细胞，第一算法24个配置仅3.8%）；FM在模拟真值上判别错误分配的AUC为0.682，低于基线配置自身决策边际0.965（p=0.003）与种子离散基线0.854；判别力由集合广度而非基数决定（基数4时种子重拟合0.933、超参数扰动0.701）；q-分位放松恢复判别力但趋近单模型置信度，上确界达0.973（受theta*隶属下界锚定），下确界无锚定；边际侵蚀比在模拟中区分真实与虚假分支点AUC 0.890（未在真实数据验证），且未认证细胞与克隆命运不一致的比例比认证细胞高16.4个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹推断中的多重性值得度量与报告，但在无标签Rashomon集上做逐细胞认证并非获得更可靠命运输出的途径。

title: Do Flatter Minima Drive Better Generalization? An Algorithmic Separation in Grokking
summary: Flat loss landscapes have long been linked to better generalization in neural networks. However, its role as a causal mechanism for generalization is less established. Grokking provides an unique testbed to understand this distinction: models are prone to fit observed data using non-generalizing structure and remain in that regime for prolonged periods, transitioning to generalization only under particular training conditions. In this work, we study whether flat loss landscapes can act as a driving mechanism in this transition. While recent work has argued for flatness as a necessary geometric condition for this transition, we find that biasing training toward flatter solutions using sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) is insufficient to reliably induce this transition, despite producing flatter solutions. However, when SAM is paired with mechanisms that drive generalization such as weight decay, an interesting property emerges: SAM can accelerate the transition to generalizing solutions by up to 4x at the epoch-level. We theoretically untangle this relationship between SAM and weight decay using a minimal interpolating two-layer ReLU model with both memorizing and generalizing solutions. We show that even in this simple setup, flatness alone cannot distinguish a memorizing solution from a generalizing one, while weight decay favors generalizing solutions. However, under a local stability analysis, there exists a window where a memorizing interpolant is locally stable under gradient descent but unstable under SAM in the low-norm regime, which can explain SAM's ability to accelerate this transition. Overall, our results provide a more interpretable account of the role of flatness in driving generalization, especially in settings where models are vulnerable to minimizing loss through learning non-generalizing structure.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"平坦损失景观是泛化的因果机制"这一观点，以grokking为测试平台，证明单独使用SAM（锐度感知最小化）不足以可靠触发泛化转变，但与权重衰减结合时可加速泛化转变达4倍；理论分析用两层ReLU插值模型解释了该机制。
AI.motivation: 平坦损失景观长期被认为与神经网络更好的泛化性能相关，但其作为泛化因果机制的地位尚未确立。Grokking现象——模型先以非泛化结构拟合数据、经过长时间后仅在特定训练条件下才转向泛化——为区分"相关"与"因果"提供了独特测试平台，因此有必要检验平坦性是否能作为驱动泛化转变的机制。
AI.method: 1) 实验上，以grokking为测试平台，使用SAM将训练偏向更平坦的解，观察其能否可靠诱导泛化转变；2) 将SAM与权重衰减等驱动泛化的机制配对，测量泛化转变速度（epoch级别）；3) 理论上，构建最小化的两层ReLU插值模型，同时包含记忆解与泛化解，分析平坦性对两类解的区分能力及权重衰减的偏好；4) 进行局部稳定性分析，刻画低范数区间内记忆插值解在梯度下降下稳定、在SAM下不稳定的窗口。
AI.result: SAM虽然能产生更平坦的解，但单独使用不足以可靠诱导泛化转变；当SAM与权重衰减结合时，可将向泛化解的转变加速最多4倍（epoch级别）。理论上，即使在最简插值两层ReLU模型中，平坦性本身也无法区分记忆解与泛化解，而权重衰减偏好泛化解；局部稳定性分析显示存在一个窗口，其中记忆插值解在低范数区间对梯度下降局部稳定，但对SAM不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 平坦性并非泛化的充分因果机制，其作用需与权重衰减等机制耦合才能体现。SAM加速泛化转变的机制可由"记忆插值解在低范数区间对SAM不稳定"的局部稳定性分析解释。研究为平坦性在驱动泛化中的作用提供了更具可解释性的说明，尤其适用于模型易通过学习非泛化结构来最小化损失的场景。

title: Multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Sequential Recommendation via Collaborative Filtering Paths
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for sequential recommendation through their ability to reason over complex multimodal data. However, existing approaches either rely solely on the target user's own interaction history, neglecting collaborative signals from neighboring users, or incur substantial computational overhead through repeated MLLM inference over long interaction histories. To address these challenges, we propose MGRASRec, a multimodal graph retrieval-augmented framework for sequential recommendation. MGRASRec injects collaborative filtering signals conditioned on the candidate item directly into the MLLM prompt by retrieving structured paths from a user-item interaction graph, extended via multimodal similarity to increase coverage beyond exact co-interaction overlap. This retrieval also surfaces the history items most relevant to the candidate at no additional cost, removing the need for recurrent summarization and keeping inference to a single forward pass per candidate. All components are unified into an augmented prompt for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an MLLM. Extensive evaluations across three publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of MGRASRec, achieving the best performance on all metrics with particularly strong gains in ranking quality.

AI.tldr: MGRASRec：多模态图检索增强的序列推荐框架，通过图检索注入协同信号并实现单次前向推理。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的序列推荐方法存在两类问题：一是仅依赖目标用户自身交互历史，忽略了邻居用户的协同信号；二是需要对长交互历史反复进行 MLLM 推理，导致计算开销巨大。
AI.method: 提出 MGRASRec，一种多模态图检索增强框架。它以候选物品为条件，从用户—物品交互图中检索结构化路径，并通过多模态相似度扩展图结构以提升覆盖范围，从而将协同过滤信号直接注入 MLLM 提示。该检索同时以零额外代价获得与候选最相关的历史物品，避免循环式摘要，使每个候选仅需单次前向传播。所有组件统一为增强提示，用于 MLLM 的参数高效微调。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上的大量实验验证了 MGRASRec 的有效性，在所有指标上均取得最佳性能，尤其在排序质量方面提升显著。
AI.conclusion: MGRASRec 通过多模态图检索增强，将协同信号与相关历史高效融入 MLLM 提示，在保证推理效率的同时显著提升序列推荐性能。

title: SteerCast: Retrieval-Based Latent Steering for Decoder-Only Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting aims to predict future values from historical observations and auxiliary features. We propose \textbf{SteerCast}, a retrieval-based latent steering method that improves decoder-only forecaster at inference time, without updating its parameters. SteerCast constructs a database from the training set by storing a representation of each history window together with a \emph{steering vector} computed in the forecaster's latent space, defined as the difference between representations induced by the ground-truth continuation and by the model's own prediction. At test time, SteerCast retrieves nearest neighbors for a query history, aggregates their steering vectors, and injects the resulting signal into the forecaster's hidden states at every step of autoregressive generation, guiding predictions toward trajectories consistent with similar training cases. Experiments across diverse multivariate benchmarks and multiple horizons show that SteerCast consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the fine-tuned backbone and retrieval-based baselines, while requiring no additional training beyond the original fine-tuning and using only the training set as a retrieval corpus.

AI.tldr: 提出 SteerCast，一种基于检索的潜在引导方法，在不更新参数的情况下于推理阶段提升 decoder-only 预测器的时间序列预测精度。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测需从历史观测与辅助特征预测未来值。现有已微调的预测器在推理时无法进一步提升，且已有检索式方法多作用于输出空间，未充分利用模型潜在空间的信息。
AI.method: SteerCast 从训练集构建检索库，为每个历史窗口存储其表示及一个在预测器潜在空间中计算的"引导向量"，该向量定义为真实续接所诱导表示与模型自身预测所诱导表示之差。测试时，为查询历史检索最近邻，聚合其引导向量，并在自回归生成的每一步将所得信号注入预测器隐状态，从而引导预测走向与相似训练样本一致的轨迹。
AI.result: 在多种多变量基准与多个预测步长上，SteerCast 一致优于微调后的主干模型及基于检索的基线，且除原始微调外无需额外训练，仅使用训练集作为检索语料。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜在空间进行检索式引导，可在推理阶段有效提升 decoder-only 时间序列预测器性能，兼具训练零开销与数据使用高效的优点。

title: Low-Cost Sensor Calibration for Indoor Air Quality Monitoring: A Dataset, Evaluation Scenarios, and a Lightweight Model
summary: Low-cost sensors enable scalable indoor air quality monitoring but require calibration because of nonlinear distortions, noise, and temporal drift. The conventional strict pairwise calibration setting requires a co-located reference sensor at each deployment location and does not account for spatial and temporal heterogeneity. To address these limitations, we introduce a six-month dataset comprising multivariate indoor air-quality measurements from low-cost and reference sensors with contextual metadata collected at five locations. Using this dataset, we define four evaluation scenarios. The reference-efficient and location-transfer scenarios evaluate spatial generalization, whereas the long-term drift and event-conditioned scenarios assess robustness to gradual and abrupt distribution shifts. Based on these scenarios, we derive design requirements and propose a lightweight temporal model that combines input-window compression with residual temporal and feature fusion. Experiments show strong calibration performance across all four scenarios with low edge-inference cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了为期六个月、覆盖五个地点的低成本与参考传感器配对室内空气质量数据集，定义四种评估场景以检验校准方法的空间泛化与时间漂移鲁棒性，并提出一种轻量级时序校准模型（输入窗口压缩+残差时序与特征融合），在四类场景下均取得良好校准性能且边缘推理开销低。
AI.motivation: 低成本传感器可支撑可扩展的室内空气质量监测，但存在非线性失真、噪声与时间漂移，必须进行校准。传统严格配对校准要求每个部署点都配置共置参考传感器，成本高且无法应对空间与时间异质性。因此需要新的数据集与评估范式来刻画空间泛化和时间漂移下的校准问题。
AI.method: （1）发布六个月、五个地点的多元室内空气质量测量数据集，包含低成本与参考传感器数据及上下文元数据；（2）据此定义四种评估场景：参考高效型与位置迁移型评估空间泛化，长期漂移型与事件条件型评估对渐变与突变分布偏移的鲁棒性；（3）由场景推导设计需求，提出轻量级时序模型，结合输入窗口压缩与残差时序和特征融合。
AI.result: 在四种评估场景下均实现较强的校准性能，同时保持较低的边缘推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过数据集与场景设计突破传统严格配对校准的限制，所提轻量模型兼顾空间泛化、时间漂移鲁棒性与边缘部署效率，为可扩展的室内空气质量监测校准提供了基准与方案。

title: Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System for Mimicking Human-like Car Following Behavior
summary: This study presents the Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System (NeMeFIS), a hierarchical machine learning architecture that asymmetrically models acceleration and deceleration in car following behavior by integrating five human memory types procedural, working, episodic, semantic, and declarative. By linking external variables to memory functions via metaheuristics and validating them through factor and p-value analyses, NeMeFIS uncovers latent cognitive influences across Arterial, Collector, and Rural Highway corridors for different types of vehicles. Results from 54 different trained models emphasize cognitive thresholds shaped by driver perception limits and cognitive load. The trained NeMeFIS models outperform traditional statistical and conventional machine learning models in replicating realistic driving behavior, including comparisons with Linear Regression, ANFIS, and LSTM architectures. Fuzzy rule analysis reveals that declarative memory demands the highest rule, especially during deceleration, indicating complex braking decisions. Procedural memory drives acceleration, while semantic and declarative memory guide deceleration. Risk perception also emerges as a key factor, particularly on urban roads. Validated on both heterogeneous and homogeneous datasets, NeMeFIS offers a robust framework for modeling driver cognition. The findings support psychotherapeutic applications and the development of adaptive, human-like decision systems in Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) to enhance traffic safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeMeFIS（神经-记忆模糊推理系统），一种分层机器学习架构，通过整合程序、工作、情节、语义和陈述性五类人类记忆，对跟驰行为中的加速与减速进行非对称建模，并在多种道路走廊与车型上验证其优于传统统计与常规机器学习模型。
AI.motivation: 传统跟驰模型多将加速与减速视为对称过程，且较少刻画驾驶员认知与记忆机制。为更真实地复现驾驶行为并支撑CAV的人性化决策与交通安全，需要一种能表征潜在认知影响、区分加速/减速机制的建模框架。
AI.method: 构建分层神经-记忆模糊推理系统NeMeFIS，将五类人类记忆（程序、工作、情节、语义、陈述性）与外部变量通过元启发式方法关联，并用因子分析与p值分析验证；针对Arterial、Collector、Rural Highway三类走廊及不同车型训练54个模型，并与线性回归、ANFIS、LSTM对比。
AI.result: 训练模型揭示由驾驶员感知极限与认知负荷形成的认知阈值；NeMeFIS在复现真实驾驶行为上优于线性回归、ANFIS与LSTM。模糊规则分析显示陈述性记忆规则需求最高，尤其在减速阶段，表明制动决策复杂；程序性记忆驱动加速，语义与陈述性记忆引导减速；风险感知在城市道路上尤为关键。
AI.conclusion: NeMeFIS在异构与同构数据集上均得到验证，为驾驶认知建模提供稳健框架，可支持心理治疗应用及CAV中自适应、类人决策系统的开发，以提升交通安全。

title: Residual spectral instabilities in representation learning
summary: Learned representations can lose latent degrees of freedom successively, suggesting a cascade of transitions whose underlying stability principle remains unclear. Here we formulate dimension-wise posterior collapse in variational autoencoder (VAE) as a fluctuation theory around partially collapsed states. Interpreting the negative evidence lower bound as an effective free energy, its quadratic expansion defines a Gaussian theory whose Hessian acts as a mass matrix for latent fluctuations. We show that the collapsed directions form an invariant fluctuation sector and derive its exact mass spectrum in terms of a conditional residual operator. A local reactivation direction lowers the free energy when the decoder variance falls below the residual spectral upper edge, with equality marking marginality. The criterion recovers principal component thresholds in the linear Gaussian VAE limit. Viewed in reverse along continuously connected branches, the reactivation boundary provides a local criterion for successive collapse. Numerical continuation experiments show successive loss of latent dimensions near these spectral marginalities. These results support a spectral cascade interpretation governed by residual information left unexplained by the surviving representation.

AI.tldr: 该文将VAE中的维度级后验坍缩表述为部分坍缩态附近的涨落理论，通过自由能二次展开导出的质量矩阵谱，给出了潜维度相继失活的谱判据，并用数值延拓验证了坍缩的级联过程。
AI.motivation: 学习到的表征会逐步丧失潜在自由度，呈现出一系列相继发生的转变，但其背后的稳定性原理尚不清楚。作者希望为VAE中维度级后验坍缩（dimension-wise posterior collapse）提供一个统一的稳定性/涨落理论解释，并说明为何潜维度会一个接一个地失活。
AI.method: 将负ELBO视为有效自由能，在其部分坍缩态附近做二次展开，得到描述潜变量涨落的高斯理论，其Hessian充当质量矩阵。证明已坍缩方向构成不变的涨落扇区，并以条件残差算子给出其精确质量谱。据此推导局部重激活方向降低自由能的条件，并在线性高斯VAE极限下与主成分阈值对应；沿连续连通分支反向观察，该重激活边界可作为相继坍缩的局部判据。最后用数值延拓实验验证。
AI.result: 推导出坍缩扇区的精确质量谱（由条件残差算子给出）；给出重激活条件：当解码器方差低于残差谱上边缘时，局部重激活方向会降低自由能，等号对应临界性（marginality）。该判据在线性高斯VAE极限下退化为主成分阈值。数值延拓实验显示潜维度在这些谱临界点附近相继丧失。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种"谱级联"解释：潜维度的相继坍缩由幸存表征未能解释的残差信息（residual information）所支配，重激活边界提供了相继坍缩的局部稳定性判据。

title: How to post-train on a surrogate: Envelope sampling mitigates reward hacking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly post-trained against LLM judges and other cheap surrogates because the true reward, such as human preference, is too expensive to query at scale. This practice often leads to reward hacking, where reinforcement learning against a miscalibrated surrogate leads to undesirable side effects. In this work, we study a setting in which a small number $n$ of model outputs are annotated with ground-truth labels (e.g., from expert review) and used to recalibrate the LLM judge before optimizing against it. Prior approaches to judge recalibration are costly or heuristic, and it is known that on-policy sampling fails when the surrogate is miscalibrated on a rare set of outputs. In this work, we propose envelope sampling, a theoretically-grounded method for judge recalibration that seeks to minimize an upper bound on the regret of the post-trained model under the assumption that the human reward and re-calibrated reward lie in an $L^2$ ball around the judge. We give practical algorithms to sample from the envelope by rejection or by fine-tuning against a modified reward, and experiments on clinical note generation and on a controlled sycophancy task show that recalibrating on envelope samples mitigates reward hacking where recalibrating on base-model samples does not.

AI.tldr: 提出"包络采样"(envelope sampling),一种有理论依据的LLM评判器重校准方法:在人类奖励与重校准奖励位于评判器周围L²球内的假设下,最小化后训练模型遗憾的上界。
AI.motivation: 用LLM评判器等廉价替代奖励进行后训练易导致奖励劫持(reward hacking),即针对误校准的替代奖励做强化学习会产生不良副作用。虽然可用少量真值标注(n个样本)在优化前重校准评判器,但已有重校准方法要么代价高、要么是启发式的,且当替代奖励在一组稀有输出上误校准时,同策略(on-policy)采样会失效。
AI.method: 提出包络采样:在假设人类奖励与重校准奖励均位于评判器周围的L²球内,寻求最小化后训练模型遗憾的上界。给出两种从包络中采样的实用算法——拒绝采样,以及针对修改后奖励进行微调。
AI.result: 在临床病历生成任务与受控的谄媚(sycophancy)任务上的实验表明,基于包络样本的重校准能够缓解奖励劫持,而基于基础模型样本的重校准则无法做到。
AI.conclusion: 包络采样为评判器重校准提供了具有理论保证的方法,并通过实验证明其在缓解奖励劫持方面优于基于基础模型样本的启发式重校准。

title: Memorization and Malign Generalization in Conditional Diffusion Models with Random Features
summary: Conditional diffusion models generate diverse, novel, and high-quality samples under prescribed conditions. However, theoretical understanding of their memorization and generalization remains limited, while recent works have characterized these behaviors primarily in unconditional settings. In this work, we analyze a random-feature conditional score model in the high-dimensional proportional limit, deriving asymptotic expressions for training and test losses. By decomposing the test loss, we show that in the overparameterized regime, increasing model width improves prediction of the condition-dependent mean while reducing within-condition prediction variance, a phenomenon we term "malign generalization." Furthermore, analyzing the training loss reveals that more informative conditions lead to memorization of training samples at smaller widths. These theoretical findings are supported by experiments with U-Net architectures on realistic data.

AI.tldr: 本文在高维比例极限下分析随机特征条件分数模型，推导训练/测试损失的渐近表达式，揭示过参数化条件下的"有害泛化"现象及条件信息量对记忆化的影响。
AI.motivation: 条件扩散模型能生成多样且高质量的样本，但其记忆化与泛化的理论理解仍有限，现有工作主要在无条件设定下刻画这些行为，缺乏对条件设定下的理论分析。
AI.method: 构建随机特征条件分数模型，在高维比例极限下推导训练损失与测试损失的渐近表达式，并通过分解测试损失来分析过参数化区域的行为；结合真实数据上的U-Net架构实验进行验证。
AI.result: 在过参数化区域，增大模型宽度会改善条件依赖均值的预测，同时减少条件内预测方差，作者称之为"有害泛化"；分析训练损失发现，信息量更大的条件会在更小的宽度下导致对训练样本的记忆化。U-Net实验支持上述理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为条件扩散模型的记忆化与泛化提供了理论刻画，揭示宽度与条件信息量对泛化-记忆化权衡的作用，并经实验验证。

title: NP-Hardness of Minimizing Neurons in Two-Hidden-Layer ReLU Neural Networks
summary: A fundamental question in neural network architecture optimization is whether the minimum hidden-neuron count required to approximate a target function within a prescribed tolerance can be computed efficiently. This paper resolves this question for two-hidden-layer ReLU networks under an $L^p(\mathbb{R}^d,\mathbb{R}^m)$ approximation constraint. For every fixed $d \ge 1$, $m \ge 1$, and $1 \le p < \infty$, we prove that computing the optimum exactly is NP-hard. The result holds even when the target is represented by a rational ReLU network whose realization is nonzero, componentwise nonnegative, compactly supported, globally Lipschitz, and continuous piecewise affine. The polynomial-time reduction from 3-SAT produces an architecture gap in which unsatisfiable formulas yield an optimum of zero, whereas satisfiable formulas yield an optimum of at least $d+2$. The proof constructs compactly supported polyhedral frustum functions realized by two-hidden-layer ReLU networks and establishes the $L^p$-density of finite linear combinations of box-frustum functions. The results offer theoretical justification for employing heuristic approximation methods in the design of ReLU neural networks, illustrating that attaining a minimal configuration within polynomial time is computationally unachievable.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了在 $L^p(\mathbb{R}^d,\mathbb{R}^m)$ 逼近约束下，精确计算两层隐藏层 ReLU 网络逼近目标函数所需的最小隐藏神经元数是 NP-难问题。
AI.motivation: 神经网络架构优化的一个根本问题是：能否高效计算逼近目标函数在给定容差内所需的最小隐藏神经元数量。论文针对两层隐藏层 ReLU 网络回答这一问题。
AI.method: 对每个固定 $d \ge 1$、$m \ge 1$、$1 \le p < \infty$，通过从 3-SAT 出发的多项式时间归约证明精确求解为 NP-难；构造由两层隐藏层 ReLU 网络实现的紧支撑多面体截锥函数，并建立箱-截锥函数有限线性组合的 $L^p$ 稠密性。
AI.result: 精确计算最优值为 NP-难，即使目标由有理 ReLU 网络表示且其实现非零、逐分量非负、紧支撑、全局 Lipschitz、连续分片仿射。归约产生架构间隙：不可满足公式的最优值为零，可满足公式的最优值至少为 $d+2$。
AI.conclusion: 结果从理论上说明在多项式时间内达到 ReLU 网络的最小配置是计算上不可行的，从而为设计 ReLU 神经网络时采用启发式逼近方法提供了理论依据。

title: Sample-Efficient Generative Conformal Prediction
summary: Generative conformal prediction builds uncertainty sets from samples of a conditional generator, which are efficient only when the samples represent the response distribution well. This can require many samples, each of which can be costly, as in large diffusion models and scientific simulators, so the sampling budget must be used efficiently. Existing methods draw the same number of samples at every input, wasting samples where the response distribution is simple and undersampling where it is complex, which inflates sets and leaves those inputs under-covered. We propose CASA (Conformal Adaptive Sample Allocation), which characterizes the marginal value of an additional sample and allocates samples across inputs to minimize the expected set size subject to marginal coverage and an average sampling budget. Theoretical analysis shows that adaptive allocation yields smaller sets than a fixed count at the same budget: a missed mode forces a radius that spans the gap between modes, and even oracle radius cannot compensate for it. On synthetic and real tasks, CASA produces substantially smaller sets at the same budget, often improves conditional coverage, and complements existing radius-adaptive methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 CASA（Conformal Adaptive Sample Allocation），通过刻画额外样本的边际价值，在不同输入间自适应分配采样预算，在边际覆盖与平均预算约束下最小化期望集合大小。
AI.motivation: 生成式共形预测依赖条件生成器的样本构造不确定性集合，其效率取决于样本能否充分代表响应分布。在大扩散模型和科学模拟器中单次采样代价高昂，采样预算必须高效使用。现有方法对每个输入使用相同样本数：在响应分布简单的输入上浪费样本，在复杂的输入上采样不足，导致集合膨胀且部分输入覆盖不足。
AI.method: 方法为 CASA。其核心是刻画"多一个样本"的边际价值，并据此在各输入之间分配样本，目标是在满足边际覆盖和平均采样预算约束的前提下最小化期望集合大小。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，在相同预算下自适应分配比固定样本数产生更小的集合：遗漏一个众数会迫使半径跨越众数之间的间隔，即便使用 oracle 半径也无法补偿。在合成与真实任务上，CASA 在相同预算下显著缩小集合，且常能改善条件覆盖，并与现有的半径自适应方法互补。
AI.conclusion: 按输入的响应分布复杂度自适应分配采样预算，比统一采样数在样本效率上更优；CASA 可作为半径自适应方法的补充，共同提升生成式共形预测的效率与条件覆盖。

title: SpatialOPSD: Self-Distilling Spatial Intelligence from Verified Coding Agent Traces
summary: Spatial coding agents significantly improve spatial reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by using external tools to generate verified execution traces. However, this paradigm inherently suffers from prohibitive inference-time overhead and external dependencies. In this paper, we explore whether an MLLM can internalize this agentic capability to operate entirely tool-free. We begin with a simple observation: prompting an MLLM with summarized execution traces of a spatial coding agent naturally unlocks the model's internal spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Motivated by this, we introduce SpatialOPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that internalizes spatial reasoning into a standalone MLLM by formulating verified agent traces as privileged information. To mitigate privileged-information leakage during distillation, we introduce Repetition-Aware Distillation, which combines repetition masking with unlikelihood regularization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that self-distilling SpatialOPSD achieves higher average accuracy than SFT and GRPO on both spatial and OOD datasets, exhibiting superior performance and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出SpatialOPSD，一种on-policy自蒸馏框架，将空间编码智能体的推理能力内化到独立MLLM中，实现无工具的空间推理，性能优于SFT和GRPO。
AI.motivation: 空间编码智能体虽能提升MLLM的空间推理，但存在推理时开销过大和外部依赖问题。作者希望探索MLLM能否将这种智能体能力内化，从而完全无需工具运行。
AI.method: 基于"用摘要化的执行轨迹提示MLLM可解锁其内部空间思维链"这一观察，提出SpatialOPSD：将已验证的智能体轨迹作为特权信息进行on-policy自蒸馏。为缓解特权信息泄漏，引入Repetition-Aware Distillation，结合重复掩码与unlikelihood正则化。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，自蒸馏的SpatialOPSD在空间和OOD数据集上的平均准确率均高于SFT和GRPO，表现出更优的性能与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MLLM可在无需外部工具的情况下内化空间编码智能体的能力；特权信息自蒸馏策略有效且泛化性更强。

title: Learning from Hetero Density for Cryo-EM Protein Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing protein structures from cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) maps is essential for understanding macromolecular assemblies. Although learning-based methods have improved protein reconstruction, information from hetero components remains underused. Our analysis finds both false predictions and reference protein sites near hetero components; filtering nearby candidates can improve or impair chain construction. We introduce CryoCue, a framework that uses hetero information to guide protein reconstruction. An anchor-supervised detector learns hetero representations across five component classes. Multiscale hetero features guide backbone localization, while predicted hetero candidates condition structure refinement through their class, confidence, and frame-relative geometry. Experiments show that CryoCue improves backbone localization near hetero components and achieves more accurate protein structure reconstruction.

AI.tldr: CryoCue利用异源组分信息引导冷冻电镜蛋白质结构重建：通过锚点监督检测器学习五类异源组分表征，多尺度特征引导主链定位，预测的异源候选通过类别、置信度和相对空间几何条件化结构精修，从而提升异源组分附近的主链定位与整体结构重建精度。
AI.motivation: 从冷冻电镜密度图重建蛋白质结构对理解大分子组装至关重要。现有基于学习的方法虽提升了重建效果，但异源组分（hetero components）信息仍未被充分利用。作者分析发现：在异源组分附近同时存在错误预测与真实蛋白位点，直接过滤邻近候选既可能改善也可能损害链的构建，因此需要一种显式利用异源信息进行引导的方法。
AI.method: 提出CryoCue框架，以异源信息引导蛋白质重建。核心包括：(1) 锚点监督的检测器，学习跨五类异源组分的表征；(2) 多尺度异源特征用于引导主链定位（backbone localization）；(3) 将预测的异源候选以其类别、置信度和帧相对几何（frame-relative geometry）作为条件，驱动结构精修。
AI.result: 实验表明，CryoCue在异源组分附近的主链定位上取得提升，并实现更准确的蛋白质结构重建。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并利用异源组分信息可有效缓解异源区域附近的预测歧义，提升冷冻电镜蛋白质结构重建的精度，表明异源线索是该任务中被低估的重要信号。

title: MC-TRCM: Observation-Aware Recursive Fusion for Incomplete Mobile and Wearable Mental-Health Feature Views
comment: Accepted to ICONIP 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/MC-TRCM
summary: Public mobile and wearable mental-health datasets often provide summarized feature tables rather than synchronized raw sensor streams. In these releases, each anchor corresponds to a survey or label time and may combine phone or wearable summaries, prior symptom scores, demographics, clinical variables, and source-availability indicators. We propose the Modality-Conditioned Temporal Recursive Context Model (MC-TRCM), which preserves each feature source as a separate token and incorporates missingness as part of the input context. Observed sources are encoded with values and missingness summaries, absent sources use learned absence tokens, dataset and task embeddings condition fusion, and a recursive prediction head refines each output over validation-selected steps. We evaluated MC-TRCM on six predefined endpoints from DepreST-CAT and Prediction of Severity Change-Depression (PSYCHE-D) using participant-level splits and validation-only model selection. MC-TRCM achieved the lowest mean absolute error on DepreST-CAT Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) and Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) severity, improving over the best tabular reference by 0.181 and 0.217 scale points. Classification endpoints showed task-dependent behavior: MC-TRCM matched the best rounded GAD-7 category balanced accuracy, was numerically highest by 0.002 balanced-accuracy points on PSYCHE-D multiclass prediction, and remained close to the strongest references on PHQ-9 category and PSYCHE-D binary prediction. Ablations support Feature-wise Linear Modulation, absence tokens, missingness projections, and recursive refinement, while calibration and feature-source controls characterize endpoint behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/MC-TRCM.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MC-TRCM模型，将每个特征来源视为独立token并显式建模缺失性，用于公共移动与可穿戴心理健康数据集（总结特征表形式）的多终点预测，在抑郁/焦虑严重度回归与分类任务上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 公共移动与可穿戴心理健康数据集通常只提供汇总特征表，而非同步的原始传感器流；每个锚点对应一次问卷或标签时间，混合了手机/可穿戴摘要、既往症状评分、人口学、临床变量与来源可用性指示。这类异构、含缺失的特征难以用常规表格方法有效建模，因此需要一个能够按来源分离特征并显式处理缺失性的模型。
AI.method: 提出Modality-Conditioned Temporal Recursive Context Model（MC-TRCM）：将每个特征来源保留为独立token，并把缺失性作为输入上下文的一部分。已观测来源用数值与缺失性摘要编码，缺失来源使用可学习的缺失token（absence tokens）；通过数据集与任务嵌入对融合进行条件化，并使用递归预测头在验证集选择的步数上对每个输出进行细化。在DepreST-CAT与PSYCHE-D的六个预定义终点上评估，采用参与者级划分与仅基于验证集的模型选择。
AI.result: MC-TRCM在DepreST-CAT的PHQ-9与GAD-7严重度上取得最低平均绝对误差，相比最佳表格基线分别改善0.181与0.217个量表点。分类终点表现依赖任务：在GAD-7四舍五入类别平衡准确率上与最佳方法持平，在PSYCHE-D多分类上数值最高（+0.002平衡准确率），在PHQ-9类别与PSYCHE-D二分类上接近最强基线。消融实验支持Feature-wise Linear Modulation、缺失token、缺失性投影与递归细化的作用；校准与特征来源控制实验刻画了各终点的行为。
AI.conclusion: MC-TRCM通过来源分离的token化表示与显式缺失性建模，在汇总特征表形式的移动/可穿戴心理健康数据上实现了较强的严重度回归性能，并在分类任务上表现出任务依赖的竞争力；消融验证了各设计组件的贡献，代码已开源。

title: Policy Alignment: New Signals for Membership Auditing in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model by aligning its policy with a teacher model on trajectories generated by the student model itself. Through this process, the student policy moves toward the teacher on the prompts used for distillation. However, these prompts are often private and costly, creating a need for prompt-level membership auditing. Existing methods mainly rely on likelihood-based confidence signals or student policy drift between checkpoints, but they do not capture the teacher-induced direction of the student update. In this paper, we propose Policy Alignment Membership Auditing (PAMA), a new auditing framework tailored for OPD. Our key observation is that a member prompt directly contributes to the teacher-guided policy update, while a non-member prompt only experiences indirect effects through cross-prompt generalization. Based on this directional trace, PAMA measures whether the student update moves toward reducing the teacher loss on a candidate prompt. Specifically, we introduce Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG) to estimate the teacher-aligned update direction from model outputs, and further combine it with student drift and uncertainty alignment signals for reliable membership auditing. We evaluate PAMA on six datasets and three teacher-student model families. On MATH, the primary evaluation benchmark, PAMA achieves AUC values of 0.791--0.941, improving AUC by 14.6--20.6% over state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PAMA，一种面向 on-policy distillation（OPD）的提示级成员审计框架。其核心是捕捉“教师引导的学生更新方向”这一成员痕迹，定义 Teacher Alignment Gain（TAG）并结合学生漂移与不确定性对齐信号进行审计。在六个数据集、三组师生模型上评测，主基准 MATH 上 AUC 达 0.791–0.941，较 SOTA 基线提升 14.6–20.6%。
AI.motivation: OPD 中学生模型在自身生成的轨迹上与教师对齐，使策略在蒸馏所用提示上向教师靠拢。但这类提示往往涉及隐私且获取成本高，因此需要提示级成员审计来判断某提示是否被用于蒸馏。现有方法依赖基于似然的置信信号或检查点间的学生策略漂移，未能刻画“教师引导的更新方向”，审计信号不足。
AI.method: 提出 PAMA 审计框架。关键观察：成员提示直接参与教师引导的策略更新，而非成员提示仅通过跨提示泛化受到间接影响。基于这一方向性痕迹，PAMA 判断学生更新是否朝着降低该候选提示上教师损失的方向移动。具体定义 Teacher Alignment Gain（TAG），从模型输出估计教师对齐的更新方向，并将其与学生漂移（student drift）和不确定性对齐（uncertainty alignment）信号结合，以提升审计可靠性。
AI.result: 在六个数据集与三组师生模型家族上进行评测。在主要评测基准 MATH 上，PAMA 取得 AUC 0.791–0.941，相较当前最优基线提升 AUC 14.6–20.6%。
AI.conclusion: PAMA 通过显式建模教师引导的更新方向，为 OPD 提供了更有效的提示级成员审计手段，实验证明其在多个数据集与模型家族上稳定优于现有基线。

title: MotiveMob: Motivation as Semantic Action for Closed-Loop Human Mobility Generation
summary: Human mobility generation, an important task in urban research, synthesizes trajectory data for urban planning and transportation management. Human mobility can be characterized as a "why-where-when" decision process: people form an intention to move and then determine where and when the corresponding activity will take place. Trajectory generation under user-level and temporal distribution shifts may benefit from explicitly modeling this decision structure. However, many existing human mobility generation methods either represent behavioral intent at a coarse granularity, such as a daily plan or a trajectory-level description, or directly predict future locations without explicitly reasoning about a possible motivation for each movement step. We introduce MotiveMob, a motivation-driven autoregressive framework for human mobility generation that first forms a hypothesis about why the next movement may occur and then jointly generates where and when it may occur. At each step, a motivation predictor conditions on the current mobility state, a long-term behavioral report, and the mobility history to infer a plausible motivation or determine whether the trajectory should terminate. Given the hypothesized motivation, a state predictor grounds it in a candidate next location and arrival time. The candidate then undergoes speed-feasibility and repetition checks before being fed back for the next decision. We evaluate MotiveMob under distribution shifts involving unseen users and unseen temporal periods, including seasonal changes and the substantial behavioral disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Experiments show that MotiveMob consistently achieves better distributional fidelity than competitive pretraining-based and prompting-based methods under user-level and temporal distribution shifts, demonstrating robust generalization to out-of-distribution mobility patterns.

AI.tldr: 提出MotivMob，一个动机驱动的自回归人类移动性生成框架，先推断"为何移动"再联合生成"去哪"和"何时去"，在用户级与时间级分布偏移下取得更优的分布保真度。
AI.motivation: 人类移动可被视为"why-where-when"决策过程，但现有轨迹生成方法要么以日计划、轨迹级描述等粗粒度表征行为意图，要么直接预测下一位置而不显式推理每一步移动的动机，在用户级和时间级分布偏移下泛化能力不足。
AI.method: MotivMob采用自回归生成：每步中，动机预测器基于当前移动状态、长期行为报告与移动历史，推断一个合理的动机或判定轨迹终止；状态预测器将假定的动机落地为候选下一位置与到达时间；候选结果再经过速度可行性检查与重复性检查后反馈进入下一步决策。
AI.result: 在涉及未见用户与未见时间段（含季节变化及新冠疫情期间的行为剧变）的分布偏移评测中，MotivMob的分布保真度持续优于基于预训练和基于提示的竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模"动机—位置—时间"的决策结构，可提升人类移动性生成对分布外移动模式的鲁棒泛化能力。

title: Zatom-2: Multitask Pretraining on Atomistic Data for Generative Modeling across Domains
summary: Unified atomistic modeling has the potential to accelerate discovery in chemistry, materials science, and biology by bridging data-rich chemical domains and data-scarce biological contexts.
