The context expansion methods we test yield no consistent improvement. Taken together, our results suggest that adaptation and selective aggregation yield consistent benchmark-level gains. The benefits of context construction depend more on the task and data regime. Adaptation and aggregation over the same backbone yield further gains when combined, but require substantially more computation than default inference. These trade-offs motivate choosing strategies according to the available computation budget. Code is available at https://github.com/kanghui-learning/test-time-compute-for-tabular-foundation-models.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了测试时计算对预训练表格基础模型（TFM）预测性能的影响，从适应、聚合和上下文构建三个维度展开实验，发现适应与选择性聚合能带来稳定的基准级增益，而上下文构建的效果更依赖任务与数据情形。
AI.motivation: 探索哪些形式的测试时计算能够提升强预训练表格基础模型的预测能力，为不同计算预算下的策略选择提供依据。
AI.method: 沿适应、聚合与上下文构建三个维度系统评估，涵盖TabArena基准及OpenML的宽表与大规模表。适应方面提出DiagScale（对角查询-键相似度更新，仅训练0.003-0.03%参数）；聚合方面研究池组成与选择策略，使用96种配置的池并比较贪婪选择与均匀平均；上下文构建方面测试注意力引导检索及上下文扩展方法。
AI.result: DiagScale在三个独立预训练骨干上取得与全量微调相当的增益；贪婪选择相对默认预测器降低2.4%误差，而均匀平均反而增大误差；注意力引导检索在部分大表上改善TabPFN-3预测并支持超出完整上下文记忆限制的源池，但上下文扩展方法无一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 适应与选择性聚合可带来一致的基准级增益，上下文构建的收益更依赖任务与数据情形。同一骨干上适应与聚合结合可进一步提升性能，但计算开销显著高于默认推理，需根据可用计算预算权衡选择策略。

title: CausalDreamer: Learning Predictive World Models with Latent Disentanglement
summary: World models for control must capture which aspects of the environment respond to the agent's actions and which are relevant to reward. Generative world models such as Dreamer 4 consist of a video tokenizer, which encodes each frame into a latent, and a dynamics model, which is pretrained to predict future latents from past latents and actions. Yet the tokenizer is trained with a reconstruction objective, without action or reward supervision, so its latent provides no explicit mechanism to separate controllable, uncontrollable, reward-relevant, and reward-irrelevant information. We propose \textit{CausalDreamer}, which keeps the tokenizer frozen and re-encodes its latent into a factored representation of four groups along two axes: controllability, where only the two controllable groups receive the action, and reward relevance, learned by predicting the reward from the two reward-relevant groups. The pretrained dynamics model is then fine-tuned to predict the factored representation. We evaluate \textit{CausalDreamer} and the pretrained world model it starts from with model-predictive planning on 20 MMBench2 tasks: 10 clean tasks seen during training and 10 unseen tasks, of which 6 are manipulated variants of clean tasks with a changed background, object, or maze layout, and 4 are new environments. We normalize returns so that a policy taking uniformly random actions scores 0 and an expert scores 1. \textit{CausalDreamer} achieves a 14\% higher normalized score than the pretrained world model on the clean tasks (0.199 vs.\ 0.175) and a 25\% higher score on the manipulated variants (0.307 vs.\ 0.246), while neither model scores meaningfully above the random policy in the new environments. Additionally, our analysis shows that the factored representation separates reward-irrelevant changes, such as a changed background, from its reward-relevant groups.

AI.tldr: CausalDreamer 将冻结 tokenizer 的 latent 重编码为按可控性与奖励相关性两个维度划分的四组因子化表示，并微调预训练动力学模型，在 MMBench2 上优于原始世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式世界模型（如 Dreamer 4）的 tokenizer 仅以重构目标训练，缺乏动作与奖励监督，其 latent 无法显式区分可控/不可控、奖励相关/无关的信息，从而限制了基于模型规划的效果。
AI.method: 保持 tokenizer 冻结，将其 latent 重编码为沿两条轴的四个因子组：可控性（仅两组可控组接收动作）与奖励相关性（通过从两组奖励相关组预测奖励来学习）；随后微调预训练动力学模型以预测该因子化表示。
AI.result: 在 20 个 MMBench2 任务上与预训练世界模型对比（return 归一化：随机策略 0，专家 1）：干净任务上归一化得分提升 14%（0.199 vs. 0.175），操纵变体上提升 25%（0.307 vs. 0.246）；在新环境中两者均未显著超过随机策略。分析表明因子化表示能将背景变化等奖励无关变化与奖励相关组分离。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入可控性与奖励相关性的因子化 latent 表示并微调动力学模型，可在不重新训练 tokenizer 的前提下提升世界模型的规划性能，尤其对背景、物体或迷宫布局等操纵变体更鲁棒，但向全新环境泛化仍是未解问题。

title: MPGE: A Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer for Molecular Classification Explanation
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) predict molecular properties from chemical graph data, but predictive accuracy does not explain how graph information supports an individual decision. A compact prediction-preserving rationale does not necessarily reveal which changes reverse the decision or which modifications the model tolerates. We propose the Multi-Perspective Graph Explainer (MPGE), unifying factual support, counterfactual sensitivity, and exemplar tolerance for a frozen classifier. The factual view, originally termed prototype (PT), seeks a compact retained edge set with the same label and required confidence. Counterfactual (CF) explanations seek bounded prediction-changing deletions; exemplar (EXE) explanations seek non-trivial bounded deletions that preserve the label and confidence. A shared constrained formulation connects prediction behavior, compactness, and edit cost, while separate objectives generate the three views. Our graph-classification extension of CF-GNNExplainer learns symmetric edge rankings and verifies discrete candidates, recording unsuccessful searches. A separate BBBP fragment backend returns RDKit-sanitized molecules. We evaluate the primary GCN implementation on MUTAG, Mutagenicity, AIDS, COX2_MD, and BBBP using semantic coverage, conditional quality, stability, and runtime. Successful factual masks retained 8.6%--15.5% of input edges on average across datasets; bounded counterfactual coverage was 4.8%--67.6%, and exemplar preservation coverage was 98.9%--100.0%. Exploratory controls reveal the influence of hard projection and retained node information. Quantitative comparisons and molecular visualizations characterize model support, sensitivity, and tolerance without treating them as validated chemical mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出多视角图解释器MPGE，为冻结的GNN分类器统一提供事实支持(PT)、反事实敏感性(CF)与样例容忍度(EXE)三种互补解释。
AI.motivation: GNN虽能预测分子性质，但预测精度无法说明图信息如何支持单个决策；紧凑的保预测有理据未必揭示哪些改动会反转决策、哪些修改被模型容忍。因此需要统一框架同时刻画模型支持、敏感性与容忍度。
AI.method: MPGE在冻结分类器上统一三视角：事实视图(原称prototype, PT)寻找标签与置信度保持的紧凑保留边集；反事实视图(CF)寻找有界、改变预测的删除；样例视图(EXE)寻找有界、非平凡且保持标签与置信度的删除。三者由共享的约束公式连接预测行为、紧凑性与编辑代价，各自独立目标生成三视角。CF侧扩展CF-GNNExplainer到图分类，学习对称边排序并验证离散候选，记录失败搜索；另设BBBP片段后端输出经RDKit净化的分子。
AI.result: 在MUTAG、Mutagenicity、AIDS、COX2_MD、BBBP上以语义覆盖率、条件质量、稳定性与运行时间评测主GCN实现：成功事实掩码平均保留输入边的8.6%–15.5%；有界反事实覆盖率为4.8%–67.6%；样例保持覆盖率为98.9%–100.0%。探索性对照显示硬投影与保留节点信息的影响。
AI.conclusion: MPGE以统一约束框架在量化对比与分子可视化中刻画模型的支持、敏感性与容忍度，且不将其视为已验证的化学机制。

title: SCORE: Spectral Correlation Estimation for Multivariate Gaussians
summary: Neural network-based predictive modeling with high-dimensional structured Gaussian targets requires an efficient and numerically stable, yet expressive approximation of the covariance matrix. We propose SCORE: a scalable framework, combining scoring rule training with an expressive covariance approximation learned in spectral space. For $d$-dimensional data, the learning task is decomposed into learning the marginal distributions and learning a structured correlation matrix, which enables dense dependencies with linear storage and $\mathcal{O}(d\log d)$ cost. We utilize the closed form Gaussian kernel score for training, which remains defined even for degenerate covariances and admits bounded gradients during optimization. We characterize kernel scores under invertible transforms and prove exact invariance under unitary transforms. At population level, our two-level objective recovers the true marginals and projects the target correlation onto the representable class; finite-sample PAC bounds show that the errors of the two stages enter additively. We evaluate our model on a variety of tasks with a commonly assumed Gaussian domain: Time-series forecasting, monocular depth estimation, and spatial weather prediction, showing improved performance at lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出SCORE框架，在谱空间中学习高维结构化高斯协方差的表达性近似，兼具线性存储与O(d log d)复杂度。
AI.motivation: 高维结构化高斯目标的神经网络预测建模，需要既高效、数值稳定又具表达力的协方差矩阵近似方法，现有方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: 将学习任务分解为学习边缘分布与学习结构化相关矩阵，在谱空间中进行表达性协方差近似，并结合评分规则训练；采用高斯核score的闭式解，对退化协方差仍有定义且梯度有界；刻画可逆变换下的核score性质并证明酉变换下的精确不变性。
AI.result: 总体层面上两级目标可恢复真实边缘并将目标相关投影到可表示类；有限样本PAC界表明两阶段误差可加；在时间序列预测、单目深度估计和空间天气预测等任务上以更低计算成本取得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: SCORE为高维高斯结构化协方差提供可扩展、数值稳定且具表达力的近似方案，实现线性存储与O(d log d)开销，并在多个高斯域任务上验证有效性与效率优势。

title: A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning
summary: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. At inference, the deployed policy is an unmodified SAC actor, since the generators are used only on the critic side during training.Across four MuJoCo-v5 locomotion benchmarks and six off-policy baselines, GeZo-SAC achieves the highest mean return on Ant-v5 and Hopper-v5 and remains competitive with other methods on the remaining tasks. Our analysis further shows that GeZo-SAC achieves the lowest average actuator work and action effort per metre among the evaluated methods, while maintaining near-zero measured overestimation frequency across all four environments.

AI.tldr: GeZo-SAC 通过为每个 critic 附加几何生成器构造 zonotope，将几何宽度与 critic 分歧转化为自适应悲观偏移与聚合权重，在 MuJoCo-v5 基准上取得有竞争力的回报并显著降低过估计频率与动作能耗。
AI.motivation: 现有 off-policy actor-critic 方法（如 SAC、TD3）采用"取双 critic 最小值"的固定聚合规则来抑制过估计偏差，但该规则与 critic 之间的一致程度无关：无论两者分歧大小，都以同一方式组合。作者希望让 critic 的悲观程度能够随状态与动作自适应，并利用 critic 间的分歧信息动态调整聚合方式。
AI.method: 提出 GeZo-SAC：在标量值之外，每个 critic 额外预测一组生成器（generators），共同定义高维空间中的 zonotope（带中心的多面体）。沿采样方向探测该 zonotope 得到几何宽度，一方面作为悲观偏移从每个 critic 值中减去，另一方面作为两 critic 间分歧的度量，并用 log-sum-exp 聚合。该分歧控制 critic 的组合方式：分歧小时趋近于按宽度加权的平均，分歧增大时逐渐过渡到标准的最小值聚合。生成器仅在训练期用于 critic 侧，推理时部署的是未经修改的标准 SAC actor。
AI.result: 在四个 MuJoCo-v5 连续控制任务与六个 off-policy 基线对比中，GeZo-SAC 在 Ant-v5 与 Hopper-v5 上取得最高的平均回报，其余任务保持有竞争力的表现。分析显示其在所评估方法中具有最低的平均执行器功（actuator work）与单位距离动作代价（action effort per metre），并在全部四个环境中维持接近零的实测过估计频率。
AI.conclusion: 几何表示驱动的自适应悲观机制可以作为固定最小值聚合的有效替代：在保持 SAC 策略与推理开销不变的前提下，同时改善回报、能耗效率与过估计控制。该工作表明将不确定性/分歧的几何刻画引入 critic 侧，是提升 off-policy 连续控制稳健性的一个可行方向。

title: Using Weisfeiler-Leman Features for Algorithm Selection in Constraint Optimisation
summary:
Algorithm Selection is essential for efficient Constraint Programming. Over the years, many algorithm selectors based on machine learning methods have been successfully applied, yet traditional feature extraction methods often rely on manually decided instance-level statistics that fail to capture the underlying problem structure.
  In this paper we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a novel, automated feature extraction methodology that integrates graph conversion and Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels to generate robust structural representations of problem instances. The 1-WL test bounds the graph-distinguishing power of standard message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and suitable GNN architectures match this bound \citep{Xuetal2018}. WL-based features offer an alternative that does not require training a GNN. Our primary contribution is a cut-based representation (\texttt{WLc}) designed to model structural partitions and provide a more nuanced predictive signal. We evaluate our approach on instances from the 2023--2025 MiniZinc Challenges across two tasks: maximizing Borda count scores and maximizing predictive accuracy. Experimental results across Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and Multi-Layer Perceptrons demonstrate that cut-based features outperform \texttt{fzn2feat} with SVMs, while results with RFs and MLPs are closer.

AI.tldr: 提出基于割表示与Weisfeiler-Lehman图核的自动特征提取方法（WLc），用于约束编程算法选择，在MiniZinc Challenge实例上优于fzn2feat（尤其配合SVM）。
AI.motivation: 算法选择对约束编程的效率至关重要，已有许多基于机器学习的算法选择器，但传统特征提取依赖人工设计的实例级统计量，难以刻画问题底层结构。
AI.method: 将图转换与Weisfeiler-Lehman图核结合，生成实例的鲁棒结构表示；1-WL测试界定了标准消息传递GNN的图区分能力上限，WL特征无需训练GNN即可逼近该能力；核心贡献为割表示WLc，用于建模结构划分并提供更细粒度的预测信号。
AI.result: 在2023—2025 MiniZinc Challenge实例上，以最大化Borda计分和最大化预测准确率为两个任务，采用SVM、随机森林和多层感知机评估：SVM下WLc优于fzn2feat，RF与MLP下两者结果较为接近。
AI.conclusion: WLc割表示可提供有效的结构特征，在SVM上明显超越基线fzn2feat，但在RF与MLP上优势不明显，表明特征与选择器模型的匹配性影响最终效果。

title: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
summary: Quantum machine learning, and quantum neural networks (QNNs) in particular, are advancing fields with growing potential. Although systematic comparisons of QNN configurations have been explored primarily for classification tasks, comparatively little attention has been given to regression problems, particularly financial time series forecasting. This study presents a large-scale systematic comparative evaluation of QNN component configurations for financial time series forecasting, using the GBP/USD spot exchange rate as a case study. A grid search across encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, layer depths, and cost functions yields 1,368 distinct model configurations, each evaluated in terms of prediction accuracy, computational cost, and convergence behaviour. The results reveal unique insights into how the choice of methods influences performance, such as that gate selection and arrangement are more critical to model success than raw parameter count, and that entanglement is a system-level property of the full circuit rather than solely at the ansatz level. The best-performing QNN configuration achieves an $R^2$ score of 0.985, outperforming a classical BiLSTM baseline. Additionally, the impact of real quantum hardware noise is assessed through execution on the IQM Emerald device, revealing that gate errors and decoherence represent a significant barrier to practical deployment, with gate selection and circuit depth identified as key determinants of hardware noise resilience. Overall, the findings provide practical architectural guidance for QNN design and establish a baseline characterisation of QNN noise sensitivity on near-term quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文对金融时间序列预测中的量子神经网络配置进行大规模系统性比较，以英镑/美元汇率为案例，网格搜索生成1368个配置，最优QNN的R²达0.985，优于经典BiLSTM基线，并评估了真实量子硬件噪声的影响。
AI.motivation: QNN的系统性配置比较主要集中于分类任务，回归问题（尤其是金融时间序列预测）关注不足；同时缺乏对近-term量子硬件噪声敏感性的基线刻画。
AI.method: 以GBP/USD即期汇率为案例，对编码方法、ansatz设计、量子比特数、层深度和成本函数进行网格搜索，共得到1368个模型配置，分别从预测精度、计算成本和收敛行为三方面评估；并在IQM Emerald设备上评估真实硬件噪声影响。
AI.result: 最佳QNN配置R²为0.985，优于经典BiLSTM基线；门选择与排列比参数总量更关键；纠缠是全电路的系统级属性而非仅ansatz层面；硬件上门误差与退相干是实用部署的主要障碍，门选择与电路深度决定噪声鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究为QNN设计提供实用架构指导，并建立近-term量子设备上QNN噪声敏感性的基线刻画。

title: Bayesian Optimisation under State-Preservation Constraints
summary: In many engineering design problems, the objective and constraints depend on the state: the solution of a PDE determined by the design parameters. We consider improving a design while holding selected state observables near trusted values, which we call state preservation constraints. Constrained Bayesian optimisation handles these with a learnt feasibility model, but struggles with this problem's highly anisotropic feasible set. Our central idea is to pre-compute the set of controls whose linearised constraint response stays within tolerance, thereby pulling back the state-space constraint into design space. This linearisation defines an ellipsoid from which we can efficiently draw a large number of well-spread candidates. The underlying linear response map is refined online, and the ellipsoid is rebuilt accordingly. We demonstrate the method end-to-end on our key application - Tokamak divertor optimisation under plasma-boundary preservation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向PDE约束工程设计的状态保持优化方法：通过预计算线性化约束响应在容差内的控制集，将状态空间约束拉回设计空间形成椭球，从而高效采样候选解，并在在线过程中不断精化线性响应映射。
AI.motivation: 许多工程设计问题的目标与约束依赖由设计参数决定的PDE状态解；作者关注在改进设计的同时，使选定状态观测量保持在可信值附近，即状态保持约束。现有约束贝叶斯优化依赖学习可行性模型，但难以处理高度各向异性的可行集。
AI.method: 核心思想是预先计算满足线性化约束响应在容差范围内的控制集，将状态空间约束拉回设计空间；该线性化定义一个椭球，可从中高效抽取大量分布良好的候选点。底层线性响应映射在线精化，并据此重建椭球。
AI.result: 在关键应用——等离子体边界保持下的托卡马克偏滤器优化——上完成了端到端验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过将状态保持约束显式拉回设计空间并利用线性化椭球进行候选采样，有望缓解约束贝叶斯优化在高各向异性可行集下的困难，并已在托卡马克偏滤器优化中展示可行性。

title: Toward Optimal Regret in Adversarial MDPs with Stochastic Hard Constraints
summary: We study episodic constrained Markov decision processes with adversarial losses under stochastic hard constraints. Specifically, starting from a known strictly feasible policy with margin $d$, we seek to obtain optimal regret while satisfying the expected cost constraints in every episode. In this setting, Stradi et al. (2025) show that a carefully designed mixing rule attains regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\min\{d,d^2\})$. Interestingly, they also provide a lower bound of order $Ω(\sqrt{T}/ρ)$ for the same setting, where $ρ$ is the Slater margin of the offline problem and can be much larger than $d$. In this work, we build on their approach to obtain optimal regret dependence on these margins. Specifically, we propose MA-OPS, an algorithm that combines an optimistic search for the Slater margin with a pessimistic evaluation of the selected policies to safely learn a policy with a large feasibility margin. This policy is then used to minimize regret while satisfying the constraints at every episode. In particular, we show that MA-OPS attains regret $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/ρ+ 1/(dρ))$. Finally, we provide a matching lower bound, showing that the dependence on $T$, $d$, $ρ$ in the regret bound is optimal up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机硬约束下的对抗损失 episodic 约束马尔可夫决策过程，提出 MA-OPS 算法，将遗憾界改进至 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\rho+1/(d\rho))$，并给出匹配下界，证明对 $T$、$d$、$\rho$ 的依赖达到最优（忽略对数因子）。
AI.motivation: Stradi et al. (2025) 在该设定下给出 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\min\{d,d^2\})$ 的遗憾上界与 $Ω(\sqrt{T}/\rho)$ 的下界，其中 $\rho$ 为离线问题的 Slater 边际，可能远大于已知严格可行策略的边际 $d$。上界与下界在边际依赖上存在明显差距，如何获得对 $d$ 与 $\rho$ 依赖最优的遗憾成为一个待解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出 MA-OPS 算法：结合对 Slater 边际的乐观搜索（optimistic search）与对所选策略的悲观评估（pessimistic evaluation），以安全地学习一个具有较大可行边际的策略；随后利用该策略在每一 episode 满足期望成本约束的同时最小化遗憾。
AI.result: MA-OPS 达到遗憾 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\rho+1/(d\rho))$；同时给出匹配下界，表明遗憾界对 $T$、$d$、$\rho$ 的依赖在对数因子内是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了随机硬约束对抗损失约束 MDP 中上界与下界在边际依赖上的差距，通过乐观搜索与悲观评估相结合的方式实现了最优遗憾，并以下界验证其最优性。

title: Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure
summary: Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.

AI.tldr: Schema 通过递归分解参考图为软社区层次结构，将属性图生成拆分为三个独立训练阶段，实现高保真、低记忆、可扩展的属性图生成，并配套提出涵盖结构保真度、记忆、下游效用与可扩展性的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 生成大规模属性图需同时兼顾拓扑复现、属性与结构联合生成及可扩展性。现实中许多图以单一大型图形式存在，模型必须从所拟合的这一个图中泛化，而无法依赖独立同分布样本，这给属性图生成带来挑战。
AI.method: Schema 递归地将参考图分解为软社区层次，为每个节点分配隶属度分布。生成分三阶段独立训练：（1）以软隶属度为条件合成节点属性；（2）从局部结构上下文生成社区内边；（3）在隶属度质量分布于多个社区的桥节点上建模社区间连接。任何阶段都不构建完整邻接矩阵，各阶段仅处理以社区规模为界的子图。
AI.result: 在四个真实属性图上，Schema 在生成属性的模型中最近地恢复了局部与长程结构的平衡，同时仅复现参考图的一小部分边；其下游准确率与参考图相当，未被人为抬高。结构保真度相当的基线会记忆参考图，而下游准确率更高的基线要么超过参考准确率，要么无法在大图上完成。可扩展性在六个额外图上验证，节点规模达 1000 万。
AI.conclusion: Schema 通过软社区递归分解与三阶段独立生成，在不构建全邻接矩阵的前提下实现了属性图的高保真、低记忆与强可扩展生成，并配以全面评估协议，验证了其在结构保真度、下游效用与规模上的综合优势。

title: Is Real-World Training Data Necessary for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection?
summary: Generalist graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to build a foundation model that detects anomalies on arbitrary unseen graphs without retraining or fine-tuning. Sufficient data are essential for foundation model training, yet generalist GAD still faces a data shortage, as real-world anomalous graphs are scarce and costly to collect and annotate. To fill this gap, we propose AG-FORGE, an Anomalous Graph generation Forge for automatic synthesis of anomalous graphs, exploring the feasibility of synthetic data-driven training for generalist GAD. Empirically, we find that synthetic data can achieve performance comparable to real-world training, but fail to push the performance boundary further due to the limited capacity of existing methods. To further unlock model capacity as training data scale up, we develop TS-GGAD, a Topology-Semantic coordinated Generalist GAD that captures complementary topological and semantic anomaly evidence, together with a curriculum learning strategy tailored to large-scale synthetic training. Extensive experiments on 14 real-world datasets demonstrate that TS-GGAD, trained on data generated by AG-FORGE, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对通用图异常检测（GAD）的数据匮乏问题，提出异常图自动合成框架AG-FORGE，并设计拓扑-语义协同的通用GAD模型TS-GGAD及配套课程学习策略，在14个真实数据集上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 通用GAD旨在构建无需重训练或微调即可检测任意未见图上异常的基础模型，而基础模型训练依赖充足数据。但现实中的异常图稀缺、采集与标注成本高昂，导致通用GAD面临数据短缺。作者希望探索合成数据驱动训练的可行性来填补该缺口。
AI.method: 1) 提出AG-FORGE，用于自动合成异常图；2) 通过实证发现合成数据性能可与真实数据相当，但受限于现有方法容量无法进一步突破性能边界；3) 提出TS-GGAD，协同捕获互补的拓扑与语义异常证据，并设计面向大规模合成训练的课程学习策略，以在数据规模扩大时释放模型容量。
AI.result: 在14个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，使用AG-FORGE生成数据训练的TS-GGAD显著优于当前最先进方法（state-of-the-art）。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据可有效支撑通用GAD训练，但需配合高容量模型与适配的训练策略。AG-FORGE与TS-GGAD结合实现了合成数据驱动的通用图异常检测，并取得优于现有方法的性能。

title: DataSense-Bench: The First Step Toward an AI Scientist
summary: As claims about recursive self-improvement (RSI) and artificial general intelligence (AGI) proliferate, we ask a simple question: do frontier AI models have a sense of data, i.e., can they reliably select the right data for training? We introduce DataSense-Bench to study this capability through the fundamental problem of data selection and performance forecasting in machine learning. We ask AI agents to select and rank candidate training subsets that can be used to fine-tune a small LLM model. Agents are allowed to inspect the data, write and execute analysis code, and run model forward passes, but can not train the model or access the actual evaluation tasks. We then fine-tune the base model on each selected subset and evaluate its post-training performance under a standardized protocol. We instantiate the benchmark in terminal problem solving and tool use, selecting trajectories from OpenThoughts-Agent and EnvScaler and evaluating on TBLite and BFCL, respectively. We then evaluate the agents along two complementary dimensions: the post-training performance of the top-ranked subset, reflecting the ability to identify high-value training data, and ranking accuracy, reflecting the ability to predict the relative performance of the selected subsets. In our experiments, selection gains over random selection are limited; agents do not reliably rank their selected groups, and ranking ability does not hold consistently across tasks: Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but in only one of three terminal runs. Analysis of execution traces on both tasks shows that agents often use similar data signals while interpreting their training value differently.

AI.tldr: 提出 DataSense-Bench 基准，考察前沿 AI 模型是否具备"数据感"——即为训练可靠选择正确数据的能力，结果显示其数据选择与排序能力均有限且不稳定。
AI.motivation: 随着关于递归自我改进（RSI）和通用人工智能（AGI）的论断不断增多，一个基础性问题尚未被系统检验：前沿 AI 模型是否具备"数据感"，即能否为训练可靠地挑选出正确的数据。作者通过数据选择与性能预测这一机器学习核心问题来研究该能力。
AI.method: 构建 DataSense-Bench：让 AI 智能体从候选训练子集中选择并排序，用于微调一个小型 LLM。智能体可检查数据、编写并执行分析代码、运行模型前向传播，但不能训练模型，也不能访问真实评测任务。随后按标准化协议在每个被选子集上微调基座模型并评测其训练后性能。在终端问题求解与工具使用两个场景实例化：分别从 OpenThoughts-Agent 和 EnvScaler 选取轨迹，并在 TBLite 与 BFCL 上评测。从两个互补维度评估智能体：排序最高子集的训练后性能（识别高价值训练数据的能力）与排序准确率（预测所选子集相对性能的能力）。
AI.result: 相对于随机选择的增益有限；智能体无法可靠地对其所选数据组进行排序，且排序能力在不同任务间并不一致——Astra 在三次工具使用运行中均能识别最佳组，但在三次终端运行中仅有一次做到。对两个任务执行轨迹的分析显示，智能体常使用相似的数据信号，却对其训练价值的解读各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 前沿 AI 模型尚未具备可靠、稳健的"数据感"：数据选择带来的收益有限，排序能力弱且跨任务不稳定。该工作提供了评估数据选择能力的标准化基准，并指出智能体在对数据信号训练价值的解读上存在不一致，为后续提升模型的数据感知与自我改进能力提供了方向。

title: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
comment: 34 pages, 9 figures. Code and cached results: https://github.com/Xodios/TRAINING-ON-THE-FUTURE-A-DELAY-AWARE-AUDIT-OF-TEST-TIME-ADAPTATION-FOR-TIME-SERIES-FORECASTING
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for time-series forecasting update a deployed model, or a small adapter around it, from incoming ground truth. But the label of an $H$-step forecast exists only $H$ steps later, and real data pipelines add further delay. We build a leakage-free harness in which the label of forecast origin $s$ is released for updates only at step $s+d$ with $d \ge H$, and enforce this rule inside the released code of four recent TTA methods (TAFAS, COSA, PETSA and DynaTTA), run on their own backbones and checkpoints across five benchmarks (ETTm1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity and Traffic). As references we add two closed-form correctors: a bank of recursive least squares (RLS) filters combined by a per-coordinate median, with no tunable hyperparameters and 56 microseconds per step on the 7-channel streams, and an ELF-style linear corrector. Under causal delayed labels the picture is asymmetric. On ETTm1 every audited method genuinely adapts, yet the RLS bank still beats three of the four at a fraction of their cost; only DynaTTA beats the bank, only at the minimum causal delay, and at roughly 2,500 times the per-update cost; the ELF-style corrector beats all four. On the other four datasets, the largest statistically significant improvement any published method achieves over its own frozen checkpoint is half a percent, on all four at least one published method is significantly worse than the frozen model at the minimum causal delay, and on drift-heavy ETTh2 longer label delays make every adapter that separates from the frozen model, ours included, significantly harmful. Leaky next-step updates inflate the apparent gains of simple adapters by up to 110%, and the backbone training recipe moves frozen online error by up to a factor of 25, more than any adaptation effect we measure. We release the harness, integration patches and all cached runs.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个无泄漏的测试时自适应（TTA）评测框架，强制标签在预测起点后 d≥H 步才可用于更新，并以此重新审计四种近期 TTA 方法与两种闭式校正器。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测的 TTA 方法依赖"即时到达"的真值标签进行在线更新，但 H 步预测的标签本就滞后 H 步，真实数据管道还引入额外延迟。这种因果错配使得此前报告的增益可能来自泄漏，缺乏可信评测。作者希望建立严格因果的评测环境，厘清这些方法的真实有效性。
AI.method: 搭建无泄漏 harness：预测起点 s 的标签仅在 s+d（d≥H）时释出用于更新，并将该规则注入 TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA 四种方法的官方代码，沿用其骨干与检查点，在 ETTm1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic 五个基准上运行。加入两个闭式校正器作参照：一为由逐坐标中位数组合的递归最小二乘（RLS）滤波器组（无需调参，7 通道流上每步 56 微秒），另为 ELF 风格线性校正器。
AI.result: 在因果延迟标签下结果呈不对称性。ETTm1 上四种方法均真实自适应，但 RLS 滤波器组仍以极小成本胜过其中三种；仅 DynaTTA 胜出，且只在最小因果延迟下、成本约为每更新的 2500 倍；ELF 风格校正器胜过全部四种。其余四个数据集上，任何已发表方法相对自身冻结检查点的最大显著提升仅 0.5%，且四者中至少各有一种在最小因果延迟下显著劣于冻结模型；在漂移严重的 ETTh2 上，较长标签延迟使所有偏离冻结模型的适配器（含作者方法）显著有害。泄漏的下一步更新最多将简单适配器的表面增益夸大 110%，骨干训练配方对冻结在线误差的影响高达 25 倍，超过所测任何自适应效应。
AI.conclusion: 在严格因果条件下，近期 TTA 方法的时间序列预测增益有限，常不及简单的闭式校正器甚至冻结模型；标签延迟、骨干训练配方等混杂因素影响巨大。作者公开了 harness、集成补丁与全部缓存运行结果，呼吁以此类无泄漏评测为准。

title: AdaCast: Conditional Parameter Generation for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved strong forecasting performance across domains. However, most adaptation methods remain static. Existing all-in-one methods learn a single set of dataset-level parameter updates and apply the same adapted model to every input. As a result, they cannot adapt the model parameters to the temporal patterns, seasonality and dynamics of each input time series. This limits their ability to produce forecasts that are tailored to heterogeneous inputs. To address this limitation, we propose AdaCast, a conditional parameter generation framework for time-series forecasting. AdaCast uses a generator to produce input-specific low-rank parameter updates for a frozen pretrained TSFM. These updates adapt the model to each input during both training and inference. Across six public benchmarks, AdaCast consistently outperforms static adaptation baseline in in-domain forecasting and improves zero-shot generalization to held-out datasets across domains. These results demonstrate that conditional parameter generation provides an effective approach for adaptive forecasting.

AI.tldr: AdaCast提出了一种条件参数生成框架，通过生成器为每个输入时间序列生成特定的低秩参数更新，使冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型能实现输入级自适应预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的适配方法大多是静态的，all-in-one方法学习单一的、数据集级参数更新，对所有输入应用同一适配模型，无法针对每条输入序列的时间模式、季节性和动态特性进行适配，限制了面向异构输入的定制化预测能力。
AI.method: 提出AdaCast条件参数生成框架。使用一个生成器为冻结的预训练TSFM产生输入特定的低秩参数更新，这些更新在训练和推理阶段均将模型适配到每个输入。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准上，AdaCast在域内预测中持续优于静态适配基线，并提升了跨域留出数据集的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 条件参数生成是实现自适应预测的有效途径，能够克服静态适配的局限，兼顾域内性能与跨域零样本泛化。

title: RIFT: Relative Isolation From Trees For Anomaly Detection
summary: Isolation Forest (IF) is a widely used baseline for unsupervised anomaly detection. Recent studies provide a closed-form expression for the infinite-forest limit for one-dimensional data. Inspired by the geometric interpretation of this formula, we introduce RIFT (Relative Isolation From Trees), a deterministic anomaly detection method that generates the minimum spanning tree and scores each point by the sum of the apparent sizes of tree edges as viewed from that point. For one-dimensional data, the RIFT score recovers the closed-form IF limit exactly. In higher dimensions, it provides a parameter-free generalization that is deterministic, robust to varying density and clustered anomalies and avoids the axis-parallel artifacts of IF. We further propose an ensemble variant for large datasets. Experiments on synthetic data and the ADBench benchmark demonstrate that the accuracy is comparable to IF, while the ensemble variant exhibits significantly lower variance across random seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIFT，一种基于最小生成树的确定性异常检测方法，在一维数据上精确复现IF的无限森林闭式极限，并在高维上提供无参数、稳健的推广，附带集成变体。
AI.motivation: Isolation Forest（IF）是无监督异常检测的常用基线，近期研究给出了一维数据下无限森林极限的闭式表达式；受该公式的几何解读启发，作者试图构造一种确定性、无参数、且能克服IF轴平行伪影的异常检测方法。
AI.method: RIFT（Relative Isolation From Trees）：构建最小生成树（MST），从每个点的视角将各树边的"表观大小"求和作为该点的异常得分；得分在一维数据上精确等于IF的闭式极限。高维下作为无参数推广，另提出面向大数据的集成变体。
AI.result: 合成数据与ADBench基准实验显示，RIFT精度与IF相当；集成变体在不同随机种子下方差显著更低。
AI.conclusion: RIFT将IF的几何解释推广为确定性、无参数方法，对密度变化和聚簇异常稳健，规避了IF的轴平行伪影；集成变体在保持精度的同时显著提升稳定性。

title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
summary: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.

AI.tldr: Cluster-TNN 通过"局部提升"替代"全局物化"，在划分图后动态采样簇组并重构诱导子图以形成拓扑小批量，从而在不牺牲预测性能的前提下大幅降低显存，首次实现大规模数据集上的高阶拓扑神经网络训练。
AI.motivation: 拓扑深度学习（TDL）将图学习扩展到超图、胞腔复形、单纯复形等高阶域，但这些高阶域通常需由输入图经"图提升"构造。全图（full-domain）训练需在执行模型前构造并存储完整的提升表示；在 Reddit（23.3 万节点、5730 万条边）这类大规模稠密数据上，这种全局物化成为严重计算瓶颈，甚至使训练不可行。因此需要一种避免全局构建的扩展策略。
AI.method: 提出 Cluster-TNN，一种与拓扑域无关（domain-agnostic）的框架，以"局部提升"规避全局物化瓶颈：1）预处理阶段对输入图进行划分（簇划分）；2）运行时动态采样若干节点簇组成簇组，重构其诱导子图形成小批量；3）在小批量内部执行所选定的提升操作。采样节点间保留全部边，以维持跨簇构造高阶结构所需的连通性，从而生成现有拓扑神经网络（TNN）可直接处理的拓扑小批量。
AI.result: 在与全图执行的 21 组匹配对比中，Cluster-TNN 在所有配置下均降低峰值 GPU 显存，平均降低 83.2%，同时保持具有竞争力的预测性能。该显存降低使得在 Reddit、OGBN Products 等大规模数据集上训练多种不同高阶拓扑神经网络成为可能，据作者所知属首次。
AI.conclusion: Cluster-TNN 是一种将拓扑深度学习扩展到超出全局域构造限制的通用策略：通过簇划分+动态采样的局部提升方式生成拓扑小批量，兼容现有 TNN，兼顾显存效率与预测性能，为大图上的高阶拓扑学习提供了可行的规模化路径。

title: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
summary: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at 20\% cost ($2.7\times$ efficiency, $p=0.002$ over 10 seeds). On the more volatile Container Trace, it achieves 96\% at 20\% cost ($4.8\times$ efficiency, $+75\%$ MAE reduction over Static). Unlike classical drift detectors (ADWIN, DDM, Page-Hinkley) which fail to trigger on regression-scale error streams, AdaptLSTM fires 42 times over 301 steps and outperforms matched-budget baselines. Wall-clock profiling shows $1.33\times$ throughput gain and 45\% update-time reduction. The framework is model-agnostic: identical Pareto patterns hold for LSTM, GRU, and Transformer backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaptLSTM自适应在线学习框架，通过验证校准阈值检测漂移并选择性更新，在低计算成本下显著提升云服务负载预测精度。
AI.motivation: 云服务弹性资源供给依赖精准负载预测，但病毒式内容、产品发布等导致分布漂移，使离线模型快速失效；朴素在线学习虽恢复精度但每步计算成本过高。
AI.method: AdaptLSTM：用验证集校准的阈值检测分布漂移，并执行选择性的、有针对性的模型更新（而非全量在线更新）。
AI.result: 在Alibaba Machine Trace上以20%成本恢复朴素在线54%的改进（2.7倍效率，p=0.002，10个种子）；在Container Trace上以20%成本达96%（4.8倍效率，MAE较Static降低75%）。经典漂移检测器（ADWIN、DDM、Page-Hinkley）在回归误差流上无法触发，AdaptLSTM在301步内触发42次并优于同等预算基线；吞吐量提升1.33倍，更新耗时降低45%；框架与模型无关，LSTM、GRU、Transformer骨干网络呈现相同Pareto规律。
AI.conclusion: AdaptLSTM在精度与计算成本间取得优良折中，弥补传统漂移检测器在回归场景的失效，且具备模型无关的通用性。

title: Ambient Discrete Diffusion: Using the Wrong Data at the Right Time for Data Efficient Learning
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops (BeNTo, DiffuLM)
summary: We introduce RefineMix, a framework for training discrete diffusion models under severe data scarcity, a common constraint in scientific applications. RefineMix uses out-of-distribution data at selected diffusion times to improve generalization without biasing the sampling distribution. Although this strategy has been explored in continuous diffusion, discrete diffusion presents a distinct challenge: unlike Gaussian noise, masking preserves domain information in surviving tokens, limiting the use of related data at high noise levels. At low noise levels, however, the domains effectively disjoint supports become an advantage, allowing the model to learn from both in-domain and out-of-distribution data without biasing the sampler. We formalize these intuitions and provide a theoretical analysis for the proposed method. Experimentally, across five domain-shift settings, RefineMix matches or outperforms in-domain finetuning and data mixing. For protein sequence generation, finetuning with just 197 in-domain examples nearly doubles the fraction of generated proteins that are simultaneously novel, foldable, and in-family compared to standard finetuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 RefineMix 框架，在数据极度稀缺下利用分布外数据在特定扩散时刻训练离散扩散模型，提升泛化且不偏置采样分布。
AI.motivation: 科学应用中常面临严重数据稀缺。连续扩散中已有利用分布外数据提升泛化的策略，但离散扩散因掩码噪声保留token域信息，在高噪声下限制了相关数据的使用，需专门解决。
AI.method: RefineMix 在选定的扩散时刻引入分布外数据。关键洞察是低噪声时各域支撑近似不相交，成为优势，使模型可同时从域内与分布外数据学习而不偏置采样器；并对该策略进行理论分析。基于掩码的离散扩散过程。
AI.result: 在五个域偏移设置中，RefineMix 匹配或超越域内微调与数据混合。在蛋白质序列生成上，仅用197个域内样本微调，生成同时满足新颖、可折叠且同家族的蛋白质比例相比标准微调几乎翻倍。
AI.conclusion: RefineMix 有效解决离散扩散在严重数据稀缺下的训练问题，理论支撑其低噪声利用分布外数据的合理性，实验证实其在多域偏移与蛋白质生成任务上的优越性。

title: SplitJEPA: Learning Invariant and Variant Latent Worlds without Reconstruction
summary: Understanding a dynamical world calls for more than a latent state that summarizes its observations: the state should also be organized into the factors that stay shared across related observations and the factors that vary between them. For example, a robot pushing a cube to a goal should take the same action when the camera shifts or the lights dim, since nothing in the scene has moved. Existing approaches to this decomposition commonly obtain it through reconstruction, so the latent variables must first explain the entire observational world before their organization can be trusted. Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) model the latent state directly and never reconstruct, yet no existing result recovers the invariant and variant parts of the state they learn. How to learn the invariant-variant structure of the latent world without paying for its reconstruction therefore remains open. To close this gap, we introduce SplitJEPA, a JEPA that jointly recovers the latent state and its invariant and variant organization directly in representation space, without any reconstruction. We prove that, under stationary Gaussian predictive dynamics and a full-rank variation condition, SplitJEPA identifies the invariant and variant subspaces up to independent block-wise isometries, without introducing an observation decoder. Since the guarantee needs no decoder, the result extends reconstruction-free latent recovery to invariant-variant block identification. Experiments on synthetic nonlinear systems and robotic manipulation tasks support the theoretical results and show their practical value for both robustness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SplitJEPA，一种无需重构的联合嵌入预测架构，能在表示空间中同时恢复潜在状态及其不变与变化子空间结构，并在理论证明与合成/机器人操作实验中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 理解动态世界需要的不仅是一个概括观测的潜在状态，还需要将状态组织为跨相关观测共享的不变因子与随之变化的变化因子（如相机移动或光照变化时机器人应保持相同动作）。现有分解方法多依赖重构，须先解释整个观测世界才能信任其结构组织；JEPA 虽直接建模潜在状态且不重构，但尚无结果能恢复其学习到状态中的不变与变化部分。因此"如何在不付出重构代价的情况下学习潜在世界的不变-变化结构"仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 提出 SplitJEPA：直接在表示空间中联合恢复潜在状态及其不变与变化组织，不使用任何重构/观测解码器。理论上在平稳高斯预测动力学与满秩变化条件假设下，证明 SplitJEPA 可将不变子空间与变化子空间辨识到独立的逐块等距变换（block-wise isometries）程度。
AI.result: 理论证明在无观测解码器的条件下实现不变-变化块的辨识，将免重构的潜在恢复推广到不变-变化块辨识；在合成非线性系统与机器人操作任务上的实验支持理论结论，并展示其在鲁棒性与效率方面的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: SplitJEPA 填补了 JEPA 无法恢复不变/变化结构的空白，证明了免重构条件下不变-变化子空间的可辨识性，兼具理论保证与实际鲁棒性和效率优势。

title: Marformer: A Transformer for Predicting Missing Data Distributions
comment: 45 pages, 19 figures; presented in part in a COLM 2026 keynote
summary: Real decisions are made under incomplete information. If we observe only some of the random variables we need, we can predict the others. The \textbf{conditional marginals} over the missing variables are the key ingredient for computing Bayes risk and Value of Information (VOI), the expected gain from acquiring one more observation before deciding. We present the Marformer, a Transformer trained to directly predict conditional marginals given any set of observed values. Like BERT, which is trained to predict missing words from context, the Marformer constructs a hidden-vector representation for each distribution $p(X_i)$ and iteratively refines it through attention to other distributions $p(X_j)$. Unlike generative approaches, the Marformer does not model the full joint distribution, requires no domain knowledge of the data-generating process, and makes all predictions in a single forward pass. We evaluate across three synthetic domains with missing data---Bayesian networks, discretized multivariate Gaussians, and structured annotation data. The Marformer can match or outperform classical missing-data methods, even when those methods are given the true model family and prior that generated the synthetic data. We also evaluate on a real annotation dataset, where the Marformer outperforms the evaluated baselines at the largest training size. In both cases, the Marformer is substantially faster than the evaluated generative baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Marformer，一种类似 BERT 的 Transformer 模型，直接预测缺失变量上的条件边缘分布，用于计算 Bayes 风险与信息价值（VOI），在合成与真实数据上匹配或超越经典缺失数据方法，且速度更快。
AI.motivation: 现实决策常面临信息不完整：只能观测部分随机变量，需预测其余变量。缺失变量上的条件边缘分布是计算 Bayes 风险与 VOI 的关键。然而传统方法依赖完整联合分布建模或领域知识，生成式方法则计算昂贵。
AI.method: Marformer 借鉴 BERT 的掩码预测思想：为每个分布 p(X_i) 构建隐藏向量表示，并通过注意力机制对其它分布 p(X_j) 迭代精炼。它不建模完整联合分布，不需要数据生成过程的领域知识，所有预测在单次前向传播中完成。
AI.result: 在三个合成缺失数据域（贝叶斯网络、离散多元高斯、结构化标注数据）上评估，Marformer 匹配或超越经典缺失数据方法，即便后者被给予生成数据的真实模型族与先验。在真实标注数据集上，于最大训练规模下优于所评估基线，且速度显著快于生成式基线。
AI.conclusion: Marformer 能高效、无需领域知识地直接预测条件边缘分布，在预测精度与计算速度上均具优势，为缺失数据下的决策（Bayes 风险、VOI）提供了实用工具。

title: Prospective Prediction of OOD Degradation from Source-Side Training Dynamics
summary: We study whether persistent out-of-distribution (OOD) degradation can be predicted before it is directly observed using only source-side training dynamics. In a controlled shortcut-learning setting, a simple logistic regression predictor develops a clear prospective signal, while training time alone does not. Temporal summaries of the source-side quantities are substantially more informative than their current values. When transferred without additional training from a CNN to an MLP, confidence and entropy dynamics retain substantial predictive information. These results provide a proof of principle that source-side training dynamics can contain an early warning signal for future OOD failure.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究能否仅利用源端训练动态，在直接观测到分布外（OOD）性能退化之前进行预测。在受控的捷径学习设定中，简单的逻辑回归预测器展现出清晰的预期性信号，而仅凭训练时间则不能。源端量的时间摘要比其当前值信息量更大。从 CNN 迁移到 MLP 时，置信度和熵动态仍保留显著预测信息，为源端训练动态包含未来 OOD 失败的早期预警信号提供了原理性验证。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于：OOD 退化通常在部署后才会被观测到，事后发现代价高昂。若能提前预警，可为模型选择、训练调整或部署决策提供依据。因此作者希望验证在某些条件下，无需访问目标域数据、仅依赖源端训练动态，是否就能预测未来 OOD 失败。
AI.method: 方法上采用受控的捷径学习（shortcut-learning）设定，仅使用源端训练过程中的动态量。以简单的逻辑回归作为预测器，对比时间摘要（temporal summaries）与当前值的信息量，并与仅使用训练时间作为基线进行比较。进一步在无额外训练的情况下，将从 CNN 学得的预测能力迁移到 MLP，检验置信度和熵动态的预测信息是否保留。
AI.result: 结果显示，逻辑回归预测器在受控捷径学习设定下形成清晰的预期性信号，而训练时间单独不具此能力。源端量的时间摘要显著优于其当前值。无额外训练地从 CNN 迁移到 MLP 时，置信度和熵动态仍保持可观的预测信息。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：源端训练动态可能包含对未来 OOD 失败的早期预警信号，构成一项原理性证明（proof of principle）。表明可在直接观测退化之前，仅凭源端训练动态进行预测，为后续扩展与实用化预警方法奠定基础。

title: Learning Kilometer-Scale Weather Prediction with Global-Regional Alignment
summary: Kilometer-scale regional weather forecasting is essential for local weather warnings and weather-sensitive decisions. Existing data-driven approaches often rely on numerical forecasts for large-scale guidance or require additional training of global forecasting components. Pretrained global weather models offer an efficient source of large-scale forecasts, motivating their reuse to guide high-resolution regional prediction. However, this coupling requires aligning global and regional representations across different grids and integrating global guidance with local interactions to advance regional states. We propose ScaleCast, a regional forecasting framework that addresses these challenges through Global-Regional Alignment. Its Global-Regional Conversion module aligns joint global and regional representations with regional locations, while the Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics block combines aligned guidance with regional neighborhood interactions. Experiments using ERA5 global analyses on a 0.25-degree grid and CERRA regional reanalysis at 5.5 km spacing demonstrate improved regional forecasts across surface and upper-air variables, with a single trained model supporting multiple global forecast drivers (i.e., Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES) without specific retraining. Fine-tuning on HRRR at 3 km spacing further demonstrates the framework's adaptability to a different regional domain and spatial resolution. Windstorm case studies show improved cyclone positioning and core-pressure estimates, while comparisons with HadISD station observations show closer agreement with local temperature and humidity changes.

AI.tldr: ScaleCast是一个区域天气预报框架，通过全球-区域对齐（Global-Regional Alignment）复用预训练全球模型的大尺度预报，实现公里级高分辨率区域预报。
AI.motivation: 公里级区域天气预报对局地预警和天气敏感决策至关重要。现有数据驱动方法依赖数值预报提供大尺度引导，或需额外训练全球预报组件，成本高。预训练全球天气模型可作为高效的大尺度预报来源，但复用时需解决全球与区域表征在不同网格间的对齐，以及将全球引导与局地相互作用融合以推进区域状态的问题。
AI.method: 提出ScaleCast框架，核心为全球-区域对齐机制：(1) Global-Regional Conversion模块将联合的全球与区域表征对齐到区域位置；(2) Global-Regional Alignment and Dynamics模块将对齐后的引导与区域邻域相互作用相结合。
AI.result: 在ERA5全球分析（0.25°网格）与CERRA区域再分析（5.5 km）上，对地面和高空变量均改进区域预报；单一训练模型无需特定重训练即可支持多种全球预报驱动（Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES）。在HRRR（3 km）上微调进一步验证了框架对不同区域域和空间分辨率的适应性。风暴案例显示气旋定位和核心气压估计改进；与HadISD站点观测比较显示对局地温湿变化吻合更近。
AI.conclusion: ScaleCast通过全球-区域对齐有效复用预训练全球模型，实现高分辨率区域预报，具备多驱动兼容性与跨域跨分辨率适应性，并在风暴定位与站点观测一致性上表现更优。

title: A Unified Bellman Operator for Safety-Critical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning in safety-critical domains requires maximizing task performance while strictly adhering to safety constraints. Existing safe reinforcement learning paradigms typically force a trade-off: they either require a priori knowledge to provide strict safety guarantees (e.g., safety filters), or they enable joint learning but only satisfy safety constraints on average. In this work, we propose a novel Bellman operator that unifies performance and safety objectives into a joint value function. We show that temporal difference learning with the joint Bellman operator converges under a two-timescale stochastic approximation framework. On the fast timescale, the safety value of the learning joint policy is estimated, while the joint value is estimated on the slow timescale. Convergence is ensured by formulating the limiting dynamics as an occupation-averaged differential inclusion, and showing that it asymptotically converges to a set of limiting optimal safety-constrained task value functions. Theoretically, once converged, the resulting optimal policy maximizes task return while maintaining safety at all times. Empirical evaluations on continuous control tasks with neural approximations demonstrate stable convergence with near-zero safety violations at test time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的贝尔曼算子，将性能与安全目标统一到联合价值函数中，并证明基于该算子的时序差分学习在双时间尺度随机逼近框架下收敛，最终得到既最大化任务回报又始终满足安全约束的最优策略。
AI.motivation: 安全关键领域要求强化学习在最大化任务性能的同时严格满足安全约束。现有安全强化学习范式存在两难：要么依赖先验知识（如安全滤波器）才能提供严格安全保证，要么支持联合学习但仅能在平均意义上满足安全约束。
AI.method: 提出一种联合贝尔曼算子，将性能与安全目标融合为联合价值函数；采用双时间尺度随机逼近框架进行时序差分学习：快时间尺度估计学习策略的安全价值，慢时间尺度估计联合价值；通过将极限动态建模为占用平均微分包含（occupation-averaged differential inclusion）来保证收敛。
AI.result: 理论上证明极限动态渐近收敛到一组受限最优安全约束任务价值函数；收敛后的最优策略在最大化任务回报的同时始终维持安全性。在连续控制任务上使用神经网络逼近的实验表明算法收敛稳定，测试阶段安全违规接近零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过统一的联合贝尔曼算子与双时间尺度收敛分析，弥合了严格安全保证与联合学习之间的鸿沟，实现了既保证安全又优化性能的安全强化学习。

title: Rounding in Preconditioner Space: Redesigning 4-bit AdamW Optimizer-State Quantization
summary: Quantizing AdamW's optimizer states reduces persistent storage, but quantization errors propagate through the moment recurrences and perturb subsequent adaptive updates. We redesign 4-bit optimizer-state quantization for AdamW from the perspective of \emph{rounding space}: the coordinate in which a quantizer chooses between adjacent reconstruction levels. For the second moment, a local analysis of the quantization cell adjacent to zero shows that small mean state error need not imply small mean preconditioner error at the next step. A one-dimensional quadratic construction further shows qualitatively different optimization dynamics under state-space and preconditioner-space rounding. These results motivate Zero-Inclusive Preconditioner-space Stochastic Rounding (\textbf{ZIP-SR}), which retains zero in the second-moment codebook and computes stochastic-rounding probabilities in preconditioner space. As a complementary route, Zero-Excluding EDEN calibration (\textbf{ZE-EDEN}) uses a zero-excluding second-moment codebook and rescales the quantized second-moment block to mitigate the preconditioner distortion caused by the positive quantization floor. Both configurations use 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) for the first moment, with targeted stochastic rounding of the LM-head first moment during the final 10\% of training. Across GPT- and Llama-style pretraining experiments ranging from \textbf{130M} to \textbf{2.7B} parameters, both methods reduce TorchAO 4-bit AdamW's mean validation-loss gap to 32-bit AdamW at every evaluated model size, with the largest reported gap reduction reaching \textbf{70\%}. In full-parameter supervised fine-tuning, both recipes achieve lower validation loss than TorchAO while remaining close to 32-bit AdamW on downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文从"舍入空间"视角重新设计AdamW的4比特优化器状态量化，提出ZIP-SR与ZE-EDEN两种方案，在130M-2.7B模型上均缩小了与32比特AdamW的验证损失差距，最大降幅达70%。
AI.motivation: 量化AdamW优化器状态可降低持久化存储开销，但量化误差会沿动量递推传播并干扰后续自适应更新，因此需要从舍入空间角度重新设计量化方案以抑制误差累积。
AI.method: 从"舍入空间"（量化器在相邻重建电平间选择时所处的坐标）视角重新设计4比特优化器状态量化。对二阶动量，局部分析零附近量化单元，表明小的状态均值误差不一定对应下一步小的预条件子均值误差；并通过一维二次构造展示状态空间与预条件子空间舍入会导致质上不同的优化动力学。据此提出ZIP-SR（在二阶矩码本中保留零、在预条件子空间计算随机舍入概率）与ZE-EDEN（采用排除零的二阶矩码本并重缩放量化后的二阶矩块以缓解正量化下限造成的预条件子畸变）。两者一阶矩均采用4比特NF4，并在训练最后10%对LM-head一阶矩做定向随机舍入。
AI.result: 在130M至2.7B参数的GPT与Llama风格预训练实验中，两种方法在各评测模型规模上均缩小了TorchAO 4比特AdamW相对32比特AdamW的平均验证损失差距，最大差距缩减达70%。全参数监督微调中，两种方案验证损失低于TorchAO，下游任务表现接近32比特AdamW。
AI.conclusion: 舍入空间的选择（状态空间 vs. 预条件子空间）是4比特AdamW量化设计的关键因素，ZIP-SR与ZE-EDEN通过预条件子空间舍入及相应码本设计，有效抑制了量化误差传播，在预训练与微调中均优于TorchAO基线。

title: Caught in the Act: Probes Effectively Detect Sabotage and Catch Unverbalized Deception
comment: 11 pages main text, 98 pages total; 18 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/AlignmentResearch/caught-in-the-act-probes
summary: Recent incidents have highlighted the challenge of monitoring LLM agents and the danger of models deceiving people. We show that white-box deception detection via probes can be scaled up to frontier monitoring settings by collecting the largest deception dataset to date for training probes and introducing a novel probe architecture which can aggregate information across many layers and tokens. Our probes achieve 98.8% AUC in SHADE-Arena, surpassing an Opus 5.5 text-monitoring baseline, and show improved efficacy as the underlying model is scaled up. To push our probes to their limit, we test them on several cases where deception cannot be determined from the context alone. In these cases, which we refer to as introspective deception, the ground truth can only be determined through careful elicitation or thorough knowledge of a model's training data. In one such evaluation, we show that probes can distinguish transcripts containing a model's true hidden goal from other goals with an AUC of up to 99.7%. Our probes also readily detect deception on prominent open-weight models which lie about politically sensitive topics, and about their beliefs when put under pressure. We release our training dataset, dubbed FIBS, to help drive frontier deployment of effective probes, and encourage the community to expand upon it with further examples of deception and sabotage.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建迄今最大的欺骗数据集FIBS并提出可跨层、跨token聚合信息的探针架构，将白盒欺骗检测扩展到前沿监控场景，在SHADE-Arena取得98.8% AUC，并在"内省式欺骗"等难以从上下文判断的场景中实现最高99.7% AUC的检测。
AI.motivation: 近期事件凸显了对LLM智能体进行监控的困难，以及模型欺骗人类的风险。白盒探针式欺骗检测虽有前景，但难以扩展到前沿监控所需的规模与复杂度，因此需要更大规模的数据与更强的探针架构。
AI.method: 1) 收集迄今规模最大的欺骗数据集（FIBS）用于训练探针；2) 提出一种新颖的探针架构，能够跨多个层和多个token聚合信息；3) 将探针应用于包含"内省式欺骗"（introspective deception，即仅凭上下文无法判定真值，需借助引导式提问或对训练数据的深入了解）的评测；4) 在开源权重模型上的政治敏感话题撒谎与受压时关于自身信念的表述上进行检测。
AI.result: 探针在SHADE-Arena上达到98.8% AUC，超过Opus 5.5文本监控基线；随着底层模型规模增大，探针效果反而提升；在内省式欺骗评测中，探针区分含模型真实隐藏目标的对话记录与其他目标的AUC最高达99.7%；也可有效检测开源权重模型在政治敏感话题及受压情境下的欺骗行为。
AI.conclusion: 白盒探针检测可通过大规模数据与跨层跨token聚合架构成功扩展到前沿监控场景，并在难以从上下文判定真值的欺骗类型上依然有效。作者发布FIBS数据集以推动探针在前沿部署中的实际应用，并鼓励社区补充更多欺骗与破坏行为的样本。

title: Bi-FORK: Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Bifurcating Systems
summary: Bifurcations are ubiquitous in physical systems, from structural buckling to fluid and climate dynamics, yet they remain largely unexplored in deep learning. At a symmetry-breaking bifurcation, a single input admits multiple equally valid solutions, violating the one-to-one assumption underlying most learned physical surrogates. We introduce Bi-FORK, a generative framework for learning these one-to-many solution maps in high-dimensional systems. Bi-FORK generates complete trajectories through latent flow matching, preserving space and time coherence, and uses repulsion-guided sampling to recover distinct solution branches in a single amortized pass. We evaluate Bi-FORK on buckling beams, mechanical metamaterials, and Allen-Cahn phase separation, spanning continuous, discrete, and field-valued bifurcations with discretizations up to 260,000 points. Bi-FORK recovers the multimodal solution structure while scaling several orders of magnitude beyond prior approaches, opening generative modeling to high-dimensional bifurcating physical systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Bi-FORK生成框架，用隐空间流匹配与排斥引导采样学习高维物理系统中分岔的"一对多"解映射，在屈曲梁、力学超材料与Allen-Cahn相分离上验证，可处理高达26万点离散化。
AI.motivation: 分岔在物理系统中普遍存在，但在深度学习领域尚未被充分探索。在对称性破缺分岔处，单个输入对应多个同等有效的解，违反了多数学习型物理代理模型所依赖的一对一假设，因此需要新方法来建模这种一对多的解映射，尤其是在高维系统中。
AI.method: 提出生成式框架Bi-FORK：通过隐空间流匹配（latent flow matching）生成完整轨迹，保持空间与时间连贯性；并采用排斥引导采样（repulsion-guided sampling），在一次摊销推理中恢复不同解分支。
AI.result: 在屈曲梁、力学超材料与Allen-Cahn相分离三类案例上评估，覆盖连续型、离散型与场值型分岔，离散化规模最高达260,000点。Bi-FORK能够恢复多峰解结构，且规模较此前方法扩展数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Bi-FORK将生成式建模引入高维分岔物理系统，成功学习一对多解映射并显著扩展可处理规模，为深度学习在分岔问题上的应用开辟了方向。

title: Whose Ground Truth? Embracing Ambiguity in Human-Centered AI
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
summary: As AI systems increasingly interact with people and make decisions about them, understanding human interpretations becomes an important part of developing human-centered AI. Conventional machine learning and AI systems are largely developed under the assumption that a single definitive ground truth exists, with variability in human annotations often resolved through aggregation or treated as noise. However, for many human-centered tasks, human interpretation is inherently ambiguous, and multiple interpretations of the same input may be simultaneously reasonable and valid. Reducing such ambiguity to a single target risks overlooking meaningful information about the diversity of human perception, judgment, and experience. In this position paper, we call for a shift towards modeling the interpretation space of plausible human judgments, while distinguishing meaningful ambiguity from annotation noise. We argue that this perspective should guide how AI systems are represented, learned, evaluated, deployed, and governed, supporting more human-centered AI that better reflects the diversity of human interpretation.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，主张AI应从"单一确定真值"转向建模"人类解释空间"，并区分有意义的歧义与标注噪声。
AI.motivation: AI系统日益与人交互并对其做出决策，理解人类解释成为以人为中心的AI开发的重要环节。传统机器学习假定存在单一确定真值（ground truth），通常通过聚合消除标注差异或将其视为噪声；但对许多以人为中心的任务，人类解释本身具有固有的歧义，同一输入的多种解释可能同时合理有效，压缩为单一目标会丢失关于人类感知、判断与经验多样性的有意义信息。
AI.method: 作为立场论文（position paper），主要通过论证而非实验：提出应转向建模"合理解释空间"（interpretation space of plausible human judgments），并强调需将有意义的歧义与标注噪声加以区分；论证这一视角应贯穿AI系统的表示、学习、评估、部署与治理等各个环节。
AI.result: 论文为立场性论述，未报告实证结果，其核心"结论"即提出建模解释空间的框架性主张，并倡导将区分歧义与噪声的原则应用于AI全生命周期。
AI.conclusion: 应推动AI从追求单一真值转向建模人类合理解释的空间，同时区分真实歧义与噪声；该视角可指导AI的表示、学习、评估、部署与治理，从而构建更贴合人类解释多样性、更以人为本的AI。

title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI. 23 pages
summary: We study whether small LLM agents can operate effectively under explicit wall-clock time budgets by both respecting the allocated runtime and using available time productively. We evaluate Qwen3.6-27B on five competitions from MLE-Bench Lite and Qwen3-4B on Zork I (Jericho), two agentic benchmarks where additional computational time can meaningfully improve performance. In the simplest setting, where the budget is stated only in the prompt, agents fail to translate the stated budget into controlled use of time. These failures arise from gaps in time awareness, since the harness provides no timing feedback, but also because they cannot reliably anticipate the duration of actions, and do not have a learned mapping from available time to an appropriate strategy. We investigate two complementary classes of interventions: harness-based mechanisms that expose timing information and enforce deadlines, and reinforcement learning with budget-aware rewards. Injecting timing information through the harness substantially improves budget adherence for Qwen3.6-27B without measurable loss in performance, while enforcement hooks tighten adherence further. RL with GRPO achieves near-perfect budget adherence on Zork I and generalizes to held-out budgets not seen during training, but does not improve task performance over the untrained harness on MLE-Bench. Once agents are made to respect the budget, they still fail to use additional time to improve task performance. RL-trained policies learn when to stop but often fill extra time with repeated actions, and GRPO training on multiple budgets tends to collapse toward the strategy learned for the shortest budget. Our results reveal a gap between time adherence and productive time allocation, which remains a central challenge for budget-conditioned agents.

AI.tldr: 小型LLM智能体在明确墙钟时间预算下能遵守时限，但无法有效利用时间提升任务表现，时间合规与有效时间分配之间存在显著鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 研究小型LLM智能体能否在显式墙钟时间预算下既遵守运行时限制、又有效利用可用时间；现有智能体缺乏时间意识与预算映射能力，故需探究干预手段是否能弥合这一缺口。
AI.method: 在MLE-Bench Lite的五个竞赛上评估Qwen3.6-27B、在Zork I (Jericho)上评估Qwen3-4B；对比两类干预：(1) harness层面的机制，包括暴露计时信息与强制执行截止时间；(2) 采用预算感知奖励的强化学习（GRPO）。
AI.result: 仅提示中给出预算时，智能体无法将预算转化为受控的时间使用，原因包括缺乏计时反馈、难以预判动作时长、缺少时间到策略的学习映射；harness注入计时信息显著提升Qwen3.6-27B的预算遵守度且无明显性能损失，强制执行钩子进一步提升遵守度；GRPO在Zork I上达到近乎完美的预算遵守并能泛化到未见预算，但在MLE-Bench上未优于未训练harness；遵守预算后智能体仍无法用额外时间提升表现，RL策略学会何时停止却常用重复动作填充时间，多预算GRPO训练倾向坍缩到最短预算策略。
AI.conclusion: 时间合规与有效时间分配之间存在鸿沟，仍是预算条件智能体的核心挑战；harness干预在合规上有效，但塑造生产性时间利用仍需进一步研究。

title: Curating Always-Loaded Context for LLM Agents: A Capacitated Assortment Model with Censored Feedback
summary:
At the start of every session, LLM agents load a fixed context file, such as $\texttt{AGENTS.md}$. Each loaded token in the file is charged again in every later round of the session, and these files can degrade performance as they grow in size. However, in practice, human or automated curators usually grow these files by appending.
  We formulate context curation as a capacitated assortment problem. Instructions consume tokens under a finite attention capacity; adding an instruction never raises the compliance of the others, while retained instructions incur a per-session setup cost.
  We prove an upper bound on the optimal file size, regardless of the number of available candidate instructions, and that appending every instruction with positive standalone value can be arbitrarily worse in net value than selecting an optimal subset. A token budget also limits the loss when the token price is underestimated.
  We then examine what can be learned from past sessions and how this information can guide decisions to add or remove instructions. Feedback is inherently censored: the benefits and harms of loaded instructions are observable, whereas missing instructions generate feedback only when their absence causes harm.
  In this setting, we show that deleting instructions ignored by agents can inevitably remove helpful ones. We characterize how much evidence should be collected before adding an instruction. Besides, we bound regret when human reviewers can inspect only a limited number of edits per period. Empirical experiments further show that irrelevant rules drawn from real context files reduce language-model compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM智能体的上下文文件整理形式化为带容量约束的选品问题，证明最优文件规模存在上界，并指出"有正面价值即追加"的策略可能远劣于最优子集选择，进而分析基于历史会话反馈的增删规则及有限审查预算下的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体每次会话都加载固定的上下文文件（如AGENTS.md），文件中每个token在后续每轮都会被重复计费，且文件增大反而会降低模型遵循指令的表现；但实践中人工或自动策展者通常采用"追加"方式扩张文件，缺乏理论依据。因此需要为上下文整理建立形式化优化框架。
AI.method: 将上下文整理建模为带容量约束的选品问题（capacitated assortment problem）：指令消耗有限注意力容量下的token，新增指令不会提升其他指令的遵循度，保留的指令产生每次会话的固定开销。在此基础上进行理论分析，证明最优文件规模上界、追加策略的次优性，并研究反馈的截断（censored）特性——已加载指令的收益与危害可观测，而未加载指令仅在其缺失造成损害时才产生反馈。
AI.result: 证明了两点：一是无论候选指令数量多少，最优文件规模存在上界；二是对所有具有正独立价值的指令一律追加，其净价值可能任意劣于最优子集选择；token预算可限制token价格被低估时的损失。在截断反馈下，证明删除智能体忽略的指令会不可避免地误删有用指令，刻画出添加某指令前需收集的证据量，并在人类审阅者每期只能检查有限编辑数时给出遗憾上界。实证表明，真实上下文文件中抽取的无关规则会降低语言模型的遵循度。
AI.conclusion: 上下文文件的"只增不减"式策展在理论上和实证上都非最优：最优文件规模受限，追加全部正价值指令可能严重次优。反馈的截断性使得删除决策存在固有风险，添加决策需积累足够证据，审查资源有限下可给出遗憾保证。该框架为上下文文件的增删策略提供了理论指导与实证支撑。

title: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Tasks
summary: Computer-use agents are capable of completing complex tasks, increasing the use of automatic judges to determine success, either for training or for evaluation without human involvement. Despite their flexibility, their reliability on long tasks spanning multiple applications remains unclear. A trajectory, composed of long sequences of screenshots and actions, may appear complete, but in reality violates constraints from the instruction or introduces an unwanted side effect. To identify these errors, a judge needs to examine the trajectory with respect to the user's instruction. To this end, we introduce AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 computer-use tasks (instruction-trajectory pairs) drawn from 166 hours of human-recorded trajectories spanning three operating systems. By recording trajectories for closely related instructions, we can construct negative tasks by swapping the instructions. This paired design evaluates judges on their ability to distinguish a successful trajectory from one that completed a similar (but incompatible) request. We release the benchmark under three splits: a frontier split, AgentHorizon (AH), a simplified split, AgentHorizon-Simple (AH-S), and a development split, AgentHorizon-Development (AH-D). We further evaluate eleven judges by (1) directly passing the full trajectory (with up to 300 screenshots and actions), and (2) using them as coding agents across five agent harnesses. We find that our best agentic judge, GPT-5.5, achieves 80.9% balanced accuracy on the AH subset. We find that tool-use improves certain models but results in worse performance for open-weight models, and that judges differ drastically in their ability to accept a valid trajectory and reject failed ones. Our findings highlight the need for judges that are capable of locating and verifying often hidden evidence that a task was properly completed inside long interaction histories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentHorizon 基准，用 1,373 个跨三操作系统的计算机使用任务（指令-轨迹对）评估自动评判器能否区分“真正完成”与“完成了相似但不兼容请求”的轨迹；在 AH 子集上最佳 agentic judge（GPT-5.5）达 80.9% 平衡准确率，并发现工具使用对闭源模型有益、对开放权重模型反而有害。
AI.motivation: 随着 computer-use agents 承担复杂长程任务，自动评判器（automatic judges）被广泛用于训练与无人工评测，但其在多应用长任务上的可靠性不明。长序列截屏与动作构成的轨迹表面上可能像已完成，实则违反指令约束或引入非预期副作用；评判器需结合用户指令审查轨迹，而现有基准缺乏对这类隐蔽错误的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 AgentHorizon 基准：1,373 个计算机使用任务（指令-轨迹对），源自 166 小时人类录制的轨迹，覆盖三种操作系统。通过对相近指令录制轨迹并交换指令，构造负样本任务，形成配对设计，用以检验评判器能否区分成功轨迹与完成相似但不兼容请求的轨迹。数据集分三个 split：AH（frontier）、AH-S（简化）、AH-D（开发）。对 11 个评判器采用两种评测方式：(1) 直接输入完整轨迹（最多 300 张截图与动作）；(2) 将其作为 coding agents 搭配五种 agent harness 使用。
AI.result: 最佳 agentic judge（GPT-5.5）在 AH 子集上取得 80.9% 平衡准确率；tool-use 可提升部分模型，但对开放权重模型性能反而下降；不同评判器在“接受有效轨迹”与“拒绝失败轨迹”两方面差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有评判器在长交互历史中定位并验证任务是否真正完成（往往证据隐蔽）的能力仍不足，亟需发展能定位与核实隐藏证据的评判器。

title: DivMoE: Fine-Grained MoE Upcycling via Cross-Domain Expert Composition
comment: 19 pages, published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become essential for scaling large language models, with recent work demonstrating the benefits of fine-grained expert designs. Training such models from scratch is expensive, and sparse upcycling from pre-trained dense models is an attractive alternative. However, we identify a structural pathology of fine-grained upcycling: when fine-grained experts are derived from a single source model, naive routing collapses and downstream accuracy drops to near-random (e.g., on Qwen3-1.7B, Drop-Upcycling-fine-grained reaches only 23.2% average accuracy across 15 benchmarks, essentially matching from-scratch training at 22.2%, while the same method's coarse-grained variant reaches 50.2%). We propose DivMoE, the first framework achieving fine-grained MoE Upcycling with structurally-balanced routing. DivMoE introduces domain-specialized fine-grained expert initialization, deriving experts from dense models that have undergone domain-adaptive continual pre-training, and diversity-constrained routing, a hard structural constraint guaranteeing that each token activates experts from distinct domain groups. Across two base models and 15 benchmarks, DivMoE consistently outperforms six upcycling baselines (55.6% vs. 51.6% for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B) and strictly improves over the dense base model on every benchmark after Stage 2 continual pre-training -- closing the regression gap that has plagued prior fine-grained upcycling. After supervised fine-tuning on a public reasoning mixture, our 12B-parameter DivMoE model matches Moonlight-MoE (16B) at 64.5% average accuracy while outperforming a controlled NVIDIA-Upcycling baseline by 6.1 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DivMoE，首个在细粒度MoE上采样中实现结构均衡路由的框架：通过领域特化的细粒度专家初始化和多样性约束路由，解决了细粒度上采样中路由坍塌问题，在15个基准上一致优于六个基线，并在12B规模匹配Moonlight-MoE(16B)。
AI.motivation: 从零训练大规模MoE代价高昂，从预训练密集模型进行稀疏上采样（sparse upcycling）是有吸引力的替代方案。但作者发现细粒度上采样存在结构性病理：当细粒度专家源自单一源模型时，朴素路由会坍塌，下游准确率降至接近随机水平（Qwen3-1.7B上仅23.2%，与从零训练的22.2%相当，而同方法粗粒度变体可达50.2%）。
AI.method: DivMoE包含两个核心组件：(1) 领域特化的细粒度专家初始化，专家来自经过领域自适应持续预训练的密集模型；(2) 多样性约束路由，一种硬结构约束，保证每个token激活的专家来自不同的领域组。此外还包含Stage 2持续预训练阶段。
AI.result: 在两个基座模型和15个基准上，DivMoE一致优于六个上采样基线（Qwen3-1.7B上55.6% vs 最强基线51.6%），并在Stage 2持续预训练后在每个基准上严格优于密集基座模型，弥合了此前细粒度上采样的退化差距。在公开推理混合数据上监督微调后，12B参数的DivMoE模型以64.5%的平均准确率匹配Moonlight-MoE(16B)，同时超越受控NVIDIA-Upcycling基线6.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DivMoE是首个实现结构均衡路由的细粒度MoE上采样框架，通过领域特化专家初始化和多样性约束路由有效解决细粒度上采样的路由坍塌问题，在多个基座模型和基准上取得一致提升，并在参数效率上具有竞争力（12B匹配16B模型）。

title: RaReCache: Bridging the Gap in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse via Rank disagreement-based Selective Recomputation
summary: Cross-model KV-cache reuse remains a key challenge in modern LLM serving. Coding agents and multi-model systems increasingly route a shared context across models: a user may switch models mid-session, or a cascade may escalate a difficult query. Because KV caches contain model-specific representations, each switch typically forces the receiving model to prefill the entire context from scratch. Recent work shows that closed-form linear maps can translate KV caches between models in the same family, but transfer accuracy degrades as the model-size gap widens. In this paper, we establish that these transfer failures are concentrated in a small subset of information-dense tokens. To bridge this gap, we introduce RaReCache, a framework that enables a large target model to decode accurately from a cache prefilled by a much smaller source via selective recomputation. RaReCache identifies these critical positions using a novel rank disagreement metric, scoring each token by the energy of its mapped KV in output directions weakly supported by the calibration data. Across two model families and five benchmarks, on a 23x parameter gap (Qwen3-0.6B to 14B) recomputing just 30% of positions retains 95-99% of the target accuracy, whereas on a 8.8x gap (Llama3-8B to 70B), recomputing 40% retains 96.5% of the target accuracy. RaReCache largely removes sensitivity to source-model size, and achieves up to a 3.04x prefill speedup. For online serving, it handles 1.8x the request throughput of target prefill on a single GPU, and at the target's saturation load, reduces median and 99th-percentile time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 5.0x and 6.4x respectively, with a 30% recompute budget. RaReCache establishes an efficient serving paradigm where small models prefill on behalf of massive targets, enabling large models to recompute only critical tokens, drastically reducing prefill latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 RaReCache 框架，通过秩不一致度量识别关键 token 并选择性重计算，实现小模型预填、大模型跨模型 KV 缓存复用，显著降低预填延迟。
AI.motivation: 现代 LLM 服务中，编码智能体与多模型系统常在模型间路由共享上下文（如会话中途切换模型、级联升级困难查询）。由于 KV 缓存含模型特定表示，每次切换都需接收模型从头预填整个上下文，开销巨大。已有工作表明同族模型间可用闭式线性映射转换 KV 缓存，但随着模型规模差距增大，迁移精度下降。
AI.method: 论文先定位迁移失败集中于少数信息密集 token。为此提出 RaReCache：利用一种新颖的秩不一致度量，根据映射后 KV 在标定数据支持较弱的输出方向上的能量对每个 token 打分，从而识别关键位置，仅对这些位置进行选择性重计算，使大目标模型能基于远小于其规模的源模型预填的缓存准确解码。
AI.result: 在两个模型族、五个基准上：23 倍参数差距（Qwen3-0.6B 到 14B）仅重算 30% 位置即可保留目标精度的 95-99%；8.8 倍差距（Llama3-8B 到 70B）重算 40% 保留 96.5%。基本消除了对源模型规模的敏感性，预填加速最高达 3.04 倍。在线服务中单 GPU 吞吐为目标预填的 1.8 倍；在目标饱和负载下，30% 重算预算使中位与 99 分位 TTFT 分别降低 5.0 倍和 6.4 倍。
AI.conclusion: RaReCache 建立了高效的serving范式：小模型替大规模目标模型预填，大模型仅重算关键 token，大幅降低预填延迟，缓解了跨模型 KV 缓存复用中的规模差距瓶颈。

title: Estimating great expectations under autoregressive language models with potentials
summary: Many applications of language models hinge not on individual samples but on the expectation of a test functional under the model. Estimating such expectations reliably can be computationally expensive. In this paper, we show how to make estimation more efficient by exploiting the next-token conditional probabilities which are available as a by-product of sampling. We do so through potentials: real-valued functions on prefixes that decompose the test functional additively. We construct an estimator whose variance depends on the chosen potential, and derive conditions under which a potential reduces this variance. We then develop practical potentials for several estimands and applications, and demonstrate substantial variance reductions across several estimands at comparable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用采样过程中自然获得的下一词条件概率，通过构造“势函数”（分解测试泛函的前缀实值函数）来降低语言模型期望估计的方差，并给出方差降低条件及实用势函数构造。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的许多应用依赖于测试泛函在模型分布下的期望，而非单样本；直接蒙特卡洛估计此类期望计算成本高昂，需提升估计效率。
AI.method: 引入势（prefix上的实值函数），将测试泛函加性分解；构造方差依赖于所选势的估计量；推导势能降低方差的条件；针对多个估计目标与应用设计实用势函数。
AI.result: 在若干估计目标上实现了显著方差降低，且计算成本与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 利用采样副产品（下一词条件概率）并结合势函数可在不增加显著成本下大幅提升期望估计效率，为语言模型期望估计提供了通用方差降低框架。

title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models
summary: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model's current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight. We operationalize this by jointly training the same model to exhibit the following three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems and known solutions, and solving problems using provided ideas. The loop alternates between reverse engineering such ideas from problems with supplied solutions and using these ideas as additional supervision for joint training of all three capabilities. We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种面向推理模型的自改进循环方法，利用"问题+现成解答"反推解题思路，再将思路作为额外监督联合训练三项能力；方法已在Lean定理证明器中实例化，但尚未进行实证评估。
AI.motivation: 当题目难度超出模型当前求解能力时，直接训练或自采样往往无效；但若额外提供解答，模型可以"事后"从中提炼出有价值的解题思路。作者希望利用这一观察，把超出能力范围的题目转化为可用的训练信号，从而突破自改进的数据瓶颈。
AI.method: 核心是训练同一模型具备三种能力：(1) 仅从问题预测解题思路；(2) 从问题+已知解答反向工程出思路；(3) 利用给定思路解题。循环流程为：先从"问题+解答"中反向工程出思路，再把这些思路作为额外监督信号，对三项能力进行联合训练；如此交替迭代。论文给出了方法的形式化描述，并在Lean交互式定理证明器中给出具体实例化。
AI.result: 论文为方法提供了形式化规格说明与在Lean定理证明器中的具体实现方案；其摘要明确指出实证评估仍属未来工作，因此本文尚不报告实验性能数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种基于"事后思路提取"的推理模型自改进范式，通过联合训练预测、反向工程和使用思路三项能力形成闭环，并以Lean作为落地场景。其有效性有待后续实证验证。

title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Science: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. Equal contribution
summary: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过神经算子自适应任务与三类控制干预，证明LLM科学智能体既具备任务相关的先验偏好，又能根据实验反馈调整决策。
AI.motivation: 现有研究不清楚LLM科学智能体是仅依赖初始任务上下文，还是能根据实验反馈动态调整决策。作者希望在神经算子自适应这一具体场景中，分离并验证"任务先验"与"反馈响应"两种机制。
AI.method: 让LLM在有限试验预算下选择微调配置，覆盖PDE族内与族间的迁移任务，并与随机搜索和贝叶斯优化对比。通过控制干预进行归因：检验首次配置在随机搜索池中的排名；采用冷启动干预观察基础学习率是否随PDE描述变化；通过重分配验证分数与保值的改写，检验下一次提议是否受影响。
AI.result: 在几乎所有匹配对比中，LLM的留出测试nRMSE低于随机搜索与贝叶斯优化。首次配置在未见验证分数前已接近随机搜索池的顶部；冷启动下所选基础学习率随PDE描述变化；重分配验证分数在所有测试情形下改变下一次提议，而保值的改写未产生可比的总体效应。
AI.conclusion: LLM科学智能体的决策层行为同时受任务相关先验和实验反馈驱动，证明其并非仅依赖初始上下文，而是能够对给定任务与观测结果作出适应性响应。

title: HRIL: Learning Multimodal Synergy via Higher-Order Tensor Modeling
summary: Self-supervised multimodal representation learning has achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet capturing synergistic information remains challenging due to the complexity of cross-modal interactions. Unlike the shared information across individual modalities, synergy arises when task-relevant signals emerge only from the joint configuration of multiple modalities and cannot be recovered from any modality in isolation. This work focuses on how to preserve the information capacity for such synergistic signals in multimodal representations. The key observation is that synergistic information is reflected in higher-order statistical dependence among modalities, which provides a principled target for explicitly modeling joint interactions. Motivated by this insight, we propose Higher-order Representation and Information Learning (HRIL), which constructs an empirical cross-moment tensor over modality embeddings to represent multi-way interactions. HRIL employs Tucker decomposition to obtain a core tensor, complemented by a synergy-aware regularizer that prevents energy concentration and preserves higher-order coupling capacity for synergistic information capture. Experiments on the controlled synergy task and real-world benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing multimodal contrastive methods, with notable gains on tasks dominated by synergistic interactions. Code is released at https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HRIL方法，通过构建模态嵌入的经验交叉矩张量并用Tucker分解提取核心张量，结合协同感知正则化器，以保留多模态表征中的高阶协同信息容量。
AI.motivation: 自监督多模态表征学习已取得显著成功，但捕捉模态间的协同信息仍具挑战。协同信息不同于单个模态的共享信息，它仅在多模态联合配置下出现，无法从任何单一模态中恢复。核心问题是如何在多模态表征中保留这类协同信号的信息容量。
AI.method: 关键观察在于协同信息反映在模态间的高阶统计依赖性中，可为显式建模联合交互提供原理性目标。基于此提出HRIL（Higher-order Representation and Information Learning）：构建模态嵌入上的经验交叉矩张量以表示多路交互；采用Tucker分解获得核心张量；并辅以协同感知正则化器，防止能量集中，保留高阶耦合容量以捕捉协同信息。
AI.result: 在受控协同任务和真实世界基准上，HRIL相较现有多模态对比方法取得一致提升，在由协同交互主导的任务上增益尤为显著。代码已在 https://github.com/brightest66/HRIL 发布。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模模态间高阶统计依赖并保留高阶耦合容量，HRIL有效提升了协同信息的表征能力，验证了以高阶统计依赖性作为协同信息建模目标的合理性。

title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
summary: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. Because data is generated through the same environment that defines what is valid, STS guarantees structural validity by construction while decoupling validity enforcement from distribution modeling, allowing each to be addressed independently. The **Generalist Populator** (GP), STS's domain-agnostic agent, addresses the remaining challenges of distributional fidelity and synthesis scalability: GP achieves **0.88** average marginal fidelity and **100\% constraint satisfaction** across all ten environments *without access to DB schemas*, while statistical synthesizers are inapplicable to seven due to necessary seed data requirements, and schema-privileged agents fail 82\% of trajectories on airline environment's tightly coupled workflows due to brittle task composition. We open-source the full framework, all ten environments, and generated datasets at https://github.com/SAP/synthesis-through-simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需数据库 schema 的数据合成范式“Synthesis Through Simulation”(STS)：让 LLM 智能体在具有策略约束的模拟企业环境中调用 API 来生成数据，从而在构造上保证结构有效性与约束满足，同时解耦有效性与分布建模。配套的通用填充智能体 GP 在十个环境下实现 0.88 平均边际保真度和 100% 约束满足。
AI.motivation: 企业级工具调用智能体的训练与评估受到业务与法律限制，难以直接使用真实的企业系统、数据和数据库 schema；表格数据合成受制于结构有效性和 schema 可得性，而基于流程的方法虽然有效性较好，却缺乏分布保真度且需要逐域人工编写。
AI.method: 提出 STS 范式：在模拟企业环境中，LLM 智能体通过执行针对强制性策略 API 的操作来生成数据；由于数据由定义“何为有效”的同一环境生成，结构有效性由构造保证，且有效性与分布建模解耦。设计域无关智能体 Generalist Populator (GP)，在无 DB schema 条件下解决分布保真度与合成可扩展性问题。
AI.result: GP 在全部十个环境中取得 0.88 平均边际保真度和 100% 约束满足，且无需访问 DB schema；统计合成器因必需种子数据要求，在其中七个环境无法适用；而具备 schema 权限的智能体在 airline 环境紧耦合工作流中，由于任务组合脆弱，有 82% 轨迹失败。研究开源了完整框架、十个环境与生成数据集。
AI.conclusion: STS 通过“以模拟环境生成数据”的方式，实现了无 schema、结构有效、约束满足且具备分布保真度的可扩展数据合成，优于统计合成与 schema 特权智能体方案，为企业工具调用智能体的训练与评估提供了可复用的开源基础设施。
